' yadi tu anya- padārthaḥ padyantaḥ eva saṃbandhī syāt, tato yathaiva ' rāja- puruṣaḥ ' ityatra ṣaṣṭhyantatvāt rājā puruṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, prathamāntatvācca puruṣaḥ pradhānatvena samāsādyau bhavati, evameva citragavādiśabdaiḥ : devadattādiviśiṣṭā gāva eva pratīyeran, na citragoviśiṣṭo devadattādiḥ |

tacca pūrvottarapadārthayoḥ :, nāpi anyatarasya, iti anyapadārtha- bhūtadravyaprādhānyādhyavasānam |

śabdaḥ : sukarasaṃbandho na ca vyabhicāri- pyati ||
' yatra tāvat jātyaiva anyapadārtha upalakṣyate tatra tathaiva ekyā sakṛd gṛhītayā upalakṣitā vyaktyo deśādibhiścāpi abhidhāsyante iti sujñānaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
na ca tadupalakṣitamavya : anyatra prayogaḥ; iti ayyabhi- cāraḥ |

sarvathā dūra- mapi viśeṣaṇamalyāṃ anuvartamānayāṃ prathamolakṣaṇasya abhedāt saṃbandhadarśanaṃ upapadyate |
ataśca piṅgākṣatvābhyāṃ svavyaktyo guṇavayavatvikā lakṣyante, tāmiravayavi dravyaṃ upalakṣyate, tacca samāsādyau bhavati ( iti bahuvrīhissamāsārtha- vicāraḥ :) |
sa punaḥ kiṃ abhidheyaḥ, lākṣaṇikaḥ : iti |
prādhānyena pratīyate : samānādhikaraṇya ' anekaṃmanyapadārthe ' (pā0 2|2|24) iti ca smaraṇāt devatātaddhitatva- rthīyādibhiriva abhidhīyate iti cit |
apare tvāhuḥ; yuktaṃ devatātaddhitau ananyaprayojanatvāt śabdā- dhikyācca anyapadārthābhidhānam |
na ca tatra prātipadi- kārthena so'rthaḥ śakyo lakṣayituṃ vyabhicārāt, kevalaca prātipadikādapratīteḥ |
bahuvrīhau tu pūrvottarayoḥ : padayo- rvidyamānatvāt anyasya ca abhyaviksya śabdā- vayavasya abhāvāt piṅgākṣatvābhyāmeva ca dravyapratyaya- siddheḥ na śakyamabhidheyaṃ kalpayituṃ iti |
karmadhāraye hi etat vyāpitvena syāt, sarvathā lakṣaṇā nimittopapatteḥ |
iha tu citraguḥ ityevamādiṣu citragośabdayoḥ : atyantavyatiriktā- rthīmabhilātvāt devadattādibhiśca na śrutyā lakṣaṇā
prāgapi ca devadattādi- śabdāt anyapadārthapratīteḥ na vākyārthatvakalpanā |
na ca kevalaṃ samāsavelāyāṃ yo padārthau avadhāritau, tau devatā- rthasaṃbandhinau, yato vākyārtho devadattaḥ syāt |
tasmāda- vaśyaṃ pratīteḥ, anyapadārtho'sya vācyaḥ : iti abhyupaganta- vyam |

yattu ekahāyanī iti vayovacana iti, tadanupapannam |
vayaso lakṣaṇā''vagateḥ : ukṣādiśabdānāṃ hi vayovacana- tvam |
ekahāyanīdiśabdāḥ : punaḥ kālaviśeṣayukta- dravyavacanāḥ : santo vayo lakṣyantaḥ : pravartante |
nahi ekaṃ hāyanaṃ asyāḥ : ityevaṃ vayo nirdiśyate, kiṃ tarhi dravyam |

(itaḥ paraṃ bhāṣyavicaraṇam) tasmādupapannaṃ etābhyāṃ ā'maikadeśopāttaguṇaviśiṣṭadravyaprayatnāt upapanno'yaṃ saṃśayaḥ : kiṃ aruṇā krujanaprakaraṇagatakrayādyarthaśeṣa- tvena niviśate, athavā samānavākyasthatvātpadapratyā- yitatvameva ekahāyanyāṃ iti |
atrāpi uddanādivat ākṣepaḥ : saṃyuktaśravaṇāt asārthatrikatve prāpte taṃ pari- harati |
eṣa guṇaḥ : krayeṇa ekahāyanyā vā samāna- vākyopādānāt saṃbadhyate |
tatra tāvat kārakavibhakti- nirdeśāt anāśaṅkanīyatare sati dravyasaṃbandhe krayasaṃbandhaḥ śrutiliyatvāt bhavet |
na cāsau amūrtatvāt niṣkri- yasya guṇasya upapadyate |
yadi tu agatyā punardavye saṃbandhaḥ āśrīyete, tatrāpi ekahāyanyāṃ ' aikasabandhe parārthavat ' (2|4|18) ityevaṃ krayāruṇīmāno prati vairūpyaṃ syāt |
bhinnavibhaktyarthayogaśca asya abhyupagamyatavyaḥ : kriyāsaṃba- ndhasya kārakavibhaktisādhyatvāt, guṇasaṃbandhasya ca pañcya- dhīnatvāt |
ataśca vākyagataṃ saṃbandhanā yogyatāvyābhāvāt asaṃbhavyamānaḥ : prakaraṇinā gṛhītaḥ : sarvārtha syāt ityāśa- ṅkyate |
tena tarhi ayamevārtho niśrīyate iti krayasaṃbandho nāśaṅkitvataḥ : tadarthamāha - ' nāśakanīyamartha pramāṇabhūtaḥ śabdaḥ : abhidhāsyati ' iti |
yadetat samānavākyopādānaṃ karaṇavibhaktinirdeśaśca etenāpi krayahāyanyāviśeṣaṇatva- buddhirddhā jāyate |
tena śabdaprāmāṇyāt vastuvisaṃvā- dācca kiṃ samasasaṃ kimasamañjasaṃ iti jāyate saṃdehe : |
tadyadi kena cit prakāreṇa upapadyate tataḥ kraya eva niveśamaṅgīkari- ṣyāmaḥ |

' atha tu kathaṃ cana upapadyate, tato vākyabheda- mapyapagamya prakaraṇadharmatvena adhyavasyāmaḥ ' ( mūle tu ' atha tu apramādyadbhiḥ : anivyamāṇo ' iti vākyārambhaḥ : ' na kathaṃ cana ' ityādi tu samānam ) |
aruṇā- śabda evaṃ ca bhedo vākyasya gamyate ||
' pṛthak bhavat vākyaṃ medayati iti vākyabhedaḥ : |
etaduktaṃ bhavati, yāvat śrutivākye vyāpriyate, tāvat prakaraṇadharmatvaṃ nāsti |
yadā tu vastuvisaṃvādāt vihitaśaktīnāṃ te nirvyāpāre bhaviṣyataḥ : , tadā prakaraṇaviniyoga iti |

ata eva ca anādikālaprasiddhatvāt asyā lakṣaṇāyāḥ matvalopabhāvena anugamaḥ|
yā tu ādimatī nānyantaprasiddhā, nāśo śāstreṇa anugamyate|
vinā'pi ca anumāt saṃbandhavattaratvena sā kadā cit upa- labhyate|
tadyathā 'madhuro rasaḥ snigdhaḥ śīto guruḥ' iti snigdhaśītatvādīnāṃ guṇāntaraviśeṣatvāt na rasena saṃbandho'sti iti rasalakṣitena dravyeṇa saṃbadhyate|
śuklatvādinā'sya bhāvapratyayaniṣkṛṣṭa- viśeṣyabhūtaguṇavattvāt gandhavadeva nityaṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyena saṃbadhyate|
viśeṣya eva śukletve, śuklo dravyaviśeṣa- paṇam||
tādṛśca niṣkṛṣyate dravyāt paścācca tvatalā- dibhiḥ||
tathā ca śukla ityasya punaranyathā dvirūpatā||
kadā cid guṇamevāha guṇine lakṣyate ka cit|
paṭasya śukla ityatra niṣkṛṣṭo guṇa āśritaḥ|
'liṅgasaṃkhyādi- vacanaśabdaśca dravyaprādhānye vartate vaiyākaraṇānāṃ guṇamuktvā guṇine vartamānatvāt|
na hi vaiyākaraṇānāṃ vaiśeṣika- vat guṇāḥ parisaṃkhyāyante|
śuklādiśabdāśca upasarjana- bhūtameva vadanti, na rūpādiṣaddhāḥ|

bhāṣyakāreṇa tu etameva parihāraṃ manasi kṛtvā uktaṃ 'bhavati hi guṇavacanasyāpi klībatā yathā karuṇābuddhi- śabdayoḥ' (mūle tu 'yathā karuṇā buddhiḥ' iti iti paṭhi- tam) gandhādiśabdatulyāpi caitau pradarśanamātraviśeṣaṇāt udāhṛtau|
etaduktaṃ bhavati, ye'pi tāvat svapradhānaguṇa- vacanāḥ, te'pi kathaṃ cit liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yujyante, kiṃ punaryeṣu dravyaprādhānyam|
evaṃ anayā yuktyā aruṇā iti guṇavacanaḥ|
bhā-- (pṛ. 685) atha yadi krīṇātinā na saṃbadhyate tasminneva vākye ekahāyanīśabdena saṃbhastye, na bhaviṣyati vākyabheda iti|
kevalaṃ hi guṇaṃ aruṇāśabdaḥ abhidhāti, na dravyaguṇau|
kevalaṃ ca dravyaṃ ekahāyanīśabdaḥ, na guṇasahitaṃ, iti tayoḥ saṃbandhasya vācikāṃ paṣṭhīmantareṇa kathaṃ saṃbandho gamyate|
āha, antareṇāpi paṣṭhīṃ ekavibhaktinirdeśāt sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ agamyam|
rūpāt (sāmarthyāt) aruṇāśabdasya guṇavacanatā, kalpanīyaṃ tu ekavibhaktisaṃyogāt ekahāyanīśabdasannidhā- nācca tadekavākyatvābhyupagamya ekahāyanīśabdāsāmānādhi- karaṇyam|
yadā kevalaguṇavacanatāyāṃ śabdaḥ pravartamānaḥ nānyena saṃbandhaṃ labhate, tadā anupadaśaktvāt ānanyakaṃ mā bhūt iti dravyaparatāmāpadyate|
tasyāṃ yasyāṃ ekavibhaktyikena ekahāyanīśabdena saṃnihitena ekavākyatāprāptyāpadyamānaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati|

kutaḥ? yenaiva hetunā krīṇātinā na saṃbadhyate 'nāmṛto'rthaḥ kriyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ bhavatīti, na ca kriyāsādhanairanyaiḥ, nahi kevalaṃ guṇavacanaḥ saṃśrito dravyamabhidhātu' iti, sa eva hetuḥ prakaraṇasaṃbandhāve'pi|
tatrāpi saṃbandhamānaḥ kriyābhir saṃbadhyate, tatsādhanairvā dravyaiḥ|
ataḥ anarthakatvaparijihīrṣayā saṃnihitena eka- hāyanīśabdena aruṇāśabdaḥ saṃbadhyate, nāsti vākya- bhedaḥ|
nahi ayaṃ aruṇāśabdaḥ eka- hāyanīviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavitumarhati|
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? karaṇa- vibhaktyā tṛtīyayā samuccārito'yam|
kārakāṇāṃ hi kriyā saṃbandho na dravyeṇeti|
vā-- (pṛ. 685) guṇavacanaśca krīṇātinā na saṃbadhyate ityucyate paraḥ punarāha- 'atha yadi krīṇā- tinā na saṃbadhyate' tataḥ|
siddhānta- vādī tu śrutvā kriyāsaṃbandhavāgāt dravyasaṃbandho vākya- lakṣaṇo durbalatvāt bādhyate ityetat pratipādayitu- māha- 'tanna kevalaṃ hi guṇaṃ' iti|
dimakāro hi nāma śabdānāṃ saṃbandhaḥ, sāmānādhikaraṇyena vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā|
tatra yadā ubhābhyāṃ ubhayārthopādānaṃ tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati|
tadiha kevalaguṇavacanatvāt aruṇākathāyanīśabdayoḥ śrutisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tāvacca vidyate|
tasmāt tṛtīyāśrutibalīyastvāt na dravyaguṇayoḥ saṃbandha iti|
valyalakṛta saṃbandhanirākaraṇaṃ avaśyam apramāṇakṛtatvābhiprāyeṇa ayaṃ bravīti iti matvā eka- vibhaktiyogāt (ekavibhaktinirdeśāt iti mūle) ityāha|
prathamaṃ tāvat svāsābhyarthana aruṇāpratipadikasya guṇavacanatvaṃ gamyate, padāntarasaṃnidhānācca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ iti balāvasam|
' idānīṃ tṛtīyāśrutibalīyastvāt kriyāsaṃbandhavāgāt dravya- saṃbandhaṃ darśayati|
bhā-- (pṛ. 686) nanu ca guṇasya kriyāsaṃbandhā- bhāvāt avivakṣitā kārakavibhaktiḥ, iti ekahāyanī- saṃbandho'yamavasthitaḥ|
yadi kāra- kābhidhānaṃ avivakṣitaṃ iti aruṇāśabdena etena dravyama- bhidhātumiyate, tadā prātipadikārthasya avyatirekaḥ iti prathamā vibhaktiḥ prāpnoti|
na hi tṛtīyāntaḥ tamabhi- saṃbandhaṃ śaknoti vaktum|
na ca anyathā'nupapattiḥ, iti anyo'sya anupapadyamāno'rthaḥ śakyate kalpayitum|

yathā 'agnau tiṣṭhati māṇavakaḥ' ityukte jvalane anupa- padyamānaḥ nāśve gavi vā kalpyate, abhisamīpavacanaḥ evādhyavasīyate, tadadihāpi apramathyataḥ śabdaḥ na kathaṃ cidapi atirikte prātipadikārthe bhavitumarhati|
tasmāt kāmaṃ anarthako''gampatāṃ, nāsya ekahāyanī- saṃbandho'vaśyasatyaḥ|
vā-- (pṛ. 686) tatrāpi agastyaiva pratyavasthānaṃ 'nanu guṇasya kriyāsaṃbandhābhāvāt' iti|
na cātra lakṣaṇāyā'pi sakṛddvitīyā- vat tṛtīyā arthavatī kārakasāmānyāsyāpi aniṣṭatvāt|
bhā-- (pṛ. 687) āha, na brūmo na kārakaṃ aruṇāśabdena abhidhīyate iti|
kadā cit ki cit vidhivisataṃ bhavati, kadā cit upasarjanabhūta'rtho vidhivisataḥ, pradhānībhūto'nuvādaḥ|
tadyathā 'daṇḍī' iti upasarjanabhūtadaṇḍapuruṣapradhānakaḥ śabdo'gamyate, kadā cit nirjāte puruṣe daṇḍaguṇavidhānārthamucāryate 'daṇḍī prapānavanāha' iti|
evaṃ ihāpi yadi upasarjana- bhūtaḥ aruṇī guṇaḥ, pradhānabhūtaṃ kārakaṃ, tathāpi anū- dite kārake aruṇāguṇavidhānārthaṃ vacanaṃ yujyate|
tasmāt ekahāyanīsaṃbandhaḥ upapadyate nāsti vākyabheda iti|
atra hi ekahāyanīkrīṇātyoḥ anava- buddhaṃ saṃbandhaṃ bodhayituṃ ayaṃ ekahāyanīśabda uccāritaḥ|
) kathaṃ punaḥ ekahāyanīśabdasya krīṇātinā aruṇāguṇena ca samāne samabhivyāhāre, krīṇā- tinā saṃbandho'pyupagamanīyaḥ, na punaḥ aruṇākhyena iti|
ekahāyanīśabdamanu niviṣṭā, na tu guṇasaṃbandhasya vācikā|
kā punaḥ kriyāsaṃbandhasya vācikā, kā vā guṇasaṃbandhasyeti? kārakalakṣaṇā kriyāsaṃbandhe vivakṣite bhavati dvitīyādiḥ|
kathaṃ tarhi bhavati atra saṃbandho nīla- mutpalamiti|
bhavati, na tu śrutilakṣaṇaḥ, kiṃtu vākyalakṣaṇaḥ|
upalakṣaṇaśabdasaṃnidhāne tadapekṣo nīlaśabdaḥ tena ekavākyatāṃ abhyupagacchan na ajahatsvārthavṛttiḥ upalakṣaviśeṣābhidhānaparaḥ uccāryamāṇaḥ saṃbandhamabhyupaiti|
nanu ihāpi vākyalakṣaṇaḥ taddeva aṣṭaminā samaṃ saṃbandhaḥ ekahāyanyā yujyate|
yadi punaḥ śrutisāmarthyāt kriyāsaṃbandho'- bhyupagamyeta, ekavākyatvādāpi guṇasaṃbandhaḥ|
yo hi anyena saha saṃbandhamucyate, na tasmīpagato'pi anyaḥ tena saha saṃbandhamarhati|
yathā 'bhāryā rājaḥ puruṣo devadattasya' iti bhāryāviśeṣaṇārthaṃ uccāryamāṇo rājaśabdaḥ na puruṣeṇa saṃbadhyate|
tadviha kriyāviśeṣa- ṇārthaṃ uccāryamāṇa ekahāyanīśabdaḥ na aruṇāśabdena saṃbandhamarhati|
vā-- (pṛ. 687) parastu āha, liṅgasaṃkhyāvat āśrayadvārāt kārakamanupraviśya prātipadikārthā vidhyāsate iti|
asti hi etadapi darśanaṃ, yat guṇaśabdebhyo vinā'pi kārakatvena kārakaviśeṣaṇatvāt dvitīyādayo bhavantīti|

yadyapi kathaṃ cit aruṇayā ityasya ekahāyanīsaṃbandhayogyatvaṃ, tathāpi kriyā''śritāyāmekahāyanyāṃ 'aikadhanye parārthavat' ( 1|4|18 ) ityevamabhyupasaṃbandhabhāve balīyasā kraya- saṃbandhena guṇasaṃbandhanirākaraṇam|
nahi atra kriyāsaṃbandha- vibhaktivat guṇasaṃbandhavibhaktiḥ ṣaṣṭhī dṛśyate|
nīlotpale tu śrutivirodhabhāvāt vākyalakṣaṇo'pi saṃbandho'vagamyate iti vaiṣamyam|
ye tu sāmānādhikaraṇyavikalpāḥ, tān ‘niyamo vaikāthyaṃ hi’ ( 6|8|10|35 ) ityatra paṭhā- nyādhikāre sūtre sarvānaiva vakṣyāmaḥ|
na ca kārakavibhakti- tvāt guṇānāṃ kārakavibhaktiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? kārakatvādeveti|
sarvatra tu bodhite padārthe vākyārtha upapadyate, nānyathā|
sāmānyena abhimṛṣṭānāṃ padārthānāṃ yadi śeṣe avasthānaṃ sa vākyārthaḥ|
tadetaduktaṃ ‘tadbhūtānāṃ kriyārthena samāmnāyo'rthasya tannimitta- tvāt’ ( 1|1|726 ) iti|
tadetadavagamyatāṃ, kevala- svārthavṛtti padaṃ anupadeśaṃ, iti padāntareṇa saṃnihitena ekavākyatvamabhyupaiti, nānyeti|

tadiha yadyapi atra hāyanīśabdaḥ: krīṇātinā saṃbadhyamānaḥ kṛtārtho na padānta- reṇa saṃbandhamākāṅkṣati, aruṇāśabdastu padāntareṇa saṃbandha- malabhamāno'narthakaḥ, iti ekahāyanīśabdena ekavākyatā- mabhyupaiti|
āha, aruṇāśabdasya anarthakyaparihārāya ubhayasaṃba- nyārtha iti vadāmaḥ|
tadyathā śālyarthe praṇīyante, tāmyaśca pānīyaṃ pīyate upagṛhyate ca|
evamihāpi krayasaṃbandhārthe ekahāyanīśabda uccāryamāṇaḥ aruṇā- śabdena saha saṃbandhasyate, na kiṃcit duṣyati|
’ ‘sarvatra tu bodhitaṃ padārthaṃ iti ko'yamupanyāsaḥ? ucyate|
’ aruṇā- śabdastāvata avaśyameva kena cit guṇinā saṃbandhanīyaḥ|
itiyat tasya tāvatyeva śrutipīḍā, ityataḥ guṇapadenāpi saṃbandhyatāmiti|
yadyapi ayamaruṇāśabdaḥ anarthako mā bhūt iti ekahāyanyā saṃbadhyeta, tathāpi sarvasmin prakaraṇe niṣedhumarhati|
na ca enaṃ ‘somaṃ krīṇāti’ ityeṣa śabdaḥ śaknoti viśeṣitum|
nahi ayaṃ viśeṣaṇatvena uccāryate, kiṃ tarhi? apūrvo'yaṃ vidhīyate|
yatra tu kriyāviśeṣaṇāni sarvāṇi bhavanti, tatra viśiṣṭavighā- nāt akleśo bhavati|
yatra tu kriyā vidhīyate dravyasya ca kiṃcit, tatra pratyayāvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ vākyabhedamabhyupetya niyamābhāvo bhavati ityucyate|
na ca vidhīyamānāvāsthaḥ krayaḥ prasiddhaḥ iti prakaraṇataikahāyanīmātrasaṃbhavaprasaṅgaḥ|
katamā punaranyā jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe ekahāyanī? sarvathā tāvat vākyena tasyāmapi guṇaḥ prāpyate, yadi tu sā na vidyate, kiṃ kriyatām|
dakṣiṇā tu vā kā cit bhavi- ṣyati|
sadṛśyāyeṣu vā udāharaṇāntareṣu eva tat bhaviṣyati|
tadyathā ‘daśa- sudhīrmīmete’ ityatra somamānādapyevāmapi ahṛṣṭe- nirvāpapudīnāṃ daśasaṃkhyāvatprasaṅgaḥ|
bhā--(pṛ.690) nanu apūrvo'pi vidhīyamānaḥ: eka- hāyanīśabdavat itareṇa saṃbhantsyate|
katham? 1.prayojanāya hi uccāryamāṇaḥ śabdaḥ yena arthaḥ, tasmai tāvat prayoja- nāya avakalpyate, saṃnihitaśca buddhau bhavati|
tena buddhau saṃnihitena śakyate sākāṅkṣaḥ śabdaḥ saṃbandhayitumiti|
yo hi asaṃbandhamāno'narthako bhavati sa saṃba- dhyate, nānyaḥ|
kuta etat? saṃbandhamāne hi sāmānyaṃ viśeṣe apratyāpyate|
na cāyamasaṃbandhamānaḥ krīṇātinā, anarthako bhavati, prakaraṇagataiḥ abhisaṃbantsyate|
nanu etaduktaṃ prakaraṇe'pi asya saṃbandho'nupapanna iti|
ekasmin vākye anyonyo'rtho vidhīyamāno nānyena saṃbadhyate vacanavyakti- bhedāt|
anyā hi vacanavyaktiḥ: vidhīyamānasya, anyā guṇena saṃbandhamānasya|
aśātatvacca jñāyate vidhīyamāno- 'rthaḥ; jñātatvat anudyate guṇasaṃbandhārtham|
na ca sakṛduccā- ryamāṇo jñātatvat ajñātatvacca bhavitumarhati|
ekahāyanī- śabdaḥ kraye vidhīyamānaḥ: aśātatvacca syāt, aruṇā- śabdena saṃbandhamānaśca jñātatvat|
prakaraṇe tu vākyāntaraiḥ kriyā dravyāntarāṇi ca prāptāni|
tatra anya- smin vidhīyate, anyāsmin vākye anyadyate ityupapannaṃ bhavati|
tasmāt saṃyogato'viśeṣāt prakaraṇaviśeṣācca sarvasmin prakaraṇe dravyeṣu ( āruṇyasya ) niveśaḥ iti|
vā-- (pṛ. 690) paraḥ punaḥ: ekahāyanīcairu- pyābhyupagamavādalaghupadasaraḥ śaknute ‘nanu apūrvo'pi vidhīyamānaḥ: manasi viparivartamānaḥ: prasaṅgādeva viśeṣyate iti|
yāvadyāvat hi padārthau viśeṣyate tāvattāvat śruteḥ kharasabhaṅgaḥ|
tena ‘sakṛt pravṛttyāḥ: kimaguṇena’ ityevaṃ ekena kena cit viśeṣitaḥ: pareṇāpi viśeṣyatāṃ ityabhyupagantavyam|
bhavapakṣe'pi svarūpataḥ, somaṃ ca prati kraye vidhīyamāne, dravyaṃ ca prati viśeṣaṇatvena anudyamāne vairūpyaṃ bhavati|
evaṃ eka- hāyanīpi krayaṃ guṇaṃ ca prati vairūpyāt naiva saṃbadhyate|
tadidānīṃ tatraiva parasya duṣṭā mā bhūt iti nirākriyate|
nyāyasya ca krayāṅgakatvāya upapannatvena pūrvapakṣa- mūlābhāvaprasaṅgāt upekṣaṇīyam |
tasmāt pūrvaiṇa nayena kṛtsne prakaraṇe (āruṇyasya) niveśa iti (pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ) |
yatra arthaikatvaṃ śrūyate dravyaguṇayoḥ, tatra dravyaguṇau ekasmin padārthe niyamyetātām |
ekaṃ hi kāryaṃ dravyaguṇayoḥ śrūyate krayasaṃbandhaḥ |
kathametadavagamyate ? ekavākyatāt ? kathamekavākyatvaṃ ? aruṇyā pijñākhyā ekahāyanā iti aparyavasito'rthaḥ sākāṅkṣatvāt abhidhātāpratipannoḥ |
somaṃ krīṇāti iti tu paryavasyati, tayoreva nairapekṣyatvāt |
tatra sarva- viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaikabhāvanāvidhiḥ, tādṛśīṃ kṛtvā kṛtārtho bhavati iti parigrahāt sarvaniyamo bhavati |
yathā ‘deva- dattaḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ odanaṃ pacati’ ityukte sarveṣāṃ ekapākaviṣayatvam |
evamihāpi kevalasyāvat dravya- guṇayoranuṣṭhānameva nāsti iti na vidhīyate |
kriyā- ntarasaṃbandhamapi śrīṇāte : paraḥ pratyayo na śaknoti kartum |
dravyasaṃbandhe tu sarvatra vidhīnāmeva śakya- bhāvaḥ |
sarvatra hi bhāvanāviśeṣaṇasyātirike'rthe vidhi- vyāpāro nāsti iti uttarādhikaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ |
tṛtīyā- nirdeśācca dvayorapi aruṇaikahāyanāyoḥ parasparamapekṣya svasādhyakriyāmātrāpekṣiṇoḥ vākyena taddeśeṣarūpasaṃbandho vijñāyate |
kutaḥ ? kārakaṃ śrutyate kutraikriyā kartuṃ karoti ca |
kriyā'pi na vinā kaiścit sādhyate kārakaḥ ka cittu |
yathaiva dravyena vinā kriyā'nupapatteḥ ekahāyanī krayo gṛhṇāti ‘tathā guṇa- viśeṣeṇa dravyaṃ yāvadalakṣitam |
nanu nāntarīyakatayā dravyagrahaṇe guṇānu- ṣṭhānāt pṛthak prayatnābhāvāt na dravyavata guṇāpekṣā tathāhi ‘na dravyamanupādāya pravṛttiḥ karmaṇīdhyate |
dravyākāṅkṣā'tha pūrvaṃ syāt sā guṇe'pi pratīya- tām |
’ yathaiva hi tayordravyagrahaṇena guṇo'pi kaścit gṛhīta eveti na pṛthagupādānaṃ prayojayati, tathā kriyāpādāne'pi yatkiṃcit dravyamupāttaṃ iti nāpekṣitavyaṃ, (dravyamapi) |
atha tu prāgupādānāt dravyaviśeṣāpekṣā bhavati, tat itaratrāpi prāk dravyopādānāt bhavetvāpekṣā ‘kiṃguṇakaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhṇāmi’ iti |
sarvathā tu etāvānatra viśeṣaḥ, praśnānottarakālamapi kriyāyāṃ dravyaṃ vyāpyate, guṇastu prajñānāt na pṛthak dravyavyatirekeṇa vyāpyate, tāvattaiva caritārthatvāt |
na ca tathā vyāāpyatasya anyā- putatvaṃ, anekaprakāratvāt vyāpārāṇām |
pariccheda- kāle tu asya (guṇasya) adhikavyāpāratvaṃ viviccyate |
’ tenātra yadi tāvat veda evaṃ kaṃ cidviśeṣaṃ dāsyati, tataḥ tena ityavadhārayiṣyate |
yadi tu na dāsyati, tataḥ arthāśrita eva yaḥ kaścit pramāṇavān bhaviṣyati ityayagame sati vidhīyamānasya aruṇaderaṅgasya bhavati |

sarvatra ca śabdāt acodite'rthe ‘arthādvā kalpanedeśāt’ (1|4|14 25) ityevaṃ ajñānasaṃgrahasyudāsa dṛṣṭaḥ ‘aruṇatvena kriyā sādhyate’ iti vispaṣṭe codite, śabdāntarāt abhyāhārādīnāṃ abhāvāt ‘yathā śaknuyāt’ ityupapanthe
’ krayagatastāvat vidhiḥ tṛtīyopanīta kathaṃ cida- ruṇimānaṃ na muñcati |
sa ca nānyena prakāreṇa tadaṃśatvaṃ bhajate |
na ca svasama- vāyinyeva kevalā calanāmrikā vā kriyā sarvatreṣyate |
sarvatraiva sākṣāt sādhanāni bhavanti, avāntaravyāpārādhīnatvāt saṃbandhasya |
arūṇā- dīnāṃ ca yogyatvāt dravyapariccheda eva svavyāpāre vijñāyate, tatra eṣāṃ kartṛtvāt |
tena arūṇapadāt etāvadavagataṃ ‘kiṃcit dravyaṃ paricchindatā arūṇaguṇena krayaḥ sādhyitavyaḥ’ iti |
tathā ekahāyinyā'pi anyathā sādhanatvasaṃbhāvanāt ‘kena cit guṇena me paricchedaḥ kartavyaḥ’ ityetāvadapekṣyate |
tatra guṇaḥ yatkiṃcit dravyaṃ paricchedyaṃ āśratvena ape- kṣitaṃ ārabhate, dravyamapi yaṃ kaṃ cit guṇam |
na ca dvayantara- guṇānāṃ atra vākye sāpekṣatvaṃ pratīyate |
tena nagnāśvadravyatvat vinā'pi panthā anayoreva saṃbandhaḥ |
ani- cchannaścatraṃ ca cit guṇaṃ dravye niyacchati |
’ yat nāma guṇaḥ anyathānupapatteraśrutaṃ dravyamānayati, tathā ekahāyanīṃ ca śrutaṃ aśrutamānayati, tamapi kraya eva śrutāguṇamiguṇatvāt necchati |
yadi hi asau aniyatadravyaguṇaḥ syāt, tato yatkiṃcidapi ānīyamānaṃ saṃheta |
nirapekṣadravyaguṇaviśeṣādeva naiva yathācoditaḥ kraya ubhayaviśeḥ kriyeta, aśrutā ca pradhānasya sata āvṛttirāpadyeta |
pradhānatvādeva ca guṇadvayasya dravyāntaraguṇānākṣepa krayaṇaṃ niruṇddhi |
kāsyabhojinyāyena vā amuka'pi aniyamaṃ vārayet, kimuta mukhya eva san |
na ca aśruta- kalpanā vinā anupapattiḥ, śrutayoreva parasparasaṃbandhena paripūrṇatvāt |
evaṃ ca svavākyagatamapi sāmānādhi- karaṇyaṃ samarthayitaṃ bhaviṣyati |
na cātra śrutivirodhaḥ, yathā vakṣyati ‘na śrutibhūte vākyārtho na’ iti |
’ kraya eva hi dravyaṃ gṛhṇan evamapekṣate ‘ko guṇa etat paricchetsyati’ iti, guṇamapi gṛhṇan apekṣate, ‘kiṃ dravyaṃ etasya āśrayo bhaviṣyati’ iti |
tenaiva tayoḥ krayavaśena anyonyānuguṇyaṃ pratipadyamānayorepi na parasparajñājñatvaṃ bhavati |
yastu manyate paricchedakatvāt guṇasya dravyājñatvaṃ pratīyate iti, sa vaktavyo guṇasyāpi krayamanyathā sādhayitumaśakyataḥ dravyaṃ āśratvaṃ pratipadyamānaṃ añjamiti |
tasmāt krayāṅgabhūtayoreva nāntarīyaḥ parasparapakāro bhavann añjatvamāpādayati iti draṣṭavyam |
yastu prakaraṇe niveśaṃ manyate, tasya kena guṇe vidhīyate iti vaktavyam |
krayavidhinā tāvat saha naiva saṃbandha iṣṭaḥ |
yadyapi kārakatvena dravyāṇi pratīyante, tathāpi tatpadānyavidhāyakavākyeva |
saṃprati pratīyamānā api na vidhātuṃ samarthāḥ |
tasmānna kathaṃ cit prakaraṇe niveśate ‘ekārthāstu vikalperan’ (12|1|4|10) i
na ca vikalpaḥ, ekaṃ kāryaṃ, sāmarthyabhedastu |
sākṣāddhi dravyaṃ kriyāṃ prati upakaroti, guṇastu viśinaṣṭi sādhanam |
yadi evaṃ, na tarhi guṇaḥ kriyāmabhinirvartayati, sādhanasyāsau viśeṣaka iti |
guṇasya kriyā- mabhinirvartayata etadeva sāmarthyaṃ, yat sādhanaṃ viśinaṣṭi ! ākāṅkṣati ca kriyā sādhanaviśeṣaṇam |
asati cihne na lakṣyeta katamat sādhanaṃ kriyāyāḥ iti |
tataḥ kriyāṃ nādhyavasyeyaṃ kartuṃ, iti bhavati kriyāsādhanaṃ guṇaḥ |
na caivaṃ sati vikalpo bhavati, yathā adhikaraṇasya kartrādīnāṃ ca |
tathā kartā kartrādīni samā- datte, tāni asamāhitāni na śaknuvanti svasvamarthamabhi- nirvartayitum |
yasmistu sādhanopakāre kāryaṃ tasminneva- pakāre anyat sādhanaṃ vidhīyate, tatra vikalpaḥ |
vā-- (pṛ. 614) avāntaravyāpārānekāryatvama- gṛhītvā vadati 'yathaikakāryatā kimiti vikalpo na bhavatīti' |
siddhāntavādī tu āha, naitena asamarthati- pakṣaḥ |
'na ca vikalpaḥ nānākāryātvāt' iti avā- ntaravyāpārābhiprāyeṇa |
parastu pradhānakāryanātmamevoktaṃ iti matvā āha 'nanu idānīmevoktaṃ' iti |
'tathāpi- viruddhaṃ' yat pūrvamukte amṛtatvāt niṣkiyo guṇa iti |
nanu pūrvapakṣavādinā taduktaṃ, idānīṃ siddhāntavādī na sakriyaṃ bravīti iti yukto viropopanyāsaḥ |
yadi cāyaṃ asiddho bhavet tataḥ tadānīmeva udbhāvyeta |
tathā cedānīṃ siddhavat arthakyābhi- dhānāt sakriyatvaṃ abhidadhato vipratiṣiddhamāpadyate |
'naitadviruddhaṃ, na ca vikalpaḥ' iti śaktibhedanimittā- vāntaravyāpārānāntvāt |
taddarśayati, dravyaṃ sākṣāt sādhanaṃ, guṇastatparicchedārtha iti |
parastu etāvattat 'itarat tadarthaṃ' itivat guṇasya dravyārthatvaṃ manyamāna āha 'yathaivaṃ na tarhi' (guṇaḥ kriyāmabhinirvartayati iti) |
bhā-- (pṛ. 616) evaṃ tarhi tadevaṃ saṃjātaṃ, bhavati ekahāyanīvidhānaṃ, tadviśeṣaṇaṃ ca aruṇo guṇaḥ |
tatra sa eva doṣo vākyabhedaḥ prasajyeta iti |
na brūmaḥ aruṇādravyaṃ ekahāyanīśabdena saṃśravyate iti |
evaṃ hi śrūyate aruṇaguṇena krayaṃ abhinirvartayet iti |
yathā ca tena nirvartyate tathā yati- tavyaṃ bhavati |
na ca aviśiṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ guṇaḥ kriyāṃ abhinirvartayati, iti arthāt sādhanaviśeṣaṇāṃ prati- padyate |
yathā 'syālyāṃ pacet' iti kriyāsādhanatve nirdiṣṭe arthāt saṃvapane dhāraṇe ca syālīṃ vyāpārayati, tadihāpi dravyam |
vā-- (pṛ. 619) paricchede doṣadvaye vastuvṛttaṃ ekahāyanīdvāratvaṃ apaśyan vākyenaiva dvāradārisaṃndhakara- pāt vairūpyāpattiṃ codayati 'evaṃ tarhi' iti |
'na brūmaḥ aruṇāśabdaḥ' iti sāmarthyakāritaṃ ekahāyanī- saṃśravaṃ darśayati |
yathā 'deva- dattayajñadattaviṣṇumitrā bhojyantāṃ' iti pratyekaṃ bhujiḥ samāpyate |
yathā ca 'yasya pitā pitāmahaḥ somaṃ na pibet' iti |
evamihāpi 'aruṇayā krīṇāti, eka- hāyanyā krīṇāti' iti |
evamapi kraye eva aruṇāmā niveśayati, na sarvasmin prakaraṇe iti |
vā-- 'nanu evamapi vākyaṃ bhiyeta iti niyama- nirākaraṇārthāmāha |
satyapi krayasaṃbandhe pratikārakaṃ kriyānya- tvāt arthabhedanimitto vākyabhedaḥ asatyeveti |
pratyekaṃ devadattādiṣu bhojanaṃ, pituḥ pitāmahasya vā asomapatvaṃ prātyapaśo-
bhā-- (pṛ. 616) satyameṣa doṣo na bhavati kiṃtu anaruṇayā'pi ekahāyanyā krayaḥ prāpnoti, aru- ṇayā ca anekahāyanyā |
tatra yaduktaṃ dravyaguṇayorniyama iti sā pratijñā hīyate |
kathaṃ ? krayasya hi dravyāruṇimānau upadiśyete na krayastayoḥ |
na ca pradhānaṃ pratiguṇaṃ midyate, pratipradhānaṃ hi guṇe midyate iti |
asita cāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ samudāye vākyapari- samāptiriti, yathā 'gargāḥ śata daṇḍayantāṃ' iti |
kathaṃ punastasmin itarasmin dṛṣṭānte sati ekāntena avadhāryate samudāye eva vākyasamāptiḥ, na pratyayavamiti |
iha dravyāruṇimānau ubhāvapi kriyāsaṃbaddhau upalabhyete paraspareṇa asaṃbaddhau |
tatra yadi dravyaparaṃ aruṇimamaparaṃ ca bhavati vacanamidaṃ, tataḥ pratyayavayaṃ asaṃśayaṃ kraya- saṃbandhaḥ |
atha krayavidhisyā abhidhīyate, tato yathaivāyaṃ ekahāyanīviśiṣṭaḥ, evaṃ aruṇamaviśiṣṭaḥ, iti niyamataḥ ubhayasaṃbandho'bhyupagamanīyaḥ |
dravyāruṇimānau krayārthī santo īpsitau syātāṃ nānyathā |
sa ca nānyataraviśiṣṭaḥ pratīyate, iti samu- dāye vākyaparisamāptiḥ |
tadā ca evaṃ, tadā naikahāyanīṃ muktvā anyat kraya sādhanamasti, na ca aruṇādravyaḥ sādhanasya viśeṣako guṇaḥ, iti niyamaḥ siddho bhavati |
yadi krayasya sādhane guṇaḥ abhisaṃbandhamupaiti, tadā vākye bhinne'pi krayasādhanatvāt aruṇāmā anyasmin dravye na niveśyate |
bhinne hi vākye ekahāyanī- sādhanakaḥ krayaḥ avabuddho bhavati, aruṇāsādhanamapi krayā- ntaraṃ, na tasminneva ekahāyanīsādhane kraye aruṇāmā vihito bhavati |
tatra yat krayāntaraṃ aruṇāguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ, tatra arthāta prāptaṃ anyadapi sādhanaṃ bhavati |
vā-- (pṛ. 616) paraḥ punarāha 'satyameṣa na doṣaḥ' iti |
nanu daṇḍasya daṇḍasaṃskāratvāt bhoja- nādivat pratiguṇaṃ āvṛttiḥ prāpnoti |
' yathaiva adhvarvādīnāṃ dakṣiṇā parikriyārthī karmasaṃyogāt, evaṃ rājñāmapi artha- daṇḍaḥ naimittikī paripālanavṛttiḥ |
tāsāṃ ca prati tatra- tatrāparādhe nimitte śatādīni upādīyamānatvāt viva- kṣitaikasaṃkhyāni bhavanti |

tatkāle ca aparādhināṃ rājā ādānatvena avasthā- nāt samastagargāpādānakaṃ rājā śataṃ grahītavyaṃ ityavagate sati, pratyekaṃ grahaṇe sati ekena śatena aparādhaniṣkraye kṛte śeṣaṃ aśrutaṃ brahmasvaharaṇaṃ syāt, saṃkhyā'ntaraṃ ca vṛddhau āpadyeta |
paraḥ punaḥ abhihito'pi hetuviśeṣe dṛṣṭāntadvayāt saṃdeha- mupanyasyati |

krayasya yāgasādhanatvopamāpyarthatvena bhūta- bhakṣyasamuccāraṇanyāyena vidhāyakatvādeva ca prādhānyāt dravyaguṇayośca pūrvahetuviparyayeṇa viparītatvāt itaraḥ eka- vākyatvapratipādanaphalaṃ prāpnoti |
tatra aparaḥ āha, sarvathā tāvat aśrutatvakalpanābhyāt bhinnavākyacoditayorapi niyamaḥ sidhyati iti nārtha ekavākyatveneti |
siddhānta- vādī vadati, vākyabhede sati ubhayaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭa- krayapratītimātrāt yathāśrutapratyekasaṃbandhakrayānuṣṭhāne sati guṇenāpi yatkiṃcit dravyaṃ gṛhyeta, dravyeṇāpi yaḥ kaścit
nahi tadānīṃ anyonyasaṃnidheḥ arthākṣepapratibandha- śaktirasti, na ca ekā kriyā guṇadravyasvīkārasamarthā syāt |
aruṇaguṇakrayo hi aniyatadravyakatvāt kimiti guṇosthāpitaṃ yatkiṃcit dravyaṃ na gṛhṇīyāt, eka- hāyanīkrayo vā yaṃ kaṃ cit guṇam |
athāpi vākyāntara- śiṣṭāni krayadravyaṇyeva guṇaṃ āskandati, tathāpi teṣu vāsaḥprabhṛtiṣu daśasvapi daśanapi prāpnoti |
śā-- 'amūrtatvād guṇe naiva kriyāṃ sādha- yituṃ kṣamaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 1|1|9, rathayogeṇa māhendrasya stotramupākaroti' atra ratho darśanivataḥ |
evaṃ ca ghoṣo nāvarathaṃ rathasye- veti |
na ca dvandena tayoḥ parasparasāhityāvagateḥ aruṇai- kahāyanīnyāyena parasparaniyamatvāt kathaṃ na ghoṣo rathasye- veti vācyam |
yādṛśopapadadvayasamabhivyāhāre āgo- pālāṅganaṃ tadarthayoḥ yādṛśo'nyavo'vagamyate tādṛśasyaiva tadarthayoḥ |
ata eva aruṇaikahāyanīsthale paricchedyaparicchedakabhāva eva pārśvikobhayaviṣayaḥ |
10|4|2, vasānau ityatra anvayavyatirekāmyāṃ puṃstvaṃ dvitvaṃ ca abhidheyaṃ pratīyate |
tatra ca aruṇaikahāyanīnyāyena paraspara- niyamatvāt puṃstvasiddhiḥ |

(pūrvapakṣe) ratna. 6|1|522 varṇakaṃ 2 samānapratyayopāttena prātipadikārthā- dapi saṃnihitatareṇa pradhānabhūtena kārakeṇa aruṇasevakaṃ prātipadikārthamanādṛtya kriyāṅgaṃ avagamyamānaṃ vākya- samarpitaṃ kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ ca saṃśayya parastāt aruṇaikahā- yanīnyāyena paṣṭhunā viśeṣaṇatvena arthāt saṃtravyate |
śā. 4|1|10. brahmaviśeṣaṇānāmapi guṇānāṃ aruṇaikahāyanī- nyāyāt upāsānābhāvarūpakāryānyato'sti |
parimalaḥ. 3|1|188 vas. viśiṣṭādānaviṣayatvāt aruṇaika- hāyanīnyāyasya anupapatteḥ |
su. pṛ. 104. yasyāṃ tu bhāvanāyāṃ dhātvarthaḥ karaṇaṃ bhavanti, tasyāṃ te bastva- ntaranirapekṣāḥ paścātanaṃ aruṇaikahāyanīnyāyalabhya- itikartavyatāsaṃtravvaṃ labhante |
na cāviśiṣya sādhanaṃ guṇaḥ kriyāmimanirvartayati' itya- rthāt sādhanaviśeṣaṇatāṃ pratipadyate |
tasya ca kāra- katvābhidhānopapatteḥ ekavākyatvasiddhiḥ (krīṇātinā), ato na sarvadharmatvamiti |
ke. aruṇāśabdasya krīṇātinā anvayaḥ iti samarthanaṃ pūrvapakṣe 'aruṇānyāyaḥ' ityatra bhāṣyādau draṣṭa-
ke. aruṇāśabdasya śaktitvalyanirūḍhalakṣaṇayā guṇaviśiṣṭaparatvaṃ svīkṛtya krayānuvādena viśiṣṭakārakasya vidhānam ('aruṇa- payā krīṇāti' ityatra) |
aruṇaikahāyanīdvayoryadi tṛtīyānirdeśāt para- sparamanapekṣya svasvādhyākriyāmātrāpekṣiṇoḥ vākyena tadvi- śeṣakrayasaṃbandho vijñāyate |

aruṇaikahāyayoḥ yathā niyamaḥ aruṇā nānyayā, kiṃtu ekahāyaneyaiva, ekahāyanī ca nānyayā, kiṃtu aruṇaiva iti itaretaraniyamo yathā, tathā 'vasānau' ityatra dvitva- puṃstvayoretaretaraniyamaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe |
nanu revatīvāravantī- yānvayavidhāne'pi ubhayoḥ kṛtvāśabdecchākamānāviśe- paṇatvena aruṇaikahāyanīvat anyonyaniyamasiddheḥ samabhi- vyāhāralambyapratītiviruddhetyāśaṅkā |
aruṇimā kraye eva niveśyati na sarvasmin prakaraṇe |
arundhatīnidarśane valīṣvapi tārāsu amūṣyāsu arundhatīpu darśitāsu yā anyā pradarśyate sā mukhyevārundhatī bhavati, evamihāpi ānandamayasya sarvāntaratvāt mukhyamātmatvam |
'arkaṃ gṛhāti' iti viṣuvati ahani arka- nāma grahaḥ śrutaḥ |
tasya prākṛtairmahaiḥ samuccayaḥ; na tu prākṛ- tānāṃ bādhaḥ |
ityasyārthasya saṃsiddhau ko vidvān yatnamā- caret' iti nyāyaḥ |
arkaḥ arka arkaṃ arkate iti pāṭhacatuṣṭayam |
kevalacet arkaṃ jñānāt puruṣārthasiddhiḥ syāt kimarthamanyathāsādhanāni karmāṇi te kuryuḥ: 'arkaṃ cet' iti nyāyāt |
śāṃbhā. 3|1413 vas. tathayā pathijālate arkaṃ madhu utsṛjya tenaiva pathā maccintayataḥ parvataṃ na gaccheyuḥ tādṛśaṃ hi tat |
yadi hi alpānmahataḥ karmaṇaḥ samaṃ phalaṃ jāyeta, tataḥ arkaṃ cenmadhu vindeta ityanenaiva nyāyena alpena siddhe mahati na kaścit pravarteta |
arthaḥ (prayojanam) - upādeyasyānekasyāpi pradhā- nena saṃtravyo'dakalpyate vyavahitenāpi |
vyavadhānādartho balīyavāniti bhā. 6|1|623 pṛ. 1445, arthaḥ (sukhahetuḥ) ko'rthaḥ 1 yo niḥśreyasāya jyotiṣṭomādiḥ |
ekasyāmeva pramadātanau paridrāṭkādīnāṃ kuṇapaṃ, kāminī, bhakṣaḥ iti vyavasthitopajanaṃ vikalpayatraṃ na syāt vāhyārtho yadi ekākāraḥ, tathaiva sarvaiḥ pratye-
atha vyākāraḥ, tatra trayāṇāmapi vikalpatrayaṃ syāt |
tadavadayaṃ ātmīyavāsanānirbhatā evaiṣā vikalpa- vyavasthā iti |
' kuṇapādi- rūpāṇi sarvāṇyeva pramadāyāṃ santi, paribrājakādistu sva- vāsanānusāreṇa kiṃ cit rūpaṃ paśyati, na sarve sarvāṇi |
snehadvayapratyayānukāro hi vāsanā svakāraṇabhūtaṃ jñānamu- tkaroti |
sā yathāvidhena jñānena janyate, tathāvidhameva jñānaṃ janayatītyarthaḥ |
tadasau vāhyākāre vastuni pūrvā- bhyastākāranirdhāraṇe kāraṇaṃ bhavati, na tu apūrvākāraṃ vikalpayati |
nahi atyantamanvākrāntastvanto'pi ghaṭaṃ kāminīṃ paśyati, mā vā madhyamiti |
yathā mithyātvaṃ sati artha na ghaṭate, tathā arthābhāve jñānotpattirapi na ghaṭate |
ṛju. pṛ. 55. arthaḥ (vācyaḥ) yādṛśaḥ padavelā- yāmavagataḥ, tādṛśa evottareṇa padena saṃtravyate |
sarvo hi śabdaḥ artha- pratyāyanārthe prayujyate |
su. pṛ. 111. arthaḥ hi kramāt balīyavān |
' yadasya pūrva upahūtaḥ iti prativacanasya samarthe, tat prativacanakāryaṃ bhaviṣyati |
bhā. 3|1|6142. na- hi artho nāma kiṃcit pramāṇaṃ, kiṃ tarhi śabdaśakti- kalpaneti |
vā. 3|1|614 pṛ. 722. yaśca arthā artho na sa codanārthaḥ |
sa nāma artho'bhidhīyate yatra śabdasya vācaka- śaktiḥ kalpyate |
oṃ arthena ca pratīyatena prayojanaṃ, na pratyāyena mantrena |
oṃ arthena ca viparyāse tādarthyāt tattvameva syāt |
tatra dhānāsu avahananaṃ kartavyaṃ, paraṃtu ādau saktupa avahananaṃ paścāt bharjanaṃ dhānā- karaṇaṃ iti viparyāsaḥ svīkriyate iti siddhāntaḥ |
vipa- ryāse ādau avahananaṃ paścāt bharjanaṃ iti prākṛtakramāt viparyāse svīkṛte'pi viparyayasya tādarthyāt dhānāthatvāta tattvaṃ eva dhānātvameva syāt |
oṃ arthena tatpakṛṣyeta (2|1|14) iti śruta- śastrādhikaraṇe liṅgakramayorvirodho darśitaḥ |
vā. 3|3|14 pṛ. 826. oṃ arthena pāṭhavādhaḥ kramakopā- dhikaraṇe (5|1|14) eva 'agnihotraṃ juhoti, yavāgūṃ pacati' ityādyala siddhāntaḥ |
oṃ arthena yatra kāryamāsādyate tatra śabdaḥ arthapralayānārtho bhavati |
yatra punaḥ śabda eva kāryaṃ, tatra kāryasaṃbandhātheṃ śabda eva pratyāyayati : vi. 10|1|14. oṃ arthād kṛtaṃ codakena na prāpyate |
yathā śruteḥ kramaḥ sidhyati tathā arthāt prayojanānu- sārādapi kramaḥ sidhyati |
'agnihotraṃ juhoti' iti pūrṇamāsāt, 'yavāgūṃ pacati' iti paścāt |
yavāgyāḥ homaprayojanāt ādau yavāgūpacaḥ, paścāt tathaiva yavāgyā homaḥ iti arthāt śruti-pramāṇena arthapramāṇasya samuccayarthaḥ |
oṃ arthādvākṣipyamāṇaṃ śrautena nivartyate, tathā parokṣavacā'pi |
vā. 2|1|3|12 pṛ. 566. oṃ arthād yaḥ prāptaḥ, sa yatra prayojanaṃ tatraiva kriyate |

tatra saṃdehaḥ : kiṃ sarvasya suveṇā- 'vadyatavyaṃ dravya māṃsasya saṃhatasya ca, tathā svadhitinā hastena ca sarveṣāṃ, atha arthato vyavasthā dravāṇāṃ suveṇa, māṃsānāṃ svadhitinā, saṃhatānāṃ hasteneti |
na ca tāni sarvāpyaviśeṣeṇa suvādibhiravadātuṃ śakyante, iti dāvyavastuvisaṃvādena ananvayavādāt aprāmāṇyamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
vakṣyamāṇapūrvapakṣanyāyena avyavastha- yaiva adhyavasāyopapattervidyateti cediti yathāvārtikamevā- dhikaraṇaṃ prastutam |
arthavādasya saṃdehanirṇāyakatvaṃ prati- pādyedānīṃ prasaṅgena sāmarthyasyāpi saṃdigdhanirṇāyakatvaṃ pratipādyate |
na ca suvādīnāṃ māṃsāvadānasādhanatvābhāvāt tanna saṃbhavatīti vācyam |
śabdatvenaiva arthāvasahabhāvenāpi sāmarthya- māpādya sādhanatvasaṃbhavāt avyavasthaiva sarvaiḥ sarvama- dātyamiti |
bhavedevaṃ yadi sāmarthyamatra vyavasthākāraṇaṃ na bhavet |

tatraya prāpnasiddhaṃ sāmarthyaṃ vyavasthā- kāraṇaṃ nāsti, tatra vidhinaiva prakārāntareṇāpi sāmarthya- māpāya viniyogaḥ kriyate (sāmarthyaṃ kalpayitvā sādhanaviniyogaḥ kriyate - iti pāṭhāntaraṃ likhite darśi- tam ) |
yatra punaḥ pūrvaprasiddhameva sāmarthyamasti, tatra taddarśanena vyavasthopapatteḥ tadanukūlyaiva vicchedaśaḥ kalpyate |
taduktaṃ 'atha yatreti saṃdigdhaṃ vākyaśeṣo na vidyate |
(vā. 1|4|14 pṛ. 358) tasmāt sāmarthyakalpitaikadeśatvarūpameva tadvākyatrayaṃ suveṇāvadyati svadhitinā'vadyati māṃsānāṃ, hastenā'vadyati
tenaiva caitā na samāmananti sahasrabhāgaṃ tu samāmaneyuḥ : |
'yo nāma kaścidviditaṃ prameyamagrāntare ttivā vadati svayaṃ vā |
markaṭatāmanukuryāt sa kīrtalopādibhiḥ saṃtatitarjayati janmaśatāni bhūyāt |
iti bālavalbhībhujaṅgaparanāmako (0 bhujaṅgadraranāmno iti likhite pāṭhaḥ :) mahopādhyāyaśrībhavadevasya kṛtau tautā- titamatatilake nāmadheyapādaḥ samāptaḥ |
tatra arthāt sāmarthyāt kalpanā yojanā kartavyā |
dravyadvayādane suvasya śaktiḥ, odanādevadāne hastasya śaktiḥ; māṃsadevadāne svadhiteḥ śaktiḥ |
'ākhyā- tānāmarthe bruvatāṃ śaktiḥ : sahakāriṇī' iti hi atra nyāyaḥ |
ka cidvākyaśeṣāt nirṇayaḥ, arthādvā ka cinnirṇayaḥ, iti vādyaṣṭasāmarthyam |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ suveṇā-vadātyaṃ sarvasya dravya māṃsasya ca tathā svadhi-tinā, hastena ca, uta sarvapāmarthato vyavasthā dravāṇāṃ suveṇa, māṃsānāṃ svadhitinā, saṃhatānāṃ hasteneti |
evaṃ prāpte brūmaḥ : arthādvā kalpanā, sāmarthyāt kalpaneti |
śakyatvāt tathā, yasya śakyatvāt tasya ceti |
tathā hi śakyate homo nirvarta- yitum |
tat yathā, kaṭe bhukte kāṃsyapātryāṃ bhukte itya- rthāt kalpyate kaṭe samāsīnaḥ : kāṃsyapātryāmodanaṃ nidhāya bhukte iti |
vā-- 'atha yatreti saṃdigdhaṃ vākyaśeṣo na vidyate |
' devatāprasādābhayaprārthanā''dau saṃhatahastayogamātramañjaliḥ; 'nāñjalinā vāri pibet' ityādi vyākośaḥ |
sakṛt- homacodanāyāṃ śabdāt saṃdeha satyasati cā''kośasya vākyaśeṣe anyathā''nupattera ākośaśrayaṇam |
nanu anenaiva nyāyena yathā śakyāditi vākyaśeṣāt annādī- nāmākhyāyaveṣādādirahitaḥ karmādhikāraḥ syāt |
asaṃdehāt, saṃdigdhanirṇayārthāt tu evaṃ kalpanā bhavati |
na cādhikāre saṃdehaḥ, samastadharmopetaṃ yathā śakyatvā- ttathā kuryāditi vākyaśeṣāt |
santi ca tādṛśaśca kartāraścakṣuṣmadādayaḥ, iti na prayogacodanā''nyathā- 'nupapattiḥ |
yatra tu yāvajjīvavacanā''dau eva bhavi- ṣyati, tatra śaktikṛtā'nyathā'pi tatraiva avaguṇyaṃ pradhānasya coditamityādhiśyāmahe eva |
tasmādyāvadeva labdhāmko vidhiḥ tāvat kalpate tadaidikaṃ, siddhe tu tatkalpanāṃ pauruṣeyavādapramāṇaṃ sāmarthyādhīnatvādvākya- śeṣasiddheḥ |
āha ca 'yathaiva pāṭhaḥ pratipattyupāyastathaiva sāmarthyamapi śrutīnām |
tenaiva caitā na samāmananti sahasrabhāgaṃ tu samāmaneyuḥ : |
anabhibhavasamartha dharmadurgaṃ praviśya prabhibhajati samarthārthacintāmi- dānīm |
śā--vidheredānīṃ pratipāditaprāmāṇyasya saṃdigdhārtha- nirṇaye'pi sāmarthyasyaiva prāmāṇyaṃ pratipādyate |
tasmāt śaktisahāyo vidhiraiva yathāsāmarthyaṃ vidheyaṃ vyavasthāpayati
19. soma- -arthavādarūpatvādvākyasya stāvakatvātirekeṇa prāmāṇyapratipādane taddeva vidhirūpatvasya vidhā- yatvātirekeṇa prakārāntareṇāpi prāmāṇyamasti iti vyutpādanam |
vyākośa iti--ā īṣadarthe īṣat kośaḥ īṣadvikasitamukulasadṛśaḥ, na tu devatāprasādanābhyaprārthanā- ''dāviva atyantaṃ itastadvyavastheyaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- sāmarthyāt vidheyarvyavasthitārtha- tvakalpanā syāt sāmarthyakalpitasya vidhivyākyaika- deśatvāditi |
tena yatra saṃdeho nāsti tatra na sāmarthyena vyavasthā kalpanīyā |
tathā ca darśapūrṇamāsādiṣviṣeḥ ekā- daśe vakṣyamāṇanyāyena sarvāṅgaviśiṣṭakarmaviṣayatāyā nidhiva-
praiṣapraiṣārthau tu viparyeṇa- mnāto, tau ca viparyeṇa kartavyau |
soma—pūrvatatra vidheyantarābhāvāt kathaṃcidupasthi- tārthavidhāyakatvaṃ yuktaṃ, na tu iha vidheyantarasadbhāvāt ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
kramaḥ pāṭhādarthato vā, pāṭhāt sarvatra darśanāt ||
tacca nyutkrameṇa anupa- padyamānatvāt krame pramāṇam |

yathā 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' 'yavāgūṃ pacati' ityatra yavāgūpakaḥ pāṭhakramāt paścāt pākasaṃkṛtāyāḥ yavāgvāḥ homadrūpasya 'yavāgvā'gnihotraṃ juhoti' iti vacanasiddhasya prayojanasyā- niṣpatteḥ, pākasya ca yavāgūpapādakatve'pi anupayuktayā- stasyāḥ prayojanatvānupapatteḥ, tadanyathā'nupapattyā pūrvaṃ pākaḥ paścāddhomaḥ |

na ca 'tṛtīyā ca hośchandasi' (pā0 2|3|2) iti smaraṇāt hoḥ karmaṇi tṛtīyā cakārāt dvitīyā ca ityarthakāt 'yavāgyā juhoti' ityatra yavāgyāḥ tṛtīyā karmatvāvagamane homasya prayojanāsiddhiḥ, tathātve'pi yavāgvāḥ upayogābhāve homavākye eva sakṛnyāyena (2|1|12) viniyogabhaṅgāṅgīkārāt |
vastutastu karaṇatve eva tṛtīyāyāḥ śaktiḥ, karmatve tu ānuṣā- nikī lakṣaṇā |
ata eva yatra caturavattadādau upayogastattvataḥ, tatraiva 'caturavattena juhoti' ityetādṛśavākyasattve'pi karmatvapratītiḥ ityeta- tparaṃ smaraṇam |
atra ca arthopasthitaḥ krayaḥ prayoga- vidhineva vidhīyate |
aṅgāntaravat arthakalpitaśrutyā viniyogaḥ, prayogamātraṃ prayogavidhinā ityapi śakyaṃ vaktum |
vastutastu prayojana- vaśena padārthānnuṣṭhāne vihite ānuṣaṅgikaḥ kramaḥ iti na tadarthe vidhānaṃ iti dhyeyam |
vastutastu arthāvirodhapāṭhasthale anya- labhyatvāt anuvāda eva |
virodhapāṭhasthale ca apūrvasyaiva tasya jñāpakaḥ ityapi anusandheyam |
vā. 3|4|4|13 pṛ. 132. abhi- yeyo'rthaḥ gavādiśabdānāṃ jātiḥ |
viṣayayo yogarūḍhānāṃ paṅkajādicchabdānāṃ padmatvādyekārtha- samavāyipaṅkajajananakartṛtvādivācināṃ padmatvādiḥ |
arthābhi- dhānāya hi śabdacodakaḥ pravartate, na pṛthak adṛṣṭakalpanā- bhayāt |
mīmā. sarvaiṣāmeva śabdā- nāmarthajñāne laukikaḥ prayogo'bhyupāyaḥ |
bhā. 6|1|1|1 pṛ. 1347. arthadvayavirodhe'tha, dravyābhāve tadutpatte- rdravyāṇāmarthaśeṣatvāt |
kāryāsāmarthya mukhyadravye labdhe'pi pratinidhereva upādānaṃ iti pratipādanāt siddhāntasūtram |
anayorvirodhe prasakte arthaḥ prabala iti jñeyam |
dravyābhāve, mukhyasya kāryasāmarthya dravyasya abhāve, tadutpatteḥ pratinidhireṣṭavyaḥ |
dravyāṇāṃ artha- śeṣatvāt, arthasya prayojanasya hi śeṣaḥ sādhakaṃ dravyam |
prayojanāsaṃbhave tu na prātasyāpi mukhyadravyasyopayojanaṃ yuktam |
yathā yūpārtho mukhyaḥ nyagrodho labdhaḥ, sa ca takṣa- ṇādisaṃskārasāmarthyaḥ pañcaniyojane'pi cāyogyaḥ, prati- nidhiḥ kadaraśca takṣaṇādisamarthaḥ paśuniyojane ca yogyaḥ
evaṃ sati pratinidhireva grāhyo na mukhyo- 'pi kadara iti |
arthadvāre hi adhyādisaṃbandho, na granthasvarū- pāśrayaḥ |
vā. 3|1|1|1 pṛ. 649. 'arthepṛthaktve'bhyāvarttate (satyā. śrau. 1|1|39) itinyāyāt pratyayatanaṃ mantrāvṛttiḥ āghāne saṃbhāranivapane |
tacca mukhye gauṇe ca kena cit prakāreṇa vidyate |
(arthāpattiprāptam) tannāma arthaprāptaṃ na prakādyate, yadevamena vinā prayatnena niṣpadyate |
vā. 3|1|2|16. arthaprāptāḥ hi karmādayo na bhavanti śabdasvābhidheya- bhūtāḥ |
na tu etadarthāḥ arthāt prāpnuvanti, tena te śabdārthabhūtāḥ |

bhā. 3|4|1|3 pṛ. 927. arthaprāptavat-tadyathā loke arthaprāpte yatra pratiṣedho bhavati, 'na viṣaṃ bhakṣayitavyaṃ, na sarpādyupaliptaṃ, na kaṇṭakaḥ pādenādhidheyaḥ' iti, agnivaiva tasyārthasya bhavati na vikalpaḥ |
tena manyāmahai vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ pratiṣedho balīyān iti |
mā. 10|8|12|12 'arthaprāptavaditi cet' (10|8|12) ityatra yat arthaprāptaṃ niṣpadyate tatra vidhyananujñaiva labhyamānaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ balīyāṃso bhavanti iti vakṣyate |

' yadā hi sarvākhyātānuvartanī karoti- dhātvācyā puruṣavyāpārarūpā bhāvanā avagatā bhavati, tadā taddeśāḥ sāmānyākhyātāntarnimittaśabdaviśeṣa- vācyā : vidhivratiṣedhabhūtabhavitavyatādinādaḥ pratīyante |
pacati, apākṣīt, pakṣyati, pacet, na pacatu iti |

vā. 2|1|1|1 pṛ. 378. icchā''dyārtha arthyate : ṇija- ntāt kartṛvivakṣāyāṃ 'erac' (pā0 3|1|56 ikā- rāntāt dhātoḥ ac pratyayaḥ syāt ) iti ac-pratya- yopādanena arthinaḥ puruṣasya arthādabhedābhimānāt, bhāva- nāyāśca puruṣadharmatvāt, dharmadharmiṇośca atyantabhedābhā- vāt tādātmyaṃ vivakṣitā arthātmā cāsau bhāvanā ca iti vigrahaḥ kāryaḥ arthātmabhāvanā tvanyā iti vārtike |
su. pṛ. 560. arthabhāvanā eva kārakaviśiṣṭarūpeṇa vākyārtho mīmāṃsakamate |
maṇi. pṛ. 91. arthabhāvanā ca pacati pākaṃ karoti iti karotisāmānādhikaraṇyatayā sarvā- khyātādapavācyā |

bāla. pṛ. 74. ākhyātopasthitā arthabhāvanā kiṃ kena kathaṃ ityatrayaṃ krameṇapekṣamāṇā 'kimiṣṭaṃ kuryāt' ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ yāgasya kartavyaṃ karaṇa- tvena na asādhyatayā 'yāgena anyad bhāvayet ' iti (uttaram ) |
tataḥ 'kimidaṃ tat anyat ?' ityākā- ṅkṣāyāṃ svargākāmapadasamarpitaṃ asiddhatayā sānāpekṣaṃ svargameva arthabhāvanā bhāvatven svīkaroti |
śrutivṛttyā hi padārthabhūtasya svargakāmasya bhāvatvamukhyamānaṃ viśeṣa- bodhe viśeṣaṇe svargaṃ paryavasyati |
tathā ca 'yāgena svargaṃ bhāvayet' iti phalitam |
yatra ca samabhi- vyāhṛtātpatti phalaṃtatra parakaraṇādinā, teṣāmapyabhāve arthavādena vidhisāpekṣeṇa (rātri satreṣu), tasyābhāve viśvajinnyāyena phalaviśeṣaḥ kalpyate |
yadyapi puruṣa- pravṛttirūpabhāvanāniṣṭhāyā yāgaḥ tatra na karaṇaṃ, tathāpi phalāvacchinnabhāvanāyāṃ viśeṣaṇe karaṇatve (karaṇe) kara- ṇopacāraḥ : iti phaloddeśyakapravartakakṛtiviṣayatvameva atra
'daṇḍena ghaṭaṃ karoti' ityādi loke'pi tathaiva karaṇatvam |
atra yāgakaraṇa- tvaviśiṣṭa lakṣaṇā iti prāñcaḥ |
itthaṃ ca kathaṃ vinaṣṭena yāgena svargo bhāvyaḥ iti pratīyanavasāne antarā apūrvaṃ kṛtvā iti saṃcyate |
tataḥ 'kathamapūrve yāgena kartavyaṃ' iti apūrvabhāvanāyāṃ itthaṃbhāvena saṃyujyamānamitikartavyatājātaṃ apūrvaprayuktami- tyucyate |

tataḥ prakārāpekṣāyāṃ 'samidho yajati' ityā- dityākhyaiḥ iṣṭaviśeṣapekṣaiḥ svādhikāraikyavākyatayā 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmimā prayājādibhāvanāpeta apūrve sādha- yati' ityavagate prayājādīnāṃ tādarthyena samanve paścāt upakāratvaṃ (upakārakatvaṃ) kalpyate |
prathayati' iti prathamavidheḥ arthavādaḥ uru prathasveti |
kapāle'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' iti vidhivaditi |
vidhvantaraśepārthavādakalpo yathā 'tasmādāraṇyamevāśrīyatām' iti vidhiśeṣeṇa 'na vā ete māṣān havirgṛhṇanti' ityanena māṣaniṣedhaḥ kalpyate 'upari hi devebhyo dhārayati' iti vidhi- vaditi |
vāla. pṛ. 30, arthavādakalpo vidhi- dvividhaḥ svatantrārthavādakalpyaḥ vidhvantaraśepārthavāda- kalpyaśca |
ādyo'pi trividhaḥ phalārthavādakalpyaḥ siddha- carlītārthavādakalpyaḥ upākhyānārthavādakalpyaśca |
tatra phalārthavādakalpyo yathā 'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti' iti |
siddhavakīrtanādarthavādakalpyo yathā 'śrīṇa ha vai yajña- syodarāṇi gāyatrī bṛhatsuṣṭup ca, atra hyevāpanti ata evodrapanti' iti |
paruktikalpyo yathā 'tābhyāmeta- mamīpomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ pūrṇamāse prāyacchat' iti kriyāyāṃ kartṛtvena anuṣaṅgāt |
purākalpyo yathā 'tāvattamamīpomī ājyasyeno pāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti |
vidhvantaraśepārthavādakalpyo yathā 'upari hi devebhyo dhārayati' iti pṛ. 12. arthavādagatasya nāmno nātideśakalpam |
bhāṭa. 5|3|9 pṛ. 198. arthavādagatapadānāṃ na pratyekaṃ prāśastyalakṣakatvaṃ tathā sati padāntaravaiyarthyāpatteḥ, kintu kṛtsnasyārthavādavākyasya |
3|4|4. arthavādatvaṃ mantrasyāpi 'artha- vādastadarthavat' (4|4|124) iti sūtreṇa, 'evaṃ ca mantrārthavādaḥ arthavān bhaviṣyati yuṣā suvāsāḥ parīta āgāt' iti tatra tanmādhyeṇa coktam |
tat 'satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma' ityādidupalakṣaṇārthaṃ ityuktaṃ bhaṭṭasomeśvareṇa (sudhāyāṃ uktasūtrade'pi naiṣā paṅktirupalabhyate'smi) |

evaṃ 'ya evaṃ vidvān amāvāsyāṃ yajate' iti vidvākyaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ iti divananopapatyarthasamudāyadisiddhayartha 'vaiśvadevena yajate' itivat 'prācīnapravaṇe vaiśvadevena' ityādidiśivilakṣaṇavat- nopapatyarthakasamudāyasiddhayarthaṃ bhūtārthavādodāharaṇameva |
udāharaṇāntaraṃ yathā 'adhastāt samidhaṃ dhārayannanudreveti hi devebhyo dhārayati' iti |
pralāpaḥ- 'na caitad vidmo brāhmaṇāḥ so vayama- brāhmaṇā vā' iti |
paridevanaṃ- 'ye māmamuṣyanta te māṃ pratyasuhyanta' iti |
tathā paridevanasarūpaḥ- yāvajjīvādhikāraṇe vārtike 'āhitāgnivā eṣa san agnihotraṃ juhoti na darśapūrṇamāsau yajate yā āhutibhājo devatāstā anyāyāyinīḥ karoti' iti paridevanasarūpaḥ |
(atra vārtikapaṅktistha 'āhi- tāmirvā eṣa san dīkṣatasa dānādau niṣiddhe vidhva- ntaraśobhataḥ paridevanasarūpārthavādo bhavati' iti |
anveṣaṇaṃ- 'iha vā saḥ, iha saḥ' iti |
anupaṅgaḥ-- 'yadastana kaṇḍūyeta pāmanabhātukāḥ prajāḥ syuḥ, yat satye namaṃbhātukāḥ, kṛṣṇavipāṇayā kaṇḍūyeta' iti |
iha nabhaṃbhātukāḥ ityatra prajāḥ syuḥ ityanuṣaṅgaḥ |

iti karikaraṇabahuḻaḥ-- 'utsṛjyā''sa notsṛjyā''sa iti mīmāṃsante brahmavādinaḥ tadāhuḥ (tat u āhaḥ) utsṛjya- meveti, amāvāsyāyāṃ ca paurṇamāsyāṃ cotsṛjyamityāhu- rete hi yajñaṃ vahata iti, te tvāva notsṛjyamityāhuḥ ye āvāntaraṃ yajñaṃ mejāte' iti |
ityāhopaniṣadaḥ-- 'devasya tvā savituḥ prasave iti spamadatte prasave' iti itividhivaikāryaśeṣaḥ |
'aśvinorvāhubhyāmityāha, aśvinau hi devānāmadhvaryū āstāṃ, pūṣṇo hastābhyā- mityāha yaccai' iti |

ākhyānakārūpaḥ- 'puruṣaṃ vai devāḥ paśumālabhanta tasmādālabhyānmedha udkrāmat so'śvaṃ prāviśata, tasmādaśvo medho'śvamedhastasmānmedhamayārjata sa kiṃpuruṣo'bhavat te'śvamālabhanta so'śvā- dālabhyādudakāmata sa gāṃ prāviśata' ityādi |
hetuva- nigadāḥ- 'śaryeṇa juhoti' ityasya vidhivaikāryaśeṣaḥ 'tena hyaṃ kriyate' iti |
nindā'rthavādaḥ-- 'na brahmā sāmāni gāyati' iti niṣedhārthavādaḥ |
yadyapi nindā'rthavadyatirikteṣu sarveṣvapi arthavādeṣu praśaṃsā'rthatvamaviśiṣṭaṃ, tathāpi vāyupraśaṃsadvārā vidheyavāyavyapaśuyāgapraśaṃsā itaratra tu na tathā iti bhedaḥ |
saṃśayārthavādaḥ-- 'hotavyaṃ gārha- patye na hotavyaṃ' iti |
parakṛtiḥ-- 'iti ha smāha baṭukurmāṇipāneva mahaṃ pacata' iti 'tasmādāraṇyamevāśrīyāt' ityasya vidhivaikāryaśeṣaḥ |
purākalpaḥ- 'ulmukaiḥ sa pūrvaṃ samājamṛtānasurā rakṣasi nijainuḥ' iti 'tasmād gṛhapatevāmiṣu nimethya nirvaperan' iti

etadapi aprāpta- paurṇamāsīkālavidhiparatvāt na ājyatvajātividhiḥ kilu 'sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate yad dhruvāyāmājyaṃ' iti prātāyā upāṃśuyājadravyaparicchedakatvajāteranuvādaḥ ityuktaṃ daśame upopānye |

bhāṣyakṛt nopadhānamātra- vidhiḥ mantrānuvādaśca, kiṃtu upadhānamātravidhau doṣokteḥ mantramātravidhau doṣokteḥ viśeṣavidhau mukhyānāṃ sahiliṅgakānameva mantrāṇāṃ vidhiprasaktau 'yat saptadaśakā upadadhāti' iti vākyaśeṣāt gauṇyā saptadaśasaṃkhyāvidhiḥ |
guṇavidhi- sarūpaḥ— 'yadākapāle bhavati, gāyatryainaṃ brahmavarcasena punāti' ityasatsarvajātividhirūpatvāt |
kriyāvidhiḥ— mṛtāmihotre 'adhastāt samidhaṃ dhārayannanudravet' iti vidhervākya- śeṣaḥ 'upari hi devebhyo dhārayati' iti |
tatra tṛtīye (3|4|15) ukte, devebhyaḥ ityukteḥ daivāgnihotre jīva- dagnihotre uparidhāraṇasya kathaṃcidācārādinā aprāpteḥ hisaṃbadaparityāgena vidhiḥ kalpyate iti |

kriyāvidhi- sarūpaḥ— 'yo vidagdhaḥ sa nairṛto, yo'dṛtaḥ sa raudro, yaḥ śrutaḥ sa sadaivaḥ', tassādvidahatā śrapayitavyaḥ' sadaivalāya' iti darśapūrṇakaraṇārthāta vākyaṃ audumbarādhikaraṇe 'prakaraṇe ca saṃbhavannapakṣoṃ na kalpyate vidhyānarthakyaṃ hi taṃ prati' (1|4|24) iti sūtre bhāṣyakṛtā udāhṛtya 'vidhipakṣe tu yatra naiṛtastatra vidadhatā nīyeta' tathā sati prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate iti kriyāvidhinirbharastaḥ |
nimittavidhiḥ-- agre śrūyate 'yo vai saṃvatsaramaśvamedha- bhṛtvā''miṃ cinute yathā sāmi garmo vipadyate tādageva tadārtimācchet vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ purastānnirvapet' iti |

atra caturthe (4|1|6) 'vaiśvānarasya nityaḥ syāt' ityadhikaraṇe saṃvatsarabharaṇaṃ arthavādamātraṃ iti nityatā iti pūrvapakṣayitvā kartṛsamānādhikaraṇe yacchabdaḥ nimittatāṃ saṃvatsarabharaṇasya pratipādayati iti naimittiko vaiśvānara- yāgaḥ |
nimittavidhisarūpaḥ— jyotiṣṭome śrutaṃ 'yāṃ vā adhvaryuśca yajamānaśca devatāma- niritastasyā āvṛtyacce, yat prājāpatyaṃ dadhigrahaṃ gṛhṇāti śāmyatyevainaṃ' iti |

'dadhigraho naimittikaḥ śrutisaṃyo- gāt' ityadhikaraṇe (4|1|5) devatantarāyo nimittaṃ yacchabdāt iti pūrvapakṣete siddhāntitaṃ akartṛsamānādhi- karaṇasya yacchabdasya nimittatāpratipādakatvābhāvāt artha- vādamātraṃ antarāyaśravaṇaṃ iti nityo dadhigrahaḥ |

kartṛvidhiḥ--- ṣaṣṭhe (6|1|1) caturhotṛsaṃjñakamantraiḥ puru- pārthatayā vihitā japā homāśca 'caturhotāraṃ prayuñjīta 'caturhotrā prajākāmo juhuyāt' ityatra pūrvapakṣitaṃ, homā āvahanīye kāryāḥ 'eṣā vā anāhitāmeḥ' ityartha- vādamātraṃ japastulyatārthaṃ, iṣṭiśabdena japokteḥ yaiṣā anā- hitāmeḥ kriyā japātmikā seṣṭiḥ iti |
siddhāntastu vacanānarthakyediṣṭivyalakṣaṇaparihārāya ṣaṣṭhīśrutyā anā- hitāmyāgnidvārā homātmakatvarkāḥ |
iti kartṛvidhi- sarūpaḥ--- ṣaṣṭhe (6|1|12) 'iti ha sbāha baṭukurvarṣi- rmāṣāneva madyaṃ pacata' iti vṛṣṇigauraiva māṣapākaḥ kartavyo nānyaiḥ |
kālavidhi- sarūpaḥ--- 'apahatapammāno vā ṛtava iti yadā ka cana kadā canopanamedyadādhītātha yajeta' ityasya śatapatha- vidheḥ śeṣaḥ |
tena na vasantavyatiriktaṛtuvidhivyati- ṣṭome, yadā ka cana iti vihita eva tadvidhisiddheḥ |
idaṃ ca pañcame (5|1|5) 'svakāle syādavamitaṣedhāt' ityadhikaraṇe tannarane yadā ka canetyādeḥ śatapathavākyasya jyotiṣṭome ṛtvantaravidhivokteḥ, taccheṣasya kāla- vidhirūpatvaṃ arthāduktam |
deśavidhiḥ-- tāṇḍake 'sarasvatyā vinaśane dīkṣante, adhvaryuḥ śamyāṃ parāsyati, sā yatra nipatā tadārṣapatyaḥ, tataḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat prakramān prakrāmati tadāhavanīyaḥ |
yanti, dṛṣṭavatyā apye aponaptrīyaṃ caruṃ nirupya yanti' iti vidhāya vākyaśeṣaḥ 'ṛtuścaraṇādiśadādhī- nāni sarasvatī vinaśanāt prākṣaḥ pralavaṇaḥ' iti |

ata eva tanmūla upa saṃhṛtaṃ 'yadā plakṣaṃ pralavaṇamāgacchanti athotyānaṃ, prākṣaṃ pralavaṇamāgamāya amye kāmayeṣṭiṃ nirvapante, tasyāmbāṃ ca purvī ca dhenuke dattvā kārapacavaṃ prati yamunāmavabhṛtha- mabhyavayanti' iti |
vārtike tu catustriṃśadavanīnāni iti śrudantaraṃ vyākaraṇadhikaraṇe (3|4|8) uktam |

deśa- vidhisarūpaḥ— 'ṣaṭtriṃśatprakramā prācī, triṃśatpavane, caturviṃśatiḥ purastāt' iti saumikamahāvedimānavidheḥ vākyaśeṣaḥ 'iyati kṣayāmahave'syāṃ kartuṃ' iti tadetat 'cīkīrṣayā ca saṃyogāt' ityadhikaraṇe (3|1|3) tṛtīya bhaṭṭasomeśvaroktam |

niṣedhavidhiḥ— aitareya- brāhmaṇe hariścandropākhyāne 'hiraṇyakaśipāvāsina ādhve' iti hotṛkartṛkasya ṛtvarthasya 'putrakāmā hyākhyāpya- yeran' iti ca puruṣārthasya śaunaḥśepākhyānavidheḥ vākyaśeṣe 'niyoktāraṃ na vividuḥ' 'vivāsitāraṃ na vividuḥ' iti śāmimantrairlābhoktyā 'mahamaparaṃ śataṃ dattāhamenaṃ viśasiṣyāmi' iti ca lobhāt pravṛttyuktvā 'na hiṃsyāt' iti sāmānyaniṣedhaḥ ṛtvijāṃ svādhi- kārikaḥ; parādhikārikeṇa sāmākhyānikena kartṛmātra- tayā ṛtvijaḥ spṛśatā'pi anādhitaḥ pravṛtho'sti, ata eva tṛtīye 'śamitā ca śabdabhedāt' ityadhikaraṇe (3|1|13) vārtikakṛtā uktaṃ 'ata eva ārvijaṃ nindanti' iti, tathāpi viśeṣaniṣedho doṣopayogārtham arthavādeneti |
niṣedhavidhisarūpaḥ— 'atho khalvāha- ranāhutirvai jatilāśca gavedhukāśca' iti |

daśame hi anāhutiti nindyā niṣedhakalpanāṃ pūrvapakṣayitvā 'na hi nindaṃ nindituṃ pravartate api tu vidheyaṃ stotuṃ' iti śāstrāntarakaraṇe prasaṅgadakena nyāyena 'yat payasā'gnihotraṃ juhoti' iti payovidhiśeṣatvāt na niṣedhakalpanā iti siddhāntam |
saṃdigdhārthopā- dānanirṇāyakaḥ— 'sārasvatī bhavataḥ' iti vidhau 'etadvai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ yat sarasvatī sarasāṃśca' iti |

atra sarasvān devatā yasya asau sārasvataḥ, aparo'pi tathā, tataḥ sārasvataśca sārasvataśca sārasvatī, uta sara- svān devatā yasya ityekasmāditaḥ, aparaśca sarasvatī devatā yasya iti taddhitaḥ, tattayorekaśeṣaḥ iti saṃdigdhe kṣīpuṃsadevatya eva evāyaṃ na puṃdvayadevatyaḥ iti nirṇayaḥ asmādarthavādādbhavati |
tadetat pañcame 'mukhya- krameṇa vā''jñānāṃ' ityadhikaraṇe (5|1|7) śāstradīpikāyā- muktam |
saṃdigdhārthaśaktigrāhakaḥ-- 'yavamatībhi- rrirdumbarī prokṣati' iti vidhervākyaśeṣaḥ 'yadā vā anayā oṣadhayo mriyante athaite modamānā ichonti' iti |
upamānārthavādaḥ— 'yathā vai śyeno nipalādate evamayaṃ dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ nipalādate yamabhiricarati dvayenena' iti |
(arthavādapādasya viṣayaḥ kathyate) vā— 'siddha- pramāṇabhāvasya dharme vedasya sarvaśaḥ |
' sāmānyataḥ prāmāṇye siddhe adhunā vibhajya viniyogaḥ prati- pādyate |
avadhṛtaprāmāṇyasya vā vedasya idānīṃ samastasya vidhyārthavādamantrāṇāmeva yathāvibhāgaṃ dharme prati upayogaḥ pratipādyate |
bhāṣyaṃ— 'so'rodīt yadarodīt tadrudrasya tvam' 'prajāpatirātmano vapāmudakhidat' 'devā vai devayajanamavyavasāya diśo na prājānan' ityevādīni samānāntāraḥ samāmananti vākyāni |
tāni kiṃ kaṃ ciddharmaṃ pramimate, uta na iti vicāraṇā |
kriyā kathamanveṣṭā iti tadvituṃ samāmnātāro vākyāni samāmananti |

nāvagamayanti kriyāsaṃbaddhaṃ vā kiṃcit, evameva bhūta- maye anvācakṣate, kaditavān rudraḥ, vapāmucchisde prajāpatiḥ, devā vai diśo na prajajñire ityevajātīya- kāni, tāni kaṃ dharmaṃ pramimīran ? athocyeta adhyā- hāreṇa vā, viparīṇāmena vā, vyavahitakalpatayā vā, vyavadhāraṇakalpatayā vā, guṇakalpatayā vā kaścidarthaḥ kalpyiṣyate iti, sa kalpyamānaḥ kaḥ kalpyeta ? rudraḥ kila roda, ataḥ anyenāpi roditavyam |
ucchisde ātmavapāṃ prajāpatiḥ, ataḥ anyo'pi ucchidet ātmano vapām |
devā vai devayajanakāle diśo na praśātavantaḥ, ataḥ anyo'pi diśo na prajānīyāt iti |
iṣṭaviyogena abhihatena vā yat brāhmaṇamocanaṃ tat rodanaṃ ityucyate |
na ca kaścit ātmano vapāṃ ucchiva tāmyau prahṛtya tat usthitena tūpareṇa paśunā yathuṃ śaknuyāt |
na ca devayajanādhyavasānakāle ke cit diśo muhyuḥ |
yadyapi ca nityāni, tathāpi na nityamarthaṃ kurvanti iti |
sa eṣa vākyaika- deśasya ākṣepaḥ, na kṛtsnasya vākyasya |
nanu eka- deśādinā sākāṅkṣaḥ padasamūho na paryāptaḥ svargame prayo- janāya, ata ākṣita eveti |
bhavati hi kaścit padasamūhaḥ, yaḥ arthavādebhyo vinā'pi vidadhāti kaṃ cidartham |
yāni punaḥ taiḥ saha saṃyujya arthāntare vartante, tāni ekadaśākṣepeṇa ākṣipyante |

vā-- tatra pūrvapakṣavābhiprāyaḥ - 'codanālakṣaṇo- 'rtho dharmaḥ' ( 1|1|2 ) ityupakramāt 'tasya jñānama- padeśaḥ' ( 1|1|5 ) iti parāmarśāt, 'tadbhūtamānāṃ kriyārthena samāmnāyaḥ' ( 1|1|25 ) ityupasaṃhārāt vidhiprati- ṣedhayoreva prāmāṇyaṃ pratipāditam |
nāpyanadhigatārthabodhanaṃ muktvā anyaḥ śabdasya vyāpāro'sti ityuktameva |
ataśca yāvantyeva sādhyasādhanetikartavyatācitvena vidhiprati- ṣedhāntargatāni, teṣāṃ bhavatu prāmāṇyam |
rodīt' 'iṣe tvāje tvā' 'udvidā' ityevamā- dīni, tāni satyāpi apauruṣeyatve arthāmidhānasāmarthyaṃ ca dharmādharmayoḥ : apramāṇaṃ atadarthatvāt |
pratyakṣanimittaṃ bhavati, cakṣurāderanavatasyāpi nimittatva- sthitayostviprapratipādanāya stutirapi asatyatvāt nāva- |
āntarālikasmṛtivyavahitamapi cendriyasaṃvanyā- kalpyate ityeṣā vā anavadhāraṇā |
na yat sahasā iti prātarayaṃ mantraḥ, 'agnirjyotiḥ' ityevaṃ sāyaṃ, ityeṣā |
sarvasya pratyakṣaṃ na bhavati, tat nipuṇato'pi paśyatāṃ na mantrayoradhāraṇā na sidhyati |
svayaṃprabhātu darśanā'yaṃ ityeṣā avadhāraṇā na sidhyati ityabhiprāyaḥ |
na ca dṛṣṭavirodhadvayaṃ, punaḥ śāstrādṛṣṭavirodhaḥ iti yat, |
na yat giriśṛṅga- saddṛṣṭanyāyāni santi kramabhedena codyate, tat parihāra- |
na ca strīṇāṃ ka cit sūtrakramabhedānurodhena |
vyabhicāradarśanāt sarvatraiva kalpya yuktā, lokaviruddhānu- varaṇaśeṣo'bhimataḥ |
viśiṣṭena hi prayatnena mahākulīnāḥ pari- tadviṣayatvena apramāṇam |
anenaiva hetunā rājabhirbrāhmaṇaiśca viparyayāḥ kena cidaṃśena karmaṇi upayujyante |
tathā ca pratikulaṃ guṇadoṣasaraṇāt tadanurūpāḥ jñānapratipādane prāmāṇyam |
na ca bhartṛvyatirekatena varṇa- yadā samānākārepu piṇḍeṣu brāhmaṇavādavibhāgaḥ śāstre- |
aśubhaphalopabhogaḥ bhavet, na tu apajātānāṃ varṇasaṃkaraḥ |
na ca niyogataḥ (na niyamena) varṇāntareva saha pramādaḥ |
jātānāmapi ca punaḥ : utkarṣāpakarṣyāṃ saptame pañcame vā tulyam |
tatra tu cchinnaṃ svavyaktiṣu anugataṃ śāstrādimadūpeṇa dṛśyate, na |
etāvanmātraṃ āgamikaṃ pratyetavyaṃ, nahi ayaṃ puruṣeyattā- tu brāhmaṇatvam |
tasmāt satyapi sārūpye ntarādate naiva pratipadyate |
yeṣāmapi ācāranimittā brāhmaṇatvadayaḥ, teṣāmapi dṛṣṭa- pratipadyeta, sa śuktikāmāpi rajataṃ manyamānaḥ krīṇīyāt |
siddhāntāṃ hi brāhmaṇādīnāṃ bhavati iti varṇitametat |
sa eva karṇa-ākāraviśeṣapādayaḥ anyajātigrahaṇe kāraṇaṃ, tathaiva |
śubhācārakāle brāhmaṇaḥ, punaḥ aśubhācārakāle śūdra- atra utpādakajātismaraṇaṃ |
tathā ekenaiva prayatnena parampīḍā'nu- saṃbandhaḥ : mātṛreva pratyakṣaḥ, anyeṣāṃ tu anumānātopa- |
samudāyo brāhmaṇyaṃ, na tajjanitaḥ saṃskāraḥ, na tadbhi- |
'paśubandhayājī sarvān lokānabhijayati' 'tarati mṛtyuṃ tarati vyavasthite 'māsena śūdrī bhavati' ityevādīni karma- |
brahmahatyāṃ yo'śvamedhena yajate ya u cainamevaṃ veda' nindāvacanāni, athavā varṇayatrakarmahānipratipādanāni |
nahi aktvā pūrṇāhūti kalpyena ajñānavidhinā saha vikalpo na saṃbhavati |
agnihotrādayaḥ kriyante, na ca aniṣṭvā agniṣṭomīyena api ca tatra anuṣṭhānatmakatvāt bhavedipi, na tu atra |
somena yajante, na ca anadhīya aśvamedhena yajante |
tadyathā payijāte'ke madhu utsṛjya tenaiva pathā madhvarthinaḥ tadveda' iti pūrvavedava ajñānasaṃśayaviparyayāṇāṃ anaupa- |
parvataṃ na gaccheyuḥ, tādṛśaṃ hi tat |
vā-- anantareṇaiva pūrṇāhūtyādiphalavacanāni vyākhyā- tathā phalābhāvān ||
pūrṇāhūteḥ asiṃsaskāratvāt, paśubandhasya ca jyotiṣṭomo- 'sya mukhaṃ ya evaṃ veda' iti yadi bhūtānuvādaḥ, ana- |
pakārakatvāt, aśvamedhajñānasya ca saṃskāratvāt na tāvat rthakaḥ |
yadi punariṣyate, tataḥ anyānartha- kālāntare phalaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cet, nahi atra pramāṇa- |
kriyante, teṣāṃ yathā ruci anuṣṭhānāt nānyanarthakatvam |
pūrṇāhūtipaśubandhayostu akṛtayoḥ itarakarmārdhākārāt etat upariṣṭāt ki phalavidhiḥ, utārthavāda iti |
'prathamaṃ vā niyamyeta' (11|1|43) ityanena tu kiṃ bhūtānuvādaḥ kriyārtho vā iti |
nyāyena avāpte phale nottarakarmānuṣṭhānayojanamasti iti tvāt nirākṛtasya iha anarthako'rthavādavicāra iti |
'tenaiva pathā 'āḍasya prājāṃ vājī jāyate ya evaṃ veda' iti |
madhvarthinaḥ' iti yatra anyaḥ panthāḥ parvatasya tatra gacche- codāharaṇam |
hi samānāyāṃ śrutau apratyakṣaḥ san phalaviśeṣaḥ karma- na dharme prati pramāṇam |
paunaruktyāt tarhi atra vicāritavyaṃ atha āha, |
bhāṣyaṃ-- 'na pṛthivyāmimiśretavyo, nāntarikṣe, na tena phalavidhitvān nirākṛtasya iha ānarthakyārthavādala- |
yata eva etat, antarikṣe divi ca agniṃ cīyate iti |
kathaṃ tat pramāṇaṃ, yat vidhvantaramākulayet svayaṃ cākulaṃ syāt ? |
vā-- trīṇyapi pṛthivyādivacanāni apratiṣedhabhābhi- namarthaṃ pratiṣedhanti |
antarikṣe divi ca tattvat aprati- tvāt pratiṣedhāviṣayatvam |
anantarikṣe hi divi ca pṛthivyāṃ nityaṃ cayanaṃ prāptaṃ iti tadvidhiranarthakaḥ |
durlabhaśca pratiṣedhaḥ pṛthivīparatve sati cayanai kalpyatvāt |
vidhva- ntarameva 'hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya cetavyaṃ' 'iṣṭakābhiragniṃ cinute' etacca ākulayet |
bhāṣya-- anityasaṃyogaśca vedaprāmāṇye sati ' paraṃ tu śrutisāmānyānmātraṃ' (1|1|8|139) iti parihṛtaḥ |
idānīṃ vaidaikadeśānāṃ āśritānāṃ punarapīdakaḥ uttiṣṭhati ' varaḥ prāvāhāṇikāmayata' iti |
vā-- sarvopakhyeyaneṣu anyaparatvasaṃbhavatvāt svarūpa- pratipādanāt anityasaṃyogaḥ |
sa ca samastavedaprāmāṇye sati kathaṃcit anyathā nīyeta |

yadā tu yathaiva pramā- ṇānāṃ madhye śabdaḥ, tatrāpi ca vedaḥ pramāṇaṃ, tathaiva vede- 'pi vidhimātraṃ yuktvā kalpyate, tadā itarekadeśavat anilyārthaikadeśaprāmāṇyaṃ yathāśrutāgrahaṇāt āpannaṃ kiṃ nivābhyate |
tasmāt evamādīnāṃ anapekṣya artha adhyayana- mātrādeva phalaṃ kalpyam |
athavā yathā etāni upekṣā- phalāni tathā tadviparyaṃ pratyakṣamapi pratipattavyam |
atha kasmāt mantravat yathāprakaraṇaṃ prayogakāle na prayujyate, prayoga- sāmarthyābhāvāt |
nahi mantrāṇāṃ pāṭhamātreṇa viniyogaḥ; kiṃ tarhi tatsāmarthyāt |
athavā yathā teṣāṃ pūrvapakṣe kāryāntarābhāva rūpamātraṃ grahīṣyate tathā atrāpyastu |
yat sūtrakāraṇe anityatvamukte, tat prāmāṇyāpekṣayā, na aprayojyatvā |
bhāṣya--idaṃ samāmnāyate ' vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta bhūtikāmaḥ, vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā, vāyumeva svena bhāga- dheyenopadhāvati, sa evainaṃ bhūtiṃ gamayati ' iti |
vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā ityatra yadyapi kriyā nāvagamyate kriyā- saṃbaddhaṃ vā kiṃcit, tathāpi vidhyuddeśena ekavākyatvāt pramāṇam |
' bhūtikāmaḥ ' ityevamanto vidhyuddeśaḥ, tena ekavākyabhūtaḥ ' vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā ' ityevamādiḥ |
kathamekavākyabhāvaḥ ? padānāṃ sākāṅkṣatvāt vidheḥ stuteśca ekavākyatvaṃ bhavati |
nāyamabhisaṃbandho viva- kṣitaḥ ' bhūtikāmena ālabhyaṃ ' iti |
kathaṃ tarhi ? ' ālabheta, yatastato bhūtiḥ ' iti |
kimarthā stuti- riti cet, kathaṃ roceta, nānuṣṭhīyeta iti |
nanu prāk stutivacanāt anuṣṭhānaṃ bhūtikāmāntāt siddhaṃ, stuti- vacanamanarthakam |
yadā stutipadasannidhānaṃ tadā pūrveṇaiva vidhiḥ, yadā stutipadasaṃbandhaḥ, na tadā bhūtikāmāsya ālambho vidhīyate |
yathā paṭo bhavati iti, paṭa utpadyate ityarthaḥ; nirākāṅkṣaṃ ca pada- dvayam |
yadā ca tasminneva rakta iti aparaṃ śrūyate, tadā rāgasaṃbandho bhavatītyarthaḥ; bhavati ca raktaṃ prati ākāṅkṣā |
evaṃ yadā na stutipadāni vidhiśabdenaiva tadā prarocanā, yadā stutivacanaṃ tadā stavanena |
nanu evaṃ sati kiṃ stutivacanena, yasmin sati adhivāyakaṃ, mā bhūt tat, tadabhāve'pi pūrvavidhineva prarocyiṣyate iti |
satyaṃ, vinā'pi tena sidhyet prarocanaṃ, asti tu tat |
nanu saravapi stutipade pūrvasya vidhirūpatvāt vidhi- rabhipretaḥ syāt, na vivakṣyeta stutipadasaṃbandhaḥ |
āha, stutipade hi anarthakāni anabhivyañjanu sākāṅkṣāṇi |
bhavantu anarthakāni iti cet, na gamyamāne'rthe avi- vakṣitārthāni bhavitumarhanti |
śaknoti nirapekṣaḥ arthe vidhātuṃ, śaknoti ca stutipadānāṃ vākyaśeṣī bhavitum |
kiṃtu aśakyaḥ stutipadasaṃbandhe sati vidhyartho vivakṣita- tum |
dvau cet saṃbandhau vidadhyāt ' bhūtikāma ālabheta ' ' ālambhena ca eṣa guṇe bhaviṣyati ' iti, bhidyeta tarhi evaṃ sati vākyam |
atha yaduktaṃ na kriyā gamyate, na tatsaṃbaddhaṃ vā kiṃci- diti, ' stutyarthena vidhīnāṃ syuḥ ' |
stutiśabdāḥ stuvantaḥ, prarocayamānāḥ anuṣṭhātṝn, upakariṣyanti kriyāyāḥ |
evamimāni sarvāṇyeva padāni kaṃ vidadhate stuvanti ( śatrantaṃ ) vidadhati |
ataḥ pramāṇamevaṃjātī- yakāni ' vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā ' iti |
vā--pūrvapakṣodāhṛteṣveva vākyeṣu siddhānte abhi- dhātavye kimarthaṃ vāyavyavākyamupanyasyate ? ke cidāhuḥ, samānanyāyatvāt idamapi tatra, tānyāpi ca iha udā- hṛttāni dravyāṇi iti |
tatra kaḥ prathama- meva tatrātipādanakleśāṃ aṅgīkuryāt iti prasiddhārtha- satyalānāṃ stutidvārā ekavākyabhāvena dharmapramāṇaśeṣala- mātraprāptisatkāryārthe vāyavyavākyopanyāsaḥ |
tatra bhāṣya- kārāḥ prasiddhenaiva ekavākyatvena stutyarthopayogaṃ vadanti |
( vedavākyānāṃ ekavākyatvādapratipādanopa- yogaḥ ) etāvattra prathamaṃ vaktavyaṃ, kimarthaṃ rūpa- bhedena balādekavākyatayā puruṣārthaṃ vā vedasya ucyate iti |
laukikavākye tu dṛṣṭatvāt iti yadi ucyate, tatrā- midhīyate |
yuktaṃ loke vākyarthasya pramāṇāntaragama- tvāt anyathā'pi kalpanam |
iha tu atyantātīndriya- tvāt yathāśrutāt īpadapi anyathātve pauṣkalyamabhāva- yet |
loke'pi ca yāni pramāṇāntaranagatārthāni āsa- pratyayamātreṇa śrotṛṇāṃ pramāṇāni bhavanti, teṣāṃ naiva anyathātvakalpanāṃ labhyate |
tatra ke cidvadanti, ' tulyaṃ ca sāmpradāyikaṃ ' ( 1|1|18 ) iti yakṣyati, tena
nahi ātmānupa- kāriṇaṃ santaṃ enaṃ buddhipūrvakāriṇaḥ puruṣāḥ prayatnena dhārayeyuḥ |
yadyapi ca keṣāṃ cidajñānaṃ bhaveta, tathāpi asātpūrvātikāntānekaparīkṣakapramādakalpanā niṣpramā- ṇikā |
tasmāt yathāyathā puruṣārthatā bhavati, tathātathā bhaṅkatvā'pi rūpaṃ, vyākhyāyate iti |
yadi hi akṣarā- nupātta'pi arthaḥ asadādibhireva kalpyate, yasmāt vayaṃ prayatnena dhārayāmaḥ : tasmādasya puruṣārthateti |
tathā sati ātmacetitavaśena prāmāṇyaṃ abhyupagataṃ syāt |
atha puruṣāntaradhāraṇamucyeta, evamapi tadadhena, tairapi evamanyavarena dhāryatvādile'pi sati anyaparaṃparayāyena sarveṣāṃ parapratyayāt na ka cit prāmāṇyavyākhyānam |
sarvatra hi ' evamayaṃ puruṣo veda ' iti pratyayaḥ, na ' evamaya- marthaḥ ' iti |
tena yadyapi teṣu adhyeṣu nūnaṃ puru- pārthaṃ vedaṃ manyante ityabhiprāyo'numīyate, tathāpi nirmūla- tvāt tanmātreṇa asiddhiḥ |
ato yāvat veda eva puruṣārthatayā sakalaṃ ātmānaṃ na pratipādayati tāvada- pramāṇam |
sakalasya tāvat vedasya ' svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ ' iti adhyayanabhāvanā vidhau- yate |
tatra kiṃ bhāvayet ityapekṣāyāṃ adhyayanaṃ ityā- gatamapi puruṣapravartanāśaktiyukena vidhyāvekena apuruṣārtha- sādhyāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ pravartanā'śaktiprasakteḥ tadaṃśāt nirā- kriyate |
tataśca adhyayanena ilyavirodhāt saṃnidheśca kara- ṇāṃśe niviśate |
tena kiṃ ityapekṣite ' vakṣyate ' ityupavandhāt akṣaragrahaṇaṃ ityapaṭhati |
tathāpi apuru- pārthatvāt ' tena kiṃ ' ' padāvadhāraṇaṃ ' ityupa- tiṣṭhate |
tenāpi padārthajñānaṃ, tena vākyārthajñānaṃ, tena ca anuṣṭhānaṃ, anuṣṭhānena svargādiphalaprāptiḥ; iti etāvati prāpte nirākāṅkṣā bhavati |
evaṃ sarvavidhīnāṃ prāk puruṣā- rthalābhāt arthavasānam |
na ca sahasaiva vidhiradarśanāt svargādeva phalaṃ kalpyate |
yogyatayā hi yasya yatra ana- ntarabhāvinī vyāpāro lakṣyate, tadeva tasya kāryaṃ ityava- dhāryate |
tatra yadi tāvat tadanusāreṇaiva kriyāpi adhvani phalamāsādyate, tato nāntarā kalpanamarhati |
yatra tu anantaraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ na svayaṃ puru- |
nāpi pāraṃparyeṇa tamāpnoti, yathā homasya āha- |
vanīyaprāptiḥ bhasmāsādbhāvo vā, tatra taditikrameṇa sākṣāt |
( arthavādānāṃ bhāvanāṃśatrayāntaḥpātistvaṃ- ) yatra tu vihite phalatvākāṅkṣiṇa tadātmakakāryaparaṃparāyāṃ |
yattu arthavādānāṃ bhāvanāṃśatrayāntaḥpātitvāt satyāṃ āntarālikaṃ kiṃ cit ṛtave puruṣārthāya vā |
satyaṃ atiriktaṃ na gṛhyate, coyate, tatra tadeva tatsādhanaṃ, pūrvasya tu vidheḥ tadupa- |
kathaṃ ? iha hi liṅādiyukteṣu kārārthatayā paryavasānam |
vākyeṣu dve bhāvane gamyete śabdārthamikā ca arthātmikā prāk tāni sādhyasādhanabhāvena acoditatvāt nāntarī- |
tatra arthātmikā arthavādā nāpekṣyante, śabdātmikā yakatvena kāṣṭhādīnāmivā jvalanādīni pūrvavihitakarmasva- |
sā hi evaṃ pravartate, svādhyāyādhyayana- vyāpāramātratayā mantavyāni |
vidhinā itare sarve viśrāvyakāḥ svādhyāyopadeśācca ātmā cidantarā vidhīyate, tatra sarvāṇi svavyāpārīkṛtya vidheya- |
tatra liṅādīnāṃ prayojakakartṛttvaṃ, sthaiveva svasya phalasādhanatā |
tena kiṃ ityapekṣāyāṃ puruṣapravartanaṃ yiṣyamāṇapuruṣārthasādhanavidhiśrāvyāṇi, tāni tatrati- |
atha tu yogyatayaiva liṅādiviṣayā kriyā pādanaṃ yāvat svādhyāyādhyayanavidhinā nīyante, para- |
ucyate pravartayet iti, tataḥ kiṃ ityapekṣite puruṣaṃ ityeva tastu phalavattvaṃ jñātameva iti na tat yātrat |
yadyapi ca acetanatvāt liṅādiyu evaṃ- prāpyante |
yāni tu tankaraṇe paṭhyante, tānyapi tathaiva |
vidhaṃ prayojakatvaṃ na saṃbhavati, tathāpi puruṣasya prayo- akṣaragrahaṇādikrameṇa svārthārthabodhanaṃ yāvat gatāni, na |
jyasya prayojakatvānupapatteḥ : tadgatacaitanyadvāreṇa vidhāya- sākṣāt phalajñaṃ bhavanti |
yadi ca evaṃ na kalpyeta, naiva pāyāpekṣeṇa kṛtādhyayanāt akṣarādiṣu anavarājatā |
atha kena ityape- tadvihitaṃ karmamātrameva hi prayojanadvāreṇa upādīyate |
kṣite pūrvaitadarthānubhāvāpekṣeṇa vidhivijñānena iti saṃśra- nānyat |
etat ? buddhipūrvakāriṇo hi puruṣāḥ yāvat praśasto'yaṃ prokṣaṇādivākyānāṃ vrīhyādisaṃskāramātraphalavasitānāṃ |
rthāmake phalaśaṃ sarvasya svayameva anuṣṭhānaṃ bhavati iti kyāni yojayitavyāni |
sādhanati- viśeṣaḥ, yat aprakaraṇasthatvāt akṣarāṇi aspṛṣṭvā pradhānaṃ |
kartavyatostu apravṛttapuruṣaniyogāt jñātvāmeva prāśastya- athaiva saṃśravyate |
sādhanāpekṣāyāṃ yadi vā phalapadena niyaṃvyeta, praśasto'yaṃ vasāyīni dūrasthaiva phalena nirākāṅkṣīkriyante |
bhūtiphalatvāt, athavā vidhinaiva sarvadopāśaṅkānivṛttyā- etena ṛtvarthakartṛpratipādanadvāreṇa upaniṣadāṃ nairā- |
vedavihitatvāt iti, athavā viśiṣṭadravyadevatetikarta- kāṅkṣyaṃ vyākhyātam (sudhā- upaniṣadamapi āghā- |
vyatāyuktatvāt iti, tatra phalapadādī arthāntarapa- nādivākyanyāyena dūrasthaiva kṛtaphalena nairākāṅkṣyami- |
yogāt punaḥ anyātrāpi upayogo na yujyate |
kālā ceyaṃ ākāṅkṣā, pūrvaṃ ca phalapadādiniveśaḥ |
ataśca ekavākya- na ca śrautārthasaṃbhave sā yuktā |
nityaṃ ca vidhiviṣayatveyoḥ krameṇa vākya- dhāt prāśastyaparatve phalādīni na syuḥ |
tatra tu cittaṃ vidhipratiṣedhāḥ śruti- mūlāḥ; ke citta arthasulabhāni lokamulāḥ|
tathā artha- vādāḥ ke cittaidikā eva, ke cittaukikā eva, ke cittu svayameva kāvyanyāyena racitāḥ|
ye tu vākyaśeṣatvaṃ na pratipadyante, te'pi ke citta svaya- meva śrūyamāṇagandhamādādivarṇakaprabhṛtayaḥ prītiṃ janayanti|
ye tu yuddhavarṇakāḥ, te sarveṣāṃ śūrāṇāṃ mīruṇāṃ ca utsāha- karāḥ; pārthivanāmāmupayujyante|
yatra na kiṃcit dṛṣṭamupa- labhyate, tatra viśiṣṭadevatādistutidvāre adṛṣṭaṃ kalpanīyaṃ ityeṣā dik|
(bhāṣyayojanā kecinmatena, paścācca svamatena) 'vidhyudeśena ekavākyatvāt' (bhā. pṛ. 116) iti|
ke cidāhuḥ 'kimarthā stutiriti cet kathaṃ roceta, (iti vidheye) nā''nuṣṭhīyeta' (iti niṣedhye) ityevaṃ stutinindāmyāṃ pravṛttinivṛtti- pādanaṃ, liṅgādibhiśca abhidhānam|
tatra ye tāvat arthavāda- rahitāḥ liddhadayaḥ; tadrahitāśca arthavādāḥ; teṣāṃ yathā- viṣayaṃ vyavasthitaṃ nivartakatvaṃ pravartakatvaṃ (ca) avi- ruddham|
yatra tu darśanepāta, tatra anyatareṇa kṛtārtha- tvāt avayavāvaye anyatarasmin bhūyasāmanugraho yuktaḥ|
yathā 'satrādu- davasāya pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena yajeran' iti, ktvāpratyayasiddha- pravṛttanuvādakatvaṃ vakṣyate|
sa eva ca vidhyudeśaḥ phalādisaṃndhettarakāla stūyate ityetat 'bhūtikāmaḥ' ityevamanto vidhyudeśaḥ' |
sutroktena tu vidhinā ekavākyatvaṃ na saṃbhavati iti atikramya tadviṣayaḥ parigṛhyate|
vidhiviśeṣasaṃbandhaniṣedhena stutitvasaṃbandhaṃ vivakṣitaṃ vadati 'yatstato bhūtiḥ' iti|
'bhinnau imau' iti pūrvoktau saṃbandho abhi- dhatte|
pratyayaścet utlātaḥ; tena avidhīyamānasya kiṃ stutyā iti|
athavā yadanayā sādhyate tat pratyayenaiva setsyati iti manasi kṛtvā vadati|
ācāryastu utlāte'pi pratyaye arthavādadeva tadarthāvāptiṃ ubhayasaṃbhave ca arthavādān- grahaṃ matvā āha 'kathaṃ roceta' iti|
itaraḥ praśnābhi- prāyaṃ vivṛṇoti, prāgeva siddhe: 'stutivacanamanarthakaṃ iti|
sarvatra avāntaravākyāni mahāvākyeṣu apramāṇaṃ, mahāsaṃkhyāsu eva avāntarasaṃkhyā, bhavanti|
tānyeva tu yadā kevalāni prayujyante, tadā nira- pekṣatvāt bhavanti pramāṇam|
na ca kadā cit etāvanamātreṇa samāteḥ nairā- kāṅkṣayadarśanāt sarvatra nairākāṅkṣyam|
tathā ca yatra upalabhyante, tatra ekavākyatāṃ gamiṣyante|
anyathā hi asau taduccāraṇe'pi na syāt|
tatsadbhāve tu na ityeta- dāha 'yadā na stutipadāni' iti|

yatra mahāvākyāntaravākyayoḥ phalaṃ bhidyate yathā paṭabhavanarāgabhavane, tatraiva yuktaṃ, iha tu anatiriktāthasya phalaṃ, tadetadāha 'yasmin sati avidhāyakaṃ' avāntara- vākyaṃ bhavati, 'mā bhūt tat' mahāvākyaṃ iti|
yo nāma vedasya kartā syāt, sa evaṃ paryanuyujyeta 'laghunā upāyena siddhe, kiṃ mahāvākyamābhyasi' iti|
yathā tamevārthe 'laṃ' ityetāvatā sidhyantaṃ ākāśaprabhu- tibhiḥ abhilapanti, na ca jāḍyaṃ labhante|
tathā''tra liṅgādibhirapi sidhyantaṃ arthavādebhyo gṛhṇate iti|
śakyate cedaṃ vaktuṃ yathaiva anekopāyāṅgai mantreṇa
smṛtaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ abhyudayakāri bhavati, tathā anyenāpi vidhisiddhau arthavādapratipāditavidhihitaṃ iti|
yatra laghumayā anupādāya gurupāyaḥ āśrīyate tatra tathāpi bhavate|
atra tu pūrva- meva laghutara āśritaḥ: samarthataraśca|
tasmāt yathaiva prayukte kha-śabde nākāśādayaḥ tadānīmeva prayujyante, tathā''tra vidhau sati stutiḥ nāśayitanyeti|
tatra uttara- sākāṅkṣatvāt stutipadāni anarthakāni syuriti|
'bhavantu iti cet' noktena nyāyena arthavattvāt avi- vakṣitārthatā yukteti|
dvayasaṃbhave hi pratyakṣadeśavākya- tvāt arthavadānugraho yukta iti|
'nanu sarasvapi' ityanena gatārthatvāt 'nanu nirapekṣatvāt' iti ava- ktavyam|
tatra arthavādaparityāgāya uktaṃ, idānīṃ tu bhavatu nāma stutisaṃbandhaḥ: rāmasasya, pūrvasyāpi tu svarūpāvagato vidhisaṃbandho na bādhitavyaḥ|
athāhasya kacidapi śaktiḥ apahiyate, tataḥ pratiprasavahebhāvāt sarvatra aśaktatvaprasaṅgaḥ iti|
bhavatu pūrvasya vidhiśaktiḥ, na tu iyaṃ ca kiñcit itya anya- vāpi bādhyate, kadā cidāvirbhūtā iti sarvatra āvirbhavati|
yatra tu arthāntarastutyādi nopādīyate tatra, āvirbhūtā śaktiḥ kāryamārabhate|
yatra tu apavādabhūtaśaktyantarārabhi- vyaktiḥ tatra vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt purā tirodhīyate|
praśnottaratvena ayaṃ pūrvokta eva vākyabhedaḥ parāmṛśyate|
'havyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ' (pā01| 4|133) iti saṃpradānatvaṃ kasmāt bhavati ? prarocyateḥ prakṛtyantaratvāt iti cet, na, tatrāpi rucisaṃbandhanapallavāt|
atha sāmānyaviṣayayā ṣaṣṭhī ityucyate, sā''pi upātte viśeṣe durlabhā|
tasmāt anuṣṭhātṝṇāṃ kriyāyāḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ : kebhyaḥ prarocaya- mānā iti apekṣite, arthāt tebhya evaitau gamyate|
atha ca 'anuṣṭhātṝṇāmupakariṣyanti' iti saṃbandhaḥ : kriyāyāḥ iti pañcamī|
kriyāto'pi hi ta eva prarocakāḥ iti|
tatsaṃbandhinaṃ vā kaṃ ciddhā vidadhāti kriyāṃ tatsaṃbandhinaṃ vā, tacca stutidvāreṇa|
(kecinmatenoktāṃ bhāṣyavyākhyāṃ dūṣayati-) idaṃ tu vyākhyānaṃ nānumanyante|
yadi hi pratyayollātiḥ syāt tataḥ kena stutirākāṅkṣyeta|
yā''pi kasmāt ityapekṣā kalpyeta, sā''pi vidhītikartavyatāviṣayaiva tadanugrahārthatvāt|
sā''pi ca niyujyamānasyaiva puruṣasya bhavati, na kriyāmātraśravāt|
nahi vāyavya- śvetālambhaḥ ityukte kartavyatā'kartavyatokteḥ prāk praśastaḥ amadastaḥ iti vā apekṣyate|
tadanapekṣatita ca śruti- mātreṇaiva vadantaḥ nārthavādāḥ pratipādayanti|
na ca dhātva- rthena saha citta saṃbandhaḥ apekṣā vā vidyate, sarvasya bhāvanāgāmitvāt|
tasmāt taddvātrayocchedāt na bhūtiḥ phalaṃ, na yāgaḥ karaṇaṃ, na vā itikartavyatā kā citta syāt|
ukte''pi ca prādhāsye kasmāt iti anapekṣitatvāt praśasta''yaṃ ityetāvāntrame avadhṛte praśastatvāt ityanuya- māne kartavyatābuddhiḥ naiva syāt|
bhavantī vā tanniṣṭhā bhavet 'praśasta''yaṃ kartavyaḥ', 'paṭo raktaḥ kartavyaḥ' : itivat|
pratyakṣaṃ ca vidhimulujya pāraṃparyalakṣaṇayā arthavādebhyaḥ parigṛhyate iti apūrvā vācoyuktiḥ|
anukte hi san arthavādādeva vidhiḥ kalpyeta, yadi anyathā nopapadyeta|
tathā arthavādo''pi yadi upākhyānādibhiva prarocanāyāṃ niṣprayojanaḥ syāt, tato dūraṃ nīyeta|
yathoktena tu nyāyena prarocanopayogāt nānyatra gacchati iti|
avadhaktavyatvāt ca prarocanā yadi anyataḥ sidhyet, tataḥ arthavādāpekṣābheta|
sarvatra ca vaidike- ''rthe arthāpatyā śabdaḥ kalpyeta, tataḥ arthasiddhiḥ, tena prarocanayā vidhiśabdaḥ kalpyeta, nārthaḥ|
tatkalpanā- velāyāṃ ca yathā aindravāyavādivākyeṣu 'somena yajeta'
ityasmin upatiṣṭhamāne nānyajiklpanā, tathaiva āla- meta ityanena anyānumānapratibandhaḥ |
pratyayārthavādayoḥ punaḥ atyantabhinnā- nugrāhyānugrāhyaviṣayatvena arthamedāt samuccayaḥ |
yadi ca pratyayollāsaḥ syāt tat kartṛsaṃkhyo- pagrahaviśeṣāyagatakriyāphalasvārthaparārthatvācchedeprasaṅgaḥ |
etaccāśakyaṃ, yataḥ tadarthamapi upāttaḥ pratyayaḥ sāmarthyāt vidhitvaṃ vadatyeva |
pratītasya ca dvayī evāvikṣā, vidhisaṃsparśo vā mraikkalavat, anu- vādakatvaṃ vā indriyakāmahomavat |
na tāvat vidheḥ avidhitvaṃ nāma kiṃcit |
nahi evaṃ saṃbhavati, 'yo'yaṃ vāyavyadhvetālabhamḥ kartavyaḥ sa praśastaḥ' iti, bhavati tu evaṃ 'kartavyaḥ praśastatvāt' iti |
yadudavasanīyavat iti, tatrāpi ktvāśona vidhipratiṣedhau anapekṣya kriyāmātrāt vidhilamāśritameva ityeṣṭavyatā |
yadi ca vidhivivakṣā syāt, tataḥ prayāsyateḥ dhātvartha eva sādhyāśe nipatet iti niṣphalatvaṃ syāt |
( svamatena vyākhyātumupakramate -- ) tasmāt sūtrā- vināśena vidhinā ekavākyatvam |
tathā ca bhāṣya- kāraḥ savidhikmeva 'bhūtikāmaḥ ityevamantaḥ : viśuddhadeśaḥ' ityāha |
na cātra kriyāmātratvaṃ viśuddhadeśatvaṃ śakyate vaktum |
'bhūtikāma ityevamantaḥ' iti ca phalādisaṃgatyuttara- kāle stutyavasarapradarśanārtham |
nanu sati vartamānā- padeśeṣu anākāṅkṣatvāt arthavādā na saṃvadhyante |

tathāpi tu pramāṇāntaraprāpyābhāvāt ka cit prayogavacanena ('āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo bhavati' ityādi), ka cit pañcamalakāre (upāṃśuyājamanyatrā yajati ityādau), athavā śrutatarmānanyathā'nupapattyā kalpite vidhividhe arthavādasaṃgatiḥ |
yatrāpi kevalārthadarśanadeva vidhivayaṃ, tatrāpi anyathā'nupapattimātraṃ śaraṇam |
yastu asmin pakṣe vākyabhedaḥ saṃbandhadvayāśravaṇāt iti, sa ālabheta praśastatvāt iti ekaprasaropapatteḥ paricchataḥ |
vicīyamānasyaiva hi stutyākāṅkṣā iti ace- rūpyāt upapannaṃ tantratvam |
yadi ca evaṃvidhaiḥ saṃbandhabhedeḥ vākyaṃ midyeta, tataḥ sādhyāsādhanetikartavyatāsaṃbandhairapi bhidyeta |
tasmāt 'nāyamabhisaṃbandho vivakṣitaḥ' ityādi- bhāṣyaṃ evaṃ netavyaṃ, na pūrvatraiva sāṅgavidhiparyavasānaṃ vica- kṣitaṃ, vidhitvāddāraprarocanākalpanāyāṃ atigaurava- nimittāt vākyabhedāt |
'kimarthā stutiḥ' iti pūrvai- ṇaiva prarocanā'pi siddhā ityabhimānāt |
'nahi' iti, stutyābhāve tasya śakti- dvayaṃ agatyā ādhīyate, na saṃvandhyantyāpi ityetat, tadā bhūtikā masya vidhiḥ samāpyate ityāha |
'vidhiśabdena tadā prarocanā' iti vivṛtaṃ kāryanānātvaṃ vidhisutyoḥ |
'nanu evaṃ' iti asti cet prarocayitumapi śaktiḥ, kasmādanyat apekṣyate iti |
'satyaṃ' iti, tasmāt vidyamāne tasmin, na avi- dyamāne yo'rthaḥ sa gamyate |
kaścāsau ? 'stutiḥ prayojanaṃ tayoḥ' na tasyaiva pūrvasyāpi ityarthaḥ |
'ataḥ assāt' vidheḥ iti idānīṃ ṣaṣṭhī, vākyaśeṣa- saṃbandhāditi eva asya stutimavagacchāmaḥ, na khata ityarthaḥ |
'nanu nirapekṣatvādi' iti, yadi ka cit ani- tikartavyatākasya vidheḥ pravartanaśaktiḥ, kasmādanyadapekṣate tena satsvapi anādaraḥ syāt |
ācāryastu sopahāsa- māha, yatrāsau kevalaḥ prayujyamāno nirapekṣaḥ, tatra bhavatu, na kaścidvirodhaḥ |
iha tu na tatsaṃbhavaḥ sākāṅkṣaḥ padāntaraiḥ : āśritatvāt |
vākyaṃ hi ekasyaiva saṃba- ndhasya vidhāyakam |
viśuddhadeśo'thāpitānāmeva eṣa hi guṇo bhavati iti prarocanāṃ darśayati |
tasmāt vidhinā ekavākyatvāt tadanugraheṇa arthavādāḥ iti |
bhāṣyaṃ-- athocyeta, prāk stutipadebhyo nirā- kāṅkṣāṇi vidhāyakāni, vidhirūpatvāt |
saṃpradāyaḥ prayojanaṃ yeṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ sarve te vidhipadānāṃ arthapadanāṃ ca tulyāḥ |
adhyāyānadhyāye, gurumukhāt pratipattiḥ, śiṣyopādhyā- yatā ca sarvasminnevajātīyeke avidyanārthe tulyamādi- yante |
vā -- caśabdavyākhyānārthe paricodanā upanyastā ānarthakyamevāstu iti, tannaiva |
athavā tatra ityava- sthicya evamarthavagamāt ityuktaprakāraparamārthaḥ |
na cāsya prayo- janavat saṃnihitādhyayanaparityāgena anyārthatve pramāṇa- masti |
yadi tāvat svargaḥ kalpyeta, tataḥ puruṣārthameva āpadyate |
atha punaḥ kratuphalasiddhiraiva paṭhite vede bhavatīti, eva- mapi duḥkhopakāritaiva ! tasmāt saṃpradāyasya akṣaragrahaṇaṃ sādhyataḥ niyamajātaṃ anugrāhakam |
na ca niṣprayo- janasya avidyane kāryaṃ, varaṃ tādṛśasya vidhameva uttapyaṃ, yena kleśo'pi tāvanna syāt |
yataste saṃprajonervaidhi- vākyaiḥ tulyamevādriyante, tena avaśyaṃ tadeva prayojana- manyapīti |
sa ca prayojanavattvātte nopapadyate, iti prayo- janavattvamapi sāmānye anumāya 'arthādvā kalpanekada- tvāt' ( 1|4|14|15 ) iti sāmarthyataḥ arthavādānāṃ stutināma prayojanaviśeṣo labhyate |
saṃbhāvyate ca kutaścit vākyāt iyaṃ pratipattiḥ iti nāmaprāmāṇyam |
anyathā hi niṣprayo- janānyetāni iti kecit parityajyārthavādān vidhi- mātraṃ pratipadyeran |

tulyaṃ ca sāṃpradāyikaṃ ityasya aparā vyākhyā-- saṃpradāyaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya vākyasya yena pravartitaḥ saṃpradāyaḥ : 'tasmāt svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' ityetat svādhyāyāviśeṣāt vidhyarthavādayoḥ tulyaṃ, ataḥ prāguktena nyāyena prāk puruṣārthasiddheḥ avasthātuṃ na labhyate iti śakyanusāreṇa sthitaṃ arthavādānāṃ stutyarthatvaṃ iti |
bhāṣyaṃ-- api ca yā eṣā anupapattiruktā śāstravirodhatvāt ityevamādyā, sā 'so'rodīt' ityemādiṣu na prāpnoti |
kutaḥ ? prayoge hi steyādi- nāmyacyamāne virodhaḥ syāt |
tasmāt upapadyate 'stena manaḥ, anṛtavādino vāk' iti |
śāstravirodha- dhikā yā anyānupapattiḥ vidhikalpanāyāmuktā, tāṃ asma- tpakṣaṃ aprāptāṃ manyāmahai |
athavā idaṃ stutivyākhyānaṃ tāṃ anupapattiṃ aprāptaṃ iti vyākhyeyaṃ yeṣāṃ hasvaḥ pāṭhaḥ |
prayoge hi anuṣṭhāne rodanavapolavananadismohesteyā- nutavādādīnāṃ kalpyamāne virodhaḥ syāt |
asmākaṃ tu punaḥ ya eṣāṃ śabdānāṃ śrauto'rthaḥ sa naiva vivakṣitaḥ, na ca adhyāhārādibhiḥ vidhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi stutimātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ, na ca tadvirudhyate |
athavā 'śabdā- thestu' iti, vidhāyakaśabdānugrahāthaiḥ sanu ayamarthavādaḥ, na svārthānuṣṭhāne saṃbhavyate |
trayo'tra pāṭhāḥ amāptāṃ cānupapatti iti, atra manyā- mahe iti vākyaśeṣaḥ |
aprāptā cānupapattiḥ itya- paraḥ, tatra asatpakṣe vijñā iti |
bhāṣyaṃ - yaduktaṃ vidheyasya prarocanārthā stutiḥ iti, tadiha kathamavakalpyeta, yatra anyat vidheyaṃ anyacca stūyate |
yathā 'vetasaśalyā avakābhiśrmāṃ vika- paiti' iti vetasāvake vidhīyate, āpaśca stūyante 'āpo vai śāntāḥ' iti |
gauṇa eṣa vādo bhavati, yatsannidhiṃ stotavye saṃbadhyante stūyate |
yathā asmakābhijano devadattaḥ asmakeṣu stūyamāneṣu stutamātmānaṃ manye |
) atha 'so'rodīt' iti kasya vidheḥ śeṣaḥ ? 'tasmād barhiṣi rajataṃ na deyaṃ' ityasya |
'so'ro- dīt' yad yadarodīt tadrudrasya ' ityatra sa iti prakṛtā- pekṣaḥ, tatasyāt |
tasya yat aśru aśīryata iti, tasyeti pūrvaprakṛtāpekṣa eva |
upapattiśca uparitanasya 'yo barhiṣi rajataṃ dadyāt purā'sya saṃvatsarād gṛhe rodanaṃ bhavati ' ityasya hetutvena arthapratinidhiryate 'tasmād barhiṣi rajataṃ na deyaṃ' iti |
rodanaprabhavaṃ rajataṃ barhiṣi dadato rodana- māpadyate |
kathaṃ punaḥ arudati arodīt iti bhavati, kathaṃ vā anaśrubhave rajataṃ aśruprabhavamiti vacanaṃ, purā'sya saṃvatsarāt asati rodane kathaṃ rodanaṃ bhavati ? taducyate ? guṇavādastu |
rudra iti rodananimittasya śabdasya darśa- nāt ' yadarodīt ' ityucyate |
nindaiva ca dhana- tyāge duḥkhadarśanāt 'purā'sya saṃvatsarād gṛhe rodanaṃ bhavati' ityāha |
tathā 'yaḥ prajākāmaḥ paśukāmo vā syāt sa etaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tūparamālabheta ' iti ākāṅkṣita- tvāt asya vidheḥ śeṣo'yaṃ 'sa ātmano vapāmudak- khidat ' iti |
