kathaṃ guṇavādaḥ ? iyaṃ nāma, nāsan, paśavaḥ, yat ātmano vapāmudakkhidat iti |
etacca karmaṇaḥ sāmarthyaṃ, yat agro prakṛtamātrāyāṃ vapāyāṃ aja- stūpara udgat, ityarthaṃ bahuḥ : paśavo bhavanti |
kathaṃ punaḥ anuṣṭhiānyāṃ vapāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ ātmano vapāṃ udakkhidat ityāha ? ucyate |
iha anvākhyāne vartamānaṃ dravyaṃ niṣpadyate yacca vṛttāntākhyānaṃ, yacca kasma- ścit prarocanā dveṣo vā |
tatra vṛttāntākhyānaṃ na pravartakaṃ, na nivartakaṃ ceti prayojanābhāvāt anarthakaṃ ityavasthitam |
prarocanayā tu pravartate, dveṣārthirvatate iti tayorvibhakṣā |
vṛttāntākhyāne'pi vidhīyamāne ādimattā doṣo vedasya paṭhyate |
kathaṃ punaḥ idaṃ nirā- lambanaṃ anvākhyāyate iti, ucyate |
nityaḥ kaścidarthaḥ : prajāpatiḥ syāt vāyuḥ ākāśaḥ ādityo vā |
sa ātmano vapāṃ udakkhidat iti vṛṣṭiṃ vāyuṃ raśmiṃ vā |
tāmagro prāgutthāt vaiyate āgnīse (jāṭhare) laukike vā |
tataḥ ajaḥ iti atra bījaṃ vīhad vā |
tamālabhya tamupayujya prajāḥ prayujya prāpnoti iti gauṇāḥ śabdāḥ |

'ādityaḥ prāṇīyaśruḥ, āditya udayanīyaśruḥ' ityasya vidheḥ śeṣaḥ 'devā vai devayajanamavyavasāya diśo na prājānan ' iti, ākāṅkṣitatvāt, sarvayamohānāṃ ādityaśvaraḥ nāśayitā, api diṅmohaḥ, iti stutiḥ |
kathaṃ asati diṅmohe diṅmohaśabda iti ? ucyate |
aprākṛtasya vahoḥ kāryasamūhasya upasthitatvāt gauṇe mohaśabdaḥ |
vā - yatra tāvat vidhisutyoḥ ekaviṣayatā tatra upapadyatāṃ nāma, saṃbandhe viṣayanātve tu kathamiti |

yat kriyāyāḥ saṃbandhi stotavye tatsaṃbandhāntaraṃ stūyeta, athavā yadikāre prakṛti- saṃbandhiṃ vidhānāthaṃ stūyate, tatsaṃbandhāntaraṃ prakṛtiḥ stūyate, tatra taddvāreṇāpi loke vede ca stutisiddheḥ prakārāntarā, tasmādadoṣaḥ |
śāntābhiradbhiḥ saṃbaddho vikāraḥ śānti- heturbhavan yajamānasya kathaṃ śamyati iti |
tatra udāhṛtānāṃ gauṇanimittaṃ kiṃcit ihaiva vakṣyate, paraṃ tu tatsiddhasūtre (1|4|12|22) so'rodīt iti sākāṅkṣatvena ekavākyatā vidhitulyoḥ pratyayavayaṃ kathyate |
evaṃ tasya yadaśru, tat rajataṃ iti saṃbhavaḥ |
sarvā ceyaṃ upari- tanasya nindāgranthasya upapattiḥ iti tadanantaraṃ tadabhidhāna- mupapadyate |
ko'sau granthaḥ ? taṃ darśayati, yo barhiṣi rajataṃ dadyāt purā'sya saṃvatsarāt gṛhe rodanaṃ bhavediti |
kena hetunā tadevaṃ bhavati, iti, tadupapadyate |
kāraṇānāṃrūpatvāt kāryasya rodanaprabhavajaratadānāt rodanopaniḥ, tasmānna deyaṃ iti sakalaṃ adānasya upapattiriti |
guṇavādastu śabdalambanaṃ rudradattotthāpitavijñāna- vaśena rodanasāmānyataḥ adṛṣṭakalpanā |
aśruṇaśca śauklyāt yadi nāma etat kaṭhinaṃ bhavet tato rajatasadṛśaṃ bhavet ityugredha tadabhavanindā |
dhanatyāgena atyantodārasyāpi gṛhajanaḥ pīḍyate iti tassāmānyādvā rodanopanyāsaḥ |
evaṃ yena kena cidālabhyanena nindāvijñānotpattiḥ prati- ṣedhopakāriṇī iti mukhyārthābhāve'doṣaḥ |
svāmyaporuktanenāpi hi viśiṣṭaprayojanārthaṃ karmāṇi kriyante, kimuta brāhmaṇa- tyāgena iti stutiḥ |
yathā 'nemamapi udadhuya artha dadāti' iti loke'pi tyāginaṃ stuvanti iti |
vṛttāntaparyavasāyī ca vedaḥ tatra prāmāṇyamapratipadyamānaḥ stutau satyatvāt nānyatrānyeṇaparṇamiti iti niṣprayojano- pākhyānasalyatayā nārthaḥ |
sā ca pravṛttiḥ vijñānamaivaiva upayujyate nārthena |
arthā- mikāyāṃ tu sarvatrāvivādaḥ siddha eva |
athocyeta, asadanyākhyānena stutinindātvamiti sutarāṃ tat pratīyate |
kāmaṃ paramārthe vakkāro bhavanti, kā''tra stutinindā vā,
asatye tu yasmādanyatra dṛṣṭamapi ava- dhṛtaṃ iha guṇavantamiti bravīti ato nūnaṃ me prarocayati, tathā guṇavantaṃ santaṃ nindati nivartayituṃ iti |
tataśca evaṃ viditvā yo yasya anatikramaṇīyaḥ, tadanurodhena sa tathā pravartate |
tena pravṛtti- nivṛttyanugrahaṇīye svasaṃvaidhe arthe puṃsaḥ praśastāpraśastajñāne bhavataḥ |
loke'pi yā kriyāṃ phalāntarayuktāṃ medhā- dihetutvena ātāṃ manyante, tasyāṃ kaṃ cit pravartayantaḥ tadabhipretaṃ saubhāgyādi phalaṃ asatyamapi upanyasya niyu- ñjate |

yadyapi ca pratipattā jānāti, naitadatra pāramārthikaṃ phalaṃ, madabhiprāyyānusāreṇa etairupamyastaṃ, sarvathā tu apuruṣārthe māṃ na pravartayanti tadasatyaṃ nāma etat, kimapi anya- davāpsyāmi iti jñātvā anutiṣṭhati |
evaṃ vede'pi vidhinā tāvat phalamavagamyata arthavādāt asatyena nāma prarocayantu, na tadte satyāsatyatve kiṃcit dūṣayataḥ, pravartamānamāropakāritvāt |
yatu parasattā bhaviṣyati tat vidheruparigata iti niśrcitya naiva vidvāṃso na prava- rtante |
nahi śuktikāgrahaṇasatyatvaṃ yadi rajatatantraṃ taddeśe labhate tato- 'misaṃdhīyate śuktikāvattu kiṃcit ālambanaṃ (iti) |
yatheha mahā- bhūtāni prajāḥ pānti iti prajāpatitvena ucyante |
vāvyādīnāṃ yathāsakhyena madhyavartitaḥ sārā vṛṣṭyādayaḥ vapāḥ, tāmagro iti tenaiva krameṇa vaiyate vṛṣṭiṃ āgnīse śarīrāntarvartini vāyuṃ antaścaratvātmānayā, raśmiṃ laukike tadāpyāyanācca |
tataḥ ajaḥ iti vījādīnāṃ sāmānyena anāditvāt ajalpaprasiddheḥ |
sudhā - vṛṣṭyādīnāṃ vapātvaṃ madhyavartitsāralakṣaṇa- guṇayogena upapādyati |
vṛṣṭyutpatyavasānayoḥ vāvyāyat- tvāt tanmadhyavartitaṃ ' saṃnemyamatra masto junanti ' ityādī ca vṛṣṭihetutvena vāyustutau tassāratvaṃ dṛṣṭeḥ |
bhāve vāyorvṛtteḥ tanmadhyavartinaṃ, vāyurahitasya ca apa- rakāśākāśasya ūṣmaduḥlotpādakatvāt tatsāratvam |
raśmeḥ ādityāvayavatvāt tanmadhyavṛttitvaṃ raśmyāyatta- tvācca prakāśakatvasya tatsāratvam |
tasmin vāyoḥ nikṣepa- kalpanāyāṃ ālambanaṃ antaśśaratsāmānyām |
'ādityo vā astaṃ yan agnimanupraviśati' ityādidarśanāt svarūpeṇa svargasthasya ādityasya bhūmiṣṭhāgnipraveśayogāt raśmipraveśakalpanā |
brīyāderasya ūṣmaṇā vinā prarohā- darśanāt tasya ca tejoguṇatvāt 'āgneyo dhyopa- dhyaḥ' iti ca liṅgāt anyadakasya tejastvāgateḥ tatsāmānyāt vṛṣṭivaidhusaṃyogasya kāraṇatvābhidhānam |
‘ākā- likaḥ āśuvināśī, pūrvadine madhyāhādau utpanna dinā- ntare tatraiva naśvara iti vā |
tatra bhavaṃ, ‘kālāt ṭhañ’ ( pā0 4|3|11 kāla- vācibhyaḥ ṭhañ syāt |
bhāṣyaṃ— ‘tathā phalabhāvāt’ ityanena udāhṛtaṃ ‘śobhate'sya mukhaṃ’ iti gargatrirātravidheḥ ākāṅkṣita- tvāt śeṣaḥ |
vedānumantraṇasya ca ‘āḍasya prajāyāṃ vājī jāyate’ iti śeṣaḥ |
mukhaśobhā vājimattvaṃ ca guṇavacanatvāt gauṇaḥ śabdaḥ |
kule saṃtatādhyayanaśravaṇāt medhāvī jāyate iti sa pratigrahāt annaṃ prāpnoti iti |
na ca eka eva prakāro mukhaśobhāyāḥ saṃsthānaṃ, ramaṇīyatā lāvaṇyaṃ ceti |
bhāṭṭa— 'vāyavyaṃ... gamayati' ityādyarthavādānāṃ vidhipratiṣedhadeva kartṛsaraṇābhāvāt apauruṣeyeve pūrvā- dhikaraṇe siddhe saṃprati tadeva dharmadharmayoḥ prāmāṇyamasti na veti vicāryate |

tatra vidhipratiṣedhavākyābhyāṃ svaśaktyā sādhyasādhanetikartavyatāviśiṣṭabhāvanāviṣayaka- vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ pratipādanāt arthāta vidhipratiṣedhaviṣaya- yāgādeḥ iṣṭāniṣṭasādhanatvakṣepāt yuktaṃ tayoḥ iṣṭāniṣṭa- sādhanarūpadharmadharmaprāmāṇyakatvam |
arthavādānāṃ tu śakyā sadasadrūpasiddhārthabodhakatvāt na dharmadharmayoḥ prāmāṇya- saṃbhavaḥ |
na ca śakyā tatsaṃbadhabhe'pi lakṣaṇā''dhyāhārā- dinā tatpratipādanaṃ, yathāśrutāthapratipādanenaiva upapattau anyāyā''nupapattyabhāvena tadasaṃbhavāt |
na ca tātparyaṃtupa- pattyā tatkalpanā, tātparyagrāhakābhāvena tasyā apyasaṃbhavāt |
nahi śabdaḥ pramāṇamātraṃ vā prayojanadvayameva ityevaṃ- niyame pramāṇamasti, yena sa eva tātparyagrāhakaḥ śakyeta |
na ca 'svādhyāyoḍadhyetavyaḥ' iti svādhyāyavidhivadeva artha- jñānoddeśena adhyayanaṃ vidadhat niṣprayojanasya arthajñānasya bhādhyānupapatteḥ arthasya prayojanavattvamākṣipatīti vācyam |
tannigamasya arthajñāne anupayogāt avyabhi- caritakṛtasaṃbandhābhāvena kratuṃ yāvat upayogakalpanā'- nupapatteśca na vidheyatvam |

ataḥ svādhyāyavidhinā svargā- rthameva adhyayanaṃ vidhīyate, lokataḥ pūrve pravṛttyaṅgīkāreṇa yathāśrutāthajñānārthaṃ vā adhyayanenaiva bhāvanāyāṃ bhāvyamastu, na caivaṃ iṣṭabhāvyatvābhāvāt pravṛttyanupapattiḥ 'anadhī- yānā bhavānti' iti vacanena akaraṇe pratyayāya- bodhanenāpi pravṛttisiddheḥ |
atastasya vedatvācchedena prayojanadvayasyakathanākṣepakatvāt nārthavādeṣu tadalena lakṣaṇāsiddhiḥ iti apramāṇaṃ arthavādā dharmadharmaṇoḥ |
iti prāpte, na svādhyāyavidhiḥ svargādhyayanaṃ vidhatte dṛṣṭe saṃbhavati adṛṣṭakalpanā anyāyāt |
nāpi yathāśrutāthajñānārthaṃ, tathātve śrāvyatvabodhakatvena adhya- yanasya āvaśyakatvāt gṛhītapadapadārthasaṃgatikasya 'sthāṇuryaṃ bhārahāraḥ kilābhūdadhītya vedaṃ na vijānāti yo'rtham |

yo'rthajña it sakalaṃ bhadramaśnute sa nākameti jñānavidhitpāmnā' ityādi vacanāt (nirukta 1|18) jñānasya āvaśyakatvena yathāśrutāthajñānasya ānuṣaṅgika- tayā''pi siddheḥ svādhyāyavidhividhayarthaprasaṅgāt |

ato vaiyarthyaparihārāya prayojanavadarthajñānānuṣṭheyatvena svādhyāyādhyayanaṃ vidhīyate prayo- janavadarthajñānādisādhanībhūtasvādhyāyādeśena vā adhyayana- mātraṃ, tathyaprayayena svādhyāyasya dharmatvābhimānāt |
ataśca jijñāsā''dhikaraṇottarītyā svādhyāyārthasya prayojanavattva- siddhau tātparyagrāhakatvena lakṣaṇāsiddhiḥ arthavādeṣu |
liṅgādyarthaḥ loke puruṣārthaḥ, vede ca tadabhāvāt liṅgādiniṣṭha eva kaściddharmaḥ |
vācyatā- ''vacchedakaṃ ca ubhayasādhāraṇaṃ vyāpāravat, na tu pravṛtti- nivṛttiprayojakatvamapi, tasya anyalabhyatvāt |
tatra nañaḥ abhāve ākhyātāthapravṛttiprayojakatvaṃ, tatsattve tu tadartha- pravṛttyabhāvaprayojakatvaṃ saṃsargaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ |
prayojakatvaṃ ca pravṛttiprayojakatvaṃ pravṛttiprayojakatvaṃ iṣṭasādhanatā- jñānajanakatvaviṣayatvam |
tattvaṃ ca pravṛttisāmagrīvighaṭakatvaṃ iti anyatra vistaraḥ |
tasyāśca bhāvaye yathāyogaṃ pravṛttinivṛttī, śabda- bhāvanājñānaṃ karaṇam |
te ca yathāyogaṃ vidhiniṣedhā- pekṣitatvāt tattatsamabhihyāhārārthavādeḥ lakṣaṇayā prati- pādyete |
tatra 'vāyavyaṃ kṣepiṣṭhā' ityādī svaśakyakṣepiṣṭha- tvādiguṇaireva lakṣaṇā |
siddhānte tu mantravat artha- vādānāmapi parocakatvaniyamāt tadupasthitaprāśastyajñānā- deva pravṛttau sā iti draṣṭavyam |
vākyaśeṣāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ ānarthakyanirākaraṇena artha- vādaṃ arthavādādhikaraṇenaiva siddham |
su. pṛ. 397. arthavādādhikaraṇe kalpanā pauruṣeye'pi pravāha- nityatayā nityatvasyavidhiviṣayatvopapattiḥ prapañcitā |

(1) pūrvaṃ tāvat eṣāṃ akriyārthatvena anupayogādaśakya adhyayanavidhividhatvāt 'vidhinā tvekavākyatvāt' (1|2| 7) iti sūtrāvayena, tulyaṃ ca sāṃpradāyikaṃ (1|2|8) ityanena ca sūtreṇa nirākṛtaṃ (2) drāsaṃbhavatvāt punaḥ ujjīvya arthavādānāṃ tāvat dvāraviśeṣaḥ asminnadhikaraṇe cintyate |

tasmādanena sūtreṇa sāmānyaviśeṣarūpeṇa pūrva- pakṣadvayaṃ tantreṇocyate, ābhyāsya 'tadbhūtatā kriyārthena samānāyaḥ' (1|2|9) ityanena nyāyena kriyārtha- tvāvadhāraṇāt arthavādānāṃ tadasaṃbhavādanarthakyam |
athāpi adhyayanavidhividhatvāt eṣāṃ kathaṃ cit kriyā''rthatvaṃ kalpayitumārabhyate, tathāpi arthavādānāṃ tāvat dvārāsaṃbhavāt duṣpratiharamānarthakyaṃ iti |
ke. arthavādādhikaraṇe nāmadheyānāṃ sāmānyapayogobha- dhāne'pi arthavādadeva adhyayanavidhividhadeva guṇavidhi- tvena nāmadheyatvena ca ubhayathā''pi upayogasiddhiḥ |
kau. 1|4|11 pṛ. 153. arthavādādhikaraṇe vyavasthāpitamidaṃ yat rudaḥ aroditī iti itihāsalakṣaṇena nāsadā- dibhirapi roditavyaṃ iti vidhikalpanā saṃbhavati iti |
sanātanadharmadīpe pramāṇaprakāśe pṛ. 94. arthavādādhikaraṇe samāmnāyedamadhye vyavasthāpitam |
ku. 1|4|12. arthavādākhyānāṃ anyaparāṇāmapi mānāntaraprativirodhadhorastataḥ svārthe prāmāṇyaṃ artha- vādādhikaraṇe vakṣyate |

su. pṛ. 712. saṃcagranthye 'karmapravṛttihetutvaṃ ātmajñānasya lakṣyate' ityana, arthavādādhikaraṇe ca 'etena kravarthakartṛpratipādanadvāreṇa upanipadāṃ nairā- kāṅkṣyaṃ vyākhyātaṃ' ityatra (vā. pṛ. 114) ātma- jñānasya kratvarthatvābhidhānam |
su. pṛ. 326. artha- vādādhikaraṇaguṇasūtre 'stenaṃ manaḥ' ityādiṣu avayavārthaparatvasyāpi pradarśanāt |
arthavādādhikaraṇaprayojanaṃ-- rātrisatre artha- vādasthaṃ phalaṃ arthavādāprāmāṇyādhīnam |

evaṃ aktāḥ śarkarāḥ ityatra saṃdigdhāryanirṇayaḥ ; aśrapratigraheṣyāṃ vyava- dhāraṇakalpanāṃ, vamaneṣṭyāṃ vaidikasomavamananimittakaṃ, 'adhāvupabhṛti gṛhṇāti' ityatra catuṣpadvyakalpan, jyoti- ṣṭomasya somayāgaparatvaṃ, dhyādhyānāṃ samidhamānavatī- samiddhavattvantarālaniṣedhāḥ, somavicāprajānāṃ āvaśya- katvaṃ, 'drayoḥ praṇayanti' ityasya madhyamaparvadvayaviṣayatvaṃ ca prayojanaṃ, teṣāṃ arthavādaprāmāṇyādhīnatvāt |
su. pṛ. 66. arthavādāḥ stutiparāḥ, na svārthaparāḥ iti artha- vādādhikaraṇasiddhāntaḥ |

sanā. pradīpe pramāṇaprakāśe pṛ. 263. arthavādādhikaraṇasthena 'guṇavādastu' iti guṇavādasūtreṇa 'āpo vai śāntāḥ' iti abhijan- stutidvāreṇa avakanāmeva stutiḥ iti vidhisutyoḥ vaiyadhi- karaṇyaparihāraḥ |

parākramaḥ 44|2. arthavādādhikaraṇa- stheṣu 'guṇavādastu', 'rūpāt prāyāt' ityādiguṇa- sūtreṇa tassidvayadhikaraṇasiddhameva gauṇīṃ vṛttimāśritya 'āpo vai śāntāḥ' 'stenaṃ manaḥ' ityādīnāṃ svāya- katvaṃ pratipāditaṃ iti paunarukyam |
su. pṛ. 7. arthavadārthasya niścayoyojanatvāt na arthavādānāṃ svārthe paryavasānam |
su. pṛ. 525. (' arthavādabhedāḥ ' iti laghusiddhāntottaraṃ 'artha- vādādhikaraṇaṃ' ityasāt prāk uttare laghusiddhāntāḥ paṭhanīyāḥ |
tatra puruṣārthapa- ryavasitavidhpekṣitaṃ prāśastyaṃ lakṣaṇāvṛtyā samarpayadaryavāda- vākyaṃ vidhivākyena saha ekavākyatāmāpadyate |
'yataḥ kṣipragāmisrbhāvatayā śīghraphalaprado vāyuḥ asya paśordevatā, tataḥ praśastamimaṃ vāyavyaṃ paśumālabhete' iti vākyayora- nvayaḥ |
7|1|3|17-21. arthavādasya nāmadheyaṃ na dharmātideśakaṃ iti aṣṭame vakṣyāmaḥ |
arthaviprakarṣaḥ tatra āśrīyate, yama tena vinā ekavākyatvaṃ nāvakalpate |
vā. 3|1|2|13 pṛ 877. arthaviprakarṣaḥ śrutyādeḥ sakāśāt liṅgādeḥ śruti- liṅgādhikaraṇādau eva draṣṭavyaḥ |
su. pṛ. 867, arthaśabdasya vyutpattiḥ kva gatau ityasya dhātoḥ auṇādikaḥ than pratyayaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'bhinne juhoti' iti kapālasugā- dimede prāyaścittamuktaṃ, ājyādihaviṣi 'sne iti ca |
idaṃ prāyaścittaṃ ekadeśe'pi, kṛtsne ekadeśe'pi vā bhinne skanne vā syāt |
arthasamavāyāt arthasya kṛtsnasya ekadeśasyāpi bhinnatve 'bhinne juhoti' itividhitaḥ bhinnapadārthe samavāyāt saṃtratvāt anta- bhūtatvāt |
tasmāt ekadeśasyāpi bhedanādau prāyaścittaṃ kartavyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ekadeśabhedanādau eva prāyaścittaṃ na aśepe kṛtsne bhinne prāyaścittaṃ saṃbhavati, vaiguṇyāt tadarthasya kāryākṣama- tvāt |
hi yasmāt homakṣaṇamidaṃ prāyaścittaṃ tadarthe bhinna kapālasya saṃskārārtham |
kṛtsnabhede tu kasya saṃskāraḥ ? tasmāt ekadeśabhede eva prāyaścittaṃ, na kṛtsnabhede |
athavā, aśepe sarvasmin kapāla bhinne tu na tat prāyaścittam |
na ca sarvabhedaḥ prāyaścittena parihartuṃ śakyate |
hi yasmāt prāya- ścittaṃ tadarthaṃ bhedanadoṣanirāsārtha vihitam |
aśepasya kṛtsnasya bhedanādau vaiguṇyāt ityādirarthasya pūrvavat |
svāddhā prāpnimittatvāt tadarthe nityasaṃyogāt hi tasya guṇārthenānityatvāt |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prātaṃ vāśabdena vyāvartya pūrvoktameva siddhāntaṃ sopapattikamāha |
prātanimittatvāt prātaṃ bhedanarūpaṃ nimittaṃ yasya prāyaścittasya tādṛśatvāt |
kṛtsnabhede'pi prāyaścittasya bhedanarūpaṃ nimittaṃ prāptameva bhavati |
yat aṃśataḥ bhinnasya saṃskārārthe prāyaścittamiti, tanna |
tasya bhinnasya kapāladerdharmaḥ taddharmaḥ, na taddharmaḥ ataddharmaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsāgneya hi ayaṃ homaḥ, na bhinnakapā- lādyaṅgam |
hi yasmāt tasya darśapūrṇamāsakarmaṇaḥ nityasya yo guṇaḥ kapālaṃ, tasya arthena homasya saṃyogo'sti |
athavā tasya homasya kapālarūpaguṇārthena kapālabhedena na saṃyogaḥ, anityatvāt bhedanasya |
guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt vacanāt vyapāśrayaḥ syāt |
guṇānāṃ parārthatvāt homo na kapā- lāṅgam |
na ca vinā vaca- nāt guṇo guṇārthaḥ syāt |
vidyamānāt vacanāt guṇo- 'pi kadā cit guṇasya vyapāśrayaḥ āśrayaḥ syāt |
tasmāt bhedanādihomaḥ na bhinna- kapālārthaḥ, kintu darśapūrṇamāsārtha eva |
vyapāśrayaśabdasya ' māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ' (bhagī. 9|32 ) ityādī āśrayaḥ ityarthaḥ |
kutūhale tu 'bhinne juhoti' iti vacanāt bhinnasya saṃskāratvena vyapāśrayaṇaṃ anāśrayaṇaṃ syāt ' ityuktam |
subodhinyāṃ ca 'vacanāt vyapāśrayaḥ anyatra viniyogaḥ ' ityuktam |
bhinnakapālasaṃskārārtha eva homaḥ iti pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate |
'gāyatryā tvā śatākṣarā saṃdadhāmi iti bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ saṃdadhyāt ' iti dvitīyāśrutyā saṃdhānasya bhinnakapālatvāt homakaraṇamapi bhedanārthe bhinna- kapālasaṃskārārtha syāt |
nanu arthameva adhyāhṛtya vākyaṃ pūrvatāṃ, kiṃ śabdakalpanā |
ekavākyabhūtapadadvayapratipāditā hi padārthāḥ vākyārthe pratipādayanti nānyathā |
nahi ānaya ityetāvati ukte, gāṃ ityukte, pratyakṣapratibhe- 'pi gavi gavā saha ānayanaṃ anvīyate |
evaṃ ca vikṛtiṣu sauryādiṣu asatrametārthāṇyadipadanivṛtteḥ nyūna- sākāṅkṣa mantravākyapūraṇāya sūryādipadakṣepatāt ūha- siddhiḥ |
arthādhyāhāravādināṃ tu sūryeṇa adhyāhṛtena viśiṣṭaṃ nirvāpāmidameva prakāśayati iti nohaḥ sidhyet |
tathā yatra adhikāravākye arthavādamātra śrutaṃ 'prati- tiṣṭhanti ha vā etā rātrīrupayanti' iti, tatrāpi bhavanmate vidhyartha eva adhyāhāryaḥ; na vidhidhvadaḥ |
tataśca prākṛtasyopakārasya padārthānāṃ ca nāpūrvedamarthya sidhyet |
sasyapi hi arthānāṃ ākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogya- teṣu nāmidhānamantareṇa anyasiddhiḥ |
na ceha apūrvā- bhidhāyī śabdo'sti, yo'pūrve prākṛtairanvitaṃ abhi- dadhyāt |
nāpi prākṛtāḥ śabdāḥ vikṛtau santi, ye svārthān apūrvānvitānabhidadhyuḥ |
na ca arthavāda- padārthaiḥ teṣāmanvayaḥ, nāpi upatyapūrvayeṇa iti ananvaya eva syāt |

evaṃ prakṛtāvapi 'sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo darśa- pūrṇamāsau' ityatra vidhiśabdasya anāmnānāt anadhyā- hārācca vidhyarthasya svargakāmādhikārāpūrvāt āgneyāyu- tparyavyebhyaśca pṛthagbhūtasyādhyāhārāt na samidādīnāṃ aida- madhyaṃ sidhyet |
nahi samidādiyataḥ avaghātādivat, adhikārāpūrvānvitaṃ svargabhābhidhātumalaṃ, syātpūrvaviṣaya- vyākhyātāt |
tasmāt īdṛśeṣu adhikāravidhiṣu vidhiśabda eva adhyāhāryo nāthīḥ |

na ca vidhyarthasya atyantā- laukikatayā pramāṇena tadābhāsena vā buddhau āropayitu- maśakyatvena abhimatāsya buddhisaṃnidhānātkaḥ adhyāhāraḥ aśrutavidhiśabdakeṣu adhikāravākyeṣu vā, utpatti- vākyeṣu 'yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ' ityādiṣu vā śakyate, ityakāmenāpi śabdādhyāhāraḥ aṅgīkartavyaḥ |
atra ke cit, 'pīno devadattaḥ, divā na bhuṅkte' iti śrutādhārthācca rātrau bhuṅkte iti śabda eva kalpyate iti vadanti |
tathāhi pīnatvā- numitaṃ bhojanaṃ divā niṣiddhaṃ rātrimojanakalpanāyā śabda- saṃjalpitayā savikalpikayā śāmyatīti śabdaḥ |
evam prāthamyalāghavābhyāṃ kalpyate, kalpitena tenopasthā- pitādarthādanupapattiśānteḥ |
nanvevamaindriyakasavikalpaka- jñāne'pi prāthamyalāghavābhyāṃ śabdasyaiva kalpanayā anaindri- yakatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
naivaṃ, tiryagādiṣu śabdasyetyevamindriyasyārthe eva śakyatvadhāraṇācca śabde'pi sāmarthyakalpanaṃ yuktam |
atha dṛṣṭārthācca artha eva śaktiḥ kalpyate |
nātrāpi śabdaḥ kalpanīyaḥ; naivaṃ, tatrāpyupapādake'rthe śaktiḥkalpanā nārthamātre |
atra śabda evopapādaka iti śabda eva śrutā- yāpattī kalpyaḥ |
ata eva viśvajidādau svargakāmapadā- dhyāhāraḥ, dvāraṃ ityādau saṃtriyatāṃ iti padādhyāhāraḥ; ūhe- 'pi 'sūryāya juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' iti śabda eva kalpyate, tathā anuṣaṅge'pi |
api ca pacati iti prayukte oda- nādipurakadāśravaṇe pratyakṣaudane anupapattiśśāntiḥ syāt, na ca tathā dṛśyate, tasmādvākyatayānanupapattesta- tpūrakaḥ śabdaḥ eva kalpanīya iti |
etadevābhipretya bhāṣyakāreṇa 'dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā' iti śrutapadaṃ prayuktamiti |
tadidamanupapannaṃ, śrutādhārthāttāvapi artha eva kalpanīyaḥ, na śabdaḥ |
śabdaviśiṣṭa- savikalpake tadviśiṣṭo'rtha eva vedyaḥ, na śabdasyāpi vedyatvaṃ, tasya smṛtisamārūḍhatvāt, ato'tra śabdaviśiṣṭa- kalpanābhiniveśo'rthasyaiva kalpyatvaṃ, na śabdasyāpi |
atha bodhakāvasthaśabdasya kalpyatvādupapattiḥ śāmyatīti cet, naivaṃ, tatrāpi prāptāprāptavivekanārthasyaivyānupapattiśāmakatvaṃ, na śabdasya |
kiṃca arthāpattāvasya kalpyatve arthe śabde ca śaktikalpanimiti gauravātprasaṅgāt paramarthamātrameva kalpya- nam |
api ca dṛṣṭārthāpatteḥ upapādakamātre śakti- rdiṣṭā, śrutādhārthāttūpapādakabodhakatvānna dṛṣṭādhikalpana- miti vairūpyamasyāptam |
kiṃca anyatra savikalpakaye smṛtyārūḍhaśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ iti atrāpi tathāvidhasyaiva
kalpanāprasaṅgaḥ, na mitisyasya, evaṃ ca vidhivijādāvapi arthāsadvādādvākyārthāparipūrrtiriti artha eva tatrāpi kalpyaḥ |
yattuktaṃ udāhau śabdakalpanā dṛṣṭeti, satyaṃ dṛṣṭā, tatra sākṣācchabda evopapādakaḥ, na tu śabdasyopapādakabodhaka- tvam |
tathāhi, ābhidhānikaṃ prakāśakaṃ prakṛtau mantrāṇāṃ kāryatayā kalpyaṃ, ato vikṛtāvāpi tarkātparopapatte sūryāṃ- yeti śabdakṣepo yuktaḥ |
yatpunareta- dabhihitaṃ pacatītyukte pratyakṣaudane'tasyānyenyānupa- pattiśāntiprasaṅga iti, tacca naivaṃ, tatra vivakṣāvadhāraṇā- bhāvādananvayaḥ, na śabdābhāvāt |
amīpomīyādarthāntare aikādaśineṣu paśuṣu ekābhi- samavāyāt ekasyāmekasyāṃ devatātvasya adhyāsakasya samavāyāt vidyamānatvāt devatāpṛthaktvaṃ syāt |
bhinnā etā devatāḥ, nātra kaścit gaṇaḥ |
ekābhi- samavāyena devatātāṃ pṛthaktvāt agniguṇepagatamedhapati- ścāndrasya ekavacanāntasya dvivacanāntasyāpi ca vikāraḥ bahutvavacanāntatvena ūhaḥ syāt |
tasmāt vikalpena ūhena dvayorāpi pravṛttiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 19. arthāpattiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā arthaḥ anyathā nopapadyate ityarthakalpanā |
yathā jīvato devadattasya gṛhābhāvadarśanena bahirbhāvasya adṛṣṭasya parikalpanā |
pramitasyārthasya arthā- ntareṇa vinā anupapattimālocya tadupapattaye yā arthāntara- kalpanā sā arthāpattiḥ |
yasya hi jīvanaṃ gṛhasattvena pratyakṣato'vagataṃ, tasya gṛhābhāve dṛṣṭe jīvanaṃ sāṃdāyikaṃ bhavat bahirbhāvakalpanā samādhīyate |
tataśca prāgavirbhāvakalpanāyāḥ jīvanasya saṃdigdhātvāt na liṅga- svam |
jīvanarahitaṃ ca gṛhābhāvamātraṃ mute'pi satvāt anaikāntikaṃ na vahirbhavamanumāpayitumalama |
yathā ca anumāne niścitaṃ gamakaṃ evamarthāpattau saṃdigdhaṃ gamakaṃ iti dṛṣṭenalabdhambu- pagamyate |
pramāṇa- siddhorarthayoḥ parasparaṃ pratighātaḥ arthāntarakalpanāyā samādheyatvena ālocyamānaḥ arthāpatteḥ kāraṇam |
( 'dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā'rthaḥ' iti ādivākye - ) dṛṣṭagrahaṇenaiva pratītimātramāt śrutasyāpi grahaṇe siddhe śrutādhārthaḥ : pramāṇagrāhiṇītvena dṛṣṭārthāpattito vailakṣaṇya- mupapādayituṃ śrutagrahaṇam |
(śrutādhārthāpattiḥ) loke tāvat 'dvāraṃ dvāraṃ' ityādiṣu saṃpūrṇādhārthapratipādanāya 'saṃtriyatāṃ' ityādi śabdāt śrutaśabdaikavākyatvena kalpyate |

tathā vede'pi 'viśvajitā yajeta' ityatra svargakāmaḥ iti vā, svargārthe iti vā, yenaiva śabdena śrutaśabdaikavākyabhūtena paripūrṇādhārthabhidhānaṃ saṃpadyate vākyaṃ, tadeva hṛdayamānīya śrutena saha melayitvā paripūrṇāt vākyāt vākyārthaḥ pratīyate |

tathā 'sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvaped brahmavarcasakāmaḥ' ityādiṣu vidhiṣu itikartavyatāpratipādakaśabdaadhyāhraṇāt apūrṇaṣu tadarthāpādakaśabdāpekṣā codanāliṅgapekṣāpitasya āgneya- vidheḥ aṃśasya sādhyasādhanāṃśapratipādakabhāgau anapekṣita- tvāt anāhalaya yastutīyo'rthabhāvaḥ : agnyanvā- dhānādiḥ vidhyantatvena parikalpitaḥ; tasya vācakaṃ yaḥ śabdaḥ : 'āgneyavat' iti, sa vākyaśeṣatvena kalpyate |
athavā ya evāyaṃ āgneyavidhivantaḥ; tathaiva vyavahitasyāpi codanāliṅgabalopasthāpitasya vikṛtividhinā saha eka- vākyatamātraṃ arthāpattayā kalpyate |
śā.-saṃkṣepaḥ 1116 pṛ. 76-82. arthāpattiḥ (pramāṇaṃ) dvividhā dṛṣṭārthāpattiḥ śrutārthāpattiśca |
bāla. pṛ. 8. arthāpattiḥ : pratyakṣa śabdena vā pramitasyā- thesya upapādakārthāntarakalpanam |
yathā devadattagṛhe dine bhojanābhāvaḥ : pīnatvaṃ ca pratyakṣadṛṣṭaṃ svopapādakaṃ rātrimojanaṃ
tathā viśvajidyāgakaraṇakabhāvanāviṣayakaprava- rtanā vidhipramitehoddeśyakatvaṃ vinā anupapadyamānā svargā- yuddeśyakatvaṃ kalpayati |
atra dinabhojanābhāvaviśiṣṭa- pīnatvajñānaṃ na karaṇaṃ, yena anumānāntarbhāvaḥ śaṅkyeta |
evaṃ jīvato devadattasya gṛhe adarśanena adṛṣṭabahirbhāvakalpanā |
vastutastu nānuminomi, nopaminomi, na śabdayāmi, kiṃtu arthapayāmi ityanubhavādeva mānāntaratvaṃ yuktam |
tathāhi, bījatvāvacchedena aṅkurajanakatve gṛhīte mūṣikā- ''ghāteṣu tadadarśanaṃ kāraṇatvasaṃdehe mūṣikā''ghātādyā vrīhiniṣṭhā kāraṇaśaktiḥ kalpyate |
evaṃ yāgajanya svarga- janakatvaṃ kalpyate iti jīrṇāḥ |
arthāpattirapi dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā arthaḥ anyathā nopapadyate ityarthakalpanā |
yathā jīvati devadatte gṛhā- bhāvadarśanena bahirbhāvasya adṛṣṭasya kalpanā |
vaidyanāthaḥ— pramāṇaṣaṭkena pramitasyārthasya arthā- ntareṇa vinā anupapattimālocya yathārthā- ntarakalpanā sā arthāpattiḥ |
tatra pratyakṣapramitāyā'nupa- patyā arthakalpanā yathā- pratyakṣata avagatādāt vahneḥ dāhaśaktikalpanā |
anumānapūrvikā arthāpattiryathā- deśāntaraprāptiliṅgenānumānena āditye gatimanumāya tadanyā'nupapatyā āditye gamanaśaktikalpanā |
upa- mānapūrvikā arthāpattiryathā- gavayadarśanāt etatsadṛśo gauḥ iti yad gavi gavayasādṛśyaṃ upamitaṃ, tadanyā'nupa- patyā tādṛśasādṛśyaviśiṣṭagavi tādṛśagrāmaviṣayatvaśakti- rasti iti kalpanā |

śabdapūrvikā pramāṇagrāhiṇī arthā- pattiryathā- 'pīno devadatto divā na bhuṅkte' iti śrutena vākyena divā abhuñjāne devadatte pīnatvasya yo'rthaḥ pramitaḥ, tadanyā'nupapattimālocya tadupapattaye 'rātrau bhuṅkte' iti rātrimojanarūpamātrakalpanā yuktā samā- śrayitum |
śrutāvākyapratīmānārthānyā'nupapattiprati- saṃdhānena tadupapattaye ākāṅkṣitasya arthāntarasya tadbho- dhakena vākyenaiva samarpaṇasya yuktatvāt, śābdaḥ śabdenānyeti iti nyāyāt |
tasyārthasya savikalpaka- jñānagrāhyatvāt śabdapuraḥsaratayā pratīteḥ śabda eva tvava- gataḥ arthamutthāpayati |
nanu evaṃ pratyakṣadiṣvapi savi- kalpakajñānāni arthaṃ na gṛhṇīyaḥ, kiṃtu śabde eva paryava- syeyuḥ |
(na) tiryagādipratītiṣu śabdajanyasya indriyasya arthe eva sāmarthyamavadhṛtam |
tena savikalpakatvajñā- mapi tatraiva bhavitumarhati nānyatra, śaktikalpanāpariśa- yāt |
śrutāthapattistu kadā cidapi tiraścā nāsti, śabdadyutpattinibandhantvāt tasyāḥ |
nanu dṛṣṭārthāpattau tāvat arthāpatteḥ arthe eva sāmarthyamavadhṛtaṃ, atapi tatraiva bhavitumarhati |
satyaṃ, arthe eva sāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, kiṃtu upādākatvena |
nahi artho'pi svarūpataḥ pratīyate, kiṃtu upādakatvā |
śabde'pi sākṣāduccārite anupapattiśāntirbhavati iti prathamonapipātini śabde eva śratārthāpatteyāpāraḥ |
tadāha bhagavān vārttikakāraḥ -- (ete ślokāḥ ślokavārttike vā tantravārttike vā nopalabhyante |
ke.) 'na cārthenārtha evāyaṃ dvitīyo gamyate tu naḥ |
iti tadetat ṭīkākāro bhagavān na mṛṣyati |
savikalpakavijñāneṣu śabdaḥ arthāva- cchedakarūpaḥ pratīyate, vācakatayā ca śabdaḥ arthamava- cchinatti |
tena goriti jñāne gośabdavācyo'yaṃ ityeva- marthaḥ parigṛhyate |
kiṃtu dṛddhavyavahārāvagatayā vācakatayā vācyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ na bhavati |
nānapapattiṃ śamayitumalaṃ iti nārthāpattiprameyatāmanubhavitu- marhati iti |
tena arthaviṣayaiveyamapi iti viśeṣapradarśana- nārthamapi śrutagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati |

ye tu śabda eva viśva- jidādiṣu aparapūrṇatvādanupapanna iti manyante tena tadupa- pādakaḥ paripūrakaḥ śabda eva kalpyate iti vadanti, te svamanīṣikākalpatayā vikalpaṃ bhāṣamāṇā upekṣā- mahaṃto'pi grālhatā iti bālajanaparivodhanāya kiṃciducyate |
kā tāvadiha śabdasya anupa- pattiḥ ? arthāpatyatirekiṇī ? aparipūrṇatā cet, kā punaḥ śabdasya aparipūrṇatā ? artha eva hi kena cit arthabhāgena vinā aparipūrṇo bhavati |
arthāpatteḥ śabdo'pi aparipūrṇa iti cet, bhavatvevam |
yanniva- ndhanā hi tasya anupapattiḥ, tasyaiva tarhi upapattirdī- karaṇīyā |
tasmāt aparipūrṇatve'pi śabdasya arthaḥ eva kalpanīyaḥ |
na ca arthānupapattau śabdasyānupapattiḥ, bhikṣātvāt śabdārthayoḥ |
athocyate, arthānupapattī prameyābhāve śabdasya pramāṇatā'pi anupapanneti |
eva- mapi pramāṇatā anupapannā syāt, na śabdaḥ |
na ca pramāṇatā pṛthagnupapannā, kiṃtu arthānupapattaiva |
api ca pramāṇatā'pi kena cidarthena vinā prameyābhāva- śaṅkayā anupapannā, na śabdābhāvena, yena śabdaṃ kalpayet |
arthāpattiri niyogataḥ tatraiva bhavet, yatraiva śabdena codanā bhavati, nānyā |
bhā. 3|1|4|10. nanu arthāpattistat, yat padārthavyatirekameva- gacchāmaḥ |
bhavedarthāpattiḥ yadi asatyā- mapi śaktī nānyat nimittamavakalpyeta |
rdravyaguṇayoḥ : ekahāyanī-āruṇyayoḥ paścāt arthāpatyā parasparāvacchedakatvena anvayaḥ |
yanmā- yena vinā coditadravyadevatāsaṃbandhānupapattiḥ, tanmātrameva adṛṣṭaśrutaṃ arthāpatyā kalpayituṃ śakyate nānyat |
vā. 2|1|21 pṛ. 523. brīhīṇāṃ vihitāḥ dharmāḥ : nīvārāṇāṃ arthāpatyā bhavanti |
eṣā cārthāpattiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā'rtho'nyā nopapadyate ityetha- kalpanā |
yathā jīvato devadattasya gṛhābhāvadarśanena bahirbhāvasyādṛṣṭasya kalpanā iti |
tathāhi, prameyādhikāt sāmagrī- bhedādvā pramāṇāntaratvamupapadyate pratyakṣadīnāmanvayaṃ, iha tu ubhayamapi na dṛśyate |
tathāhi, devadatto bahi- rdeśasaṃyogī, gṛhābhāve sati vidyamānatvāt, yoyo gṛhābhāve sati vidyamānaḥ sasa bahirdeśasaṃyogī, yathā aham |
tathā jīvato gṛhābhāvavān kālaḥ ka cit bhāva- vān, jīvadgṛhābhāvavattvāt, yoyaḥ kālo jīvadgṛhā- bhāvavān sasa ka cidbhāvavān yathā mamaiva kālaḥ |
kiṃ arthāpatteranumānatvamanumānena sādhyate, vivādādhyāsitā'rthāpattiranumānaṃ avinābhāvabalenonapāya- mānatvāt dhūmādijñānavat iti |
nanu anyathā nopapadyate iti kalpanā arthāpattiḥ |

nainaṃ, bahirbhāvaṃ vinā gṛhā- bhāvo'nyā nopapadyate iti kathamavagamyate ? jīvato gṛhābhāvasya bahirbhāvena niyamadarśanāditi cet, tarhi- vinābhāvaḥ eva anyathā'nupapattivadanāpadyate iti nāsaddhatvam |
anvayagrahaṇaṃ tatrānumānaṃ, yatra tu tadubhayaṃ nāsti śaktyādau, tatrārthāpattiriti |
anyābhāvena tajnumānamiti cet, tarhi kevalānvayino vyatirekā- bhāvena pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt |
bhavaditi cet, spārśana- pratyakṣasya rūpavatvābhāvāt pratyakṣat prāmāṇāntara- prasaṅgaḥ iti |
anumāne tu na saṃdigdhaṃ saṃdehāpādakaṃ vā gamakaṃ, ataḥ sāmagrīmedādeva bhedaḥ |

atra kaḥ saṃdehahetuḥ ? 1 jīvanaṃ ca gaṇitāgādisiddhamapi prāyaśo gṛhādhikaraṇatayā dṛṣṭamiti gṛhe eva niyamiti bhramo jāto yasya, tasya gṛhābhāvadarśane pūrvanirūpitadharmavirahāt saṃdigdhaṃ jīvanam |
kiṃca āgamasiddhasya jīvanasya gṛhābhāvānvaye gṛhatvaṃ bahirdeśo'pi deśāvacchettā- bhāvānvite vyāptibhramāt bahirdeśābhāvatvāvagataḥ |
evaṃ saṃśaya rūpānupapattisandehāt jīvanameva bahirdeśasaṃbandhatayā kalpyate |
yaccoktaṃ, na saṃdigdhaṃ kalpakaṃ dṛṣṭamiti, vyāsaṃva vā gamakaṃ kutra dṛṣṭam ? dhūmādau dṛṣṭamiti cet, tarhi arthāpatti jīvanādau dṛṣṭameva |
anupapadyamānādanyatra na sarvatra dṛṣṭamiti cet, tarhi tatrāpi liṅgādanyatra na dṛṣṭameva |
athā- nyatrādṛṣṭamapi vyāpyāt vyāpake pratītadarśanabalena vyāptaṃ gamakamiṣyate iti cet, tarhi atrānupapadya- mānādupapādake pratītadarśanabalena vyāptamiṣyate iti samāna- carcam |
yatpunaretadabhihitaṃ, saṃdehasya kāraṇanirāsādvā, anyatarapakṣasāvadhāraṇādvā nirāsa iti, tadatrāpyastyeva |
tathāhi, nātra jīvanasya bhāvābhāvau saṃdihyete, jīvanameva bahiḥsthitatayā niścitya ityanyatarapakṣasāvadhāraṇamastyeva |
yattu saṃśayahetureva niścayaheturnopapadyate iti, tadapya- nāsti, mitrahetukatvādbhūmeḥ |
yatpu- naretaduktaṃ, anumāne'pi saṃdigdhameva gamakaṃ, dhūmasyāpa-
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvino- rbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāmagne juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' iti nirvapāmantraḥ |

atra savitṛ-aśvi-pūṣa-śabdāḥ karma- samavetārthamabhidadhati tena teṣāṃ vikṛtau yathāyathaṃ ūhaḥ, kiṃvā ete śabdāḥ karmasamavetamarthaṃ nāmiddhati iti vikṛtau teṣāṃ na ūhaḥ iti vicāre 'arthābhidhānasaṃyogā- ntreṣu śeṣabhāvaḥ syāt' iti sūtraṃśena pūrvapakṣamāha |
mantreṣu 'savituḥ prasave, aśvinorbāhubhyāṃ, pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ' iti triṣu mantreṣu vidyamānānāṃ devatā- vācakanāṃ śeṣabhāvaḥ śeṣatvaṃ karmāṅgatvaṃ syāt |
arthābhi- dhānasaṃyogāt karmāṅgabhūtasya devatārūpasya arthasya yada- bhidhānaṃ prakāśanaṃ, tena saṃyogatvāt vācakatā saṃbhavāt |
tathā ca karmāṅgavācakatvena karmaśeṣatvāt 'saviturjaṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi, aśvinorjuṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi, pūṣṇo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' -iti prakṛtau teṣāmapi devatānāṃ havirdātṛtvam |
coditābhidhānāt coditaḥ vidhivihitaḥ yo'rthaḥ agniḥ agnīṣomau upāṃśuyājadevatā ca prajāpatyādiḥ, tasyaiva coditasya mantreṇa abhidhānāt |
tatra pūrṇamāsakarmaṇi evaṃ darśakarmaṇi acoditaṃ savitṛ-aśvi- pūṣadevatārūpaṃ, ataḥ aprāntaṃ syāt |
darśapūrṇamāsakarmaṇi agnyādaya eva devatā vihitāḥ na savitrādayaḥ |
tasmāt savitrādiśabdāḥ na karmasamavetārthāmidhāyinaḥ, iti na savitrādiśabdānā- mūhaḥ prakṛtau vikṛtau veti siddhāntaḥ |
ekasminneva sūtre tuśabdadvayārthādapāṭhāt vinaiva pūrvottarapakṣayoḥ pratipādanaṃ 'vicitrā sūtrāṇāṃ gatiḥ' iti nyāyena |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'- ścinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāmagne juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi'
iti savitrādiśabdaiḥ pratyāyyaireva savitrādayaḥ prakāśyante, iti kathaṃ teṣāṃ karmaṇi avivakṣitatvaṃ ucyate, iti śaṅkāyāmāha siddhāntī |
tataśca taiḥ savitrādiśabdaiḥ teṣāṃ karmasamavetānāṃ avacanaṃ, na vacanaṃ bhavati |
agnyādiṣu vidhivihitāsu satīṣu kevalaṃ mantra- liṅgāt savitrādīnāṃ karmasamavāyitvaṃ svīkartuṃ na śakyate |
nanu tarhi kimarthaṃ nirvāpamantre savitrādīnāṃ pāṭhaḥ ? ucyate |
itarāthai nirvāpapraśaṃsāthai utsāhajana- nārthe nirvāpamantre savitrādiśabdāḥ prayujyante |

(Symbol) arthābhidhānasaṃyogāt ityadhikaraṇe devasya tvetyādipadānameva uccāraṇamātrārthatve bhinnaprayojanakatvena nirvāpāmipadaikavākyatayābhyāpatteḥ tadśāt devasya tvetyādi- padārthaviśiṣṭanirvāpaprakāśanasyaiva abhyudayakārikalpatayā teṣāmapi svārthābhidhāyakatvaṃ vakṣyate |
(Symbol) arthāvagatau na śrutatvameva kāraṇaṃ, kiṃ tarhi ? prakaraṇādikamapi |
(Symbol) arthāvabodhaḥ adhyayanottarakālabhāvī iti na tanmukhena karmavidhīnāṃ prayojakatvam |
ata eva dravya- rjananiyamavat dṛṣṭo'pi arthāvabodhaḥ adhikāraviśeṣaṇa- tayā na parigṛhyate |
uttarakālabhāvitayaiva ca arthāvabodho'pi prayojanāntaraṃ na svīkriyate |
tathāhi - 'tassātsāmarthyaprāpto'- babodho bhāvyatvenāvatiṣṭhate - 'arthā samartho vidvāna- dhikriyate' iti nyāyena darśapūrṇamāsādiṣvapyavodha- mavekṣamāṇāstvavabodhe svādhyāyaṃ viniyuñjate |
atha prakṣiptapaṭhiteṣu yajuḥṣu kathamavagamyate iyadekaṃ yajuriti |
mantratraividhye nirūpite kiyāneko mantra ityā- kāṅkṣāyāṃ ṛksāmayoḥ parimāṇasyādyetuparaṃparāsiddhatvāt prakṣiptapaṭhiteṣu yajuḥṣu kiyadekaṃ yajurityākāṅkṣāyāṃ tatpari- māṇalakṣaṇaṃ kriyate |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo'bhisaṃdhiḥ-- na tāvadarthaikatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ, tathā sati pratipadamarthabhedena vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
nāpi vibhajyamānasākāṅkṣatvaṃ, evaṃ ca sati 'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ karomi ghṛtasya dhārayā suśevaṃ kalpayāmi' ityasya 'tasminsīda' ityanena sahaikavākya- svaprasaṅgāt |
nāpi militamekavākyatvalakṣaṇaṃ, ekaṃ hi pada- mekārthaṃ, na tadvibhajyamānasākāṅkṣam |
taduktaṃ 'ekārthatvaṃ padasya syāt sākāṅkṣatvavat na tat |
(Symbol) arthaikatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ sākāṅkṣaṃ ced vibhāge syāt |
prakṣiptapaṭhiteṣu yajuḥṣu idamaikaṃ yajaḥ iti kathamava- gamyate, ataḥ ekavākyatvalakṣaṇamāha |
arthaikatvāt arthasya pratipādyasya ekatvāt, ekārthapratipādakaṃ ekaṃ vākyam |
yāvatā padasamūhena eko'rtho viśiṣṭaḥ pratipādayituṃ śakyate tāvān padasamūhaḥ ekaṃ vākyam |
yadi ca vibhāge kriyamāṇe sākāṅkṣaṃ padaṃ syāt |
bhavati kiṃ cidekārthaṃ, na tu vibhāge sākāṅkṣaṃ yathā 'bhago vā vibhajatu, arthamā vā vibhajatu' iti |

atha vibhāge sākāṅkṣaṃ ekaṃ yajuḥ ityukte 'ṛtāṣāḍṛtādhāmā'gnirgandharvastasyauṣadhayo'psarasa ūrjoṃ nāma sa idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tān idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pāntu tasmai svāhā tābhyaḥ svāhā' ityādirāprabhṛṭomeṣu dviḥsvāhākāra- mekaikaṃ yajuḥ syāt |
tatra vibhāge sākāṅkṣatāyāmapi ekayajuṣṭvaṃ mā bhūt iti arthaikatvāt ityuktam |
' nanu artha- katvāt ityatra nyāyo'sti, yena ekavākyatā syāt |
satyaṃ ayaṃ nyāyo nāsti, kiṃtu yeyajāmahaṃ viparivartamānamantraṃ paryudāsāthau vidhīyate |
(Symbol) arthaikatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ (2|1|14) 46) ityanena nyāyena prakṣiptapaṭhitānāṃ yajuṣāṃ parimāṇaṃ jñeyam |
tatrāyaṃ 'arthaikatvāddhikalpaḥ syāt' ityavayaṃḥ pṛthakkula adhikaraṇāntaratvena bhāṣyakārai- rvyākhyāta: |
tatsaṃpādanārthāḥ ṛgakṣaravikāraḥ, vikṣepaḥ, vikarṣaṇaṃ, abhyāsaḥ, virāmaḥ, stobhaḥ ityevamādayaḥ upāyāḥ |
teṣāṃ kiṃ samuccayo vikalpo veti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
teṣā- mupāyānāṃ arthaikatvāt gītinirvartanarūpatvādvikalpaḥ syāt, na samuccayaḥ iti |
tatra prathamaṃ 'ṛcā stuvate' 'sāmnā stuvate' iti śrūyate |
tatra ṛcā sāmnā vā stotramiti vikalpaḥ |
uta sāmnaiveti niyamaḥ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
arthaikatvāt stutirūpārtha- sādhakatvāt, ṛksāmayoḥ tadarthatvāt stutirūpa- tvāt : prayojanaṃ yayoḥ te tadarthe, tadarthatvāt stutiphalaka- tvāt ṛk
yathā hi alābvādyaṃśabhakṣaṇe'pi tallakṣaṇaniṣedhaśāstrāllohacchurna siddhaṃ, naivaṃ vaconirṇayārthāśraye akṣatvāṃśabādhādikaṃ iti vaiṣamyāt |
bhā. 3|7|6|12. 'ardhamantarvedi' itivat lakṣaṇyā puṃsavadepi uddeśyatvānnāvādyīkāreṇa satyapi ubhayorekāpūrvasādhanatve vyavasthaiva 'yoktreṇa patnīṃ saṃnahyati, mekhalayā yajamānaṃ' ityana |
alpatvaṃ ca kasya cit bahumamepya bhavati |

vā. 3|1|14 pṛ. 860. yathā apratigraheṣṭeḥ pratigrahītṛviṣayatve varuṇādyeti caturthyāḥ pañcamyarthaṃ, anyat ityasya ca pratigrahītṛtvaṃ, 'sa svāṃ devatāṃ' iti ca tacchabdasya prādhānyanirdiṣṭavaruṇaparāmarśitaṃ, dātṛtve ca varuṇasya adevatātvāt devatāśabdādyogaḥ iti bahubādhaḥ |
alpānāṃ bhūmivi- dhirodhe bādho bhavati iti sā rītiḥ |
'na cātra alpa- bhūmivirodhanyāyo'sti pratyatyāge bhūyasāṃ tadarthānāṃ bādhāpatteḥ |
yathā 'dadhnā juhoti' ityādī viśeṣavidhiḥ guṇa- vidhinā |
bāla. pṛ. 140. alpārthavidhisaṃbhavaścana viśiṣṭavidhānena parihāro ghaṭate |
vā. 3|1|10|21. avakābhirbhavataśākhayā ca vedivikarṣaṇaṃ sakṛdeva, na pratīkṣakaṃ agnicayane |

vi. 9|1|7| 26-28. avakāśasya 'āpo vai śāntāḥ' iti vākyaśeṣānusāraṇa apsu lakṣaṇa nopeyate, arthavādādhi- karaṇe guṇavādasūtreṇa abhijanastutidvāreṇa avakānāmeva stutiḥ iti vivakṣitavaiyadhikaraṇyaparihārāt |
avakāśaiḥ (grahavākyaiḥ) : nāma 'dvau samudrau' ityādibhiḥ 'ko'si ko nāma' ityetairmantraiḥ grahyāyu- pasthānaṃ prātaḥsavane mādhyaṃdine savane ca agniṣṭome |
ke. avakaṇīrpaśuḥ : 'yo brahmacārī avakiret sa gardabhaṃ paśumālameta' |
kiṃtu 'atha paśuklpaḥ' iti āśvalāyanoktāyāḥ smārta- paritikartavyatāyā eva tadaṅgatvaṃ iti ke cit |

' brahmacaryavakaṇīr nainaṃtaṃ gardabhamālameta ' ityuktaḥ avakaṇīrpaśuḥ avakaṇīrṇeḥ striyāṃ kṛteteovisargasya brahma- cāriṇaḥ paśuḥ tadattu pūrvoktādhikārakatvaṃ sthapatīṣṭivat laukike'mau eva syāt, na ādhānasiddhe'mau |
āghā- nasya aprāptakālatvāt brahmacaryakāle ādhānaṃ na prāptam |
na prātaḥ kāle yasya tadādhānaṃ aprāptakālam |
ādhānasya aprāptakālatvāt avakaṇīr- paśurlaukike'mau iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyam— asti avakaṇīrpaśuḥ 'brahmacaryavakaṇīr nainaṃtaṃ gardabhamālameta' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ tadarthe ādhānaṃ kartavyaṃ, uta laukikeṣvāgniṣu tat vartateti |
pūrvasya adhikaraṇasya yaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ so'tra pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ, yaḥ siddhāntaḥ sa siddhāntaḥ |
sarvārthamādhānaṃ tasmādāhitā- miṣu iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

nahi atra avipluttabrahmacarya- padena kṛtabrahmacaryaśrotratvābhayoḥ paurvāparyamātrasya anena vidhānāt avakaṇīrṇe'pi vivāhe bādhakābhāvaḥ; 'snātvā bhāryāmupeyāt' ityanenaiva snānapūrvabhāvinī brahmacaryasya snānonottarabhāvinā vivāhena arthāt paurvāparyasiddheḥ asya vacanasya sāṅgabrahmacaryavata eva vivāhādhikāraḥ ityeva- marthatayā avakaṇīrṇeno vivāhānupapatteḥ |
kiṃtu 'atha paśuklpaḥ' ityāśvalāyanoktāyāḥ ( āśva. gṛ. 1|19|1-15 ) paritikartavyatāyā eva tadaṅgatvaṃ iti ke cit |
5. avakhyeyaṃ 'sucakṣā avakhyeyaṃ' iti soma- bhakṣārthe camasacahaṇamantrāḥ |
cakṣudaḥ khyāyādeśa- smaraṇāt chandasi dṛṣṭānuvidhine iha khyāñ ityupa- saṃkhyānakaraṇāt 'simbyahalaṃ leṭi' ( pā0 3|1|34 ) iti simbvikaraṇaśrayaṇācca rūpasiddhiḥ |
su. pṛ. 1135. avagataprādhānyasya anyāryatā na yuktā |

āgūḥ śabdasyaiva āgūryyasyapi yejāmahavāci- svāt 'avagūrya vaṣaṭ karoti' iti vacanena tadānanta- ryasya vaṣaṭkāre kaṇḍaraveṇa vidhānāt yājyāvaṣaṭkāra- samuccayapakṣasya ca śāpakasiddhatvena nirepakṣapradānārthatva- bodhyavikalpatvāt durbalatayā cāsārvatrikatvāt eva vaktavya- tayā yadā samuccayastadā yājyeva vaṣaṭkāraḥ, yadā kevalo vaṣaṭkārastadā yejāmahavahitottarameva praya- ktavyaḥ |

iti prāpte, kiṃcidvyavadhāne'pi 'bhuktvā gataḥ' ityādau loke 'puro'nuvākyāmanūcya yājyā juhoti' iti vede'pi kvāpratyayaprayogāt samuccaya- vikalpayorvikalpakalpanāsya atyantajaghanyatvāt uttara- kālatāyāmevāvagūryyatve ityupa |

vastutastu ādhānavadhayo- rānayanāvanayanayoḥ āhārāvahārayoropasargabhedamevārtha- bhedasya bahuśo darśanāt avagoraṇasya vadhāyyavasāyapara- tvena anyatra prayogādiha tadasaṃbhave'pi lakṣaṇayoccairuccā- raṇāyyavasānamevārthaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 4|3|4. avagoraṇe brāhmaṇasya, śatasaṃvatsaraṃ yātanāḥ kartu- bhevanti, 'yo brāhmaṇāyavāguṃret, taṃ śatena yātayāt, tasmād brāhmaṇāya nāvagureta' iti vacanāt |
avagoraṇa- niṣedhaḥ : kevalaṃ puruṣārthaḥ, na kṛtyathaḥ; ṛtuyuktapuruṣārtho vā |
bhāṣyam— darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'devā vai śaṃyuṃ bārhaspatyamabruvan hyaṃ hyo naḥ vaha' iti prakṛtya vacanamidaṃ bhavati 'kiṃ me prajāyā iti |
taṃ śatena yātayāt, yo na hinatat taṃ sahasreṇa yātayāt, yo lohitaṃ karavat yāvataḥ prasandhya pāṃsūn saṃgṛhṇāt tāvataḥ saṃvatsarān pitṛlokaṃ na prajānīyāt iti |
tasmān brāhmaṇāyavāvagureta na hanyāt na lohitaṃ kuryāt' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ava- goraṇapratiṣedhaḥ, uta puruṣopayogideya iti |
na darśa- pūrṇamāsayorbrāhmaṇasyāvagoraṇamityaṃ vadho vā kāryo lohitaṃ vā prasandhyamapi |
asti chātra vidhāyaka- vibhaktiḥ 'śatena yātayāt, sahasreṇa yātayāt, svarge loke na prajānīyāt' iti |
teṣāmapi prākarikaṃ saṃbandhadvayamapi aṅgīkṛtya nirdiṣṭaṃ ṛtudharmaḥ śuddhapuruṣadharmaśceti dvāveva pakṣau |
samastena ca anutavadana- pratiṣedhanyāyena (3|4|4) kṛtvarthasyāghoraṇasya prasajya- mānasya pratiṣedhaḥ |
kā ca tatra pravṛttiḥ ? (bārhaspatya- ārcyuhotrarūpa -) caturbrāhmaṇasāhasratvāt darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ tadānantyarthe sāmadānabhedadaṇḍeṣu prasajyamāneṣu anvāhārtha- (caru-) dānena ānamayet iti gamyate |
yadā tanmā- treṇa nānamanti, tadā punaryathā dānāt ānatirbhavati tathā
' ghṛte śrapayati ' ityāhya vidhānāt kriyate iti vaiṣamyam |
soma— śataṃ svarṇāni kṛṣṇalāni kṛṣṇala- ( kṛṣṇa- mukhaguñjā- ) tulitāni yasya tat ityataḥ iti bhaṭṭa- bhāskara: |
na ca avaghātasya haviṣprakṛtitvaṃ saṃskāryaṃ, ityuktaṃ nayame |
kṛṣṇalānāṃ ca haviṣmeva, na prakṛtitvaṃ, ityavaghātaprasaktyaiva abhāvat ayaṃ vicāro'nupapanna iti vācyam |
samprakṛtikkaviṣkyaṃ kṛṣṇalavidhānena haviṣ- statprakṛtitva nivṛttyā kṛṣṇalānāṃ haviḥsthānāpannatvavat haviḥprakṛtisthānāpannatvamapi asti, ityavaghātaprāpya- virodhāt |
vi— avaghātaḥ kṛṣṇalānāmasti no vā, 'sti pākavat |
prayoktavyā caret pākabhavaghāte tu nāsti sā ( pratyakṣetiḥ ) |

bhāṭṭa— yat mūle varṇakāntareṇa 'prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapecchatakṛṣṇalamāyuṣkāmaḥ ' ityāhya kṛṣṇa- leṣu vituṣībhāvaprayojanābhāvāt avaghātasya bādha ityuktaṃ, tat kṛṣṇalānāṃ pradeyatvaprakṛtitvaṃ kṛtvācintā |

vastu- tastu kṛṣṇalānāṃ satyapi ghṛtādhikaraṇavācanikāgnisaṃyoga- mātrarūpe paṇe vaiśyābhāvena kṛṣṇalaprakṛtikkacarupārthā- tarotpattau pramāṇābhāvāt teṣāmeva pradeyatvāttaḥ āgneyaprakṛtitvena pradeyapuroḍāśadharmāṇāṃ paryagnikaraṇādīnāṃ prāptāvapi pradeyaprakṛtitvabhūtahavirmāṇāṃ teṣu pramāṇābhāvāt na vaituṣyābhāvaprayukto bādhaḥ |
na ca havirmābhāve nirvapāsyābhāvāt ' nirvapet ' ityanuvādānupapattiḥ |
na ca codanāliṅgātideśena avaghātaprāpyabhāve'pi caruśabdasya nāmātideśavidhayā carudharmātideśatvamaṅgīkṛtya avaghātaprāptirāśaṅkituṃ śakyā |
caruḥ prakṛtyāvahita- tvena taddharmāṇāmasiddheḥ, sauryādāvatideśaprāptānāṃ dharmāṇām vidhānādadhikāre'pi avaghātasya taddharmatvābhāvāt |
na ca caruśabdo'yaṃ kṛṣṇalānāṃ caruprakṛtitvāvagamārthaḥ ityapi śakyaṃ vaktuṃ, kṛṣṇalajanyadravyānurānupattau teṣu tatprakṛtitvasya bādhita- tvāt |
ataścaruśabdo'yaṃ acarāveva agnisaṃyogarūpaśrapaṇa- vatsavasāhacaryāt gauṇaḥ san āgneyaprakṛtitvasādhakakaṭhina- tvāparpāyaviśadatvasāhacaryātpohalako'nuvāda ityuktam- ghṛme ( 8|18 ) |
' ghṛte śrapayati ' ityanena hi na śrapaṇaṃ vidhīyate, viklṛttyabhāvena śrapaṇāsaṃbhavāt |
tena kṛṣṇalānāṃ pradeyatvāt pradeyadharmāḥ paryagnikaraṇādayaḥ prāpye- ran, na tvavaghātādayaḥ; iti na tatra vaituṣyābhāvaprayukto bādhaḥ ! sa tu paraṃ savanīyahavirantargatalājavyaparivāpe |
tatra hi dhānāprakṛtitvena yavānāmiha lājaprakṛtitvena vrīhiṣu prāptau avaghātasya vaituṣyābhāvadeva prayojanaṃ, na tu svarūpeṇa |
prakṛte ca tasya pradeyapāke virodhivādasaṃbhavaḥ; satuṣadravyasya bharjane lājaniṣṭhatveḥ |
ata eva dhānāvat bharjanottaramapi nāvaghātaḥ; lājavattvadhātāpāteḥ |
ata eva tadā nakhādineva laukikaṃ vituṣīkaraṇam |
ata evārtha- lopasthale nārthasya svarūpeṇaiva upayogi, api tu kathaṃcidapi viśeṣaṇābhāvaprayukto viśeṣābhāvaprayuko'- nyaprayuktaścetyādi draṣṭavyam |
vastutastu tatrāpi na dvāra- lopādvādhaḥ, śrapaṇavihitopādānakattaṇḍulaprahārā- bhāvena vrīhihavirmāṇāpratideśenāpravṛtteḥ |
api tu lājatvā- nyathā'nupapattayaiva tatra vrīhimāgrahaṇamityuktaṃ kaustubhe |
tatra hantiḥ pākārtho bhavi- ṣyati, na dhānātvaṃ vihanyate |
vi. 5|27, avaghāte vrīhīṇāṃ apūrvasādhanatvākāro vivakṣyate, na vrīhisrūpa- pam |
9|11|1 varṇakaṃ 2 avaghātakālīnaḥ tupopavāpaḥ paramyaktakapālopajīvitayā na kapālepādānāsādanayoḥ prayojakaḥ |
bhāvasya anekāni khaniṣpattisamarthāni sādhanāni ālo- cayataḥ yaḥ avaghātavidhinā sādhanaviśeṣasamarpaṇena tanno- pasaṃhāraḥ kriyate, sa eva niyamanibandhādiśabdena ucyate |
arthākṣepeṇa hi prāpyasyāpi avaghātaḥ taṇḍulībhāvajana- katvena niyamyamāno janyajanakaniyamasya adṛṣṭaṃ prayojana- mapekṣate |
tataśca avaghātena taṇḍulībhāve kṛte tajjanya- tvāt taṇḍuleṣu atiśayo niṣpādyamāno nāvaghātakriyā- janyo vaktuṃ śakyate |
taṇḍulotpādananirapekṣatvāvaghāta- svarūpajanyābhyupagame kṛṣṇaleṣvapi atideśaprāpto''vaghāto na nivārayituṃ śakyate |
tasmāt niyamādṛṣṭasya caturthī- dhikaraṇe ( 2|1 ) kriyājanyatvaṃ nābhyupagamyate |

anye tu arthākṣepasya vidhikalpanānirapekṣasya aprāptakatvena manthara- tvāt aprāptāvasthasya kriyārūpasyaiva vidheyatvāt prayo- janakalpanā ucitā, na phalamātratvenāvāstasya niyamasya iti manvānāḥ niyamādṛṣṭasyāpi kriyājanyatvamicchanti |
avaghātaniṣadhaireva taṇḍulaiḥ avāntarā- pūrvadvāreṇa darśapūrṇamāsau paramāpūrva janayato nānyathā |
ekadravye saṃskārāṇāṃ vyākhyātamekakarmatvaṃ, tasmin mantrārthanānātvādāvṛttau mantrasyāsakṛ- prayogaḥ syāt |
tatra mantraḥ, ' atha rakṣo divaḥ sapatnaṃ vadhyāsaṃ ' iti |
tasmin vicāryate kiṃ pratiprahāraṃ mantraḥ, uta sakṛ- deva ādāviti |
kutaḥ ? prahārāt prahāraḥ karmāntaraṃ, yataḥ paryavasānāt |
karmabhede ca sati gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ; yena karmaṇā saṃnipatito mantra- stadartha iti |
ekasmin dravye vrīhādau saṃskārāṇāṃ avahananādīnāṃ vyākhyātameka- karmatvaṃ ā taṇḍulanivṛtteḥ : ekamidaṃ karmeti ( 5|1|2|
' sarveṣāṃ vaikakammādeteṣāṃ ca tadguṇtvāt ' iti ( etādṛśaṃ sūtraṃ nopalabhyate ) |
nanu pratiprahāraṃ karma- bhedaḥ; ityuktaṃ, ucyate |
yatra mantrārthasya nānātvaṃ, tatrābhyāvṛttirbhavati yathā agno lokapūṇāyāḥ |
kathaṃ jñāyate ? karaṇo'yaṃ mantraḥ, karaṇasya kartṛ- vyasya vastuno''bhisaṃdhānārthaḥ samadhigataḥ |
samastā hi kārye sādhayanti, na vyastāḥ |
uktānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ taṇḍulavicchedanaṃ yattaccharki- pitaṃ, tadabhisaṃdhātavyam |
soma— yathā kapālaśabdaśaktiparyalocanayā kapā- lānāṃ na tantratvaṃ, evaṃ avahantiśabdaśaktiparyalocanayā mantrasyāpi na tantratvaṃ ityavatiṣṭhateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
mantravidhiṃ avahantakarmakabhāvanāyāṃ uddeyatvapratītāvāpi ' pradhāna- vidhivākyaṃ khalvaṅgavākyasamanvitam |
( śā. 7|1|1 pṛ. 525 ) iti saptamādhyāyasya paramārthataḥ pradhāna- bhūtāvahananavidhividheyatvāt mantrasyāvaghātakarmabhāvanā- ''nvaya upapadyate |
sūtrātthastu- yatra mantrārthasya nānātvaṃ, tatrāvṛttāvapi iha sakṛdeva prayogaḥ |
' taṇḍula- niṣpattiparyantatvena āśritaprahārābhyāmukttasya avaghātasya ekakarmatvāt tatra viniyuktasya mantrasya avaghātaprakrame sakṛdeva pāṭhaḥ |

bhāṭṭa— darśapūrṇamāsayorāvaghātamantraḥ ' atha rakṣo divaḥ sapatnaṃ vadhyāsam ' ityayaṃ kiṃ pratiprahāramāvartate, na veti cintāṃ somādivat prathamato bhāvanā'''nvitasyāpi mantrasya avaghātādvyavadhānāyāt pratiprahāraṃ guṇāvṛttyāyena
na ca avaghātasvarūpe ānarthakyātpūrva- 11|4|12, avaghātamantraḥ rājasūye nānāvījeṣu sādhanībhūtataṇḍulībhāvakatvopadhāyakatvena tasyoddeśya- prativījaavaghātādau sakṛtsakṛt paṭhanīyaḥ |
avaghātānāṃ tvāt taṇḍulībhāvaṃ prati cāvṛttāvavaghātatvenaiva phalopadhāyaka- tatra bhinnatvāt |

11|4|14 avaghātādayaḥ tade- tvāt tādṛśarūpavicchinnāvṛttāvapyamantrāvṛttiriti vaikamapūrve prāpya arthavanto jātāḥ, na paramāpūrve karmānta- vācyaṃ, taṇḍulībhāvaṃ prati tena rūpeṇa phalopadhāyakatve'pi rāpūrve vā apekṣante |

vā. 3|1|4|10 pṛ. 670, avaghātasyaiva sādhanatā'vacchedakatvena lāghavāt taṇḍulī- avaghātādayaḥ navamādhyāyādhikaraṇanyāyena śrauta trīhihya- bhāvajanakatvenaivāvaghātatvenaiva kāraṇatvāt, mullaṅghya apūrvasādhanatvena saṃbadhyante |
saurye iti kartavyatāyā prāsāyāṃ ki (agre juhva iti mantraḥ) avikṛtaḥ prayoktavyaḥ, uta vikāro'pi (kaścidasti) ityanena prasaṅgena navamo daśamavyāpāra- manumanāya evottiṣṭhati (navamaḥ |
tatsannitte ūhe) 'vidheḥ prakaraṇāntaraṃ' (1011191) iti sūtraṃ nava- mākṣepeṇaivārabhyate |
tasmātprathamataḥ 'apivā'bhi- dhānasaṃskāradvayaṃ' (1011112) ityanena sandrāvaḥ (pratipādyate na kevalasya daśamasya) tenāṣṭamānantaraṃ nayama ārabhyate |
sā caikaspā mantrasāmasaṃskāreṣu kriyamāṇā saiva sā, na tasyāḥ cakri- diśeṣaḥ |
sāmagrahaṇenārthavattvaṃ ca, mantragrahaṇena saṃskāra- grahaṇena copāttatvāt |
atra varṇayanti, naiva vayaṃ ūhemedaṃ (ūharūpasya bhedaṃ) pratijānīmaḥ |
kutaḥ ? yadiṣṭādena itikartavyatāyā abhisaṃbandhāt 'evaṃ yāgaṃ kuryāt' iti, evaṃ yāgena kuryāt iti |
atha yaduktaṃ yajatiśabdenābhisaṃyogo dharmā- ṇāmiti, taducyate, tasya dravyeṣu yajato yaḥ saṃskāraḥ, sa taṃmyuktaḥ apūrvamayuktaḥ tadarthatvāt |
yajaterdravyāṇāṃ ca tadīyatvena dharmairabhisaṃbandho, na svenātmanā |
nahi ghātyarthasya ca dharmāṇāṃ ca parasparaiṇākāṅkṣā vidyate |
pratyayārthena hi itikartavyatā ākāṅkṣyate kartavyaṃ katha- miti, na yajiḥ kīdṛśa iti |
tasmāt yat kartavyaṃ tasyaiva itikartavyatā saṃbandhaḥ, apūrve ca tat |
apū- rvāthī dharmā iti sthite satame, navame nimittaṃ parīkṣyate kimapūrve nimittaṃ, uta yāga iti |
na cānimittā pravṛttiḥ, yena vicāra eva na syāt |
tatra bhāvyamānāt darśa- pūrṇamāsāpūrve nimittaṃ na bhavati |
nanu yāgasya phale upādīyamānatvāt nimittatvenāyāṃ codyamānatvāt vivakṣābhedaḥ syāt |
prakṛtayāgāt darśapūrṇamāsapadāve'pi vidhīyante eva tena ( yajinā ) |
yadi etat nimittānāṃ na pratipadyeta, anarthakameva syāt (darśapūrṇamāsapadam ) |
nanu satabhyantaṃ nimittaṃ bhavati 'bhinne juhoti' iti, tṛtīyāntaṃ cedam |
'nimittaphala- hetuṣu sarvāsāṃ ( vibhaktīnāṃ ) prāyadarśanaṃ' iti draṣṭavyam |
(tasmāt (darśapūrṇamāsayoranimittatvāt ) vikṛtau apūrvamasti, darśapūrṇamāsayogo nāsti, tadabhāve dharmāṇāmapyabhāvaḥ; yathā bhedanābhāve homābhāvaḥ |
saurye ca sākṣātkatvadapūrvasya atideśenānuṣaṅgeṇa vā prākṛtairadvairācchan sauryayāgaḥ sidhyati |
prayojakatvaṃ vāca- nikaṃ, nimittabhāvaśca naiva vacanādvidhīyati |
yadi yena prayujyate, bhavati tattasya nimittam |
yathā ārāma- poṣakasya ārāmo vetanadāne prayojako nimittaṃ ca |
ārāme sati vetanaṃ dīyate, vetanena samartho bhavati ārāmaṃ rakṣitum |
vā—(svayamidānīṃ vārtikakāraḥ padāntaramāha) athavā apūrvāthī dharmā iti sthitaṃ saṃnipayopakārakā ārādupa- kārakāśca prakaraṇe pramāṇena |
tatra prakaraṇe 'agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' iti mantra āgnāyate |
tatra kathaṃ khalu upa- kariṣyatīti viśeṣākāṅkṣā jāyate, kimuccāraṇamātreṇa, uta prakāśanadvāreṇeti |
tasmāt prakāśanadvāreṇopakaroti tenāmi prakāśanam upakaroti iti ( niścīyate ) |
tatra nimittabhāvāt mantrasya nivṛttiḥ yathā medanābhāvāt homasya nivṛttirdapūrṇamāsayoḥ : (iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

devatāprakāśanadvāreṇa mantreṇāpūrve kuryāt ityetāvatā śabdasya paryavasānāt apūrvamasya prayojanaṃ, tadanuṣṭhāne arthājnimittaṃ bhavati, iti apūrvīyadevatāprakā- śanamevāsya nimittaṃ iti apratihatā mantrasya saurye pravṛttiḥ iti ) |

soma--iha yacchabdādyabhāvāt yajeḥ apūrvasya vā nimittatvaṃ na kenāpi śabdenocyate, kiṃtu dharmapravṛtteḥ kādācitkatvā ārthikaṃ nimittatvaṃ, tadapi apūrvasyaiva, tasya sādhyatayā sādhanānuṣṭhāne nimittatvaucityāt |
yajestu siddhatvā'vagamyamānasya tadayogatvāt, apūrvasya cāni- pyanasyāpi buddhau viparīvṛttimātreṇa 'carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti' itivañcanimittaṃ saṃbhavati |
hi yasmāt tadeva codyate, tasyāpūrvasya dravyeṣu saṃskāraḥ avaghātādiḥ tadayuktaḥ apūrvaprayuktaḥ : apūrvārthatvāt |
prathama- vyākhyāne taptayuktaḥ apūrvasādhanatvaprayuktaḥ tadarthatvāt ityarthaḥ |
vi—(tṛtīyaṃ varṇakam-) 'nāpūrvasya nimittavamasti vā, na proktataḥ |
tatra ūho nāma prakṛtau anyādṛṣṭasya vikṛtau anyābhāvaḥ |
tattvaṃ ca saṃbandhena yaddharmā- vacchinnavṛttistvaṃ yasya prakṛtau śrutaṃ, tasya tena saṃbandhena vikṛtau taddharmāvacchinnabhinnatvam |
asti cedaṃ 'devasya tvā' ityādimantreṣu prokṣaṇādisaṃskāreṣu ca |
mantrāṇāṃ hi smārakāsaṃbandhena agnivācya- cchinnatvaṃ śrutaṃ prakṛtau, vikṛtau ca tenaiva saṃbandhena taddharmāvacchinnabhinnasyatvādicchutivāt |
evaṃ prokṣaṇāvaghātā- dīnāmapi saṃskāryātsaṃbandhena brīhityāvacchinnatvaṃ prakṛtau śrutaṃ, vikṛtau ca tenaiva saṃbandhena taddharmāvaccha- innabhinnatvāmākāṅkṣādivicchutivāt |
evaṃ sāmanāmapi āgnyādi- rūpāṇāṃ yena saṃbandhena yasthānagatai (te) kārucchitvaṃ prakṛtau śrutaṃ, vikṛtau teṣāṃ tenaiva saṃbandhena tasthānabhi- sthānagatai (te) kārucchitvāt |
atra śrutatvaṃ tātparyamanapekṣya pratīyamānatvaṃ, tena ukte (kate) kārucchitvasya śabdādapratī- tāvapi na kṣatiḥ |

atra ca saṃbandhetyādinā śrutapaśu- puroḍāśāgodeśādyasya prakṛtau smārakasaṃbandhena abhīṣṭoma- devatādṛṣṭeḥ vikṛtau anupayuktanyadevatāvidhānena ārādupa- kārakasya saṃbandhena ṛtūpakārakatva atiprasaṅga- vāraṇāya saṃbandhetyavivakṣaṇam |
prakṛtāveva śrutabrīhitvā- vacchinnavṛttitvena śrutānāmavaghātādīnāṃ tadvijayavādi- vṛttitvāt tadāraṇāya prakṛtivikṛtipadopādānam |
prakṛtistrīyavikṛtipakṣeyā sauryādiprakṛtivikṛtivyatirekītyā bhedāt ātideśikatrīhimauryādau eva avaghātādīnā-
prakṛtau prokṣaṇādīnāṃ tātparya- gatyā apūrvasādhanatvāvacchinnatvasya vivakṣitatvena vikṛtāvāpi tenaiva rūpeṇa svābhāvikatvasādha- bhavaḥ |
apūrvayoḥ darśapūrṇamāsītyādināṃ medavivakṣāyāṃ tu sauryaśvahīṣu ativyāptimāśāṅkya śatapadaṃ nirukta- pratīyamānatvārthakama |
atra ca abhipadasthāne sūryādipade'pyeṣe'pi avaśiṣṭamantrasya prākṛtatvānnapātā na lakṣaṇe tasyetiśabdānupapattiḥ |
evaṃ ca tatra prākṛtaprakṛ- sthāne kragantarasyohaḥ ; tatrohaśabdo bhākta iti dhyeyam |
athavā astu tadanurodhena tasyeti padaṃ prākṛtatatkāryā- pannāyatparaṃ iti saṃkṣepaḥ |
sa noha: prākṛtapadārthānāṃ prakṛtau yadrūpāvacchinnoddeśya- saṃnnidhitvena vidhānaṃ, tadrūpāvacchinnasaṃnnidhitvenaivātideśe sidhyet, na tu svarūpeṇaivātideśe |
tathātve agnipadasyai- vātideśena sauryaṃ tasyaivātideśaprayojanāntarakalpanāyā prayo- gopapattau ūhānāpatteḥ |
ata eva upakārapṛṣṭhabhāvena padā- rthānāṃ vikṛtāvātideśaḥ; prakṛtau nirūpitarūpāṇāmeva vā vikṛtāvātideśaḥ iti daśame vakṣyate |

tadiha upodghātatayā kiṃ prokṣaṇāvaghātādīnāṃ 'agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi ' ityādivākyanipādānāṃ ca prakṛtau vrīhitvāvacchinnoddeśena vidhānaṃ tataśca vrīhyanyā- dimyuktāste, athavā apūrvasādhanatvāvacchinnoddeśena tata- śāpūrvayuktā iti cintyate |
brīhmādiprayuktatve śyāmāke carau saurye vā vrīhmādīnāmabhāvāt prokṣaṇādīnāṃ lopa eva, na tuhaḥ |
apūrvaprayuktatve tu śyāmākādīnāmapi tadrūpāva- cchinnatvāt siddhayūhaḥ |

tatra yatrāpi ārādupakārakatve na śrutamuddeśyatā''vacchedakaṃ, tatrāpi karaṇāgrāhakākāṅkṣā- rūpetikartavyatā''kāṅkṣākramakaraṇena yāgajñāllaiva prayājādividhānāt yāgatvamevoddeśyatā''vacchedakaṃ, na tu apūrvasādhanatvaṃ samprādhānyāpatteḥ |
na caitāvatā pari- plavatvapattiḥ, anuvādyasya sati saṃbhave saṃnihitagāminvena
na vā'ti- deśo'cchedeḥ, apūrvaviśeṣārthatve iva āgneyādyarthatve'pi 'tadvat kuryāt' ityatideśena āgneyasthānapace saurye dharmātideśopapatteḥ |
ataste yāgaprayuktā eva, tadā kimu vakṣyata yat, brīhmādisaṃyogenaiva prokṣaṇādidhaśravaṇāt vrīhitvādimeva uddeśyatāvacchedakamiti |
na ca vrīhi- yāgādisarūpārthatve dharmāṇāṃmānyatvaṃ, teṣāmapi agnivat phalavattvena tadabhāvāt |
na ca amīnādhānānvayatirekena utpattau pramāṇābhāvena tadabhāve'pi vrīhmādīnāṃ prokṣaṇādi- vyatirekeṇāpi jāyamānatayā ānarthakyapāttastadasyaiveti vācyam |

tādṛśānarthakyaparihārāya prokṣaṇādiviśiṣṭa- vrīhīṇāmeva kalpitavākyāntareṇa yāgārthatvasya apūrvatva- syaiva vā bodhopapattī, niṣādapatyanyāyena (6|1|13|1) vrīhipade yavādisādhāraṇyena apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇā pramā- ṇābhāvāt |
astu vā vrīhipade lakṣaṇā, tathāpi lāghavād- pasthitatvācca vijātīyayāgasādhanavrīhitvādimeva lakṣyate, na tu apūrvasādhanatvam |

na ca yāgasyāpi niśatopā- yatvena prokṣaṇādivyatirekeṇāpi jāyamānatvāt ānartha- kyāpattiḥ, yāgatvāvacchinnasya apūrvatvāvacchinnasya vā jāyamānatve'pi vijātīyayāgatvāvacchinnasya prokṣaṇādi- vyatirekeṇa jāyamānatve pramāṇābhāvāt |
nahi āgneyatvāva- cchinnaṃ prati prokṣaṇāditā cit sāmagrī kalpatā'sti, yena tajjanyavyaktau āgneyatvābhivyaktirbhavet |
prokṣaṇā- daiva tu vidhānabalena tatsāmagrītvāt tadvyatirekeṇa tadu- papattī pramāṇābhāvena na yāgasvarūpārthatve ānarthakyaṃ prokṣaṇādīnām |
ata eva ārādupakārakāṇāmapi yāga- svarūpārthatve nānarthakyam |

iti prāpte, yadyapi tāvat vijātīyayāgasādhanatvameva prokṣaṇādimuddiśyatā''vacche- dakaṃ, tathāpi apūrvasādhanatve iva vakṣyamāṇarītyā na tatra vrīhitvādi praviṣṭaṃ, iti śyāmākebhyapi tatsatvāt ūha- siddhirinyāyaivaṃ |

vastutastu, na vijātīyayāgasādhanatvaṃ uddeśyatāvacchedakaṃ, vijātīyayāgavyaktīnāmi vyāpa- kībhūtayāgatvāvacchinnasyevagatatvatāt tadavacchinnaṃ prati dravyatvāvacchinnasya lokata eva kāraṇatvāvagateḥ sāmagrī- vaśena vrīhmādi dravyaṃ vinā'pi, dravyāntareṇa kadā cit vijātīyayāgavyaktīnāmupatvau bādhakābhāvena ānartha- kyasya tadavacchatvāt |
na ca sāmānyasāmagryāḥ viśeṣa- kāraṇasattvāhityā eva kāryajanakatvaniyamaḥ; anyatra tathātve'pi prakṛte tathā kalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt, 'tadeva yādṛk tādṛk ca hotavyaṃ' iti liṅgānuptatteśca |
ata evānaiva vrīhyā pañcāprātimupapādya phalato niyama- vidhitvaṃ vrīhmādividhīnāmupapatteḥ pratinidhiṣva |
ato dravyatasaṃskāravidhivyaḥ sarve apūrvasādhanībhūtavidhayā eva vyāpakībhūtapūrvāvacchinnaṃ prati dravyādinā kāraṇatvasya lokata'klṛptatvena niruktapratibandhakatvāpatteḥ |
ārādupa- kārakāṇāmapi anayaiva rītyā apūrvajananākulayogyatā- saṃpādakalatvaṃ dravyaṃ, na tu yāgārthatvaṃ, ānarthakyapātteḥ |
yāgādiniyogyatāsaṃpādakatvācca na prādhānyāpattiḥ aṅga- tvavighāto vā ityādi kṣuṇṇa kaustume |

yattu vrīhitvāvacchinnoddeśena prokṣaṇādividhiḥ, śābdabodhe lakṣaṇāyā anaṅgīkārāt, paścāttu niṣāda- patyanyāyena prokṣaṇādiviśiṣṭavrīhīṇāṃ vākyāntarakalpanā apūrvārthatvakalpanā ityuktaṃ, tat prokṣaṇāḥ : tadanyādyasya vā vrīhitvāvacchinnabhāgyātvatve ayogyatānirṇayasya prati- bandhakatvāt śābdabodhasyaivāpatteḥ : lakṣaṇā'ṅgīkārāta prayuktam |
ato vrīhmādipadena apūrvasādhanatvavacchinna- lakṣaṇāt taduddeśenaiva prokṣaṇādividhiḥ; iti te apūrva- prayuktā eveti siddhaḥ śyāmākādau ūhaḥ |
na caivamapi dharmānuṣṭhāne vrīhmādīnāmapi anuṣṭhāpakatayā nimittatvāt |
vikṛtau tadabhāve bhedabhāve iva dharmalopāpattiḥ, yaccha- vdābhāve vrīhmādīnāṃ nimittatve pramāṇābhā
śravaṇāt 'brīhibhiryajeta' iti dravyasvarūpamātrasya tacchru- vaṇāt ' ityadhikā śaṅkā |
'brīhinvahanti' ityatra yāgavācakaśabdābhāve'pi prakaraṇavattvāt yāgārthatvamupa- padyate iti parihārastu spaṣṭaḥ |
' yathā deśakālakartṛdravyāṇāṃ pakṣe prāptī niyamo vihitaḥ, evamavaghāte'pi taṇḍulaniṣpattaye lokataḥ prāpto'pi pākṣikatvavidalanādivāvyāvṛttaye niyamyate |
bhāṭṭe tu idaṃ sūtraṃ navame'dhikaraṇe antarbhāvitam |
na ca sarvamate haviṣṭvāvacchedena havirayogyatvasya nimittatve dravyatvavanāśe'pi ājyena yāgapattiḥ ; nimittajñānasya naimittikānupāyakatayā tādṛśanāśasya nityatayā vā nimittatvānupapatteḥ |
aṅguṣṭhaparvamātravarjanīyā- tiriktāvayavanāśe tu bhavatyeva ājyena yāgaḥ |

teṣā- mayamāśayaḥ — ekadeśadāhavadeva ekadeśanāśasya na nimittatvaṃ, ekadeśanāśe'pi puroḍāśāvayavopyate'dhivādeḥ pratyabhiśayamānatvāt, tasyaiva haviṣṭvāvacchedakatvena yāva- nniruptavrīhiparimitāvayavatvacchedakatvān, tannāśasyā- varjanīyatvāt |
kramasaṃyogāt' iti sūtre nyāyopanyāsena tasya prakṛtāva- nyasya vikṛtiṣu niveśa ityapi suvacam |
avadāne pañcāvatte pañcamamavadānaṃ abhi- ghāraṇāt prāgeva |
puruprayatnena lokavyavahārasyecchikatve'pi apoṣedhye tadyogāt uttaliṅgadarśanasya kramānamidhāyāt 'āga- ntūnāmante niveśaḥ ' iti nyāyena ( 5|2|9 ) abhi- ghārottaraṃ haviṣaḥ paścārdhādavadeyam |
iti prāpte, abhi- ghāraṇasya saṃskāratvādeva saṃkhyāvattvaṃ pracurerīpadhasya śrīpavadānāni kramikāṇyeva |
iti prāpte, catu- rthottaratvamātropasthiteryathākathaṃcit aṅgīkāre'pi caturthā- vadānakarmabhūtameveha vivakṣitamityabhidhānā
avabhṛthapi pratiprasthātā nādhvaryukarmaṇi vartate iti nāsyāṅgeṣu bhakta: syāt padau |

ata eva gṛhamedhīye parisaṃkhyāpakṣe 'ājya-bhāgau yajati' ityasya avadhāraṇārthalakṣaṇasya ājyabhāga-sajātīyabhāgāntaravyavacchedakatvaṃ sviṣṭakṛdihānasya vā avadhāraṇārthaṃ lakṣakasya śeṣakāryāntaravyavacchedakatvaṃ ca pūrvatantre 'sviṣṭakṛt bhakṣapratiṣedha: syāt' ityādidhakaraṇe ( 10|7|21|35 ) darśitam |
avabhṛtha: apsu, jyotiṣṭome āhavanīye iti aṅgapradhānayordeśabheda: 'apsu avabhṛthe caranti' iti vacanāt |
sadhivat, apsu me somo abravīt' iti |
tāmyāmetau ādyabhāgā apsumantāveva iti, nirguṇamevedaṃ vacanaṃ itareṣāmaṅgānāṃ parisaṃkhyāpakaṃ bhavitumarhati |
yat 'apa- bhṛthaḥ prayājān yajati' 'apavarhiṣaṃ prayājān yajati' iti (tat) parisaṃkhyātānāṃ prayājānāṃ anuyājasya vidhānārthe bhavatīti |
kiṃca 'apa- bhṛthaḥ prayājān yajati' iti vākyaśeṣo nāvakalpate |
yadi 'prayājān yajati' ityeva vidhiḥ, tadā barhiḥprayā- jo'pi prāpnoti |
