bhāṭa. 6|1|4. avibhaktaśca aṅgapradhānānāṃ prayogaḥ ityuktaṃ 'aṅgāni tu vidhānatvāt pradhānenopadidhyeran' ityatra (1|1|2|18) |
mā. 1|1|2|32. avimāṃsānāṃ ajamāṃsānāṃ ca vigamā paṃktiḥ |
yāvatā kālena ājāni pacyante, tāvatā āvikāni vilīyante |
bhāṣye'pi (mahābhāṣye'pi) avivikkanyāyena iti dvaṃdvagarbhaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ pūrvasamāsapūrvadaśāyāḥ sup 'supo dhātupātipadikayoḥ' (pā 2|4|71) iti pratyayalopa-dipo'pi luk na kṛtaḥ |

vā. 1|3|824 pṛ. 260. (bhāṣyakṛtā pañcalinā) 'karmaṇyaṇ' iti sūtre (pā03|1|12) 'himavantaṃ śṛṇoti, ādidayaṃ paṭhyati' iti dṛśiśṇotibhyāṃ aṇpratyayaḥ kasmāt bhavati ityāśaṅkya anabhidhānāt iti parihāra uktaḥ |

tathā avika-śabdasya svārthikapratyayāntasya aviśabdasamānārthatve'pi 'tasya vikāraḥ' iti vikāratadante lakṣaṇayā'pi 'āvikaṃ māṃsaṃ' iti prayogadarśanāt avikaśabdeya dhānasāmarthyābhāvāt na aṇpratyayotpattiḥ ityupapādanāya avivikkanyāyena iti dṛṣṭānte abhihite aparaśabdaḥ prayukta ityāha-bhāṣye'pīti |
aviśca avikaśca avya-vikī, tayornyāyaḥ : iti dvaṃdvagarbhaḥ tatpuruṣaḥ |
vā. 2|1|3|21 pṛ. 525. avivākyaṃ nāma caturviṃśastomakaṃ daśamamahaḥ agniṣṭomaḥ somo rathaṃtarasāmā dvādaśāhaḥ |
nātra kaścana kamme cana vispaṣṭaṃ brūte |
prasaṅge sati ye brāhmaṇā dṛśī-kavaḥ te vinyūyuḥ |
yadi tatra na vindeyuḥ gṛhapa- tinā cyucyam |
prakṛtau yatra stotre yāvantaḥ stomā bhavanti tato nyūnāḥ stomāḥ, tatra stotre yatra ṛtau bhavanti, te avibuddhastomakāḥ ṛtavaḥ |
ke. avibuddhastomakāḥ vibuddhastomakāśca vikṛtirūpāḥ ke cit ṛtavaḥ |
vi. 10|4|12. avibuddhastomakeṣu ṛtuṣu prākṛtaṃ sāma nivartyeta, yāvatā nivṛttena sā saṃkhyā pūryate tāvat prākṛtaṃ bādhitavyaṃ, anyat prākṛtameva syāt |
'aviśiṣṭaṃ hi lakṣaṇaṃ' iti nyāyena upalakṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayogaḥ |
'sarveṣāṃ vā lakṣaṇatvāviśiṣṭaṃ hi lakṣaṇam' ( 3|1| 714 ) iti sūtrasyākṣarārthaḥ:- sarveṣāṃ grahaṇāṃ saṃmā- janaṃ kartavyaṃ, naikasyaiva, grahatvasya lakṣaṇatvāt kṛtsnasyaivatya- pathāpaktvāt |
aviśiṣṭaṃ samānaṃ hi yasmāt lakṣaṇaṃ grahatvarūpaṃ sarveṣu iti |
prakaraṇavato'rthasya saṃnidhāne yamarthamāma- nanti ( mantrāḥ ), sa tasya sādhanabhūtaḥ ityeva gamyate |
( loke vede ca kriyākārakasaṃbaṃdharūpo vākyārthaḥ samānaḥ |
iti sūtrā- kṣarārthaḥ :) aviśiṣṭastu vākyārthaḥ iti nyāyāt mantrāṇāmiva vedāntānāṃ arthaparatvaṃ autsargikam |
bhāmatī. 1|1|1 pṛ. 46 bras. arthaparatā na dṛṣṭatvādvat svādhyāyādhyayanavidheḥ karmavat aviśiṣṭastu vākyārtha iti nyāyāt |
aviśeṣeṇa yacchāstramanyāyatvāt cika- lpasya tat saṃdigdhamārāt viśeṣaśiṣṭaṃ syāt |

aviśeṣeṇa viśeṣamanulikhya yat śāstraṃ, sāmānya- śāstraṃ, tat yāvadviśeṣaviṣayaṃ katipayaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ veti saṃdigdhaṃ bhavati, ataḥ tat ārāt viśeṣadharmāt dūrāt bhavati, viśeṣaśāstraṃ dṛṣṭvā dūraṃ bhavati, viśeṣaśāstraviṣaye na pravartate ityarthaḥ |
tasmāt tādṛśe sthale viśeṣaśiṣṭaṃ viśeṣaśāstreṇa yat śiṣṭaṃ vihitaṃ tadeva syāt |
yathā jyotiṣṭome 'varmani juhoti' havirdhānaśakaṭacakrasya varmani cakra- gamanena upanyāyāṃ rekhāyāṃ juhoti iti viśeṣaśāstram |
tena varmaśāstrasya viṣaye āhavanīyaśāstraṃ na pravartate |
tasmāt varmādihome varjitvā anyeṣu homeṣu āhavanīyaḥ syāt |
aviśeṣeṇa yacchāstraṃ iti daśamādhikaraṇa- nyāyenāpi kāmyaṃ nityasya bādhakam |
aviśeṣādanarthakaṃ hi syāt ( 2|4|2 ) iti abhyāsādhikaraṇe sthitavedapramāṇalakṣaṇena uktam |
vidheyāntarahitaśca ananyaparo vidhiḥ karmasvarūpameva vidadhat pūrvavihitatā avaśyameva kamāntaraṃ karoti iti vidhivinirṇayaphalopajīvanam |
'samidho yajati' ityādau ekasya yajateḥ punaḥśrutiḥ evaṃ śabdāntaravat bhedikā syāt aviśeṣāt arthabhedā- bhāvāt ityakṣarārthaḥ sūtrasya ) |
avihitapratiṣiddhamanumaṃtaṃ bhavati iti nyāyena caudhayanasiddhāntaḥ ( samudrayānaniṣedhasiddhāntaḥ )
avihitaitikartavyatākaṃ karma vihitaitikartavya- tākāt dharmāt gṛhṇāti ityuktam ( 7|4|1 ) |
bhā. 8|4|4|15. avihitaitikartavyatākeṣu sauryādiṣu itikartavyatāyā atideśaḥ ityadhikaraṇārthaḥ |
padāntara- samabhivyāhārābhāve dhenupadamātraśravaṇe sarvatra godhucidhānā- diguṇasyaiva pratīteḥ dhenvādipadānāṃ gomātravṛttitvā- tīyathānādiguṇe eva śaktiḥ |
aveḥ ajñāni sahayā pacyante ajā'jñāni tu vilambena |
vā. 3|1|12|25. prakṛtau ājyolapanāvekṣaṇayoḥ prayojana- metat, yat ājyasya apareṇa dravyeṇa asaṃsargaḥ |
aveṣṭayo dvividhā rājasūye bhūtānāmaveṣṭayaḥ, diśāmaveṣṭaya iti |
paṭ pūrvā aveṣṭayaḥ, 'agnaye svāhā' ityādayaḥ uttarāḥ |

diśāmaveṣṭayastu ekādaśa yathā 'agneyamāṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā, aindramekādaśakapālaṃ ṛṣabho dakṣiṇā, vaiśvadevaṃ caruṃ payasvī paṣṭhī dakṣiṇā, maitrāvaruṇīmāmāṃkṣāṃ vaśā dakṣiṇā, bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ śitipṛṣṭho dakṣiṇā, ādityāṃ mahāṃ garbhiṇīmālabhate, mārutīṃ pṛśniṃ, paṣṭhīmaśvibhyāṃ, pūṣṇe puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati, satyai satyāyai caruṃ, savitre satyaprasavāya puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ tisṛ- dhanvaṃ śuṣkadatirdakṣiṇā' ( taisaṃ. 1|8|9 ) |

anākhyākāmavākyaikavākyatva- lambhasya 'rājanyo'jñādhakāmo yajeta' iti phalapadānu- ṣaṅgasya 'brāhmaṇo'jñādhakāmaḥ' 'vaiśyo'jñādhakāmaḥ' ititvat rājanyasyāpi aviśeṣāt tatprayogasyāpi phala- medāt medāvagatiḥ |
su. pṛ. 912. aveṣṭiḥ dvedhā rājasūye antaḥprayajamānā bahiḥprayajamānā ceti |
tatra bahiraveṣṭau 'yadi brāhmaṇo yajeta bārhaspatyaṃ madhye nidhāya āhutimāhutiṃ hutvā tamabhimārdhayet |
yadi rājanya aindraṃ, yadi vaiśyo vaiśvadevaṃ' iti vidhīyate |
tathā cānena vākyena brāhmaṇādikartṛkaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭaṃ karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate |

'yadi rājanya aindraṃ madhye nidhāya āhutiṃ hutvā abhimārdhayet' ityanu- paṅgalabhyasya rājanyakartṛkaprayogaviśapyaindramabhidhānapūrvakā- bhidhānavidhivyākhyāsya tantramayoga vinā anupapatterapi prayogabhedo'vasīyate |
su. pṛ. 912. aveṣṭiḥ rāja- sūyāt bahirapi |
nahi rāja- sūyiko dakṣiṇāprastāraḥ prāpyante 'etayaiva anākhyākāmaṃ yājayet' ityekavacananāntena śabdena phalaṃ prati nirdeśāt sahaprayoga eva |
bhāṣyaṃ- tasminneva rājasūye aveṣṭiḥ, āgneyo'- ṣṭākapālo hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā,... bārhaspatyaścaḥ śitipṛṣṭho dakṣiṇā ityādyāḥ |
tasyāṃ cintyate kimajñā medaḥ, atha tantrabhāva iti |
liṅgaṃ hi tantrabhāvasya sūcakaṃ dṛśyate 'yadi brāhmaṇo yajeta bārhaspatyaṃ madhye nidhāya ''hutimāhutiṃ hutvā'bhimārdhayet, yadi rājanya aindraṃ, yadi vaiśyo vaiśvadevaṃ' iti |
nanu liṅgamupapadyate, kutaḥ prāptiḥ ? 1 saha codanayā prāptiḥ |
ime vā atha taṃ lokaṃ punarāparohanti' iti |
yadi anyānyapi havīṃṣi tantreṇa kriyante, evaṃ madhyaśabdo bhavati |
yadi bhedena prayogo bhavet, tathā sati prayoge bahuvacanaṃ śrūyata |
kutaḥ ? ukto nyāyaḥ, 'pratidakṣiṇa vā kartṛsaṃyogaḥ' iti (1|4|12) |
sati 'yadi brāhmaṇo yajeta' ityādivākyeṣu pūrvādhikaraṇa- nyāyena nimittatāmeva brāhmaṇādīnāṃ śravaṇamiti |
nanu rājñaḥ karma rājyamiti hi smaranti |
atra hi prākaprasiddharāja- śabdārthasya karma rājyamiti pratīyate, na tu rājasya kartā rājeti |
dramiḍā hi kṣatriya- jātāveva rājaśabdaṃ prayuñjate |
taduktaṃ tatraiva 'ekadeśo'pi yo dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo jātiniba- ndhanaḥ |
(vā. pṛ. 343 ) kiṃca rājño'- patyaṃ rājanya iti, tadapi smaranti |
tadyadi rājyayogādeva rājā, tadā varṇāntarasyāpyapyarthaṃ rājanyaḥ syāt, na tvevam |
mlecchaprasiddheśca āryaprasiddherbalīyasīti yavavarāhādhi- karaṇe eva darśitam |
yattu rājñaḥ karma rājyamiti smaran, tat rājaśabdasya janaparipālane rūḍhasyaiva sādhutvamātrapratipādanārtham |

yathā ākṛtiviśeṣe rūḍhasyaiva gośabdasya pratipādanārthaṃ gacchatīti gauriti vyutpattidarśanaṃ, tathā rājño'pyayaṃ rājanya itye- tadapi rājanyaśabdasya kṣatriyajātivacanatvena rūḍhasyaiva sādhu- tvamātrapratipādanārthameva saraṇam |
tena rājasūye traivarṇikasyaivādhikārāt, tadantargatayāmaveṣṭau brāhmaṇādīnāṃ prāptatvāt 'yadi brāhmaṇo yajeta' ityādiśravaṇaṃ nimittatāmeveti |
ki tarhi ? kṣatriyajātivacana evāyaṃ, draviḍānāṃ kṣatriyajāti- mātre prayogāt |
naivaṃ, anyathyāsaddhicetanā mleccha- prasiddherevābhidhānaśaktiṃ vinā prakārāntareṇāpi saṃbha- vati |
āryāṇāṃ tu jātyantare prayogaḥ kṣatriyadharmakāritayā gauṇatvenaivopapadyate |
kṣatriyasya manvādibhiḥ janapadapurapari- pālanavalipiṇḍabhāgoddharaṇamabhiṣecanaṃ ca vihitam |
atasta- tkāriṇi varṇāntare'pi prayujyamāno gauṇa evāyaṃ rāja- śabdaḥ |
evaṃ sati rājñaḥ karma rājyaṃ, rājño'pyayaṃ rājanya iti smṛtidvayaṃ niṣpannāgatavathārthaparyāyena sādhutvamātrapratipādanārthe bhaviṣyati |
yattu 'na rājñaḥ prati- gṛhṇīyādrājanyaprasūtitaḥ' ; iti 'na śūdarājye nivaset' iti ca, tatta gauṇarājaśabdārthamabhipretyeti mantavyam |
ato rājaśabdasya kṣatriyavacanatvāt rājasūyāntargatayāma- veṣṭau brāhmaṇādīnāmaprāpteḥ na nimittatātharvam |
ataḥ pūrvādhikaraṇasyaiva draviḍādiprayogādinā brāhmaṇādikartṛkaṃ prayogāntarameva aveṣṭividhīyate |
nanu rājasūyaprayoga- vākyātiriktamparamapi aveṣṭerviśeṣasaṃbhavavacanaṃ śrūyate— 'etayā''dyakāmaṃ yājayet' iti |
atra ca varṇavasyaiva prāptatvāt rājasūyayoge nimittārthayā saṃbhave'pi anādhyāyayoge brāhmaṇādīnāṃ nimittārthe śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati |

ucyate—syādevaṃ yadi anadhyāyakāmavākyaṃ prayogaparaṃ bhavati, kiṃtu phalopādānāt karmaṇaḥ phale vini- yojakaṃ sat anekaparatagauravabhayāt anyena prayogamapekṣa- māṇaṃ rājasūyaprayogamadhyasthametacchando'nyopādāya 'ekasya tumyale saṃyogayyaklam' ( 4|3|15 ) iti nyāyena annādyaphale viniyukte |
tenāsyāḥ sādhāraṇaṃ svārājyaṃ phalaṃ, asādhāraṇaṃ annādyamiti |
sā ca niśaṃtakṣatriya- kartṛketi nimittārthe brāhmaṇādiśravaṇamiti |
nanu rājasūya- vākye svārājyaphalaviśeṣitāyāmeveṣṭiṃ rājā kartavya- gataḥ |
naivaṃ, na hi kartā phalena saṃbadhyate, phala- viśeṣitena vā karmaṇā, kārakāṇāṃ kriyāmātrākāṅkṣā- tvāt |
tena rājeti kartṛpadasya kriyāmātrākāṅkṣāyāṃ rājakartṛkāveṣṭiṃ kriyateyetāvadavagatam |

bhavatu vā annādyavākyasya prayogaparatvamapi, tathāpi etayeti karaṇavibhaktyā yathā- vijñānaṃ saṃnihitāyā evāveṣṭerupādānāt ityadavat śāstrā- 'ntarīyaprayogavacanopasaṃhṛtākṣatvaca rājño'pi kartṛtveno-
ato na kathaṃ cidapi brāhmaṇā- diyuktavākyāccanimittārthatvamiti pūrvādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣa- nyāyena yadiṣṭyadaparityāgādinā aveṣṭereva brāhmaṇādikartṛkaṃ prayogāntaraṃ vidhīyate iti siddham |
na ca prāpte karmaṇi kathaṃ brāhmaṇādivākyasyānekārthavidhānamiti vācyam |

tathā ca sati rājasūyāntargatatvāpekṣitāprayogasya svārājyaphalatvāt nirākāṅkṣatvāt brāhmaṇādiyuktaprayoga- syasya phalākāṅkṣā''t 'etayā''dyakāmaṃ yājayet' ityannādyaphalaṃ brāhmaṇādiyuktaprayogayaiva saṃvadhyate |
' iti (vā. pṛ. 587 ) prayojanam--pūrvapakṣe rājasūyā- ntargataveṣṭau brāhmaṇādināmiṣṭyāhavasyādimedhanidhanam |
siddhānte tu rājasūyaprayogadāhivaiva brāhmaṇādikartṛkāveṣṭi- prayoge bārhaspatyādimathanamiti |
sūtraṃ tu-- aveṣṭau brāhmaṇādiyuktyeveṣṭyakye yajeteti yajñasaṃyogāt, ṛtupradhānaṃ brāhmaṇādīnāmabhidhānaṃ kriyate prayogāntara- vidhātumityarthaḥ |

' rājā rājasūyena svārājyakāmo yajeta' iti prakṛtya 'āmeyo'ṣṭākapālo hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā, aindramekā- daśakapālamṛṣabho dakṣiṇā, vaiśvadevaṃ caruṃ piṣṭapañcī dakṣiṇā, maitrāvaruṇīmāmikṣā vaśā dakṣiṇā, bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ śitipuṣṭho dakṣiṇā' iti pañca diśāmaveṣṭayo nāma iṣṭīrvidhīyante 'yadi brāhmaṇo yajeta bārhaspatyaṃ madhye nidhāya āhutimāhutiṃ hutvā''dibhyārayet, yadi rājanya aindraṃ, yadi vaiśyo vaiśvadevaṃ' ityādyām |
atra rājanyaśabdena yaugikena brāhmaṇādīnāmapi rājasūyādhikārittvena prāptānāṃ nimittārthe śravaṇa iti pūrvapakṣe utsūtre prāpte siddhānta- māha |
aveṣṭau aveṣṭiyajñe 'yadi brāhmaṇo yajeta' ityādi ṛtupradhānamucyate, na nimittārthena |
rājasūyāt vahireva brāhmaṇādīnāṃ ayaṃ pradhānabhūtaḥ aveṣṭiṃyajñaḥ kratuḥ vidhīyate ityarthaḥ |
kratuḥ pradhānaṃ yasmin karmaṇi tat vacanarūpaṃ karma ṛtupradhānamiti viprahaḥ |
kṣatriyeṇaiva rājñā yajñasya rājasūyasya saṃyogān na brāhmaṇādivākyasya nimittārthatā |
kiṃtu brāhmaṇādīnāṃ ayaṃ aveṣṭiṃyāgaḥ : rājasūyāt vahireva vidhīyate |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ karmāntara- maveṣṭeḥ, utāveṣṭireveti |
sannidhau phalārthena punaḥśrutiḥ aveṣṭereva, na karmāntara- miti |
etayā ityaśabdo na śaknoti aveṣṭyā vibhaktaṃ yāgamayaṃ vaktum |
kiṃ prayojanam ? yadi aveṣṭeḥ āmeyādīni havīṃṣi, atha karmāntaramyahaviṣko yāgaḥ iti |
vā--prayojane tu codayanti, karmāntare'pi kila etacchabdakṛtāt sādṛśyaprayāt āmeyādīnyeva havīṃṣi, iti kathaṃ anyahaviṣko yāgaḥ iti |
tasmāt suddhaṃ karmāntare anyahaviṣko yāgaḥ iti |
soma--etayeti vākyasya karmāntaravidhāyakatve tasmin karmaṇi 'avyaktāsu tu somasya' iti saumika- dharmaprāpteḥ |
( bhāṣya ) tasya karma rājyaṃ iti avayavaprasiddhirsaṃbhavāt na tannirapekṣaṃ śakyantarakalpanamapapadyate |
vinaiva tena āryāvartanivāsināṃ prayogo na virotsyate |

atha tu prathamameva rājyamiti pratipālanaṃ rūḍhispeṇa abhidhīyate, tataḥ tacchakyanusāreṇaiva tatkartari rājaśabdaprayogasiddheḥ śakyantarakalpanamantareṇaiva draviḍānāṃ rājyādhikārayogye kṣatriyeṣu prayogo na virotsyate |
tasmāt na tādṛśāvapi rūḍhiśabdau, nāpi yaugiko, na anyataraditve tu rāja- śabdasya tatkalpanā yuktā |
' rājyaśabdābhidheyaṃ paripālanādi karma kṣatriyasya iti manvādyaḥ smaranti |
pāṇibhinaprabhṛta- yo'pi rājñaḥ karma idaṃ rājyaṃ ityevaṃ vyutpādayanti |
sūtrārthastu- aveṣṭiviṣayaṃ 'yadi brāhmaṇaḥ' ityādikaṃ brāhmaṇadikartṛkaprayogāntarapradhānaṃ syāt, ekasyaiva kṣatriyasya rājasūyasaṃyogāditi |
' bhāṭṭa - rājasūye prakṛtyeṣṭeḥ pratyekadakṣiṇā''mnānāt aveṣṭi saṃjñākāḥ pañca iṣṭayaḥ pṛthakprayogāḥ samāmnātāḥ |
tadavāntaraprakaraṇe 'yadi brāhmaṇo yajeta bārhaspatyaṃ madhye nidhāya āhutiṃ hutvā abhidhārayet, yadi rājanya aindraṃ, yadi vaiśyo vaiśvadevaṃ' iti śrutam |
tatrāpi pūrvavat brāhmaṇakartṛkatvādi nimittameva, yadi śabdaśruteḥ |
oṃ aśaktasya anyaḥ paṅguḥ badhiraḥ mūkaḥ gavāśvā-dayastiyyaśca ityādiḥ karmasu nādhikāraḥ |
oṃ aśaktāstvapadaṃ gantuṃ tato nindāṃ prakurvate iti nyāyaḥ |
mahatāṃ padaṃ gantuṃ asamarthāḥ prākṛtāḥ janāḥ mahatāṃ nindāṃ kartumārabhante |
mahatsu apakarṣatipe svasya tatpulyatā'pi labdhuṃ śakyeta iti teṣāṃ durāśā |

viśvajiti yacce deyāt sarvasmāt kiñcit śeṣayitvā tena dakṣiṇādānottarakālīnaṃ karma kartavyaṃ iti dvitīya-pūrvapakṣe anyārthasya darśanaṃ vidyamānaṃ upapadyate 'avabhṛthādutpannaṃ vakhatvaṃ paridhatte' (ācchādayati) iti |
avaśiṣṭakarmotsargaṃ tu avabhṛthaḥ eva na syāt |
tasmādavaśiṣṭaṃ karma kartavyaṃ iti dvitīyaḥ pūrvapakṣa eva sādhuḥ |

ekasya yajamānasya jyoti-ṣṭomānāśanācchau aśakti0' nyāyāt jyotiṣṭome'pi vihitayajamānaikatvalāgena arthāt taddvilambatvapravāpti-rbhaviṣyati ityāśaṅkya ākhyātādekatvaviśiṣṭasya kartu-tyāgavateḥ, ekatvābhāvena adhikārābhāvādeva tu asya aśakkṛtājñatyāganyāyaviṣayatvānupapatteḥ nārthāt dvitva-prāptiḥ iti parihāramāha |
su. pṛ. 1291. 'dvitvabahutvayuktaṃ vā''ḍvadanāttasya' ityadhikaraṇe (3|1|9) yajamānasya ātmīyamekatvamapi anupādeyamityuktaṃ tatra aśakkṛtājñājñatyāganyāyābhāvātprayujyate |
oṃ aśakto'haṃ gṛhārambhe śako'haṃ gṛhabhañjane iti nyāyaḥ |
aśeṣaṃ niḥśeṣaṃ tu sarvasvaṃ dānaṃ samajasā samajasam |
atha śeṣakamaṃ kathaṃ syāditi cet, ādānena navīnaṃ saṃpādanena śeṣakamaṃ syāt |
anyat dravyamarjayitavyaṃ, tena ca śeṣakamaṃ kartavyaṃ iti tṛtīyaḥ panthāḥ |
aśakyajñājñatyāgasya vidhinā anuśātatvāt na vaiguṇyāpādyakatā ( nityādhikāre ) |
viśvajiti yacce mārthadine savane sarvasvadakṣiṇādāno-ttaraṃ apūrveṇa arjitena dravyeṇa śeṣakamaṃ kartavyaṃ iti yaḥ tṛtīyaḥ panthā uktaḥ, taṃ dvitīyaḥ pūrvapakṣo niṣedhati |
arjitaṃ pravṛtto'pi kadā cin labheta, tadā ca śeṣakamaṇo lopaḥ syāt |
tasmāt śeṣakamārthaṃ sarvasvādaiva śeṣakamaparyantaṃ avaśeṣa-titvaṃ ityeva dvitīyaḥ pakṣo yuktaḥ |
kathaṃ punaḥ liṅgavākyādīnāṃ svātantryaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ na bhavati ? ucyate |
viśvajiti yacce sarvasvadānottaraṃ na śeṣakamalopaḥ, na śeṣakamārthaṃ sarvasvadavaśeṣayitavyaṃ, nāpi tadarthaṃ apūrvamarjayitavyaṃ iti tuśabdārthaḥ |
prakṛtau eva jyotiṣṭome dīkṣāsu vinirdeśaḥ viśeṣato nirdeśo bhavati 'idaṃ kratvarthaṃ, idaṃ bhakṣārthaṃ, idamānamanāya' iti |
etasmāt dīkṣāsu vinirdeśāt sarvasvaṃ tredhā vibhaktam |
aśāstralakṣaṇāni ukvyastotrāṇi śatāgniṣṭome, tāni śāstralakṣaṇāyā agniṣṭomāntatayā bādhyante |
tatra yat akratvarthaṃ kratvarthabhinnaṃ bhakṣārthabhinnaṃ ca, tena bhakṣārthabhinnaṃ kratvarthabhinnaṃ ca kevalamanāyarthena dravyeṇa 'sarvasvaṃ dadāti' iti vihitena dānena saṃyogo-'vagantavyaḥ |
tathā ca sarvasvasya dānaṃ nāma āna-manāyarthasya sarvasya viśvajiti dānam |
'sarvasvaṃ dadāti' ityatra ca svaṃ dadāti ityucca sarvatā vidhīyate |
tena na adā-tavyasya kratvarthasya bhakṣārthasya ca dānaṃ vidhīyate |
tathā ca ānamanāyarthasya sarvasyaiva dānaṃ, kratvarthaṃ ca pūrvakarmaṇaḥ śeṣakamaṇaśca anuṣṭhānaṃ, bhakṣārthasya tu bhakṣārthatyeva |
tasmāt avirodhaḥ syāt na kaścit virodhaḥ ! sarve sama-ñjasam |
aśīlaṃ kasya nāma syānna khalīkārakāraṇaṃ iti nyāyaḥ |
kasya khalīkārakāraṇamapamānaheturna bhavati ? api tu sarvasyaiva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |

ayamekasmin sādhye anekeṣu sādhaneṣu satsvapi ādau ekasmin prayukte sati sādhyasiddhau anyaprayoge''bhāvāt tat svayameva nivartate, pūrve kasya cit prayoge cecchaiva niyāmiketi vivakṣāyāṃ prava-rtate |
yathā- rāvaṇo laṅkāyāṃ sītāṃ nītvā rākṣasībhya āśritavān- aśokavanikāyāmimāṃ sthāpayati |
tatraikāṃ sthāpayate cettāvataiva tadājñayāḥ paripālitatvāt sarvatra sthāpayitumaśakyatvāccānyā tatra sthāpanaṃ svayameva nivartate |

kecittu- yathā rāvaṇena sītā nītā cedaśokavanikāyāmeveti kutaḥ sthāpitā, nānyatraiva rāvaṇa-ṇecchaiva niyāmiketi, tāvattaiva tadavasthānasiddheḥ sarvatra sthāpanasaṃbhavāccānyatra sthāpanaṃ svayameva nivartate iti nyāyārthamāhuḥ |
'aśuddhamiti cecca, śabdāt' iti vyāsasūtraṃ (3|1|26) vihitahiṃsāyāṃ niṣedho na pravartate ityāha |
(agniṣṭomādikarma paśuhiṃsāyuktāt aśuddhaṃ iti cenna, 'agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta' ityādi-vidhirvipāt śabdāt jñāyamānatvena aśuddhatvābhāvāt iti sūtrārthaḥ |
yathā tulāpekṣayā''dikāṭhi-nasyāpi loṣṭasya adhamāpekṣayā mṛdutvaṃ, tathā prakṛte'pi |
viśvajiti yacce dakṣiṇākāle vidyamānaṃ sarvasvaṃ deya-mityuktam |
dakṣiṇādānāntaraṃ ca aśeṣatvāt svīyasyaiva śeṣābhāvāt, śeṣasya karmaṇaśca dravyasiddhitvāt dravyeṇa siddhiyasya tādṛśatvāt dravyādhīnatvāt dakṣiṇādottara-kālīnaṃ avaśiṣṭaṃ karma kartuṃ na śakyeta |
tasmāt viśvajit sarvasva-dakṣiṇādānantaḥ kartavyaḥ; avaśiṣṭaṃ karma utsraṣṭavyaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
śrutadevatākeṣu yāgeṣu devatoddeśamātrabhave'pi aśrutadevatākeṣu tatkalpane mānābhāvaḥ |
niveśatāt tadakṣepe tu agnidādinā tadupasthite: ākṣe- ptā'vacchedakadevatātvapuraskāreṇa vā 'devatāyā idaṃ, na mama' ityādirūpastyāgo'stu |

iti prāpte, sāmānyasya pravṛttau anupayogāt tattadiśeṣadharmeṇa saṃpradānasya yāga- śarīraghaṭakatvāt viprasāmānyāya dānasvābhāvat anyādi- devatāyā: śabdadvāre yāgopakārakatvena tadvācakadevabhmi- padasya niyamane iva devatāpadasyāpi śabdaviśeṣarūpatvena taduccāraṇaniyamane'pi pramāṇāntarāvaśyaṃbhāvāt 'prajāpate na tvetāndhanya: iti juhuyāt' ityādāvapi mantraprati- pādyasya prajāpatyādereva devatātvam |
yathā coktaṃ gītāyāṃ bhagavatā śrīkṛṣṇana- 'yadyadācarati śreṣṭhastatta- devetaro jana: |
'yadi grahaṃ na varteyaṃ jātu karmaṇya- tandrita: |
aśva ṛṣabho dhṛṣṇvaṃśata: puruṣa: iti te prājā- patyā: ' ityatra liṅgaṃ puṃstvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ ' muṣkarā bhavanti sendriyatvāt ' iti vidhānāt (muṣkarā: vṛṣaṇavanta:) |
agniṣṭoma- saṃsthe upahavye tu ' aśva: śveto dakṣiṇā ' iti) |
aśvāṃ puruṣī dhenuke dattvā ' iti sārasvate satre kāmeṣṭau turagamanjujātīyānāṃ strīṇāṃ dakṣiṇātvena dānaṃ śrutam |
(āśvalāyanaśrautasūtre (12|6|12) nārāyaṇavṛtti: ' strī aṃśā strī puruṣī ca te dhenvaśve' iti |
prathamaprasūta aśva puruṣī ca tayordānaṃ iti tadartha: |
'na ca śīghradhṛte'śvaidisi cirādāgacchato gati: ' iti pūrvārdha: |
aśvamedhe traya: savanīyā: paśava: aśva:, tū para: (śuddharahita: paśu:), gomṛga: (go: mṛgāmṛga: paśu:) iti |
tatra agnipraiṣe aśvārthe 'caturviṃśadvājino deva- vandyorhyaśvairaśva sthaviti : sameti ' ityākhyā ṛk samā- jñātā paṭhanīyā iti pākṣika: siddhāntapakṣa: ucyate |
tasmāt tasya aśvasya mantrarūpāt vacanāt vaiśeṣikaṃ viśeṣarūpaṃ idaṃ mantrānu- vacanaṃ kartavyaṃ, tū paragomṛgayostu dvipañcāśadanayorvaiśvakra: iti vacanaṃ kartavyam |
tat pratiṣidhya prakṛtirnividyate, sā caturviṃśa- dvākyatvāt |
aśvamedhe aśvārthe 'caturviṃśadvājino devavandyorhya- śvairaśvasa ' iti ṛk vaktavyā iti prāgṛk |
tat pākṣikatvena siddhāntabhūtamāpi pūrvapakṣatvenā abhipretya siddhāntamāha |

tat iti dvitīyaṃ padaṃ, caturviṃśaditi jina: ityuttarūpaṃ vacanaṃ, 'na caturviṃśaditi brūyāt ṣaḍviṃśatirityeva brūyāt' ityanena ṣaḍviṃśadaśvatvāt sakāśāt pratiṣidhya sā prakṛti: yathāprāptaṃ samasta vacanaṃ codakaprāptaṃ niyujyate |
tasmāt vaiśeṣikaṃ vacanaṃ na kartavyaṃ, sāmāsikaṃ tu vacanaṃ kartavyam |
tatra tū parasya ṣaḍviṃśati: , gomṛgasya ṣaḍviṃśati: , aśvasya caturviṃśat, iti saṃkalanayā ṣaḍaśītireva vakraya: |
tū paragomṛgayośvasya ca ṛkṇāṃ samasta vacanaṃ ṣaḍaśī- tireṣāṃ vakraya: |
aśvasya tū paragomṛgābhyāṃ samasta vacanaṃ na
kartavyaṃ, kiṃtu aśvārthe ṛk syāt 'caturviṃśadvājino devavandyorhyaśvairaśva sthaviti : sameti ' ityākhyā ṛgeva vaktavyā syāt |
sā hi aśvārthamā- mnātā, na ca pratiṣiddhā |
ṛgvā samasta vacanaṃ vā iti vikalpastu na nyāyya: |
tū paragomṛgārthe tu dvipañcāśadanayorvaiśvakraya: iti samasta vacanaṃ syāt |
uktaṃ pakṣaṃ tuśabdena vyāvartayan pūrvapakṣī brūte |

ṛk yathā''mnātā na vaktavyā kiṃtu tasyāṃ ṛci 'na catu- rviṃśaditi brūyāt ṣaḍviṃśatirityeva brūyāt' iti vaca- nāt padavikāra: syāt caturviṃśat iti padasya sthāne ṣaḍviṃśati: iti padaṃ ādeśaṃ kṛtvā ' ṣaḍviṃśatirvā- jino devavandyo: ' iti paṭhanīyam |
yathā 'yajñā- yajñā vo agnaye girājā girā ca dakṣase ' ityādyāṃ ṛci girāpadesthāne irāpadaṃ ādeśaṃ kṛtvā avaśiṣṭā ṛk saiva paṭhyate tata: |
aśvārthe ' caturviṃśadvājino devavandyo: ' ityākhyā ṛk caturviṃśadityasthāne ṣaḍviṃśati: iti padamādiśya paṭhanīyā iti pūrvapakṣeṇā uktam |
na kevalaṃ padavikāra: kartavya: kiṃtu sarvapratiṣedha: sarvasyaiva mantrasya pratiṣedho'yaṃ ' na caturviṃśaditi brūyāt ' iti pratīkagrahaṇena syāt |
' caturviṃśaditi ' ityanena mantrasya pratīkaṃ gṛhītvā tasya sarvasyaiva ' na brūyāt ' iti pratiṣedha: kṛta: , na padamātrasya prati- ṣedha: |
padamātraniṣedhe tu caturviṃśat iti padena tasyā ṛca: asaṃyogāt nirarthakameva syāt |
saṃbhūya vākyā- rthapratipādanaṃ kartuṃ avaśiṣṭā ṛk na śaknuyāt |
tasmāt pratīkaṃ gṛhītvā sarvasyaiva niṣedho'yaṃ ' na caturviṃśa- śaditi brūyāt ' iti |

tasmāt abhigupte tū paragomṛga- yorvaiśvakraṇāṃ samasta vacanaṃ, aśvārthe ṛk sarvā pṛthak vaktavyā ityeka: pakṣa: , ṛcaṃ pratiṣidhya trayāṇāmarthe ' ṣaḍaśītireyāṃ vakraya: ' iti trayāṇāmapi samasta vacanaṃ iti dvitīya: pakṣa: iti, vikalpa: siddhānta: |

aśvārthe ' ṣaḍviṃśatireva vakraya: ' iti pṛthak paṭha- nīyaṃ, ' ṣaḍviṃśatiryājino devavandyo: ' iti vikṛtā ṛk paṭhanīyā, tata: paraṃ tū paragomṛgārthe dvipañcāśadanayorvaiśva- kraya: iti samāsavacanaṃ iti tu pakṣadvayaṃ pūrvapakṣa: |
aśvasya dānaṃ pratigraho vikrayaśca anācāra: udī- cyānām |
vā. 11|1|3 pṛ. 204, aśvasya bāla- kiśora: nāma |
aśvādīnāṃ kesariṇāṃ adeyatvaṃ, viśvajiti sarvasvadāne'pi pratiṣiddhatvāt |
viśva- jityapi sarvasvadāne pratiṣiddhatvāt aśvādīnāṃ dānaṃ iti vakṣyati |
atha rājasūyaśabda: anyupata: aśvakarṇanyāyena nattarāṃ viśeṣe vartate |
' śālākhye vṛkṣaviśeṣe aśvakarṇatvayo: śaktirūpeṇāpi abhāvāt samudāyasya śālajātivācitvaṃ kalpitam ' |
aśvo ghāsa: (tṛṇaṃ) iti pramāṇāntarāsiddhatadarthavivakṣāyāmapi prakṛtivikārabhāvā- bhāvena tadarthasamāsayogāt tādarthyalakṣaṇārtha: ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣa: kathyate |
aśvatarasya dānaṃ pratigraho vikrayaśca anācāra: udīcyānām |
yathā vaḍavāto gardabhā- dutpannā aśvatarī, tasyā garbho yathā tannāśāya bhavati, tathā prakṛte'pi |
kiṃca nanvanaśāntyāt syādupajīvyavirodhāditi kathaṃ svakāraṇībhūtānāśāya syādupajīvyavirodhāditi cet prakṛtanyāyādeva |
aśvādānaṃ viśvajiti sarvasvadāne niṣiddhaṃ aśva- vyatiriktaṃ sarvaṃ deyam |
ka: punarlaukiko'śvapratigraha:, ko vā vaidika iti |
loke bhikṣamāṇo vā abhikṣamāṇo vā yaśvāśvaṃ labhate, tatra laukikāśvapratigraha: |
pauṇḍarīke aśvasahasraṃ dakṣiṇā, jyotiṣṭome gauścā- śrūyeta |
akarmāṅgabhūtadānāśvapurupārthatvābhi- mato laukikaḥ, karmāṅgabhūtadānāśvastu vaidika iti |
vā. na ca tasya (jalodasya) aśvapratigrahaḥ laukiko nidāna iti pratijñāyate |
na ca kasyāṃ cit vaiyākasaṃhitāyāṃ laukiko'śvapratigraho nidānaṃ śrūyate, nāpi pratyakṣānumānādibhirgamyate |
vā.- # aśvapratigraheṣṭi bhūyastve vāruṇeṣṭyo bhūyastvaḥ kartavyāḥ |
atra ṭupaṭīkā-tasmāt bhinnā evaiṣāṃ prayogāḥ kratūpakāra- stu ekaḥ |
vāruṇān ityanena sāhityamiti cet, tatra devatā chānnenocyate |
tatra ekasmin aśvapratigrahe bahvo vāruṇāḥ prāpnuvanti |
dvitrāśva- pratigrahe dvitrādipuroḍāśeṣu virodhābhāvāt yathārthānusamaya eva |
soma. yatra tu pradhānavirodho bhavati padārthānusamaye, tatra kāṇḍānusamaya eva |
aśśabdāne jalodaravyādhiṣo dṛṣṭadoṣaḥ 'varuṇo vā etaṃ gṛhṇāti yo'śvaṃ pratigṛhṇāti' iti varuṇagrahavākyenocyate |
# aśvapratigraheṣṭiḥ, naimittikaḥ san adoṣābhiniryātaiḥ kratvarthaḥ adhikāra- vidhiḥ |
doṣāt tviṣṭilaukike syācchastrādi vaidike na doṣaḥ syāt |
# bhāṣya- aśvapratigraheṣṭiḥ : 'varuṇo vā etaṃ gṛhṇāti, yo'śvaṃ pratigṛhṇāti, yāvato'śvān pratigṛh- ṇīyāt, tāvato vāruṇāṃścuṣkalān nirvapet' iti |
# tatra sandehaḥ kiṃ laukike aśvapratigrahe iṣṭiḥ, atha vaidike iti |
kaḥ punaḥ laukiko'śvapratigrahaḥ ko vā vaidika iti |
loke bhikṣāmāṇo vā abhikṣāmāṇo vā vastrāśvaṃ labhate tatra laukikaḥ aśvapratigrahaḥ |
vaidiko'pi, pauṇḍarīke aśvasahasraṃ dakṣiṇā, jyotiṣṭome gauścāśva iti |
doṣo hi śrūyate 'varuṇo vā etaṃ gṛhṇāti, yo'śvaṃ pratigṛh- ṇāti' iti |
sa ca laukike aśvapratigrahe śūdrādyansādā pāpakamaṇaḥ kṛto āha, na doṣasakīrtanaṃ prāyaścittaviṣayaviśeṣaṇaṃ, kiṃtu prāyaścittastulyatvena |
varuṇamocanamidaṃ karma, tatra laukike bhavitu- mahati, loke varuṇagrahaṇasya vidyamānatvāt |
śāstrādi vacanena tasya karta- vyatā avagamyate |
yadi ca tataḥ pāpaṃ syāt, na tasya kartavyatā avagamyate |
nanu vaidike'pi pratigrahe apratigrāhyāt pratigṛhṇataḥ pāpa- masti |
bhavedevaṃ, yadi pratigrahasya kartuḥ iṣṭirbha- vet |
sā tu khalu yathā hetukṛtaḥ tathā uttarādhikaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ |
tasmān vedacodite aśvapratigrahe iṣṭiḥ, ityetāvat ihādhikaraṇe siddham |
# vā- vaidikalaukikapradhānasambandhavicāraprasaṅgāt yatra nimittānāṃ laukikavaidikatvāśaṅkā, tāni vicāryante |
tatra 'yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt' iti yāva- cchabdopapannāt aśvapratigrahāṇāṃ nimittatvam |
tatra saṃdi- ghyate kiṃ aśvapratigrahamātrasya, atha laukikasya, atha vaidikasyaiva iti |
kaḥ punarlaukiko'śvapratigrahaḥ ko vā vaidikaḥ ? iti (bhāṣye) loke pratiṣedhāt, vede ca pratigrahetyevaṃ avidhānāt ubhayatrāpi aśvapratigraho nāsti iti manyamānasya praśnaḥ |
itaraḥ vidhipratiṣedhanir- pekṣasvarūpamātraṃ darśayati, akarmāṅgabhūtadānāśvapurupārtha- tvābhimatau laukikaḥ, karmāṅgabhūtadānāśvastu vaidikaḥ iti |
# bhāṣyakāreṇa tu aviśeṣa- pakṣamanābhāṣya (sautra-) tuśabdārthavattvayā siddhāntopa- kramaḥ kṛtaḥ, 'vaidikavasāmānyāt' phalakalpanābhāvācca 'vaidike' iti |
naimittikaṃ hi vidhīyamānaṃ nimittamapi vaidikameva yudau sannidhāpayati |
tenaiva nirākāṅkṣībhūta- tvāt na laukikena saṃbadhyate |
itaratra tu saṃbadasya kratopakāraḥ sukhenaiva kalpiṣyate |
kutaḥ ? 'śrūyate doṣasaṃyuktaḥ sa ca dopo'sti laukike |
'varuṇo vā etaṃ gṛhṇāti, yo'śvaṃ pratigṛhṇāti' iti pāpena grahaṇaṃ yasmin aśvapratigrahe, sa nimittaṃ pratīyate |
yadi hi vidhīyeta, tata kadā cit etadvākyasāmarthyādeva vaidike'pi syāt |
na ca tatra karma- vidhānaṃ, vidheyasya karmaṇaḥ pāpaphalatvātsaṃbhavāt |
na ceha aśvapratigrahaḥ pratiṣidhyate, tadaśravaṇāt, nimittasaṃbandha- mātropayogācca |
sa ca laukikasya pratiṣedhaḥ, 'na kesariṇo dadāti, nobhayatodataḥ pratigṛhṇāti' iti |
nanu ayamapi pratiṣedhaḥ sāmānyenaiva śrūyate, satyaṃ, tenaiva tu laukikasya iti brūmaḥ, itarasya viśeṣa- vidhisaṃsṛṣṭasya pratiṣedhaviṣayatvātsaṃbhavāt |
ataśca doṣa- samabhivyāhṛtatvāt iṣṭirapi laukikaviṣayā syāt |
nanu ca nimittabhāvāt uddiśyamānaḥ aśvapratigraheḥ na doṣeṇa viśeṣaṃ śakyate, iti vidhīyamāneṣṭisutimātrapare doṣakīrtane vaidiko'pi nimittaṃ bhavet |
' nahi evaṃ kriyate doṣavān yo'śvapratigrahaḥ (iti), kiṃ tarhi ? nimittavelāyāṃ tāvat sāmānyamātreṇa gṛhyate |

yadā tu iṣṭibhāvanāyāḥ prayojanākāṅkṣā bhavati, tadā anyasya svargādeḥ karmopakāra- kasya vā saṃnidhyapekṣayoḥ abhāvāt, asya ca doṣasya samānavākyopapattatvena pratyāsatteḥ, svarūpeṇa karmānape- kṣatvena phalatvapratipatyasaṃbhavāt puruṣopāyikaṃ vidhi- saṃbandhārthaṃ nirghātaṃ apekṣamāṇasya apanīyamānatayā karmaṇā sambandhaḥ |
ekena ca nairākāṅkṣye saṃbhavati, na prayojanā- ntaraṃ kalpayituṃ śakyam |
yatra ca doṣaḥ, tatra nirghāto'pi pratiṣedhānusārī |
sa ca pratiṣedhaḥ laukikasya, iti anta- reṇāpi viśeṣaṇaṃ arthavaśāt tasyaiva nimittatvam |
eta- darśayati (# bhāṣyakāraḥ) 'varuṇapramocanaṃ tu idaṃ karma, tat laukike bhavitumarhati' (iti) |

yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa doṣaṃ pradarśayatā uktaṃ 'sa ca laukike aśvapratigrahe śūdrādyansādā pāpakamaṇaḥ kriya- māṇe bhavati' iti, punaśca vaidike'pi etat samānaṃ iti manyamānena 'nanu vaidike'pi apratigrāhyāt prati- gṛhṇataḥ pāpagrahaṇamasti' iti codavivā parihāra uktaḥ :, (tatrocyate) bhavedetadevaṃ, yadi pratigrahīturiṣṭiḥ syāt, sā khalu dāturiti |
tanmantṛ syāt, dānamātra yaṣe vihitaṃ, na pratigrahaḥ iti |
dānavidhā- nainaiva prāk parasvatvāpādanāt aparyavasthatā tasya (prati- grahasya ) āśritatvāt |
tena 'dadyāt' iti sāmarthyagṛhītaḥ svalpaparityāgaṃ ' mantravān niyamairyuktaḥ karmamadhye'ṅgasaṅgataḥ |
' ( ' ka idaṃ kasmā adāt 0' iti mantraḥ, prāṅmukhatvā- diniyamaḥ |
) yadi pratigraho na vidhīyeta, kathaṃ tasya itikartavyatā vidhīyeta, kimiti vā tasminkṛte karma- vaiguṇyaṃ syāt |
atra vadāmaḥ : 'ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāditi dānaṃ vidhīyate |
' nahi dadyāt ityasya prati- gṛhṇīyāt ityayamartha

śā-- ki laukike aśvadāne mitrādāyebhyaḥ snehā- dinā vidhimanapekṣya kriyamāṇe nimitte puruṣārthatā vidhīyate, uta vaidike karmāṅgabhūte jyotiṣṭomapauṇḍarīkā- dipiye karthavyatā, uta ubhayeti saṃśayaḥ |
tadarthaṃ ca kiṃ doṣanirghātakāryaṃ ityaṃ, uta neti |
tatra aviśeṣāt ubha- yaneti prāpte'bhidhīyate 'doṣanirghātakāryaṃ yatrāsau tatra gamyate |
laukike sa ca doṣo'sti, vaidike na vidhānataḥ |

prābhākarāḥ vaidikā api kṣāmatīṣṭāḥ laukikamudahā nimittakatvadarthena prakaraṇādhyayanaṃ vinā vaidikanimittakatvātsiddheḥ 'yāvata'śvān ityaśvaha- tvasya pauṇḍarīke eva saṃbhavācca 'pauṇḍarīke śrūyate' iti kṛtvā cintāmāhuḥ |
tatra kṣāmatayādau vaidikasya gṛha- dāhasyābhāvāt laukikanimittakatā iti na tāvatā siddhā- ntāsiddhiḥ |
'yāvata'śvān' iti aśvasamasaṃkhyā- katyamātrokteḥ nimittacāhutyasyavivakṣitatvāt bahulyavat saṃkhyā'ntaramapi grāhyameva iti vṛtvā pauṇḍarīkaprakaraṇa- gatatvāśrayamiti |
dāna- dvaye laukike vā vaidike vā bhavedīyam |
na, jalodaheratulaṃ pramitaṃ laukike ka cit |
vaidike tu śrutaṃ tasmāt tasyāścittaṃ sā |
bhāṭṭa-- anārbhya prajāpatirvaruṇāyāśvamanayat, sa svāṃ devatāmācchat, sa paryadaiyata, sa etaṃ vāruṇaṃ catuṣkalamapaśyat, taṃ niravapat, tato vai sa varuṇa- pāśādamucyata |
varuṇo vā etaṃ gṛhṇāti, yo'śvaṃ prati- gṛhṇāti, yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt tāvato vāruṇān catuṣkalān nirvapet' iti śrutam |
pratigrahaśabdo'tra dānaparaḥ iti uttarādhi- karaṇe vakṣyate |

tataśca yata mitrādāyādibhyaḥ laukikaṃ dānaṃ tatsaṃbandhinī iyamiṣṭiḥ, kiṃvā aśva- dānamātrasaṃbandhinī, kiṃvā agnimatyaṃṅgābhūtāśvadāna- saṃbandhinī iti cintāyāṃ, arthavādānurodhena dāna- viṣayatvat asyā iṣṭeḥ doṣanirghātārthatvasyāpi avagamāt, doṣasya ca 'na kevariṇo dadāti' ityanena avihita- laukikaviṣayatvāt tadanurodhena asyā api laukikadāna- viṣayatvam |
idaṃ hi vakṣyaṃ yatra aniyamena sāmānyato vihite aśvaviṣaye (aśvadāne) icchayā pravṛttiḥ, yatra vā naiva vihitaṃ yathā mitrādāyādibhyaḥ; tadipyama |
ata eva yatra viśvajidādau sarvasvadāne aśvadānaṃ niyataṃ, tatra tadprakaraṇasthena vākyāntareṇaiva tasya paryudāse'pi asyā śāstrā'ntarīyavacanasya uktaviṣaye niṣedhatvameva |
atastatra niṣedhatvena doṣāpagateḥ tannirghātārthatayā iṣṭepi tadvi- payatvaṃ bhedanahome'styeva bhedanavat darśapūrṇamāsaviṣayatvam |
ata eva doṣanirghātaḥ phalaṃ, aśvadānaṃ ca nimittaṃ, na tu śeṣā |
yadi tu asyāḥ doṣanirghātā- rthatvaṃ nābhyupagamyate, tato yāvacchabdasamabhivyāhāreṇa aśvadānasya uddeśyatvāvagateḥ tāvacchabdasamabhivyāhṛtā- prāpteḥ tadaṅgatvāpātāt nimittatvānupapattiḥ |
nāhi yāva- cchabdo nimittatvāvācī, api tu sākalyavācī |

na ca yāvattvācchabdamātrāṃ kriyādravyasya saṃnnidhamātrāvagatau śeṣi- tvapakṣe ārādupakārakatvena tantratvāpatteḥ tāvacchabdārtha- prāptyabhāvena vidheyatvaprasaṅgāt, nimittatvapakṣe ca pratini- mittaṃ naimittikābhyupagamena tāvacchabdārthasya prāptatvena avidheyatvāt vidhilāghavānurodhena nimittatvāvagatiḥ |
pakṣadvaye'pi nimittatānuparodhena pradhānānurodhena vā āvṛttipakṣato kālai- kyena tantratvaprāpteḥ tāvacchabdasya pratiprasavavidhilāvaśyaṃ- bhāvāt |
mama tu doṣanirghātārthatvāt tanniścayaḥ iti vaipamyam |
ataśca tadvalena laukike evāśvadāne āhi- tāgneḥ syāt, iti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ |
dvitīyastu, yasmāttat arthavāde jalodarāparaparyāyo varuṇagrahasyo doṣaḥ, sa naiva pratyakṣādinā vaikasaṃhitāmirvā aśvadānajanyatāya ava- gamyate |
atha mukhyarthāvāde'pi pāpameva vṛṇotīti gyupattyā avayavayogena varuṇagrahaśabdena ucyeta, tato vaidikadāne'pi kathaṃ cit tyāgāhuḥsvadarśanat tādeva varuṇagrahaśabdena ucyatām |
iṣṭyādyamaravinodena ca tadṛṣṭyadamānāt, 'sa evainaṃ' ityākhyāpyanteḥ asyā doṣanirghātārthatve pramāṇābhāvāt laukikamātraviṣayatvā- nupapatteḥ vākyasaṃkocādyogena sarvaviṣayatvam |
na ca 'gṛhṇīyāt' iti liṅā vihitatvena uktatvāt vihi- tasya upasthitiḥ, uddeśya vihitatvena viśeṣaṇayogāt |

iti prāpte, jayādinayāneva (3|4|13) laukike phalakalpanā vaidike na ityevaṃ, vihite'pi agnirāhite tapaṇayanādiprayojakatvaṃ itaratra na, ityevaṃ ca vairūpyāpatteḥ vidhilāghavānurodhena sva- saṃkocaṃ kāmaśrutitvadeva anumanyate |
tadapi ca śeṣitvayā pratardhanyāyena (3|1|12) aśvadānagataprayojanavattva- jijñāsāyāṃ ananyopasthitakratoreva śeṣitvakalpanā'nī- cityāt |
ataśca upatadeva nāśvadānasya hetutvaṃ śeṣitva- tayā, api tu nimittatayaiva |
astu vā tat, tathāpi agnimatyasaṃbandhvaśvadāne eva iyamiṣṭiḥ |
bhāṣya-- aśvapratigraheṣṭyāṃ vāruṇāśrutakapālāḥ puroḍāśā asaṃkhyeyāḥ śrūyante 'yāvato'śvān prati- gṛhṇīyāt tāvataścakapālān vāruṇānnirvapet' iti |
tatra vicāryate kiṃ dairghyaṃ kapāleṣu sarveṣāṃ śrapaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ, athavā pratipuroḍāśaṃ kapālacatuṣkabheda iti |
yathā prājāpatyeṣu kumbhī tantraṃ, evaṃ tulyasaṃkhyānāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ kapālāni tantramityarthaḥ |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ? evaṃ sahalaṃ cānumahīṣyate, sarve caturṣu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtā bhaviṣyanti |
prakṛtau darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prati- puroḍāśaṃ kapālāni bhinnāni, ihāpi tadeva mettvāni coṭakānugrahāya |
api ca yadi kapālāni tantraṃ bhaveyuḥ, naiko'pi puroḍāśaḥ catuṣkapālaiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ syāt |
bhāṣya-- idaṃ ca śrūyate, 'yāvakapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti |
soma-- iha tarhi paktyaipyabhāvāt na medaḥ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
karadvāreṇa adhvariva avayava- dvāreṇa kapālāmeva śrapaṇasādhanatvasaṃbhavāt lāghavena dairghyamātraṃ saṃpāyaṃ, na tu kapālāntarāṇi |
'yāvakapālaṃ prathayati' ca āyāmatau dairghye'pi pariṇāhato hastatvasya ava- dyavaktavyatvāt pariṇāhāpekṣā upapadyate iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
prakṛtau sākṣādeva kapālāṃnāṃ sādhanatvāt ihāpi tathaiva svīkārye nāvayavadvārā, 'yāvakapālaṃ prathayati' iti vacanasya pariṇāhamānaviṣayatayā saṃkoce na kiñcit pramāṇaṃ |
kumbhītvata tantratā, mevaṃ medaḥ syāt prakṛtāviba |
12. bhāṭṭa-- 'yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt' ityatra dvināvaśvadāne tantreṇa kriyamāṇapratigraheṣṭi na tāvat
puroḍāśasya ekatvaṃ, tāvacchabdatvena tatredasyāpi vidheya- tvāt |
catuḥsaṃkhyākapālānāṃ tu prakṛtau kapālapari- māṇasya aśrutatvena dīrghatvādepi śrutatvāt hastadvārā arghyāderiva avayavadvārā avayavino'pi kapālasya sādhanatvopapatteḥ na bhedaḥ |

iti prāpte, sākṣāt sādhana- tvasaṃbhave'pi paraṃparā''śrayaṇasya anyāyatvāt prakṛtau ca sākṣātsādhanatvasyaiva vivakṣitatvena iha paraṃparā''śrayaṇā- nupapatteḥ, yāvakapālaṃ ca pranasya prakṛtitaḥ prāptatvāt ‘tāvato vāruṇān’ ityanena ca viśeṣaṇabhūtakapāleṣvapi utsargeṇa tāvatsva pratītasya bādhe pramāṇābhāvāt bheda eva kapālānāma |
athavā svāmikarmātithyayoḥ katarasmin syāditi saṃdigdhe yatra liṅgaṃ sāmarthyātmaka- mavaklṛpte, tatra iti sūtrārthaḥ |

(atra sudhā. pṛ.1848- pūrvādhikaraṇasiddhāntasūtrayoḥ vāśabdajñāśabdayoḥ vyavahitayorapi apekṣitatayā anupaṅgeṇa yajñāṅgo dāne anaṅge vā ṛtvikarmaṇi iti saṃdigdhe ityevaṃ svayameva anyathā nyāyācce- athavā svāmiti [athavā svāmikarmātithyayoḥ iti ] ) |
kathaṃ punaryajamānavyāpāre nimittaṃ iti liṅgena gamyate ? taducyate, 'sāmarthyaṃ karmaṇastāvadekaṃ liṅgaṃ vivakṣitam |
yadā hi aśvapratigrahavataḥ karmaṇo'ṅga- meva ityavadhāritaṃ, tadā aṅgapradhānānāṃ ekadeśakāla- kartṛkatvāt ( 1|2|12 ) |
ya eva kratoḥ kartā, tenaiva iyamapi kartavyā |
yaśca kratoḥ kartā, sa 'svāmikarma parikrayaḥ ' ( 3|8|19 ) ityevamastvasya dātā |
etaddhi aṅgasya sāmarthyaṃ, yat pradhānena ekakartṛkaṃ sat upakāraṃ śaknoti kartuṃ, na bhinnakartṛkam |
tena pradhānavadeva itara- ssyāmapi ārṣijyaṃ kartavyaṃ, na yājamānamiti |
tasyāpi ca vākya- saṃtra-dhopakramopasaṃhārasya īdṛśameva sāmarthyaṃ, yat dāturvi- dhatte |
nahi etāvadeva vākyaṃ 'yāvata'svān pratigṛhṇī- yāt tāvataśvapālān varuṇārpaṇameva ' iti, kiṃ tarhi anyo'pi upakramaḥ 'prajāpatirvaruṇāyāśvamanayat ' ityā- dirasya vidyate |
' yadi lbyāmakako''tra pratigrahītṛviṣayaḥ vidhyuddeśo bhavet, tato vicāra eva na kriyeta, na tu asau lakṣaṇatmakaḥ |
' satyapi pradhānaguṇābhāve vidhyarthavādānāṃ pūrvā- parocāraṇakṛtaḥ anyo viśeṣo bhavati |

sarvathaiva tāvat 'mukhyaṃ vā pūrvacodanāllokavat ' ( 1|2|18|23 ) iti ca, śrutiliṅgādhikaraṇanyāyena ca pūrvaṃ vijñānaṃ anu- prajātapratidvaṃdvi dvitīyavijñānanāntarānupanyavatvāt ājña- styena ātmānaṃ labhate |
paścāccanaṃ tu pūrvavijñānaviruddhajñāna- viṣaye upajāyamānaṃ, satyāṃ virodhāvasthāyāṃ, tadānuguṇyā- tiriktena rūpeṇa utpattumeva na śaknoti, iti anyathātva- mapi pratipadyate |

tadiha vidhyarthavādalavakṛtaṃ viśeṣaṃ pūrvapaścādbhāvitāyā anāśritya upakramopasaṃhārayoḥ dātṛ- pratigrahītṛviṣayatvena vipratiyamānārthatvāt, tathā sati ca ekavākyatvātsaṃbhāvāt, pṛthakatve ca ubhayopi paraspara- saṃnidhivaśena akalpitavidhvantaramarocanā'ntarasaktayoḥ sākāṅkṣatvena aparipūrṇārthayoḥ ānarthakyaprasaṅgāt anyadayaṃ- bhāvyekavākyatvavaśena samānaviṣayatve kalpyamāne anupa- jātavirodhaavasthā pūrvāvadhāritadātṛgāmitvātparibhāṣāsaṃbha- vāt, uttaraṃ alabhyavasyameva pratigrahītṛsthānaṃ gauṇahyāti- kalpanayā dātṛviṣayatvena adhyavasīyate |
' prajāpatiḥ varuṇāyadattaṃ pratyakṣāt svāṃ devatāmapānabhūtāṃ varuṇameva iti yat asañjasaṃ syāt |
mama tu grahāti- reva kathaṃcit prayojakavyāpāre vartitavyaḥ |
yat vidhiḥ arthavādāt balavattara iti, satyam |
sarvatra hi vākye yat pūrvapaderanavataṃ apekṣitaṃ ca, tat uttarapadebhyaḥ parigṛhyate, netarat pratīyamānamapi |

tadyathā 'satrādudavasāya ' iti kvāpratyayasyaiva uttarasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ udavasānavat anyonyanirapekṣā bahavaḥ kartāraḥ : aya- dhāritāḥ : udiṣyamānatvāt aviśvasitasāhityāḥ, iti 'pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena yajeran ' ityatra satyapi upādīyamānatve saṃhatavahukartṛtpamayaḥ pūrveṇa anapekṣitatvāt aviśvasito bhaviṣyati (10|2|13|14) |
evamiha yāvadeva 'prajā- patirvaruṇāyāśvamanayat ' ityevamādena dātuḥ varuṇanirmo-
cane hetutvena iṣṭiḥ praśasyamānā avagatā, tāvadeva tasya kimapi vaktavyaṃ iti imeva iṣṭiḥ vidhyāste ityava- dhāryate |
tataśca pūrvavidhyāratividhiviṣayaḥ puruṣo vidhyanu- mānānmukhaḥ tanmātrameva ucyamānaṃ prārthayate, nādhikam |
yattu arthavādasya vidhiśaktirnāsti, tāvanmātraṃ vidhāyakāt gṛhyate eva |
na tu tāvatā sarvameva tadvataṃ vivakṣyate, anapekṣitatvāt |
ato nimittārthe liṅgadhāraṇaṃ dhātu- mantareṇa na saṃbhavati, iti yatra ka cana dhātau prayojyatve dātṛvyāpārātyahīto gṛhṇāti : prayukta iti draṣṭavyam |
anyathā hi yasmān purākalpe dāturevaṃ śrut, tasā- dyave'pi pratigrahītṛbhiḥ evaṃ kathaṃ kartavyaṃ ityasaṃchadameva vākyaṃ syāt |
tasmāt vidhyuddeśena iha pravṛttena dātā āśrita ityavirodhaḥ |
nanu ca tenaiva gatatvāt iha nārabdha- dhyametat |
bhāṣyāntarajanitabhrāntya- panayārthaṃ ( bhāṣyāntare sautrāvijñañchandāt pratigrahīturiti siddhāntam ) tu punarārambhaḥ |
itarathā hi śakyamidaṃ sūtradvayaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇe'pi vyākhyātum |

yo nāma āla- mbhaniryāpavat lokevedayoḥ aśvapratimeṣṭyaviśeṣāt ane- kānte sati na niyogataḥ karmāṅgaṃ gamyate iti manya- māno vadet ' yājñe'pi acoditemetat karma mede sati nirṇayakāraṇābhāvāt ' iti, tasyottaraṃ ' sā liṅgadā- rvije syāt ' iti |
yat ṛtvigbhyo'nuvadānaṃ, tatra syāt, vaikalpyasyaiva liṅgaviśeṣatvāt, nimittatvopa- yuktasyāpi liṅgaḥ eva liṅgatvāt |
vaidikī hi (prati- grahaḥ ) liṅgasaṃjño dṛṣṭaḥ, na laukikaḥ |
athavā etadeva cordhvaṃ vinā sūtreṇa kṛtatvāt sūtradvayamapi ekī- kṛtya parihāro varṇanīyaḥ |
yasmāt acoditaṃ laukikaṃ, na tatra nimittatvena buddhiḥ iti pūrvavadeva yojyam |
tatra etat syāt ekamidaṃ kathaṃ yathā vaidikaṃ sat nimittaṃ bhavati iti, tathā laukikamapi saṃbhavati iti ata āha, naitat |
asti hi coditāccodita- tvakṛtaḥ deśādibhedakṛtakarmavyiktito'pi karmabhedaḥ, yena nimittavyavasthā bhaviṣyati |
ato yasya asaṃdigdhaḥ sadbhāvaḥ, tathaiva nimittatvam |
na cāvaśyaṃ asya nimittārthe śravaṇaṃ, saṃgrahadhamāpaparyavasānāt |
ataśca asyadānasyaiya mitikartavyatā iti prayojanavattvena vaidikaṃ gamiṣyati |
gṛhṇāti- śabdaśca prayojakakriyāyāṃ adṛṣṭapūrvaṃḥ dṛḍhāṃ bhrāntiṃ kurvan lakṣaṇayā netavyaḥ :, prayojakavyāpāre prayojyavadupacārāt |
tatra yadā hetutvaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā hetumada-vyāpāre vivakṣite'pi ṇijupa- yate |
kartṛtvāmātravivakṣāyāṃ vinaiva ṇicā yo'śvapratigrahaṃ yathākathaṃcit nirvartayati sa pratigṛhṇāti iti śakyate vaktum |
yathā ' ṣaḍbhirhalaiḥ kṛṣati ' iti vilekhana- vacanaḥ san kṛṣiḥ ṣaḍ-halapadānāmasāmarthyāt vilekhitṛ- viṣayasaṃbhavāt tatrayojakamyāpāre vartate |
nahi spaṣṭa- kena ekaḥ kartā vilekhituṃ śaknoti |
tena ṣaṇṇāmeva vilekhitṛṇāṃ yaḥ saṃvidhānena prayojakaḥ sa tad-vyāpāreṇa kṛṣepi kartā bhavati ityevamabhidhīyate, tadat arthavāda- vaśena vartamāno gṛhṇātiḥ tadyojakamyāpāre vartayate |
vicitravaktavya hi dhātavaḥ prayojyaprayojakavyapārāvaca- nena bhāvārthādhikaraṇe darśitāḥ |
teṣāṃ sahakārikāraṇasaṃni- dhānāt kadā cit kā cit prasiddhivyatirekeṇāpi śakti- rabhivyajyate |
tasmāt dadātyarthe pratigṛhṇātiśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ iti dāturihiḥ |
yathā kila maitrāyaṇīyānāṃ ' sa eṣa'śvaḥ pratigṛhyate ' iti ekarūpopakramopasaṃhāravihinā vispaṣṭameva pratigrahītṛriṣṭiḥ iti gamyate |
tatra ca vadanti, nayane tāvat vayaṃ balī- yāṃsaḥ, yadi tu vacanāntareṇa jīyāmahe kiṃ kriyatāṃ iti |
kathaṃ ? 'pratipra- hītari spaṣṭe yadi vākyavāntaraṃ, tataḥ |
sā na nyāyāntareṇa apanīyate, na vacanāntareṇa |
yadyapi prati- pedyavacanaṃ syāt, tathāpi vihitapratiṣiddhatvāt vikalpe
yat pratigrahītṛvidhā- yakaṃ, tadādi tāvat karmāṅgatvena vinā'pi upakramaviśe- pāt pūrvāvākyārthānusāra eva bhavati, tataḥ tenāpi dātṛ- reva |
atha tu svātantryāt pratigṛhṇātivaśāt prati- grahītuḥ, tataḥ pūrvavākyāt dātuḥ ityubho kariṣyataḥ |
tatrapratigrahītṛgatā ca karmāṅgatvābhāgāt puruṣārthā satī laukike'pi syāt |

yastu 'ārvije syāt' ityeta- sūtraparaḥ san pūrvavākyenaivāpi pratigrahītureva vadati, tena tarkatkriyāḥ karmāṅgatvābhāvāt ṛtvijāmitareṣāṃ ca puru- pārthakalpakatvanāttusyatvena laukike'pi prāptau salyā kena pramāṇena 'tasyāśve pratīyate' ityetadabhidhīyate iti vaktavyam |
śa— kimiyaṃ iṣṭiḥ pratigrahasya svatantrakartṛḥ uta hetukartṛdāturiti, tadarthe ca prakramasya arthavādasya upa- saṃhāraścavidhvadeśasya ca virodhe kasya baliyastvaṃ iti cintyate |
tatra pratigrahīturiti prāpte'bhidhīyate 'asaṃ- jātavirodhitvād arthavādo yathāśrutaḥ |
ṛgādiśabdāḥ vede'pi bahulaṃ dṛṣṭaprayogāḥ, ṛjñātiṣu dātṛvyāpāre na ka cit dṛṣṭaḥ, tena nāsau tatparatvena vyākhyātuṃ śakyate iti viśeṣāśaṅkāniścaya- rthamadhikaraṇam |
athavā bhāṣyakārāntareḥ 'sā liṅgā- daliṃje syāt' iti sūtrānusārāt pratigrahīturiṣṭe- rāśritā, taccitratyarthe anenaiva sūtreṇa dāturiṣṭi pratipāda- yituṃ bhāṣyakāro'dhikaraṇāntaraṃ cakāra |
(sūtradvayārthastu) yajñe'pi accoditamidaṃ karma, mede sati nirṇayārthake |
ata ubhayatra syāt, iti codyam (soma- irda vāruṇeṣṭi- rūpaṃ karma yajñe'pi acoditaṃ, yajñāṅgabhūtatvedānadānimi- takamepi na bhavatīti yāvat |
mede sati laukikavaidika- dānamede, dānadvaye satīti yāvat |
) tasyottaram- sā liṅgāt vaidikatvasāmānyāt ārvije ṛtviksaṃ- nidhi vaidike dāne syādityarthaḥ |
(soma-adhikaraṇa- natve na acodinamiti sūtrasyāyamarthaḥ :- vāruṇīṣṭi rūpaṃ karma dāturacoditaṃ dānapratigrahayorbhedāt asya ca prati- grahaṇayogāt iti) |
tena vāruṇīṣṭirapi vaidikāśva- dāne eveti prasaktam |
tadanu ca iṣṭistvireveti prasaktaṃ iti prasaktānuprasaktatā jñeyā) maitrāyaṇīyaśākhāyāṃ dānurūpakamābhāve'pi taittirīyaśākhāyāṃ upakramabalāt dāturiṣṭiditi nirṇayaḥ |
iṣṭiḥ śrutā tato dātṛrnije'pi vidhi nayete |
bhaṭṭa- seyamiṣṭiḥ na pratigrahītṛḥ, api tu dātudeva |

upakramasyārthavāde prajāpaterdātudeva pradhānabhūtasya 'saḥ' ityanena parāmarśāt prajāpateraiva varuṇāyadatvā svāṃ devatāṃ saṃpradānarūpāṃ varuṇaṃ jalekharapeṇa prāptaḥ ityarthā- vagamāt tathaiva tanmitho'rthe iṣṭakartṛtvayāgateḥ; udaistatvā- divadeva upasaṃhārasyapratigrahītṛpadasya dātṛlakṣaṇāttvāt |

athavā ākhyātena sākṣāt prayojakasādhāraṇye kartṛ- mātrāpekṣāt sākṣāt saṃbhave prayojakadhanākṣepe'pi iha upakramanuparodhena tadākṣepāt tatpratiyaṃ yaḥ kārayet ityarthā- vagateḥ vinaiva lakṣaṇā dāturiṣṭiḥ |
na caivaṃ taṃ gatāthatvaṃ, maitrāyaṇīyaśākhāyāṃ 'sa eṣo'śvaḥ pratigṛhṇate' ityevaṃ pratigrahakramāyā evāsyāḥ |
ājñānāt taddeśena upa- kramasthe'pi arthavāde eva lakṣaṇā ityikāśaṅkāyāḥ satvāt |
tanniṣṭisu śālā'ntare pratigrahītṛḥ iṣṭyavagame- 'pi asyāṃ śālāyāṃ (taittirīye) prabalakrame pramāṇā- bhāvena lakṣaṇā'nupapatteḥ etadaccane dāturiṣṭi bādhakā- bhāvāt |
dāturupakramānu- rodhena vā maitrāyaṇīyaśākhāsthopakramasyāpi prayojakakartṛ- svābhiprāyeṇa vyākhyātuṃ śakyatvācca |
ku- pratigrahītureva eṣā iṣṭiḥ iti prācīnabhāṣyānu- sārī pakṣo'pi vārtike dhvanitaḥ |
na bharadvājasūtraṃ 'pratigrahe iṣṭiḥ ityārabhyathaḥ, aśva- pratigrahe ityālekhanaḥ, ārvije pratigrahe yajamānasyaiva syāt' iti |
satyāṣāḍhaḥ- 'ṛtvijo'śvapratigrahe vāruṇī, yāvato'- śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt tāvato vāruṇān śrutkapālān nirva- pet, ekatirikte, imaṃ me varuṇa, tattvā yāmīti yājyānuvākye |
※ yadyapi pṛṣṭadhamanīye sato'davasānaṃ nimittaṃ, tathāpi aśvapratigraheṣṭyanayena satrāṅgaṃ pūrvapakṣe |

bhāṭṭa. 10|2| 11, yūpasparśe prāyaścittaṃ sparśaḥ vihitaḥ avihito veti- cintāyāṃ, prakaraṇādinā aśvapratigraheṣṭyanayena ca vihita- sparśāṅgatā tannimittakatvā yā naimittikamidaṃ prāyaścittaṃ karmāṅgatayā vidhīyate (iti pūrvapakṣaḥ) |
yadi tu atra sparśeniṣedhādhikyāt yadidaṃ doṣapādānācca aśvapratigraheṣṭi- velakṣaṇyamāśaṅkyeta |
parākramaḥ 1, ※ aśvapratigraheṣṭyadhikāra- ṇe'pi na pūrvādhikaraṇasiddhakarmāṅgatvena dāturiṣṭi- riti nirṇayaḥ, anyonyāśrayāpatteḥ |
pūrvadhikaraṇe hi etadadhikaraṇasiddhaṃ dāturiṣṭiḥ ityamumarthe avaikṣaya karmāṅgatvanirṇayaḥ |
yadi hi ṛtvijaḥ pratigrahītṛṣṭiḥ syāt tadā tasya adhikārasiddhaye tadgāmyaiva phalaṃ kalpa- nīyaṃ, iti kathaṃ yajamānagāmiphalakakarmāṅgaṃ bhavet |
ataḥ dāturiṣṭiḥ iti sthite idamadhikaraṇamārabhya iti bhāṣyādiṣu darśitam |
soma. 2|1|16, ※ aśvapratigraheṣṭyadhika- ṇokarītyā vaidikyā eva itikartavyatāyāḥ śīghropasthiti- katvāt grahaṇaṃ yuktaṃ, na laukikyāḥ |
kasyāmaśvo yasyāyaṃ bhulaḥ,; kasyāyaṃ bhṛtyo yasyāyamaśvaḥ, ityatra yathā na vastunirṇayaḥ,; tathā prakṛte'pi |
※ 'aśvamālabheta' ityatra akārakavāryormedhyava- tirno varṇasya dantyace, 'svaṃ dhanaṃ tadahitaṃ daridramālabheta' ityartho bhavati |
tataḥ saṃśayāt aprāptārthaṃ tasya vākyasyeti cet |
vyākaraṇa- nusāreṇa añj nyāsau ityasmāt auṇādike vapratyaye sati tālavyatvanirṇayāt |

'tasya saptadaśo'gniṣṭomaḥ, tasya dīkṣaṇīyāyāmiṣṭiṃ dvādaśamānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dadāti, caturviṃśatimānaṃ prāyaṇīyāyāṃ, dve caturvi- śatimāne ātithyāyāṃ' ityādi 'aṣṭāviṃśatiśatamānāni vaśāyā vapāyāṃ ' ityantena bahudakṣiṇatvoktā |
tatra hi dīkṣaṇīyā, prāyaṇīyā, ātithyā, ṣaḍupasadaḥ, agnīṣomīyapaśuḥ, savanīyapaśu-vacanatraya-udayanīya- anubandhyapaśuṣu dvādaśamānamārabhya uttarottaradviguṇā dakṣiṇā uktā |
3|4|116. vas. ※ aśvamedhaṃ adhīyānāḥ ke cit aśvasya ghāsamāiranti, apare na, pare anyaṃ dharmamācaranti |
aśvaghāsādeḥ ekeṣāṃ upa- kāramākāṅkṣati aśvamedhādiḥ, ekeṣāṃ nākāṅkṣati |
※ aśvamedhe adhigṛyaiṣe aśvavachkīyatvāprākā- śanārthaṃ vaiśeṣikamantrākaraṇapakṣe trayāṇāṃ paśūnāmarthe ṣaḍaśītireṣāṃ bahukrayaḥ |
tatra savanīyaḥ paśuḥ aśvaḥ tūparagomṛgau ca |
asti tu prakṛtau agnīṣomīye ‘ṣaḍviṃśatirasya bahukrayaḥ’ iti vacanam |
asti tu ṛka samāmnātā ‘caturviṃśadājino devavadhordhvakrīrasya svadhitiḥ sameti |
acchidā gātrā vayunā kṛṇota paruṣparanuṣṭupā vi śasta |
tadidaṃ saṃdihyate kiṃ aśvasya vaiśeṣika- midaṃ vacanaṃ kartavyaṃ tūparagomṛgayoḥ samāsena, uta sarveṣā-
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? aśvasya caturviṃśat vaṅkayaḥ ; tasya vaiśeṣikamidaṃ vacanaṃ kartavyam |
evaṃ ' caturviṃśad vājino deva- bandhoḥ ' ityetad vacanaṃ arthavaditi |
' caturviṃśadvā- jinaḥ ' ityanayā avaśyaṃ vaṅkayittā prakāśayitavyā |
ānarthakyamabhyāt ( mantrasya prakaraṇāmānānarthakyamabhyāt ) prakaraṇānumitena vākyena prāpitatvāt |
nanu pratiṣiddheyaṃ ( ṛk ) ' na caturviṃśat ' iti |
vidhi- pūrvikeyaṃ prāptiḥ ; iti vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ vikalpaḥ ṣoḍaśi- vat iti pakṣe tāvat anayā prakāśanam |
tat arthāt prāpnoti, tat pratiṣedhena bādhyate |
nanu iha ānumāniko vidhiḥ pratyakṣeṇa pratiṣedhena bādhyate |
na caitat pūrvapakṣasūtraṃ samāmnā- yasya balavattvāt |
tat pratiṣidhya prakṛtirniyujyate, sā caturviṃśa- dvācyatvāt |
bhāṣyaṃ— tat pratiṣidhya prakṛtirniyujyate, prakṛtau yat kṛtaṃ vacanaṃ tat kartavyamiti |
kathaṃ ? ' na catu- rviṃśaditi brūyāt, ṣaḍviṃśatirityeva brūyāt ' iti |
tasmāt pratiṣiddhatvāt vaiśeṣikaṃ vacanaṃ na kartavyaṃ, sāmā- sikaṃ vacanaṃ kartavyam |
nanu ' ṣaḍviṃśatirityeva brūyāt ' iti vacanāt pratiṣiddhe'pi vaiśeṣikameva vacanaṃ kartavya- miti |
nahi ayaṃ ṣaḍviṃśatiśabdo vidhī- yate, kiṃ tarhi ? yathāprāptaṃ vacanamanūdyate |
ṣaḍviṃśatiśabdena tat prakṛtau lakṣitaṃ ihāpi ṣaḍviṃśatiśabdaḥ tallakṣaṇārtha- meva uccāritaḥ |
caturviṃśatyātiṣedhaḥ ṣaḍviṃśatisaṃkhyāvacanaṃ ca , tatra vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
' na caturviṃśaditi brūyāt , ṣaḍviṃśatirityeva brūyāt ' iti |
etaddhi vacanaṃ catu- rviṃśadanābhāve prāpteta satva kartavyatā pratiṣedhaṃ prajñā- situṃ uccāryate |
sā eka- vākyatā saṃkhyāpare bādhitā syāt |
idaṃ śrūyate ' na catu- rviṃśaditi brūyāt, ṣaḍviṃśatirityeva brūyāt ' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ samastā ṛk pratiṣidhyate aśvasyāpi samasavacanaṃ, uta caturviṃśatpratiṣedhaḥ aśvasya vaiśe- ṣikavacanaṃ ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ iti |
nanu ṣaḍviṃśatiriti bruvan nigade ṣaḍviṃśatiriti śabdasya vidhi bodhayati pūrvapakṣavādī |
tasya karmānuṣṭhānaṃ, tatpurogamayoḥ sāmāsikavacanamanyat ' dvipañcāśadayogvaṅkayaḥ ' iti, aśvasya tu vaiśeṣikaṃ vacanamanyat ' ṣaḍviṃśatirasya vaṅkayaḥ ' iti |
taditaraḥ pratyāha ' na hyayaṃ vidhīyate ' iti ( bhāṣye ) |
yadi tāvat pratiṣedho vidhīyate, ṛci prākaraṇikāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ yadanyat codakaprāptaṃ ityācavanaṃ tat svayameva bhavati |
ṣaḍviṃśativacanaṃ anuvādaḥ saha evakāreṇa, ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ iti iyattā vidhīyate |
na sā śakyā codakaprāptatvāt evakāro- pabandhāt |
yadanyat prākaraṇikaṃ pratiyogi (catu- rviṃśadājina iti mantraḥ ), tatra bhavati |
evaṃ anya- tasyānuvādatve avaśyaṃbhāvinā ṛcaḥ pratiṣedhavidhānaṃ mukhyatvāt |
itarasya cānuvādaḥ, jaghanyatvāt pratiṣedha- stutyarthaḥ iti |
bhāṣyaṃ— āmnātā hi ṛk apratiṣiddhā ca |
bhavatīti cet na pratiṣedhaḥ, neti cenna vidhiḥ |
' āmnātā hi ṛk apratiṣiddhā ca ' iti ( bhāṣyaṃ ) |
padavikāraṃ vakṣyāmaḥ ' tasyāṃ tu vacanādaivata ' ( 20 sū. ) iti |
nanu śrutyā ṣaḍvi- ṃśatividhāne anekārthavidhānādoṣaḥ syāt |
airatvat pratiṣedhaḥ kāryātpratipradarśanaṃ bhaviṣyati asya ' ṣaḍviṃśativājino devabandhorṛśvasya ' iti |
bhāṣyaṃ— atha yaduktaṃ ṛk tatra pratiṣedhate iti, naitadevam |
vacanaṃ hi bhavati, ' na caturviṃśaditi brūyāt, ṣaḍviṃśatirityeva brūyāt ' iti |
tatra caturviṃśadatha śrutvā pratiṣidhyate, ṛk lakṣaṇayā pratiṣidhyate, śrutilakṣaṇaviśaye ca śruti- nyāyyā |
( airatvat— ityādi tuṣṭīkā yadyapi ekaviṃśatitamasū- trīyeṇa mudritā ānandāśramīye, tathāpi sā viṃśasūtrīyeva iti vayaṃ pratīma iti tathaiva likhyate'smābhiriti dhyeyam |
yatra ādya- padaṃ gṛhyate tatra ṛcaṃ lakṣayati sarvo, saṃbandhena ādyatvā- deva ' ayaṃ sahasramānavaḥ ' itivat |
yatra tu anādyaṃ gṛhyate tatra śaknoti parāṇi lakṣayituṃ, arthenasaṃbandhāt |
tathā pūrṇānyapi paryāvṛttibhāvāt svayameva tat padaṃ kāryeṇa prayujyate |
ataśca ' aśvasya caturviṃśat ' iti pūrvapakṣa- sūtraṃ niyamena ṛgeva vaktavyā iti, ' tatpratiṣidhya ' iti siddhānto niyamameva vārayati |
bhāṣyaṃ— sarvasā eva vā ṛcaḥ pratiṣedho'yaṃ, na caturviṃśatpadasya |
caturviṃ- śatpadena ṛcaḥ saṃyogo na syāt |
vinā tasmāt padāt naiva ṛk-doṣo vaṅkayigaṇāt kuryāt |
atha ṣaḍviṃśatipadena saṃbadhyeta, tathāpi na aśvavaṅkayisaṃkhyāṃ brūyāt |
ūnaṃ ca vākyaṃ arthaṃ na sādhayet |
ūne ca vākye doṣaśravaṇāt, ' mantro hīnaḥ svarato varṇato vā mithyāprayukto na tamarthamāha |
sa vāgvajro yajamānaṃ hinasti yathendraśatruḥ svarato'parā- dhāt ' ( pā. śi. 52 ) iti |
ṛcaśca vidhyantareṇa vihitatvāt vaiśeṣikaṃ vacanaṃ iti |
śā— atra bhāṣyakāraḥ caturviṃśat ityevamādi- sūtrapakṣaṃ ekādhikaraṇatvena vyākhyātavān |
vārtika- kārastu idaṃ sūtraṃ pṛthakkṛtya prāptisūtratvena adhikaraṇāntara- tvena vyākhyātavān |
ṛca eva niṣedhe'tastathā sati ca codakāt |

soma— ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ ityasya padyagaṇāntare samasya- vacane'pi aśvamedhe na samāsaḥ iti agrimādhikaraṇa- dvitīyapūrvapakṣasya pūrvvādhikaraṇasaṃgatyā utthānāt tasya pākṣikaprākṛtāgniṣṭuyavanaviṣayatvāt tapākṣikatvavicāra- rūpasya asya vārtikakārīyādhikaraṇāntarasya tadupodghātatayā saṃgatirdraṣṭavyā |
sūtrārthastu-aśvasya caturviṃśat ṣaḍvi- krayaḥ santi, tasmātsamastasyaiva vaiśeṣikameva kartavyaṃ, vacanāt prakaraṇe vaiśeṣikamānāt iti |
bi— ' na caturviṃśadityeva niṣedho niyato na vā |
na ca tadavasthātvāt ṛṣiviśeṣaviṣaye pṛthagvacanaṃ kartavyam |
evakāreṇa svārthe eva vidheyatvāpādanena ṣaḍviṃśatipade tanniṣedhaścodakaprāpte prākṛte adhrigupreṣe prathamādhi- |
vidhilakṣaṇatvaṃ evakārasya ayogavyāvṛttirūpaṃ phala- pratyekaṃ ṣaḍviṃśatitvāt aśvasya catustriṃśatvāt samāsena |
mādāya catustriṃśatpadyānyayogavyāvṛttirūpaṃ phala- ṣaḍaśītireṣāṃ vaktrayaḥ ityevamuhanīyam |
tatra tritvameva upādeyaṃ avaśyaṃbhāvāt prathama- māvitvāt lāghavācca |
vi. 11|14|8 aśvamedhe śataṃ rājatāḥ haritasvaraḥ adyaḥ bhavanti |
bhā. 9|4|4|24. (aśvamedhe traidhātavyāviṣayakaṃ sarvamidaṃ dīkṣaṇīyā- yājñinama nyāyaprayojanatvena sarvatropamyastaṃ, tathāpi avā- ntarabhedāt tata uddhṛtya aśvamedhapṛṣṭhake niveśitamasmi |
ata eva 'kiṃ bhavati prayojanaṃ itarasmin itarasmin vā pakṣe iti |
yadi paramāpūrvaprayuktaḥ evaṃjātīyako dharmaḥ, tataḥ tasyopakāraviśeṣe nibaddhaḥ iti tatkāryapañjāyāṃ traidhātavīyāyāṃ bhaviṣyati |
atha āgneyavaiṣṇavapūrvaprayuktaḥ, tato nedamāgneyavaiṣṇavāpūrve, iti tatra traidhātavīyāpūrve na tena dharmeṇa saṃbhantsyate iti |
dup-- pūrvapakṣe 'traidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati', iti āgneyavaiṣṇavakāryāpannā taddharmairyujyate yathā nīvārāḥ prokṣaṇena |
siddhānte tu āgneyavaiṣṇavapūrvaprayuktā dharmāḥ, traidhātavīyāyāṃ na apūrvāntaram |
na ca apūrvāntaraṃ apū- rvāntaradharmāṃ gṛhṇāti |
( kathaṃ ) 'traidhātavīyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' iti sāmā- nādhikaraṇyaṃ (anayoḥ) |
tatra yadi mukhyavṛtte dve api pade gṛhyetāṃ, (tataḥ) sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nopapadyate |
tatra prāthamyādvirodhācca traidhā- tavyāpadaṃ mukhyaṃ, dīkṣaṇīyāpadaṃ (tu jaghanyatvāt saṃjāta- virodhaṃ ) ātmīyaṃ krūpakāraṃ lakṣayati |
tasmin lakṣite traidhātavyā vidhīyate (traidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyākāryāriṇī bhavati iti) |
sā ca vidhīyamānā tatkā- ryāpannatvāt taddharmān labhate |
siddhānte'pi yathā salevāvī yūpakārye vidhīyamānā taddharmān (ajñanā- dīn ) labhate |
athocyeta 'traidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' ityanena (vacanena prasiddhāyāḥ ) traidhātavīyāyāḥ yat
kāryaṃ, tat nivārya dīkṣaṇīyākārye (tasyāḥ ) vidhīyate ( nātrāpūrvā naidhātavyā vidhīyate ) |
tacca (dīkṣaṇīyā- kāryaṃ ) ātmīyaiḥ (yathāsiddhaireva ) dharmaiḥ, apūrve ca (ātmīyena upapattyapūrveṇa naidhātavyā ) sādhyayiṣyati, na ( ca ) dīkṣaṇīyādharmāṃn grahīṣyati siddhāntādinaḥ |
( pūrvapakṣe'pi yadi dīkṣaṇīyākāryaṃ yathāsiddhaiva traidhātavyā varteta, tathā sati ātmīyaireva dharmaiḥ tatkāryaṃ sādhyayiṣyati prasiddhadharmakatvāt |
atha na pravartate, sutarāṃ ātmīyā eva dharmastasyāḥ |
api ca paramāpūrvaprayuktayāmāya bāhya- niyamasya prayuktau āgneyavaiṣṇavo viśiṣṭaṃ dvāramabhūt, tacca (dvāraṃ ) iha nāsti |
nanu anena nyāyena nīvāreṣu prokṣaṇaṃ na prāpnoti |
iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ, vrīhayo dṛṣṭe nopakurvanti, nīvārāśca tat (kāryaṃ ) sādhayanto dṛśyante, tatra tatkāryāpekṣayā tadaṃprāptiryuktā |
iha tu adṛṣṭaṃ dvāraṃ, tasmin kārye traidhātavyā vartate iti nāsti pramāṇam |
athavā dūrādevedaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ prayojanam ( iti pūrvoktameva svīkriyate |
kathaṃ ) ? traidhātavyā yādṛśī utpannā, tādṛyeva (atra ) coyate, śabdena (hi ) saiaiva viparivartate |
yadyapi ca karmāntaraṃ ( syāt ), tathāpi nāmnā ( traidhātavīyā- ) dharmān grahīṣyāt, na ca
8|4|12-3, aṣṭakā- liṅgāśca mantrā vede dṛśyante 'yāṃ janāḥ pratinandanti' ityevamādayaḥ |
eṣā hi mukhyā, yā māghyāṃ vṛttā |
tatrāpi pūrvaidhuścāri, aṣṭakāḥ catasraḥ, anyaṣṭakāḥ catasraḥ iti dvādaśa bhavanti |
mārgaśīrṣa- pauṣamāghaphālgunamāsānāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu saptamyaṣṭamīṣu etāni krameṇa bhavanti |
• aṣṭakādhyāyaḥ arthavādāḥ, na tu guṇavidhayaḥ jāteṣṭivākye 'yadaṣṭakāpālo bhavati' ityādi |
tatra ekaṃ caturthaṃ prayājārthaṃ, dvitīyaṃ tu anujājārtham |
vi. 4|1| 15, ‘aṣṭāvupasṛti’ iti ahaṃsaṃkhyākamekaṃ grahaṇaṃ na vidhīyate, kiṃtu catuḥsaṃkhyākamagrahaṇayordvayam |

bhāṭṭa. 5|1| 8, ‘aṣṭāvupasṛti gṛhṇāti’ iti asaṃyuktāni ājyāni prākaraṇikadravyāpekṣakāryārthatvena viniyujyante ‘aṣṭāvupasṛti gṛhṇāti anujājemyastat’ iti baca- nena tatkāryārthatvena viniyogāt aupabhṛtasya anujāja- mātrārthatvam |
yattu ‘aṣṭāvupasṛti gṛhṇāti prayājānu- yājemyastat’ iti vacanaṃ, tatra prayājatvānuyājatvayoḥ ude- śyatā'vacchedakatve vākyabhedāpatteḥ anuyājānāṃ prayājo- ttaratvānuvādamātram |
iti prāpte, ubhayathā'pyanuvādatvā- vaśyakatve samānanyāyādavicchedyārthatvānurodhena śuddhānu- yājavacanasyaivānuvādatvam |
su. pṛ. 66. ‘aṣṭāvupasṛti gṛhṇāti prayājānuyājemya- stat’ itidarśapūrṇamāsayoḥ aupabhṛtaṃ vihitam |
‘athaitasyāṣṭātrasya viśva- jitamiti ekāhī amitaḥ, ubhayatojyotirmadhye ṣaḍahaḥ, paśukāmo hatena yajeta’ |
atra svatantrasya ekāhasya viśvajito dharmāḥ prathame'hani viśvajiti ati- diśyante |
tasmāt sarvasvaṃ deyaṃ iti bhāṣyakārasya matam |
viśvajitiātirikteṣu sasaṣu ahaḥsu codakaprā sarvasvadakṣiṇā vācanīyā, ahargaṇasya ekaiva dakṣiṇā iti daśame vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
sūtrakārastu nāmātideśasya prābalyaprāptimātraṃ nyupāditavān iti draṣṭavyam |
aṣṭārātrasya ahīnasya viśvajit prathamamahaḥ tato- 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ, ( jyotirgaurāyaḥ āyurgauryotiḥ iti |
bhā. 10|1|2|178, 10|8| 1|123. aṣṭātre ‘pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ dvau svarasāmānau’ iti vihite svarasāmānau ananyagatikaliṅgavaśāt gavā- mayanagatasvarasāmnoḥ vikārau bhavataḥ |
tasmin prakṛtibhūtāt ekāhāt viśvajitaḥ vatsavatvaṃ prāptā |
tatra kaupīnārthe vāso yogyaṃ, prāvaraṇe ca tvak yogyā iti ubhayoḥ samuccayaḥ, na prasaṅgaḥ |
bhāṣya— asti ahargaṇe'ṣṭarātraḥ ‘athaitasyāha- rātrasya viśvajitmijitāvekāhāvamitaḥ, ubhayatojyoti- rmadhye ṣaḍahaḥ, paśukāmo hatena yajeta’ iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ ki ahargaṇasyaivāpi sarvasvameva dakṣiṇā syāt, āho- svit dvādaśaśatamiti |
ya eva prakṛtau viśvajito dharmaḥ, sa eva cāsya codakena bhaviṣyati |
ṭup— asminnadhikaraṇe ( bhāṣyokta- ) siddhānta- dūṣaṇam ( ucyate ) |
nahi ahargaṇagataḥ ( viśvajit, ekāhakāṇḍapaṭhitāt- ) viśvajitaḥ codakena nāmadheyena vā dharmān gṛhṇāti |
ratna— gaṇārthatvāt dakṣiṇāyāḥ, gaṇasya ca dvādaśāha- prakṛtitvena taddakṣiṇā prāpnoti |
tadantaḥpātino viśva- jito'pi saiva yuktā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pratikarmāvatsā- yitvāt codakānāṃ, viśvajiti ca nāmnā sarvasvadāne
prāpte mukhyatvanīyasatve sati sarvasvadakṣinaiva deyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
tatra dharmā vihitāḥ viśva- jiti kṛtsnāḥ |
kutaḥ ? naiṣa yato viśvajito guṇe dvādaśaśatam |
tasmāt viśvajito grahīṣyati, na jyotiṣṭomāt iti |
kiṃ liṅgaṃ bhavatīti ? etamāha, ‘hīyate vā eṣa paśubhiryo viśva- jiti sarvasvaṃ na dadāti’ iti niyataṃ sarvasvadānaṃ darśayati ahargaṇe |
dvādaśaṃ ca śataṃ jyotiṣṭomāt tatrāti- vidyate |

prāptaṃ viśvajiti sarvasvaṃ bādhitvā itareṣāṃ satānāmahāṃ dvādaśaśatadakṣiṇāṃ bhūyasāṃ sādhamryāt dvādaśaśatameva deyaṃ, ekaiva ca tantreṇa sarvaiṣā- mekaprayogavartināṃ dakṣiṇā na pṛthakpṛthak pradātavyā |
soma-- ekāhaviśvajiti sarvasvadāne ahargaṇā- ntargate'pi tathā iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu ahargaṇe vidyamāno'pi viśvajit sarvavedasadharmayuktaḥ sarveṣāṃ viśvajitāmaviśeṣāt iti |
tasya viśvajit prathamamahaḥ, tato'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ, tato'bhijit |
tatra viśvajiti prakara- ṇāntarādhikaraṇanyāyena ( 2|3|11 ) karmāntare nāmā- tideśena ekāhāṇḍapaṭhitaviśvajito dharmaḥ sarvasvaṃ, anyeṣu tu gaṇatvāt dvādaśāhato jyotiṣṭomakī dakṣiṇā |
dvādaśāheḍapi ca pratilaghyaṃ medenātideśe'pi prayogatvena kathaikalasya daśame vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
tadānalarthyāḥ dakṣiṇāyā api tantreṇa ādāvante vā deyatvaktau ‘anvahaṃ dvādaśaśataṃ dadāti’ ityanena āvṛttiphalakaḥ anvahakālo vidhīyate |
tena vā dakṣiṇā tantreṇa deyatvena prasaktā, tāṃ pratyahaṃ dadāti iti tadvākyārthaḥ |

tadiha aṣṭārātre nāmātideśa- prāthamyāt viśvajitidharmānugrahātprāptāvapi bhūyo'nugrahasya nyāyatvāt dvādaśaśatasyaiva tantreṇa upakārakatvaprasakteḥ tasyaiva anvahaṃ ityanena āvṛttikaraṇāt dvādaśaśatameva pratyahaṃ deyaṃ iti vārtikakārārāyaḥ |

bhāṣyakārārāyastu aṣṭārātrakaraṇasyaiva ‘hīyate vā eṣa paśubhiryo viśva- jiti na sarvasvaṃ dadāti’ iti ananyathāsiddhaliṅgopa- ṣṭambhaprāmāṇyāt tatkalpyavidhenaiva sarvasvavidhānāt ādya eva sarveṣu ahaḥsu sarvasvaṃ deyamiti |
bhāṣya-- asti aṣṭātro'hīnaḥ : ‘tasya viśvaji- dabhijito agniṣṭomāvamitaḥ, ubhayatojyotirmadhye ṣaḍahaḥ, paśukāmo hatena yajeta’ iti |
viśvajiti ekāhe vatsavatvaṃ paridhānārthatāmānātā ‘aśvatthādudetya vatsavatvaṃ paridhatte’ iti |
tathā pradhānabhūtārthabodhake pratyaye'pi jaghanyatvāt lakṣaṇā ucitā iti bhāvaḥ |
alaṃkāraḥ pṛ. 63. asaṃjāta- virodhini lakṣaṇakatvakalpanāt varaṃ uttarapade tatkalpa- nam |
yathā 'prathamo yajaḥ' ityatra yajñaśabdasya yajñaprayoge lakṣaṇā |
vi. 3|1|17, asaṃjātavirodhitayā prabalasya prathamasyāhaḥ ānuguṇyena āgneyī subrahmaṇyā kāryā pañcadaśarātrasya pratyaye'hani amiśruti iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
1|2|15, asaṃjātavirodhiyupakramānusāraṇa caramaṃ 'pratigrāhayet' iti vidhāyakaṃ padamapi 'pratigrāhayet' ityevaṃ antarbhāvitanirjaraparatayā vyākhyeyam |
3|1|15. asaṃdeśena vikṛtamehāprakaraṇaṃ yathā- yatra vikṛtau prākṛtakriyā'nuvādena kiṃ cid vihitaṃ, tat tatkaraṇena gṛhyate yathā 'prayājeprayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' iti |
ahīnāmakradādaśāhe ca dvādaśa dīkṣāḥ dvādaśopasadaḥ iti dvādaśatvam |
bāla. pṛ. 9, asaṃśeodbhūtakaṃ prakṛtermahāprakaraṇaṃ, yathā darśapūrṇamāsādeḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 140, asaṃndigdhaśrutvā saṃdigdhaśrutidhā yathā āmiṣāyāge vaiśvadevī ityasyedidaṃtpatyā vājivyaḥ iti caturthīpañcamītvena saṃdigdhayāḥ śrutervādhaḥ guṇādhikaraṇe uktaḥ |
su. pṛ. 955. 'asaṃnipātikarmaṇāṃ viśeṣāgrahaṇe kalleka- tvāt sakṛdvacanam |
ye tu asaṃnipātikarmaṇāṃ mantrāḥ, yathā subrahmaṇyā''hvāne 'devā brahmaṇaḥ' iti aupavasathye'hani, teṣāmekakāla- tvāt ajuhlāmāṇāviśeṣaṇāṃ sakṛt vacanaṃ syāt |

'athaiṣa goḥ' iti gośabde asaṃ- baddhapadavyayanyāyena pūrvaitāni viśamāne taduddhau anu- pajjamānāyāṃ prakaraṇavicchede jñāte arthāntaralupitāyāṃ ca buddhau nipatatasaṃjñā'ntarāvigrahaṃ ca jyotiṣṭomaṃ gantumaśaknu- van vicchinnānusaṃdhānāt arthāntare vartate |
tathāhi 'saṃjñā- nadīvyavacchinne yajiḥ pūrvaṃ na gacchati |
na ca pūrvastami- tyevaṃ balādarthāntaraṃ gataḥ |

' (asyārthaḥ:-- 'athaiṣa jyotiḥ, athaiṣa viśvajyotiḥ, athaiṣa sarvajyotiḥ; etena sahasradakṣiṇena yajeta' iti tāṇḍyaśrutau jyotirādayaḥ tisraḥ saṃjñāḥ sahasranadītvena rūpitāḥ, tathā ca saṃjñānāṃ navyā pravāheṇa vyavacchinnaḥ vyavahitaḥ 'yajeta' iti yajiḥ pūrvaṃ jyotiṣṭomaṃ na gacchati, na ca pūrvaṃ jyotiṣṭomaṃ taṃ yajiṃ gacchati anveti |
ityataḥ balāt yajiḥ arthāntaraṃ gataḥ iti |
vā. 2|1|22 pṛ. 529. X asaṃbandhaḥ samatvāt syāt (guṇānāṃ ca parāyatvādasaṃbandhaḥ samatvāt syāt |

3|1|122) iti nyāyena śaktimātraparatve'pi kāntaratvayogaḥ kasmānna bhavati ityāśaṅkya asaṃbandhaḥ samatvāt syāt ityanena nayena śakyateḥ śakyantarāyogāt dravyasya ca ekaśaktivaśīkṛtasya śakyantarāyogāt |
su. pṛ. 1442. ghālyasya vidhisāmarthyāt karaṇatvāvagateḥ sādhyā-
medhātithemeva' ityādiḥ padajātasya avikāreṇa prayoga iti siddhāntaḥ |

tatra ekahāyanīyāmidamāmnāyate 'iyaṃ gaustasyā te krīṇāmi, tasyai ghṛtaṃ, tasyai śaraḥ, tasyai dadhi, tasyai mastu, tasyā ātañcanaṃ, tasyai navanītaṃ, tasyai ghṛtaṃ, tasyā āmikṣā, tasyai vājinaṃ' iti |
tatra 'iyaṃ gaustasyā te krīṇāmi' ityasya sthāne 'ayaṃ sāṇḍastena te krīṇāmi' ityuhe na vivādaḥ |
avaśiṣṭānāma tu 'tasyai ghṛtaṃ' ityādīnāṃ padānāṃ ūho na vā iti saṃśayaḥ |
tatra siddhāntāha, ūha- vacanaṃ tadviśiṣṭaṃ gopadāryaviśiṣṭaṃ pratīyata tadartheṣu gojanya- śrutādipadārtheṣu ekahāyanyā
) bāla. pṛ. 181. ✱ asarvagatatveveva paryāyeṇa sarvatra kāryopalambhasya darśanāt |
su. pṛ. 616. ✱ asādhakaṃ tu tādarthyāt iti nyāyaḥ |
) nanu aphalasya kāmyatvāyogān kāma- śabdopanandhe ' asādhakaṃ tu tādarthyāt ' iti svarga- kāmādhikaraṇasiddhāntanyāyena phalaparo'yaṃ pañcakāmāśabdaḥ ityāśaṅkya |
su. pṛ. 415. ✱ rājā rājasūyena svārājyakāmo yajeta ' ityatra asādhakaṃ0 iti nyāyāt svārājyakāmaḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ |
ratna. 6|1|14. ✱ asā- dhakaṃ tu tādarthyāt ( 6|1|12 ) iti siddhāntasūtraṇa vidhyanyathā'nupapattyā kāmanopanandhyācca svar
so'yaṃ jīvadbhiḥ satribhiḥ saṃvatsare atīte kartavyaḥ |
asthnāmevādhikāraḥ iti kṛtvā- cintayā dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |

bhāṣyam-- idamāmnāyate 'yadi satrāya saṃdīkṣa- tānāṃ pramīyeta taṃ dagdhvā kṛṣṇājine asthīnupanahya yo'sya nediṣṭaḥ taṃ tasya sthāne dīkṣayitvā tena saha yajeran, tataḥ saṃvatsare (atīte-) asthīni yājayeyuḥ' iti yo'yaṃ saṃvatsare yajñaḥ, sa saṃdihyate kim asthinām, uta jīvatāṃ iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? sāmānyādhikaraṇyāt asthnā iti |
nanu asthīni acetanāni na śaknuvanti svayaṃ tantrayitum, kathaṃ tāni kriyāyāṃ kartuṃ bhaveyuriti |
tat : anye prayoja- yitāraḥ, te etāni kriyā kārayiṣyantīti |
yāvat yājamānaṃ kārayituṃ śakyante tāvat kārayiṣyante, audumbarīsamānaṃ śukā- nvārambhaṇaṃ ityemādīni |
āha, pradhānameva na śaknuvanti, nāṅgāni kurvanti yājamānāni bhavantīti |
vacanasāmarthyāt tat śabdadvayaṃ ṛtvijaḥ pratigṛhṇanti, tadakṣitāṇapariṣkṛtītaḥ tat lakṣyanti |
āha, evaṃ varṇyamāne yājayituṇāmeva kartṛtvamupadiṣṭaṃ bhavati nāsthā- miti |
ucyate yatṇameva etena prakāreṇa kartṛtvamupa- diśyate |
hetu- kartṛtvaṃ cāstnāṃ yāge sati prāptamevābhyudyate |
yathā 'grāma- kāmaṃ yājayet' iti grāmakāmo yajeta iti vidhīyate |
tacca darśayati, 'stotrai'sthi- kumbhamupadadhāti' iti asthnāmeva yajamānatvaṃ dṛśyate |
yaduktaṃ 'ṛtvijaḥ śabdadvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇa tatparīkṛtāḥ tyāgaṃ kurvanti, īdṛśo vācanikastyāgo bhavati' iti |
nahi yajeta ityukte aśaknuvatsu vacanaprāmāṇyāt anyo yajño bhavati |
yāgaṃ kurvanti iti hi tadvacanaṃ nānye yajñartha iti |
na ca vacana- prāmāṇyādetad bhavati, yat śabdadvayaṃ tat gṛhyate |
śabdaḥ saṃbadhyate yathā 'gauranuvandhyaḥ' iti gojātiviśiṣṭaḥ paśustanucyate, na vāhīkaḥ |
'gaurayaṃ vāhīkaḥ' iti saṃvāde vāhīke gauṇaḥ pravartate |
na ca asthnāṃ dravyaṃ svaṃ bhavati, yat ṛtvijo gṛhītvā 'vayamena parīkṛtāḥ' iti manyeran |
tasmāt na kathaṃ cana asthīni yajñaṇa bhavanti |
'tataḥ saṃvatsare yājayeyuḥ' ityetāvato vākyāt kaścidyo'- ''sthi- vagamyate, sa iha vivakṣitaḥ |
āha, kiṃ asthīni iti pramādāt ? na na pramādapāṭha iti brūmaḥ |
nahi sa eva apramādapāṭho yo vidhānārtho mukhyārthaḥ |
anuvādannapi arthe lakṣaṇayā'pi bruvan vākye samavāyaṃ gacchati, na ca pramādapāṭho bhavati |
tatra asthīni ityeṣa śabdo vidadhat svamarthaṃ mukhyā vṛttyā bruvan vākye na samaveti |
anu- vadastu lakṣaṇayā samaveṣyati 'tataḥ saṃvatsare yājayeyuḥ' iti jīvataḥ prakṛtān vakṣyati, tatra asthiśabdo vartiṣyate lakṣaṇayā, tataḥ saṃvatsare asthimato yājayeyuḥ iti |
ke te asthimantaḥ ? ye tena saha yayuṃ
tasmāt yasya tāni asthīni, tairasthibhiḥ sa śakyate lakṣayitum |
dup-- yadi pyaurdho vidhīyeta, adṛṣṭaṃ kalpyeta yajantaṃ yājayituḥ kimapi bhavatīti |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ asthnāṃ yājamānaṃ darśayati 'stotre asthikumbhamupadadhāti' iti |
ato vacanaprāmāṇyāt etat karma yājamānasvarūpaṃ bhavati |
yāvati vacane tāvatyeva tanmuvimarhati, na tat sarvaṃ yājamānaṃ śaknoti lakṣayitum |
soma-- pūrvatra dveṣyādvacatvāt asthnāyarthavat iha asthyādavattvāt mṛtādhikāraḥ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
tasmin yāge mṛtādhikāraḥ, uta mṛtavyatiriktānāṃ jīvatāṃ satriṇāmeva adhikāraḥ iti saṃśayaniccharḥ |
satrānna- tvāt phalaṃ siddhānte na kalpanīyaṃ ityuktaṃ tantraratne |
sūtrārthastu- asthīni yājayeyuḥ ityayaṃ yajño jīvatā- mitareṣāṃ asti avirodhāt |
asthnāṃ asthimato, mṛtasya vipratiṣedhāt adhikārasaṃbhavāt iti |
tatra yo'yaṃ asthiyāgaḥ : saṃvatsare, sa kiṃ mṛtādhikāraḥ, uta jīvadadhikāra iti cintāyāṃ, 'etayā niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet' itivat asthnāmevā- dhikārapratīteḥ |
teṣāṃ ca svarūpeṇa tadasaṃbhave'pi tadupa- lakṣita mṛtādhikāraḥ |
na ca tasya kartṛtvāsaṃbhavaḥ, śuknvārambhaṇau asthnāmeva prayojyakartṛtvāpatteḥ |
dravyāgādau ca jīvadadhyāyeva sarvairmaraṇabhāvanā svetareṣāṃ anumatidānāt anumatidvārā kartṛtvāpatteḥ |
anyathā mṛtasthāne ānītena saha satraprayogamātāvapi anumatyabhāvāt tadīyasaṃsṛṣṭadravyāgānānupatteḥ |
yājanaṃ tu satraprayogamāsiktṛbhireva kāryaṃ 'tataḥ saṃvatsare' ityādinā prayogamāsiktājanayoḥ samānakartṛkatvapratīteḥ |
yadi tu tataḥ śabdāt ānantarya- syaiva pratītiḥ, na tu samānakartṛkatvasyāpi iti vibhājyate, tataḥ anya niyamaḥ |
ayaṃ ca naimittiko'pi na satrājñaṃ vibhinnādhikārakatvāt, api tu yatasyaiva svatantra- phalārthaḥ |
ata eva paṣṭhokkarītyā mṛte satraphalāsaṃbhave'pi etaphalatvattu bādhakāmāva ityavadheyam |
iti prāpte, na tāvat asthnāmeva kartṛtvaṃ yāgānukūlakṛtyāśrayatvasya tasya teṣu asaṃbhavāt |
ataśca tasyā'pi tatsaṃbandha- jīvallakṣaṇatayā tasyādhikāro vācyaḥ |
tataśca asthnā jīvadavasthāyāṃ nimittābhāve eva anumatikalpanā phala- kalpanā na ityādyanekadopamiyā varaṃ asthipadena svasaṃ- bandhino jīvata eva puruṣān lakṣyitvā temādhikāraḥ |
kiṃca jīvadavasthāyāṃ anumatyā'pi ki tadantarameva svalpamucyate, uta maraṇottara, nācyaḥ : jīvadavasthāyāṃ tyāgā- nāpatteḥ |
na nānyaḥ, anumateḥ kṣaṇikatvena maraṇottara- khallotyādakatvānupapatteḥ |
ata eva maraṇottarakālīnasatra- prayogasamātāvapi paṣṭhokkarītyā mṛtasya anadhikārāt tadīyaṃ dravyaṃ pṛthakkṛtyaiva svīyadravyairva jīvadbhiḥ prayoga- samāptiḥ kāryā iti dhyeyam |
ataśca anumatikalpa- nāyā api anupapatteḥ mṛtasya kathamapi adhikārasaṃbhavena asthipadena lakṣaṇayā jīvatāmevādhikāraḥ : asthyupanahana- kartṛtvādikaṃ ca śakyasaṃbandhaḥ |
ayaṃ ca asthiyāgo na satrarūpa eva, satyapi pratyabhijñāne yājayeyuḥ iti ṅijanta- prayogavalena karmabhedāvagateḥ |
tatra ca abhyaktasahādhyāt atideśenaiva ṛtvikprāpteḥ : anuvāda eva |
evaṃ dīkṣaṇīyāyā api dīkṣopyarthatvāt, dīkṣāyāśca yamanīyamaparihānukūladṛṣṭarūpatvāt yamanīyamathaśca mana- ādisādhyayoḥ tadyodhinā'rthoyaśca tadabhāve lopāt dīkṣaṇīyāderapi lopaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- santi asthiyajñe darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtikāni codakaprāptāni prāyaṇīyā'dīni, teṣu codakaprāptaḥ sūkta- vākaḥ |
‘ yadi satrāya saṃdīkṣitānāṃ ( kaścit ) pramīyeta, taṃ dagdhvā kṛṣṇājine asthīnyupanahya, voḍasva nediṣṭaḥ ; taṃ tasya sthāne dīkṣayitvā tena saha yajeran |

dup— 'patnīsaṃyājāntānyahāni saṃtiṣṭhante' itya- viśeṣaśravaṇāt sarveṣāṃ patnīsaṃyājāntā |
nanu gamyate viśeṣaḥ 'asaṃsthito hi tarhi yajñaḥ' iti, yatrāsaṃkhyā tatra patnīsaṃyājāntā, anye ca (ahani) saṃtiṣṭhate |
na, vacanāt sarveṣāṃ (patnīsaṃyājāntā) prāpyamāṇā, vacanāntareṇa vinā kathaṃ viśeṣāvasthāpayitum |
yaduktaṃ hetusāma- rthyāt yatra asaṃsthā, tatra patnīsaṃyājāntateti |
hetuvacanaṃ patnīsaṃyājāntāstulyathai bhaviṣyati cireṇa saṃkhyāmāletya iti |
(yo hi cireṇa saṃtiṣṭhate, saḥ asaṃ- sthita iva bhavati iti |
tasmāt lāghavārthe patnīsaṃyājāntaṃ kṛtvā śiṣṭaṃ luptyatām |
tena uttamamahaḥ patnīsaṃyājāntaṃ kṛtvā avabhṛādīnyeva kartavyāni, na tu hāriyojanaparyantaṃ ahaḥśeṣaṃ kartavyamiti |
liṅgaṃ bhavati, 'patnīsaṃyājāntānyahāni saṃtiṣṭhante, na barhirgrahaprahati, asaṃsthito hi tarhi yajñaḥ' iti yasminnahani asaṃsthito yajñaḥ, tasmin patnīsaṃyājāntaṃ darśayati |
api ca yeṣvahaḥsu patnīsaṃyājāntā, teṣvasaṃsthā dṛśyate kīryamānā |
asaṃsthāṃ ca prāguttamāt dṛṣṭvā prāguttamādeva patnīsaṃyājāntāmavagamyate |
anuvādo vā dīkṣā, yathā narkasaṃsthāpa- nasya |
yaduktaṃ, 'yeṣu patnīsaṃyājāntā, teṣvasaṃsthā dṛśyate, tasmādasaṃsthāyāḥ prāguttamādahanāṃ patnī- saṃyājāntā nicchyāmḥ' iti, naitadevam |
yadetat 'asaṃsthito hi tarhi yajñaḥ' iti, arthavāda eva patnīsaṃyājāntā- stutyarthaḥ |
yathā, dīkṣnomocanavacanaṃ narkasaṃsthāpanasyā- rthavādaḥ, evametat draṣṭavyam |
anunmuktaḥ sa varuṇapāśābhyāṃ, na tāvadīkṣyā mucyate |
bahavo niyamāstadānīṃ visa- jyante, yānālocya eṣa vādo bhavati |
kathaṃ tarhi ? sāmānyena, patnīsaṃyājāntya- hāni bhavanti |
kā punaryāyena prāptiriti ? 'patnīsaṃyājāntyahāni saṃti- ṣṭhante' iti |
teṣu saha kriyamāṇedhvahaḥsu, avadayaṃ kasmiṃścit padārthe avaśyamavaśyamaparasyāhanaḥ padārthā anuṣṭhātavyāḥ |
tasyāvasthānasya etat prayojanaṃ, kathamaharantarasya padārthā- nuṣṭhānena yaugapadyamanubhūyeteti |
yasmin naitad dṛṣṭaṃ, na śakyaṃ kalpayituṃ tatrāgraham |
tasmāt prāgantyāt patnīsaṃyājāntateti nyāyena prāpte liṅgadarśanaṃ 'asaṃsthito hi tarhi yajñaḥ' iti |
tatra 'saṃkhyayā karmedaḥ' (2|1| 7|21) iti nyāyena dvādaśa yāgā ete |
ahaḥśabdaḥ (yājayet iti ) yāgasāmānādhikaraṇyāt yāgaṃ (eva ahaḥsaṃjñatvāt) ahaḥ (ityanena) bravīti |
prakṛtau (jyotiṣṭome) ahaḥśabdena upāṃśvādihāriyojana- paryanto yāgaḥ paricchinnaḥ |
(tatra) dvādaśa yāgāḥ (saha) phale coditatvāt cahaiva kartavyāḥ |
teṣāṃ ā amīṣomīyāt yā itikartavyatā (abhidhau ākāraḥ |
agnīṣomīya- paryantā yā purastāditikartavyatā), sā ahyahamāna- viśeṣatvāt tantreṇa kartavyā |
ye (tu madhyasthāḥ) saṃnipatyopakārakāḥ (padārthāḥ adyayajyamā- sādayaḥ), ye ca tanmadhyapatitaḥ ārādupakārakāḥ sava- nīyādayaḥ) te āvartante |
(tatra) sahaprayogāt (prayogavacanāt) kasmiṃścit sthitvā dvitīyādiṣu ahaḥsu pravartitavyam |
tatra anye uttarasya yāgasya (kartavyasya) abhāvāt avasthānaṃ nāstyeva aniyamena |
na ca etadeva vākyaṃ (patnīsaṃyājāntāni ityādi) ka cinnimamaparaṃ, ka cidapūrvavidhinir (bhavitumarhati) vivakṣāmedāt |
api ca yasya niyamārthe (vacanaṃ), tasya dṛṣṭo'rthaḥ |
' patnīsaṃyājāntāni sarvāṇi ahāni kṛtvā hāriyojanādyahaḥśeṣaṃ tantreṇa sarveṣāmupari- ṣṭhāt anuṣṭheyam |
siddhānte dvirātrādiṣu dvādaśāhikāreṣu yadanyamahaḥ dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vā, tat prakṛtau patnīsaṃyājāntamapi anu- ṣṭhitaṃ uhitvā sakalamanuṣṭhīyate |

tatra agnīṣomīyāntāni pūrvāṇyaṅgāni ava- bhṛthādīni uttarāṅgāni ca tantreṇānuṣṭhīyante |
