na ca asaṃsthāyāḥ patnīsaṃyājāntatve hetutvabhāvāt tasya uttamamajatve sattvena tatraiva patnīsaṃyājāntatvāgatiḥ |
etasya 'tena ahnaḥ kriyate' itivat hetvarthavādatvena ahetutvāt |
na ca tarhi tenaiva 'akkāḥ śarkarāḥ' itivat nirṇayaḥ, tadat iha saṃdigdhatvācca tasya ani- ṇāṃyakatvāt, pratyudeyaṃ guṇasya āvaśyakatvena aviśeṣa- pravṛttavidheḥ arthavādena saṃkocānupapatteśca |
ataśca artha- vādo'pi bahudinasādhyatvāt cirasaṃsthābhiprāyeṇa gauṇyā vṛttyā vyākhyeyaḥ |
nanu— vidhiraiva svasya niyamavidhilāghavaanurodhena uttamabhinaviṣayatvena pratīyate |
tathāhi, dvādaśānāmapi ahnāṃ ekaphalasādhanatvāt prayogaikyaṃ avagamyate, ata eva agnīṣomīyāntapadārthānāṃ tantreṇa karaṇaṃ, avabhṛthā- yānāṃ ca brāhmaṇatarpaṇāntānām |
ata eva tanmadhyavartinī saṃnipatyopakārakāṇi ārādupakārakāṇi ca aṅgāni prati- sulyamāvartante iti vakṣyate |
evaṃ ca ekaikaṃ ahaḥ yasmin kasmiṃścinnema samāpya aparaṃ aharārambhaṇīyam |
iti prāpte, patnīsaṃyājāntatvavidheḥ ekādaśasu niyamavidhiḥ saṃpadyate, antime tu sarvasyaiva samāpanīyatvāt patnī- saṃyājāntatvavidhiḥ apūrvavidhiḥ āpadyeta |

ataśca sarvā- rthatve apūrvavidhiniyamavidhivikṛtavai rūpyāpatteḥ niyama- vidhilāghavānurodhena uttamavarja ayaṃ vidhiḥ iti cet, dvādaśasaṃkhyā'nurodhena ahaḥśabdavyāvahāriyojanānta- prayogasyaiva āvartanīyatvena tanniṣṭhāṅge yasminkasmiṃścit samāpanasyaiva prasaktau sarvatraiva, apūrvavidhitvāt |
patnī- saṃyājānāṃ hāriyojanottarameva sarvādhvaryuśāstrāmānena patnī- saṃyājānāmapi avamṛthādivat tantreṇa anuṣṭheyatvāt, te
oṃ ahargaṇe sutyākālīnasubrahmaṇyā''hvānasya abhiṣṭome 'kṛṣṇaviṣāṇyā kaṇḍūyati' iti dikṣi- |
bhāṣyaṃ--tasminneva dvādaśāha tatkālā yā subrahmaṇyā, śāhe viśāṇāyāḥ prāsanaṃ tyāgaḥ |
kutaḥ ? prayogaṃ prati tasyā ahani kartavyaṃ iti vikalpaḥ syāt |
yukte śvaḥ paraśvo veti nokto bhavati |
tatrāpi ca tyajeta, tadā dvitīyādiṣu ahaḥsu dakṣiṇāyananāt |
prācīnā ye padārthāḥ, teṣāṃ viśāṇāyā, kaṇḍūyanaṃ nāma |
atha anye ahani eva niyamena tyajeta, |
bhāṣyaṃ--iti cet paśyasi 'adya' iti viśeṣa- tadā pūrvaiṇamahā dakṣiṇāyanottaraṃ ye padārthāḥ, teṣāṃ haste |
kutaḥ ? yataḥ kaṇḍūyanaṃ nāma dharmo bādhyate |
yadyapi adyaśabdārtho na vivakṣitaḥ tathāpi yasminnahani sminnahargaṇe viśāṇāyā kaṇḍūyanaṃ niyameta |
tadyathā, 'aṣṭāvaccuttare vihāre havīṃṣyā- savanāni bahūni madhye yasya saḥ prātaḥsavanamadhyaḥ aha- |
ityottarerhakāriṇādhvaryuṇā deśamedāt mārutā nopa- śiṣṭe avaśiṣṭe ca dakṣiṇāyanottarakāle'pi uttarayoḥ |
yathā tāni deśabhedādupakurvanti, evamidamapi savanayoḥ viśāṇāyāaiva kaṇḍūyanaṃ syāt |
ekasmin ahani āhūtā prāsanaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
tasyāḥ ahargaṇe sarveṣāmahaḥ ṛjīpaḥ avabhṛthe pratipāda- |
saṃskṛtasya na punaḥ karmaṇi saṃskāraḥ : ekasya kriyate iti |
ṣāmahaḥ yat tatra tat sarvaṃ aviśeṣāt avabhṛthe apsu |
bhāṣyaṃ--atha kaścit brūyāt, iha dvādaśāhiko saṃmārgādīnām |
tasmādadyadānenāpi tathā bhavi- bhāṣyaṃ--iti yaduktaṃ, yathā agredādhānaṃ sarvakarmaṇi |
kṛtsno'nyo vidhiḥ punaḥ prayujyate abhipavapyamānagraha- bhāṣyaṃ--naitādādhanena tulyam |
svakāle hi tat kriyate, tatra na gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ |
tatra vasatīvarīvadā sakṛt syāt, idaṃ punaḥ karmakālamāhvānam |
stotrādivā bahukṛtvaḥ kṛtaṃ syāt, tatra bahukṛtvaḥ kṛta- tadarthamiti gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣam |
na ca amīṣṭomīyakāle anuṣṭhitasya aṅgānādi- mīgāre praviśya subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyāmāhvayeti preṣyati' |
saṃskārasyāpi tadapavargo apavargaḥ syāt iti vācyam |
ajñānāderna na yūpagatatvāt tato, kiṃtu yūpasvarūpa- hvānam |
tatra yūpaparvavidhiyānāt paśutrayasyāpyekaḥ, iti taddhi tatheti cet |
iha tu āhvānasya dvāraṃ bhāṣyaṃ--tadityanena yūpāhṛtiṃ pratinirdiśati |
ityatra pramāṇā- taddhi yūpāhṛtikarma yathā yūpaikādaśinyāṃ tantraṃ bhavati, taye- |
bhāvāt yasminnahani asau anuṣṭhīyate, tadapavargaṃ pratyahaṃ damapi bhaviṣyati |
kiṃ tasya cāsya ca sādṛśyam ? tat |
vi-- ' sutyākālīnamāhvānaṃ tantraṃ syād bhidyate- raṇasyāntikasya durlabhatvāt |
bhāṭṭa--sutyākālīnasubrahmaṇyā''hvānaṃ tu ahargaṇe gṛhya- kasya cit saulasya karmaṇo'ntike kriyamāṇaṃ sarvārthe |
na ca prakṛtau sutyāyā eka- bhāṣyaṃ--naitena tulyam |
tvāt adyetyasya avivakṣitārthatvaṃ, 'sutyāmāgaccha' nātra yūpāntike homaḥ : śiṣṭe |
ityanenaiva sutyākāle āgamanaprakāśanopapatteḥ adyeti āhvayanīyapratiṣedhārthametadiyuktam ' itarapratiṣedho vā, |
padasya vaiyarthyamidheya sutyādītyevamabhyāsena abhyu- ( 11|12|27 ) aśāstratvācca deśānām |
medāt avaśyapaṭhanīyatvādyena sutyā''ntaradinānāṃ prakāśa- kālabhedāt gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣasya āhutyā bhavitavyamiti |

na ca savanīyādyapūrvāṇāṃ tattattutyā'''pūrvopayogitāyā tadupattau apavageṇa prasaṅgasiddhayanupapatteḥ āvṛttyupapattā- vapi prakṛte devatāyā ekatvāt sakṛdāhānasaṃskṛtāyā eva prasaṅgena sarvopakārakalpopapatteḥ kathamāvṛttiriti vācyam |
āhvānasya svarūpeṇāvidyamānatayā devatā- smaraṇamātrarūpasya dṛṣṭopakārasya tatkālameva nāśāt tadāhitasaṃskārasyāpi pradhānakālīnadevatāsmaraṇena nāśāt prasaṅgānupapatteḥ |
ata eva yatra pāśukradevatā'''vāhanaprakāśa- janyasaṃskārasya anaśaḥ hṛdayadādiyāgīyadevatāsmaraṇasya bhāvitvāt, tatra mavatyeva paśupuroḍāśe prasaṅgaḥ |
na ca uttarasmaraṇasyaiva pūrvajñānajanitasaṃskāranāśakatvasya loka- klṛptatayā vapāyāgīyadevatāsmaraṇenaiva tasya nāśāt, kathaṃ prasaṅga iti vācyam |
tathālye uttamaprayājīyadevatāsma- raṇenaiva tasya nāśe āhvānasya pradhānopakārakatvānupapatteḥ |
ato'''vadyaṃ tajjanyasaṃskāratvāvacchinnaṃ prati pradhānatvāvacchi- nīyadevatāsmaraṇasya nāśakatvam |
avacchinnatvaṃ ca paryāptisaṃbandheneti na vapāyāgīyadevatāsmaraṇena tannāśa iti yuktaḥ prasaṅgaḥ |
bhāṣya-- jyotiṣṭomaṃ prakṛtya samāmananti 'tisra eva sāptadaśyasadaḥ, dvādaśāhīnasya' iti|
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ dvādaśopasattvaṃ jyotiṣṭome, uta ahīne iti|
dakṣiṇayā kratukaraṇairvā phalena vā na hīyate|
vā-- na adhyāyādau yāvānarthaḥ pratijñātaḥ sa sarvaḥ parvatisaḥ|
' tatra prakaraṇasya tāvat śrutiliṅgāvākyaiḥ saha virodhāvirodhau saṃpradhāryate (3|6|6 ityadhikaraṇa- ntena granthena)|
jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'tisra eva sāptadaśyasadaḥ kāryāḥ dvādaśāhīnasya' iti|
tatra sāhasaśabdena tāvat ahā samāpyāmānatvāt sahaiva ahā saṃstāpayanti ityevaṃ jyotiṣṭomo gṛhyate iti nyupasattvaṃ tasya|
'dvādaśā- hīnasya' iti tu dvādaśopasattvaṃ kiṃ jyotiṣṭomasya, atha ahīnasya dvādaśāhadeḥ iti saṃdihyate|
yadi ahīnaśabdaḥ kathaṃ cit jyotiṣṭome'pi upapadyate, tataḥ prakaraṇasya avirodhāt tasminneva niveśaḥ|
atha ahīna iti ahargaṇanāmadheyaṃ, tataḥ śrutyā saṃbhuktatvāt asaṃyukta- grahaṇasvabhāvena prakaraṇe agrahaṇam|
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? siddhāntena upakramaṃ vāśabdena vyāvartaṃ prakaraṇaṃ jyotiṣṭomārthatvaṃ iti prati- jānīmahe|
na ca śrutivirodhaḥ; prakaraṇādeva ahīnaśabda- syāpi jyotiṣṭomagāmitvāt|
ato yadyapi 'ahaḥ khaḥ ṛtusamūhe' (grāmajanabandhuvyastal pā0 4|2|43 sūtre 'ahaḥ khaḥ kratau' vārtikamupanyastam|
si. kaumudyāṃ tu 'ahaḥ khaḥ kratau' iti vārtikamupanyastam|
hādhikāraḥ anuṣṭupa eva) ityevaṃ nyupādyamānaḥ aha- rgaṇavācī ahīnaśabdo bhavati, tathāpi virodhaparihārārthe ahīnaguṇayogādeva jyotiṣṭomārthaḥ samarthanīyaḥ|
sa hi kṛtsnavidhānāt sarvaprakṛtitvācca na kutaścit hīyate|
na cainaṃ ke cidapi ṛtavaḥ prakṛtitvena jahati|
yattu bhāṣya- kāreṇoktaṃ 'dakṣiṇayā kratukaraṇairvā na hīyate' iti, tadasaṃbaddham|
tasmāt vidhvantādanena ayaṃ na kaṃ cinjahāti, kena cidvā na hīyate iti ahīnaḥ|
prakaraṇasāmarthyāt anena guṇayogena ucyate iti gauṇaḥ, na gauṇatvavyāśrayaṇāt|
apica vyapadeśo bhavati 'tisra eva sāptadaśyasadau dvādaśāhīnasya' iti|
yadi anyaḥ sāhaḥ anyaśca ahīnaḥ, tata evaṃ vyapadeśo'va- kalpate|
ahīnaśabdasaṃyoge na tu tasya kathaṃ cana |
asaṃyogācca tenāsya yā saṃkhyā tena saṃgatā|
na sā prakaraṇāt tasya tenāsmādapa- kṛṣyate|
yadi tāvat gauṇa iti upacārāt pravṛtto'bhidhīyate, tato na prakaraṇānurodhena arthaparyavasāne yuktaḥ|
na cedaṃ arthavādārthaṃ, yena ekāhe'pi praśastaṃ ahargaṇavadupa- caryate|
na cāsya śabdāntaraṃ nāsti, yena siṃhaguṇasamūha iva kleśena pratipādyate|
na ca nañsamāsena avayavavyutpattiḥ; samudāya- prasiddhyā tannirākaraṇāt|
na ca nañsamāsasya lakṣaṇa- (tatpuruṣe tulyārtha0 pā0 6|2|2 iti sūtreṇa) ānu- dāttatvaṃ syāt|
tathāhi sati 'āyanādiṣu upadeśādcchan svarasiddhayarthe' ityevaṃ īnādeśo āśrīya- māṇe pratyayāyudāttatvena īkāre svaraḥ sidhyati|
apica sāhasaśabdena dvādaśasaṃba- ndhe'pi akalpyamāne ahīnapadopādānāt asya śāstrasya arthāntaravācitvaṃ vijñāyate|
prakaraṇāt tridvādaśāhayoḥ saṃbandhe labdhe dvāpi sāhāhīnaśabdau syātām|
tataśca ānantyāt tritvasyāpi tatsaṃbandhaḥ prasajyate eva, iti vyavasthā'thai sāhagrahaṇamapi arthavat|
(evaṃ yathābhāṣyaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vyākhyāya svābhiprāya- māha--) na tu kila etadyuktam|

paraprakaraṇe anyadharma- vidheḥ anyārthyatvāt, tena vā asaṃnaddhapadadvayavyāviccha- nnasya prakaraṇasya punaranusaṃdhānakleśāt, dvādaśopasattaḥ iti ca dvādaśāhaprakaraṇe vihitatvāt, tatprakṛtitvena sarvāhī- neṣu tavyate|
ataḥ tritvameva asmin vākye sarvadoṣa- rahitatvāt vidhīyate, dvādaśatvaṃ tu ahīnasaṃndhivākyā- ntarādeva prāptaṃ aucityarūpeṇa asya stutyarthe nivītādi- vat anudyate iti|
' eta- duktaṃ bhavati, kiṃ jyotiṣṭomaḥ ahīnaḥ; tasya cedaṃ pra- karaṇādvidhīyate, atha ahargaṇaḥ; tasya ca prāptameva anyārthamanudyate iti|
nanu evaṃ sati ahargaṇasaṃbandhamapi etajjyotiṣṭomasya stutyarthamupayuktaṃ, iti prakaraṇavirodha- vicārābhāvāt prāpnoti|
pūrvapakṣe hi dvāda- śatvasya vidhīyamānasya prakaraṇaṃ grāhakaṃ bhavati ityanu- gṛhyate|
siddhānte tu ahargaṇasaṃyukttasya prakaraṇaṃ neṣṭaṃ iti bādhyate|
anyannu tat, yat tathā satyapi prakārāntareṇa prakaraṇe etadupayuktamiti|

yadā tu dvitvabahutvanyāyena (3|1|9) utkarṣo'pi kathaṃ cidāśrayīta, śālā'- ntaravidhau ca satyapi śālā'ntarasya prayojanāntararahi- tasya vidhitvamupapadyate, tadā yathābhāṣyameva śakyaṃ samartha- yitum|
sarvathā 'dvādaśāhīnasya' ityetat tāvat aha- rgaṇaviṣayatvāt prakaraṇāt utkṛṣyate iti siddham|
rūḍhiścet dvirātrādau sā ca yogād balīyasī |
tatrāpi yaugikatvaṃ cet satreṇaiva saṃprayo- gataḥ|
' soma-- adhyāyādyasūtrapratijñātārthamaye antyasya nirūpaṇaṃ idānīṃ prāptāvasara iti avasarasaṃgatiḥ|
'tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyetisaptamyupamānāvyayadvitīyākṛ- tyā' ityanena sūtreṇa (pā0 6|2|2) tatpuruṣe samāse avya- yādīnāṃ pūrvapadabhūtānāṃ prakṛtisvaratvaṃ vidhīyate|
prakṛti- svaratvaṃ nāma teṣāṃ samāsābhāvadaśāyāṃ yaḥ svaraḥ; samāse- 'pi tatsvaratvam|

tataścātra avyayasya nañaḥ pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvaratve tasya 'nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' 'upasargāścā- mivarja' ityudāttatvāt samāse'pi evaṃdoṣāt it- ratvaṃ tu sarvasya 'anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' (pā0 6|1| 158) ityanudāttatvaṃ iti ahīnapadaṃ ādyudāttaṃ syāt|

nanu 'ādyudāttaśca' ityanena sūtreṇa pratyayāṃśasaṃni- yogena vidhīyamānādyudāttatvaṃ antaḥsthatvāt īnādeśāt pūrvameva bhavati, tataśca khapratyayānte antodāttatvameva syāt, na mayodāttatvaṃ ( iti cenna ) 'āyaneyīnīyaḥ' ityādiṣatrukvihitā ādeśā ye āyanādayaḥ teṣu (āyanādiṣudeśādcchan
so'syāstīti upadeśī, upadeśinā tulyaṃ vikṛtitvāt enamapekṣamāṇā na jahati |
tataśca upadeśivat iti vacanaṃ nañsamāsaḥ, tathātve tasya tatpuruṣatvāt 'tatpuruṣe tulyārtha- kartavyaṃ svarasiddhaye ityevaṃ īnādeśasyāpi upadeśi- tṛtīyāsaptamyupamānāparvadvitīyayākṛtāḥ ' |

iti smṛtyā yadvāvānuśāsanena pratyayopadeśatve evopadeśiprāyāt ' prakṛtyā pūrvapadaṃ ' ityanuvṛttisahitayā avyayākhya- pratyayasaṃśapraścitadaśāyāmeva īnādeśasya satvāt tatsaṃjñā- nañpūrvapadasya udāttākhyaprakṛtisvaravidhānāt ādyudātta- saṃniyogena vidhīyamānamapi udāttatvaṃ īkārasya bhavati tvāpatteḥ |
apitu madhyodāttāt ' ahaḥ svaḥ kratau ' iti yuktaṃ ( ahīnaśabdasya ) madhyodāttatvamiti
pauṇḍarīke iti samudāyaśabdena samudāyāni ahāni upalakṣya dakṣiṇā guṇe vidhīyamānaḥ pratipradhānaṃ midhyeta |
gavāmayutaṃ aśvasahasraṃ ceti dakṣiṇā sarvasya ekādaśa- rātrasya pauṇḍarīkasya syāt, na pratyaham |
ekaṃ ca tat karma ca eka- karma tādṛśatvāt |
kriyate iti karma, ekaṃ karma kāryaṃ ṛtvigānarūpaṃ yāsāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ tāḥ ekakarmāṇaḥ, ekakarmaṇaṃ bhāvaḥ aikakamyaṃ tasmāt iti vigrahaḥ |
dakṣiṇānāṃ aikakamyāt sarvasya ekaiva dakṣiṇā iti siddhāntaḥ |
pauṇḍarīke avāmayutaṃ aśvasahasraṃ ceti dakṣiṇāparasya guṇasya śāstraṃ ahaṃ ekādaśānāṃ syāt, pratyahaṃ
'sarvatra tu bodhite padārthe vākyārthaḥ upapadyate nānyathā|
sāmānyena abhi- pravṛttānāṃ padārthānāṃ yat viśeṣe avasthānaṃ, sa vākyārthaḥ|
tadetaduktaṃ ' tadbhūtanāṃ kriyārthena samāmnāyo'rthasya tannimittatvāt ' iti (1|1|25|
tadetadavagamyatāṃ, kevalasyārthasya padaṃ anupadeśakaṃ, iti padāntareṇa saṃni- hitena ekavākyatvamabhyupetya, nānyatheti|
bhā. 3|1|12 pṛ. 688-89. ākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ saṃnidhānama- kāraṇaṃ bhavati |
yathā ' bhāryā rājaḥ puruṣo devadattasya ' iti|
ekasmin vākye tadavayavabhūtasyānvayasya naiva bhavati saṃncayaḥ|
yathā ' aśvena vrajati śvetena paṭenāśvataḥ ' iti|
bhā. 6|4|123 pṛ. 1443. ākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ ākāṅkṣāpūraṇasamarthe jñātasaṃnivapadaṃ ekadeśaviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati |
ṛju. pṛ. 71. ākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ (grahaṃ saṃmārtha iti evam ) vivakṣayeta |
sā ca upādīyamāneṣu ākāṅkṣā upajāyate noddiṣyamāneṣu |
uddiṣyamāne hi prāti- padikādisaṃbandhamātrāpekṣatvāt na saṃkhyā''kāṅkṣā pramāṇā- ntarādeva vijñātasaṃttvāt |
su. pṛ. 525. ākāṅkṣāpūrvakaḥ saṃbandho bhavati sarvatraiva |
vā. 2|1|13 pṛ. 409. ākāṅkṣā'- bhāve padārthasya mananusāreṇa saṃkocaḥ ayuktaḥ |
mantro hi anuṣṭhānakāle padārthasya prakāśanaṃ padārthaśeṣaḥ |
vā. 3|1|14 pṛ. 829. ākāṅkṣā-yogyatā-saṃnidhānāni ākāṅkṣāmaha- vākhye anvitābhidhāne prayojakāni, na śabdopāttatva- mapi |
tathātve śabdānabhihitasya prākṛtopakārakasya vaikṛtavidhinā anvitābhidhānābhāvaprasaṅgāt (prābhākara- rotyedam ) |
pūrvapratīte ca uttaramātmānuguṇaṃ adhikaṃ vā ākāṅkṣati |
vā. 3|1|12 pṛ. 806. arthasaṃvandhe hi yasyāt arthākāṅkṣā hetuḥ noparjanatā anupasarjanatā vā, ' kasya gurukulaṃ ' ityevamādiṣu darśanāt |
kasya guru- kulaṃ ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ gurukulaviśeṣaṇeḥ devadattādibhiḥ saṃbandhadarśanāt devadattasya iti |
ākāṅkṣā iti ekena hi nirākāṅkṣīkṛtaḥ netaro ākāṅkṣiṣyati |
ekena ca saṃvaddho nānyatho bhavati, tasmāt netaro ākāṅkṣati |
bhā. 2|1|16|18 pṛ. 457, kartavyasa iti kartavyatā''kāṅkṣasya vacanaṃ prakaraṇam |
kathaṃ ityanugrahopāyākāṅkṣaṇaṃ ākāṅkṣā iti ṣaṣṭhantaṃ vyākhyāyate |
yadvā itikarta- vyatāmākāṅkṣati iti itikartavyatā''kāṅkṣa bhāvā- pūrvayoreva ekam |
etaduktaṃ bhavati, vasturūpeṇa vidhimānā'pi ākāṅkṣā na prakaraṇaṃ ityabhidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi pratīyamānā |
sā'pi ca kartavyatā''pauruṣatvena gṛhyamāṇā, na svātantryena |
tena ākāṅkṣā abhidhīyamānā prakaraṇaṃ ākāṅkṣāvatī vā bhāvanā iti draṣṭavyam |
sā ca bhāvaśabdebhyaḥ prasarpantī dṛśyate, na dravyaguṇaśabdebhyaḥ |
2|1|12 pṛ. 376. ākāṅkṣasya saṃnidhau parastāt purastāt pari- pūraṇasamarthaḥ śrūyamāṇo vākyaśeṣo bhavati |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 71 ākāṅkṣitavidhānaṃ nyāyaḥ iti nyāyaḥ |
ākāṅkṣitameva vidhātyaṃ, na anākāṅkṣitaṃ iti nyāyārthaḥ |
' yat mīmāṃsakaiḥ uktaṃ " jñānajaṃḍhe ' kartari kṛt ' iti vyākaraṇaṃ śaktigrāhakam " iti tadapi āpātaḥ |

yathā hi vatsaśabdo gotvamanabhidhāyaiva gotvopalakṣitaṃ vayoviśeṣamabhidhāti, yathā vā kiśoraśabdaḥ aśvatvamanabhidhāyaiva aśvatvo- palakṣitameva vayoviśeṣamabhidhatte, yathā vā ācāryaśabdaḥ upanayanādhyāpanādikamanabhidhāyaiva tadupalakṣitaṃ brāhmaṇa- vyaktimabhidhatte, tathā gavādiśabdā api anabhidhayā- meva ākṛtimupalakṣaṇīkṛtya vyaktimabhidhasyantīti sarvatra vyaktivācitvameveti |
bhavedevaṃ yadi anavagatāyāmākṛtau gavādiśabdebhyo vyaktivagamaḥ prakārāntareṇopayeta |
nahi anantāsu vyaktiṣu ekasyo- palakṣaṇasyānavagame vyaktivagamaḥ saṃbhavati |
tadatromaya- gamasyāvaśyaṃ svīkāre kimākṛtimātraṃ śabdenābhidhīyate taddvāreṇa anantā vyaktayaḥ pratīyantāṃ, ākṛtimeva vā prakārāntaropasthitāmupalakṣaṇīkṛtya anantā
13|9| 30 pṛ. 295, ākṛtivacana: śabda: tattva- caritāṃ vyaktiṃ lakṣayati |
ākṛtiśca yadyapi aṅgabhāvena śrūyate, tathāpi na sākṣāt tasyā: kriyāṃ prati aṅgabhāva: |
yacca kriyāsādhanaṃ dravyaṃ arthā- daṅgabhūtaṃ prāptaṃ, tat paricchindantī kriyāyāmaṅgabhāvaṃ yāti, vyakteśca ākṛtyā viśeṣa: paricchidyate, te viśeṣa: aṅgabhūtā: |
bhā. 6|1|12|27, gośabda: bahuluka- uccarita: śrutapūrvaśca govyaktiṣu anyavyatirekābhyāṃ ākṛtivacanamavagamayiṣyati |
bhā— atha gaurityasya śabdasya ko'rtha: ? sāsnādiniśiṣṭā ākṛti: iti brūma: |
nanu ākṛti: sādhyā asti vā na veti |
rucaka: svastiko vardhamānaka: svarṇālaṃkārā ete iti hi pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate |
nāsati pratyayaviparyāsai vyāmoha iti śakyate vaktum |
asatyapi arthāntare evaṃjātīyako bhavati pratyaya: paṅkti: yūyaṃ vanaṃ iti yathā iti cet |
pratyakṣameva ākṣipyate vṛkṣā api na santīti |
yadi evaṃ, pratyukta: sa māhāyānika: pakṣa: |
atha kiṃ ākṛtichadmavāvī upālabhyate, siddhāntāntaraṃ te duṣyati iti, vane'pi asati vanapratyaya: prāpnotīti |
evamapi prakṛtaṃ dūṣayituṃ aśaknuvata: tatsiddhāntaradūṣaṇe nigraha- sthānamāpadyate, asādhakatvāt |
sa hi vakṣyati, duṣyatu, yadi duṣyati, kiṃ tena duṣṭena aduṣṭena vā |
prakṛtaṃ tvayā sādhitaṃ bhavati ( kiṃ ) madīyo vā pakṣo duṣṭito bhava- tīti ( kiṃ ? nobhayamapi iti ) |
na ca vṛkṣavyatiriktaṃ vanaṃ yasmāt upalabhyate, ato vanaṃ nāsti ityavagamyate |
yadi vane anyena hetunā sañjātamapi pratyaya: |
utpa- dyate mithyaiva vanapratyaya iti, tato vanaṃ nāstītyava- gacchāma: |
atha vanādiṣu naiva viparyati, na te na santīti |
ata upapannaṃ jaimini- vacanaṃ ākṛti: śabdārtha iti |
yathā ca ākṛti: śabdārtha:, tathā upariṣṭāt (1|3|9|33) nipuṇataraṃ upa- pādiṣyāma: iti |
bṛhatī — 'atha gaurityasya śabdasya ko'rtha:,' ( bhāṣyaṃ ) iti nāyaṃ praśna upapadyate |
abhidheye tu na kaścit viśeṣa: ākṛtirvyaktirguṇo vā bhavatu, nahi autpāttikatve kaścit virodha: |
asyārthī cāyaṃ pakṣa: ( ākṛtiguṇavyaktīnāṃ abhidheyatā ityevarūpa: ) |
nāyaṃ ( mīmāṃsakānāṃ- ) rāddhānta:, yaduta ākṛtivaca- natā eva sarvaśabdanāmāti |
( ṛju — nanu pratiguṇe aruṇādīnāṃ medāt ekaṃ sāmānyaṃ aṅgīkartumucitam |
yā'pi ca paṭumandatā- dibhirviśeṣai: viśiṣṭabuddhi:, sā'pi na svarūpabhedāvahati viśeṣamātrāt |
nanu aruṇādaya: paramāṇupā pārthiveṣu pākajā:, sarvakāryadravyeṣu ca kāraṇaguṇapūrvakā: |
vayaṃ pratipadyāmahe sa guṇasamavāya: kasya cit kathaṃ cit udeti apeti ca |
tena sakala- dravyeṣu aka: aruṇā aruṇādiṣu asmadādinīya iti vyaktivacanatā uddiṣṭādiṣu |
yadi śabdasya vyatiriktaṃ, athāpi sāmānyaṃ, saṃbandho viśeṣa: ? viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ ca prayojanaṃ vaktavyam |
athedamapyucyate vyaktipakṣe hi saṃbandhasya sāpekṣatā prāpnotīti, kā kathā
tatra kriyā upalabdhamiti cet, ihāpi ākṛtirbhaviṣyati |

tatra hi abhihitā kriyā dhātubhāgena, iha tu ( gavādiśu ) anabhihitā jāti: nālamupalakṣa- ṇāya iti cet, kalpatāmabhidhānaṃ, na puna: sāpekṣatā- 'bhidhāne upayogamasya paśyāma:, nirapekṣatā'bhidhāne vā |
vācakatvaiva sarvavākyeṣu avagati: iti manvāna: śabdārthobhedo nopapadyate iti pṛṣṭa- vān pūrvapakṣavādī |
( ṛju — pūrvaṃ gakārādi- visarjanīyāntaṃ varṇā evaṃ ityupasaṃhṛtam |
tadāvi- kṣipnu: pṛcchati pūrvapakṣavādī atha gaurityasya śabdasya ko'rtha iti |
vanamiti bahuṣu vṛkṣeṣu ekavacanāntaṃ padaṃ nopapadyate |
tatra yadi varṇātmakaṃ padaṃ, tadā spaṣṭamedātrābhāvasaṅga: syāt |
tenāyaṃ bhāṣyasyārtha: — gaurityasya śabdasya ko'rtho bhavato'bhimata: ? kiṃ śabdāt vyatiriktaṃ, yena varṇā eva bravīṣīti |
atra ca na bahirarthāpabha: kriyate, sthāpitatvāt |
kintu śabdāmidheyaṃ śabdāt vyati- riktaṃ na bhavati iti pūrvapakṣa: |
( itarastu ( siddhāntī ) veko'stra prayoge abhidhāne ca, prāyogikī buddhi: abhi- dheye adhyavasyati iti tadapanuttye sāsnādiviśiṣṭā ākṛti: ityuktavān |
( asya vaiyākaraṇasya pūrvapakṣina: prayogasādhau abhidhāne arthasādhau aviveka: |
prayogaśādhuṣṭu prayoge vinā'pi arthena prayujyate' iti |
tena prāyogikī prayoge sādhubhā- vikāṃ buddhiṃ abhidheye adhyavasyati |
abhidheye tu śabdā- tmakameva vivekaṃ apekṣya anyam śabdātmakamebhidheyaṃ darśa- yituṃ itara: siddhāntī sāsnādiviśiṣṭā ākṛti: ityuktā- vān |
yathā abhidhānamupalakṣaṇaṃ gaurityasya śabdasya ityatra anye- 'pi śabdā draṣṭavyā:, tathā ākṛti: iti upalakṣaṇaṃ vyakyādayo'pi draṣṭavyā: ) |
'nanu ākṛti: sādhyā'sti vā na vā' ityabhi- dheyatayā śabdarūpatāṃ na jahātītyuktavān ( na svarūpeṇa ākṛtirnāstītyucyate kiṃtu abhidheyatayā śabdarūpā nāstītyucyate ) |
nanu ca tadrūpāt abhāvābhidhāne kiṃ prayojanaṃ ? ( bhāṣye kila 'asti vā na vā' iti granthena ākṛtairabhāva: pratipādyate, tacca na yuktam |
pariharati-) abhi- dheyābhiprāya evāyamabhāva: ukta:; na svarūpābhiprāya: |
( abhidheyaspā jāti: śabdavyatiriktā asti vā na vā iti bhāṣyeoktaṃ, na puna: svarūpeṇa asti vā neti ) |
yadi paraṃ svarūpeṇaiva abhāva: sādhyate, tadaiva anabhidheyatā ( bāhyāyā ākṛti: syāt |
yadā tu asti, tadā saivā- bhidheyā syāt ) |
na cābhāva: śakyate vaktuṃ pratyakṣagamya- tvāt |
kena voktaṃ svarūpeṇa asyā abhāva iti ( pūrvapakṣī brūte, na mayā svarūpeṇa ākṛtairabhāva- ucyate, kiṃtu svarūpeṇaiva |
saiva tu abhi- dhīyate iti vyāmoha eva ) |
itarastu ( siddhāntī ) tamevābhiprāyaṃ ( svarūpāpahnavamantareṇa abhidheyāpahnava na yuktta iti pūrvoktaṃ ) buddhau kṛtvā 'nāsati pratyayavipa- ryāse
asmin vanābhidheye arthe ekapratyayo nopapadyate iti kiṃ pratyakṣagamyā vṛkṣā api na santīti śakyate vaktum |
ko'bhiprāyaḥ ? ( ucyate-) vṛkṣā evātra ekatayā pratīyante na punaḥ vanaśabdarūpā gamyate (vanaśabde samuccarite vṛkṣā eva pratīyante |
tatra bhavanānevaṃ vadati, śabdavyatirikta'rtho nāstīti, tathā sati pratyakṣa eva na santīti prāptam |
śabdātirekiṇāṃ teṣāṃ pratyakṣasiddhatvāt ) athāyamabhiprāyaḥ 'vṛkṣā api naiva santi iti' tadapi hi śabdādyasyaiva rūpamiti pratyuktaḥ sa māhāyānikaḥ pakṣaḥ |
arthaviṣayā hi pratyakṣa saṃvit, na buddhiviṣayā ityuktam |
buddhiviṣayatve vā saṃvidaḥ, kiṃ sidhyati śabdādyāsaḥ ? ( yena śabdādyāse nirācikīrṣite buddhiviṣayatā saṃvido nirākriyate ) |
anyaiva vṛkṣasaṃvit, anyā vanasaṃvit ( yadi vṛkṣasaṃvit vanasaṃvit ekā syāt, na tadā buddhi- viṣayatve saṃvido'syā
bhavati, sāmānyamapi yadi vastu syāt, tataḥ anenāpi bhinnana abhidhena vā bhavitavyam |
na ca dvedhā'pi saṃbha- vati, tasmādvastu' iti |
anyathā kathaṃ vastutvasya bhedābhedābhyāṃ vyāptatvāt vyāpakyānupalabdhyā sāmānyasya vastutvaṃ na saṃbhavati iti bhaṇituṃ śakyam |
nanu aupādhiko vastuśabdo na jātinimittakaḥ, tatkathamenaṃ jātyāpattiḥ |
jātirvā bhavatu aupādhikaṃ, sarvathā tāvat sāmānyarūpamepekṣitavyam |
na ca dhyāvṛttaikasa sarve vastujātaṃ abhyupagacchataḥ saugatasya ka cidapi kiṃ cidapi anuvṛttaṃ rūpaṃ saṃbhavati, iti aupādhiko vyavahāro durghaṭa eva |
tasmāt sarva- prāmāṇasiddhaṃ sāmānyaṃ na śakyamapahotum |
na tāvat aparihatā api śaknuvanti sāmānyamapahotuṃ, teṣāmapi tadapekṣatvāt ityuktam |
kaḥ punarasau ? ayutasiddhānāṃ ihapratyayahetuḥ saṃśrayaḥ iti ke cit |
'iyaṃ gauḥ' iti hi sarvadā sarveṣāṃ pratītiḥ, na 'iha golaṃ' iti |
kā punaryutasiddhiḥ ? pṛthaggatimatyaṃ pṛthagāśrayāśritatvaṃ vā, tadabhāvaḥ ayutasiddhiḥ ? yathaiva avayavāvayavino- saṃbandhaḥ, samavāyo na syāt |
vinā'pi avayavacilanena avayavānāṃ calanāt, avayavinaḥ avayavānāṃ ca svāva- yavāśrayatvāt |
tathā sāmānyasya vyaktyāśrayatvāt vyakteśca svāvayavāśritatvāt asti pṛthagāśrayāśritvaṃ, iti samavāyānupapattiḥ |
tasmādevaṃ vaktavyaṃ, yena saṃśrayena ādheyaṃ ādhāraṃ svānurūpaṃ buddhi janayati, svākāreṇa bodhayati ityarthaḥ, sa saṃbandhaḥ samavāyaḥ |
yadya- jātyātmanā vyaktiḥ pratīyate, tato jātivyakttyoḥ abhedaḥ eva pratīyitatvāt āpadyate, kathaṃ medābhyupagamaḥ |
'gaurayaṃ śāvaleyaḥ' (śavalāyāḥ apatyaṃ), 'gaurayaṃ gāhu- leyaḥ' (bahulāyāḥ apatyaṃ ) ityubhayatra gavākāro'nu- vartamāno dṛśyate, śāvaleyavāhuleyākārī tu vyāvartete |
tadyadi tayoḥ śāvaleyavāhuleyākārayoḥ abhedaḥ syāt, ekāṇutvaṃ itarorapyanuvarteta |
kiṃca tasyāmeva vyaktau 'iyaṃ gauḥ' iti gavātmanā pratīyamānāyāmapi, na iyaṃ buddhigobuddhayoḥ : 'gauḥ gauḥ' itivat paryāyatvaṃ pratīyate |
kathaṃ tarhi tādrūpyaṃ vyaktau pratīyate ? idameva hi tādrūpyaṃ vyaktaḥ, yattat samavāyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
tasyaiva mahimā, yena ādheyaṃ ādhāraṃ svabuddhyā anurañjayati |
yadi hi 'idaṃ rajataṃ, nedaṃ rajataṃ' itivat parasparapadena medā- medī pratīyatāṃ, tato virudhyeyātām |
na tu tayoḥ para- sparopamadena pratītiḥ |
'iyaṃ, gauḥ' iti buddhiśca ayaṃ- yena pratibhāsamānaṃ ekaṃ vastu dhyātmakaṃ vyavasthāpayati |
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ hi abhedāmāpādayati, aparyāyatvaṃ ca bhedaṃ, ataḥ pratītigatāt avirodhaḥ |
tathāhi, gorūpeṇa nirūpyamāṇā jātyā vyaktiḥ abhedena pratīyate 'gaurayaṃ śāvaleyaḥ' iti |
yadā tu jātiḥ vyatyantarā- dhmanā nirūpyate, tadā iyaṃ vyaktiḥ tato bhinnarūpā ava- sīyate, 'yo'sau śāvaleyo gauḥ, so'yaṃ śāvaleyo na bhavati' iti |
evaṃ dhārmiṇe dravyasya rasādidharmāṃtara- rūpeṇa rūpādibhyo medaḥ, dravyarūpeṇa cābhedaḥ |
tathā avayavinaḥ rūpeṇa avayavaiḥ abhedaḥ, avayavāntararūpeṇa tu avayavāntarairbhedaḥ |
tatra yathā dīrghahasvā- dīnāṃ viruddhasvabhāvānāṃ apekṣābhedāt ekatrāpi aviruddhaṃ pratītitvāt aṅgīkriyate, tathā medābheda- yorapi dravyasya pratītiviśeṣāt |
kaścit (prābhā- karaḥ) punarāha, 'pratītireva medābhedābhāsinī na saṃbhavati iti |
bhedapratibhāsasamaye jātirūpaṃ vyaktirūpaṃ ca pratīta, tena abhedapratītivelāyāṃ tayoranyatarat pratyetavyam |
tatra ekasya dviravabhāso'yaṃ bhavet, na punaḥ istena abhedaḥ pratīto bhavati |
nahi vastudvayatirekeṇa meda- pratītiḥ, tadvade'pi abhedāt |
prathamaṃ vyaktidarśane'pi hi asti jātivyakttyoḥ dvayoḥ pratītiḥ |
na ca tadā tayoḥ bhedaḥ pratīyate, vyaktyantaradarśanena tu jāteḥ anvayāt, pūrvavyakteśca vyatirekāt, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ jātivyakttyoḥ medo'dhāyate iti bhavato'pi siddhāntaḥ |

tathā devadattamupalabhya kālāntare tasa- dṛśaṃ yadṛṣṭaṃ tadāt paśyan pūrvopalavdhaṃ ca devadattaṃ smaran vastutaḥ tadillakṣaṇameva puruṣadvayaṃ pratyeti, tathāpi na medamavadhārayati, saṃśate hi 'kiṃ sa evāyaṃ devadattaḥ' kiṃvā anyaḥ ; iti |
tathā tameva devadattaṃ kālāntare dūrāt paśyati 'kiṃ sa evāyaṃ, utānyaḥ' iti saṃdehāno vastugatyā ekameva pratyayapi nāmedamavadhāra- yituṃ alaṃ bhavati |
kiṃtu 'anyo'yaṃ' iti buddhiḥ medābhāsaḥ, 'anyo'yaṃ' iti ca abhedābhāsaḥ |
asti ca śāvaleyāhuleyau upalabhamānasya 'ayaṃ gauḥ, ayamapi gauḥ' ityamedāva- bhāsaḥ, 'anyaḥ śāvaleyāt bāhuleyaḥ' iti ca medāva- bhāsaḥ |
nanu anu- vṛttā nityā anuvṛttavināśādharmā ca jātiḥ, viparītaḥ svabhāvā ca vyaktiḥ, kathaṃ tayoraikyam |
nahi ekameva vastu anuvṛttaṃ vyāvṛttaṃ, nityamanityaṃ, upastivināśadharmakaṃ atadabhedakaṃ ca saṃbhavati, trailokyasaṃkaraprasaṅgāt |
jātira- pyevaṃ anityatvādidharmā syāt, vyaktirapi nityādi- dharmā |
nānā''kāraṃ hi tat vastu kena cidākāreṇa nityatvādirka, kena cicca anityādikaṃ vibhrat na virudhyate |
jātirapi vyaktirūpeṇa anityā, vyaktirapi jātyātmanā nityā iti nāma kā cinniṣṭhā- pattiḥ |
(jātiḥ sarvagatā na vā) yattu sarvagatā vyaktigatā vā jātiḥ iti vikasitaṃ, tadapi vyaktyātmatvā- bhidhānādeva parihṛtam |
nanu evaṃ vyaktideśe vyaktyutpatteḥ prāk avidyamānā jātiḥ kathaṃ tatra paścāt bhavati |
svakāraṇāt niṣpadyamānā vyaktiḥ, jātiviśeṣātmanā saṃbadhaiva upajate iti na doṣaḥ |
tatrāvidyamānā jātiḥ kathaṃ vyaktyā saṃbadhyate, nahi asau tadānīmeva tatra utpadyate niyatvāt, na ca anyataḥ āgacchati amṛtatvāt |
yo'pi deśāntarādāgatya anena deśena saṃyujyate, so'pi prāk asmin deśe avidyamāna eva kathamanena deśena saṃyoga- manubhavati ? kāraṇavaśāt iti vaktavyam |

saṃyujyamānaḥ pūrvavasthitaḥ ana- ntaradeśena prathamaṃ saṃyujyate, tataḥ tadanantaradeśena, iti krameṇa deśāntarasaṃyogaṃ gacchati, tādātmyasa- vāyostu anantaradeśamapekṣyaiva svakāragato niṣpattiḥ |
nahi yaḥ saṃyogasya svabhāvaḥ, sa eva tādā- tmyasya samavāyasya vā aṅgīkartavyaḥ |
sarvagatamapi sāmānyaṃ vyakte revātmā tatsametaṃ vā |
saṃyuktasamavāyasaṃbandhena ca sāmānyasyopa- lambhaḥ : tena ca saṃnikarṣe vyaktideśe eva saṃbhavati nānyatra, iti na sarvopalavdhiḥ |
abhedo'pi jāti- vyakttyoḥ medasyāpi vidyamānatvāt nityānityavādivat sarvagatatvasarvagatatvamapi nātūpapannam |
yattu kātsyena vā avayavaśo vā vṛttiriti vikalpitaṃ, tadapyayuktam |
na ca sāmānyasya svarūpato'vayavaśo vā medo'sti, ekatvādana- yavatvācca |
tasmāt vyaktiṣu jātirvartate ityetādeva atra vaktuṃ śakyate, pramāṇato'vagamāt |
tathā avayavino'pi avayaveṣu na kātsyena saṃbhavati, bahutvābhāvāt tadapekṣa-
kimidānīṃ ekarūpaiva sāmānyasya vyaktiḥ, avayaveṣu cāvayavino vṛttiḥ ? netyucyate |
sāmānyaṃ pratyekaṃ vartate, avayavī tu vyāsajya, ityevaṃ viśeṣaḥ |
vyaktyantaramapekṣyaiva vyaktyantare varta- mānā svānurūpāṃ buddhiṃ janayantī jātiḥ |
pratyekaṃ vartate ityucyate, na tu kārtsnyena vṛttiḥ |
avayavī tu avaya- vāntarānyeva avayavāntare vartamānaḥ svākārāṃ buddhiṃ janayan avayasya vartate iti vyapadiśyate |
nahi ekasyā- meva vyaktau gobuddhivat ekasminneva tantau paṭabuddhirūpa- dyate |
yattu nityatvājjāteḥ svaviṣayajñānajananasāmarthyāt na grāhyava- miti |
na ca hetullakṣaṇaṃ grāhyatvaṃ, jñāna- janyalakṣaṇabhāgitvalakṣaṇaṃ hi tat iti śūnyavāde varṇitam |
yattu svalakṣaṇaireva svānubhavadvāreṇa gavādivikalpo- dayasaṃbhavāt aprāmāṇikī jātikalpanā iti |
nahi jātirna dṛśyate, yena evamupālambhaḥ syāt |
upajāyamānaṃ tu jñānaṃ svaviṣayabhūtāṃ jātiṃ upasthāpayati iti nedṛśānāṃ pralāpānāmevasaraḥ |
kathaṃ ca atyantavila- kṣaṇāni svalakṣaṇāni ekarūpaṃ vijñānaṃ janayanti, 'tada- tadrūpiṇe bhāvāstadatpahetujāḥ' iti sthite |
bhavato vā kathaṃ vilakṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ ekarūpasāmānyānvaya- kāraṇatvaṃ iti cet, sveṣuvaśāditi brūmaḥ |
kāni cit svalakṣaṇāni svakāraṇādupadyamānāni ekena kena cit sāmānyāyena tādātmyaṃ samavāyaṃ vā bhajante |
nanu hetavo vilakṣaṇāḥ kathaṃ ekavidhasāmarthyayuktāni svalakṣa- ṇāni janayanti |
na janeyayuḥ, yadi vilakṣaṇāḥ syuḥ; te'pi tu ekajātīyā eva |
yathā tāla- bījamekajātīyaṃ pariṇāmaparaṃparayā tālajātisaṃbaddhāṃ vyakti- mupanayati sā'pi tathaiva svakāraṇabhūtabījasamānājātīyaṃ vījāntaraṃ, tathaikogātīyatāt śukāt gojātīyavyakti- niṣpattiḥ |
tasyāṃ ca tajjātīyaśruniṣpattiḥ; iti nātyantaṃ tādātmyāpattiḥ |
tasmāt asti ekaṃ ākṛtijāti- sāmānyaśabdāmilapanīyaṃ śābaleyādiṣu anugatam |
sa evāyaṃ iti pratītiḥ, na tatsadṛśaḥ iti |
na ca sarvasāmānyāpahnava- vādinaḥ sādṛśyamapi saṃbhavati, bhūyo'vayavasāmānyātmaka- tvāt |
na ca ataddyāvṛttitpamapi sāmānyaṃ anaṅgī- kṛtavidhirūpasāmānyena śakyate praletum |
agovyāvṛtti hi pratīyatā avaśyaṃ prathamameva (vidhirūpeṇa ) gauḥ pratayetavyaḥ |
nahi apratīte gavi tadvyatirekātmanā gavāṃ nirūpaṇaṃ saṃbhavati, iti prathamamavaśyaṃ vidhirūpeṇa gauḥ prayetavyaḥ |
nahi tebhyo vyatirekarūpamevamahāya ādi- vyaktīnāṃ prātisvikena rūpeṇa grahaḥ saṃbhavati |
tepāmanantānāṃ buddhau anarohāt, anarūḍhe ca teṣu tadvyāvṛttirūpasya goḥ pratyetumaśakyatvāt |
gaurgauḥ iti ca vidhirūpaṃ sāmānyaṃ avagamyamānaṃ kathaṃ nivṛttirūpaṃ śakyaṃ aṅgī- kartum |
tatrāmāṇyapratiṣṭhāpayiṣayā nityā ākṛtiḥ padārthabhūtā sthāpyate ākṛtivādena |
bāla. pṛ. 6-7. a ākṛtivyaktyoḥ atyanta- bhedābhāvāt kadā cit vyaktirūpeṇa dravyamamīyate kadā cit sāmānyarūpeṇa yathāvivakṣitam |
... jātervā vyaktitaḥ atyantabhedābhāvāt vyaktau kṛtā dharmāḥ jātau kṛtā eva bhavanti |
vā. 2|3|9|35, a ākṛtiśabdānāṃ vyaktau śakyamāvaḥ pratīyate |
3|4| 4|13 pṛ. 913, a ākṛtiśabdāṇi ākṛtau asaṃma- vanti vyaktilakṣaṇārthāni bhavanti |
tāni vyaktiṣu paro- kṣatvāt durbalāni jāyante |
bhāṣyaṃ - yadi (ye eva) laukikāḥ te eva (vede'pi) arthāḥ, tadā saṃdeḥ, kiṃ ākṛtiḥ śabdārthaḥ, atha vyaktiriti |
kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? 1 gauḥ ityukte sāmānyapratyayāt, vyaktau ca kriyāsaṃbhavāt |
yatra uccāraṇārthavayaṃ tatra vyaktyarthaḥ, ataḥ'tra ākṛtivacanaḥ; iti cet, ukte anyāyaścānekārthatvaṃ iti |
) kathaṃ vyaktyantareṇa prayogaḥ ? ' iti bhāṣyadvayaṃ atra galitaṃ iti sudhāyā- muktam |
) vyaktipadārthasya ākṛti- śrihabhūtā bhaviṣyati, ya evamākṛtikaḥ; sa gauriti |
yathā yasya daṇḍo'sti, sa daṇḍī iti |
vā - lokavedapoḥ agniḥ śabdārthā iti siddhe vicāryate 'kiṃ ākṛtiḥ śabdārthaḥ atha vyaktiriti' |
niyogena vikalpena dve vā saha samuccite |

gośabdādyarthaḥ kiṃ ākṛtirvā vyaktirvā (4) atha ākṛtiśca vyaktiśca (5) kimubhayoḥ saṃgrahaḥ (6) uta samu dāyaḥ (7) kimākṛtiviśiṣṭā vyaktiḥ (8) uta vyaktiviśiṣṭā ākṛtiḥ iti ( prameyamapyaṣī, ita uttaraṃ vārtike anekā aṣṭapakṣī darśitāḥ |
ante ca 'catuḥpadyadhikaṃ pakṣasahasradvayaṃ bhavati' ityuktvā 'parasparavyatikarādeteṣāṃ vahavo'parāḥ |
asāmistu nātiphalakatvāt ekaikā api saṃhitā nādhiko vistaraḥ |
na caitanmātra saṃbhave, na caite niṣprayojanāḥ |
nanu prathamapāde eva ākṛternirūpaṇāt idānīṃ praśnottare mandaprayojane |
pṛthivī- tvād ghaṭatvaṃ ca, tad vyaktiku sumāpyate |
' ( 'hayo bhūtvā devānavahat, vājī gandharvān, arvā asurān, aśvo manuṣyān' iti bṛhadāraṇyakabhāṣyanu- sāreṇa (1|1|2) hayatvaṃ vājitvaṃ arvaratvaṃ aśvatvaṃ ityaparaṃ sāmānyam |
karkādiṣu iti - aśvatvai- kāryasamavāyiśuklātvāntarasāmānyaṃ karkatvaṃ, raktātvāntara- sāmānyaṃ śoṇatvaṃ ityarthaḥ |

' (yathā yajatiṣuhetidadātirūpaśabdāntaraiḥ karmāvāntarabhedaḥ, tathā punarvidhānaṃ nāma abhyāsaḥ, saṃkhyā, ākhyā, guṇaḥ, prakaraṇāntaraṃ ca ityetairapi jāyamānaḥ karmabhettaḥ karmatvā- vāntarasāmānyānyeva iti ke cidācāryā manyate ityarthaḥ |
' sarveṣu hi pārthiveṣu gavādighaṭādi saṃsthānaṃ bhavet |
amitroyavyā- kāśānāṃ tu pārthivadravyaparigrahavaśāt ākārānuvṛttiḥ kalpyeta, na svātantryeṇa |

agre : iṃdhanasaṃsthānānusārisaṃsthānametaddarśanāt, tauyasya ca ādhārabhūtapātrādisaṃsthānānusārisaṃsthānabheda- darśanāt, ākāśasya ca avacchedaghaṭādisaṃsthānānu- sārisaṃsthānabhedadarśanāt, vāyośca ghaṭādyacchinnākāśa- saṃcāriṇaḥ : ghaṭādisaṃsthānānusārisaṃsthānametad aupā- dhikaṃ karmaṇaṇāṃ ca na kathaṃ cidapi saṃsthānaṃ saṃbhavati |
su. pṛ. 344) dikkālātmamanasāṃ tu guṇakarmaṇāṃ ca na kathaṃ cidapi saṃsthānaṃ saṃbhavati |
(saṃsthānākhyākārābhāve'pi ekākārapratyayavedyaḥ sarva- sva-vyaktenugataḥ : vijātīyebhyo vyāvṛttaḥ : nirālambana- bhuddhayavagāt brāhmaṇadhiyāt nāpahotuṃ śakyaḥ |
sarveṣu svaviśeṣeṣu anuvṛttireva rūpaṃ yasya iti vigrahaḥ |
tasmāt etadeva abhidheyākṛtilakṣaṇaṃ, na avayavacaranāsaṃsthānākṛtirvaṃ avakalpate |
'saṃsthā- nasya ca nāśitvāt prativyaktya ca bhedataḥ |
' tasya hi upalabdhamālocyamānaṃ na jāteratya labhyate |
tataśca jātireva sāmānyaṃ iti nyāyena āpadyate |

tena prathama- pāde rocakasvastikavardhanamākodaharaṇāt saṃsthānākṛtya- bhidhānāt ākhyāśyādaśarnavat āsīt iti etābhyāṃ praśno- ttarābhyāṃ ( bhāṣyasyābhyāṃ ) vyāvaryate ( tena vyāvaryate ityanvayaḥ : su. pṛ. 245) |
ataśca dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ yāvat kiṃcit prāk vyaktibhyaḥ sāmānyaṃ, tat sarvaṃ ākṛtireva ityabhipreya mātraśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ ( bhāṣye) |
ke cidāhaḥ : asādhāraṇā viśeṣā eva vyaktiḥ |
' khaṇḍamuṇḍadayastata anyā api vyaktayo bhavantyeva, gavayamahiṣādipyakyaḥ |
śābale- yo'pi yathā ekaḥ, tathā anyo'pi yaḥ śavalāpatyatvena gamyate, sa sarvaḥ śābaleyaḥ |
etacca ubhayavarṇanimittaṃ vā yācchikaṃ vā nāma anyatrāpi viniyogavaśādatraiveva |
tadapatye ca śābaleya iti asādhāraṇapyadeśānupa- pattiḥ |
tasmāt asādhāraṇā viśeṣā yasyāṃ sā vyaktiḥ ityevaṃ vyākhyāyam |
nanu pūrvoktena nyāyena khaṇḍādīnā- mapi bahutvaikasisādhāraṇatvāt vyaktivyatiriktānāṃ ca anyeṣāṃ kevallaikavyaktigatānāṃ viśeṣaṇānāmasaṃbhavāt bahubīhirepi anupapannaḥ |
naiva viśeṣāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ asādhāraṇyamāsthāya vyaktiviśeṣatvaṃ upādanām |
kathaṃ tarhi ? sādhāraṇarūpāṇāmapi ekadvitrādibhedena ka cidupalambhānāṃ yadekatra piṇḍīkṛtānāṃ grahaṇaṃ, tadapekṣaṃ asādhāraṇaviśeṣatvamabhidhānam |
'pravibhaktā hi ye dṛṣṭā dṛśyante saṃhatāḥ punaḥ |
' na ca asyāṃ vyaktau ye samuditā
dṛṣṭāḥ, te eva vyaktantare'pi anyūnānatiriktā dṛśyante |
yaḥ eva adṛṣṭapūrvaḥ tasmin samudāye saṃprati dṛśyate, sa eva asādhāraṇatā āpādayati |
anantabhedasapi vyaktiṣu na atyantāpūrvaviśeṣopalakṣaṇopādānaṃ, kiṃcidutkarṣapakarṣa- mātreṇa ca sarvatra asādhāraṇopalakṣaṇatvāt |
parasāmānyā- pekṣayā ca sarvāṃyeva avāntarasāmānyāni viśeṣapyadeśa āpnuvanti |
etacca vyaktiviśeṣaṇāṃ anyatvaṃ upariṣṭhāt bhāṣyakāro'pi vakṣyatyeva |
yo'rthaḥ : sāmānyasya viśe- pāṇāṃ cāvayavaḥ sa vyaktiḥ' iti (pṛ. 303) |
( ākṛtāisasāmānyasya ' dravyyānugatasattāsāmānyameva ākṛtiḥ, na gotvādyavāntarasāmānyaṃ' iti sattāvācya- svādādināṃ vyākhyāṃ buddhiyāṃ dūpayituṃ tanmatamupamyasyati- teneti |

su. pṛ. 346) tatra ke cit gotvādiṣu viśe- ṣatvamaṅgīkṛtya sāmānyavācinā śabdena anabhiyeyatvāt yadeva mahāsāmānyaṃ sattā-vastu-bhāvaśabdābhidheyaṃ, tadeva śabdasvarūpavyavacchinnaṃ gotvādiviśeṣavyavacchinnaṃ vā gosa- ttā''khyaṃ ākṛtyabhidhānapade vācya iti manyate |
' iti ( astī- tyevarūpaḥ : sarvaśabdānāmeva iti idaṃśaṃ pratyāyasya vācyasya lakṣaṇamāhuḥ |
su. pṛ. 347) 'tantu kaśyā- vibhāgena sāmānyānāṃ nirūpaṇāt |
' pratiniyatārtha- viṣayā hi śabdānāṃ vācakaśaktiḥ : arthāpatyā gamyate |
tatra anantavāntarasāmānyavacanānāṃ dravyaguṇakarmaśabdānā- meva tāvat asaṃkīrṇārthatvāt sattā'rthatvaṃ anupapannaṃ, kimuta dūrāntaritārthagavādiśabdānām |
pṛthivītatvajalādīni dravyavā- vāntarasāmānyakaśyāyāṃ, rūpatvarasatvādīni guṇavāvāntara- sāmānyakaśyāyāṃ ityevamādiḥ kaśyāyāṃ vibhāgaḥ |
tatra dravyaśabdena dravyatvasya : niścitapratītirbhavati, pṛthivī- tvādiṣu saṃdigdhā pratītiḥ, guṇatvādiṣu tu apratītireva |
( tathā ca ) sattā'vāntarasāmānyaviṣayāṇāṃ dravyādi- śabdānāmiva tāvat sattāvācitvamevamuktam |
tatraiva sati durāntaritārthānāṃ gavādiśabdānāṃ sutarāṃ sattāvācakatve śaktirnāsti |
su. pṛ. 347) 'sattāmete vadantaśca na śuddhāṃ saviśeṣaṇām |
nahi sattaiva nāstīti kathaṃ cittaṃ saṃpratīyate |
' ya eva hi astiśabdena dvitīyo bhāvavikāraḥ : ucyate |
( ṣaḍ bhāvavikārā bhavantīti vākyāṇiḥ, jāyate'sti viparītamate vardhate'pyapate vinaśyatīti |
niruktaṃ. 1|2) jāyamānavipariṇāmāca- yasarvasvavastuṣu vinaśyataparyanateṣu vastvakṛtipratipatti- rdṛśyate |
tena yadi nāma mahāsāmānyaṃ abhidheyaṃ prati- jñāyate, tato 'vastvarthaḥ : sarvaśabdānāmiti pratyāyalakṣa- ṇam |
na ca avayavārthaparityāgena sacchabdasattāśabdau vartate iti bhavacchabdadeva astīti sadbhāvaḥ sattā iti |
na tu vaiśeṣikaparibhāṣayā 'yato dravyaguṇakarmasu saditi pratītiḥ sā sattā' ityevalakṣaṇā jātiḥ : pratipattavyā |
( 'saditi yato dravyaguṇakarmasu sā sattā' iti su sūtra- pāṭhaḥ 1|2|7 ke |
yato vastutvāt mahāsāmānyatvāt dravyā- diṣu sat iti buddhirbhavati sā sattā ityarthaḥ |
bhāvapratyayalakṣaṇasubantatvayogyāvyayapadena (asti iti vimaktipratirūpakaṃ avyayam ) saha kṣīra- śabdasya anyapadārthe bahuvrīhirabhyupagatanya |
tatra cāyaṃ sārthavacanaḥ, sakṣīrā gauḥ iti pratyayotpādāt |

tataśca vastuni sati prayujyamānaṃ astiśabdamūlamya tadartha- nusaraṇapratyāsannaṃ sacchabdaṃ ca 'devātattva' (pā0 5| 4|27 ) iti ca svārthikaṃ devatā itīvat talaṃ ihāpi astitādvācyārthaviśiṣṭakartṛpratītiṃ anaṅgīkṛtya śuddha- dyārthamātravacanāveva sacchabdasattāśabdau gṛhītvā evaṃ tārkikaiḥ kalpitaṃ 'sacchabdavācyā sattā mahāsāmānyaṃ' iti |
taduktāntagamane (tārkikaiḥ) anādarācca pada- vākyavidbhirapi upekṣitaṃ prasiddhamiva imāmavasthāṃ prāptaṃ ( yuktāyuktavicāravasthāyāṃ prāptaṃ ) gavādiśabdavācyatve- nāpi saṃbhāvyate |
na tvarthād gamyamānasya vastutva- syāpi vācyatā |
yadeva ākṛtiviśiṣṭavyaktya- bhidhānapakṣe vyaktiviśiṣṭapratīte vā nirākaraṇakāraṇaṃ, tadatrāpi sulabhaṃ, viśeṣaṇasya pūrvatarābhidhānaprasaṅgāt |
gojātvā vā viśiṣṭāṃ tāṃ vaded vyaktibhireva vā |

' viśeṣaṇamanabhidhāya tadviśiṣṭe'bhyā- dhānāsaṃbhavāt viśeṣaṇasya ca viśeṣyeṇa atyantasaṃbandhāt pūrvatarābhihitaviśeṣaṇabhūtagotvasattvādevā sattā'vagama- siddheḥ na tatra abhidhānaśaktikalpanāyāṃ arthāpattirapi anyathā'pi upapadyamānaphalatvapratihatā satī na pravartate |
tathā vyaktiviśiṣṭasattā'bhidhāne'pi eṣa eva nirākaraṇa- hetuḥ |
yattu 'apūrvadevatāsvargaiḥ sama- māhuḥ' iti (kecitpakṣaḥ śloke ), tatrābhidhīyate |

' ke cit śrutārthāpatyā, ke cit vākyaśeṣavākyāntara- paryupasthāpitārthaviśeṣavacanena eva santaḥ atyantāvyabhi- cārisiddhārthadvāreṇa sattāṃ gamayanti : anabhidhāyakatvena avadhāryante, na sattā padārtho vyabhicarati iti lakṣaṇa- yaiva tebhyaḥ sattāpratītiḥ |
yāgādijanitaṃ ca puṃsāṃ phalaprāptisāmarthyaṃ apūrvaśabdavācyaṃ yāgānuṣṭhānāt pūrvaṃ abhūt anuṣṭhānottarakālaṃ ca apūrvaṃ jāyate iti yaugika- tvādeva apūrvaśabdāmidhānaṃ sarvatra labhyate |

tathā dīvyanti dyotante vā candradityamignanakṣatrakādi- rūpeṇa, vāyavaśca satatagatyā stūyante sarvairmantraiḥ iti devāḥ sujñānaśabdasaṃbandhāḥ viśeṣarūpairaiva, iti na sattāgocaratvaṃ pratipadyante |
tathā svargaśabdo'pi nakṣatradeśo vā vaidika- pravādapaurāṇikādyaśabdarśanana ucyate, yathā hi vede 'ye hi janāḥ puṇyakṛtaḥ svarge lokaṃ yanti, teṣāmetāni jyotīṣi nakṣatrāṇi |
tathā ca 'eṣa jyotiṣmantaṃ puṇyalokaṃ jayati' iti |

yadi vā itihāsapurāṇopapannaṃ merupṛṣṭhaṃ, athavā anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vibhaktaṃ kevala- meva sulabhaṃ, yat saṃvatsarādiṣu anubhūyamānaṃ duḥkha- sādhanaśītoṣṇatṛptipādādisamastadvirahitārthapattisiddha- -deśāntarānubhavanīyam |
tacca yadyapi tādṛśaṃ adṛṣṭapūrva, tathāpi miśrānubhavādeva vivekena ud- dhṛtya svargeśabdārthatvena jñāyamānaṃ sattāṃ gamayati, iti na tadabhidhānamapekṣate |

' (prayogacodanā'bhāvāt iti sūtre lokavedadhikaraṇasiddhānte anyā yojyatvāt- vivekakāya ākṛtyadhikaraṇapūrvapakṣe'pi ākṛtyā yojyati- kiṃ tāvaditi-- ) kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? 'prayogacodanā- 'bhāvād vyaktirvācyā, na tūbhayam |
yathā vidheyat tathā kārya teṣāṃ rūpa- nirūpaṇāt |
tena cetyeta, na tyāga ākṛterupa- padyate |
tadvidhiḥ pratiṣedho vā tenāsyā nāva- kalpyate |

' brīhīnavahanti, paśumamabhi- dhuṇoti, pāvayati, somena paśunā brīhimiśna yajate, iti yāvanta evamādayo vināśimūrtimadipyayāḥ saṃskārāḥ prayojanasiddhayarthaṃ vā, teṣāṃ prayogacodanāyāḥ ākṛtau abhāvāt vyaktau tu bhāvāt, kāryapradhānatvāt ca padārthapratīteḥ |

tathā yadapi 'brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ' : 'na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayitavyaṃ' ityādipratiṣedhavidhānaṃ, tadapi prāptipūrvakatvena sāpekṣatvāt vyaktau ca prāptisaṃbhavāt, ākṛteśca anadhikāratvāt amatyāṃ prāptau anarthakameva syāt |
tasmāt yena śabdārthena prayogacodanānāṃ bhāvo bhavati, sa eva abhyupagantuṃ nyāyyaḥ |
vyaktisaṃbhavatvayoga- codanāsu vyaktyarthaḥ, tato'nyatra ākṛtyaiva etra bhavi- ṣyatīti |
nyāyena hi sthitaṃ eṣa śabdasya artheyaṃ, ( nyāyayamāha - ) anavasthitasaṃbandhatvānna- dṛṣṭavācakaśaktikalpanavikalpopaprasaṅgāt |
( yatravarāhābhi- karaṇoktaḥ nyāyamāha - ) saṃbaddhānāṃ nārthānāṃ anyatarā- midhānenaiva itaratra pratipattisiddheḥ |
kathaṃ tarhi ākṛti- pratyaya iti cet ata āha 'avibhāgāt' iti |
yatastu nityameva vyaktyākṛtyoḥ avibhāgaḥ, tasmāt vyatiriktitā satī śakyatve ākṛti gamayituma |
taduktaṃ tadbhūtādhikaraṇe, yasya tu padasya yo'rthaḥ abhidheyatvena āśritaḥ, tasya tatparihārāsaṃbhavāt avaśyaṃ tatrasthasyaiva arthāntaraṃ lākṣaṇikatvena abhyupa- gantavyaṃ iti |

) tathā ca sudhā- etacca 'yatra hi śukla iti vā kṛṣṇa iti vā guṇaḥ pratīto bhavati, bhavati khalu asau alaṃ guṇavati pratyayamātrāṇām' iti tadbhū- tādhikaraṇabhāṣyeṇa [ pṛ. 96-97 ] tulyanyāyatvāt uktaṃ bhavati ityata tatkathamiti - iti pṛ. 367 ) |
api ca ākṛtipadārthasya vyaktiṣu sādhāraṇānekāntika- tvāt nirṇayo na syāt |
vyaktipadārthasya punaḥ atya- ntāntarbhūtakṛtiniścayasiddheḥ : na śabdavyāpārakalpane- tpattiḥ |
na ca vikalpasamuccayasaṃśayasamudāyānyataraviśiṣṭatarābhidhāna- pakṣaḥ : saṃbhavānti avibhāgādeva sarvasāmapi jñānasiddheḥ |
na tatra dravyāśrayavacanaḥ śabdo bhavet, yadi ākṛtiḥ śabdārtho bhavet |

' gośabdādīnāṃ ākṛtivacanatve ' gauḥ śuklaḥ; ' ' aruṇyā piṅgākṣyāhāyyā gavāṃ krīṇāti ' iti ' ṣaḍ gāvo deyāḥ ' ' ekāṃ gāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt ' ityevādiṣu sarveṣāṃ jātiguṇamātravacanatvāt sāmānyādhikaraṇaṃ na prāpnoti |
nahi gotvākṛtiḥ śuklā nāuṇā nāpi bahuguṇā |
jātiguṇaviśiṣṭa- vyaktivacanatvena śuddhavyaktivacanatvena vā pratyakṣe bhavati sāmānyādhikaraṇyam |
evaṃvidhamapi samānadravyaśabdatvaṃ tvapakṣe na syāditi najā tadbhāva- prasaṅgaṃ darśayati |
yattu bhāṣyakāraḥ viparītārthena dravyaśabdenaiva tadāśraya- guṇalakṣaṇayā nañaśca asamarthasamāsamīkṛtya 'na dravyā- śrayavacanaḥ śabdo bhavet' ākṛtivādinaḥ ityāha |
tatrāpi akṣarābhyāsamātrasaṃyojanā, dravyāśraya guṇasya yaḥ śabdaḥ : dravyaśabdaḥ; sa ākṛteḥ nirguṇatvāt ekatrāśrayatvaṃ gotvaṃ śuklaṃ ityādi vat na pratipadyate |
sāmānyādhikaraṇyaṃ ca svapakṣe'pi aviśe- ṣāt tadānīmapi anupapannameva iti pūrvatra vyākhyā kartavyā |
sādhāraṇarūpeṇa śabdapravṛttasaṃbhave sati viśeṣāvacchinnarūpeṇa vyakterabhidheyaṃ vācyaṃ, tasmiṃśca pakṣe saṃbandhakathanābhāvādyo doṣāḥ syuḥ |
'vācyavācakatvaniyamahāniḥ saṃbandhānityatvāpattiḥ vikalpa- prasaṅgaḥ aśeṣavyaktyakhyānayanāpattiḥ nityatvahyuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ śuklādiśabdasāmānyādhikaraṇyasaṃbhavaśca ādiśabdeno- pāttāḥ |
su. pṛ. 163 ) na ca yatra saṃśayaḥ, tat pratyayyaṃ bhavati iti nirviṣayatā śabdasya |
vyakti- viśiṣṭākṛtibhāgā''pi nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā iti nyāyāt vyakteḥ prathamagrahaṇaprasaṅgāt (prayuktaḥ |
) saṃbandhasamudāya- yorapi svarūpapratyābhāvāt sarvatra cāviśeṣataḥ avaśyaṃ saṅghanissamudāyādiviśeṣaṇatā abhyupagantavyā bhavati |
na ca vyaktyākṛtyoḥ bhinnakāryayoḥ guṇapradhānānvayoḥ samudāyopagamanaṃ yuktam |
vyaktiviśeṣo'ddhyabhāvāt vyakti- mātramiti cenna, tadānīṃ tasya ākṛtito'nyatvena ani- rūpaṇāt |
mātraśabde hi sāmānyavācī iti ākṛti- revocyate |
nānā''kārakaśca vastuṣu tadbhedānusāritvāt śaktīnāṃ anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ gotvākāranibandhanaiva gośabdavācyatvaśaktirgamyate |
sā hi pratīyate niṣkṛṣṭarūpā, kriyāyoginī tu vyaktyapetā bhavatyeva iti, prokṣaṇāvekṣaṇādi tu na kathaṃ cinbhavati |
tathāhi, paśvādiṣu apa- nītādyeṣu viśeṣabuddhayabhāvāt sāmānyarūpeṇa viśasanā- diviśiṣṭā buddhirdṛṣṭā |
nanu evamamitā ākṛtiḥ syāt, tenāṃśena iṣṭaiva |
tena yat tāvanmātrameva tasya vināśaḥ, anekadeśeṣu tu na kathaṃ cidvināśaḥ syāt |
atyantavyatireke tu naiva dharma- vidhiviṣayo vyatiṣṭheta |
tadupalakṣitaṃ tu yat dravyaṃ, tat dravyatvāt ṛte na tādūpyeṇa gamyate ityekāryasamavāyāt vyāpaka- tvācca dravyaṃ gamayitavyaṃ, tatrāpi amūrtatvaṃ doṣaḥ |
viśeṣastu paśulasya vā dravyatvasya vā adhyāpakatvādagamyaḥ |
na ca yatra saṃśayaḥ, tat pratītam |
na ca anyathokau dharmaḥ tatrāsaṃbhavāt anyatra kāryaḥ |
viśeṣarūpā na kadā cit vyaktiḥ pratīyate |
athavā etadapi evārthaṃ prapañcaḥ kiṃ śabdena ākṛtyā veti |
yo hi dhruvatvāt agrimatvaṃ prati- padyate tasya teṣvapyapi ākāṅkṣā siddhā |
) yo hi jāḍyāt sāmānyavācitāṃ hitvā kaṃcideva viśeṣaṃ yatra saṃbandhānubhavaḥ taṃ vācyaṃ manyate, tasya sāmānyapratīteḥ na viśeṣāntarāpekṣā bhavati |
athavā, yathā śabdāt svatantrāmākṛtiṃ budhyate, naiva kadā cit ākṛtiṃ abudhvā vyaktimiti |
kena tarhi gotvagośabdayorviśeṣaḥ ? vyatirekāṃśasya ekatra vivakṣā, gotvavān iti tu sphuṭaṃ pratyayena jātibhedabhidhānaṃ, vibhāgopatteḥ |
prayojanaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdayoḥ ekaviṣayatvāt sāmānyaśiṣṭasya viśeṣaśiṣṭena agrahaḥ pūrvapakṣe (siddhānte tu bādhaḥ |
(atra sudhā - 'varṇāntaratvābhāve'pi pūrvavyākhyā- prakāre kena cit vyākṣepeṇa aprasannābhidhānāt śiṣya- kleśāpatteḥ sukhapratipatyarthaṃ prakārāntaramārabhate -- 'evaṃ vā' iti' |
yadarthadyotako tau tu vācakaḥ sa vicā- ryate ||
pratīyate viśeṣo yaḥ saṃśayena sa nāpyate ||
tato vicāro jāyeta na sāmānyadhiyā vinā ||
(paunaruktyāpatteḥ ākhyātaṃ na vicāryamityāśaṅkate) ākhyātasyāpi nambatra na yuktā'rthavicāraṇā |
(pratyayārtha- cinteva prakṛtyarthacintā iti pariharati - ) pratyayā- rthasya bhāvasya vācyatā pratipāditā |
sāmānyaṃ vā viśeṣo vā kiṃ vācyamiti cintyate ||
siddhā seha vivekārthaṃ tatra bhāvasya bhāṣitā ||
(aparitoṣāt anyathā pariharati - ) yasyārthasyepi vā vācye kiṃ sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ |
eṣā tatra ca cintoktā śeṣā prāsaṅgikī kathā ||
iyaṃ prāsa- ṅgikī cintā sādhuśabde nirūpite |
na cākṛtyā na ca vyaktyā vinā tatropapadyate ||
pramāṇa- miti siddhasya kiṃ cidatra vicāryate ||
tena vyāka- raṇe'pi na pramāṇaṃ smṛtirmatā ||
smṛtestenā- payādo'yaṃ prāmāṇyasya ca cit kṛtaḥ |
(prayo- janābhāvena adhikārārambhaśaṅkate - ) nanu cākṛtipakṣe'pi vyaktyāveva kriyākriye |
(vede prayo- janābhāve'pi loke prayojanaṃ bhaviṣyati iti tāvat pari- harati, yadyapi - ) yadyapyevaṃ na bhedo'sti vedārtha- karaṇe nṛṇām |
dadhi viprebhya ityādi phalaṃ loke bhaviṣyati ||
( saṃśayahetumāha-) ( gauḥ iti śabdaḥ ādiryasya tasmin ‘ gauḥ ityasya |
bhedā- śabdasya ko'rthaḥ ’ iti bhāṣye 1115 pṛ. 49) |
( vimṛśya tena, tena gatārthatvāt punaścintā na yujyate |
pūrvapakṣamāha-) kiṃ prāptamucyate bhinnau śabdāthau ( pariharati-) ākṛterabhidheyatvapratijñā kevalā |
etadayuktaṃ, vyakterapi pratīyamānatvāt kathaṃ jāteraiva pratītirnupasyate |
yadi ca vyaktirna saṃpratīyate, tataḥ saṃśaya eva na syāt 'kimabhidhīyate anena' iti |
na ca kriyāsaṃbhavaḥ abhidheyatve kāraṇaṃ, vyaktyantarāṇāmapi prasaṅgāt |
( sadeva - ) prayogapratīyoḥ sādhāraṇatvāt śāstrāntare ( nyāyaśāstre ) vyaktipakṣāmyupagamāt saṃśayaḥ |

yadvā śabde uccārite sāmānyapratyayāt vyaktyākṛtyoḥ sāmānyatvāt tulyāt pratyayāt, vyaktau ca śabdāt ākṛtau ālambana- sparśana-śyenasadṛśavacanādikriyāsaṃbhavāt sāmānye vyaktau ca pratyayāt kriyāsaṃbhavāt iti coktam ! ( anena bhāṣyamupapāditam |
) 'kā punarākṛtiḥ, kā vyaktiriti' ( bhāṣyaṃ ) kathaṃ punarayaṃ praśnaḥ, yadā 'goḥ ityetasya śabdasya ko'rthaḥ' ( 1|1|9- ākṛtīvāde ) ityatra jātirni- rūpitā |
yena etanna jñātaṃ, asau pṛcchati, 'kā punarākṛtiḥ kā vyaktiḥ' - iti |
saṃdehādvā atra punaḥ ubhayasmin pratīyamāne, kā kiyatī vā jātiriti |
vaiparītyena vā kaścit pṛcchati, yadā śāstralekhādipiṇḍāt na kiṃ cit vyaktaṃ vastvantaraṃ bhinna- mupalabhyate, tadā kuto'yaṃ vivekaḥ 'vyaktiriyaṃ, jātiriyaṃ' iti |
jāteśca padārthatve'pi vyakteḥ kriyāsaṃbhavāt niṣprayojanā cintā |
yatastattvau prayatnena etat vicārayati, tena nūtanaṃ kā'pi asya piṇḍāt atyantabhinnavyavahārayogyā jāti- rabhipretā ityabhiprāyaḥ ! tatrāha, 'dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ sāmā- nyamātrākṛtiḥ' iti |
yau tāvat ajñānasaṃśayavādinau, tayoḥ svarūpakathanābhāvena nirākaraṇaṃ vaktavyam |
yadyapi jātiḥ vyakteratyantabhinnā nopalabhyate, tathāpi śāstrakāre tasminnupalabhyamāne sāmānyabuddherālambanaṃ prathamapādoktena nyāyena ākṛtiḥ, itarā vyaktiḥ |
na cānena granthena jāteḥ sadbhāvaḥ pramāṇaṃ vā pratipādyate, vyaktervivekaḥ kevalaḥ kathyate |
tenaivābhiprāyeṇa mātraśabdaprayogaḥ, anyathā tasya gatārthatva bhavet |
yadyapyuktaṃ na ka'pi atyanta- bhinnā jātirabhipreteti, tasyāpyuttaraṃ dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ sāmānyamātraṃ ākṛtirabhipretā nātyantatiriktā iti |
dravyādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ yat sāmānyaṃ sattārūpaṃ, tadenena nirdiṣyate, tannirdeśena avāntarasāmānyānāmapi nirdeśa- siddhiḥ |
yadā sāmā-yaśabdasya pratyekaṃ saṃśravāt dravyatvā- dīni trīṇi sāmānyāni nirdiśyante, sattā vyavahārābhāvāt |
athavā mātraśabdaprayogāt dravyā- diṣu yāvanti avāntarasāmānyāni mahāsāmānyāni ca, tat sarvamabhidhīyate |

asādhāraṇāḥ viśeṣāḥ yasyāṃ vyaktau teṣāṃ asādhāraṇaviśeṣā, na tu asādhāraṇāśca te viśeṣā iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ saṃbhavati, upariṣṭhāt viśeṣādhārasya vyaktivābhidhānāt, smṛteśca ( vaiśeṣika- tantre dravyaguṇakarmavyaktīnāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣādhāratvasmṛteśca |
sudhā. pṛ. 379 ) tena samyagmihitaṃ kimākṛtirvā vyaktiriti |

kiṃ prāptaṃ ? ( prayogacodanā'bhāvāt iti sūtraṃ ākṛtyā etadvicārapūrvapakṣe'pi yojayati - ) ālambanaprokṣaṇa- viśasanādiprayogacodanāyāḥ vyaktipakṣe bhāvāt ākṛti- pakṣe cābhāvāt, 'brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ' 'surā na pātavyā' ityādipratiṣedhacodanāyāśca vyaktipakṣaṃ eva saṃbhavāt 'devadatta gāmabhyāja' ityevamādilaukikavyava- hārodanāyāśca upapatteḥ vyaktiḥ śabdārtha iti niśrī- yate |
( anenaiva sūtravayavena ākṣimāni hetvantarāṇi āha - ) saṃkhyākārakopatteśca |

yadi hi vyaktiḥ śabdārtho bhavati, tato vṛkṣau vṛkṣābhyāṃ iti pratipadi- kāmahitāsu vyaktiṣu pratyayābhihitadvitvādisaṃkhyā karaṇā- dikārakaṃ ca ubhayamupapadyate, itaratra tu jāterasaṃvyatvāt akārakatvācca ubhayamapyanupapannaṃ, lākṣaṇikavyāśrayaṇaṃ ca apeyatāyām |
jātipakṣe lākṣa- ṇikadāraṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ kalpayitavyaṃ bhavet, tenāpi vyakteḥ padārthatvamasīyete |
'paśumālabheta' iti ca śruteḥ dvyajyādibhiḥ vyaktipratyayaḥ: upariṣṭhāt vyavahāro dṛśyate, na jātyā |
siddhasvarūpāyāśca vyakteḥ abhidheyatvaṃ yuktaṃ, nāprasiddhāyāḥ jāteḥ |
( ayaṃkathyaṃ iti sūtrāvayavamavatāra- yituṃ śaknute - ) kimiti ubhayaṃ vācyaṃ nāśīyate prayogapratītikriyopapatteḥ iti cet |
( sūtrāvayavena nirā- karoti - ) na, anekaśaktiklpanāprasaṅgāt, ekābhi- dhānenaiva saṃśravāt, itaratra pratīterupapannatvāt vyaktere- vābhidheyatvam |
( avibhāgāt iti sūtrāvayavāvatāraṇāya śaknute - ) sāmānyapratyayaḥ kathamiti cet, ( sūtrā- vayavena nirākaroti - ) vyaktisaṃvanatvātpapatte |
yatraiva kriyā'nupapattiḥ tatraiva arthāpatyā vyaktivacanatvaṃ yuktaṃ, anyatra tu pūrvapratīteḥ jātivacanatvameva iti cet na, uktamārgeṇa anekaśaktiklpanādoṣaprasaṅgāt |
vyaktivādinaḥ kathaṃ nirmittatā vyaktyantaraṃ śabdasya pravṛttiriti cet, ākṛticihnanimittatvāt vyaktyantare prayogasyāvirodhaḥ |
bhāṣyakārastu 'kathaṃ sāmānyanāgatiḥ' ityupamyasya 'ākṛtirhyabhūtā bhaviṣyati' ityuttaraṃ dadāti, tada- saṃbaddham |
kathaṃ sāmānyapratyayaḥ : kāraṇe pṛṣṭhe vyaktyantara- prayoganimittaṃ kalpyate |
kathaṃ vyaktyantare prayogaḥ, cihnatvāt ākṛteḥ; ityevam |
yadvā 'kathaṃ sāmānyanāgatiḥ : iti cet' ityupamyaste pūrvapakṣavādī sāmānyanāgatiraho'śaktanuvan ākṛti- viśiṣṭavyaktibhāvanapakṣaṃ parigṛhṇāti ākṛtirhyabhūtvā viśeṣaṇabhūtā abhidheyā bhaviṣyati |
tena kevalā viśiṣṭā vā vyaktiḥ śabdārthaḥ |
( adṛśyaśabdatvāt iti sūtraṃ 31 saṃkṣepeṇa nyāyaṣṭe - ) tathā ca 'ṣaṭ deyāḥ' ityevamādiṣu ṣaḍā- dikā saṃkhyā upapadyate |
( anyadarśanācca 32 iti sūtraṃ anyamukhena vyakte - ) 'ayaṃ tadūrṇa' iti ca vyaktyantare anyaśabdopapattiḥ tadarmatā ca bhaviṣyati |
( vyatirekamukhena bhāṣyakārīvyākhyānamanusandhatte - ) anyathā vyaktyantarāneva'pi jāteranyatvāt aguṇa- nyācca ubhayamanupapannam |
naitat vyaktaḥ śabda- vācyeta, kiṃtu ākṛtiḥ padārthaḥ iti vijñāyate |
atra hi śyenavyakti cayanaṃ kuryāt ākṛtiṃ vā iti vākyārthī syātām |

yāvadicchābhiḥ : śyenavyaktaḥ kartumaśakyatvāt, snātvādi- bhirapi anirdiṣṭaiḥ, iṣṭakātvāt, śyenavyakteḥ prayojana- kalpanāt, cinoteramukhātprārthatvāt, 'karmaṇyagnyākhyāyāṃ' iti ( pā0 3|1|92 ) smṛtiparityāgaprasaṅgācca caya- nena śyenavyaktiṃ kuryāt ityevaṃ tāvat nopapadyate |
tathā ākṛterapi icchābhiḥ kartumaśakyatvāt, devanirmita- tvāt, prayojanakalpanāt, cinoteramukhātprārthatvāt, smṛtivādhācca, ākṛtiṃ kuryāt ityepi nopapadyate |
pari- śeṣāt śyenamiva citaṃ abhisalyaṃ cayanena nirvartayet iti vākyārthaḥ |
tataśca yayā cit śyenavyaktyā sadṛśasya agnestathāśrayatvāt sarvavyaktitvātsahasrabhāt atītānāgatavyaktitvātsahasratvātpapatteśca śyenakṛtisāha- śyasaṃpattiśca ākṛtiḥ śabdārtha iti niśrīyate |
atha kasmāt śyenavyaktibhiḥ cayanacodaneyaṃ nāśrī- yate 'śyenacitaṃ cinoti' iti ? tatra bhāṣyakāreṇottaraṃ dattaṃ 'īpsitatamo hyasau śyenaśabdena nirdiśyate' iti |
nadya śyenaśabdaḥ svārthaḥ, na ca sakala- śyenavicchedottarakālaṃ śrutatvāt dvitīyāyāḥ tadantaḥ ( dvitīyāntaḥ : śyenaśabdaḥ ), yena īpsitatamābhyapratipādakaḥ syāt |
tena 'karmaṇyagnyākhyāyāṃ' iti smṛteḥ śyenaśabdā- rthasya karmatvaṃ nivedyam |
karmaṇi hi kārake cinoteḥ kip-pratyayaḥ smaryate, yadi cinotiḥ agnyākhyā bhavati |
na ca cinoteḥ kevalasya agnyākhyānaṃ saṃbhavati |
tena kintaccinotiśruteḥ : śyenacitchabdasya sakalasya agnicayanatvaṃ niśrīyate, na śyenaśabdasya pṛthagarthatā |
yadi vā'sau karaṇaṃ syāt tato lakṣaṇā''mātrāt tṛtīyāmāsannatvanānu- papattirbhavet, tṛtīyā cāśrutā kalpanīyā |
satyāṃ ca gatau pratiṣiddhāneka- śyenavyaktirhiṃsā jāyate |
tena karaṇatvānupapatteḥ : 'śyenamiva citamagniṃ cinoti iti' vākyārthaḥ |
nyāyena asya vākyasya ākṛtipakṣe saṃbhavāt ākṛtiḥ padārthaḥ iti |

naitadevaṃ, nahi nayanakriyāsaṃbhavamātreṇa ākṛtirabhidhe- yatvaṃ labhyate, vyaktipakṣe'pi ālabhanādikriyāsaṃbhavān, bahutvācca ālabhanādivākyānāṃ tadanyathā'nupapattayā vyaktyaiva padārthatvamavasīyate |
atha ākṛtipakṣe'pi vyaktilakṣaṇayā tāni upapadyante ityucyate, tadā etadapi śakyameva vaktuṃ śyenavākye vyaktiḥ ākṛtilakṣaṇā iti |
avagatyā ca tṛtīyāsa- māsāśrayaṇaṃ śyenavākye kariṣyate |
' gośabdoccāraṇe hi pūrvameva avagatyā tāsu vyaktiṣu nāmārthapratītye, tadākārajñānotpatteḥ paścāt vyaktyaḥ pratīyante, ataśca ākṛtipratyayasya nimittāntarā
''dirūpo vyaktantare prayogaśca na prāpnoti, viśeṣaṇa- syānyatvāditi |
nanu guṇabhūtā pratīyate atrānyena pradhānane abhi- dheyena bhavitavyamiti |
yadi vicakṣāvaśena arthāt guṇatvaṃ prādhānyaṃ vā bhavati, bhavatu nāma, na tāvatā śabdābhidheyatvaṃ vyāha- nyate |
yadā cāsau śabdenābhidhīyate, tadā guṇatvaṃ naiva pratīyate, tena arthāt guṇatvapratītidoṣaḥ |
nanu pūrva pakṣokteḥ kāraṇaiḥ vyaktyaiva śabdārthatvaṃ yuktam |
vyaktya- ntare prayogo na prāpnotīti cet, ākṛtiścihnabhūtā bhaviṣyati |
yathā anabhidhīyamānamapi kākanilayaṃ devadattagṛhasadṛśaṃ svārthamabhidhattaḥ cihnabhūtāṃ pratipadyate, tadvat ākṛtiḥ cihna vyaktyabhidhāne bhaviṣyati |
bhāṣya- kāreṇa tu daṇḍi'śabdo dṛṣṭāntatvenopāttaḥ; yathā tena na nāma kila daṇḍo'bhidhīyate, atha ca daṇḍaviśiṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ pratyāyyate, tadadākṛtāvapīti |

nanu daṇḍiśabde prakṛtyā daṇḍo'bhidhīyate eva, kathamucyate 'na ca tāvat daṇḍo'bhidhīyate' iti, kathaṃ ca upalakṣaṇatvena ākṛtau upanyastāyāṃ viśiṣṭaḥ pratyāyyate iti viśeṣaṇa dṛṣṭāntatayā upanyastamiti |
yathā pratyayena na ca tāvat daṇḍo'bhidhīyate, atha ca tadviśiṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ pratyāyyate, tayehāpi bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ |
yattu upa- lakṣaṇopanyāse viśeṣaṇasya dṛṣṭāntatā na yukteti, tadupa- lakṣaṇasyāpi viśeṣakatvāt na codyam |
yadā, kena cit sāmānyena dṛṣṭāntatā bhaviṣyati anabhidheyatvena viśeṣa- ṇatvena ca ityuktam |
tataśca samyagbhihitaṃ, yathā daṇḍiśabde tadadaśāpi bhaviṣyati |
evaṃ ca aprasaṅgāti- prasaṅgo na bhaviṣyataḥ iti |
yuktaṃ devadattagṛhasya puruṣasya ca kevalasya abhidhānaṃ, viśiṣṭa- pratītāvapi kākanilayapadayoḥ pratyakṣa-daṇḍaśabdavat |
na tu gotvasya asaṃnihitasya iho- palakṣaṇatvaṃ yujyate |
na ca daṇḍaśabdavat tadadaśatvena gotvābhidhānaṃ pratīmaḥ |
ataśca yadi tāvat gotvamabhidhīyate, tataḥ tadeva uktaina nyāyena vācyaṃ bhavet |
na ca yathā daṇḍiśabdaḥ kevale daṇḍe na prayujyate iti viśiṣṭavacano- 'vadhāryate, tadadākṛtau prayogābhāvāt viśiṣṭavacano 'vadhārayituṃ śakyate |
dyenacityādau ākṛtau prayoga- darśanāt anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ ca jātireva vācya, ityava- dhāryate, dyenacityādye kevalayāmākṛtau prayuktatvāt, ka cidapi ca ākṛtyā vinā vyaktimātre prayogadarśanāt |
evaṃ ye'pi saṃbandhasamudāyādayaḥ pūrvapakṣāḥ, te'pi uktena nyāyena nirākṛtāḥ |
na kriyā syāditi cedarthāntare vidhānaṃ na dravyamiti cet |
bhāṣyaṃ - atha yaduktaṃ na kriyā saṃbhavet 'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti |
anyadarśanavacanaṃ ca na syāt 'anyaṃ tadrūpaṃ' iti |
bhāṣyaṃ - ākṛtyarthatvecchabdasya yathāḥ vyakteḥ ākṛtyā saṃbandhaḥ, tatra prayogaḥ |
prokṣaṇa hi dravyasya karta- vyatā śrūyate |
katamasya ? yat yajatisādhanaṃ apūrva- prayuktatvāt, nākṛteḥ aśaktatvāt |
sa hi ākṛtiṃ pratyāyayiṣyati, ākṛtiḥ pratītā satī prokṣaṇā- śrayaṃ viśeṣayiṣyati |
evaṃ 'ghaṭ deyā gāvo dakṣiṇā' iti dakṣiṇā- dravye saṃbhavātḥ proktavye 'gāvaḥ' iti ākṛtivacanaṃ viśeṣakaḥ |
tasmāt goḥ aśvaḥ ityevamādayaḥ śabdāḥ ākṛtyabhidhāyakā iti siddham |
bhā - ye tu ālabhamanādicodanābhāvādayaḥ 'na kriyā syāt' ityetatsūtrānubhāvitāḥ pūrvapakṣoktā hetavaḥ, teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ anena sūtreṇa parihāro'bhidhīyate |
dravyaṃ ca apūrvasādhanaṃ, yāgena svasiddhayarthaṃ āśritatvāt, nākṛtiḥ; asamarthatvāt |
tadabhidhānaṃ tu dravyaniyāmārthaṃ pratipattavyaṃ, na svārthe, jāterana- pekṣitatvāt adṛṣṭārthatvaprasaṅgāt, sādhanaprāptītyeva |
yadapi jāteḥ prātipadikāmihitāyāḥ karaṇatvaṃ pratīyate, tadapi dravyaniyāmakatvenaiva na sākṣāt, ayogya- svāt |
tena ākṛtyabhidhānasya dravyaniyāmārthatvāt; dravye ca ālabhanaprokṣaṇasaṃkhyākārakasāmānā- dhikaraṇyadisaṃbhavat adṛṣṭatā |
tadāha 'prayogasyā- vibhāgaḥ' iti, ākṛtipakṣe'pi ālabhanādiprayogasya dravyadavibhaktatvaiveti |
athavā, ākṛtyabhidhānasya dravya- niyamārthatvāt uktavat prayogasya vibhāgaḥ |

yadvā, ākṛtivyaktyoḥ atyantabhedābhāvāt kadā cit vyakti- rūpeṇa dravyamamidhīyate, kadā cit sāmānyeṇa yathā citrakṣitaṃ, tathā śabdasya ubhayarūpavattvatvāt vyaktimabhi- dhāne'pi na prayogasya vibhāgo nānārūpeti |
jātervā vyaktitaḥ atyantabhedābhāvāt vyaktau kṛtā dharmāḥ jāto kṛtā eva bhavanti, iti na prayogasya vibhāgena prayojana- miti |
yadvā, ākṛtivyaktyoḥ ubhayoḥ yāgārthatvāt dharmāṇāṃ ca yatrakacana yāgasādhane kṛtānāṃ prayojanavattva dravyadavibhaktatveti |
tasmāt ākṛtipakṣe'pi ālabhama- nādisaṃbhavāt ākṛtireva śabdārthaḥ iti siddham |
śā - idānīṃ vācakamajñāt vācyaviśeṣapranyate, kimākṛtiḥ, uta vyaktiriti |
tatra yadi lokevedayoḥ śabdārthānāmanyatvaṃ bhavet tata idamanārambhaṇīyam |
... tena ākṛtyadhikaraṇopauddhātatayā lokavedayoḥ padapadā- rthānāṃ anyatvānanyatve vicāryate |
... anye iti prāpte abhidhīyate 'pratyakṣapratyabhijñānād varṇakatvaṃ prati- ṣṭhitam |
' evaṃ siddhe vicāryate, kiṃ ākṛtiḥ śabdārthaḥ, uta vyaktiḥ, uta ākṛtiviśiṣṭā vyaktiḥ, iti trayaḥ pakṣāḥ prādhānyathinyante |
tena śuddhā viśiṣṭā vā vyaktiḥ śabdasya gocaraḥ |
' atraiva gurumatamāha 'gavādiśodanā no mā jātivyaktyor- nirṇayat |
' bhāṭṭa - tatrāvaghātādikriyāṇāṃ liṅgakārakasaṃkhyā- dīnāṃ ca jātau ayogyātvāt gauḥ śukletyādisāmānādhi- karaṇyanirdeśācca vyaktivācitvameva |
na caivaṃ jātinodhānā- pattiḥ, lakṣaṇā''dinā tadvotropapatteḥ |
tathāhi, na śaktigrahasya svātantryeṇa kāra- ṇatvaṃ, api tu lāghavāt śaktyatvādidantvena ghaṭapadavattvā- jñānasya |

ataścāsanyate ghaṭatvaṃ dharmitā''vacchedakīkṛtya śakyatvasaṃbandhena ghaṭapadakārakasya jñānasya ghaṭo ghaṭapada- vāni tyākārakasya viśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena viśiṣṭaśabdabuddhi- tvā''cchinnaṃ prati kāraṇatvam |
bhavanmate tu ghaṭatvatvaṃ dharmi- tā''vacchedakīkṛtya tadvācyam |
ataśca ghaṭatvasya ghaṭe- tārāvacchidādirūpasya anekapadārthaghaṭitasya praveśāt tatra kāryakāraṇabhāve gauravam |
iti prāpte, ghaṭatvaṃ dharmitā'vacchedakīkṛtya śakyatvasaṃbandhena ghaṭapada- vācyatāyāḥ kāraṇatvaṃ vinigamanāviraheṇa anantakārya- kāraṇabhāvaprasaṅgāt|
asamante tu ghaṭapadaṃ dharmitā'- vacchedakīkṛtya śakyatvasaṃbandhena ghaṭatvavattāniśśrayasya ghaṭa- padaṃ ghaṭatvavadityākārakasya kāraṇakalpanāt lāghavam|
na ca mayāpi viparītamāpādayituṃ śakyaṃ, tathā sati ghaṭa- tvasya dharmitve svarūpeṇa tasya dharmitvāgogāt ghaṭatvatvena tasya praveśe gauravarasya tyaktavyoktvāt|

ato na ghaṭatva- tvācchinnaṃ ghaṭatvaṃ śakyatvasaṃbandhena ghaṭapadavācyakāraka jñānaṃ kāraṇaṃ, api tu ghaṭapadaṃ śakyatvasaṃbandhena ghaṭatvadi- tyākārakameva, jāteḥ svarūpeṇa prakāralopyato ghaṭatva- tvasyāpraveśāt|
na ca samavāyena anyaprakāratve eva jāteḥ svarūpeṇa prakāratā, na saṃbandhāntareṇetyatra pramāṇa- masti, parairapi tathā'nabhyupagamācca|
ataśca kāryakāraṇa- bhāve'pi lāghavāt ghaṭatve eva śaktiḥ|
evamaruṇādiṣabdadānāmati guṇe eva guṇetva vā, na tadviśiṣṭadravye|
vyaktistu tṛtīyā''dikhale 'paṅkhyā yajeta' 'aruṇayā piṅgākṣyā krīṇāti' ityādau naiva padādbhāsate, jātiguṇayoreva vyaktiparicchedadvārā kāraṇatvopapatteḥ|
dvitīyā''disrale tu jātiguṇayoḥ karmatvānvayāyogyatāvat vyakterlakṣaṇayā bodhaḥ|
prayo- janaṃ pūrvapakṣe rathaṃtarādiśabdānāṃ ṛcāvitvāt 'rathaṃtara- muttarayogyāti' ityādau uttarapadopalakṣyottarākāryāyoḥ: ṛgvidhānam|
' laukikavaidikānāṃ śabdānāmananvaye anārambhaṇī- yamevedaṃ ākṛtyadhikaraṇaṃ syāt|
tadupamānanyatve tu loke kṛtaḥ śabdārthanirṇayaḥ tatrānupayuktatve'pi vede upa- yukto bhaviṣyati ityadhikaraṇapodghātatvena lokavedayoḥ padapadārthānāṃ anvayānanvaye vicāryate|
ku. 1|3|1| 27 pṛ. 80. yasyāpi hi dravyaṃ kārakaṃ, tenāpi śaktiḥ viśeṣaṇatvena avaśyamabhyupagantavyā, tadrahitadravyavyāpārā- saṃbhavāt|
tataśca ākṛtyadhikaraṇaśakterevābhidhānaṃ iti dravyaśabdena saha sāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapattiḥ|
vā. 3|4|4|13 pṛ. 933. ākṛtyadhikaraṇe 'adravya- śabdatvāt' iti sūtravyākhyāne 'aruṇayekāhāyanyā piṅgākṣyā gavā somaṃ krīṇāti' iti gopadamārganāt iti vārtikakṛtā uktam|
bāla. pṛ. 167. ākṛtyadhi- karaṇe avaghātādidravyasya jātivyakteyoḥ arthatā-
6|1|12 pṛ. 1350. atra mūlānuyāyinaḥ ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena guṇamātrāvacchinnasiddhau ka cit dravyapratītiḥ niruḍalakṣaṇayā tāmādāyaiva ca matub- lepādyanuśāsanāni |
kau. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 167. aruṇā ityādi ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena aruṇā- śabdasya guṇamātrācalatve'pi 'kevalaṃ guṇābhidhāna- daśāyāmapi viśeṣabhūtāt āśrayato liṅgavacane bhavataḥ' iti khīlitam |
soma. 9|1|9. aruṇāśabda- syāvat ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena aruṇatvavinānātvapakṣe aruṇatvajātivacanaḥ |
kau. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 166. ākhyāta- vācyā bhāvanā kartāraṃ vinā anupapannā tamākṣipatī, ākṣepādeva kartuḥ pratipattisaṃbhave kimiti tadātmakatvaṃ ākhyātasya kalpanīyam |
na ca vinigamanāvirahaḥ kṛtimān hi kartā, evaṃ kṛteraiva bhāvanāparaṃparayā ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena ākhyātavācyatvasaṃbhavena tadataḥ kartṛtvāccatvaṃ na kalpanīyaṃ, gauravaprasaṅgāt ityuktamiti |

anyatrāpi- ākhyātavācyaḥ kartā iti vādino'pi mate 'devadattaḥ pacati' iti sāmānyādhikaraṇyaṃ tanmate, tanmate ākhyātena tṛtīyatvān niṣkṛṣṭaśaktimātraprakṛtaikārakābhi- dhānāt śaktimaddravyasya ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena anabhi- dhānāt ityuktamiti |
sāhastrī. 854. ṛgādi- śabdaḥ jātiparaḥ san ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena ākṣepalavdha- tadāśrayamanaḥparaḥ syāt, na tu vedaparaḥ lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt |
ku. 3|1|1|1. śakteḥ śaktimato vā kārakatve śaktaireva ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena ākhyātaviṣayaṃ kṛdante- ṣvapi vācyatvāt |
su. pṛ. 1444. 'siṃho devadattaḥ' ityatra anāropyaiva siṃhatvaṃ tatsāhacaryādādipratītirbhavati |
sā ca kiṃ śabdāt atha arthāt ityanyacchatāṃ anvayavyati- rekābhyāṃ ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena arthāt iti niścayo jāyate |
jāyate na tvabuddhe'rthe siṃhaśabde śrute'pi naḥ ||
' vā. 4|1|12|23 pṛ. 358. svargaśabdaḥ śrutismṛtipurāṇādiṣvattu duḥkhamiśrasukha- bhogyogyadeśaviśeṣavācī ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena tādṛśa-
bhāṭṭa. 6|1|2 pṛ. 219. ākhyātasya ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyāt śakti- mātrābhidhāyitve kṛdantavat svabhāvataḥ śaktimaddravyapara- tvāt |
su. pṛ. 1441. ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyasya svarūpaṃ 'viśiṣṭayarthaṃ nedamagrahīt viśeṣaṇam' iti |
vā. 3|4|143 pṛ. 919. ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyasya svarūpaṃ - 'sarvaisihyeṣu yat sāmānyaṃ tadvacanaḥ śabdaḥ' iti sthito nyāyaḥ |
vā. 1|3| 9135. ākṛtyabhidhānapakṣe sattā-sattu-bhāva- dravyābhidheyaṃ mahāsāmānyameva gosattā''dirūpaṃ vācyaṃ iti ke cinmanyante |
ākṣepaḥ arthāpattiḥ samānavittavedyatvaṃ vā niruḍalakṣaṇā vā |
maṇi. pṛ. 120-21. ākṣepaḥ vidhāyakasya ātmani saṃcāraṇaṃ prayuktirvā |
su. pṛ. 820. ākṣepe sati adhikaraṇasya prayojanaṃ na vaktavyam |
su. pṛ. 789. ākhyā caivaṃ tadarthatvāt ityanenaivādhikaraṇa- ṇena (3|1|6|23) [te sarvāthāḥ iti idaṃ adhi- karaṇaṃ 6|1|9|139-40] siddham |
satyaṃ siddhaṃ, na tu tatra virodhāvirodhī vicāritau |
iha tu yogyatvaprakaraṇa- viśeṣāt sarvārthatvaprasaktyā virodhamāśaṅkya pariharati, uttaravivakṣayā vā anuvadati ityapunaruktam |
kramo yathā viniyojakaṃ pramāṇaṃ evaṃ ākhyā ca ākhyā''pi viniyojakaṃ pramāṇam |
ādharyavayaṃ adhyayauḥ karma iti samā- khyā yajurvedavihitakarmaṇaḥ adharyuṇā saṃśravodha bodhyate |
yajurvedasya ādharyavaṃ iti samākhyā iti yajurvedavihita- karmaṇo'pi sā |
ke. ākhyātāni iti bhāvaśabdān paryāyaśabdeno- padeśati |
6|1|1042. ākhyātena bhāvanā ucyate, sā na kartāraṃ vinā'nupapannā tamākṣipatti |
nanu kimiti evaṃ varṇyate 'ākṣepamabhyaḥ kartā' iti, ākhyātavācya eva kiṃ na syāt, ākhyātaśravaṇe bhāvanā iva karturapi pratipatteḥ |
na ca bhāvanayaiva ākṣepasaṃbhave kimiti tadātmakatvaṃ kalpanīyaṃ iti sāṃpratam |
tathā sati ākhyātavācya- katvaiva bhāvanā''kṣepabhave tadātmakatvamapi na syāt |
kiṃca bhāvanāyāḥ na kevalaṃ kartaiva saṃbandhaḥ, kārakāntare- ṇāpi saṃbandhāt |
ataḥ sā na jhaṭiti kartāramevākṣipeta viśeṣābhāvāt |
kartā tu bhāvanayaiva saṃbadhyo na kārakānta- reṇa, 'guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādisaṃbandhaḥ samatvāt syāt' iti nyāyāt ( 3|1|12|22 ) |
ataḥ sa jhaṭiti tāmākṣipeta iti sa evākhyātavācyaḥ |
bhāvanā tu ākṣepamabhyaiva kiṃ na syāt |
(svīkriyate hi siddhāntinā yathā paktā ityādi kṛdanteṣu kartuḥ śakyatvaṃ bhāvanāyā- ākṣepamabhyatvaṃ, tathaivākhyāte svīkartumucitam |
ākhyāta- vadvā kṛdanteṣvapi bhāvanā eva śakyatvaṃ vaktumucitam |
atha tatra liṅgasaṃkhyā''nvayāya kartuḥ śakyatvamaṅgīkriyate, tarhi ākhyāte'pi saṃkhyā''nvayāya aṅgīkriyatām |
athā- khyātasthale kārakānyāyāya bhāvanā''bhidhānasyāvaśyakatvāt karturākṣepaḥ, tarhi 'kāṣṭhaiḥ pakkaḥ' ityādiṣu kārakānva- yāya kṛdanteṣvapi bhāvanā''bhidhānāpattiḥ |
atha kṛdanteṣu kartrādeḥ ākhyāteṣu bhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyapratīterabhidheyatva- syetyucyate |
kiṃcaivaṃ tṛtīyā''divibhaktīnāmapi karaṇādivācakatvaṃ na syāt, teṣāmapi kartṛtvākṣepeṇa lābhasaṃbhavāt |
kiṃca yadi kartā na vācyaḥ syāt kathamevaṃ tadanvayāt |
anyathā udāhilo- pasaṅgaḥ (tatsasamayapuroḍāśeṣu peṣaṇakāle pratyakṣopasthitamāṃsā- mī, ko, 102

nitkriyāprakāśanena kurvatā mantreṇa prākṛtakāryasiddherna māṃsa- masīti ūhaḥ syāt, upamitaprakṛtividhilakṣitaprākṛtā- jhopakāraviśiṣṭaṃ [ upamitena prakṛtividhinā lakṣitaiḥ prākṛtānāmajñānāṃ upakāraiḥ viśiṣṭaṃ ] bhāvanāṃ vidadhataśca vikṛtividheḥ nairākāṅkṣyasaṃbhavena nātideśatvaḥkalpanā syāt ) |
kiṃca 'devadattaḥ pacati' iti sāmānyādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt |
nahi kevalaṃ bhāvanāvācakasya ākhyātasya devadattapadena sāmānyādhi- karaṇyamupapadyate, ekārthaniṣṭhatvābhāvāt |

'laḥ karmaṇi' iti vyākaraṇasmṛti- virodhastu karturanabhidheyatve spaṣṭa eva ( 'kartari kṛt' ityasmin sūtre hi kartāra iti padaṃ kṛdabhidheyatāṃ kartāraṃ pratipādayati ityavivādaṃ, tasmācca 'laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti sūtre kartarītyanuvṛttyā niṣpa- mānameva 'laḥ kartari' iti sūtre kartṛlakārāmidheyatvaṃ bodhayati, abodhakatve vā tiṅāmiva śṛṅgānnacorapi lādeśatvāviśeṣeṇa tatrāpi karmanabhidhānamāpadyeta |
tataśca 'jajñyamāno''nubudhyāt' iti vihitajapasya na ṛtu- yuktapuruṣadharmatvaṃ syāt ) |
kiṃca karturanabhidheyatve deva- dattena pacatīti prayogaḥ syāt |
tṛtīyā hi anabhihi- tayoḥ kartṛvācinau tṛtīyā syādeva |

karturabhidhāne tu abhihitatvādeva tṛtīyā na prāpnoti, tasyāḥ anabhihi- tetve, prathamāyāḥ abhihitakārakavibhaktitvāt, ( atho- cyeta 'laḥ kartari' ityasya tṛtīyā''dividhāyakasūtrasya ca hyorvirādhe'pyekavākyatvena kartrādisaṃkhyāmevavacanādi tṛtīyekavacanādi ca vidhīyate, tatsakṣādhikāraprāptamanabhi- hitatvaṃ saṃkhyāyāmanveti viśeṣaṇatvena pradhānagāmitvāt |
ataḥ pacatītyanena karturanabhidhāne'pi kartṛsaṃkhyāyā abhi- hitatvānna devadatteneti tadātmakatvabhaktiprasaṅgiriti |
itsa- ntena laḥ ityanena niranubandhalakārasāmānyagrahaṇamaṅgīkṛtya 'vartamāne laṭ' ityādi vihitasya lasyādeśabhūte dviva-
[ nanvevaṃ pacyate ityādāvapi bhāvanā''śritakartrā saṃkhyā''nyāpattiḥ, tanniṣṭhe karmaṇidhānāśritatve apa- siddhāntaḥ, na syācca devadatteneti tṛtīyā karmavidhānamiti cet, na |
yato bhavadbhiḥ śabdaśaktivaicitryamahimā yathā kartṛkarmorabhidhānavyavasthā āśrīyate tulye'pyā- khyātve, tathā asmābhistadarthenaiva kartṛkarmalakṣaṇavyāva- syā'pi śakyate evāśrayitum |
āśrīyate ca śaklarūpaśabdayo- rguṇatvātiśayaviśeṣe'pi śakticaraśenaiva dravyalakṣaṇā''da- bhāvasya ca vyavasthā |
' ( ślokaṃ nyācche - ) iha keṣu cidartheṣu abhidhānadeva lakṣaṇā- śaktirapi anādikālapravṛttatvena nirūḍhā yathā śuklādiṣu |
keṣu cit kriyate yathā 'rathāṅganāmā cakravākaḥ' iti |
keṣu cit punaḥ : kartṛmapi na śakyate yathā śabdasparśa- rūparupagandhepu |
kathaṃ punaḥ iha aviśiṣṭe saṃndhe sati na lakṣaṇeti ? tatrottaraṃ abhidhānavat iti |
yathā bhavataḥ samāne guṇaśabde śuklādīnāṃ guṇopasarjanadravyavacanatvaṃ na rūpādīnāṃ, evaṃ mama lakṣyate ( vā. 314|6|12 pṛ. 683 |
) nanvevaṃ śaktyantarasvīkāraṃ paramatānatra viśeṣa iti cet |
parigṛhyateta bhavadevena abhidhānaśaktyaiva abhidheyāvināmāvo'pisthatārthatātparya rūpayā lakṣaṇāśakti- śabdārthatvāditi |
yathā''huḥ 'yathaiva ka ciduktvā- 'pi karmānyatra na vakṣyati |
' ( ślokaṃ vyācche - ) yo hi manyate karmaṇaḥ ka cit tiṅabhihitasaṃkhyā''haṃ dadhaṃ, ato'nyāpi tena bhavitavyamiti, tasya ka cit tiṅa- nābhidheyatvadarśanāt sarvatra abhidheyatvamāptu |
aya tad kartṛcit vyavatiṣṭhate, tataḥ saṃkhyā'pi tathaiva vyava- sthāsyate iti anyoyametat |
yadvā uktanyāyena ākhyātajanyapratītiviśeṣavyā- rāntye saṃkhyā''nyaniyamāṅgīkaraṇāt tattviddhiḥ |
ke cittu yattroṇaśabdābhyāṃ gavāśvau anabhidhāya tadtatvayoviśeṣa- rūpaviśeṣābhidhānavat kartṛkarmapratyāyanāya tadtasaṃkhyā''- bhidhānamaṅgīkṛtya tanmahimnaiva kartṛkarmatītvavyavasthāmāhuḥ |
anubhūyate hi gavāśvau vatsalatvatvāvāntarabhedī pratyakṣeṇeti saṃbhavataḥ tadabhidheyau, nānubhūyate ca saṃkhyā- ''vāntarabhedaḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ |
tatsaṃkhyā tu ākhyātataiva pratīyate iti na tatrāpekṣā |
yathā āhuḥ 'saṃkhyāyāṃ kārake vā dhīrvibhaktyā hi pravartate |
ubhayaṃ cātra tat siddhaṃ bhāvanātiṅ- vibhaktiḥ |
' 'pacati devadattaḥ' ityatra kartṛtvaṃ tāvat bhāvanaiva bodhitam |
yatra tu nākhyātena tadvā saṃkhyā''khyāte, tatra bhavatyeva tṛtīyā yathā ‘devadattena odanaḥ pacyate’ iti |
tasmācca karturnibha- dhāne kiṃ cit dūṣaṇam |
[ yadi ca kartā ākhyātāvācyaḥ syāt, samidādiṣu saṃnipātitvaprasaktyā kartṛtvena vidhiḥ syāt |
bhavatviti cet 'sthāṇau sthāṇvahutiṃ juhoti' iti vihitā āhutiḥ kartuḥ saṃskārikaiva syāt, na yūpasya |
yūpa- yathaiva hi tasyāḥ śrutibaloktaṃ daśame (10|1|6|10) |
iyāṃstu kartari yūpoddiṣṭo, yadyapi juhotītya- mihitaḥ kriyā ca sākṣātsaṃbaṃdhyā |
na cāstu yūpārthatva- siddhāntabhaṅga iti śakyam |
'atastvaṃ deva vanaspate śatavalśo viroha' iti āhuti mantre devādipadāmihita- yūpatātiśayaprakāśanānupapatteḥ |
na ca tatra tadarthaiva yūpārthatvasiddhiḥ, nyāyaviruddhamantraliṅgasya akiṃcitkara- tvāt |
kiṃca upāṃśuyājasya vākyāntareṇa yāgāntara- sādhāraṇyena sidhyataḥ phalasaṃbandhāt 'antarā yajati' iti svadoṣasthitakartṛsaṃbandhaḥ śīghraṃ bhavati iti samidāde- satkāryatvameva syāt |
avagataṃ ca 'yajamānaḥ ājyama- vekṣate' iti kartuḥ prayojanavattvam |
āgneyādivākyeṣu tu saṃskārārhakartṛbhirbhāvyavyākhyātātvāt teṣāṃ pradhāna- vākyena phalasaṃbandhaḥ |
bhavatvevamiti cet, samidādi- vadupaાંśuyājasya vaiśvadevaparvaṇatideśe sati triṃśadāhuti- śrutyanupapatteḥ |
kiṃca stotraśastrādīnāmapi yajamānasaṃskāra- katve yajamānena kartavyatā āpadyeta, tatra audgātrasamākhyā- bādhaḥ syāt |
satte ca pratipadyamānaṃ śastrādīnāṃ nādyoḥ atigarāvasaraḥ, iti tadvādhaḥ syāt |
na ca siddhānte- 'pi karturlakṣaṇayā ākṣepeṇa kopasthityavaśyaṃbhāvāt prayā- jādeḥ saṃnipātitvaprasaktyā uktadoṣatādavasthyāmiti śaṅkā- ''spadam |
atrabhāvanāyāṃ pradhānakartṛnaiva nairākāṅkṣyasaṃbha- vena pradhānakartṛsaṃkhyāyā eva cāṅgāvākye'nvayena tatra kartṛtvākṣepalakṣaṇayoranyamupagamādityevaṃ sudhībhirjñeyam |
ākhyātena hi yo'rthaḥ kartavya ityucyate, tatra etadupanibaddhaṃ 'yathā śakyate tathā' iti |
vrajati pacati ityupakrama- prabhṛti apavargaparyantam' iti śāstrakārā āhuḥ |
... yadā asya ( karoteḥ ) utpādanā'bhidhāyitvaṃ, tadaiva viśiṣṭā- khyātāsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛṣṭam |
vā. 2|1|1|1 pṛ. 376-377, ākhyātasya anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ bhāvanāparatvaṃ ... 'yāgadānāthanuṣṭhuye bhāvanātmā''- vagamyate |
' yāvāneva hi ananyalyo'rthaḥ śabdādgamyate sa sarvaḥ śabdārthaḥ |
sarvatra ca ākhyāte dhātvarthaśca tadanuraktā ca bhāvanā vijñāyate |
upakramādārabhya yāvat pari- samāptiḥ ityetāvān vyāpāviśeṣastasyārthaḥ; na yathā pākaḥ tyāgaḥ iti |
tatra hi pākasattāmātraṃ nirdiśyate, nāramya parisamāpayitavyamiti |
evaṃ ca ākhyātāyeṃ laukikā api pratipadyante |

ranyāpārāt jyotirādau ca 'etena sahasradakṣiṇayena yajeta' ityādiguṇānvayavyāpāreṇa 'etena ṛddhikāmo yajeta' ityādiphalānvayavyāpāreṇa ca śrutasyākhyātasya medā- bhedayorapārāt tadanvitasyāpi nāmno'pi medakatvaṃ avi- ruddham |
ākhyātasya nākṣepalabhye kartṛ- tvādi śaktiḥ kiṃtu ākṣepakṛtāveva |
ākhyātasya pūrvakarmaviṣayatvaṃ vinā nāmnaḥ pūrva- karmavācitvānavadhāraṇāt |
ākhyā- tasya pradhānakarmavidhāyakatvaṃ, guṇavidhāyakatvaṃ, abhidhāya- katvaṃ ceti |
ākhyātasya medakatve tatpāratantrāt guṇasya medakatvaṃ nāsti |
ākhyātasya yatno vācyaḥ pacati ityasya pākaṃ karoti iti yanārthakarotinā vivaraṇāt iti naiyāyikāḥ |
su. pṛ. 1184, ākhyātasya śrautenaiva bhāvanā''khyena arthena upayogasaṃbhavāt lākṣaṇikasyaiva tātparyānupapattiḥ |
pṛ. 1384, bhāvanāvācitvena bhāvanā''kṣepadeva kartṛpratītisiddheḥ ākhyātasya kartṛvācitvaṃ kartṛdhikaraṇe niṣedhate |
nahi dvayoḥ ākhyātayoḥ kena cidupabandhena vinā ekavākyatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
vā. 3|1|14|4 pṛ. 741, ākhyātānāṃ anekeṣāṃ ekavākyatvaṃ nimittatvādibhirvinā na ghaṭate |
'kaṭe bhuṅkte' 'kāṃsyapāyāṃ bhuṅkte' ityatra laukikāsta- drastvanusāreṇa vyavasthāṃ kalpayanti, kaṭe āsīnaḥ, kāṃsya- pābhyāmodanaṃ nidhāyate |
vede'pi 'añjalinā sakṛt juhuyāt' ityatra yadyapi dvihastasaṃyogo'ñjalistathāpi gurudevatādiprasādanārthāñjaliprasiddhasaṃyogo na bhavati, tādṛśāñjalī sakūnnāmakatvābhāvāt |

ataḥ sāmarthyāt saṃyuktaprasṛtidātmako madhyagatākāśopeta'ñjalirbhavati; evamatrāpi dravyadravyasyājyasya suvo yogyaḥ; chedanīyasya māṃsasya śastrāviśeṣaḥ svadhitiḥ; saṃhatasya puroḍāśasya hastaḥ, ityanena prakāreṇa suvācā vyavasthā |
ākhyātānāmarthaṃ bruvatāṃ śaktiḥ sahakāriṇī iti 'arthādā kalpanekadeśatvāt' (1|4|20|30) ityadhi- karaṇanyāyasya svarūpam |
ke. ā jyāmāṃ sapuroḍāśeṣu haviḥṣu amī suvasvādisthityāḥ avadānahetavaḥ saṃkīrṇāḥ, vyavasthā- pa kasya śabdasyābhāvāt |
ākhyāte pradhānabhūte viśeṣaṇaṃ vivakṣitaṃ, guṇabhūte avivakṣitaṃ, śabdavṛttena vidhīyamānaṃ parārthamucyate |

tenāyamarthaḥ, yatra ākhyātārthaḥ svavidhānārthamucyate, tatra vivakṣitaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ, yatra vidhinārthamucyate yathā 'dadhnā juhoti' iti dadhisaṃbandhavidhānārthaṃ homaḥ uccā- yate, tatra dvitīyapadasaṃbandho nāsti, vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
vā. 6|4|123 pṛ. 1444, ākhyāte śaktatā''- vacchedakaṃ ladādikaṃ jñānivṛttitvādipratyayāt, artha- pratyayasya ādeśisaraṇāt iti cet |

anye tu jñānibhūtalādikamajānato'pi arthapratyayāt, śabdādīnāṃ sādhutvārthe kalpitatvena prativyākaraṇaṃ bhinnatvena ca tatra śaktigrahasaṃbhavāt ādeśavṛttitvādimātrameva śaktatā''- vacchedakaṃ, gacchetyādau śavādidikkaraṇavṛtti tat ityāhuḥ |
ākhyāteṣu bhāvapradhānatvāt na kadā cit dhātvarthasya nirṇayaṃ karaṇabhūtasya prati sthitam |
vā. 3|4|14|2 pṛ. 903, ākhyāteṣu sarveṣu karotyarthadvāreṇa bhāvayatyarthaḥ siddhaḥ |
ākhyāteṣu sarveṣu kriyā'nuṣṭhānaṃ śrūyate, na kārakaṃ kiṃ cit |
yataḥ kriyā- manuṣṭheyā pratīyate : nanu kartāramapi pratiyanti, satyaṃ pratiyanti, na tu śabdāt |
yadā kriyā anuṣṭhānavyā vidhīyate, tadā arthāta kāraka-
yaśca na śrautaḥ; na sa vākyāt gamyate |
ityācāryopadeśāt kartā śabdārthaḥ, karma ca itya- vagamyate |
'kartari śap' - 'karmaṇi yak' iti pratya- yārthe kartāraṃ karma ca samānamanti ācāryāḥ |
ucyate, na ācāryavacanāt sūtrakāravacanādā śabdādartho bhavati |
anuṣṭheyā ca kriyā pravītā satī kārakāṇi pratyayayati ityavagatametat |
apica naiva kartā pratyayārthaḥ karma ca ityācāryā āha |
nanu kartari karmaṇi ca lakāraḥ śrūyate |
nāsau kartari karmaṇi vā śrūyate, kiṃtu ekasmin ekavacanaṃ dvivacanaṃ bahuṣu bahuvacanaṃ iti tatra aparaṃ vacanam |
tatra evamabhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate ekasmin kartari, dvayoḥ kartroḥ bahuṣu kartreṣu iti |
nvena pacyādīnāmapi phale eva śaktiḥ, na vyāpāre iti |
ghaṭa ātmānaṃ bhāvayati' iti vārtikoktarītyā ca |
bandhakalpane vā gauravam, 'pacyathau vidhyate' iti prayogā- |
viklityādiphale anukūlavyāpāre ca pratyekaṃ śaktiḥ, na |
yāvat ca vyāpāreṣu pacati iti prayogā- |
na ca dhātpācavyāpārāśrayatvasya kartṛtayā sarveṣāṃ kārakāṇāṃ |
na ca ante tyajigamyoḥ paryāyatā, tatta- |
tat siddhaṃ vyāpāratvena yatnatvena vā pratyayavācyo yatno bhāvaneti |
sa ca nityaṃ sakarmakaḥ, nityasakarmakeṇa kujā ṇijantabhavatinā ca vivaraṇāt |
evaṃ ca ' svāsthyakāmaḥ svapet ' ityādyakarmakadhānāmapi svāsthyādibhāvyakalpopapattiḥ, tasya bhāvanāyāṃ karmatvena anvayāt |
na ca ' caitraḥ pacati ' ityādī tasyāḥ prathamāntapadopasthāpye caitrādau prakāratayā anvayānumantraṇāt na mukhyaviśeṣyatvaṃ saṃbhavatīti iti vācyam |

' sthālyāṃ pacati ' ' kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati ' ' khādire vīryakāmasya yūyaṃ kuryāt ' ityādī prathamāntapadābhāve'pi śābdabodhānubhavena bhāvanāprā- rakṣaṇādabodhe prathamāntapadopasthiteḥ hetutvasya vaktuma- śakyatvāt |
na ca tatra prathamāntakatvaṃ tattadvidhādhyāhāraḥ, pratyayavācyasaṃkhvāyāḥ samānapadopasthāpyatvenasaṃbhavena adhyāhārāpekṣayā lakṣaṇāyā laghutvena ca ākhyātate kartṛ- lakṣaṇāyā eva yuktatvāt |
etena ' ākhyātārthaviśeṣye ākhyātārthaviṣayaviśeṣye vā prathamāntapadopasthāpye vā saṃkhyā'nvayaḥ; ' gaganena sthīyate ' ityatra prathamā- ntapadābhāvāt saṃkhyā ananvitaiva ' ityapāstam |
' kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati ' ityatrāpi anvayāpatteḥ; ' pacati ' ityatra kṛtiviśeṣyatvobhasvīkāre ananugamāt, ākhyā- tārthaviśeṣatvādina hetutvasya ākhyātajanyopasthiteḥ hetutvāpekṣayā gurutvāt |
evaṃ ca yatra prathamā'- ntapadābhāve'pi yatnameva vācyatā'- vacchedakaṃ ityāhuḥ |
' jānāti icchati yatate karoti bhavati naśyati ' ityādī āśrayatvapratiyogitvādi niddhalakṣaṇa |
na ca āśrayatvaṃ saṃsargaḥ iti vācyam |
anyathā ' taṇḍulaḥ pacyate, caitraḥ pacyate taṇḍulaḥ ' ityādī anvayodhāpatteḥ |
tatrādipratyayāt arthapratyayasya ādeśisaraṇāt iti ke cit |
anye tu khānibhūtaṃ lādikaṃ ajānato'pi arthapratyayāt, śatrādīnāṃ sādhutvārthe kathitatvena prativyākaraṇaṃ miśratvena ca tatra śakticchedā- saṃbhavāt, ādeśavṛttitvādikameva śakyatāvaccheda- kam |
na caivaṃ ' pākabhāvanā jāyate ' ityasminnarthe ' pacati bhavati ' iti prayogāpattiḥ; iṣṭā- patteḥ |
kiṃca ' bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ ' iti smṛteḥ ( niruktaṃ 1|1 ) bhāvanāprādhānyayoccikāyāḥ sārthakatvaṃ, anyathā ānarthakyāpattiḥ |
na ca neyaṃ bhāvanāprādhānya- bodhikā, kiṃtu ' dhātvarthaḥ kevalaḥ śuddho bhāvanā ' iti vaiyākaraṇaparibhāṣitadhātvarthaprādhānyabodhikā iti vācyam |
na ca ' sarvamākhyātajaṃ nāma ' iti smṛteḥ ākhyātapadena dhātvartha eva ityucyate iti vācyam |
nāma- nirvacane tu ākhyātapadaṃ tattatkṛtau lakṣa- ṇikam |
ato'tra ' paṣṭhiṣṭhibhumo māghyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ ' itivat anekākhyātāthodeśena bhāvanāpradhānavidhiḥ |
tena ākhyātavācyalakṣya-kālasaṃkhyāmānākartṛkarmasu bhāvanāprādhānyaṃ vidyate ( bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ iti smṛtiḥ ) |
anyathā dhātvarthanirūpitaprādhānyavidhī ' prakṛtipratyayau ' iti smṛtiprāsatvena anuvāde āna- rthakyāpattiḥ |
vaiyākaraṇaparibhāṣaṇaṃ tu ' napuṃsake bhāve kaḥ ' ( pā0 3|1|14 ) ityādī dhātvarthagrahaṇameva, na tvatatvādyarthagrahaṇaṃ ityetadarthaṃ, na tu bhāvapadaśaktigrāha- kam |
evaṃ ' sattvapradhānāni nāmāni ' ( niruktaṃ 1|1 ) ityatrāpi ' pāvakaḥ, lāvakaḥ ' ityādyanekārthanāmasu liṅasaṃkhyā'nvayayoginaḥ prādhānyavodhanam |
ata eva ca ākhyātadhikaraṇe ( 1|3|15-35 ) jāti- vyaktyoḥ bodhadvayaṃ ityāhuḥ |
ataḥ anekārthapratipādakeṣu ākhyāteṣu bhāvanāprādhānyaniyamaḥ ' bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ ' ityanayā smṛtyā kriyate |

' sattvapradhānāni nāmāni ' iti smṛtyā anekārthapratipādakamudiṣu kriyāpadaṃ vinā anvayayodhājananāt kriyā'nvayaṃ vinā kārakatvavyāghātācca pradhānabhūtakriyā''nvayitvena kartṛtvādhikāraprādhānyaniyamaḥ |
kārakanāmasya prādhānyaṃ, saṃkhyā''dīnāṃ prātipadikārtha- syāpi pratyayārthaprādhānyayordhakatvasabhyatvā kārakanvayaḥ |
