saṃkhyā''dīnāṃ tu samānābhidhānaśrutyā tatparicchedadvārā kārake evānvayaḥ iti caturthe ( 4|1|11-16 ) sphuṭam |
ataḥ sarvakārakāṇāṃ bhāvanā'nvayāt siddhaṃ bhāvanāyā mukhyaviśeṣyatvam |
tatra ' abhihitakartṛkarmavācinī prathamā ' iti mate prathamā'rthakartṛtvāderbhāvanā'nvayaḥ |
vastutaḥ lakṣaṇaiva yuktā, nipātātiriktanāmārthatāyātāyoḥ medānvayāsaṃbhavāt iti |
evaṃ saṃśoṣanavibhakterapi prathamāntārthakatātvāt tadartho'pi bhāvanā'nvayī evaṃ kyā-pamul-kṛsuc-naj-ghañādyarthānāṃ kālā- dyutthabhāvādināmapi bhāvanāyāmanvayaḥ |
ṣaṣṭhyāstu kārakavibhaktibhāvāt tadarthasya upapadādyarthā- nvayaḥ iti saṃpradāyaḥ |
anye tu sākṣātparaṃparāsaṃ- ndhena bhāvanāyāmeva prādhānyena anvayo yukta ityāhuḥ |
evaṃ ca ' yajeta ' ityādī āśrayabhede'pi ekavacanopapattiḥ |
' vasāno ' ityādī pramāṇāntarāṇugata lakṣitāśraye ( daṃpatyoḥ ) tadanvayaḥ |
tatra śanikaraṇasattve kartṛtvāvanvayaḥ, yāgādivikaraṇe karma- tvānvayaḥ iti vyavasthā iti saṃpradāyaḥ |
ke cittu ' sthīyate, supyatāṃ ' ityādī bhāvanāyāmeva saṃkhyā'nvayaḥ, pradhānatvasya yuktatvāt |
na caivaṃ kṛtau saṃkhyā'nvaye tasyāḥ sattvā''pattiḥ, ityatvāt tatrāpi smṛtibodha
na ca bhāvanādye dvivacanāpattiḥ ekavacanasyaiva sādhutvāt |
'gagane sthīyate' ityādau ākhyātasthe āśrayatve saṃkhyā'nvayaḥ ananvayaiva vā saṃkhyā ityapyāhuḥ |
tatra kartākhyāte ākhyātasthitakartṛtvasya sāmānyādhikaraṇyena, karmākhyāte tadvācyayatnaprayojyatayā lakṣitaphalasya sāmānyādhikaraṇyena anvayaḥ |
evaṃ ca 'taṇḍulaminnāśritatvakarmatva-samānādhikaraṇaphalaprayojaka vyāpāraḥ' iti karmākhyāte, kartākhyāte 'devadattaniṣṭhakartṛtvasamānādhikaraṇaḥ pākānukūlo yatnaḥ' iti bodhaḥ |

evaṃ 'odanaḥ pacyate svayameva' iti kartṛkarmākhyāte odana-niṣṭhayoḥ kartṛtvakarmatvayorvibhaktyantā 'odananiṣṭhakarmatva-samānādhikaraṇaphalaprayojakaudananiṣṭhakartṛtvādi-pākānukūlabhāvanā' iti bodhaḥ |
na caivaṃ 'odanaḥ svayaṃ pacati' iti prayogapattiḥ |
'karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' (pā0 3|1|87) iti yagādividhānena tādṛśasya asādhutvāt |
ata eva tatra caitre na prathamā na tṛtīyā, kiṃtu ṣaṣṭhī iti saṃpradāyaḥ |
tasmāt 'bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ' iti smṛtaiva sarva-kārakakartṛtvādinirūpitaṃ prādhānyaṃ bhāvanāyāḥ iti siddham |
kiṃca anayaiva smṛtyā prādhānye bhāvanāyā bodhite pradhā-nasya guṇākṣepakkatvaniyamena bhāvanāyā eva kartṛtvakarmatvā-kṣepakkaṃ yuktaṃ, na vaiparītyam |
ananyalabhyasya śabdārtha-tvācca nākṣepalabhye kartṛtvādyau śaktiḥ, kiṃtu ākṣepakka-kṛtāveva |
ata eva yatra nākṣepakkaṃ, tatra nānaiva śaktiḥ yathā saṃkhyā''deḥ |
paktā pacamānaḥ pacaḥ ityādikartṛkarmakṛtā-mapi bhāvanāvācitvaṃ lāghavāt iti vācyam |
na ca ākṣe-peṇa tadbodho lakṣaṇyā vā, śaktyā vā kidapi aprayoge śakyajñānena lakṣaṇāyā asiddheḥ |
na ca kṛtau lakṣaṇā kartari śaktiḥ; lāghavā'pi prādhānyavirodhitena aprayojaka-tvāt |
bhāvakṛtāṃ tu 'pāko yāmaḥ' ityādau 'jāyate kriyate' ityādikṛtivācidhātvarthādāreṇa bodhaḥ |
atastatra dhātvartha-mātre śaktiḥ; kṛtestu ākṣepaḥ eveti siddham |

'laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (pā0 3|1|69) iti smṛtirapi 'laḥ' iti paśyatamāśritya 'dvayorekavacanaikavacane' (pā0 1|4|22) 'bahuṣu bahuvacanaṃ' (pā0 4|1|21) ityanuśāsanekāvyatvāt lādeśātivādinā kartṛkarma-gatakalādividhayā ekavacanādividhānaparā vyākhyā |
'kartari kṛt' (pā0 3|1|93) iti smṛtistu nāmārthayo-rbhedānvayānupapattena kṛtyabhidhānaparā kiṃtu kartṛbhi-dhānaparaiva |
ākhyātaviśeṣāṇāṃ mantratvena vidhiśaktiḥ tirodhīyate iti nāyamekāntaḥ |
dṛṣṭaśca mantragatā api vidhāyakatvāḥ 'vasantaya kapiñjalānālabhate' ityādayaḥ |
ākhyātaśabdāḥ ye śaknuvanti guṇavacanasahitāḥ guṇaṃ karma ca vidhātuṃ, śaknuvanti tareva te kevalaṃ guṇaṃ vidhātum |
yo hi pāpānān bhakṣayati, īpvatkarāḥ tasya mudraśaṅkulyaḥ iti |
pravṛttīnāmapi abhidhāyakatvātvaśena aidamarthyaṃ nirūpyate iti ākhyātaśabdāścintyatvāḥ kimarthaḥ punaḥ pravṛttīpādātuṃ śaknuvantīti |
1|3|176 pṛ. 247, ākhyāta-śabdānāṃ mantragatānāṃ brāhmaṇagatānāṃ ca yeṣāṃ śabdāntareṇa vidhiśaktirapagacchati teṣāmabhidhāyakatvam |
ākhyātaśabdābhidhānena nahi pradhānabhūto guṇabhūto vā artho bhavati |
yaḥ svabhāvato guṇabhūtārthaḥ, nāsau ākhyātaśabdābhidhānena pradhānabhūto bhavati |
'yāni upādeyārthāni nāmapadāni, tāni tāvat ākhyātaparantattvāt tadanusā-rīṇi santi tadvṛtti pratīkṣante |
ākhyātābhihitā saṃkhyā anabhihite'pi kartaryanveti ityutsargaḥ : ityuktaṃ kartṛdhikaraṇe |
ākhyātārthaḥ : (bhāṭṭarahasyam) pākānukūla-vyāpārasāmānyasyaiva pratyārthatvaṃ, 'pākaṃ bhāvayati' iti ṇijantabhūtādhunā vyāpārasāmānyavācakena vivaraṇāt |
yadapi 'pākaṃ karoti' iti vivaraṇaṃ, tadapi karoteḥ vyāpārasāmānyavācakāt anukūlameva |
nahi karotyartha-tārthakaḥ, tathātve karoteḥ yatarthakameva akarmakatā''patteḥ |
paceḥ phalaṃ viklattiḥ : odanavṛttiḥ : vyāpāraḥ : caitravṛttiḥ : iti vyadhikara-ṇatvāt sakarmakaḥ |
svāpasya phalaṃ sukhaṃ, tat caitra eva iti dvayoḥ samānādhikaraṇatvaṃ iti saḥ (svapiti :) akarmakaḥ |
tayadi karotiyatayoḥ : ākhyātatvaṃ, tadā eka-syaivārthasya phalavyadhikaraṇatvaṃ phalamānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca viruddham |
ata eva 'ratho gacchati' ityatra 'ratho gamanaṃ karoti' iti vivaraṇamapi saṃgacchate |
ataḥ karotibhāvarathayitvāṃ vivaraṇāt ākhyātāsyāpi phaledeyatvaṃ prakṛtadhātvarthātirikte vyāpārasāmānyaṃ vācyam |
tacca phalaṃ ka ciddhātvarthaḥ ka cicca svargādi ityanyadetat |
vyāpārasāmānyasya ca viśeṣā-kāṅkṣāpekṣitatvatā''śaṅkāyāḥ prayājādivākyaiḥ : viśeṣa-samarpaṇaṃ iti pārthavāriḥ |
vastutastu tattatphalabhedena tattadvāpārabhedena ca anugatatvalaghubhūtaśakyatāvacchedakā-bhāvāt 'pacati', pāke yatate, 'pākaṃ karoti' ityādi-vivaraṇāt ākhyātasya yatnameva śakyatā''vacchedakam |
vātarogādinā spandamāne caitre spandākurūvijātīyavyāyutaṃgorūpa-vyāpāratvapi 'nāhaṃ spandaṃ karomi, api tu vātarogā-maccharīraṃ spandate' iti pratīyatā karotyarthātmaka-pratīteḥ |
evaṃ ca 'ratho gamanaṃ karoti' ityādau anukūlavyāpāre kuñjo lakṣaṇā iti dhyeyam |
na ca bhavyarthakartṛkarmakatvāviśeṣāt karoterbhāvayatiparyāyatvaṃ, paryāyābhāve'pi 'pi bhāvayati-śakyatāvacchedakayatnatvānavacchinnaśakyatāvacchedakatvenāpi bhavatyarthakartṛkarmakatvopapatteḥ |
na ca karotyarthātmakatve yatateriva akarmakatā''pattiḥ; satyapi yatnasyaiva-thaitve dhātvarthatā''vacchedakabhedena sakarmakatvākarmakatva-vyavasthopapatteḥ |
tataśca yathaiva pacati-gacchatyoryāpārarūpakriyaive phalebhedena vyavasthā, evamehāpi vyāpārarūpayatnaikatve'pi phala-bhedādeva sakarmakatvākarmakatvavyavasthopapattiḥ |
tat phalaṃ punaḥ ubhayatratā pramāṇāntarāvagamyameva dhātvartho-palakṣaṇaṃ, dhātuvācyameva vā ityanyadetat |
vastutastu etallakṣaṇasya kaustubhoktīyasyā adhyākhyādidoṣaduṣṭatvāt avivakṣāvirahaviśiṣṭakarmakāṅkṣāśaktatātvameva sakarmakatvaṃ, tadabhāvaśca akarmakatvaṃ ityevaṃ kaustubhoktalakṣaṇaṃ yuktam |
tena satyapi arthakatve yathā 'ghaṭaḥ karmatvaṃ' ityādī
anākāṅkṣatvaṃ 'ghaṭa' ityādi sākāṅkṣatvaṃ, tathaiva yatataḥ karmānākāṅkṣatvaṃ karoteśca karmāsākāṅkṣatvaṃ ani- ruddham |
pañcādeśa svarūpeṇa karmasākāṅkṣatve'pi avi- vakṣādaśāyāṃ akarmakatvāt avivakṣāvicchedati |
ata eva 'odanasya pacyate' iti bhāve'pi prayogaḥ |
āsādi- dhātūnāṃ ca svarūpeṇa akarmakaṇāmapi māsadi kālavācye karmasākāṅkṣatvāt sakarmakatvāt 'caitreṇa āsyate māsaḥ' iti prayogopapattiḥ |
evaṃ ekasyaiva granthapātoḥ caitraniṣṭha- vyāpāravācitvarūpadharmapuraskāreṇa karmasākāṅkṣatvāt sakarma- katvaṃ, puṣpaniṣṭhavyāpāravācitvena karmanākāṅkṣatvāt aka- rmakatvaṃ ca draṣṭavyam |
ato yannārthatve'pi karoteḥ saka- rmakatvāsteḥ ; tena vibhinnamākhyātāstathāpi yanārthatvam |
evaṃ ca 'ratho gacchati jānāti icchati prayatete' ityādau yatra yatnasya bādhaḥ, tatra anukūlavyāpārasya āśra- yatvasya vā lakṣaṇa iti draṣṭavyam |
tat siddhaṃ bhāktamukhyasādhāraṇyena sarvatra ghātyarthāti- riktā bhāvanā ākhyātārthaḥ |
ataśca bhavatītyādau karotinā vivaraṇābhāvena bhāvanā'bhāvāt dhātvartha eva kārakatvānyaḥ paraṃparayā'nvayena ekatvānvayaśca iti prāñcaḥ |
nāpi tiṅādyādeśopasthāpita- latvaṃ, tathāce tiṅādīnāmekeśāṃ praveśāt śaktatā'vacche- dakānāṃ anugamane śakyatve kalpyate |
ata eva tiṅādinā lakārānupasthitāvapi śabdabodhaḥ; anyathā anekaiṣu tiṅā- diṣu tāvatāṃ śaktibhramāṇāṃ kāraṇatvakalpane gauravāt |
tadvattvaṃ ca tiṅā- diṣu iti te śaktāḥ' ityapi apāstam |
tiṅādiṣu ākhyātapadavācyatvajñāne'pi tiṅtvena pacantītyādau jñāne- 'pi bhāvanābodhāt |

✱ ākhyātārthaḥ yatra svavidhānārthamucyate, tatra vivakṣitaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ, yatra paravidhānārthamucyate yathā 'dadhnā juhoti' iti dadhisaṃbaṃdhavidhānārthaṃ homa ucyate, tatra dvitīyadadhisaṃbaṃdho nāsti, vākyabhedaprasa- ṅgāt |
rahasya pṛ. 24. ✱ ākhyātārthe pradhānabhūte saṃdhya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, parārthe punaḥ viyujya iti |
pradhānabhūte ākṛtirguṇo vā tatsaṃbaṃdhārthamucyate, tatrobhayaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ eka- sādākyādavagamyate ! tadviśiṣṭaṃ ca kṛtvā bhavati |
yatra punaḥ ākṛtilakṣite dravye ākhyātārthaḥ kītyarthe, tatra sarvaidhaiva tajjātīyasya ukto bhavati |
na tatra ekasmin nirgupte kṛtau manyeta, aparasminnapi hi ākṛtilakṣite tadukta- meva |
tatroktaṃ, apratipidaṃ ca kimiti na kriyeta |
ākhyātārthe punaḥ pradhāne na tasya ākṛtilakṣitena saṃbandhaḥ |
na ca kiṃ cit śrutaṃ hīyete |
ke. ✱ ākhyātiyo vibhaktayaḥ pacati pacataḥ pacanti ityādayaḥ |
na ca arthaprakaraṇa- śabdāntareḥ vispaṣṭaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti |
yena kena cit varṇasāmānyāt ākhyāvikāranyāyena gauṇatvena vā.

su- viddhavākyayoḥ prakṛtayāgānuvāditvābhāve paurṇamāsamāvāsyāśabdayoḥ tadācyakālayogiprakṛtayāga- nāmatvānavagateḥ, tathorvā lakṣaṇayā prakṛtayāgapravṛttāvapi darśapūrṇamāsaśabdayoḥ tātparyavadhāraṇahetusāmānyādhikaraṇya- bhāvāt, pūrṇamāsaśabdasya kiṃcirdhasāmyāt vācakapaurṇamāsīśabdopasthāpanena ākhyātabhūtapaurṇamāsī- śabdavikāravādā tato'nyatvena darśaśabdasya jaghanyavṛtti- tvasāmyāt gauṇatvaśabdoktyā viruddhalakṣaṇayā amāvāsyā- śabdakārthakalpanāt darśapūrṇamāsaśabdasya prakṛtapaurṇamāsa- māvāsyākālayogiyāgaviṣayatvāvasānaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
yathā muṣko'piṭakaṃ bhakṣaṇīyadravyāviśeṣaṃ pātayitumeva śaknoti, taduddhṛtaṃ samyaksaṃpādayituṃ vā na śaknute ityarthaniṣedhasya pravṛttiriti |
✱ āgantukānāmante niveśaḥ iti vā, āgantu- nyāyaḥ iti vā, āgantūnāṃ nyāyaḥ iti vā, āgantu- nāmante niveśaḥ iti nyāyaḥ |
etadartha eva ‘ante tu bādarāyaṇaḥ’ iti nyāyaḥ prāggataḥ |
etadvyati- pādakamadhikaraṇaṃ tu 'nārichanyāyaḥ' iti brindau draṣṭavyam |
✱ āgantukānāmante niveśaḥ iti nārichādhikaraṇa- pratipādyaḥ 'ante tu bādarāyaṇaḥ' iti sūtreṇa (5|2- 9|19) uktaḥ nyāyaḥ |
ke. abhicyane sāvitrā- dīnāṃ āgantukānāṃ dīkṣaṇīyādinakṛtyasya ante niveśaḥ iti prāṣṭa |
āgantu- kānāmanate niveśaḥ' iti nyāyena adessūtre guṇapado- ttaraṃ vṛddhidoṣapakṣasthitā tatsāhacaryeṇa tatra sūtrasvarūpaparavaṃ tasya' ityādi vivaraṇe spaṣṭamityalaṃ bahunā |
yatra kalpatvena smṛtau padārthavidhiḥ, na tu sthalaviśeṣamāgarnaṃ, tatrāpi āgantukānāmante niveśaḥ iti nyāyena ante evānuṣṭhānam |
kau. 1|2|13- pṛ. 35. āgantukānāmante niveśaḥ iti nyāyācca asā- dhāraṇānadhīnatāṃ varuṇādīnāṃ tadvidhānataye yuktam |
nyāyanirṇayaḥ 4|3|13 brasū. samājeṣu pūrve niviṣṭeṣu keṣu cit, anye avakāśābhāvāt na niviśante, tatra āgantunyāyaḥ pravartate |
yatra prāya- mikapadārthaniveśo niścitaḥ, tatra āgantunyāyāt anya- lopaḥ |
samājeṣu samāseṣu ca ye āgantavo bhavanti, te pūrvopaviṣṭān anupamṛdya nivi- śante |
samājeṣu samāseṣu ca āga- ntujano vāstvyānupamṛdya niviśate |
vāstvyakrānte deśe āganturjanaḥ asaṃbhavāt ante niviśate |
lokaṃpraṇāyāḥ pūrṇārthatvena madhyamekacitiviṣayāṇāṃ iṣṭakānāṃ āgantunyāyyena prāpto niveśo bādhituṃ na śakyate iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ‘ekaviṃśatimanubrūyāt pratiprākāmasya’ ityatra sāmidhe- nīṣu adhikānāṃ ṣaṇṇāmṛcāṃ ante niveśaḥ |

5|1|15|13-14. ✱ pūrapaprayatvena lokavyavahārasya aicchikatve'pi apo- rūpaye vede tadyogāt āgantunāmante niveśaḥ iti nyāyena abhighāraṇettaraṃ paścārdhādavadeyaṃ jādamantyānāṃ pañcāvatte iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
✱ āgamaḥ sāmāntarāṇāṃ viduṣṭastomake kratau śruta- saṃkhyāsaṃsthaye |
bhā. 10|5|16|25-26, āgamena saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ prathamottame trirabhyasya avaśiṣṭā nāṃ sāmidhenī- vidyudau |
10|5|1|27-33, āgamena saṃkhyā- pūraṇe sāmānyāpāṭhakrameṇaiva ṛcaḥ āgamabhitavyāḥ: eka- viṃśe triṇave tryaviṃśe cātirātre |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 270. āgamasya nyāyaviṣaye tātparyamāvāt, tadvi- patyabhāve'pi nyāyaviruddhārthāmidhāyitvāt tadvādhakatvaṃ bhaviṣyati (iti cenna) tātparya vinā āgamasya prāmā- mī. ko. 104
su. pṛ. 1418. tatra nāma āgamavirodho yuktaḥ udbhāvayituṃ, yatra nyāyāgamau samānaviṣayau bhavataḥ |
vā. 5|4|413 pṛ. 122, āgamavirodhe nyāyaḥ kāryakṣamo na bhavati |
āgāmisaṃnihitasvāpi atītasaṃnihitasyeva saṃhitatvādinā etacchabdena parāmarśaḥ saṃbhavati |
yathā ‘ athaiṣa jyotiḥ ’ ‘ athaiṣa viśvajyotiḥ ’ ‘ athaiṣa sarvajyotiḥ ’ iti |
āgneye ( saṃkalpa ) satraṃ, apravṛttasya viśvaji- dvidhi |
āgnāvaiṣṇava ekādaśakapālaḥ prathame trisaṃyukte prathamaṃ haviḥ rājasūye |
bhā. 11|4|12, āgnāvai- ṣṇavamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedadhavarakalpayā prātaśca madhyaṃdine ca tṛtīyasatrane ca prathamaṃ haviḥ |

bhāṭṭa. 8|1|19. ‘ āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet sarasvatī- mājyena yajeta’ iti śruteḥ mukhyasya āgnāvaiṣṇavasya vika- lpena agnīṣomīyandivikāratvāt paurṇamāsyāmāvātsvatantra- prātenaiva nairākāṅkṣyāt pāścātyasya sārasvatasya upāṃśu- yājavikāratvahetukapaurṇamāsa tantraniyamā ( ma ) pravṛttiḥ dvādaśādhikaraṇe vakṣyate |
su. pṛ. 1171. ‘ āgnā- vaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet sarasvatīmājyasya yajeta ’ iti |
) vi. 11|2|8. āgnāvaiṣṇa- vasya prathamaṃ nirvāpaḥ tato haviḥpatyavaronirvāpaḥ, vaikṛta- mukhyakramānurodhāt, adhvarakalpayām |
adhvarakalpayāmāgnāvaiṣṇavasya aindrāgnavikāratve ‘ agniḥ praṇena mantramā 0 soma gīrbhirdhavā yaṃ 0 ’ iti vṛdhanvatyo ājyabhāgayoranuvākye |
agnīṣomīyavikāratve tu vārtraghnyo ’ agnirdhṛtrāṇi 0 tvaṃ somāsi 0 ’ iti |
pradhāniṣu samasaṃkhyeyeṣu dharma- virodhe prathamapaṭhitasyaiva dharmasyānugrahaḥ ||
bhāṣyaṃ— yatra tulyasaṃkhyānāṃ pradhānānāṃ dharmaviprati- dhedhaḥ, tatra mukhyadharmaḥ kartavyaḥ |
yathā ‘ āgnāvaiṣṇavamekā- daśakapālaṃ nirvapedaparāhe, sarasvatīmājyasya yajeta ’ iti |
taduttarakālā hi tasya prāptiḥ, taddharmāṇāṃ ca |
pūrvasya kṛte kalpe uttarasya tenaiva kṛtārthatvāt svakalpo nivartate |
dup— mukhyaṃ vā pūrvacodanāt lokavat iti sama- saṃkhyayoḥ ( pradhānānāṃ ) dharmāṇāṃ ( virodhe mukhyasya svādharmya anena sūtreṇocyate |

alpabhyuvirodhe bhūyasāṃ sādhamyaṃ, alpe tu taddharmajanitamupakāraṃ prasaṅgādupajīvanti, samasaṃkhyāvirodhe tu mukhyasyaiva sādhamyaṃ itare tu prasaṅgopa- jīvinaḥ; iti yasādevaṃ nyāyayorvividhabhedaḥ—) tasmāt minne etraite adhikaraṇe, na tu vāśabdaśravaṇātṇa ekā- dhikaraṇyaṃ vṛttikārāntarakṛtaṃ samyak |
bhāṣyaṃ— anyārtho'pi pūrvaṃ prāptasya balīyastvaṃ darśa- yati |
adhvarasyeva pūrvamathāgneyīyate rūpā'pi hyeva karma- vadabhikarmeti |
( vivalakarīye tu adhvarasya pūrvamathāḥ upāyi hyetat karma yadamikarma iti— iti pāṭhaḥ |
) idaṃ cāpi, yathā vai pūrvopāsayino jaghanyavācāyinaṃ noccīyante ( nenīyante iti vicalakarīye ) nāvāsāsnītyevamevai- tat iti |
( atra ‘ adhvarasyeva ’ ityārabhya ‘ mikarma ’ ityantaṃ śrutivākyam |
‘ yathā ’ ityārabhya ‘ mevaitat ’ ityantaṃ śrutivākyaṃ, ‘ iti ’ iti bhāṣyapadam |
aya 5|1|9|20 sūtrabhāṣye ‘ adhvarasya pūrvamathāgneyapraityetat karma, yadamikarma ’ iti mudrayitvā ‘ paścāt samāmnātasya paścāt prayogaṃ

10|1|4|129 sūtrabhāṣye tu ‘ adhvarasya pūrvamathāgneḥ, upāyi hyetat karma yadamikarma ’ iti vākyaṃ, bhāṣyaṃ ca ‘ pūrvamadharasya, athāgneḥ ’ iti vyapadeśaḥ samuccaye avakalpate nāsati viśeṣe ’ iti mudritam |
jñā— yatra samasaṃkhyānāṃ dharmapratiṣedhaḥ, tatra kasya svadharmalābhaḥ, kasya vā anyadharmopajīvanaṃ iti cintāyāṃ aniyamaprāptau mukhyasya svādharmyābhilā |
tasya hi dharmaḥ asaṃjātavirodhatvāvayā nirvibhramavagamyate, jaghanyasya tu tadviruddhatvāt dharmaḥ grahītuṃ
utkarṣe sūktavākyasya na savanīyadevatāmuktakarṣaḥ; pañcanakṣatvād yathā niṣkarṣa'nanvayaḥ |
tatra savanīyatāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ devatāḥ saṃkī- rtyante - 'bhṛjjabhrindrāya harivate dhānāḥ, pūṣṇante karambhaṃ' ityārabhya |
kiṃ prāptam ? utkarṣe sūktavākyasya, na savanīyadevatāmuktakarṣaḥ |
anuyājāḥ pañcoraṅgamuktvādhamānāḥ pañca- mevotkṛṣyante, na somāṅgam |
yathā paurṇamāsyāṃ prayoge pūrṇamāsīdevatānāṃ niṣkarṣe amāvāsyādevatānāmananvayaḥ, itaratra cetarā- sām |
ṭup - savanīyānāṃ yā devatāḥ, tāḥ sūktavākotkarṣe- 'pi notkṛṣyante |
yathā paurṇamāsyāṃ prayujyamānaḥ sūktavākaḥ amāvāsyādevatāṃ notkarṣati, evamihāpi |
sūktavākasya ekadeśabhūtāni saumika- devatāsaṃkīrtanāni, 'bhṛjjabhrindrāya harivate dhānāḥ, pūṣṇa- nte karambhaṃ, sarasvativate parivāpaṃ aya yajamānaḥ' iti saṃbadhyate |
tathā, 'indrāya harivate dhānābhiḥ, pūṣṇa- nte karambheṇa, sarasvativate parivāpeṇa supakṣā aya devo vanaspatirabhavat' iti saṃbadhyate |
tānyetāni sūkta- vākya madhye uccamānāni arthavanti |
na ca savanīyānāṃ sūkta- vāko'sti, yaistasyānukāryena |
arthe- ṣṭhasaṃ ca amāvāsyādevatānāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ, itarāsāṃ cetatra |
yatkāraṇam, yā iha devatāḥ saṃkīrtya- nena pratyavekṣyante, iyamapiṣṭhā na kā cidantareti |
na ca tantrapadānāṃ (agnimaya hotāramagṇīta ityādīnāṃ) apakarṣaḥ (labhyate), yena nirākāṅkṣī- bhaveyuḥ; parārthatvāt sūktavākasa |
paurṇamāsyāmavāsāyāṃ ca tantreṇa (sādhāraṇyena) sūktavākaḥ (viniyuktaḥ prakaraṇāviśeṣāt ) tatrāpakarṣo yuktaḥ |
śā - pūrvaṃ prājāpatyaparacārasya utkarṣe abhihite prasa- ṅgata savanīyapuroḍāśadevatānāmapi utkarṣaḥ pratipādyate iti saṃbandhaḥ (saṃgatiḥ) |
toma - sūtre 'yathā niṣkarṣe ananvayaḥ' ityasya 'yathā paurṇamāsyāmavāsāyāḥ' taccaitadāpādānāṃ niṣkarṣe sati itaradevatāpādānamanvayaḥ tadvat' ityarthaḥ |
bhāṭṭa - savanīya paśau prākṛtasya sūktavākasya vikṛtaḥ pāṭhaḥ samāmnātaḥ |
sa ca anuyājotkarṣāt āgnimārutā- dutkarṣamukte iti sthitam |
tatra savanīyapuroḍāśa- devatā 'bhṛjjabhrindrāya harivate dhānāḥ' ityādinā saṃkī- rtyante, harivadādipadaiśca tathāgadevatā indra eva lakṣaṇayā
yadyapi āpastambāmmuktarītyā nirvāpe harivadā- dīnāmapyuddeśaḥ pratīyate, tathāpi tyāgavelāyāṃ indroddeśa- syaiva vācanivācchalakṣaṇayā sūktavāke tatpratipādanaṃ nāyu- ktam |
pāṅktaṃ tantraṃ savanīyaṣu puroḍāśeṣu prasyajyate iti vakṣyate |

tatrotkṛṣyamāṇe sūktavāke puroḍāśadevatāpādānā- mapyutkarṣo, na veti cintāyāṃ, puroḍāśadevatāpādānāṃ pañcanakṣatayā pāṅkyānuyājairvadakramatvābhāvena dākṣiṇāgnika- homavadanutkarṣatā tāni tāvat savanīyapuroḍāśabhakṣaṇo- ttarakālaṃ paṭhanīyāni |
ataśca tadekavākyatā''pannānāṃ tantrapadānāmi tadguṇavattvāt tatra pāṭhāvaśyakatā |
iti prāpte, tantra- padāpekṣitavādeṣāṃ na tāvat kevalānāṃ prayogāśaṅkā |
tadanu- rodhena tantrapadādyutkalpanā tu puroḍāśaviśeṣatantrapadāṃśo paśuprayuktānāmevopakāralāmena prayojakakalpanāgaura- vāpatterayuktaiva |
nahi pradhānabhūtapuroḍāśadevatāpādānāṃ anu- yājottarakālaṃ prayoge kiñcidguṇam |
pradhānaprayāsacittu bādhya- mānā'pi prayojakakalpanāgauravameva naiva duṣyati |
āgnimārutādvai savanīyapuroḍāśīyapiṣṭalepaphalī- karaṇahomayoḥ pañcarthānuyājaiḥ saha notkarṣaḥ |
āgnimāruṇyā iṣṭeḥ krame atīte somāraudrāṇā- manāgate manordevaḥ; tāḥ sāmidhenīṣu ityādyucyante |
tathā 'pṛthupājāḥ' 'saṃ satrādho' iti dve dhāyye kalpyete |
āgmīdhraḥ (ṛtvik) agniṃ 'ukṣānnāya vaśā- nnāya' iti punarucyate dvitīye home yajati |
3|8|12|124, āgmīdhraḥ samānatvādutkarṣasya (vaṣaṇaprayāseṣu uttaravedidaye'pi ) tatrāvasthita eva pratyāśravaṇe ubhau kartārau (adhvaryu pratiprasthātāraṃ ca) anugṛhṇāti |
11|2|10|14, āgmīdhraṃ (maṇḍapaṃ) āgneyyā upatiṣṭhate prakṛtayā na tu dāśatayīsthayā, jyotiṣṭome |
saṃkarṣa. 3|2|15. āgmīdhramaṇḍapasaṃsambandhanaṃ hiraṇyakeśinaḥ 'ayaṃ no agniḥ' ityanayā ṛcā kurvanti, baudhāyanāśca 'agnirmūrdhā' ityanayā |
mīnyā. āgmīdhramaṇḍapopasthānaṃ prakṛtayā 'ama ā yāhi vītaye' ityādyeyā ṛcaiva kartavyam |
(tāsthyāt tācchabdayam) nanu āgmīdhraśālā'nyāyena śālāsthitaṛtvigādīnāmapi āgmīdhraśabdavat pradhāne'pi ātmaśabdaprayogadarśanāt |
bhā. 3|6|7|18. āgneyaḥ iti yo nirapekṣāmidevatyaḥ so''midhīyate |
tenāyaṃ tadvito nāmīṣomādi- gatāmiprasādātpadyate, iti na tadarthasya devatātvamāha |
yatra tu asau nirapekṣo devatā, sa śakyaḥ āgneya iti vaktum |
vi. 8|1|17, 'āgneyaḥ kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ, sārasvatī meṣī, vabhruḥ saumyaḥ, pauṣṇaḥ śyāmaḥ' ityādekādaśināṃ devatānāmanekalāt 'meghapatibhyo medha' ityekavacanāntamantrasya ūhaḥ |
9|1|14. āgneyaḥ paśuḥ agniṣṭome ālabhyaḥ sava- nīyaḥ |
ubhayatra vihitaḥ 'yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇa- māsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' iti |
āgneyaḥ puroḍāśaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ kiṃ sarva eva āgneya dātavyaḥ śeṣayitavyaṃ vā kiñcit iti saṃdehe śeṣayitavyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇaḥ' atra āgneyaśabdaḥ brāhmaṇasya stāvakaḥ |
āgneyo vai brāhmaṇaḥ ityādau āgneyādi- śabdāḥ arthavādāḥ, na guṇavidhayaḥ |
'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇo devatayā' iti vacanena brāhmaṇasya kṛṣṇotkarṣo vidhīyate, tasya somapūrvatvameva iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
tena vacanena darśapūrṇamāsamātredevasya paurṇamāsīmātrasya utkarṣo vidhīyate, athavā paurṇamāsaika- deśasya agnīṣomīyasyaiva- eva utkarṣo vidhīyate |
karmāntaramevedaṃ ūrdhvaṃ somāt brāhmaṇasya vidhīyate, tataśca brāhmaṇasya vikalpa eva iti siddhāntyekadeśyattarapakṣaḥ |
ekasyaiva haviṣaḥ utkarṣo vidhīyate brāhmaṇasyāpi vikalpaḥ |
10|8|8| 16 pṛ. 2069, 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo bhavati' ityayaṃ yāgaḥ phale coditaḥ |
yadā vrīhayo na santi prakānte karmaṇi, tadā'pi yāgacodanā dravyamā- kṣipati |
'āgneyo- 'ṣṭākapālo bhavati' ityādau vidhiṃ prakalpya taccheṣa- tvena 'agnireso vā ita uttamāḥ suvargā lokamā- yan' ityādiḥ arthavādasvānvayaḥ |
'āgneyāḥ (prajājāḥ) iti tu sthitiḥ, bhaktimātramitarat' iti smṛtiḥ |
āgneyaṃ kāṇḍaṃ 'yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ manaḥ' ( taisaṃ. 4|1|1 ) ityārabhya paṭhitam |
'āgneyaṃ payaḥ' ityatra sāṃnāyyadharmā- matideśaḥ haviḥsāmānyāt devatāsāmānyāt balavattvāt |
āgneyaṃ ( dvitīyāntaṃ ) avadāya hutvā agnīṣomīyamavadāya juhuyāt |
āgneyaṃ kṛṣṇagrīvamālabheta, saumyaṃ babhruṃ, āgneyaṃ kṛṣṇa- grīvaṃ puroḍāyāṃ ( purohitatve ) spardhamānaḥ ' ityekatve- 'pyamedevatāyāḥ karmabhedāt medenāvāhanaṃ kriyate |
'āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti' 'puro- ḍāśa caturdhā karoti' iti ṛtvarthaṃ upasaṃhāravidhiḥ |

'āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti' 'puro- ḍāśa caturdhā karoti' ityādī bhinnavākyasthe'pi guṇā- gurogheṇa pradhānayoḥ abhedānvayaḥ ( yat puroḍāśaṃ caturdhā karoti iti, tat āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti iti upasaṃha- ro'tra, tena āgneyaṃ itipadasya itipadasya puroḍāśaṃ iti padasya cāmedena anvayaḥ |

āgneya- maṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati, saumyaṃ caruṃ, vāruṇaṃ daśapālaṃ, sārasvataṃ caruṃ, āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ' ityasyāmiṣṭau nirguṇābhidevatve āgneyakarmāṇi 'āryudā agne haviṣo juṣāṇaḥ' iti saguṇābhidevatvasyājyāyāḥ viniyogaḥ |
āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet rukmaḥ ' idaṃ karmāntaraṃ na tu dāśapaurṇamāsike āgneye phalavidhiḥ |
āgne- yasya puroḍāśasya pūrvaṃ, paścāt dadhnaḥ avadānābhighāraṇā- sādanāni yathāpradhānam |
bhā. 5|4|2-4, āgne- yasya puroḍāśasya prathamāvino vikṛtiḥ : bārhaspatyacaruḥ |
ataḥ aruṅtvāt carudharmā eva pūrvamanuṣṭheyāḥ : adhvara- kalpyām |
āgneyasya puroḍāśasya prathamamanuṣṭhānaṃ, tata upāṃśuyājottaramagnīṣomīyasya, brāhmaṇa- pāṭhāt mantrapāṭhasya balīyastvāt |
āgneya- syaiva ( paśoḥ ) prathamamupakaraṇaṃ na tvagnīṣomīyasya sāṃvatsarike cayane iṣṭakopadhāne viniyogaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|32,34, 36, tatrāpi brahmavarcasakāmasya gāyatrīcchandaskenyeva, vīryakāmasya traiṣṭubhanayeva, paśukāmasya jāgatānyeva, netara- cchandaskāni |
āgneye anuvākyā 'adhi- mūrdhā divaḥ' iti darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
āgneya kapālāṃ sarvāṃ upadhāya agnīṣomīyasyopa- dhānam |
bhā. 8|1|16|27-31, āgneya (puroḍāśa) dharmāṇāṃ śucidevatādau atideśaḥ, ekadaivatatvāt |
bhāṣya-- ca cintyate, 'āgneyaṃ kṛṣṇagrīvamāla- bheta, saumyaṃ babhruṃ, āgneyaṃ kṛṣṇagrīvaṃ puroḍāyāṃ spardhamānaḥ' iti |
tatra vicāryate kiṃ kṛṣṇagrīvasya prathamaṃ tṛtīyasya ca saha pradānaṃ kartavyaṃ, athavā medeneti |
iha tu kṛṣṇagrīvayorekadevatvāt saha prayoge kriyamāṇe na gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ |
bhedastu kālabhedāccodanānvayāt, syād viśiṣṭānāṃ vidhiḥ pradhānakālatvāt |
bhāṣya-- medastu pradānasya yukto, na tantratā |
tatra pāṭhakramā- daiksya purastāt saumyasya prayogaḥ prātaḥ, ekasyottaratra |
tayordvi saha pradānaṃ kriyata, krama upalabhyetānyatarasya |
bhāṣya-- atha vidhiviprāyaṃ kalpyeta, śrutyarthamuktvā lakṣaṇārthaḥ parigṛhītaḥ syāt |
' bhāṭṭa-- 'āgneyaṃ kṛṣṇagrīvamālabheta, saumyaṃ babhruṃ, āgneya kṛṣṇagrīvaṃ, puroḍāyāṃ spardhamānaḥ' iti śrutam |

atrālametapadānugraheṇa vākyatrayeṇa yāgatrayatvaṃ vidhāya caturthaṃ tānālametetyāhārābhyāṃ sāhityene sarveṣāṃ phalasaṃbandhaḥ, na tu spardhamānadānuṣṭhena vākyatrayameva aṅgīkṛtya pratyekaṃ phalasaṃbandhaḥ |

ataśca śravaṇāṃ paśyāgānāmeka- prayogatāsiddhau kimāmedyasya saṃpratipannadevatākatvāt sāṃnāyyavat tantreṇa pradhānaṃ, uta pāṭhakramānurodhenāpyeti cintāyāṃ, ekaprayogavidhinā sāṅgānāṃ pradhānānāṃ yauga- padyāvagatau yatra vibhinnadevatākatve tatsaṃbandhaḥ, tatra kramāpekṣayā pāṭhādinā kramaniyame'pi yatra saṃpratipanna- devatākatve yaugapadyasaṃbhavaḥ, tatra kramāpekṣā'bhāvena pāṭhādinā tanniyamogātā sāṃnāyyavat tantreṇaivānuṣṭhā- nam |

na ca prayogavidhī ekena padena anekeṣāmupādā- nāt daṇḍacakravadādavat samuhyapyurusāhityenāpyeka- kṣaṇavṛttitvarūpayogapadye pramāṇābhāvaḥ, phalāni santītyādauḥ loke ekaprayogajanakatvasya ekadeśakālavṛttitvasyāpi utsargeṇa pratīteranubhavikatvāt |
ata eva deśe vṛtto kālasyāvacchedakatā, kāle vṛttau deśasyeti prāmāṇikāḥ |
( pramāṇapratipādanaparā naiyāyikāḥ - ke. ) ataśca prayogavidhinā ekakṣaṇavṛttitvarūpayogapadyāpi
vostantratvasaṃbhave'pi saumyena tayoḥ kramādarthabhāvāt ādyasya saumyaprāptatvāt, anyasya taduttarakālatvaṃ ca tantrānuṣṭhāne bādhyateti vācyam |
saumye āgmeyo- ttararūpamaṅgaṃ tu āgmeyena saha uttarasya tantratve'pi, saumyasya āgmeyottaratvābhāvāt na virudhyate |
uttarā- gmeye saumyottaratvaṃ tu payoyāge dadhiyāgottaratvavat naiva prāmāṇikam |
na caivaṃ āgmeyājyabhāgenāpi pradhāname- yasya tantratā''pattiḥ; tatra yājyā'nuvākyābhedena bhedā- ṅgīkārāt |

iti prāpte, dvitīyāgmeye saumyottaratvasya dvitīyaāgmeyottaratvāpatteḥ ca dvitīyāgmeyottarasya ca prāmāṇikasya bādhāpekṣayā prayogavidhivyavagatasyaikasya yaugapadya- syaiva tyāgocityāt nāgmeyasya tantratvam |
payoyāgo- ttarabhāvistriṣvṛkdādau payoyāgottaratvaṃ tu payoyāgasya dadhi- yāgena tantratve'pi na virudhyate iti viśeṣaḥ |

na caivaṃ prakṛte'pi payoyāge dadhiyāgottaratvasya saumyottaratva- syāpi dvitīyāgmeye prayogavidhivyavagataprayogānurodhena pāṭhene avabodhanāt taduttarabhāvistriṣvṛkdādiparvasya ca dvitīyāgmeyena saha pāṭhabhāvāt kathaṃ yaugapadyabādhaḥ iti vācyam |
prayogavidhinā yaugapadyavācyame'pi saumyadvitī- yāgmeyoḥ pāṭhasya ananyathāsiddhatayā apūrvakarmaṇo'- katvāt |
tena yājyā'nuvākyābhedaiva yaugapadyabādho- papatteḥ dadhiyāgapayoyāgayoḥ kaścitpāṭho varjanīyatayā anyathāsiddhaḥ iti nāsau kramakalpakaḥ iti na yaugapadyaṃ bādhate |
prakṛte tu tantratvaṃ yadi vivakṣitaṃ syāt āgmeya- dvayasyāpyavaghānena pāṭhaḥ syāt |
saumyottaraṃ pāṭhāttu anyathāsiddhaḥ pāṭhaḥ apūrvamapi kramaṃ kalpayatīti yuktastena yaugapadyasya bādhaḥ |
bhā. 2|3|14|27 -29. āgmeyapuroḍāśasya havirāsādana-prayājaśeṣā- bhighāraṇasriṣvṛkdavadānāni pūrvaṃ kartavyāni, sāṃnāyyasya tu paścāt |
8|1|121-2. āgmeyayāgaḥ : aṣṭākapālasya utpatteḥ upādānasya pālanasya ca prayojakaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 106. āgmeyavat- āvāhane 'agnimagna āvaha' iti ya eva saṃbodhyate, sa evocyate 'ātmānamāvaha' iti tadvat |
bhā. 10|1|125, āgmeyavat, tadyathā 'agne pāvakāya agnaye śucaye' iti devataistatsyāt codanāsāmānyāt āgmeyasya vidhvantāyāsaḥ; tadvat |
yathā āgmeyapuroḍāśasya punarvacanaṃ pūrvapakṣe medakamuktaṃ tathā |
ke. āgmeyavat- yathā 'ṛjīpāṇāmagneyena saṃvatsaramupadhāne āsīt, sūktena sūktasyāvicchedāya' iti |
āgmeyena sūktena ityukte yāvanti āgmeyāni sūktāni dāsyantāni taiḥ : sarvairiṣṭvā upadhīyante |
bhā. 10|1|119|173. 'āgmeyavat sauryo'nuṣṭheyaḥ' iti codakavākyamanumāpya liṅgena dharmaviśeṣanirṇayam |
' āgmeyapakṣāt nirvapati ' ityatra ekadevatāyogitvaṃ auṣadhadravyakatvaṃ nirvāpaḥ etāni liṅgāni śrutāni, tāni saurye'pi santi |
bāla. pṛ. 4. āgmeyavikāreṣu abhirmanamaṃtrasya vikalpaḥ aikāpyāt (caturhotrā vā pañcahotrā vā iti) |
bhāṣyaṃ- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : 'āgmeyo'ṣṭākapālo'- māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cānyuto bhavati' iti vidhāya
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimamāvāsyāyāṃ dvirāgmeyena 'yaṣṭavyaṃ, uta sakṛditi |
kiṃ prāptam ? āgmeyasūktehetutvādvāmā- sena pratīyate, ekasyaiva punaḥśrutirviśeṣārthanarthakaṃ hi syāt, iti (2|3|12) |
kiṃ evāsau ubhayatrāpi acyutaḥ, tasyai- vaiṣā punaḥśrutiḥ kenāpi prayojanena, atha karmāntaraṃ iti saṃdehaḥ |
tatra 'sannidhau tvavibhāgāt' (2|3|13 26) iti satyapi anupādeyāmamāvāsyāṃ prati upādāne, tadeva karma iti siddhānte prāpte, abhīyate 'punaḥ- śrutirananyārthā bhedityevadhāritā |
śabdaḥ punaraccarito na punararthaḥ kartavya iti śaknoti vaditum |
yo'sya prathamamucaritasya, śatakṛtvo'pyuccaritasya sa evārtho bhaviṣyati nānyaḥ |
nanu vihitameva punarviśiṣṭaṃ vidadhat anarthako bhavati |
bhavatu kāmamanarthakatvaṃ, na tvanyaṃ śaknoti vaditum |
vā- tatra pakṣāntaramāha- avibhāgāt karmaṇo, dviruktena vidhīyate iti |
tacca dravyadevataṃ abhirmanapulyamanāt pūrva- saṃbandhyānubhavaśat ekāntena tameva yāgaṃ bodhayati |
dravyadevatamapi anyat iti cet, avibhāgapratyayopa- lambhāt |
yadi tu vyaktikṛto bhedaḥ āśrīyate, sa prayo- gāntare tasyāpi atiśayeḥ |
tasmāt vaikalpikena vacana- dvayena amāvāsyāyāṃ āgmeyavidhānam |
athavā yugapat pravṛtteḥ 'yathā syāt sattvadarśanam' ityanena nyāyena (6|1|12) tadeva karma ekena itareṇa ca pratipādyate |
kāmaṃ bhavatu anarthakatvaṃ, tadeva hi yuktvā anarthyārthamānaṃ ihopapadyata iti nārthāntarava- natvaṃ, śabdārthanityatvaprasaṅgāt |
sarvaṃ tu idaṃ anyāsādhikaraṇe (2|3|21) nirākṛtamapi sat uttarasūtradarpeṇa viśvaśrutamadhīyate, na tu paramārthena āmanarthakyābhyupagamaṃ vedaḥ kṣamate |
kimarthādena prayo- janaṃ, yadā pūrvavaiṇa vākyena sārthavādakena vihita āgmeyaḥ kamanyamarthaṃ vidhātuṃ stutiḥ prayujyeta |
stutimātraṃ yatra kasya cidvidhānārthaṃ, tadarthakamityukte ' āgmeyasya kriyārthatvādarthavattvamarthānāṃ' iti (1|2|11) |
yathā stutā vā astutā vā devatā aṅgabhāvaṃ sādhayati, evametaditi |
taducyate, anarthā vā punaḥśrutiḥ; nāmeyaṃ vidhātum |
āgmeyo'ṣṭākapāle'māvāsyāyāṃ bhavatyeva, na kevalenārthānā sa sādhubhavati, indra- sahito'gniḥ samīcīnataraḥ |

vā- sarvathā punaḥśrutijeṣu atrānviṣyamāṇeṇu guṇasyāśravaṇāt parisaṃkhyāyāśca tridoṣatvāt arthavādāya- tve'pyapagate, kasyārthavāda iti vivicya asaṃkīrtanānnuna- māgmeyasyaiveti matvā vadati- sārthavādakena vihite kiṃ pradeśāntarasthena ekavākyatāmanāgacchatā arthavādeneti |
tatra yathā stutā vā astutā vā seva devatetyavirāṇāṃ vijñāpyate kiviṣayamiti |
tacca etadatikrāntālocanena mahendrādhikaraṇe 'guṇaśrā- narthakaḥ syāt' (2|3|15|18) ityatra sūtre'mihitaṃ parāmṛṣṭamiti dṛśyate |
yathaiva hi mahalaṃ devatā''nanta- gaṃtamiti pakṣe kevalasyaivadevasya sādhanatvāt vidhyuddeśo arthavāde avasthitamarthakaṃ prāpnoti |
kartuṃ sahendreṇa punaḥ praśaṃsāṃ punaḥśrutiḥ samyaggṛhā- śritayam ||
sūtrārthastu-āgneyaḥ amāvāsyāmāvartanīyaḥ abhyāsasya karmabhedakavyoṣaktatvena amāvāsyāyāmāgneya- dravyāvamāt iti |

'bhedena pratīyate' iti vaktavye saṃpratipannadevatākatvāt yāgabhede'pi tantreṇānuṣṭhānāt anu- ṣṭhānabhede nāsti iti śaṅkāṃ nirākartuṃ yāgadvasya tantrā- nuṣṭhāne'pi puroḍāśadvayaṃ kartavyaṃ iti prayojanapradarśanārtha 'abhyāsena pratīyate' ityuktam |
bhāṭṭa - kāladvayayogena āgneyaṃ vidhāya 'āgneyo- 'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ bhavati' iti śrutam |
tatra kāladvayayuktādāgneyāt karmāntaramidaṃ, prakaraṇāntaradravyā- sādvā bhedopapatteḥ |
anenaiva vihitasya itareṇa paurṇamāsī- mātravidhistu utpattiṣkālavarodhāccirākartavyaḥ |
na caikasyaiva karmo'bhyudayaśiraskatayā vidhivyena vidhānaṃ piṅgākṣaikahāyanīśabdābhyāmivā dravyaviśeṣasye vācyam |
prakṛte tvekena vihitasya netareṇa vidhisaṃbhavaḥ; iti karmāntarameva |
ata eva amāvāsyā- yāmāgneyadvayakaraṇaṃ pūrvapakṣe prayojanam |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' iti vidhāya punarucyate 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ bhavati' iti |
so'trāpi vartate iti āgneyo dvinubheyaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
āgneyaḥ dviḥ kartavya iti pūrvapakṣe siddhānte'deśī āha |
karmaṇaḥ āgneyakarmaṇaḥ avibhāgāt vibhāgābhāvāt bhedābhāvāt dvirhakena vākyena ekameva karma vidhīyate |
sā āgneyasya punaḥśrutiḥ na dvirhakathanāya kiṃtu anyārthā aindrāgnastutyā |
kevalena agninā na tāvatī sādhutā, indrasahitena tu agninā bhūyasī sādhutā iti stutyarthā sā punaḥśrutiḥ |
tasmāt amāvāsyāyāṃ āgneyasya sakṛdeva anuṣṭhānam iti siddhāntaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' iti vidhāya punarucyate 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ bhavati' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimamāvāsyāyāṃ dvirāmayena yaṣṭavyaṃ, uta sakṛt iti |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ, anupādeyakālasaṃbaddhasyāgneyasya punaḥ śrutya 'saṃnidhau tvavibhāgāt' ityanena nyāyenāpavādāt
mā bhūt prakaraṇāntaranimittako hyāgneyadeḥ, abhyāsa- nimittakastu bhaviṣyati |
tathāpi, na tāvadāgneyayāge kiṃcidena vidhīyate, dravyadevatākālānāṃ pūrvataiva prāta- tvāt |
vidhivi ca sati vihitavidhānāsaṃbhavādāgneyādeva karmabheda iti |
evaṃ prāpte'bhi- dhīyate, anyārthā vā punaḥśrutiḥ |
bhavedevaṃ yadi aindrāgnastulyo''ya- mānneyārthavādo na bhavet |
na ca kalpayitumapi śakyate, aindrāgnaviccheda- vākyatayā tadarthavādatvenaivopāpatteḥ |
na cātra aindrāgna- stutiḥ na pratīyate iti vācyam |
ayaṃ khalvasvārthaḥ, kevalā- gnidevatātvādāgneyaḥ praśasto jñāta eva |
kartuṃ sahendreṇa punaḥ praśaṃsāṃ punaḥśrutiḥ samyaggṛhāśritayam |
(vā. pṛ. 623.) prayojanaṃ - pūrvapakṣe āgneyayāgayorbhintvāt puroḍāśa- dvayopādānam |
tautā. (Symbol) āgneyājyabhāgayoḥ : codanāpṛthakttve'pi ekā- tantryaṃ sahaprayogaḥ |
bhā. 1|4|15|22. (Symbol) āgneyājyabhāgayoḥ : avadānena homāntana (pradānāntena) anutsamayaḥ, na tu kevalaavadānena (darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ) |
idaṃ cāparaṃ śrūyate 'tau hotṛṣuḥ kimāvayostataḥ syāditi |
yasyai kasyacidevatāyai havirnirvapastaidān purastādā- jyasya yajaciti |
tasmādyasya kasyaicidevatāyai havirni- rvapanti te purastādājyabhāgamājyabhāgayorbhāmāyāṃ yajanti, tau na saumyai'dhvare na paśau' iti |
yadājya- bhāgayorbhāmāyāṃ ityete - kiṃ tatrāgnibhāgo devatāsaṃskā- rārthaḥ, uta ārādupakāraka iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? iti net saṃdehaṃ paśyasi, tathā ājya
bhāṣya-- sa eṣa vyapadeśo bhavati liṅgaṃ, prāptastu vaktavyā |
devatā'pi śrutā pradhānayāge, yāgo'pi vākyāntare ājyabhāgau yajatīti |
na hi devatāṃ vinā yāgo bhavati, tena sa devatāmākāṅkṣati |
katham ? 'abhīṣū vā etau yajasya yadā- dhārau', 'nakṣupī vā etau yajājyabhāgau', 'yadyajā ijyante varma vā etadyajñasya kriyate varma yajamānasya bhrātṛvyasyābhibhūtyai' iti |
dup-- ājyabhāgaḥ ( yāgaḥ ) devatāmapekṣate ( nirvartakatvena ), pradhānayāgaḥ ( tu ) devatāsārakaṃ ( yat kiṃ cidapekṣate ) |
tatra ( ājyabhāga- ) yāgo devatayā vinā na bhavati, na tu pradhāna-( yāga- ) devatā ājyabhāgameva ( sārakaṃ ) apekṣate ( anyā'pi saraṇasaṃbhavāt ) |
asmin vyākhyāne svāhākāraḥ ( yāgaḥ ) api evameva ( aṣṭārthyaḥ ) āpadyeta |
yadi kaścit brūyāt tasmin ( svāhākāre ) mantre yakṣyamāṇā devatāḥ ( sarvāḥ krameṇa kīrtitāḥ ) vidyante |
( na tyājyabhāge tathā kīrtita- masti iti ) |
satyaṃ vidyate ( svāhākāre mantre devatā- saṃkīrtanaṃ, tathāpi tat- ) nirvartakatvenaiva yāgo guṇabhūta devatāmākāṅkṣati |
tasmāt ājyabhāgasvāhākārayo- stulyatvāt ( dvayo'pi aṣṭārthatvāt ) kathaṃ svāhākārā- dhikaraṇam ( 10|8|10 ) |
ucyate ( svāhākāra- ) yāgo hi ( prathamadevatā ) nirvṛttaḥ ( api ) san viparivṛtya devatāprakāśanadvāreṇaivopakaroti |
tantraratne 'eva' iti, ānandāśramīye tu na kimapi ] apūrveṇa nāpekṣyate |
( vihitā hi bahavo'nye devatāsvarūpāyāḥ āvāhanaṃ, svāhākāraḥ, sviṣṭakṛnnigadaḥ, sūktavākaḥ |
iti teṣu satsu tādṛśaṃ tatkāryakatvameva anyasyāpekṣatem |
ataḥ saṃskārakatā yuktā ityāśaṅkya sūtroktaṃ mūlahetumāha-) ājyabhāgau iti ca dvisaṃkhyā ( dvivacanaṃ ) śrūyate |

sā ca kena cit ( samānadharma- ) yogena pravartate ( tena dvayorapi prādhānyaṃ guṇatvaṃ vā āśrayaṇīyam ) tatra somaḥ ( devatā ) tāvat ārādupakārakaḥ ( iti na saṃśayaḥ ), yadi agnirapi ( ārādupakārakaḥ syāt ) evaṃ dvisaṃkhyā yujyate nānyathā |
( tasmāt dvayoḥ samatvāt āgneyo'pi ārādupakārakaḥ iti ) |
vi-- ājyabhāgo ya āgneyaḥ ki mukhyāmeḥ sa saṃskṛtiḥ |
tatra saṃkhyayā karmabhede'pi ekaika- smin yāge agnīṣomayorvyavasthitirdevatātvaṃ, dvandvānte śrūyamāṇacaturthyā parasparasahitānāmaiva devatātvapratīteḥ |
atraiva dvayorapi agnīṣoma- devatāsaṃskārakatvaṃ, mantrāḥ punarmotanāyānena ubhayalakṣakāḥ |
dviruccāraṇādhikataraḥ saṃskāro devatāntare iva āvāhana- svāhākārādī na vidhyate |

athavāsu 'athāgneye somāya ityājyabhāgābhyāṃ carati' iti śākhā'ntara- vacanāt asyāpi śākhāyāṃ pratyekameva devatātvaṃ, dvitasya devatātvaparyāyyadhikaraṇābhedakatve saṃbhavati saṃba- ndhāntareṇādhiṣṭhānābhiprāyeṇa kalpane pramāṇābhāvāt |

na caikasmin vidhau ekāṃśe ārādupakārakatvaṃ itarāṃśe saṃnipatyopakārakatvamityevaṃ vairūpyāpattiḥ, āśra- yikarmāntaravat ārthikavidhvantarakalpanā tadupapatteḥ, ata eva śrayamāṇavidhau agnīṣomayogatvenaiva anvayena tathyade'pi vairūpyābhāvāt |
iti prāpte, āvahanādimantreṣu somāt pūrvottaramebheḥ diḥ pāṭhāt pūrvo'gniḥ āgneyadevatāto bhinnaḥ iti kramaparyā- locanayā avagamyate |
abhimanve''pi sa ca uddeśāṃśaṃ prati āgneyādiva guṇabhūtaḥ eva, itarathā paśau dvayo- rājyabhāgayoḥ pratyakṣabhāvena pratiṣedhānupapatteḥ |

gṛhamedhīye cāmeyasyājyabhāgasya klṛptopakārakatvābhāvena apūrva- tvānāpādakatvāt saumyapunaḥśravaṇasya vaiyarthyāpatteśca, saumyamātravidhānena apūrvakalpane āgneyāṃśe ārādupa- kārakatvena vidhau dairūpyāpatteḥ |
ataḥ prakṛtāveva tasya ārādupakārakatvāt sauryādāvapi agnidevatyameva, na tu agnidevatāyā bādhaḥ, sūryadevatāyā vā ūhaḥ iti siddham |
āgneyādīni payo'ntāni pradhānani, ādhārādīni ārādupakārakāṇi aṅgāni |

dup. 4|4|4|7. āgneyādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ vā samuccayaḥ; darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
ratna. 5|3|11229-31. āgne- yādīnāṃ pradhānatvaṃ ādhārādīnāmiva darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
ādhārau, ājyabhāgau, prayājānuyājāḥ, patnīsaṃyājāḥ, samidhayajñaḥ, sviṣṭakṛt etānyaṅgāni ) |
bhā. 4|4|1129-38. āgneyādīnāṃ phalavākye sahitānāṃ phalānye'pi yayā pratyekameva aṅgāpekṣitvaṃ tathā ekādaśo upādāyādibhyaḥ |
soma. 1|2|6. āgneyādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pradhānānāṃ saṃghasya darśapūrṇa- māseṣṭitvam |
vi. 10|1|3. āgneyādīnāṃ samastānāṃ phalādhārthaḥ prayoga uktaḥ 'darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' ityanena |
bhā. 11|2|14, āgneyādīnāṃ samucitānāṃ darśapūrṇamāsādiṣu svargārtha- phalakatvam |
tatra deśakālakartāraḥ, 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta', 'paurṇa- māsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta', 'amāvāsyāyāmamāvāsyā yajeta', 'darśapūrṇamāsayoryajñakratvoraśvāra ṛtvijaḥ' iti |
tathā cāturmāsyeṣu 'prācīnapravaṇe vaiśvadevena yajeta', 'vasante vaiśvadevena yajeta', 'cāturmāsyānāṃ yaścakratūnāṃ pañcabhiḥ' iti |
tatra vicāryate kimāgneyādīnāṃ pradhā- nānāṃ tantraṃ deśakālakartāraḥ, athavā bhedeneti |
kiṃ codanāviśeṣā deśo'pi, 'yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ' ityevamādaya āgneyādi- codanāvidhyaḥ; teṣāmime samādividhayaḥ śeṣāḥ, āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ same bhavati evaṃ sarvatra, athavā prayogārhaṃ deśadadhmiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? ekadeśakālakartṛkatvaṃ mukhyānāṃ tantramityeṣā pratiṣṭhā |
tata evaṃ tāvadvadanti, prayogārhaṃ deśadadha iti |
kutaḥ ? na tāvatte deśakālakartṛkatvaiḥ prayogo bhavati |
yacca yena vinā na bhavati, tat tantramityava- gamyate |
tatra na jñāyate viśeṣo deśādīnāmedamarthya prati |
dup— kimāgneyaḥ agnīṣomīyādinirapekṣo deśā- dibhiḥ saṃvadhyate, uta agnīṣomīyādisahitaḥ iti ( cintā ) |
atra pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ, āgneyādayaḥ ( yadā- gneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ ityevamādibhirupalakṣāḥ ) ( prasātāḥ ) |
tānanūdya aprajñātā deśyādyo vidhīyante ( 'same darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityevamādibhiḥ ), teṣāṃ codisya- mānānāṃ itikkartavyatā saṃbandhaḥ ( nopādīyamānānām ) |
tasmiṃśca ( saṃbandhe yadyapi tannābhihitā yāgāḥ, tathāpi ) āgneyaḥ agnīṣomīyādinirapekṣaḥ itikkartavyatā saṃba- dhyate |
tasmāt ( avivakṣitasāhityayogadeśena vidhīya- mānāḥ ) deśakālakartāraḥ, ( anyādhānāni ) : iti itikkartavyatā ca agnīṣomīyādinirapekṣasya āgneyasya nyāyyā, iti itikkartavyatāyāḥ āvṛttiḥ |
atra codyate, yadi āgneyaṃ agnyādhānādipradhānāntaṃ kṛtvā agnīṣomīya ārabhyate, tadā etadarthaḥ phalaprāpti prati itaretarayogaḥ ( avagataḥ pradhānavighanā ) saḥ ( atyantaṃ ) bādhitaḥ |
yathā sauryai ( karmaṇi ) āgneyena saha itaretarayogaśaṅkā ( śaṅkaiva ) nāsti, evamihāpi prasajyate |
tasmāt yadi tantreṇitakartavyatā kriyate, eva- mitaretarayogaḥ saṃpādito bhavati, nānyathā |
( tasmāt phalavākyāvagatasāhityatvaladeva deśādīnāṃ anyeṣāṃ cāṅgānāṃ tantramiti ) |
itaretarayogadamayaṃ labhyate, ekenāpi kriyamāṇena yāgena phalaṃ na prāpyate |
tasmāt ekaikasya kṛtsnā itikkartavyatā kriyamāṇā netare- tarayogaṃ bādhate |
siddhāntastu-yadyapi ayaṃ kālaḥ kāraka- vibhaktiyuktaḥ śrūyate, tathāpi ( svabhāvāt ) anupādeyaḥ |
avaśyaṃ ca ( tasya ) kriyāyā saha saṃbandhaḥ karaṇīyaḥ |

tasmiṃśca saṃbandhe ( dvayordṛśyayorādeyayorvā mithaḥ saṃbandhabhāvāt anyataredeśena anyatarasmin upādātavye kālaṃ ( anupādeya ) prati upādīyamānāt itaretara- yogādi vivakṣitam ! ( ādiśabdena tṛtīyopācaṃ kara- ṇyatvaṃ gṛhyate ) karaṇavibhaktiśca itikkartavyatā ca nopa- padyate |
tasmāt itaretarayuktāḥ trayo yāgāḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ setikartavyatākā vidhīyante |
evaṃ ca ( kāle karmavidhānāt ) dhātvartho'nyatra vihito bhavati, tatra śrutiranugṛhītā syāt |
itarathā tu parārthe ( kāla- vidhānārthe ) dhātuḥ uccāryeta |
evaṃ deśe'pi ( draṣṭavyam ( tasyāpi anupādeyatvasya tulyatvāt ) |

kartārastu seti- kartavyatāke prayoge ( phalavākyena ) vijñāte ( sati yajamānaḥ ) kathaṃ kariṣyati ( kiṃ sasahāyaḥ, uta asa- hāyaḥ ) ityetasāmavasthāyāṃ ( svayaṃ prayoge syāt ) 178818 iti nyāyāt kevale ) yajamāne prāpte vacanāt adhvaryvādayo vidhīyante |
( upasaṃharati ) tasmāt yadi ekaikai itaretaranirapekṣaṃ kuryāt, tathā sati deśaṃ prati vidhīyamānāmitaretarayogo bādhitaḥ syāt |
( tathā ) kāle'pi aṅgaiśca vinā karaṇavibhaktirvādhitā syāt |
tasmāt vacanāt ( sahitāni sāṅgāni pradhānāni prati deśādīnāṃ ) tantratā |

( atra bhāṣyakāreṇa 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta' ityanena kālavidhānamudāhṛtaṃ, tatra codayati-) nanu 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta' itya- nena kālavidhānaṃ na kriyate, utpattivākyena 'yadāgneyaḥ' ityādinā kālasya prāptatvāt ( anuvādāmātraṃ tu etat ) |
nanu, phalārthatvāt kathamanuvādāt, āha - phala- saṃbandho'pi na kriyate, darśapūrṇamāsavākyena kṛtatvāt |
api ca ( atra ) phalasaṃbandhācchaṅkaiva nāsti, phalaśravaṇāt ( tasmāt anarthakamevetat ) |
etena vākyena vinā ( utpattivākyeṣu pratyekaṃ kālaśravaṇāt, tasya ca sāṅgapradhānaviṣayatvāt ) ekaikasya kṛtsnaṃ itikkartavyatā- kāṇḍaṃ ( āgneyādeḥ ) āvartata |
sati tu etasmin vākye paurṇamāsyāṃ ye yāgā utpannāḥ, te ( sarve ) karaṇa- vibhaktikatvāt phalaṃ prati vidhīyante |
tasmāt yadi ekaikaḥ kṛtsnetikartavyatākaḥ kriyate, yattu sāhityamavagataṃ tat bādhyate |
tena ( tada- bādhāya ) itikkartavyatā prati sāhityaṃ kriyate |
tasādenana vākyena itikkartavyatā tantreṇa bhavati iti ( ayaṃ arthaḥ ) kriyate trayāṇāṃ yāgānām |
( atra codayati-) aya- masya ( vākyasya ) bhavato'rthaḥ ( prayojanaṃ ) abhi- pretaḥ |
ayaṃ ca vākyāntareṇa kriyate eva ( labhyate eva ) iti rūnapāṭhaḥ |
ityanena itaretarayuktāḥ setikartavyatākāḥ ( yāgāḥ ) deśaṃ prati vidhīyante, vidhīyamānānāṃ ca sāhityaṃ viva- kṣitam |
tat yadi itikkartavyatā āvartata, ( tadā ) yat sāhityamavagataṃ, tat bādhyate |
tasmāt asmin vākye ( sati siddhamajñānāṃ tantratvaṃ iti ) 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta' iti ( anarthakaḥ ) anuvāda eva |
pradhānasya ( kevalasya utpattivākye ) paurṇamāsī kālaḥ avagataḥ, ajñānāṃ ( tu ) anavagatāt kālasya, pañcamyāmpi prayogaḥ prāpnoti, tasmāt anena ( ajñānāṃ ) kālanīyamaḥ kriyate iti |
( tathā ) yahimaśca kāle karaṇaṃ, tasminneva itikkartavyatā ityuktam |
yā ca saṃnipatyopakārikā itikkartavyatā, yā ca ārādupakārikā, te ubhe api anena ( pradhāna- ) kathaṃbhāvena saṃbadhyate |

tatra paurṇamāsyāṃ pradhānaṃ kurvatā saṃnipatyopakārikā ( tāvat itikkartavyatā avaśyaṃ ) karaṇīyā ( na anyathā pradhānameva nirvartate ), yena prayāmena saṃnipatyopakārikāṃ karoti tenaiva ( pramāṇena ) ārādupakārikāmāpi ( kuru ) |
na ca īdṛśaḥ kaścit nyāyaḥ ( asti ), yena pradhānamātrameva kartavyaṃ syāt |
( deśaṃ prati karaṇībhūtā setikarta- vyatākā eva kartavyā bhavanti |
tacca kālaikye sidhyati, nānyathā, iti siddhaṃ ajñānāmpi tatkālatvam |
'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityanena ṣaḍapi yāgāḥ setikartavyatākāḥ itaretarayuktāḥ deśaṃ prati vidhīyante |
tatra ṣaṇṇāmapi yāgānāṃ tantreṇa itikkartavyatā prāpnoti sāhityasya vivakṣitatvāt |
( prayoga- tantraṃ tu nānyat ) tasmāt ye paurṇamāsīsaṃjñakāḥ ( yāgāḥ ) teṣāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ kriyamāṇānāṃ ( prākatānāmajñānāṃ ) ājyabhāgāntāni ( pāṭhakramāt ) kariṣyante |
eva- mamāvāsyāsaṃyuktānāṃ ( sāṃnāyyādigānāṃ paścātnāni aṅgāni ) anupājādīni ( kariṣyante ) |
evaṃ tantreṇa aṅgaprayoge prāpte 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta' itya- nena ajñānāmāvṛttiḥ pratipādyate |
api ca 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityanena itaretarayogasya viva- kṣitatvāt tantreṇa itikkartavyatā prāpyate |
tatra paurṇamāsyāṃ prārabdhaṃ pradhānaṃ amāvāsyāyāṃ samāpyate |
( prātaḥ savanā- rabdhaḥ savanīyaḥ iva tṛtīyasavane |

tena sarvo'pi pradhāna- kālaḥ iti ) paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyayorantarāle ( yatra kka cidapi ) kurvan aṅgāni 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityasya na kiṃ cit bādhate, na ca phalavākyasya ( tatrāpi itaretarayogavagamāt ) |

tasmāt anena ( paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta ityanena ) vākyena kālanīyamaḥ ( antarālakāle yatra ka cidaṅgāni ) ajñānāmanīyate, aniyatakālata ca ( ājyabhāgāntānāṃ ) paurṇamāsīkālāt, anupājādīnāṃ cāmāvāsyākālāt iti ) bādhyate |

( anena hi yāgatyasya karaṇabhūtasya kālaṃ prati upādānāt sāṅgaṃ yāgatyaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ kartavyaṃ, tathā amāvāsyāyāmapi iti trikasyatrikasya sarvāṅgayuktasya svesve kāle prayogadvayaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati iti ) |
avidhiśeṣatvaṃ karmaṇāṃ nābhisaṃbandhaḥ pratīyate, lakṣaṇāthābhisaṃyogāt codanāvidhitvācceteṣāṃ pratipradhānaṃ bhāvaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyaṃ- avidhiśeṣaṃ yadi codanāvidhiśeṣo na syādehādividhiḥ, tataḥ karmaṇāmāgneyādīnāṃ medena deśādibhirabhisaṃbandho na pratīyate |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? iha same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmitye- mādibhirvākyaideśādyo vidhīyante, aprāsatvāt |
te cedvidhīyante, āgneyādīnāṃ darśapūrṇamāsaśabdenānuvāda eṣitavyaḥ; anyathā anarthārthavidhānamekasmin vākye bhavati |
anuvāde ca teṣāṃ sahalaṃ na vidhyate |
kathaṃ punaḥ same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmityevamādivākyeṣu deśādyo vidhātuṃ śakyante ? lakṣaṇāyābhisaṃyogāt |
samudāyaśca samudāyālakṣaṇāṃ śaknoti sāhāyyāt samudāyāno lakṣayitum |
vini- yogānvayinaḥ sāhityātsarvapradhānāṅgatā, aṅgayoga- syāpi pradhānaprayogavidhividheyatvasyaiva sthāpitatvāt |

tatra ekameva vākyaṃ nirguṇaṃ saguṇaṃ vā, tatrotpattiviniyoga- prayogā ekenaiva vidhinā pūrvapūrvasyottaratra vaiśiṣṭhya- maṅgīkṛtya vidhīyante, guṇāśca tatrāsyāḥ svayogyatā'nu- sārāt tatratatrānvīyante |
yatra tu vākyadvayaṃ vākyatrayaṃ (vā) śrutaṃ, tatra vākyavaidhryaparihārārthe vidhibhāvāya ca ekenaikau vidhiraparepāraḥ, tatra ca tattadanyaguṇānvayaḥ eva niyāmakaḥ |

tadiha darśapūrṇamāsayorāgneyādivākyeṣu satyapi kāla- śravaṇe tasya phalasaṃbandhasiddhayarthatvena vidhitārthyaviṣayatvā- bhāvāt dravyadevatā''khyatasyaguṇaśravaṇena tatpatti- vidhimātraṃ, viniyogaprayogāṃte tasyānuvādakatvameva |
evaṃ phalavākye nimittavākye ca viniyogavidhitvāt tatra prayogavidhi- kalpane gauravāt |
prayogavidhisu deśādividhāveva, tada- nyaguṇasyaiva tatra tadviniyāmakatvāt |
ata eva deśādividhau viniyogamanivāhet sarvatra tadviśiṣṭa- prayogavidhiḥ |
prayogaśca bhāvanāyā itikartavyatā''nvaya- svābhāvyāt aṅgavidhīnāṃ pratyekaṃ prayogavidhikalpane gauravācca sāṅkhyasya deśādividhau vidhīyate |
svarūpeṇa prāsānāmpi ca pradhānānāṃ prayogaviṣayatvena vidheyatvāt tadviśeṣaṇasya sāhityasyātsarvaviśiṣṭatvena deśakāla- karmādiḥ sarvo'pi sahitasarvaiṅgadhāneṣvaiva saṃbadhyate |

na caivamekapradhānaviśiṣṭau katipayāṅgayuktāyāṃ deśādideśā- nāpattiḥ, prakṛtau pradhānāntarasahitasamastāṅgayuktatvaivedeśya- tvāditi vācyaṃ, prakṛtau deśādivākye deśatva aṅgapradhāna- sāhityasyāpi 'ekatra dravyaṃ' iti nyāyena pradhānaprayoge vaiśiṣṭyāṅgīkāreṇa sakalaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaprayogavidhānāt ārthyakena ca viśeṣaṇavidhinā aṅgapradhānoddeśena pratyeka- meva deśādividhānāta prakṛtau sāhityasye deśādi- tantratvasiddhiḥ |
vikṛtau ca pradhānāntarasyābhāvena tatsā- hityābhāve'pi aṅgāntarayuktaikapradhāne eva deśādiprāptyupa
ataśca 'same darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityanena ṣaṇṇāṃ yāgānāmeko daiśikaḥ prayogaḥ |
ata eva ṣaṭsvapi yāgeṣu sāṅgeṣu eko deśaḥ, ekaḥ kartā iti sidhyati |
'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta' ityādi 'sāyaṃ juhoti' 'prātarjuhoti' ityādī ca kāliko'pyaparaḥ, viruddhakālamedāt, viśeṣyabhūtapradhāna- bhedācca |
tatparaṃ prayogadvayaṃ nyāyavyāpakabhāvena ca deśikā- diprayogeṇāvirodhaḥ |

na caivaṃ sarvatra kālādividhau eka- prayogatve 'ya iṣṭyā paśunā' itrāpi kālaviśiṣṭaikaprayoga- vidhyāpatteḥ sarvairāmiṣṭiprabhṛtisomayāgānāṃ ekaprayogatā''- pattiḥ, tatra yacchabdasamabhivyāhārāt tattadvikṛtiprayogā- nuvādena kālamātravidhānāt tattadvikṛtivākyeṇaiva prayogavidhivikalpatayā abhyanujñānāt, tataścittakṣaṇaphala- sādhanānāṃ teṣāṃmekaprayogavidhiviṣayatvānupapatteśca |
ata eva tattadvākyagataṃ vikṛtiprayogasāhityamapi anuvādagatatvād- vivakṣitam |

yatra tu naivaṃvidhaṃ kiṃ cit prayogānuvādajñāpakaṃ, tatra prayogasyaiva vidheyatvāt sāhityavikṣepapatteryugaiva prayogaviṣayabhūtavākyaghaṭānāṃ nāmaikadeśakāla- kartṛtā, paurṇamāsyādikālpayogamede cājñāpyatiḥ |
āgneyādipradhānānāṃ ekaphalasaṃbandhapekṣayā aṅgānāṃ caikakaraṇopakārasaṃbandhapekṣayā svārthyavaśāvinānāmapi vākyānāṃ saṃhatya ekamahāvākyārthāpādanena ekavākyatvaṃ bhavati |
bhāṭṭa. 5121. āgneyādi- yāgaḥ devatāyāḥ uddeśātmaka-upādānasyaiva prayojakaḥ, devatotpattipālanayostu aprayojakaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 107. āgneyādivākye dravyadevatāsaṃbandhasyāptyāgavat śrutyādibhirupasthitasya kramasya adhyāhṛtaśabdābhihitasya vidheyatvasaṃbhavat |
soma. 5121. āgneyādi- śabdāḥ guṇavidhayaḥ na karmanāmadheyam |
kevalaganyādidevatākaiḥ aindrāgna-agnīṣomīyādīnāṃ asā- marthyāt agrahaṇa iti vakṣyati caturdhākaraṇendrapītapūṣa- prapiṣṭabhāgavicāraśca |
tadguṇāstu vidhīyairannābhidhāgāt vidhānāthe, na cedantyena śiṣṭāḥ |
bhāṣya-- 'yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇa- māsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' ityevamādayaḥ śrūyante |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimāgneyaḥ amīṣomīyaḥ ityevamādayo guṇavidhayaḥ, karmanāmadheyāni iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? guṇavidhau sati aneko guṇo vidhīyeta agni-puroḍāśa-aṣṭā- kapālā iti |
avibhaktā hi te karmaṇo vidhānāthe tadvitānte śabde |
sa eva evamanāmeyo bhavati, yadi agnaye saṃkalpya dīyate |
tena ayaṃ anena prakāreṇa yāgo vihito bhavati |
sa evaṃ vidhīyamāno na śakyaḥ argina aṣṭākapālaṃ ca avidhāya vidhātum |
saṃbandho hi vidhīyamāno na śakyate saṃvandhau avidhāya vihita iti vaktum |
aeṣu kapāleṣu saṃskriyamāṇo vrīhimo yavamo vā puroḍāśa eva bhavati, ṣoḍanuvādaḥ |
siddhaścātra aṣṭākapāla ucyate 'kapāleṣu śrapayati' iti vacanāt, nānyena arpitaṃ gṛhṇanti |
tena asmin pakṣe na vākyamedo bhavati |
yatra punaḥ anyena baca- nena śiṣṭā guṇā bhavanti, bhavati tatra nāmadheyam |
vā-- evaṃ siddheṣu nāmadheyeṣu nāmadheyakāryeṣu ca idānīmapavādaḥ prastūyate |
kasmāt punaḥ ihaiva davihoma- padaṃ na vicāryate ? vicāritametadapi tatparye (2|4| 3|4) ityanena |
tatra tu (8|1|11) arthavādagatānāṃ 'yadekayā juha- yāt davihomaṃ kuryāt' iti |
yā tu tatra guṇavidhyāśaṅkā, sā adhi- karaṇamadhye paricodanāmāttraṃ, sarvamevaitat prāsaṅgikam |
kena punaḥ vihitānāṃ karmaṇāṃ āgneyādīnāṃ nāmadheyatvamāśaṅka- yate ? taducyate |
'aṣṭākapāle bhavati' ityādibhiḥ dravyamātrayuktāḥ kramavayo bhāvanāḥ pratipādyante |
tāsāṃ ca sthānakrameṇa agnyādidaivatyāni yājyā'nuvākyāyu- lāni āmnāyante |
tāni kramaviniyuktāni santi mānatra- varṇikīḥ karmāṅgabhūtā devatāḥ kalpayanti |
nahi anyathā te mantrāḥ karmopayogaṃ gaccheyuḥ |
kriyāsvarūpa- prakāśanena tatsaṃbandhaprakāśanena vā mantrāḥ karmopayogitāṃ gacchanti |
yat agnyādi abhidhīyate, tasya saṃbandhatvaṃ na jñātaṃ, tatra asaṃrvandhanyatvādiprakāśane anaṅgalyaprasaṅgaḥ |
tena ava- dhāritā'nvayamanurodhena evaṃ vijñāyate 'yān ete vadanti, te nūnamagnyādeyaḥ kriyā''ṅga' iti |
te ca mantreṣu prādhānyānmidhāt devatātvena praśatāḥ iti tada- vailakṣaṇyāt karmasvapi devatā bhavanti |

puroḍāśādibhirapi havirāmakatva yogyatāyā yāgasādhanatvena upalabhyamāneḥ devateva ākāṅkṣitā iti dravyadevatāsaṃbandhiniṣpatteḥ anumitāyāṃ yāgānāṃ 'tatvanyaṃ cānyaśāstraṃ' (2|4| 3|4) iti āgneyādīnāṃ nāmadheyatvam |

athavā aṣṭā- kapālādīnāṃ haviṣtvāt 'dvirhavipo'vadyati' iti hi avadāne gṛhīte codanāntareṇa ca tatsaṃskārādyaupastarā- bhighāraṇagrahaṇāt caturvaratte niṣpanne 'caturvattaṃ juhoti' iti vacanāt yāvad-dravyaṃ niṣpannānāṃ homānāṃ tathaiva agnyādiṣu prāpteṣu nāmadheyatvam |
evaṃ ca anekāryavidhi- doṣo na bhaviṣyati |
'na cedantyena śiṣṭāḥḥ syuryogyāḥ' śabdena kena cit |
na cānyavācinā tasya saṃbandhaḥ saṃprati- yate |
' na 'aṣṭākapāle bhavati' ityetāvatā kaścit puruṣavyāpāre vidhīyate, yo'nuṣṭhānāya smṛtikarṇa mantra-
na ca puroḍāśabhavanaṃ puruṣasyānujñeyaṃ, pratiniyata- kartṛtvāt kriyāṇām |
nāpi dravyaṃ svarūpeṇa siddhātmaka- tvāt kartavyaṃ, yena syeta |
na ca 'agniṃsūryā' ityā- dibhiḥ dravyaṃ tadvāpāro vā abhidhīyate, yena ākāṅkṣā- 'pi saṃvadhyeran |
agnyādyabhidhāyānāṃ na kaścit taiḥ saṃbandho vidyate |
'na ca yāgo haviṣṣadhaṃ vā puroḍāśeḍa- vadhāritam |
yena syād devatā''kāṅkṣā tanma- ntrāṇāṃ ca saṃgatiḥ ||
' yadi hi prathamaṃ yāgalamava- dhāyeta, tato devatā''kāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ devatāvācino mantrāḥ saṃvadhyeran, na tu tat bhavati śabdenoktam |
na ca yāgasaṃbandhāt prāk puroḍāśādīnāṃ haviṣtvamavadhāryate |
tadeya hi dravyaṃ yāgasaṃbaddhaṃ payaḥprabhṛti na loke haviḥśabdavāca
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ prakṛtābhiḥ evaṃliṅgavatimīrūpasthātavyaṃ, uta dāśatathīmayaḥ evaṃliṅgā āgamayītavyā iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? prakaraṇe ca mantro liṅgena vidhīyamāno dāśatathīmaya eva āgamayītavyaḥ |
āgneyī ityevamādi- bhirhi śakyā dāśatathyaḥ abhivaditum |
yathāyaṃ prakṛtaḥ, sa kāryāntare viniyukto, na ihāpi upadeśamarhati |
upa- deśopadeśo hi na nyāyya evaṃjātīyakasya |
kathaṃjātīya- kasya ? yaḥ kasiṃścit viśeṣeṇapadiṣṭaḥ, nāsau sāmā- nyena liṅgena anyopadeśamarhati |
kathaṃ ? yadi talliṅgaṃ tasya lakṣaṇatvena, tataḥ viśiṣṭe lakṣyate 'yena anena evaṃliṅgena etat karoti' iti, tato nopadiṣṭo bhavati |
athopadiṣṭyate evaṃliṅgena karotīti, tato na lakṣyate, tena upadiṣṭasya evaṃjātīyakasya evaṃjātīyakaḥ punarūpa- deśo na nyāyyaḥ |
atha tu devatā upalakṣitā, vyaktireva śabdārthaḥ, tataḥ prakṛtagrahaṇe sati śrutijanitapratyekadeśatvāt syāt |
sā ceha 'vyaktireva sādhanaṃ, na sāmānyaṃ nāma kiṃcit' |
kiṃ punaridānīṃ ākulatākaraṇoktasāmānyāpahavaṃ bhāṣyakāraḥ karoti ? neti brūmaḥ |
vyaktiśabdo hyaṃ yaugikatvāt ( āgneyyā iti ) na jātiśabdavat pratipadyate |
na cātra jātiḥ kā cit pratīyate |
nahi 'ama ā yāhi vītaye' 'agniṃ hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ' ityetayoḥ devatāvyatireke kiṃ cit sāmānyaṃ dṛśyate |
vyabhicarati tu ṛgjāti, dravyakarmādiṣvapi prayogāt ( āgneya
vā—atha vākyabhedaṃ parihartuṃ yathāśrutāgnyādyupasthāna- sambandhamātramityucyate tatrāha, (sūtrakāraḥ) 'anarthaka śro- padeśaḥ syātsambandhatvā phalavatā' iti |
'nanu prakaraṇāt jyotiṣṭomasya upakārakaḥ syāt' iti anyataḥ sāmānya- sambandhasiddhiṃ manyate |
na tu asāvapi avidhīyamānaḥ saṃbhavati iti darśayati |
yadā tu khalu 'tamavidhāya upasthānamantrā viśiṣṭavidhā- nena vā mantrasambandho vidhīyeta, tadā laukike niṣphale śuddhe evopasthāne mantrāḥ prāpnoti anumitaśrutiprakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā |
as- tyakṣe tu prathamameva jyotiṣṭomena svīkṛtatvāt nānyatra prāptiḥ, iti arthavattā lāghavaṃ ca |
athavā āgneyādīnāṃ karmāṅgatvabhūtānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ ca karaṇānāṃ saṃbandhe vidhīyamāne upasthānamapi anudyate iti laghutaram |

acchedakadhātvapekṣayā ātmanedālocanayā abhi- dhā'lpatvālpāvacchinnatvāvagamāt ' āgneyyā ābhīmaṃ amidadhyāt ' iti vākyārthapratīteḥ ' agra ā yāhi ' ityādimiśra saṃnihitaviṣayāmanatravibhaktyādipukteḥ (kyāyuktaḥ?) samīpasthānaṃ vinā abhidhānāsakteḥ prāptasya samīpasthānasya anuvādeopapatteḥ tasyāpi sāmānyānyavat avidhānaṃ iti atilāghavam |
su. 1132. āgneyyadhikaraṇe ' āgneyyā āmīmamupatiṣṭhate ' ityādau viniyukto'pi prakṛta eva mantro grāhyaḥ na tu dāśatāya āgamanīyaḥ ityuktam |
(3|2|21-24) ke. āgneyyadhikaraṇe yaugikānāṃ padānāṃ saṃnihita- mātravācakatvasya nirākṛtatvāt (pārthasārathinā) |
ke. (āgneyyā āmīmamupatiṣṭhate iti) āgneyī- vākye sāmānyasaṃbandhavodhakaprakaraṇe prakṛtāprakṛtasādhāraṇya- pravṛttaśrutisārasvabhaṅgaḥ (
bhāṣyaṃ-- 'āgrayaṇaṃ bhavati, hutāyāya yajamāna- syāparābhāvāya nānādhaimnaḥ, purāṇānāmāgneyaḥ, saumyaḥ śyāmākaḥ, vaiśvadevaḥ payasi caruḥ, dyāvāpṛthivya eka- kapālaḥ' iti |
tatra śrūyate 'vāso dakṣiṇā, vattaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā' iti |
tadana saṃśayaḥ kiṃ vāsovatsamanvāharyasya nivartakaṃ, uta nivartakamiti |
na ca kayāṇāmiva ānasyatirikāthatvakalpanāyā prākṛta- vakṛtayoḥ samuccayapattiḥ, ṛtvik saṃpattiphalatvānirūpa- kāryasyaivena siddhau ānatyātirekasya niyojanāta |
kayeṣu tu 'daśabhiḥ krīṇāti' iti vaca- nāt samuccayaḥ |
ataḥ prākṛtadakṣiṇā vaikṛtadakṣiṇā bādhyate ityuttaravivakṣayā prāpyate |
tatravṛttyā tu tantrasya niyamaḥ syāt, yathā pāśukaṃ sūktavākena |
bhāṣyaṃ-- tasya prasannasya prakṛtyā vaiśvadevikaṃ tantraṃ niyamyate |
yathā pāśukaṃ tantraṃ sūktavākasa preṣeṇa vaiśeṣi- keṇa niyatam |
bhāṣyaṃ-- kiṃca na ca śāstravihitāḥ prasanāḥ |
kimataḥ ? yadi śāstravihitā bhaveyuḥ, tatastena prakṛtilena vaiśvadevikaṃ tantraṃ niyamyeta |
athavā dyāvāpṛthivyadharmatvāt prāsānāmeva prasanānāṃ puna- rvacanamanarthakyaparihārāya lakṣaṇayā vaiśvadevikasya tantrasya vidhānaṃ vijñāyate prasanādi tatra bhavatīti, na tacchāstralakṣaṇam |
tantritva- niyatau śaṃke nātaḥ sarvatra tantritvam : ||

' bhāṭṭa-- na caivaṃ viruddheṣvapi navaprajvalanādiṣu dyāvā- pṛthivyasyaiva dharmāngrahāditayoḥ prasaṅgasiddhiḥ, itarābhyāṃ barhirmātragrahaṇe prasūnamayatvasya tadupakārakatvena tadaṃśe itarayoḥ prasaṅgitvābhāvāt |
ataśca navajvalādiṣviviruddha- dharmaviṣaye mukhyatvamyusabhyāmitarayoreva tantritvādeka- kapālasya prasaṅgatveva |
aviruddhasarvadharmośe tu tantritva- meva, sahopakrameṇa agradharmāviśeṣatvāt |
atra navasu pañcānāmivāvirodhāt navaprajvalyamapi na virodheti prati- bhāti |
paśupuroḍā- śādau tu yatra tantramayathāpāṭhādinā grahyamāṇaviśeṣatā, tatra viruddhaviddhobhayāṃśe'pi prasaṅga eva |
bhāṣyaṃ-- tatraiva vāsasi vatse ca saṃśayaḥ anvāharya- dharmāḥ kartavyāḥ, uta neti |
kiṃ prāptam ? na tāvanyāya ucyate kartavyā iti |
kathaṃ punarvāsovatsaṃ tatkāryatvaṃnamiti ? nimittatayā ādhāya parikreyeṇa, dakṣiṇeti tathā abhi- saṃyogo bhavati 'vāso dakṣiṇā' 'vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā' iti |
soma-- sūtrāttu-- vāsovatsaṃ anvāharyadharmakaṃ syāt anvāharyakāryaparikreyanimittakadakṣiṇāśabdayogāt iti |
' bhāṭṭa-- vaikṛtī dakṣiṇā prākṛtadakṣiṇākāryapannatvāt prākṛtānvāharyādidakṣaṇādharmāṃ labhate ityapi tathaiva |
bhā. 7|1|5| 23, āgrayaṇe dyāvāpṛthivyaikakapāle cāturmāsyavaiśva- devikadyāvāpṛthivyaikakapālavidhittasya atideśaḥ |
āgrayaṇe vāsovatsayoḥ anvāharyasthānā- pannayorapi abhighāraṇasya bādhaḥ ||
bhāṣyaṃ-- āgrayaṇe śrūyate, 'vāso dakṣiṇā' 'vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā' iti |
tatrāyamarthaḥ : samadhigataḥ anvā- haryadharmā vāsasi vatse ca kartavya iti |
kim ? kriyate ? abhighāraṇaṃ hi anvāharye khādimne kriyate |
khādimnā hi odanasya parikreye upa- karoti |
na ca vāsasi vatse ca khādimnā prayojanam |
soma-- iha tu adṛṣṭārthatvācca prayojanaṃ ityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |

' bhāṭṭa-- abhighāraṇasya tu prakṛtau adṛṣṭārthatvāt vāso- vatsādāvapi karaṇe prāpte, odanasyādimā''rthatvena hṛdyātva- saṃbhave adṛṣṭārthatvakalpanā''nupagateḥ khādimnaśca prayoja- nāmābhāvātkaraṇameva |
āgrayaṇe tattatsasyotpattikālāvadhikaḥ saṃvatsaro grāhyo na cāndrādiḥ ||
'saṃvatsarādyetadadhi bhavati' iti śrutau 'dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ' ityādiśrutatasiddhacāndrādisaṃvatsarā- nyatamaḥ eva vikalpena prāptaḥ |

'saṃvatsare sasyāni pacyante' ityādisu loke phalasasyāpākādyaiṣa- sasyapākāvadhikakālasyāpi saṃvatsaratvaṃ vyavahārataḥ sasya- pākānimittakameva tasyaivopalakṣitatvā niyamanasaṃbhave vika- tyāyogāt dvādaśamāsyānutirekasyāpi 'saṃvatsarādi' iti vādaḥ |
( 'paktu parāri eṣamo' (mas) bde pūrva pūrvatare abde, ityamaraḥ |
paratū pūrva abde, parāri pūrvatare abde, aimam : yati vartamāne abde ) |
'āgrayaṇenāṣṭakāmo yajeta' iti vidhāya vākyānantareṇa kālanāṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca vidhānāt agni- hotradravyāṇāmiva vikalpaḥ syāt |
deśena kāladvayānekānuvidhāne vākyamedāt viśiṣṭa- vidhitvāvaśyaṃbhāvena vayāṇāmapi āmayaṇānāṃ abhyāsā- cchedaḥ |

kaupītakibrāhmaṇe tu śyāmākāgrayaṇaṃ vidhāya 'sasadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ, sacchantāvājyabhāgau' (4|12) ityādinā prākṛtājñāni uddiśya guṇaviśeṣān vidhāya, yavāgrayaṇadī- kṣato vidhāya 'etanmamevaitad brāhmaṇaṃ' (4|163) iti vācanikātideśavacanāt spaṣṭaḥ karmabhedaḥ, ato na dravyavikalpaḥ, nāpi karmavikalpo nimittabhedāt |
mutrādiśamīdhānyānāmapi pakkaupacilāviśeṣeṇa niṣedhe prāpte, teṣāṃ ayāgayogyatvādeva na niṣedhaḥ |
oṃ āmayaṇākaraṇe'pi śākāparṣādīnāṃ bhakṣaṇe na doṣaḥ ||

'sasyaṃ nāśnīyāt' iti vacanāntareṇa śākādīnā- mapi bhakṣaṇaniṣedhe prāpte, teṣāṃ yāgayogyatvābhāvena 'devā oṣadhīṣu pakāsu ājimīyuḥ; tā indrāgnī prathamamuda- jayatāṃ' ityupakramya navāśananiṣedhena devebhyo dātuṃ yogyānāṃ dhānyānāṃ pakānāmeva tebhyaḥ aniṣṭvā bhakṣaṇasya nindyā pakṣaśākānāṃ haritayavādīnāṃ ca bhakṣaṇe yathā- kāmyam |
'vrīhibhiridhvā vrīhibhiriva yajeta ā yevebhyaḥ' ityanena vrīhikālavakālāntarāle vrīhyagrayaṇabhāve sato vidhī- yate yatiśabdena prakaraṇinaḥ eṣopasthiteḥ |
iti prāpte, antarālakāle nityaprāptayordaśapūrṇamāsayoḥ dravyaniyamavidhi- paratve saṃbhavati alpāntāprāptāsaparatvamayuktam |
'tasmānnāśnīyāt āmayaṇena, navasyāśitavyam' iti niṣedhaḥ phālguṇārayaṇasyaiva, na vrīhiyavāśanasya yāḥ phālguṇāstāsāmitareṇa' iti vākyaśeṣe phala- kuṣṭhīkīrtanena viśeṣe vyavasthāpanāt |
tasmāt phālguṇāti- riktānāṃ grāmyāṇāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ aniyatam |

iti prāpte, ajñasya dravyasāmānyeṇa karaṇāsaṃbhavena pravṛtteḥ viśeṣaika- viṣayatvena sāmānyasya viśeṣe paryavasānāt vākyaśeṣā- vaśyakatve'pi nivṛtteḥ navadhānyasāmānyāśanaviṣayakatvā- nupatterabhāvena vidhinā anākāṅkṣitasya vākyaśeṣeṇa asamarthatvāt phālguṇāryavāt : chanitvat lakṣaṇayā stāvaka- mātraṃ iti sarvagrāmyāṇāmeva bhakṣaṇaniṣedhaḥ |
aprasūtatvasya bādhe'pi śāstrārthasya barhirmātrasya bādhabhāvāt na kasya cidgauṇam |
sūtrārthastu- tannasādhāraṇye adhiko guṇaḥ prasūtalakṣaṇaḥ guṇinni amukhyā'pi sati virodhābhāvāt niyamyate |
yadi dvayorekasmin pātre bhojanamāpadyeta, tatra amukhyāsyāpi śiṣyasya dharmo'nugṛhyate tadvat iti |
vi--'barhirāprayaṇe kiṃ cit prasūnaṃ vā, bahutvataḥ |
sa vaiśvadevaścāvāpyupanidhaya ekakapālaḥ' iti trayo yāgāḥ śrutāḥ |
nahi tayoraniyamo nāma kaścit padārtho'sti, yena jaghanyaika- vṛttitvānniyamo bādhyate, barhirmātraṃ tu tadaṅgam |
ataśca kāṃsyabhojinyāyena durbalānurodhenāpi prasūnamapyagrahe na kaściddoṣaḥ |
10|5|10. āma- yaṇasthālyai dvaityaśeṣaḥ ādityasthātyāḥ sakāśāt āgacchati |
bhāṣyaṃ-- jyotiṣṭome śrūyate, 'yadi rayaṃtarāsā tomaḥ syādaindravāyavāgrān grahaṇṇīyāt, yadi bṛha- tsāmnā śukrāgrān, yadi jagatasāmā āmayaṇāgrān' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kimāgayaṇā- pratāyāḥ prakṛtau niveśaḥ, uta vikṛtāviti |
yadi jagatsāmeti jyoti- ṣṭomaḥ evocyate, yena kenacidisaṃbandhena guṇena kriyayā vā |
soma--yathā (caturthecaturthe'hani iti) vīpsāyā yathākathaṃcidanuvādatayā nayanaṃ, evaṃ jyotiṣṭome eva jagatsāmaśabdasya kathaṃcidyanaṃ ityuktānāt (dṛṣṭānta-) saṃgatiḥ |
atra jagattīśabdaparyāyo jagacchandaḥ; chāndasa īkāralopo vā bodhyaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- 'yadi jagatsāmnā' ityatra jagatsāmnaḥ abhāvāt uktaṃ sāma ṛksaṃbandhāt tadākhyaṃ jagacchandābhidheyaṃ syāt iti |
vi--'prakṛtau vikṛtau vā syād graheṣvāgrayaṇā- gratā |
16. ke-- 'vibhrāḍ bṛhat pibatu somya madhu' iti jagattīndrakāyāmṛci utpannaṃ sāma jagatsāma |
āmayaṇāgratvaṃ jyotiṣṭomevikṛtibhūte viṣuvati pṛṣṭhastotrasya jagatsāmatve sati kartavyam |
vi. 2|3|1, āmayaṇāgratvaṃ dhārāgraheṣu, dvādaśāhe vyūḍhe caturthapañca-
yat kāraṇaṃ, tasmin kāle pradhānāntyeva na santi|
yadā tu sarvāṇyaṅgāni kṛtāni, tadā tajjanyāpūrvāṇi saṃbhūya pradhā- neṣūpakurvanti|
bhā. 11|2|15-17, āghāra: prathama: amantraka: 'prajāpatiṃ manasā dhyāyan āghārayati', 'tūṣṇīmāghārayati' iti śruteḥ|
vi. 10|3|2, āghāra: 'syuvyamāghārya juhvā paśaṃ samanakti' iti agnīṣomīyapaśuprakaraṇe śruta:|
bhā. 4|3|112-4, āghārau ājyabhāgau prayājānuyājā: patnīsaṃyājā: samidyaju: srigdhakṛt etānyaṅgāni|
.....dravyaṃ hi anayā kriyayā kṣārpate, kṣāritaṃ ca yāgaṃ sādhayati |
2|2|13-16, āghāre ṛjutva-saṃtatatva-ūrdhvatvadharmāṇāṃ samuccaya: ahaddāra- bhedāt, na tu vikalpa:|
'saṃtatamāghārayati' iti saṃtata- śabdastu dīrghadhāratvāt dīrghā dhārā yasya tādṛśatvāt prayukta:|
āghārājyasya dhārā ekakṣaṇamārabhya anyasaṃ- mukhakoṇaparyantaṃ dīrghā bhavati|
tatrāpi kṣaṇikatvamantreṇa karmaṇa: saha tananaṃ na ghaṭate|
saṃtataṃ kṣārayatīti dīrghadhārayā juṣetīti dīrghadhāratvāt saṃtata- śabda:|
soma-- na ca karmaṇa: kṣaṇikatve'pi kriyāyā: ekaphalatvācchabdānvayāpattiranyatvarūpatvāt dīrghakālasambhavena sāhityamupapadyate iti vācyam|
bhāṭṭa-- 'saṃtatamāghārayati' ityatra karmaikatvāt tadvicchedavidhānupapattirmantrasāhityameva vidhīyate iti mantrānte: karmādisaṃnipāta:|
iti prāpte, kṣaṇikasya karmaṇo bahukṣaraghaṭitamantrasāhityānupapatte: dīrghadhārasya
ucyate satyamevaṃ, tathāpi ākāṅkṣāvaśāt parasparadravya- devatā'nubandhena sarvemeva vākyānāṃ dravyadevatāviśiṣṭa- karmavidhāyakatvāt dravyadevatābho nānupapannaḥ |
tena yāni vākyāni āghārābhihotrayorguṇavidhāyakatvena siddhā- nti''mimāni, tāni sarvāṇi anyonyānubaddhadravya- devatābhidhāpadāni viśiṣṭavidhāyakāni |
na caivaṃ sati āghārābhihotravākyayorāpi dravyadevatā'bhidhāpadānupapanna karmavidhāyakatvāt nānuvādakatvamiti vācyam |
na cātrānuvādanahaṃ ūrdhvādisthānīyaṃ dadhyādisthānīyaṃ vā guṇāntaramasti |
āghārāgnihotraśabdau samudāyānuvādau na karmāntara- vidhāyakau iti pūrvapakṣaṃ vāśabdena vyāvartayan siddhāntamāha|
“agnihotravākyaṃ āghāravākyaṃ ca codanā apūrvakarma- vidhāyakameva, nānuvādaḥ |
śabdārthasya āghārayatiśabdasya juhotiśabdasya ca yo'rthaḥ, tasya prayoge bhūtvāt anuṣṭhānaṃ prāptatvāt |

nanu ūrdhvādivākyaiḥ dadhyādivākyaiśca viśiṣṭakarmavidhāyakaiḥ prāptatvāt aprāptatvamasiddhaṃ, ata āha- guṇārthena ūrdhvādidadhyādiguṇavidhānaprayojanāya āghārayati juhoti iti punaḥśrutiḥ anuvāda ityarthaḥ |
nanu saṃnihitaṃ dhātvarthaṃ parityajya pratyayaḥ kathaṃ guṇaṃ vidadhyāt tatrāha- tatsaṃnidheḥ |
tasya guṇasya viśeṣadhāla- rthāṃpraveśena pratyayasaṃnidhānāt ” iti kutūhalam |
“ tatsaṃnidheḥ ’ ‘ agnihotraṃ juhoti ’ ityādivākya- vihitakarmetidhanāt punaḥśrutiḥ ‘ dadhnā juhoti ’ ityādi punaḥśravaṇaṃ guṇavidhayarthatā upapadyate ” iti kastūrivṛttiḥ |
tasmāt āghārāgnihotraśabdau karmāntaravācakau na samudāyaśabdau iti siddhāntaḥ |
tathā imānyaparāṇi ( śravaṇāṇi ) ‘ ūrdhvāmāghārayati ’ ‘ saṃtatamā- ghārayati ’ ‘ ṛjumāghārayati ’ itya
ghāramācārya', 'indra ūrdhvo adhvara ityādyāḥ' iti ca dravyamātravarṇanadevatāviśiṣṭa nāmaprayogārhatvāditi |
tatra nāmnā viśeṣaḥ pratīyate, yatra kaṃ cidviśeṣamupādāya nāmāni pravartante |
atra punaḥ saṃnihitāvayavārthatvāt samudāyāprasiddhimantareṇa āghāraśabdaḥ kṣaraṇamātravāci- tvācca viśeṣe vartate |
na hyāghāraḥ prakṛtaprakaraṇāttvāt, darśapūrṇamāsa- prakaraṇametat sakalaṃ, nānyasya prakaraṇasyāvakāśaḥ |
saṃnidherviśeṣagāma iti cet, atrāpi subam, na, vākyavalīyastvenātra prakṛterapi saṃbandhāt |
yatra yaḥ kaścit rūpa- leśo'sti, tatra nirūpite karmaṇi kena cit prakāreṇāntareṇa guṇāntarāṇi ka
nahi homasyādhikaraṇatvaṃ śabdāt vastuto vā siddham |
na ca dadhnaḥ kartavyatā, nityaṃ karaṇā- tmakatvāt |
iyamapi ca śrutiḥ dvividhādapi viśiṣṭavidheḥ balīyasī, ekavidhisaṃbhave anekaśaktikatvā-(kalpanā-) 'nupapatteḥ |
saṃnikṛṣṭāsaṃbhavakṛtameva cāsya (dadhnaḥ) viprakṛṣṭasya grahaṇaṃ, tanomayāśrayaṇe yugapadvipa- tiṣṭhaddhaṃsamasaṃbhavamāpattiḥ |
anyatra viśiṣṭārthavidhānāt nātigurvī eva (dadhnā ityādistutiḥ) iti na padyame sthāne niveśayitavyā |

kāmaṃ vā śuddhārthatvavidhā- nāt tasya vā anyatra vidherantarā kartavyatā (śrutiliṅgā- divat) āsāṃ aṣṭānāṃ śrutīnāṃ pradarśitāṇāṃ pūrvapūrvāna- pekṣatvāt na kramopanyāsena prayojanaṃ, yadi tu avaśyaṃ krameṇopantyasyataḥ |
dhātvarthe anyasaṃbandhavidhirūpaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ prakāraṃ dūṣayati-) yattu ‘prākāśau adhvaryave dadāti’ ityanena dadātidhātvarthe prākāśādhvaryūsaṃbandho vidhīyate iti, tadayuktaṃ, vacana- vyaktyavivekāt |
sarvatra hi yacchabdena anudyamānamupa- nibadhya tacchabdayuktaṃ vidheyamupanīyate |
tadiha yadi tāvat yaddadāti ityatra adhvaryūprākāśayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ iti vidhīyate, tataḥ sakaladānānuvādāt samastadakṣaṇādhikāra- prasaṅgaḥ |
pratyayasya ca anekavidhiśaktikalpanā codite sati karmaṇi aparadiṣṭaiva |
saṃbandho hi vidhīyamānaḥ saṃba- ndhinaṃ tāvat ākṣipat, dhātvarthe tu punaḥ sa vidhātavya eva saṃbandhī, anyathā saṃbandhasyaiva saṃbandhī śeṣaḥ syāt, na kriyāyāḥ |
tatraitat syāt, dhātvarthāntaḥ pratyayo vidadhat avaśyameva tatra vidhāsyati |
evaṃ tarhi uttara- yorapi śrutyoḥ atraivāntarbhāvāt bhedenopādānaṃ vyartham |
nahi ‘vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta’ ‘dadhnendriyakāmasya juhu- yāt’ iti dhātvarthānuraktaḥ pratyayaḥ saṃbandhaṃ vidadhāti iti |
prakṛtiliṅgamātralakṣaka ālabhatiḥ uccāryamāṇo na dravyadevatāsaṃbandhavidhau ātmānānujñena kiṃcidupakaroti, na cāsau saṃbandhaḥ ālabhatinā saṃpādayituṃ śakyo yāga- viṣayatvāt dravyadevatyoḥ |

yadi cānyasaṃbandhakaraṇe pratyayoccāraṇasiddhiratiriktaṃ kiṃ cid dhātuḥ kuryāt tato dadhīndriyasaṃttvavidhāne kimiti homaḥ; parityajyeta, kimiti vā prakaraṇalabhyo''bhyupagamyeta (anena prasaṅgāt saptamādhamaśrutiprakārāvapi dūṣitau) |
athāpyavyaviśiṣṭaṃ dānamanyata adhvaryūvā tadviśiṣṭaḥ; evamapi viśiṣṭānuvādāt vākyabhedaḥ |

śuddhā- dhvaryūvāde tu yadyapi saṃpradānaśruteḥ arthādānamākṣipyate, tathāpi saṃpradānasyadevatvaṃ-dhasya dadātimantareṇa anupapadya- mānatvāt dravyadevatāsaṃbandhaścaiva yadyaḥ; kalpanamiti na dhātvarthe anyasaṃbandhaḥ iti vacanavyaktiḥ saṃbhavati |
avaśyaṃ cātra dānādhvaryoḥ codakena prātatvāt prākāśādyeva vidhā- tavyau |
vakṣyati caitat jātyadhikaraṇe (3|1|10) ‘yatrānyataradaprāptaṃ, tatraivetaranetaravidhiḥ; arthāt saṃbandhaḥ, ubhayaprāptau anubhayaprāptau vā kevalasaṃbandhavidhānaṃ’ iti |
tisṛṇāmapi ca saṃbandhavidhiśrṛtīnāṃ pratyayaviśeṣa- sāmyāt balābalai kaścidviśeṣo, nāpi samavāyavirodhasaṃbhavo yatra tajjñānamupayujyate, iti mandaphalaṃ kramaṇopanyāsasya |
tasmāt prastāvādhikaraṇanyāyena sarvatra viśiṣṭabhāvanāvidhi- reva tattvam |
itarattu tatratatra sthūlabuddhipratipādanopāyamātraṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa kṛtamiti draṣṭavyam |
yacca saṃnikarṣaviprakarṣa- midhānaṃ tadbhāvanāstha eva vidhitve kārakāṇāṃ bhāvanā- viśeṣaṇatvaṃ prati iti mantavyam |
kathaṃ punaḥ satī bhāvanā vidhīyate ? viśiṣṭā na prāpteti tādātmyena vidhā- syate, phalataśca tad viśeṣaṇayorvidhiriti vyapadiśyate |

nanvevaṃ sati viśeṣaṇe'navatarvidhāyako bhāvanā- dvāreṇapūrvavidhivat prāptakarmavidhau'pi anekaṃ vidhātuṃ samartha iti ‘codite hi tadarthatvāt tasyatasyopadiśyeta’ (2|1|16) ityasyāviṣayatvaṃ prasajyeta |
tvenaiva gṛhyate, tadā arthādiśeṣaṇavidhau sati avākyabhedaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ |

yadā tu tadviśeṣaṇamiti avadhāryate, tadā bhāvanāyāḥ saṃhitaproṣitatvam anekaviśeṣaṇayoge sati yadyarthaṃ vidhitvamavasīyate, tasyaivaikasya vidhānaṃ, netarasya tadeśasyāpi cakṣuṣeva sparśādeḥ, iti vākyabhedo bhavi- ṣyati |
sarvatra samānadeśamapi vidhitvaṃ phalataḥ pracalita- miva ekatropasaṃhṛtaṃ darśitam |
yattu abhyu- diteṣṭikāśādādividhiṣu anekakāryavidhadoṣaḥ, sa sarvaśeṣeṣu tulyaḥ |
yathā cāsattvade na bhaviṣyati, tathā tadadhi- karaṇeṇaiva vakṣyāmaḥ |
yadi sākṣāt guṇo na vidhīyate, tataḥ puruṣasya tatra apravartitatvāt tatparityāgena anutiṣṭhataḥ kṛtārthatā syāt iti manyate |
tathā ‘kathaṃ punaḥ’ iti ‘tulyaṃ ca sāṃpradāyikaṃ’ (1|2|18) ityabhiprāyeṇa |
‘asati tvarthe kiṃ’ iti tvevaṃ kriyate, yena tadānarthakya- māpadyate, matsye tu sati arthe nārthatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
‘evaṃ tarhi’ iti vākyena viśiṣṭāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ pravartamānaḥ śrauto'pi vidhiḥ vākyāt bhavi- ṣyati ityucyate |
parantu yadyasādena sa vidhīyate, saiva tāvat vidhīyatāṃ iti śrutyarthe sati na vākyārthaḥ |
‘satyametat’ iti vidhiśaktisaṃkrānti ‘na cedanyena śiṣṭāḥ’ iti ca darśayati |
tasmāt tatsaṃnidheḥ guṇasya bhāvanā'nupraveśāt vidheyatvaṃ, athavā guṇasaṃnidheḥ śakti- saṃcaraṇaṃ, bhāvanādhātvarthaprāptisaṃnidhervā śrutivirodhāt guṇavi- dhānam |
juhoteḥ iti spaṣṭamapi dhātuccāraṇaṃ anavabudhya sakalasyātānuvādābhiprāyeṇāha ‘yadi juhotītyanuvādaḥ’ iti |
‘dadhiśabdena iti mā vocata’ iti vājapeyādhi- karaṇaṃ yathāyathāgranthayā yojanīyā |

(sudhā pṛ. 776- yathā vājapeyādhikaraṇe mā. 1|4|18 pṛ. 339 ‘yadi yajetetyanuvādaḥ, kenedānīṃ guṇo vidhīyate’ iti praśnopa- pādanārthe ‘vājapeyaśabdeneti mā vocata, nahi ākhyātaṃ vā kuryaṃ vā antareṇa nāmapadasya vidhiśaktirasti’ ityuktaṃ, tathā atrāpi vācyamityarthaḥ |
atra sudhākṛte bhāṣyānuvāde kiṃcidakṣara- bhedo dṛśyate ) pratyayo vidhivaiva, dhātvartho'nuvādaḥ; iti vivekaḥ |
‘yadi vidhāyakau’ iti (evaṃ tarhi vidhāyakau iti bhāṣye pāṭhaḥ ), bhāvanāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ kathaṃ vidhānaṃ ityabhiprāyaḥ |
dadhnaḥ padārthatvāt naiva vākyārthatvaṃ saṃbhavati ityetadapi dadhiviśiṣṭabhāvanā'bhiprāyameva |
na cotpattivākye kathaṃbhāvo nāsti, phalasaṃbandhaṃ tu yāvat pratīyate |
na ca ahitadravya- devatvasya phalavidhavanupapattiḥ; homamātratayā vihitasya paścādapi tadupalakṣaṇatvāt |
na cātra jyotiṣṭomasya mahā- bhyāseṣu avayavabuddhiḥ, ubhayatrāpi sākalyapratīteḥ |
evaṃ ca darśapūrṇamāsavata ubhayatra samastaiḥkartavyatā''- vṛttirūpapadyate |

anyathā tu paśutantraviprakarṣanyāyena ( 1|1|2|1|18 ) sakṛtkṛtaiva upakuryāt ( savanīyapaśau paśupuroḍāśaprāpyavārāṃ kālamede'pi ajñānācchiṣya ihāpi anāvṛttiḥ ityāśaṅkya karmataḥ prakramāt prabhṛti ā samāpteḥ ekakālatvāt, savanīyapaśauśca aikakarmyāt, prayogākhyasya tantrasya viprakṛṣṭakālatve'pi ajñānādvṛttiryuktā iti vaiṣamyaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntitam |
su. pṛ. 779 ) na caikakarmatve kiṃ cit prayojanamasti |
( paramatamupasaṃharati ) tasmāt dvaya- rāhuloḥ samudāyānuvāda iti |
( samudāyānuvādaṃ niṣpa- yojanatvena dūṣayati - ucyate iti |
( ucyate iti pāṭho'tra sudhiyām ) ' samudāyānuvādasya na tāvat dṛśyate phalam |
' yathaiva hi samudāyānuvādatvaṃ avayavaśiṣṭasamudāyaikatve bhavati, evameva prayogavākyagataṃ ' agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ ' iti bhaviṣyati |
yathā ca ' rājasūyena svārājyakāmaḥ ' iti vināpi anyena samudāyānuvādena siddhiḥ, evami- hāpīti |
nanvevaṃ sati aprāptikānāmapi homānāṃ prathā- natvaṃ syāt |
nahi yathā paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyādayoḥ prayājādibhyaḥ kāla- saṃyogena avacchedaḥ tathaiva kena cit kriyate |
api caivaṃ sati aniṣṭaṃ tava prasajyeta |
tasmāt sati vā samudāyānuvāde na kaściddhi- śeṣaḥ |
tathā yadāptarāmikānaṃ homānāṃ medo, yadi vā sarvāgnihotramevābhyastakarma kriyate, sarvasyāgnihotraśabdena sannidhyagnisaṃyogamātvaviśeṣāt phalasaṃyogena sama- pradhānatvam |
tathā caikeṣāṃ sarvasāmānyādhikaraṇyenāgnihotra- śabdaprayogaḥ ( agnihotraśabdasya sarvaviṣayatvamāpāda- yannupapanno bhavati |
) gārhapatyānyāhāryapacanayoścatastraścatasra āhutī: āhavanīye ca dve vidhāyā''ha ' ya evaṃ vidvān virāṭ saṃpannamagnihotraṃ juhoti ' iti |
tataśca taṇḍu- lādivākyavadeva gārhapatyādisaṃyogasya guṇārthatvānna karma- bhedaheturasti |
tadeva hi prakṛtaṃ karma tantratatra pratyabhi- jñānīmaḥ |
kasmāt punarekakarmaviṣayatvāt dadhyādideva agrayo na vikalpyante ? ke cidāhuḥ |
nirādhārasyāpi hi prakṣepasya apratiṣṭhe'pi dravye saṃbhavāt adṛṣṭārtho'gni saṃyogaḥ |
evaṃ tu sati padādibhirapi āhavanīyo na bādhyate |
tasmāddirāṭ saṃpanni- tyetādeva vacanāt ' saṃkhyāvihiteṣu tu samuccayaḥ ' ityanena nyāyena ( 1|1|2|1|130 ) samuccayaḥ |
' satyāpi agni saṃyogasya adṛṣṭārthatve samastaśravaṇāt āghāraprati- pattidāraṃ tat ityavagamya tat ca pratyakṣapratīteḥ ekenā- vaddhe karmaṇi nānyat saṃbhavatīti vijñāyate |
kasyātpunaḥ ' tila āhutīrjuhoti ' ityādivat saṃkhyāyā karmabhedo na bhavati |
utpattisā hi saṃkhyā medikā bhavati ' tisra āhutīḥ ' ityādiṣu |
iyaṃ punaradhārite karmaṇi upajāyamānā ' ekādaśa prayājān ' itivat abhyāsenaiva pūrvateti na svarūpabhedāya prabhavati |
tena eka- meva sarvābhibhū abhyastaṃ karmeti niścīyate |
' sāyaṃ juhoti ', ' prātarjuhoti ' iti vākyāntaraprātaḥ- kālo devatāvasthāpare vākye saṃkīryete |
sa tu kālo na svarūpeṇa devatā saṃbadhyate, iti prakaraṇalyakarmānuraktaḥ saṃbadhyate |
na ca lakṣaṇayā labhyamāno homo vākyaṃ bhinatti |
nanvevamapi bhinnapadopātte dve devate vidadhatī vākye vidheyātām |

' ( ayaṃ ślokārthaḥ - ' agnaye dātre ' itiviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvā- ṅgīkaraṇena prajāpatitvaguṇaviśiṣṭasyāgnerdevatātvavyapake kārakaṃ, tathāpi anekakārakapāṭhātpayoragniprajāpatirūpa- kārakayoḥ vibhaktiśravaṇāt kriyā'nvayapratītetaḥ prāgvi- śeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāvagatamāt pratyekaṃ vivicyāpārāvaśya- bhāvāt vidhāyakapratyayāpattiḥ |
vastutastu prajāpateḥ svātantryeṇa devatāprasiddheḥ viśeṣaṇabhāvena kārakaikyamapi nāstīti sudṛḍho vākya- bheda iti |
sā ca yatraikā agnīmomādī tatra sadrūpeṇa pratyayasya vyāpāro bhavati |

yatra punarvibhaktisaṃbandhānekapadātmakamevāpi kārakaṃ bhavati yathā atraiva agnaye ca prajāpataye ceti, tatra yugapat pratyavekṣaṇābhāvādvayaṃ bhedena agniprajāpatī pratya- yasya pratyayaṃ prayuṅkte, sā ca nānocāritānāṃ naiva prayu- ṅkte ityādyutpriprabhaṅgaḥ |
tasmānna parihāraḥ, iti eva- mabhidhīyate vākyadvaye'pi āsinaṃ prajāpatitveva vidhī- yate |
agnihotroḥ punarmantravarṇādeva prāptiḥ, vākyānta- reṇa evaṃ devayau mantrau vihitau, tābhyāmeva ca devate prāpte sadyo prajāpatitvaucityena stutyarthamupādīyete |

yadapi ca ' tatprayaścānyaśāstram ' ityatra ete vākye nidarśita, tadapi mantravarṇaprāptiotārthatvena draṣṭavyaṃ, evaṃ mantravidherṇe paunaruktyaṃ bhaviṣyati, anyathā tadarthāśa- doparihāraprayojanaguṇavidhiparisaṃkhyāvādādīnāṃ anya- tame atiśleṣaḥ syāt |
yattu sāyaṃ prātarhomayorbhavayavatvadvirnāstīti, dākṣāyaṇa- yajñādivat sakalakarmārthatvavijñānāt tadityavagantavyam |
nanvevaṃ sati sakalakarmaparicchedakatvena sāyaṃ prātaḥ- kālayostulyatvāt vikalpe sati sāyaṃ prātar'gnihotraṃ hotavyaṃ nobhayaneti prāpnoti |
yāvajjīvacoda- nayā tāvat jīvatā sāyaṃ hute, punarjīvataḥ eva prātaḥ- kāle sati samastanimittopajananāt naimittikomakaraṇaṃ bhaviṣyati |

satyamevamapi sidhyati, ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ, yadā sāyaṃ prātaramyastoḍameka eva prayogo bhavati, tadā sāyaṃ- home kṛte, yadā nāma yajamānasya kadā cidāpadyavati, tadā yathākathaṃcit prātarhomaḥ kartavyaḥ |
aya tu vasante jyotiṣṭoma- vat sāyaṃ kāle samāptaṃ karma, tato nāvarayaṃ prātarhomaḥ kartavyaḥ |
' abhyastakarmapakṣe tu kāladvaye'pi prayatnena avaiguṇyaṃ saṃpādanīyam |
kathaṃ punarvikalpa iti, vacana- kṛtāt samuccayāditi brūmaḥ |
' pravargyau vā eṣa ' iti hi prakṛtaṃ bravīti ' sa vai sāyaṃ ca prātaśca juhoti ' iti |
na ca samuccaye sati sāhityāpattirbhavati, anupādeyatvāt kālasya- virodhaḥ |
prātaśca vacanāntareṇa kālyoḥ samuccayyārtha- mevedaṃ vākyamiti na vākyabhedadoṣaḥ |
kāla prati hi karmopadīyamānaṃ vivakṣitāṅga- saṃyogaṃ bhavati, tena sāyaṃtanasya pradhānasya tatkālāṅgā- nyeva upakurvanti nānyakālāni, vaiguṇyāt |

kuṇḍapāyināmayane ' māsamihotraṃ juhoti ' ityekakarma- vidhānāt ekatikartavyatāpekṣaṇe sati sāyaṃhomasya prāta- homasya vā dharmā āgacchantītyekadharmavat sakṛdeva prayujyate, amede tu yathāprakṛtīti |

soma - iha dadhyādeḥ anyataḥ aprāptatvena mantra- varṇaprāptavidhyānuvādena viśvidāvākyānimāva- katvābhāvāt vidhāyakatve sati dadhyādi viśiṣṭakarmavidheḥ agnihotrādivākyamanuvādaḥ iti pratyayasyāt saṃgatiḥ |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe dadhyādivākyavidheyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ samu- ccayānuṣṭhānaṃ, siddhānte tu ekasminneva karmaṇi dravyāṇāṃ vikalpaśca samuccayaḥ |
tathā pūrvapakṣe sāyaṃprātarvākyayorapi dadhyādivākyavat karmāntaravidhāyakatvena dadhyādivākya- vihitakarmasu sāyaṃprātaḥkālanīyamabhāvaḥ, siddhānte tu tadbhāvaḥ ityādi |
ādhāravākye tu pūrvapakṣe ūrdhvatsāṃta- tyādimadhye yasya bhraṃśaḥ, tadguṇakasya karmaṇaḥ punaranu- ṣṭhānaṃ, siddhānte tu karmabhedābhāvā
ācāntena kartavyaṃ ityādismṛtiḥ śrutyā'viru- ddhātvāt pramāṇam |

bhā. 1|3|15-7. ācāraḥ pratyarthavaidikaliṅgena bādhyate yathā- yavavarāhādhikaraṇe ( 1|3|18-9 ) 'yadā vā anyā oṣadhayo mlāyante athaite modamānā ivottiṣṭhanti' ityarthavādaliṅgena priyaṅguṣu yavaśabdaprayoga ācāro bādhyate |
vā. 3|3|74 pṛ. 860. āryāvartanivāsināṃ anyajanapadavāsinyo glecchebhyaḥ samīcīnatara ācāro bhavati |
bhā. 1|3|2 pṛ. 581. ācāraḥ ke cit krutkaraṇamātāḥ kena citrittena ukthyamāṇāḥ puruṣadharmatāṃ bhajante, yathā 'malavadvāsasā saha na saṃvadeta' 'tassāt na brāhmaṇāyā- vagureta' ityevamādayaḥ |
vā. 1|3|12 pṛ. 164. ācāraḥ 'dharmatvena prapannāni śiṣṭāni tu kāni cit |
' anagnikaṃ māghasaptamīpaurṇamāsī- phālgunīpratipadprasannotsavādīnāṃ niyamakriyāpramāṇaṃ na śāstrāhate kiṃ cidasti |
smṛtikārāśca 'ācāraścaiva sādhūnāṃ deśajātikuladharmāśca āmnāyaiḥ aviruddhāḥ pramāṇaṃ' iti vedāviruddhānāmācārāṇāṃ sāmānyataḥ prāmāṇyamanumanyante |
vede'pi ca mahāvrate 'prekhalamāruhya hotā śaṃsati' ityetadvākyaśeṣe śrūyate 'yadā vai prajā maha āviśanti, preṅkhaṃ tarhi ārohanti' iti |
mahā iti pāṭhe śakradhvaje mahāyātrā iti saptamīsamāsaḥ |

yāni tu mlecchadiśamānāni niyatāṃ- niyatakriyā'ntarāṇi arthesusādhanakṛṣisevāvāṇijya- dīni mṛdādyapānamṛduśayānāsanamaṇīyādyecchālasyagīta- nṛtyagandhapuṣpādimāṃṇi prasidvāni, teṣu naiva kaścit dharmatvābhāsa asti, iti na tatsāmānyāttadedhena itaranirā- kriyopapattiḥ |
keṣāṃ cidvā dharmatvamapyagamāt na sarvaiṣā- meva tatsaṅghaḥ |
loke hi kaścidācāraḥ śiṣṭatvena viśi- dyate |
sa eva kevalo dharmo, netaraḥ prāṇimātraḥ |
ācārā ye dṛṣṭārthāḥ, te tata eva pramā- ṇam |
vivaddhā api śiṣṭagṛhītāḥ- 'pañcadhā vipratipattirdakṣiṇataḥ, anupanītena bhāryayā ca saha bhojanaṃ, paryūṣitabhojanaṃ, ucchiṣṭabhojanaṃ, pitṛbhṛtsa-mātuladuhitṛ- pariṇayanaṃ iti |

tathottarataḥ pañcadhā ūrdhvakīrtiḥ, sīdhu- pānaṃ, ubhayatodadrivyavahāraḥ, āyudhīyakaṃ, samudrayānaṃ iti' iti baudhāyanena smṛtiviruddhecārādeharaṇāṇi dattvā 'itara itarasmin' iti deśaprāmāṇyavyavasthā prāmāṇyaṃ āpastambhenopyastaṃ 'micyatediti gautamaḥ, ubhayaṃ tveta- dvādriyante śiṣṭasmṛtivirodhāt' iti niyuktam |
