(ubhayataḥ: maste adharaphalake upariphalake ca yeṣāṃ paśnāṃ dantā bhavanti, taiḥ aśāśvataragardabhaiḥ kraya- vikrayayo vyavahāraḥ |
) ācāreṇa adṛṣṭārthena dṛṣṭārthe ācāro bādhyate, yathā vasantotsavādyācāreṇa adṛṣṭārthena tatsamānakālīnasya kasya cit dṛṣṭārthasya vādhaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 139, ācāreṇa adhigītena vigītācāro bādhyate, yathā lobhādimūlaka- tvena māṃsabhakṣaṇācārasya vigītatvasya asaṃbhavalobhādimūla- kena adhigatena māṃsavarjanācāreṇa bādhaḥ |
yathā vṛkṣa- viṣayapīluśabdamayogarūpācāreṇa hastiviṣayamleccharūpa- anāmaprayogarūpācārasya bādhaḥ |
idaṃ pīlyadhikaraṇe ( 1|3|18 vātikaṃ varṇakaṃ 2 pṛ. 219|3-220|3) uktam |
pṛ. 139. ācārād gṛhyamāṇeṣu tathā syāt puruṣā- rthatvāt |
ācārāt śiṣṭānāt gṛhyamāṇeṣu jñāyamāneṣu 'gurunugantavyaḥ' 'vṛddhavayāḥ prayujyatheyaḥ' ityādidharmasu tathā pūrvādhikaraṇoktāmiśotrādikarmavat punarpunarnimitte prāpte punaḥpunarudyetā syāt |
yathā grāmāntarāgātānāṃ śāntyarthe agnipraṇayanavyastaprabhṛteḥ śirasa upari ārāmaṃ śuci- deśapratiṣṭhāpanaṃ ca |
su. pṛ. 633. ācārasya yadi aikarūpyaṃ bhavet, naiva smṛtayaḥ prayatnena dhāryeran |
sa eva tu saṃkīrṇavādasphuṭa- svaraṇena pratipālyate |
vā. 2|1|4|12 pṛ. 409, ācārāṇāṃ āmnāyavicchinnāṃ gautamena aprāmāṇya- muktam |
bhāṭṭa. 1|3|1 varṇakaṃ 3. ācārāṇāṃ prayupasthitaniyamānāṃ dṛṣṭārthatvādaiva prāmāṇyaṃ 'gurvanugamanaṃ, prapāḥ, taḍāgāni, gotraciham' ityādī- nām |
ācārāṇāṃ smṛtīnāṃ ca sarvadharmalaṃ asati viśeṣaṇe |
jñā. 1|3|8. mī. ko. 110 ācāre lobhādihaṇasaṃbhave eva smṛti mūlakatvaṃ 'apivā kāraṇāgrahe' ( 1|3|7 ) iti sūtre vakṣyate |
sāhasa ca mahatāṃ prajāpatīndravasiṣṭhamitrayudhi- ṣṭhirakṛṣṇadvaipāyanabhīṣmadhṛtarāṣṭradevājurnaprabhṛtīnāṃ bahu- nāmaghaṭatānāṃ ca |
prajāpatestāvat 'prajāpatirasamama- bhraittvāṃ duhitaram' ityagamyāgamanarūpāt adharmā- caraṇāt dharmavyatikramaḥ |
indrasyāpi tatpadayasya ca nahuṣasya paradārābhibhogāt dharmavyatikramaḥ |
bhīṣmasya ca sarvāśramadharmavyati- rekeṇa avasthānaṃ, apalīkasya ca rāmavat ṛtuprayogaḥ |
tathā anyasya dhṛtarāṣṭrasya ijyā pāṇḍavārjunairdhṛtaiḥ ityadhikṛtakriyā |
tathā yudhiṣṭhirasya kanīyo'rjita- bhrātṛjāyāpariṇayanaṃ, ācāryabrāhmaṇadharmāt manūttabhāṣaṇaṃ ca |
vāsudevārjunayoḥ pratiṣiddhamātuladuhitṛsukhiṣmī- subhadrāpariṇayanaṃ, 'ubhau madhāsaccīvī' iti sugapā- nācaraṇam |
mitrasvajanocchiṣṭabhojanaṃ sarvavarṇaparasparaspṛṣṭa- tāmbūladānatadavasānānāmana- ( tāmbūladānante āca- manābhāvaḥ ityarthaḥ ) nirṇayajakautagardabhāstadvyavahārapari- grahahyā |
atisthūlāni pratipuruṣajātikulasthitasukṣmadharmavyatikramaṇāni tu anantamedāni sarvatra vigānahetudarśanāni ca prāyeṇaiva saṃbhavanti naivajātīyakamiśradācāradharmatvādhyavasāna- saṃbhavaḥ |
vā. 1|3|17 pṛ. 203-04. ācārakalpyaḥ pratiṣedho yathā harivasarapari- bhāṣite kāle pāraṇā niṣedhaḥ |
ācāraprāmāṇyaṃ na dṛṣṭamūlasaṃbhavamātraṃ ucyate, kiṃtu dharmabuddhayā anuṣṭhīyamānatvenaiva 'apivā kāraṇā- grahaṇe' iti sūtre (1|3|17) |
ācārasmṛtivirodhe balābalacintanaṃ 'smṛtyā- cāravirodhe balāvalaṃ' iti bindau draṣṭavyam |
' iti śrutaskadhā- karaṇedāhṛtavṛddhaśloke vivadanāmāmepi apekṣāmedena ekatra yugapatsaṃbhavasyoktatvāt, vastuvirodhasattāvāsti |
ācāryasya śiraso'vatāra- tāyā api khaluḥ śiṣyeṇa śucideśe'vasthāpanam |
ācārye proṣite 'ācāryānī bhavatāmācāryaḥ' iti ācāryaśuśrūṣā ācāryānīṃ atidiśyate |
ācāryakaraṇavidheḥ adhyayanena saha nānni- tāmidhānaṃ, padaśrutya adhyayanavidhineva anvitābhidhāna- siddheḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 5, ācāryakaraṇavidhau upanayanaṃ padaśrutyā dūramapi ajñatayā samarpitam |
tatra āsādya- māno mānavaḥ yadi akiṃcitkaraḥ, tadā tadāsādanamanupa- yogī |
tataśca āsādyamānasa karmapekṣāyāṃ upanayanakarmaprakramāt upanītakartṛkaṃ adhyayanaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ tatkarmatayā vijñāyate |
tadākṣitādhyayana anuṣṭhānasiddhaśca adhya- yanavidhiḥ svasiddhayarthe nādhikārāntaramapekṣate |
bhā. 1|1|2|12 pṛ. 12, ācāryavacaḥ pramāṇaṃ iti śrutiḥ |
1|3|6|13, ācāryavacanāt sūtrakāra- vacanaccā na śabdādhau bhavati, pratyāyādasau gamyate |
'upanīya tu yaḥ śiṣyaṃ vedamadhyāpa- yed dvijaḥ |
sāṅgaṃ ca sarahasyaṃ ca tamācāryaṃ pracakṣate |
mahāvrate 'tārpyaṃ yajamānaḥ paridhatte, darbhamayaṃ patnī' iti śrutam |
prakṛtau tu ahaṃta vāsaḥ śrutaṃ codakena prāptam |
tatra ācchādane guhyādiśarīrācchādane nimitte sati yat codakena prākṛtaṃ prāptaṃ, tasya prākṛtasya tārpyādinā viśeṣavihitena vikāro bāghaḥ syāt |
aikārthyāt ekaḥ ācchādanarūpaḥ arthaḥ prayojanaṃ yayoḥ tārpyādyayoḥ te ekārthe, tayorbhavaḥ aikārthyaṃ tasmāt |
tathā ca ekakāryakaratvāt prākṛtasya bāgha iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tātparyaṃ darbha- mayaṃ ca ahaṃtāt adhikaṃ syāt, samuccaya ityarthaḥ |
adhovāsaḥ, tātparyaṃ darbhamayaṃ ca uparivāsaḥ iti |
'vāsāṃsi vārāhī copānahī vimuñcati' iti 'kṛṣṇaviṣāṇā vāsāṃsi vivaṃsayati' iti ca bahuvacanaṃ samuccayaṃ darśayati |
(atra prakaraṇe prāyaḥ ājyaśabdaḥ vṛtātharka eva, ka cittu jyotiṣṭomagatastotraparo'pi bhavati |
'ājyapa- śabdaviṣayakaśca eka eva laghusiddhāntaḥ - racanāsaṃkṭapari- hārāya varṇakramamanusṛtya yathāsthānaṃ niveśitaḥ iti jñeyam |
) ; ājyaṃ upāṃśuyājīyaṃ amīpomīyaṃ prājā- patyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
8|1|9|135, ājyaṃ vilapayati iti ājyaśabdaḥ jātiśabdaḥ; na tu saṃskāraśabdaḥ |
upāṃśuyājādyaṃ brāhmaṇena somāt prāk amīpomīyaṃ na kartavyam |
prājāpatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vā kartavyamiti na tasya somādutkarṣaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
ājyāni stotrāṇi ityanena śabdena lakṣaṇayaiva guṇo vidhīyate |
yadi tu ājyaiḥ stuvate ityanena vihitānāṃ pañcadaśatvavidhirucyate (pañcadaśānyāni) tataḥ pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyena (udbhi- dadhi0) saiva matyalakṣaṇayā iti matvā vadati (bhāṣya- kāraḥ) |

yadi vākyabhedaparihārāya utpattivākyavihitānuvādena pañcadaśatvaṃ guṇo vidhīyate, tataḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasiddhayarthe ājyaśabdena mavyarthalakṣa- ṇyā vihiteṣu ājyeṣu guṇavidhivyāpateḥ lakṣaṇaiva doṣaḥ ityevaṃ bhāṣyaṃ nyāyāt |
yattu aprasiddhaṃ karmaṇāṃ nāmadheyamiti avayavaprasiddhayā ājigamanāt ājyāni |
ājyena jāghanī vikalpyate darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ patnī- saṃyājeṣu |
bhā. 3|1|10|20-23, ājyena palyavekṣitena yajamānāvekṣitena ca homa ucyate |
6|1|4|17 pṛ. 1362, 'ājyena yūpamankti' ityatra ājye prākṛtājyadharmāḥ na kartavyāḥ |
'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthā- payati' ityanena ājyadravyakaṃ patnīvedyatārtha śeṣavatpaśu- yāgasamanantaramāvi karmāntaṃ vidhīyate |
ājyena samāpanaṃ prakṛtau dravyanāśe 'yasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi naśyeyurjuhuyātpuroḍāśasya ājyenaitā |
devatāpaḥ pari- saṃkhyāya yajeta' iti vacanāt tyāgaśaṃsta ārādupakāra- kalpake |
(idaṃ sarvaṃ liṅgakadravyaṃ iti śāstradīpi- kādau somanāthe ca spaṣṭam |
bhā. 4|1|9|22-24, ājyaiḥ stuvate iti stotraṃ pradhānakarma, na guṇakarma |
2|1|5|29, 'ājyaiḥ stuvate' ityatra ājyaśabdaḥ stotraviśeṣa- dhasya vācakaḥ |
ājyasya upāṃśuyājī- yasya dharmātideśeḥ vihitau madravyako |
1| 4|4|16, ājyasya aupabhṛtasya anujāvat caturtha- pañcamaprayājaniṣpādakamānayanamapi prayojakam |
4|1|9: ājyasya aupabhṛtasya prayājārthe samānayanaṃ prayo- jakam |
ājyasya aupa- bhṛtasya viniyogaḥ - 'adhāpabhṛti' yadupabhṛti, prayājānyājyeṣvastat ityarthaḥ |
anujāyārthe caturthapañcamaprayā- jāyai ca tat ityarthaḥ |
vi. 4|1|15, āvyasya jauhvavya viniyogaḥ - 'caturguhāṃ gṛhnāti' 'yajjuhāṃ gṛhnāti prayājemyastan' iti |
4|1|15, āvyasya autrasya viniyogaḥ - 'canurdhruvāyā' sarvasai vā etadyajñāya gṛhte. yad dhruvāyāmājyam' iti |
4|1|16 āvyasya prati- nidhirna haviṣo nāśe doghe vā |
āvyasya prayājārthamya pātrāt anuyājārthapṛṣṭhadājyapātraṃ minnaṃ agnīṣomīye paśau |
bhā. 5|2|8|16. 'catu- rjuhāṃ gṛhnāti' 'anuyājapṛṣṭha' 'caturdhruvāṃ' 'yajjuhāṃ gṛhnāti, prayaḥjebhyastat . yadupabhṛti, prayājānuyājemya- stan |
sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhte, yad dhruvāyā- mājyam' iti śrutam |
10|4|2|5|9. 'pañcadaśāni ājyāni' iti ājyaśabdaḥ jyotiṣṭome prātaḥsavanī- yānāṃ stotraviśeṣāṇāṃ nāmadheyaṃ, na guṇavidhiḥ |
su. pṛ. 110. ājya- śeṣasya pratipattiḥ 'yadyagniṣṭomaḥ juhoti, yadyukthyaḥ paridhimanakti, yadyatirātraḥ yajurjena havirdhānaṃ pratipadyeta' iti sarvādhvarasya viśeṣavacanādagamyate |
yadyatirātraḥ, etadeva homayajñaḥ : 'yamagne pustu marya' iti japan havirdhānaṃ pratipadyeta' iti |
oṃ ājyasaṃkhyā pratinidhiḥ syād dravyotsa- rgāt |
idamājyaṃ kiṃ pūrvasmin prati- nidhibhūtaṃ, uta ājyadravyaṃ karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
ājyasaṃsthā ājyena yeyaṃ saṃsthā samāptiruktā, sā pālīvatasya paśoḥ pratinidhiḥ syāt yathā vrīhīṇāṃ nīvārāḥ |
kutaḥ ? dravyotsargāt paśurūpasya dravyasya 'pālīvatamutsṛjati' iti vacanena utsargāt |
pūrvapakṣe hetvantaramāha- 'paryagnikṛtaṃ pānīyatvamutsṛ- jati', 'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati' ityatra 'saṃsthā- payati' iti samāptivacanam |
tathā ca ārabhyameva karma ājyena parisamāptaṃ syāditi avagamāt ājyaṃ pratinidhiḥ syāt ityavagacchāmaḥ |
codanā eṣā syāt karmāntarasya 'ājyena śeṣaṃ pālīvataṃ saṃsthā- payati' iti |
karmotsargāt pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ utsargāt utsargeṇa parisamāptatvāt, anyaiḥ karmāntaravidhāyakaiḥ : nirva- patyādibhiḥ aviśiṣṭatvāt sahaśatvāt |
tasmāt ājyasaṃkhyā na pratinidhiḥ kintu karmāntaraṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
anijyāṃ ca vanaspateḥ prasiddhāṃ tena darśayati |
ājyena saṃsthāpanaṃ karmāntaraṃ iti siddhānte yuktya- ntaramāha |

prasiddhāṃ vanaspateḥ anijyāṃ, vanaspateḥ prasi- ddhā ijyāyāḥ abhāvaṃ, tena 'yat tvaṣṭāṃ ca vanaspatiṃ cāvāhayasi, athavaitau yakṣyasi, tadyau navamī prayājejyā, vānaspatyā daśamī' iti vākyena darśayati |
yadi pūrvaṃ karma parisamāptaṃ tato ṅasā syāt vanaspatījyā |
tasmāt ājyena saṃsthāpanaṃ karmāntaraṃ, na pratinidhiḥ |
yattu pūrvapakṣiṇā 'saṃsthāpayati iti apravṛtte nopa- padyate' ( 9|4|14|153 ) ityuktaṃ, tat pariharati siddhāntī |
pūrvaṃ karma pālīvataṃ, idamapi pālīvatameva iti |
tadevatvāt, sā devatā yasya, kiṃvā tasya pūrvasya karmaṇe devataiva devatā yasya karmāntarasya tat tadevatvam |
tadevatvāt pūrva- samāptisāhacarya atra dṛśyate iti kṛtvā sāhacaryāt saṃsthāpayati iti saṃsthāśabdaḥ upapadyate |
tasmāt ājyasaṃsthā karmāntaraṃ, na pālīvatasya pratinidhiḥ iti siddham |
bhāṣyaṃ- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'atihāyaiḍo barhiḥ prati samānayati' iti |
ājyasya dharmāṇāṃ ca prayojakaṃ, uta aprayojaka miti |
kutaḥ ? prayājānuyājārthasya ājyasya ayamekadeśaḥ samānīyate iti pūrveṇa nyāyena aprayojakatā prāptā |
kiṃ liṅgaṃ ? 'caturgṛhītānyājyāni bhavanti, nahi atrāṇuyājān yakṣyan bhavati' iti ādityāyāṃ śrūyate |
yadi prayājārthe samānayanaṃ, tata- statra ekaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ samānīyate, ekamapi anuyājānaṃ bhavati |
tataśca ādityā iḍānāṃ saṃtiṣṭhate iti anu- yājāmāve |
upabhṛti samānayanārthaṃ ekaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ grāhyaṃ, na tu anuyājārtham |
tatra bahūnāṃ caturgṛhītānāṃ darśanamu- papadyate, itarathā hi anuyājābhāve naiva upabhṛti catuḥ gṛhyeta |
nanu liṅgamupadiṣṭe kā prāptiḥ ? ucyate, dṛṣṭaṃ tatra prayojanam |
prayājau dvau yacchyau, tatra juhvāṃ ājyena prayojanaṃ, nopabhṛti riktāyām |
tena prayājahomārthe ājyasamānayanaṃ aupabhṛta- mājyaṃ prayojayati |
tadapi hi prayājārthamanuyājārthaṃ ca, iti vakṣyate |
duṣ- 'aprayojakaṃ' samānayanaṃ 'prayājānu- yājārthasya ( ājyasya ) ayamekadeśaḥ samānīyate iti pūrveṇa nyāyena aprayojakatā' ityukto'yaṃ granthaḥ |
yadi prayājānuyājārthametat ( dravyaṃ yat samānīyate, tataḥ ) prayājā ātmīyaṃ dravyaṃ prayujyate eva |
ataḥ pūrveṇa ( prayājārthavidhānena ) uttaraṃ ( aprayo- jakalābhidhānaṃ ) na saṃvadhyate ( tasmādayuktaḥ ) |
tatra kaiścit prayājaśabdaṃ tyaktvā anuyājārthasyāyamekadeśaḥ samānīyate ityevaṃ grantho nītaḥ |
aparaiḥ : prayāje anuyā- jārthasyāyamekadeśaḥ samānīyate iti ( saptamyantaṃ prayāja- śabdaṃ vyastamāśritya grantho nītaḥ |
) anyaistu 'yadupabhṛti gṛhṇāti, anuyājebhyastad gṛhṇāti' ityanena ( kevalānu- yājārthameva aupabhṛtamājyaṃ gṛhṇīta iti uparitanādhikaraṇa-) pūrveṇaiva atra pūrvapakṣaḥ kṛtaḥ |

trīṇyapi etāni ( matāni ) ayuktāni, ekaiḥ granthaḥ ( prayājaśabdarūpaḥ ) parityaktaḥ ( teṣāṃ sa eva doṣaḥ ), aparaiḥ : adhi- karaṇavamasaṃbhavi prayājānāṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ ( nahi ājyādhā- ratvaṃ kriyārūpaṇāṃ prayājānāṃ saṃbhavati ) |
anyaiśca ( tṛtīyapakṣavādināṃ ) granthaparityāgatadvat eva ( ayaṃ cāparo doṣaḥ - ) asiddhena cāsiddhaṃ sādhyate |
tasmāt uttaragranthānurodhena anyathā varṇyate ( tasmāt arthagranthā- nurodhena iti tu ānandāśramīyādanyatra likhitamudriteṣu pāṭhaḥ ) |
tat ( tasmāt ityarthaḥ ) uttarapade yā vibhaktiḥ, sā tantreṇa ( prātipadikadvaye'pi ) draṣṭavyā śrutatvāt tasyāḥ |
anyasyāṃ ( tu dvivacanarūpayāṃ prayājaprati- padike - ) ānīyamānāyāṃ śrutahānaṃ aśrutakalpanā ca |
tasmāt prayājebhyaḥ iti bahuvacanasāmarthyāt sarva- prayājānāṃ aupabhṛtam |
prayā- jebhya iti viśeṣavidhānāt vikalpena ubhayorevacca bhaviṣyati ityabhiprāyaḥ |

tataḥ kiṃ ? tatrāha - ) 'juhavā juhoti' iti ( vacanāt ) yasmin kāle prayā- jāṃ juhoti, tasminneva kāle yat aupabhṛtaṃ prayājārthe, tat juhavāmānayati ( nahi anyathā tathā hotūṃ śakyate ) evaṃ ca sati ataḥ utpatyapekṣāyāṃ yadupabhṛti prayā- jānuyājārthe ca dravyaṃ gṛhītamāsīt tadasmin kāle ‘atihāyaiḍo barhiḥ prati samānayati' iti |

ādā- veva ( prayājārambhe ) prayājārthasya samānayanāt na ( ubhayārthatayā ) vicinte, iti anuyājārthe ( arthe ) kevalamidānīmāste, tat samānīyamānaṃ parakīyatvāt ( anuyājārthatvāt ) aprayojakaṃ, ahaṣṭārthaṃ ca |

siddhā- ntaśca, yat aupabhṛtaṃ samānayate juhavāṃ, tat atihā- yeḍo barhiḥ iti asmin kāle ( na tu sarvaprayājārambhe ) iti kālanīyamo vidhīyate, tasmāt prayājatrayasya jauhavaṃ, dvayoḥ aupabhṛtaṃ atihāyaiḍo barhiḥ prati samānayati iti |
satyapi tulyārthatve nāsti vikalpaḥ :, bhinnaviṣa- yatvāt |
khāt virodhāt na śrutā vibhaktirgṛhītvā, dvivacanaṃ adhyāhriyate prayājyābhyāṃ iti |
bhāṣyaṃ - atha kasmānna vacanametat, caturgṛhītā- nyāyānīti |
vacane hi hetusamarthitaḥ syāt, ‘na hyanuyājān yakṣan bhavati’ iti |
yadā samānayanaṃ na prayājārthamiti gamyate, tadā vacanam |
asati hetau, ‘na hyanuyājān yakṣan bhavati’ iti hetuvannigado nopa- padyeta |
tasmāt prayājārthaṃ samānayanaṃ prayojakaṃ aupabhṛ- tasya ājyasya |
prayājārthaṃ samānayane yāvat prayājārthe, tāvat sarvaṃ samānayeya-dha- maupabhṛtasya |
tasmāt dhruvāyā upaghātāyājyasya sattvāt upāṃśu- yājīyādājyapi sviṣṭakṛdādeśaśca syāt |
sūtratacchuyena prāptaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ tuśabdena nirastan siddhāntamāha |
aśeṣatvāt avidyamānaḥ śeṣo yasya tādṛśāt upāṃśuyājīyājyasya śeṣasya abhāvāt |
tacca sarvameva auvāt homakāle eva ādhīyate |
tathā ca sarvasyaiva ādānāt nāsti tasya śeṣaḥ |
dhruvāyā yadyapi ājyaśeṣo vidyate, tathāpi nāsau upāṃśuyājīyaḥ, anyārthastu saḥ |
tasmāt upāṃśu- yājīyāt ājyāt na sviṣṭakṛdādi, iti siddhāntaḥ |
rājasūyagate vaiṣṇave trikapāle navakapāladharmāt nāti- diśati |
bhāṣyaṃ - jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'yadātithyāyāṃ barhiḥ, tadupasadāṃ, tadagnīṣomīyasya' iti |

tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ paradravyasya upadeśaḥ, uta nirikṣaṇa (nirgataṃ nirmitaṃ vā iṣṭaṃ sādhyaṃ yasya tat nirikṣaṇaṃ, karmaṇi sakṛt upayuktaṃ nirikṣaṇam) athavā dharmaviśiṣṭasyaḥ, athavā barhiḥ sādhāraṇamiti |
yathā 'yo devadattasya gauḥ, sa viṣṇumitrasya kartavyaḥ' iti, devadattāt ācchidya viṣṇumitrāya dīyate iti |
siddhāntastu— barhiḥpade dharmalakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt triṣvapi nyakkyavidhānam |
tataścātithyopakrame lupyamānaṃ barhiḥ ; tritayasādhāraṇamiti tatra kriyamāṇaṃ dharmā api pratipattivajaṃ sarvasādhāraṇāḥ |

na cāśvavālādidharmāṇāṃ prakaraṇe tanmātrārthatvāpatteḥ prasaṅgenopakārakatve'pi itarārthatve pramāṇābhāvaḥ, āśva- vālādivākyānāṃ etadvākyāvadhānena tritayāpūrvasādhanī- bhūtatadarthatverevoddeśyatvāt |
atra ca lakṣaṇayā etatriva- gevoddeśyatā''cchedakaṃ, ato na vākyabhedaḥ |
na caivaṃ lakṣaṇāyā- vaśyakatve dharmātideśapakṣatvāt ko viśeṣaḥ ? jahatsvārtha- lakṣaṇāto viśeṣāt, āśvavālādidharmāṇāṃ upasadartha- tasya vākyitvena prākaraṇika
gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatve'pi barhiṣi tritayodeśāt tatra kriyamāṇasaṃskārāṇāmapi tritvoddeśopapattirvibhāvyate, tadā'stu sarvatra tantrameva |
barhiḥpratipatteḥ paraṃ agnīṣomīyārthatvameva, itarayoḥ khaṇḍeṣṭitvena tatra pratipatyantardeśāt |

yuktaṃ caitat, saṃskāravyakteḥ upadheyakāryajijñāsāyāṃ saṃskāryārthyairvyaktyu- padheyakāryakatvasya ghaṭityupasthitatvena phalatvopapattau eka- prayogavṛttitvena vilambopasthitātithyāmātropakārakatva- kalpane pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva yatra nāśīṣṭamāgādau kūṭasya phalatvopapattiḥ, tatorupasthāpanāntaraprakāryāyāmeka- prayogavṛttitvasya kāryopasthāpakatvāt tadupasthāpitasyaiva phalatvamiti |
ātideśikena ātideśikasya aṅgaprasaṅge yathā, paśvayena prayājādinā paśupuroḍāśārthasya prayājādeḥ |

bāla. pṛ. 132, ātideśikena aupadeśikasya prasaṅgo yathā, 'ekaviṃśatimanubrūyāt pratiṣṭhākāmasya' iti kāmye anuvacanāntare nityānu- vacanaprakṛte atidiṣṭāmiḥ sāmidhenībhiḥ prākṛtasāmi- dhenīkāryasya amisamindhanasya prasaṅgāt siddheḥ tāsāṃ bādhaḥ |
pṛ. 133, ātideśikena aupadeśikasya aṅgaprasaṅgo yathā, dyena atidiṣṭeḥ kartumiḥ prayogavidhitaḥśradakabalīstvena prāpteḥ śyenesya audgātra- samākhyā prāsaṅga utsādaḥ kāryasiddheḥ prasaṅgaḥ |
pṛ. 110. ātideśikahyakālatvaṃ aupadeśika- kālatvatvāt bādhyaṃ, tena cāturmāsyasakamecīyeṣṭeṣu sadyaskālatvameva |
' dyavadānaprakṣepādīni hi sarveṣāṃ saṃkalpādidvāreṇa ātmaiva kartā ityavadhāritam |
vā. 2|1|15 pṛ. 397. 'ātmā jñātavya ityeta- nmokṣārthaṃ na ca coditam |

'ratnākaraḥ- vivekajñānasya pāralaukikaphaleṣu jyotiṣṭomādiṣu vṛttiḥ adhyayanasya prayojanaṃ karmapravṛttihetutayā karmaphalavargā- rthatve vākyaśeṣā phalaśrutiḥ : parṇamayīnyāyena artha- vādamātraṃ syāt, na phalāntaramalaṃ bodhayituṃ ityajñā-vijñāte iti |

upāsanātmakamastu tu jñānasya karmaṇi puruṣe ca dṛṣṭa- prayojanābhāvāt ahadṛṣṭāpekṣāyā śrutyādyabhāvena ṛtvarthatvā- bhāvāt vākyaśeṣopanītā'bhyudayaniḥśreyasaphalatayā vat puruṣārthatvameva iti vyākaraṇādhikaraṇe vakṣyatīti |
' yadā hi aṇumātra ātmā bhavati, tadā yāvāneva pradeśaviśeṣastenādhiṣṭhitaḥ, tanmātragatānāmeva sukhaduḥkhādīnāmupalabhyaḥ prāpnoti, tataśca ekasmin kṣaṇe śiraḥpādavedanā'nubhavo na syāt |
prakṛtau hi 'śukraṃ yajamāno'nvārabhate' ityādau yajamānapadavācyo yāgakartā jīvātmaiva kartṛtveno- cyate |
pṛ. 403. ātmā phalasaṃbaddhaḥ sarvasyeṣṭaḥ, tadaye karma kartavyam |
' (buddhiścaitanyaṃ citiśaktiḥ puṃsaḥ svābhāvikatvāt nityamekaṃ ceti) ślovā. śabdādhikaraṇe 404|
'ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ' ityādibhiḥ upāsanā'- paranāmadheyaṃ dhyānameva vidhīyate |
su. pṛ. 25. ātmā śarīraparimitaḥ iti arhatapakṣaḥ ayuktaḥ |
2|1|2|5 pṛ. 400. sullecchādīnāṃ manoṇutvasya śrutisiddhatayā nirguṇa- jñānasvarūpa ātmā |
tasya ca niṣkārakameva upaniṣa- janyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ mokṣasādhanaṃ iti vedāntinaḥ |
kaṃ cidarthaṃ vivakṣanti na vivakṣanti cāparam |
vā. 1|1|13 pṛ. 702. ātmane saṃkalpa- mānasya dravyasya svatvanivṛttyasaṃbhavāt |
saṃprati śarīrendriyagamanaḥprāṇabuddhibhyo bhinnatvaṃ, nānātvaṃ, grāhakatayā siddhatvaṃ ca, ātmanaḥ pratipādyate |
jñātā tu ātmā bhavati iti nirvivādaṃ sarvavādinām |
tatra śarī- rasyaiva jñātṛtvaṃ pratīyate 'ahaṃ jānāmi' iti |
ahaṃ- kāragocaraścabhedaḥ, 'sthūlo'haṃ kṛśo'haṃ gacchāmyahaṃ tiṣṭhā- myahaṃ' iti sthaulyyādiphena dehena ahaṃkārasya sāmā- nādhikaraṇyasya pratīteḥ |
athāyaṃ prayogo lākṣaṇikaḥ, ato na śarīrālambanatvamiti cenna |
na cātra dehātirekeṇa anyo mukhyyārtha upalabhyate |
tadālamvanatve ahamiti śāstrabhāsasya tadīyānekāvayava- rūpādipratibhāsānayo'pi syāt śarīrapratibhāsatvat, na na tathā dṛśyate |
mano'bhedendriyasya tu āntaraguṇagrahaṇe eva sāmarthyaniya- māttathā nāvabhāsaḥ |
kiṃca bāhyendriyapratyakṣe'pyeṣaṃ niyamo nāsti, anekāvayavayoginaḥ nyuṇakṛtsya grahaṇe avayava- grahaṇābhāvāt |
tathā tvagindriyeṇa vāyupratītau sparśādhi- ṣṭhānamātrayaiva pratītiḥ, na tvavayavapratibhāsānvayaḥ |
bhavatā- mapi dehavyatiriktālambanatve'pi ahaṃpratyayasya tadīyaguṇa- sukhādiguṇapratibhāsānvayaḥ : samāna eva |
kiṃca śarīre eva caitanyāpalambhāt, anyatra anupalabbhācca śarīraguṇaḥ eva caitanyam |
nanu śarīraguṇatve caitanyasyāsādhāraṇatvāt viśeṣaguṇatvaṃ prāptaṃ bhavatīti cet, tarhi kāraṇaguṇapūrvaka- tvamapi syāt |
tadapi bhavati cet, pratyeka śarīrā- rambhakeṣu avayaveṣu caitanyaprasaṅgekasmin śarīre aneka- sahasracaitanyaprasaṅgaḥ |
yadyapi kāraṇaguṇapūrvakaviśeṣaguṇatvaṃ na saṃbhavati, tathāpi śarīraguṇatvaṃ na nirākartuṃ śakyate |
na ca ayāvaccharīrabhāvitvāt ityādibhiranumānaiḥ śarīraguṇa- tvapratiṣedhaḥ, pratyakṣabādhitaviṣayatvātteṣām |

yadyapyavayavarambha- vayaveṣu caitanyaṃ nāsti, tathāpi kramukaphalatāmbūladala- vayavādiṣu avidyamāno'pi kārye paridṛśyamāno rāgaḥ iva ārambhakāvayavasaṃyogaviśeṣāccharīre tadupalambho nānupapannaḥ |
kiṃca viśeṣaguṇasyāpi ka cidakāraṇapūrva- katvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, yathā śukkakṛṣṇādinānāntubhirārambhe paṭe citratvamārambhakeṣu pratyekamevavidyamānamapi dṛśyate |
yadi avayavini citratvaṃ rūpaṃ nāṅgīkriyate, tadā nīrūpatvā- vayavinaḥ amyalakṣaṇaprasaṅgaḥ |
api ca icchādyutpādikriyatvaṃ indriyāśrayatvaṃ na dehe dṛśyamānaṃ acetanāt vaṭādevyāvartamāne dehasyaiva cetana-
athetarabhūtasaṃghāteṣu acetanyāt śarīre- 'pi nopapadyate iti mataṃ, bhavatāmapi pṛthivyādidravyeṣu caitanyānupalabdhāt dravyatvādeva vyatiriktātmanyapi na saṃbhavediti samāno'yamabhyupagamaḥ |
athocyeta, hṛdyasya dehasya draṣṭṛtvaṃ na ghaṭate, ekasya karmakartṛbhāvavirodhāditi |
naivaṃ, vyatiriktātmavāde vā kathamahaṃpratyayasya draṣṭṛtvam ? rūpabhedāditi cet, tadasākamapi samānam |
tacca śarīre vyatiriktātmani ca na saṃbhavati, svasamavāyijñānaphala- yogitvāt |
ata ubhayavādisaṃmatasya dehasyaiva cetanatvo- papattau na tattvāntarakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇamasti |
tathā ca sūtraṃ ' pṛthivyāpastejovāyuriti tattvāni, tebhya- ścaitanyaṃ kiṇvadibhyo madaśaktivat '
anyathā ātmana: paramamahatve cāmbugamyamāne sparśaśūnya- tvādeva parispandānumānamanādyo na mukhyā: syu: |
api ca suṣuptau ātmā vṛttihīna: iti nirvivādam |
jaḍatvavyāptaṃ śarīrādiṣu dṛṣṭamanātmatvaṃ, jaḍatvaṃ ca saṃvidi nivarttamānaṃ anātmatvamapi nivarttayati |
kiṃca yaistu saṃvidavyatirikta ātmā abhyupeta:, tai: saṃvedanamapi aṅgīkriyate eva, tadadhīnatvāt tatsiddhe: |
ata ubhayathāsiddhisiddhadeva sakalavyavahāropa- pattau kiṃ tattvāntarābhyupagamena ? nanu 'ahaṃ jānāmi' iti jñātā vyatirikta ātmā pratyakṣata: prakāśate |
kṣaṇabhaṅginyā: saṃvida: ātmatve pratipannamayābhāvena aparayugjñāṃtasya pareyu: pratyabhijñānānupapatti: |
bhavati hi anyeyurdṛṣṭe pareyurdira- mahaṃmadaśe iti pratyaya: |
nirālambanatvasādhanānāṃ nirālambanatve nirālambanatvameva na sidhyet, sālambanatvena anekānti- katvam |
atha vijñānalakṣaṇastanmāsayitayā pratyabhijñopa- patti:, naivaṃ, tasya sthāyitve kṣaṇikatvapratijñāvirodhāt apasiddhāntaprasaṅgācca |

lūnapunarjātakeśadādi- jātivivekavaditi cenna, tatra tadavyatirikta: pūrvopara- vyaktidarśī sādṛśyānusaṃdhātā caika: samasti, atra tu vijñānavyaktīnāṃ kṣaṇikatvena parasparānusaṃdhānaṃ ca na saṃbhava- tīti na sādṛśyanibandhanaṃ pratyabhijñānam |
kiṃca sādṛśya- mapi kṣaṇikaṃ sthāyi vā ? kṣaṇikatve jñānatulyatvāt tanni- bandhanaṃ pratyabhijñānam |
tathāhi, nānā- deśeṣu sarvatra buddhisukhādīnāmupalambhānna sarvatrātmana: saṃnidhirabhyupagantavya:; guṇinamantareṇa guṇasyāvasthānā- saṃbhavāt |
tatra gatvā saṃnidhau kalpyamāne gatikalpyanaṃ tatkāraṇakalpyanaṃ ceti gauravaṃ prasajyate, agacchato'pi saṃnidhānadarśanāt |
ākāśādau idameva vimalaṃ, yadagaccha- to'pi yugapannānādeśeṣu saṃnidhānam |
kiṃca ātmā sarva- mūrtibhi: saṃyujyate, aṇuparimāṇarahitatve sati nitya- dravyatvāt, yadityaṃ tadityaṃ yathā ākāśādi |
atha aṇuparimāṇo bhayatu ātmā, ko doṣa: ? ayameva doṣa:, aṇuparimāṇatve yugapadeva śira:pādavedanā nopa- padyate |
kiṃca ātmā aṇuparimāṇadhāro na bhavati, indriyagrāhyaguṇādhikaraṇatvāt, ghaṭādivaditi |
tathāhi, ātmā yatropalabhyate tatparimāṇa: tatraiva sarvopalabhyamānaguṇatvāt, yadityaṃ tattathā, yathā'tarvarttitayopalabhyamānaprabhā'nuguṇa: pradīpo gṛhaparimāṇa: iti digambarā: |
tat nopapannaṃ, ātmana: sarvamūrtibhi: saha saṃyogasya sādhitatvāt, tatraivopalya- mānaguṇatvaṃ viruddhaṃ, dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikala: |
nahi gṛho- daravartinīṃ pradīpaprabhā gṛhasamānaparimāṇā, tadantarvarttitena nyūnaparimāṇatvāt |
nahi samānaparimāṇaṃ gṛhāntaraṃ gṛhānta- vaiti dṛṣṭam |
tathā sādhanavikalaśca, nahi gṛhāntarvarttinī prabhā gṛhe sarvopalabhyate |
yat niravayavadravyaṃ, tat aṇu vā vibhu vā dṛṣṭam |
tathā ca śruti: 'anantamparaṃ' 'sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā' iti ca |
ata'yaṃ meda: pāramārthika: kālpanikau veti vādināṃ vipratipatti: |
pratyakṣoṇa tāvat ahamiti bhoktṛtā ātmā parātmano bhinna: pratīyate |
ato vilakṣaṇā- kārabuddhivodhyatayā ghaṭapaṭayoriva svātmapararātmano: meda: sphuṭatara: |
atha ya evāhamiti pratīyate, sa eva para- śarīrastho'yamiti pratīyate iti, maivaṃ, yadi paraśarīre'pi sa evātmā, tarhi kathamabhedo'pi pratyabhijñāyate |

tathā, yathā kaṭṭekartṛkatve karaṇe'pi cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭasyaiva tvagi- ndriyeṇa pratyabhijñāya 'ahamadrākṣaṃ, ahaṃ spṛśāmi' iti, tathā paraśarīrastha ātmā parānubhūtamipi pratyabhijñānīyāt, ekātmadātmano'nubhavitu: |
na ca manomedāt apratya- bhijñeti vācyam |
vivādādhyāsito'ya- mātmā dravyatvātiriktarūpadhārabhedena nānā, aśā- vaṇaviśeṣaguṇādhikaraṇatvāt, yadityaṃ tattathā yathā ghaṭādi |
tathā ātmā nānā bhavitumarhati, jñānasamavāyi- kāraṇaśrayatvāt, manovat |
tathā ātmā nānā, viśeṣa- guṇādhāratvāt ghaṭādivat |
vivādādhyāsitāni śarīrāṇi ekena ātmanā ātmavanti, śarīratvāt prativādiśarīravat |
ata: eka- syāpi ātmana: sarvaśarīreṣu vidyamānatvāt siddhasādha- nam |
atha ekenaivātmā ātmavat sādhyate, tarhi prati- vādiśarīre sarvasyātmānāṃ sadvāvāt sādhyavikalatā dṛṣṭā- ntasya |
atha ekātmatve bhogasādhanamiti sādhyate, tarhi ekameva śarīraṃ yathā svasya bhogasādhanam, tathā svasya ca bhāryādīnāṃ śarīrāṇyapi bhogasādhanānveveti punarapi sādhyavikalatā |
atha na bhogasādhanatvamātraṃ sādhaṃ kiṃtu bhogāyatanatvaṃ, ataśca na sādhyavikalateti |
tanna, kimidaṃ bhogāyatanatvaṃ nāma ? yadi bhogasādhanatvaṃ, tarhi pūrvoktameva dūṣaṇam |
atha bhoga: sukhaṃ, tadāyatanatvaṃ nāma sukhasamavāyitvamabhipretaṃ, tadā śarīreṣu sukhasama- yābhāvāt bādhitaviṣayatvamapasiddhāntaśca sapratisādhanasya hetu: |
tathāhi, vivādādhyāsitāni ekakālavartti- śarīrāṇi svasaṃsthayā ātmavanti, śarīratvāt, prati- vādiśarīravat |
na ca janmāntaraśarīreṣu anekāntyam, ekakālavarttināṃ pakṣīkṛtatvāt |
na ca saubhyādiśarīreṣu vyabhicāra:, teṣāṃ yugapadeva bahuśarīraparigrahe pramāṇā- bhāvāt, purāṇavādānāṃ cānyatvāt |
yadi teṣāmaneka- śarīrāṇi santītyabhiniveśa:, tadā asadādyekakālavarttinī śarīrāṇīti pakṣaviśeṣa eva kartavya: |
tathāhi, sukhadu:khavyavasthā tāvat pratīyate, eka: sukhamanubhavati yadā, tadaivāparo du:khī dṛṣṭa:, iyaṃ sukhadu:khādivyavasthā ātmabhedaṃ vinā anupa- padyamānā medaṃ kalpayati |
nanu iyaṃ vyavasthā ekātma- katve'pyupapadyate, yathā ekaśarīre 'pāde me vedanā, śirasi me sukhaṃ' iti vyavasthā, tathā śarīrāntare'pi evaṃ, tatra saṃbandhasyanusandhānamapyasti |
maivaṃ, yatraikyamarthaṃ saṃprati- pannaṃ, tatra saṃbandhasyanusandhānamapyasti |
yatra saṃbandhanusaṃdhānaṃ nāsti, tatra ekātmakatvamapi nāstyeva |
śarīrabhedaprayuktaṃ anusaṃdhānaṃ nāmabhedaprayuktakamiti cet, ātmana ekatve'pi śarīrabhede jātissarasyānusandhānadarśanāt |
anyathā aka- smādeva sarvaviṣayamamusaṃdhānaṃ kimiti nāstīti cet |
ato'styanusandhānaṃ ātmabhede satye- vopapadyate na śarīrabhede |
'dve brahmaṇī veditavye paraṃ cāparaṃ ca' 'dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣvajāte |
'pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā' 'sarva ete'pyātmāno'bhyucaranti' 'so'śnute sarvān kāmān saha brahmaṇā' 'eko bahūnāṃ
vidadhāti kāmān ' 'nirañjana: paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti' 'mama sādharmyamāgatā: ' 'uttama: puruṣastanya: ' ityādi śruti: smṛtirapi |
tathā 'brāhmaṇo bṛhaspatisavena yajeta' 'rājā rājasūyena' 'vaiśyo vaiśyastomena' ityādimaṃ- vidhaya: adhikārimedādye ātmabhedamākṣipanti |
nanu bhavatāṃ kṛtsnasyāgamasya kāryaparatvena prāmāṇyāt na siddhārthe'tmātmabhedaprāmāṇyamupapadyate |
naivaṃ, ekātmavādināṃ bhavatāṃ siddhe'pi prāmāṇyāt ātmabhede pramāṇamevāgama: |
na ca pratyakṣavirodhe āga- masyaiva balīyastvaṃ, tathā sati upaniṣadvākyānāṃ ka- cidvaiṣṇavyā varṇyaṃ śāstre kriyamāṇamasaṃgataṃ syāt |
tatra 'ekemevādvitīyaṃ' ityādyeka- tvaśrutaya: ekasmin śarīre eva svāmītyevaṃparā: |
'neha nānāsti kiṃcana' ityādi nānātvaniṣedha- śrutaya: anekaśarīragrahaṇe'pyeka ātmā, na nānā iti |
evaṃ 'eṣa neti neti' ityādayastu dehendriyādibhyo bheda- parā: |
evaṃ ca sati nānā''tmavāde eva baddhamuktavyavasthopapatti: |
ekatve tu kālpanikī baddhamuktavyavastheti cet, tarhi bandhamokṣayormithyātvāt sādhu samarthita: advaitavādamirmokṣa: |
tathā viṣayagrahaṇe grāhakatvenaiva ātmana: siddhi:, na grāhyatvena, ekasya karmakartṛttvavirodhāt |
yadi viṣayagrahaṇe kartṛtvātmā na prakāśyate, tadā svaparavedyoranatiśaya: syāt |
athocyate, grāhakatvā anavabhāse'pi ātma- paravedyoratiśaya: sidhyatyeva |
tathāhi, khasamaveta- jñānajananeva svavedyasyātiśaya:, parasamavetajñānajananeva paravedyasya |
yathā yasyaiva gamanaṃ takṣaṇaṃ spandanaṃ, tasyaiva deśāntaraprāpti:, nāspandanavata: |
atha svaparasaṃbandha- jñānajananavayavasthe kathaṃmavagamyate iti cet, svīkīya- parakīyandriyārthasannikarṣādijñānahetusāmagrībhedena sukhamava- gantuṃ śakyate |
nahi anyasya bodhe anyasya siddhi:, atiprasaṅgāt |
kiṃca saṃvidadhīnā ca sakala- bhāvavyavasthāsiddhi:, sā viṣayaprakāśakāle na prakāśyate, kimuta punastadāśrayatvena prakāśa: |
yattu ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmīti viṣayaprakāśakāle sarvatra niyamena tritayaṃ prakāśate ityucyate, tadapi sarvalokaviruddhaṃ, ghaṭo'yaṃ paṭo'yamiti viṣayamātrasyaiva prakāśane sarvatrikam |
yattu cit jñānavyavahāra:, sa prākaṭyādyanumitajñāna- nibandhana: prakāśa: |
api ca yadi ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmītivyavahārāt ātmasiddhirviṣayajñānanibandhanavat tarhi 'cākṣuṣaṃ rūpaṃ' 'āvaṇa: śabda:' ityādindriyaviśiṣṭa- vyavahārāt cakṣurādisiddhirāpi rūpādijñānāt syāt |
atha tatrāpyamānasiddhacakṣurādinibandhanaśrutvādidyava- hāra:, tarhi atrāpi jñānāntaranibandhana: iti tulyacarca: |
bhavati ca viṣayavittī mayedaṃ viditamiti sarveṣāṃ sarvatra pratibhāsa: |
svavedyaṃ tu svapratiyogitayā prakāśate, paravedyaṃ tu parapratiyogitayā |
yo'yaṃ svavedyasya paravedyāti- śaya:, sa: asati svabhāve nopapadyate ityarthāpatti: grāhaka- siddhī pramāṇam |
tanna, yadi khasamavetajñānāt vedyamātrameva jñānaṃ, tadā jñātādhiṣyāt ajñātasya so'tiśayo bhavatu, na para- jñānāt svajñānasya |
yadā puna: khasamavetajñāne ātmano- 'pi pratītirista, tadā svavedyasya paravedyāt rūpavailakṣaṇyaṃ kāryavailakṣaṇyaṃ copapadyate, abhāvasya vyavahārānupapatte: |
nahi svīkayena dīpena svasyaiva prakāśo, na parasyeti niyama: |
yattu viṣayamātrameva prakāśate, vyavahāro'pi tasyaiva, ātmavyavahārastu na viṣayagrahaṇaniyata iti |
tanna, yatra ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmīti ātmavyavahāra: saṃpratipanna:, tatrāpi nātmaviṣayajñānāt ahaṃvyavahārasyopapatti: |
atastatnāpi viṣaya- bodhādeva ahaṃvyavahāra iti vaktavyam |
evaṃ ca sati yatra viṣayamātravyavahāra: ghaṭo'yamiti, tatrāpi viṣaya- jñānādeva kartṛtayā 'ātmā me jñāta:' 'iti, yadi paraṃ vyajiviharṣā''bhāvādātmani saṃvide vyavahāro na jāta: |
na ca jñātasya sarvasya vyavahāraniyama:, nirvikalpādī vyabhicārāt |
ato viṣayabodhādeva ātmā na jñānajño:, tadaivaṃ pratīti: syāt 'ghaṭastāvadayaṃ, jñāyate na veti na vidma:, mama vā pratibhāsate parasya vā ityapi na vidma:' iti |
yattu cākṣuṣaṃ rūpamityādipratītivyavahārābhyāṃ cakṣuso'pi viṣayajñānena pratītiprasaṅga iti, tadyuktaṃ, tathāvidhapratītiniyāmā- vāt cakṣurādyanumānajñānameva niścīyate |
atra tu jñānāntarameva na saṃbhavati, vyavahāro'pi niyata: ityuktam |
na ca mānasapratyakṣeṇa ātmaviṣayajñānaṃ bhavati, ekasyaiva kartṛkarmabhāvavirodhāt |
na ca rūpabhedāt kartṛkarmabhāvopapatti:, niraṃśatvāt grāhakaika- rūpatvādātmana: |
nanu kriyājanyaphalabhāgitvaṃ hi karmatvaṃ, yathā gamanajanyaphalabhāgino grāmasya, atrāpi saṃvedanakriyā- janyaphalaṃ bhāsanaṃ vyavahāro vā, tadubhayamapi ātmani abhyupagatameva, ato na kartṛtvam |
na ca caikasya karmatva- bhāva: kacidapi dṛṣṭa: |

kiṃca ghaṭamahaṃ jānā- mīti vartamānapratītivyavahārau dṛśyate, tatra bhavatā jñānasya kṣaṇikatvena svānumānakāle atītatvāt asādhisamiti bhūtapratītivyavahāraveva syātāṃ na vartamānapratītivyavahārau |
'ghaṭa- mahaṃ vedmi' ityātmano grāhakatayā bhānaṃ sarveṣāṃ saṃmata- meva |
tadidaṃ grāhakatayā bhānaṃ viṣayavittīdhīnaṃ, bhāna- tvāt, vittivedyabhānavat |
api ca ātmasādhikā saṃvit svāśraya- vyatiriktakarmikā, sakarmakakriyātvāt, pākādivat |
ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmītyātmano vyavahāra: ghaṭajñānanibandhana:, tadanantaramupajāyamānatvāt, ghaṭavyavahāravat, ātma- viṣayajñānānantaramupajāyamānatvāt |
tadanantaramupajāya- mānatvamiddhamiti cenna, ātmaviṣayajñānasyaiva śaśa- viṣāṇatulyatvāt asiddhi: anyāsiddhirvā vaktuṃ na śakyate |

kiṃca vivādādhyāsitātmasvarūpasiddhi: viṣa- yānubhavanibandhanā, ātmasvarūpasiddhitvāt jāgrata: ātmasvarūpavat, yathā suptikāle ātmasvarūpasiddhi- rnāsti, prabodhadaśāyāṃ viṣayānanubhavadarśanāt ātmasvarūpa- siddhinirmīyate tadityartha: |
ata: siddham 'buddhī- ndriyādibhyo bhinna ātmā vibhudhaiva: |
pravi. pṛ. 84-97. kartṛlopavyāsastu virupyate niṣkriyātvāt ātmana: |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 173. sākṣātkāreṇa pratibhāsamānatvāt ātmana: anumānādiṣyāpi pratyakṣatva |
ātmanāṃ vibhūnāṃ satāṃ punarnānātve'pi sarveṣāṃ sarvaśarīrai: saṃbandhāt anyadīyasukhadu:khādyanupalabdhi: ? ke cit tāvadāhu: 'yathā śarīramātre'pi mātu- garbhābhamartinām |
sukhādīnāṃ vyavasthaiva sarvatraivā bhaviṣyati' 'śarīraparimāṇatvādvādi'pi kilāyaṃ tulyo doṣa:, tathāpi garbhātmanadeśatvāt mātṛkṣetrajña: tadgatani sukhādīni upalabheta |
tatra yastasya parihāra:, sa sarvānmāna sarvaśarīreṣu bhaviṣyatītyaviśeṣa:, yadi atra upapattirucyate |
tasya ca tava ca ubhayorapi anyena paryyanuyo- gāt |
apica tasya tvagindriyaparimāṇatvāt antaḥśarī- rākāśe brahmavadeva ātmana: anabhyupagamāt naiva garbha-
śarīreṇa mātṛkeṣajñasya prāptirasti, yena tulyadoṣatā syāt |
tato doṣaḥ prasajyeta yogya- bhoge tvadṛṣṭatā |
' yadi hi ātmanaḥ sukhādīnāṃ ca samānadeśatvam eva saṃbandhaḥ upabhogakāraṇamiṣyeta, tato'yaṃ doṣaḥ syāt |
iha tu cakṣurādīnāmeva kṣetrajña- yogyatālakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
tatra yathaiva tvagindriyeṇa sparśa- samānadeśānāmpi rūpādīnāmagrahaṇaṃ, evamanyenātmanā anyadīyamarthadharmopabhogaḥ sulabhagraham |
vā. 2|2|15 pṛ. 404, ākāśādikkāṭhātmanāṃ paramāṇudṛṣṭā- ntamalena nityatvāt 1|3|8|27 pṛ. 285, ātmajñānaṃ vinā (karmesu) pravṛttireva nāsti |
atha nu vijñānādanyo vijñātā nityaḥ, tata ekasminnahani ya eva upalabdhvā, aparedyurapi sa eva eṣiṣyatīti |
yat nopalabhāmahe, tat śaśaviṣāṇa- vadeva nāstītyavagacchāmaḥ |
na ca tasminnasati vijñāna- sadbhāvaḥ anupapannaḥ |
na ca jñātari vijñānānyasmin avati, jñāne ca anitye aparedyuricchā anupapannā, pratyakṣagatatvādeva |
no khalvapi etat dṛṣṭaṃ, ya eva anyedyuḥ upalabdhvā sa eva anyedyurapisthitai |
idaṃ tu dṛṣṭaṃ, yat ka cidanyena dṛṣṭaṃ anya icchati, ka cin na |
samānāyāṃ saṃtatau anya icchati, saṃtatyantare necchati |
(ratnākaraḥ- avaśyaṃ kṛtanāśakṛtābhyāgamaparihārāya nityaḥ pumān pratipāda- yitavyaḥ |
ayameva tasya śarīreṇa saṃbandho, yat bhogāyatatvena ātmasātkaraṇam |
(kathaṃ sakri- yatvaṃ vibhoḥ tadāha- ) na parispanda evaikaḥ kriyā naḥ kaṇabhojicchattu ||
na ca svasamavetaiva kartṛbhiḥ kriyate kriyā |
krayo yathā''- tmano nāsti gamanādi tathaiva hi |
yathā vā deva- dattasya chedane kāṣṭhasaṃśrite |
na ca sarvatra tulyatvaṃ syāt prayojakakarmaṇām |
calanena hyasi yoddhā prayukte chedane prati |
tannivṛttau na teṣāṃ syād dhyānaṃ, śiṣyopadeśane |
pravṛttirdṛśyate sā ca, tenāmā taiḥ pratīyate |
(ratnākaraḥ- na kevalamupaniṣadvacanādeva ātmā''stitvaṃ, agnihotrādiviśeṣo'pi nityaṃ bhoktāramantareṇa anupa- padyamānāḥ, tarmyāt yotayantyeva |
tameva tu upaniṣadaḥ gahanatayā vispaṣṭayante śrutyādibhiridamiha |
avināśī svarūpeṇa puruṣo, yā tu nāśitā |
(ratnākaraḥ- nityāmasattāmātreṇaiva vedaprāmāṇyasiddheḥ tanmātramiha pratipāditaṃ, dāḍhyārthi- bhistu vedāntavihiteṣveva śravaṇamanananididhyāsanādiṣu yatitavya iti |
) bṛhatī- nanu ca anyatvopalabdhau satyāṃ gauḥ vāhī- kasya ca, gauṇyā nirdeśa upapadyate 'gaurvāhīkaḥ' iti |
' nopalabhāmahe iti ko'bhiprāyaḥ ? ayamevābhiprāyo nopalabhāmahe iti |
caturṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ samā- hāramātraṃ śarīraṃ, na caturbhūtāracaṇaṃ, kiṃtu pārthivameva śarīraṃ,
paratantrāṇyanyāni taijasāni vāyavīyāni ca dravyāṇi saṃyogīni |
taduktaṃ paraiḥ : 'saṃyogasyapi vipratiṣiddho mimaḥ pañcānāṃ' iti |
tathāhi, śarīramidaṃ na pañcabhūtā- rabdhaṃ caturbhūtārabdhaṃ vā, nākṣupācākṣuṣadvyārabdhasya acākṣuṣatvāpatteḥ vāyuvanaspatisaṃyogavat |
tadāhuḥ : 'pratyakṣāpratyakṣāṇāṃ na-(ṇāma-)pratyakṣatvāt saṃyogasya pañcātmakatvaṃ na vidyate' (vaiśe. 4|2|12) iti |
na ca pṛthivyatejobhirapi cākṣuṣaiḥ yathākramaṃ anuṣṇāśīta- śītoṣṇasparśabhāgabhiḥ ārabhyate, etantyalakṣaṇasparśa- patteḥ |
yathā hi sitāsitatanvārabdhaḥ paṭaḥ villakṣaṇa- citrarūpo bhavati, tathā idamapi śarīre vilakṣaṇasparśa syāt |
taduktaṃ taireva 'guṇāntaraprādurbhāvācca vyātma- kamapi na' (vaiśe. 4|2|13) iti |
ekapārthivāṇagatasa ca ekākino gandhasya ganvāntarārambhakatvānupapatteḥ agandhaṃ śarīramāpadyeta |
tatsaṃyoginaḥ : paratantrāḥ pare bhūtāntarārabdhāḥ kāryadravyaviśeṣāḥ cakṣurādayaḥ iti tantrāntarāt anusara- ṇīyam |
tena cātubhautikaḥ saṃghātaḥ) na tarhi śarīrakāryāṇyetāni ayāvaccharīramācilādi- tyarthaḥ |
satyapi bhūtatve upāttānāṃ na rūpādayaḥ ityopa- labhyante |
sa cāyaṃ naikāntena śarīrakāryatayā asaṃbhavaṃ sādhayituṃ kṣamate |
yadi bhūtārabdhadravyasamavāyīni etāni syuḥ, tadā kāryadravyasamavāyitvāt kāraṇamye'pi tadāpattiḥ syāt |
kāraṇaguṇapūrvako hi kāryadravye vaiśeṣikaguṇārambhaḥ yathā ghaṭe rūpādārambhaḥ, vaiśeṣikaguṇaśca buddhyādayaḥ |
nanu dravyāṇāmapi kaṭhino vikāro dṛśyate karakā''diḥ |
acetanācca gomayādeḥ : cetanau vṛkṣiko jāyate iti |
kāṭhinyaṃ nāma na guṇāntaraṃ, apitu avayavānāṃ viralaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
tatra yadi kāraṇadravye'pi buddhyādayaḥ syuḥ : tadārambhaṇi ghaṭādīni buddhyādibhiḥ bhaveyuḥ |
tathā 'satyapi bhūtatvena anu- pāttānāṃ' [ 'bhūtatve upāttānāṃ' ] iti bṛhaṭīpāṭhaḥ : aśuddhaḥ syāt ] śarīratvena astrīkṛtānāṃ na rūpādaya iva vaiśe- ṣikaguṇāḥ : prāṇādayaḥ upalabhyante |
'kāryatāṃ na kāraṇajñānāt' [ 'kāryāntarājñānāt kāraṇājñānāt' ] iti pāṭha āvaśyako bhāti anupadameva tathā vyākhyānāt |
mūle vaiśeṣikasūtrapāṭhe tu 'kāryeṣu jñānāt 5 ajñānācca 6' iti dṛśyate ] iti |
kāraṇabhūtasya pṛthivyādeḥ ajñānāt jñānābhāvāt tadārabdhasya śarīrasya ajñānaṃ jñānābhāvaḥ |
kāraṇājñānaṃ kāryāntarasya ghaṭāderajñānāt iti asya sūtradvayasyārthaḥ |
kiṃca sukhādayaśca na bhūtadharmāḥ śakyante vaktum |
parendriyagrāhyā hi bhūtadharmā rūpādayo bhūtadeva (bhūtānāmiva bhūtavat ) na sukhādayaḥ (parendriyagrāhyāḥ :) |
mā bhuvan bhūtadharmāḥ ; tadvya- tirekasyāsya iti kimatra pramāṇam |
nanu ca kāryametat kāraṇādṛte nopapadyate iti idamevātra pramāṇam |

'nahi yogya upalabhyate tasyatasya saṃbandhinā bhavitavyaṃ' iti yaduktaṃ taduktamiva pratibhāti |
yat utpattimata dṛṣṭaṃ, tat kathaṃ saṃbandhyantaraṃ nāvagamyatīti |
kathaṃ punaridamagamyate visabhāgahelabha- prāyametaditi 'nahi candramasamidaṃ vā' ityatra saṃbandhva- ntaraṃ iti antaraśabdaśravaṇe hi vilakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhabhūtaḥ pratīyate |
satyamupapadyate, na tu kāryamakāraṇaṃ iti śakyate vaktum |
bhavatu dṛṣṭatā granthasya, na punaḥ doṣa eva arthinyatve (arthāntarava-
ataḥ samānasaṃtānihetukramevedaṃ kārya- jālaṃ nātra visadhadoṣopalabdhau pramāṇamasti ityupasaṃhṛtam |
yadi ca visabhāgahāte nopapattiḥ syāt anyavasthaiva syāt |
anayaiva yuktyā ( buddhayādibhyo'nyasya anupalabdheḥ para- sparakāraṇatayā copapatteḥ; jñānātīti- ) kartṛśabdāryaḥ icchā smṛtiśca pratyuktāḥ; anyasya ( jñānātiriktasya ) adarśanāt iti |
nahi adṛṣṭe anyasmin visabhāge ( visadṛśe ) smṛtyādayo nopapadyante iti śakyate vaktum |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sarve evamī prati- pattihetavaḥ ātmanaḥ upanyasta nissante bhāṣyakāreṇa |
yadi ete hetavo na nirākriye- ran tadā śiṣyāṇāṃ eṣyāpi vaiśeṣikādidarśanaśravaṇavipra- labdhabuddhīnāṃ samīcīnāmātmelabhimānaḥ na syāt iti teṣāṃ hetūnāṃ nirākaraṇam |

yattāvadidamuktaṃ ( bhā. pṛ. 60 ) 'prāṇādibhirainamupalabhāmahe' iti kimatrāyuktam ? bhūtaguṇā hyamī na bhavanti ayāvadravyabhāvitāditi niraste bhūtadharmatve āśrayitvācca saṃbandhitāyāmavagatāyāṃ cittacaitānāṃ ca svayamāśrayitvāt ātmaguṇā hyete iti yuktamevoktam |
kathamanena anātmani ātma- buddhiḥ śakyate vaktuṃ ? tatsādayo'pi āśritatayā upalabhyamānā ayāvadravyabhūtitayā ca samavyātmaguṇatayā uktāḥ ( vaiśeṣikādibhiḥ |
atro- cyate - ) prāṇādayastāvat ayāvadravyabhūtitayā naiva śakyate vaktum |
ye'pi sukhādaya upanyastāḥ, te'pi bhūtavikāra- hetutvāt bhūtaguṇā eveti śakyate vaktum |
na ca avasthā anavasthāvato- 'nyā iti siddhaṃ bhūtaguṇānāṃ ( sukhādīnām |
tena sukhādayo'pi bhūteṣu samavāyiṣu nayanādiṣu prasannatādi- vikāraṃ prati asamavāyikāraṇabhūtāḥ bhūtasamavāyina eveti |
nanu ca evameva vaktavyaṃ, kimityukte kāmaṃ sukhādaya eva sphuriti |
abhyupagamāpyapi ( abhūtadhamaivaṃ) ayamevārthaḥ ( ātmadharmatvaṃ ) na sidhyatītyabhiprāyaḥ, kāmābhidhānāt |
atra ke cit prabhābhimānino vipratipannāḥ ( bauddhāḥ |
nahi ekatra upalabdhyāśrayitā bhavati bhūtānāmiva parasparam |
tassātte'pi sukhādayaḥ svatantrā vā āśrayiṇo vā ityanyupagamāt pradarśitam |
atrāpare brahmavidaḥ ( sāṃkhyāḥ ) kartṛbhimānāt smṛteri- cchātśca mahadādibhūtaparyantatvāt śarīrāt atiriktamā- tmānaṃ upalamāmahe iti pratipannāḥ |
kathaṃ punaḥ : abhi- dhānādeḥ hetutā uktā taiḥ ? jñānātmakaṃ hi antaḥkaraṇaṃ mahadādi ( buddhayahaṃkāramanāṃsi ) jñeyaṃ ca kāryam |
jñānena kimapi jñeyaṃ, bhāvayet iti hi pratyayaḥ |
( uttaraṃ - ) yeṣāṃ tāvat ( vaiśe- ṣikāṇāṃ ) ātmani jñānaṃ samavaiti, teṣāṃ tatkāraṇatvāt pratyayakartṛtāpyapi siddhaiva |
yeṣāṃ ( sāṃkhyānāṃ ) punaḥ buddhidharmataiva prasiddhā jñānādayaḥ, teṣāmapi bhoktṛtayā ayaṃ hetuḥ |
( ātmano hi bhoktṛtayā buddhirjñānarūpeṇa bhogyatayā viparīmate |
iti ) kathaṃ icchātaḥ upalabdhi- rūpācceti śyanyatiriktaṃ svakāraṇaṃ icchā avagamayituṃ na śaknoti |
uttaraṃ - ) evamuktā, anu- bhūtapūrvaviṣayo hi abhilāṣaḥ icchā |
na ca kṣaṇikesu anubhūtapūrvamimānaḥ upapadyate ( yasya bauddha darśane
samavāyikāraṇaṃ nāma nāsti, na tasya kṣaṇikesu skandhesu vijñānarūpavedanasaṃskārasaṃjñakeṣu bhūtapūrvā buddhikalpa- yate, pūrvabhoktuḥ adhunātanobhoktṛśca anyatvāt |
tassā- dasti pūrvottarakālavartī bhogayogī skanyātirekī puruṣa iti ) |
na punaḥ dṛṣṭasyābhāvo dṛṣṭatvāt nānu- papanna iti śakyate vaktum |
kathaṃ tarhi bhāṣyakāroktaṃ 'anupapannamiti naḥ ka saṃpra- tyayaḥ ' iti |
nanu anubhūyamānena sthireṇātmanā vinā siyānubhavaḥ eva yathā nopapadyate, tathā kartrā vinā kartṛbhavaḥ |
( tatrāha - ) anubhavaḥ eva yasya ( bauddhasya ) anubhūyate, kā tasya anubhava- mānāpekṣā |
tassāt suṣṭhu ucyate 'anupapannaḥ iti naḥ ka saṃpratyayaḥ ' iti |
'vijñānaghana evai- tebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānuvinaśyati na pretya saṃjñā'sti' iti |
tassāt anātmani ātmabuddhereta- amī nirākaraṇīyatayā upanyastā bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇa |
‘atrocyate naitadevaṃ anyeyurdṛṣṭaḥ pareyuḥ ahamitimadarśa iti bhavati pratyayaḥ |
tassāt na vyatiriktaḥ anyo'sti, yatrāyaṃ ahaṃśabdaḥ |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ atrānumānanirākaraṇe ? asaṃbhavāt iti brūmaḥ |
pratyakṣa- dṛṣṭe anumānaṃ na saṃbhavati iti sāhasamidam |
tassāt nātra ( anumānasya - ) asaṃbhavamabhiprāyo varṇayituṃ śakyate |
athaitanmanasi vartate paroktamanumānaṃ na saṃbhava- tīti, pratyayopanyāsāt kiṃmarthaḥ ? |
nahi asati pratyakṣe anumānamupapadyate iti cet |
) kimidaṃ asati pratyakṣe iti, asti cānumānaṃ pratyakṣyāpāranirapekṣaṃ ( kriyā''diṣu |
na brūmo nahi anumānaṃ pratyakṣyāpāranirapekṣaṃ nāstīti, kiṃ tarhi, khayamātmānaṃ pratyakṣyāṇupalabhya nedamanumānaṃ pravartate iti |
athāyamupadeśaḥ : parārtha- eva pravṛttaḥ, ātmasaṃvidaḥ : idānīṃ ka upayogaḥ ( pratyakṣaṃ tarhi nopanyasanīyam |
) atha parasyāpi prati- pattau pratyakṣameva pramāṇaṃ iti, ( tarhi ) anumāno- panyāso nirarthakaḥ |
punarapahūyate 'na vayamahamiti imaṃ śabdaṃ prayujamānaṃ asminnarthe hetutvena vyapadiśāmaḥ' iti, tadapi abuddhimata ivābhidhānaṃ pratibhāti |

kiṃ apa- havīyasa ( ahaṃśabdasya ) upanyāse prayojanam ? ida- maparamyuktaṃ 'yadi vijñānādanyadasti vijñātu, vijñāna- mapāsya tannidarśayatāṃ idaṃ tadīdaṃ ceti' pṛṣṭe 'atro- cyate' ityevādi uttaraṃ nopapadyate |
atra vijñānā- grahaṇe tadgrahaṇaṃ nāstīti coditam |
nahi khasaṃvedyatvanincanaṃ vijñāna- grahaṇapūrvakaṃ grahaṇaṃ vastunaḥ |
athāyamabhiprāyaḥ, khasaṃvit na pṛthaktayā vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyate parasmai iti, atyaspamida- mucyate |
apṛthaktayā vā kathaṃ parena asaṃvinaḥ arthaḥ vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyate parasmai ? tassāt idamapi anālocya- nāpūrvakameva pratibhāti ! prayuktasya copanyāse kiṃ prayo- janamiti naiva jñāyate |
( vijñānagrahaṇapuraḥsaro viśeṣa- bodhaḥ iti siddhānte'pi ayamartho na parityaktaḥ |
‘tassāt vijñānaṃ pratyākhyāya na kasya cidrūpaṃ darśayituṃ śakyaṃ ' ityanena bhāṣyeṇa vijñānagrahaṇena upasaṃhāraḥ kṛtaḥ |
) athāyamabhiprāyaḥ, vijñānagrahaṇe'pi ātmanaḥ pratya- kṣatvaṃ na śakyate apahrotum |
na ca kaścit viśeṣo- 'mihitaḥ ( yena pratyakṣajñānapakṣe'pi bāhyārthasiddhiḥ syāt ) upamānamapi naiyāyikaiḥ abhidadhatā lakṣaṇā-
na ca 'ahaṃ gacchāmi' iti codyasya vispaṣṭaṃ kiṃ viduttaramupalabhyate |
brahmavidvi- rūddhaṃ caitat, yaduta ahaṃpratyayameyetā ātmanaḥ |
mūrdhāmi- ṣiktamadaṃ anātmani ātmajñānaṃ ityādyuhaṃ yaduta ahaṃ- kṛtimemakāraśceti |
'atrocyate, anyedyurdṛṣṭe aparedyuḥ ahamitamadarśa iti bhavati pratyayaḥ, pratyagātmani caitadbhavati, na paratra' |
kimidaṃ ahamitamadarśa iti ? yadi tāvat pratyabhijñā, kṣaṇikatvasaitaduttaraṃ, na nairātmyasya ( tena ahaṃpratyayamātramevopapadyasanīyaṃ na pratyabhijñānam |
) na cātra kṣaṇikatvanirākaraṇamapiprametaṃ, kiṃ tarhi ? buddhīndriya- śarīravyatiriktasya ātmanaḥ sadbhāvapratipattiḥ |
tasya cātra chadmaḥ paraiḥ- kṣimaḥ pratipādyate |
na punarātmano vidyamānasya nityatā- ''kṣepaṃ prati samādhiḥ ( pratipādyate ) |
na cānya upalabhyā hāḥ, atha cānya ityetāvatā nairātmyam |
tasmāt ahaṃpratyayagrāhyaḥ kāryakaraṇavyatiriktaḥ ātmā astītyetāvat vaktavyam |
athaiyaṃ buddhiḥ, kṣaṇikatvāt sādhite'pi ( ātmanaḥ ) astitve ātmataiva hīyate iti |
( moktṛtā hi ātmatā, kṣaṇikasya bhoktṛtvaṃ hīyate ityarthaḥ |
) keyaṃ vācoyuktiḥ, skandhānāṃ skandhatā kimiti na hīyate |
yathā kṣaṇikatve'pi bhoktṛtā nāpanetuṃ śakyate skandhānāṃ, tathā bhoktṛtvamapi ātmanaḥ |
( samādhatte ) - anātmajño bhavān, yasya evaṃvidhāni codyāni |
vetsi bhoḥ kimiti kṣaṇa- katā skandhānāmukteti |
pṛcchati pūrva- pakṣī- ) bhokturabhāve kṣaṇikatā skandhānāṃ iti kimidaṃ rājājñā ? nayaṃ rājājñā, nyāyā hyeṣā |
kathaṃ ? bhoktuḥ sadbhāve kāryakaraṇaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ iti nāsti naḥ pramāṇam |
( yo hi bhoktāramabhyupagacchati, abhyupagaccha- tyeva bhuktirūpāṃ kriyām |
tasya kadā cit kāryodayāt kāraṇānumāne prastute tato'numānāt kriyāsiddhirbhavati |
kriyā ca kṣaṇikasya syāt ā phalaniṣatteḥ |
tasmāt bhoktāramabhyupagacchadbhiḥ bhuktirūpāṃ kriyām aṅgīkurvāṇaiḥ sthiraṃ dravyaṃ aṅgīkaraṇīyam |
sthiradravyāṅgī- kāre ca, kṣaṇikatve nāsti pramāṇam |
( kriyāyāṃ hi asatyāṃ kādācitkaṃ kāryaṃ āgantukasvabhāvaṃ kāraṇaṃ anumāpayat dravyameva kṣaṇikatvaṃ nayati |
kriyāyāṃ tu aṅgīkṛtāyāṃ tata eva kādācitkakāryasya upapannatvāt kṣaṇikatā dravyāṇā- mavagantuṃ na śakyate |
atha kriyā'ṅgīkāraḥ eva na kriyate, tadā kartṛtvaṃ bhoktṛtvaṃ ca na sidhyati |
pariṇatisvabhāvamātramidaṃ kāryakaraṇaṃ iti kalpane kartā bhoktā iti ca ( ato bhoktāramicchatā avaśya- ṅgīkaraṇīyā kriyā |

sthemā ca dravyasya pratyabhijñā'dhīnaḥ, iti manvāno bhāṣyakāraḥ satyamamidaṃ pratyaya upadarśitavān ityāha - ) tasmāt ahaṃpratyayālambanamātrasiddhau, siddhe'pi buddhī- ndriyaśarīravyatiriktaṇa kartṛtvabhoktṛtā iti manvānaḥ sapratyabhijñaṃ pratyakṣamupanyastavān bhāṣyakāraḥ |
ata eva ca nairātmyavādinaḥ muhurmuhuḥ kṣaṇikatāṃ akiṃcitkaratāṃ ca āpādayanti ātmanaḥ - 'carmopamaścet so'nityaḥ khaluyaścedastvam' iti |
prati- pannaṃ ca sarvagatatvaṃ sarvatra sulopalabdhāt |
vinā'pi gamanena na kasya cidanu- papattiḥ |
śarīrāgamane tu yā sukhādyupalabdhiḥ, sā prādeśikatvena sukhādīnāmupapannā |
prādeśikatvaṃ ca sukhādīnāṃ ātmanaḥ saṃnikarṣatvāt manasaśca
ātmaiva yat śarīraśūnye deśe nopalabhyate, tatrāpi prādeśikatvaiva jñānasya hetuḥ |
pariharati - ) calanātmakaṃ kriyām aṅgīkṛtya anikṣiptatā uktā, na punarbhogopalabdhāvapi |

viṣayapramiṇasā ca etannibandhanā iti śabdādhikaraṇe upanyasyate ( sa evāyaṃ gakāra iti yeyaṃ pratyabhijñā, sā pūrvaparāgamanubhavatisthiratvānubhavitavyapratyayabhijñānimittā iti śabdādhikaraṇasamīpe pratyabhijñeya upanyasyate, sthire'nu- bhavitari siddhe viṣayapratyabhijñā yathā syāditi |
) ‘ pratyagātmani caitadbhavati ’ iti kasyārthasya siddhaye ? bhoktṛtvasyaiva |
yadi paro'pi ahaṃpratyayasya viṣayatāmāpadyate bhoktṛtvajñānaṃ prāpnoti |
' na paratra ' paro hyasau yo'nyairduṣṭavāniti pratyabhijña'nupapattiḥ |
' yatrā- yamahaṃśabdaḥ ' iti ahaṃśabdopameyāḥ tarhi kimarthaḥ ? yadi paramapyavahā ( na vayaṃ ahaṃ itīmaṃ śabdaṃ prayujya- mānaṃ asminnarthe hetutvena vyapadiśāmaḥ ' ityevaṃ apahavaṃ kartum |
pareṇa hi sākṣāt hetutāṃ manvānena ātmanyapi ahaṃśabdo'sti iti pradarśitaṃ ' patrāpi ahaṃśabdo bhaktyā dṛśyate ' ityeva- mādinā |
' na vayaṃ ' iti na sākṣāt hetatayā idamupamyastaṃ iti prakaṭitam |
hetvarthapradarśanārthastu śabdaprayogaḥ ( pratyaya eva tu sākṣāt hetuḥ |
) nanu ca ' ahaṃ gacchāmi ' iti na hetvarthapradarśanārthatā śakyate parihartum |
atra hi ahaṃpratyayo'pi vyabhicāryeva upalabhyate asalanātmaka- tvādātmanaḥ |
kimiti nirāśāhaikeva gamyate ? ( uttaraṃ - ) kimatrāśaṅkanīyam ( nāstyevāśaṅkanīyam |
pratya- yāntaragrāhye ca vastuni viruddhapratyayāntaralabhyatatā nopa- padyate, gaurādīha iti yathā ( na kadācidapi vāhikaḥ gopratyayaviṣayatāmāpadyate |
) gauṇaḥ upapadyate iti cet, parihṛtaṃ tathaiva |
tasmāt asaṃbhinneṃdrapratyaya eva ahaṃ- pratyaya ālambanam |
brāhmaṇamapi amumevārthamanuvadati ‘ aśīryo na hi śīryate ’ iti aśīryatayā bhoktṛtva- mātmanaḥ |
vinaśvaraṃ ca vijñānaṃ iti tadvyatiriktā- lambanatāmāpādayati |
vyāmoho'yaṃ ahaṃkāragranthaḥ iti na śakyate vaktuṃ ' yasya ca duṣṭaṃ karaṇaṃ, yatra ca mithyeti bhavati pratyayaḥ, sa eva asamīcīnaḥ pratyayo nānyaḥ |
yadi paraṃ brahmavididameṣa niścayaḥ : ‘ yadupalabhyate tadasat, yannopalabhyate tat tattvaṃ ’ iti namastabhyaḥ |
viduṣi nottaraṃ vācya ' iti atra pari- hāraḥ |
tasmāt yathārtho''yamarthavādaḥ : ‘ sa eṣa yajñayudhī yajamānaḥ ’ iti |
‘ āha yadi vijñānādanyadasti vijñātṛ, vijñānama- pāsya tannidarśayatāṃ idaṃ tat īdṛśaṃ ceti ' kimidaṃ codyate ? idamatra codyate, tadeva na jñāyate ( iti ) |

kathaṃ na jñāyate ? kiṃvā sa vijñānasya ātmano'nya iti pramāṇa- tayā upanyastaḥ, yenedamucyate vijñānamapāsya tat nidarśa- yitavyamiti, anekavastvavalambanaṃ hi yatra jñānaṃ, tatredaṃ yujyate vaktuṃ ' idamapāsya idaṃ nidarśayitavyaṃ ' iti, iha tu ekātmarūpaiva saṃvit |
tasmāt idaṃ nyadasanīya iti tasmi padam ( asmītyeva pravṛttam |
ayamasabhiprāyaḥ :, jñeyatve hyatmanaḥ jñānajñātṛṇī na vyati- rikte śakyete vaktum |
nahi yat yasyaiva bādhyaṃ, tat tasyaiva bādhakaṃ bhavitumarhati |
' yathā kaściccakṣuṣmān ' iti anenāpi nidarśanena kartṛkaraṇāntarameva eṣa sthirīkṛtaḥ |
nanu cātra kartṛntaraṃ ( puruṣaḥ ) karaṇāṃtaraṃ ( cakṣuḥ ) bhinne meyāt ( rūpāt ) kimidaṃ nidarśanaṃ ? kartṛntarā- bhāvasāmānyāt |
tassāt kāraṇadoṣarahitā aviparitā ca saṃvit ātmāstītye hetuḥ, bhavatu kartṛntaraṃ mā vā ( asti ca ātmanyapi saṃvit |
ataḥ asyātmā yadyapi kartṛntaraṃ nāsti ) ukte ca ' yathā'vagamyante arthāḥ tathā bhavanti |
atrāpi brāhmaṇaṃ bhavati ' śāntāyāṃ vāci ' iti |
vyāpṛte anyatra kartṛtayā kathaṃ kartṛkaraṇāntarābhāve gṛhyate iti praśnaḥ |
' ātmajyotaḥ samprāditi hovāca ' ityayamarthaḥ pūrvottarapakṣabhaṅgyā pradarśitaḥ |
evaṃ ca ' agryo na hi gṛhyate ' iti brāhmaṇamupapannam |

( uttare - ) nanu na śrutaṃ bhavatā ' ātmajyotaḥ : samprāṭ ' iti, idamapi kiṃ na śrutaṃ dvayoḥ : tadanurodhena ( svayaṃjyotiṣvānurodhena ) asya agrahaṇaśrutiḥ : āpekṣikī, na punaḥ ātmagrahaṇaṃ anyathā ( parapuruṣābhiprāyeṇa ) vyākhyāyate iti |
kā yuktiḥ ? svayaṃjyotirgrahaṇe guṇavādasyāsaṃbhavāt, agrāhyatve ca āpekṣikatvā upapatteḥ |
nanu caivaṃ sati kathaṃ parasmai pratipādayituṃ śakyate ? parapratya- yārthe cāyamārambhaḥ : śāstrakārāṇāṃ śrutīnāṃ ca |
parasaṃviātiṣedhamukhena copadeśānāṃ upadeśatā, tadidaṃ ' neti neti ' ityupyastam |
nanu ca sukhādyo'pi svasaṃvedyā eva, te'pi pareṇa naiva parasyāḥ saṃvedyante |
kathaṃ tebhyo'nyatayā parasmai upadiṣṭa ātmā bhavati |
ataḥ pratipakṣopaghātī kathaṃ vidvadbhiḥ likhyate ? tadidamapyupasthitaguruśrautrayam |
( kaḥ punarayoviśeṣaḥ ? anenāpi ( ceṣṭā'numānena ) parasyaiva ( ātmanaḥ ) saṃvidupalabhyate |
tena ceṣṭāto yadanumānaṃ, na tatkāryāt bhūmajñādīnāṃ sukhādyakārya- tvāt anumānaṃ kāryataḥ |
tena ceṣṭāto nātmā pratīyate, bhūmajñādimistu sukhādayaḥ pratīyante |
tena parātmā nānumānato'pi pareṇāvagamyate, sukhādayastu avagamyante iti viśeṣaḥ |

) kathaṃ punaḥ asaṃdigdhasatya ( yadi akāryabhūtā ceṣṭā ātmanaḥ, tadā kathaṃ ātmanā asaṃvedā satī ātmanyupalakṣyati ?, kathaṃ vā anupalabdhitaḥ puruṣāntarāvāvapraśraḥ : svatmani viparyayāśaṅkā nirastā |
( prayatnenāpi anviṣyamāṇe yadā puruṣāntare viparyayo nāvagamyate, tadā svaviṣaye yā viparyayāśaṅkā, sā nivartate eva |
ceṣṭā- 'numānena hi yāhyameva mama ātmapratipattiḥ, tādṛśayeva asyāpīti pratipattiḥ : sahaśī pratīyate |
pratyetavyasya ātmanaḥ : na cāgrahaṇe saṃbandhanā upayujyate ityuktam |
kathanaṃ ca pramāṇāntarapūrvake iti na lakṣaṇavyavahārayorvirodhaḥ |
yadapyucyate ' vijñānamāsya tacchidraśyatāṃ ' iti, nanu ca dattottarametat ' svasaṃvedyaḥ sa bhavati ' iti |
yadi na kasya ciduttaraṃ, kimetāvatā taduttaraṃ bhavitavyam ? |
( dūṣaṇavādī āha - ) nanu ca tada- ntarābhidhānāt taduttaramiti gamyate |
' svasaṃvedyaḥ sa bhavati ' itīda- mapi liṅgādeva uttaramasītyete |
( avalamyāha - ) satyaṃ ' idamahaṃ vedami ' iti saṃvedyate, nākārāntarakalpanā |
( vijñāna- viviktasya tu grahaṇaṃ na prāpnoti vyāpṛtātvagamāt ( viṣayaṃ jānantrātmā avagamyate iti vijñānarahitasya ātmano grahaṇaṃ na prāpnoti iti vijñānasyāpi grahaṇena bhavita- vyam ) |
( vijñānaṃ hi gṛhyamāṇaṃ kena cit rūpeṇa grāhyaṃ, rūparahitasya grahaṇābhāvāt |
tatra ca nīlādivyatirikta- rūpāntarānupalabdheḥ : tasyaiva nīladirūpatā prāpnoti |
) tassāt ( vijñānagrahaṇanibandhane bādhārthe avasthite ) vikalpa evāyaṃ ahaṃkāragranthaḥ |
' yadi upāyameva pratiṣedhasi ' iti kimabhipreta- muttaravādinaḥ ? |
idamabhipretaṃ, ādyānukāritā hi grahaṇa- ślokā, na grāhakakāritā vyāpṛtātvayā anupāyatvaiva ( upāyataiva iti ṛjupāṭhaḥ ) upanyastā |
tadidamāha - ' yadi upāyameva pratiṣedhasi na śakyate upāyamantareṇa upetyanupetum |
' tathā, kaḥ śuklo nāma ? yatra śuklayamasti ' ityanena kiṃ samarthitam ? idaṃ samarthitaṃ, yathā na jñeyamavagamyate iti |
nanu caivaṃ śuklatāpuraḥsareva śukle buddhiḥ ( evaṃ jñānapuraḥsareva jñeye'pi buddhiḥ ) evaṃ ca anabhipreto'rthaḥ samarthito bhavati |
etāvadanenoktaṃ, nopāyamantareṇa upeyānā- mupeyatve'pi tatpuraḥsarā na saṃvit ityuktam |
tasmāt sarvavijñānānāṃ śeyatā ātmanaḥ : sthitā bhavati ' ahamita- madarśa ' iti ( tassāt sarvajñaviṣayatā sthitā ātmanaḥ : ahamitamadarśa iti bhāṣyeṇa ) |
iyān viśeṣaḥ, anu- mānādiṣvapi pratyakṣatā ( sākṣātkaraṇe pratibhāsamānatvāt ātmanaḥ : anumānādiṣvapi pratyakṣataiva ) |
pramātṛrūpatā tu jñānasya anāśaktanīyaiva, anāśaktatvāt ( kena nidādinā ) |
yuktaṃ cedaṃ yathāśaṅkitaṃ karmapravaṇatvāt karmaṇaḥ : sakarmakasya ( sakarmakāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ karmapradhānatvāt ) |
yadapi jñātṛ- taiva jñānāhate na śakyate'vagantumiti, tadadhīnatvāt tadavagateḥ |
yuktaṃ ' na ca rūpāntaropalabdhiḥ ' iti, tadapi pratyuktaṃ ' kāmaṃ vijñānamapahūnayeta nārthaḥ ' iti |
yat punarbrahmaṇaṃ ' na pretya saṃjñā'sti ' iti, tat pūrvottarabhaṅgyā svayameva brāhmaṇā- ntareṇa vyākhyātam |
nanu ca eṣa : ityupapannārthe, ' svarge loke yāti ' iti kathaṃ, adhikṛta- kāmasiddheḥ : siddham |
yuktaṃ ' ahaṃkāramamakārau anātmani ātmābhimānau ' iti, muditakaṣāyāṇāmevatat kathanīyaṃ, na karmasaṅghināṃ ityupamyate |
āha ca bhagavān dvaipāyanaḥ : ' na buddhibhedaṃ janayedajñānāṃ karmasaṅghinām ' ( magī. 3|26 ) iti rahasyādhikāre |
tasmāt vidhutamatra bhāṣyakāreṇa bhagavatā vacanāntarānurodhāt, nājñānāt iti |
ātmavādaḥ yatu pratyakṣaviruddhaṃ vacanamupanyastaṃ ' sa eṣa yajñāyudhī yajamānaḥ : ajñāsā svarge lokaṃ yāti ' iti etat śabdena pratyakṣaṃ śarīraṃ yajñāyudhasaṃyuktaṃ upadi- śati iti |
tadabhidhīyate, arthavādatvāt asya anyapara- tvāt na svārthe pramāṇāntaravirodho doṣaḥ |
nahi anena śarīrasya svargagamanamucyate, kiṃ tarhi ? ātmano yasya etat śarīraṃ, so'pi hi śarīra- śarīriṇoḥ : abhedādupacāreṇa śarīrasthena yajñāyudhitena pratyakṣatvena ca vyapadiśyate |
ātmano vā svargagamanaṃ śarīre upacaryate iti nāsti virodhaḥ |
na ca śakyate tasya kāpilavat akartṛtvaṃ vaktuṃ, śrutivirodhāt |
yathā atraiva ' yajamānaḥ : svarge lokaṃ yāti ' iti |
yathā ' ya evaṃ vidvān cinute ṛgnoyeva ' ' ya evaṃ vidvān
nirdeśaḥ kriyate, saṃsṛṣṭe caruyavasī kathaṃ gamyetātāmiti |
tatra carasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ payaḥ carau tyajyamāne niyataṃ tyajyate |
payasā śrapyamāṇasya tasya pradānaṃ kathaṃ syāditi sati nirdiśyate |
yā yasya śrūyate, sā tasya deveteti |
yathā 'dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ tāṃ udakaṃ tat saṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyaṃ' iti evamevedaṃ caruyavasī yadyapi saptamīnirdiṣṭaṃ, saptamyarthasyāviśiṣṭatvāt, nirdeśamātrasya vivakṣitatvāt |
yayaudane dadhi dattvā abhyavahartavyamiti, odanasya nirdeśamātraṃ vivakṣyate, nābhikaraṇatvam |
bhāṣya-- evaṃ ca kṛtvā pradeyasaṃskārāṇāṃ keṣāṃ cit pratiṣedha upapanno bhavati |
bhāṣya-- tatpratiṣedhe yaḥ pratiṣedhe, tathābhūtalamāpi loke varjyate |
tatrapratiṣedhe, taile pīte pānīyaṃ na pātavyamiti vileyaṃ yavāgraśca pīyate |
na ca tathābhūtasya varjanat payo loke evaṃ bhavati |
yathā hi loke payaḥ, tadvihāpi bhavitumarhatīti sāmānyato'haṃ vyapadiṣṭam |
( atra sarvapustakeṣu adharmatvamapra0 ityeva pāṭha upa- labhyate |
bhāṣye tu 'adharmatvaṃ tu payasaḥ' iti mūle mudritaṃ, 'adharmakaṃ tu payaḥ' iti ṭippaṇyāṃ pāṭhaḥ pradarśitaḥ |
asya tāvat siddhāntasūtratvāt tuśabda āvaśyaka eva |
tasmāt sārvatrikaḥ pāṭho na samīcīnaḥ iti spaṣṭam |

tataḥ pūrvaṃ tu adharmatvaṃ iti vā adharma ityeva padaṃ syāditi cintāyāṃ, prathamasūtre pūrvapakṣe 'taddharma', iti bahuvrīhiṇā samastasya aniścayatvāntasya padasya pāṭhāt siddhāntasūtre'pi adharma iti aniścayatvāntameva paṭhituṃ yuktaṃ, na tu adharmatvaṃ iti, vairūpyāt |
sadharma- adharma iti yuktā vipratipattiḥ, na tu 'sadharma- adharmatvaṃ' iti |
tasmāt atra 'adharma tvapradānāt' ityeva pāṭhaḥ svīkṛto'smi |
bhāṣya-- adharmaṃ tu payaḥ, nāsya pradeyadharmā bhaveyuḥ; ityarthaḥ |
( atra 'adharmatvaṃ tu payasaḥ nāsya' iti bhā-pāṭhaḥ |
'adharmakaṃ tu payaḥ nāsya' iti bhā- ṭippaṇī pāṭhaḥ |
kiṃca 'pradeyapayodharmāḥ' iti bhā- pāṭhaḥ, 'pradeyadharmāḥ' iti tu bhā-ṭippaṇyāḥ |
evaṃ sati bhāṣye anyādṛśa eva pāṭhaḥ anumito'ssāmiḥ ) kutaḥ ? apradānāt |
nanu carau pradīyamāne pradāpyate ityevamarthe payasi śrapaṇamucyate |
netyāha, śrutśruḥ kathaṃ syādityevamarthe hi tat jñāyate |
na tu pacena payasā naitādarthyaṃ śrūyate |
nanu vākyabhedaḥ evaṃ bhavatīti parihāpita eva pakṣaḥ |
payaso yat vākyena pradeyatvaṃ gamyate, tat adhikaraṇaśrutyā bādhyate |
payasi, ādityaśrutiriyamau caruyayaḥ śabdau āditya- pradhānau ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati, na vākyabhedaprasaṅgaḥ |
bhāṣya-- atha yacchiṣyukte, 'ayujuṣā vatsāna- pākaroti' 'apavitravati gāṃ dohayati' iti |
naita- devaṃ sati asyārthasya sādhakaṃ bhavati |
naiva apradeyatvāt yajuṣā vatsā apākriyante, na pavitravati gaurdūhyate |
asmācca vākyā- didaṃ gamyate, na yajuṣā vatsā apākriyante, na pavitravati gaurdūhyate iti |
tacca asya apradeyatvāt yajuḥ pavitraṃ ceti |
vihitaṃ keṣāṃ cit, yajuṣā vatsānapākaroti, pavitravati gāṃ dohayati |
varjane guṇabhāvitvāt taduktapratiṣedhāt syāt, kāraṇāt kevalalakṣaṇam |
bhāṣya-- aya yaduktaṃ, payaḥpratiṣedhe, payasā sikkaṃ ca saṃsṛṣṭaṃ ca varjyate iti |
yuktaṃ hi loke yatsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ varjane, tadeva hi tatra pratiṣedhyate |
nityaṃ hi upasarjanabhūtaṃ bhojane payaḥ pracarati |
yatra pracarati, tasya hi aprasaṅgāt pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ |
kāraṇāt kevalalakṣaṇaṃ, vrataumaṣaṃ vā yasya, sa kevalamupayukte |
tasmāt prāyeṇa guṇabhūtatvāt payasoḥ payoyuktameva na bhakṣayitavyami- tyevamarthaḥ payaḥpratiṣedha ucyate |
yitavyaṃ' ityukte darviṃgatamapi lepaṃ varjayanti, evamihāpi 'payo na pātavyaṃ' ityukte payasā sikkaṃ payasā saṃsṛṣṭaṃ varjayiṣyantīti |
tatra tāvadapi yo bhakṣayati, yāvati māṃsarasamātraṃ viditaṃ bhavati, tasyāpi doṣaḥ, na śleṣmaprakopādi kiṃcit dṛṣṭamapekṣate |
iti prāpte brūmaḥ 'caruṇā''ghārabhūtena payasā ca viśeṣa- dhataḥ |
soma-- daśārṇaudaurasya agrihotratvābhāvena tadu- ddharaṇadharmaprāptyā'pi payasaḥ pradhānārthatayā pradeyadharma- prāptiḥ ityityiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- saha śrapaṇe pradānamapi saha dṛśyate, caroḥ saha tyajyamānatvāt- mavāt 'dadhi madhu vratamāpo dhānāḥ' ityādidat |
saṃsṛṣṭa- tvācca payaso'pi yāgārthadravyatvāt pradeyadharmāḥ syu iti |
caravat syuḥ, pākahetuḥ saptamyā syurna tataḥ ||
' bhāṭṭa-- 'ādityaḥ prāyaṇīyaḥ payasi caruḥ' ityatra payasi ityadhikaraṇanirdeśāt na payo havirdravyaṃ, api tu caroreva, taddhitasāmānyādhikaraṇyena tasyaiva devatāsaṃbandhāt |
payasastu adharmatvalakṣaṇamātraṃ, ato na tatra pradeyadharmāḥ |
vastutastu saṃyanārthatvāccaroḥ, caroḥ ca tadabhāvāt, te'pi na bhavantyevetyuktam |

pradeyadharmaprāptyāśaṅkā tu yadyapi nānyathā cit, tathāpi ādityaprakaraṇe 'ayujuṣā vatsānapākaroti, apavitravati gāṃ dohayati' ityādiprāptasavāpākaraṇādyanuvādena yajurādipavitravidhiva utpattivākye saptamyā vivakṣatāyāḥ abhyuditeṣṭi-
vastutastu laukikasiddhapayograhaṇasyaiva tadā prasakterdīnādikartavyatā aprāptatvena avaśyavidhe- yatve'pi itarasya sarvasyaiva nityānuvādatvāt na saptamyarthā- vivakṣā|
) yattu ekadeśasya sato nānādeśeṣu yugapaddarśanamanupapannamiti, ādityaṃ padya devānāmapi (‘mūrya’ ityarthaḥ); eka-, san anekadeśāvasthita iva dṛśyate ..., evaṃ śabde'pi|

yathā ‘āśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ’ ‘vaiṣṇava trikapālaṃ’ ‘āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ’ iti aṣṭākapālasya yadādyaṃ dravyaṃ, tasya dharmāḥ āśvine dvikapāle grāhyāḥ|
ityadhikaraṇe ādyagrahaṇaṃ anyalopaḥ iti siddhāntitaṃ, tasyāyaṃ ‘aparvāṃsu tu saṃkhyāsu|

yathā anyatrāpi ṛtvijāṃ saṃskāro vidhīyate ādyāne ‘yastaṃ ṣoḍaśimādyāsnu syāt, sa etāṃ rātriṃ vrataṃ caret’ iti ‘na māṃsamaśrīyāt, na striyamupeyāt’ iti vacanāt adhvaryornimo vidhīyate, tathā jyotiṣṭome ‘sarve ṛtvijaḥ upavasanti’ iti ṛtvijāmupavāso vidhīyate, tadvat ihāpi (satre) ṛtvijāmeva saṃskāro bhaviṣyati|
✻ ādhānaṃ agnicanagate kāmye vārkṣe āpte vā agnī nāsti pūrvasiddhatvāt, saṃskārānupayogāt|

ādhānaṃ cakṣurnimita 913 ādhānaṃ na katvartha ādhānaṃ sarvakarmaṇāṃ
iti) bhā. 6|1|7|31. ādhānaṃ na katvartha, na puruṣārtha iti tantraratne dravyārjanavarṇake (4|1|2|12 varṇakaṃ 3) uktam|
‘ādhānaṃ na puruṣārthe’ iti siddhāntavārtikaṃ tantraratne ‘pratyakṣeṇa dravyārjanasya yathā puruṣārthatā avagamyate naivaṃ ādhānasya’ ityabhiprāyaṃ vyākhyātam|
