✻ ādhānaṃ yathā agnerguṇaḥ saṃskārārthaḥ; evaṃ pava- mānaharvīṣyāpi agnerava guṇabhūtāni|
✻ ādhānaṃ sarvakarmaṇāṃ tantraṃ, na tu pratikarma pṛthak||
dravyasya cākarmakālaniṣatteḥ prayogaḥ sarvārthaḥ: syāt, svakālatvāt|
bhāṣyaṃ - ‘vasante brāhmaṇo'gnimādadhīta, grīṣme rājanyaḥ, śaradi vaiśyaḥ|
‘āhavanīye juhoti’ ‘gārhapatye havīṃṣi śrapayati’ dakṣiṇāgnau anvāhāryaśrapaṇādi karoti iti teṣāmagnīnāṃ karmasuyogaḥ|
tatra vicāryate kiṃ tastasya karmaṇo'nyena bhedena ādhānaṃ kartavyaṃ, athavā sarveṣāṃ aiṣṭikapāśukramī- kadāvihomikānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tantraṃ iti|
kiṃ prāptaṃ? dravyasya agneḥ, akarmakālaniṣatteḥ vasante grīṣme śaradi iti, prayogaḥ ādhānaṃ, sarvārthe syāt|
na kasya cit karmaṇaḥ kāle śrūyate|
tatra na gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ asmaṃ karmaṇe imādhānaṃ nāsmai iti|
nanu ādhānottaraṃ yasya karmaṇaḥ prayogaḥ, tadarthaṃ tadā- dhānaṃ iti gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ|
yadā'pi sarvārthe tadā'pi avaradaṃ kasya cit karmaṇaḥ pūrva prayogaḥ; yogapadyasyāsaṃbha- vāt|
tadekena ānantyaṃ samo hetuḥ; sarvārthatve ekāthatve ca|
na vā ādhānaṃ karmāṇi upakra- myante, yathā prayayanena|
yadi upakramyetara tataḥ yadanantaraṃ karma, tasyopakramo vijñāyeta
nimittādiśena anekeṣu kriyamāṇeṇu kasya cit ānantaryasya cāvarjanīyatvāt |
ādhānasamaye kasyāpi karmaviśeṣasya niyatatvābhāvena anudeśādeva sarvoddeśāvagataśca |
ata eva prayogarhamidaṃ'pi dṛṣṭaśrutinambasya tattadāja- peyavyuktakālatvarūpaguṇamāvaviśeṣatayā prativājapeya- mātṛcittvena |

na caivaṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ yāgānāṃ pratyekaṃ darśapūrṇamāsa- padavācyatvāt paurṇamāsārambhe darśārambhe ca tataḥ pūrvakāla- kriyamāṇānārambhaṇīyāyā āvṛttiprasaṅgaḥ, kālabhedena pṛthakprayoge'pi ekaphalādhānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ sahaiva mahāsaṃkalpatvādārabhya aikyopapatteḥ |
svatantrakālatve'pi ca yatra pramāṇāntareṇa vyaktiviśeṣasya uddeśyatā'vagamaḥ tatrāpi gṛhyamāṇaśeṣatvāt āvṛttiḥ ityapi dhyeyam |
na caivaṃ ādhānā- karaṇe ṛtuvaiguṇyāpattiḥ, agnyābhāvena vaiguṇyapatteḥ |
vastustu lāghavena ṛtuvidhīnāṃ ādhānasiddhimagraheṇaiva upapattau svayamaprayojakatvābhāvāt anāhitāgneḥ anadhikāra eva ṛtuṣu, iti vaiguṇyāśaṅkā dūrāpāstaiva |

prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe ādhānasya kālāntareṇāmānasya bhinna- prayogavidhivihitatayā sarvārye sakṛdanuṣṭhāne'pi bṛhaspati- savādivat adhikāraviśeṣatve pramāṇābhāvāt nitye ādhānaṃ vinā'pyanuṣṭhānaṃ yathāśaktiprayoge |
' ādhānane agreḥ saṃskṛtatvaṃ na punaḥ karmaṇi saṃskāraḥ etasya kriyate |
bhā. 11|3|1|125, ādhānena agniviśeṣamarjayati, anena svādhīnena ya
ataśca 'āhitā- gniṃ klinnaṃ dāru abhyādadhyāt' ityāhitāgnimata- vadeva ādhānottarameva kratupravṛttiḥ |
iti prāpte, bhāṣya- kārametat tāvat tattadvākye nairāpekṣyaśravaṇe'pi ekasyo- tpādakatvaṃ, itarasya saṃskārakatvaṃ ityatra pramāṇabhāvaḥ |
pratyuta pavamāneṣṭīnāmeva svaniyojakavākye āhavanī- yotpādakatvāvagateḥ ādhānasya guṇavākyāvagatahavanīyo- tpādakatvaṃ vilambopasthitikam |
na caivaṃ ubhayorupā- deyatvavikalpaḥ; 'sadyo nirvapet' 'dvādaśasu rātriṣu anunirvapet' ityādi kālavidhiśādeva samuccayāsiddheḥ |
vārtikamate tu sāṅkhyasya ādhānasya utpādakatvāt na tadabhāve agnisiddhiḥ |
na ca sthāpakatvaṃ bṛhaspatisava- vat pavamāneṣṭīnāṃ, ādhānaprayogavahitatve'pi tadadatra ādhānakaraṇakabhāvanāvirbhāvasyāśrutatvena sthāpaka- kalpanā'nupapatteḥ |
ataḥ pavamāneṣṭyatirekeṇa āhava- nīyaniścayaterabhāvāt tadanantarameva agnihotrādīni |
āhitāgnitve'pi tu ādhānottarameva puruṣasya āhitāgni- padavācyatvopapatteḥ tadanantaraṃ karaṇam |
yattu nidarśanamuktaṃ, tat tūṣṇīhomasya ādhānāṅgatvasya stutyarthaṃ, nāgnihotrasya pūrvapravṛttisūcakam |
etaddhomasyāpi ādhānadvārā agniprayojakasya agnisaṃbaṃdhidharmāviśeṣāt, prāyaṇī- yādipadavat anatideśakatvācca |
ataḥ apūrvatvasya homasya iyaṃ stutiḥ iti nāgnihotrasya pūrvapravṛttī liṅgam |
(6| 8|4|22 ) vivāhāt prāk brahmacāriṇaḥ ādhānaṃ na saṃbhavati ādhānakālasya tadānīmaprāptatvāt iti nyāyārthaḥ |
🞶 ādhānasya āvaśyakatā avasīyate ‘nānāhi- tāgnibhiryeta' iti vākyāt |
su. pṛ. 915. 🞶 ādhā- nasya iṣṭipūrvatvapakṣe brāhmaṇasya paurṇamāsītāgnīṣṭomīyasya haviṣaḥ somādapūrvamutkarṣaḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ : kimiṣṭipūrvatvaṃ somapūrvatvaṃ vā vikalpyate, athavā iṣṭipūrvatvameveti |
vacanamidaṃ bhavati, 'eṣa vai devaratho yad darśapūrṇamāsau, yo darśapūrṇamāsāviṣṭā somena yajate, rathaspaṣṭa evāvasāne sva devānāmavasati samāptye tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ |
'yaḥ somena yakṣya- māṇo'gnīnādadhīta, natu pratīkṣeta nakṣatraṃ' iti |
yaḥ somayāgaṃ kartumādadhīta, sa na pratīkṣeta nakṣatraṃ, nāpi ṛtuṃ, tāvatyeva ādhavīteti ānantaryamucyate |
ānantarye ana- pekṣyamāṇe yatraiva ṛtunakṣatre ukte tasyaiva tayoranādaraḥ kīrtitaḥ |
api ca vispaṣṭā cādyatanī vibhaktiḥ; 'somena yakṣya- māṇaḥ' iti |
yadā sā iṣṭipūrvatvamanujñāya vivakṣyate, na tadā adyatanakālavivakṣā, tatrāyaṃ śabdo vipratiṣidhyeta |
māda0iti ratnapāṭhaḥ ] iti hi (ādhānottarakāle somaḥ ) śrūyate |
sa ca ( somasya karmāṃtarebhyaḥ ) asādhāraṇye ( sati ) upapadyate |

yadi ādhānottarakālaṃ ( prāgeva darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ ) somena yajeta, na darśapūrṇamāsottara- kālaṃ, evaṃ ( sati ) asādhāraṇaḥ saṃtrandhaḥ ( syāt ), itarathā darśapūrṇamāsapaśudhanvādibhiḥ sarvaireva ( puruṣo ) yakṣyate |
tatra somena yakṣyamāṇa iti viśeṣaṇa nāva- kalpeta |
na caivaṃvidhaḥ ( puruṣaḥ ) asti, yaḥ somena naiva yakṣyate, yadapekṣayā ( somena yakṣyamāṇa iti ) viśeṣa- paṇaṃ bhavet |
( sūtrārthamāha -) ṛtunakṣatrapratiṣedhaśca somādhānānnantarye eva ghaṭate ( nānyathā ) |
somasya hi kālaḥ ( 'vasante jyoti- ṣṭomena yajeta' iti ) vihitaḥ |
sa yadi pratiṣidhyeta, kimarthaṃ tasya vidhānam |

yadi ( tu ) ādhānottarakālasya somasya ( natu pṛcchet iti ) kālapratiṣedhaḥ, tato darśapūrṇamāsottarakāle ( some 'darśapūrṇamāsī iṣṭvā somena yajeta' iti vihite ) vasantakālavidhānaṃ kṛtārthe bhavati |
( upasaṃharati-- ) tasmāt somasya dvau kālau prāk darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ; ūrdhvaṃ ca |

( evaṃ sthite adhikaraṇe kimādhānānāntaraṃ anyat kiṃ cidakṛtvā soma eva kartavyaḥ, uta antarā'pi kiṃ cidatraiva iti saṃśaye, na kiṃ cit kartavyaṃ āna- ntāryavagamāt somādhānayoḥḥ iti prāpte pakṣāntaramāha-) na ca ādhānāntaraṃ anyat na kiṃ cidanuṣṭheyaṃ soma eva kartavyaḥ ( iti mantavyaṃ ), kiṃ tarhi pavamāneṣṭi- vrātyapaśu-agnihotrāṇi kṛtvā'pi somo darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prāk kartavyaḥ ityetadapekṣayā 'somena yakṣyamāṇaḥ ' ityāsādhāraṇyamupapadyate eva |
( tadidaṃ bhāṣyakāro na mṛṣyatītyāha - ) yathā tu bhāṣyakāroktaṃ, tathā vrātya- paśuḥ somāṅkatvāt bhavati, pavamāneṣṭyo'pi agnisaṃskāra- tvāt bhavantyeva |
( ye tu iṣṭi- pūrvatvapakṣe eva vrātyapaśuṃ manyante, teṣāṃ kiṃ mūlamiti na vidmaḥ |
'yaḥ somena yakṣyamāṇo'gnīnādadhīta' iti ca sarvairapi yakṣyamāṇaḥ agnimādhatte somena evādhimadhikam |
ayamasau viśeṣaḥ syāt, yat ānantaryaṃ somā- dhānayoriti |
athayakṣyamāṇasya ca pavamānahaviṣāṃ kālanirdeśa- śādānantaryāt viśaṅkā syāt |
bhāṣya-- somena yakṣyamāṇasya ca pavamānahaviṣāṃ kālo nirdiśyate |
'yaḥ somenayakṣyamāṇo'gnīnādadhīta, sa purā saṃvatsarāddvātriṣu nirvapet' iti |
kiṃ prayojanaṃ cintāyāḥ ? iṣṭiḥ ayakṣyamāṇasya somena, nirabhisaṃdhike ādhāne |
soma- pavamāneṣṭibhirvāgyanā ca vyavadhānā- vaśyabhāvena ādhānānāntaryavidhisaṃbhavāt arthādapi somasya na darśapūrṇamāsāpekṣayā pūrvatvam |
evaṃ cātra vācanikakramasya na kenāpi bādhaḥ : iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
'somena yakṣyamāṇaḥ' iti vākye somasya vādhānasya ca anyataḥ prāptalakṣaṇatayā somasyādhāna- tvameva vidheyaṃ, anyathā vākyārthakatvāt |
tatra pava- māneṣṭīnāṃ ādhānātvāt vrātyapaśoḥ somādhikāra- siddhayarthatvācca na vyavadhāyakatvam |
vi- 'darśadīṣṭyā somayāgaḥ kramo'yaṃ niyato na vā |
bhāṣya-- ādhānaprakaraṇe 'yaḥ somena yakṣyamāṇo'- gnīnādadhīta natu pṛcchet nakṣatraṃ' iti śrutam |
na ca tena somasya ādhānānantaryaṃ vidhātuṃ śakyaṃ, ānantarya- syāśravaṇāt vākyabhedaprasaṅgācca |
' yadi hi yajurvede eva eṣābhyutpattiḥ syāt , tatsvarūpa- nimittameva upāṃśutvaṃ syāt |
eteṣāṃ tu sāmavedaupantāṃ svarūpataḥ uccaistvaprasaṅge pradhānasparśanimittamupāṃśutvaṃ iti pradhānadharmatā |
vā. 3|2|19 pṛ. 810. ādhāne 'kṣaume vasānau abhī ādadhīyātāṃ' iti |
vi. 6|1|5. ādhāne dakṣiṇānāṃ aparimitatvaṃ pūrvoktāt ekādaśahāntasaṃkhyāyāḥ sakāśāt saṃkhyā'ntaram |
bhā. 6|1|122. ādhāne dakṣiṇānāṃ aparimitatvaṃ sahasrā- dhikatvam |
bhāṣya-- aparimita (aparimitaṃ deyaṃ ityatra ) kalpāntara iti sampāditam |
athedānīmidaṃ saṃdihyate kiṃ sahasrādūnaṃ aparimitaṃ, uta sahasrādhikamiti |
na kaścidiha bahule viśeṣa āśrīyate sahasrādūnamadhikaṃ veti |
adhikaṃ vā syād, bahurthatvāditaraiḥ saṃnidhā- nāt |
bahuṣu hi imaṃ śabdaṃ upacaranti ityetaduktam |
bahutvaṃ cāpekṣikaṃ, kiṃ cidapekṣya tato'dhikaṃ bahu ityucyate |
yathā putraḥ kiṃ cidapekṣya bhavati, nānyathā |
tatra prakṛtaṃ saṃnihitaṃ cāpekṣya nirṇayaḥ; sahasraṃ ca saṃnihitam |
bhāṣya-- kathamevaṃ ? tatra 'utkṛṣṭaṃ vai aparimitaṃ' iti tadūnantāṃ sahasrasya darśayati |
na caikasāḥ prayogo, bahusaṃyuktaḥ prayogo bhavati |
'brahma- varcasakāmasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi saha niṣpadyāṇi' iti tatra nirvāpe saha codite vacanāt tantraṃ bhavati |
soma--nitye prayoge samānatantratā, kāmye tu prayoga- bhedaḥ |
aveṣṭī prayogadravyasya vairūpye'pi pavamāneṣṭividhu na vairūpyaṃ ityuktānāta saṃgatiḥ |

' bhaṭṭa-- anekapradhānakāḥ pavamāneṣṭayaḥ ' saṃvatsare nirvāpeta, dvādaśāhe caturahe vā, aho nirupyāṇi' itya- nena tatkālaviśiṣṭaikaprayogavidhānāt, 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇa- māsyā yajeta' ityādidat ekaprayogeṇaiva kartavyā itya- vivādam |
ata eva 'aho nirupyāṇi' ityatra ahan: sadyaḥ ādhānesaṃnikṛṣṭāni ityarthāṅgīkāre saṃvatsarādi- kālabādhamātrāṅgīkāre'pi saṃvatsaravākye kālaviśeṣāvaśyaka- tvena tatra ekaprayogavidherāvaśyakatvāt |
tasyaiva ca ādhānesaṃnikarṣavidhānena sadyaḥpakṣe'pi ekaprayogatā- siddhiḥ |
tadevaṃ nityaprayoge sahatvavidhāne'pi saṃyoga- pṛthaktvanyāyena (4|3|15-7) 'yo brahmavarcasakāmaḥ syāt tasya sarvāṇi saha nirupyāṇi', ityanena phalārthe sahatvaṃ dadhyādivat vidhīyate |
tadevaṃ sthite punaḥ : 'yaḥ kāmayeta uttarottaraṃ vasīyān śreyān syāmiti, tasyāme pavamānāya nirupya pāvakaśucibhyāṃ uttare haviṣī samāna- barhīṣi nirvāpeta' iti śrutam |
tatra laghya pavamāna- prayogottarakālatvāviśiṣṭapāvakaśucisamānatantraikaprayogatve phalārthe vidhānāt na trayāṇāmekaprayogatā |
na ca nitya- prayoge trayāṇāmapi sahatvavidhānāt atra laghya pradhāna- mātrakrama eva dadhyādivat phalārthe vidhīyatā iti vācyam |
na caivaṃ prayogabhede kartṛbhedāt laghyukta- samānakartṛkatvānupapattiḥ, varaṇabharaṇādibhedena ṛtvigbhediṣṭha- kartṛtvamede tadadhiṣṭhānekamātreṇa yajamānarūpakatraikyena vā tadupapatteḥ |
vastutastu ādhāneṣṭividhā pavamāneṣṭimadhye eva dānavidhānāt tatraiva prasaṅgena kāryasiddheḥ na pavamāneṣṭeṣu pṛthagvaraṇabharaṇe |
ādhāne pavamāneṣṭayaḥ na pavamāneṣṭi- saṃskṛte'pi, kintu kevalādhānasaṃskṛte eva |
bhārgya-- santi pavamāneṣṭayaḥ ' agre pavamānāya ' ityevamādyāḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛte agnau pavamāneṣṭayaḥ kartavyāḥ, uta neti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? tāsāṃ khalu pavamāneṣṭīnāṃ pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛtaḥ agniḥ prakṛtitaḥ syāt |
yathā āśu prayājā bhavanti codakena, evaṃ pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛtā agnayo'pi bhaveyuḥ |
vā-- 'tasyāṃ tu syāt prajājavat' (10|1| 4|6) ityetadadhikaraṇanyāyena pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛtāgni- sādhyatvaṃ tāsāmiti nāstīti vicāraḥ |
tatra 'iṣṭiṣu darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prakṛtaḥ syāt' (8|1|4|11) ityevaṃ pavamāneṣṭīnāṃ darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtitve siddhe yathaiva prayājādīni atidiśyante, tathaiva pavamāne
deyayoḥ sahādhānābhāvena parāmarśayogāt samyāvasthayapara- tvasya vaktavyatā 'sa hi tasya' ityasya sāhitya- bahubhyaparatvena āhavanīyayogikatvaśravaṇāt |
'yadeva tṛtīyaṃ jyotistadeva tenāpyate' ityāhavanīyaṃ prakṛtya śrutyantarāt |

iti prāpte, tṛtīyapatoḥ padasya auttaravedi- kābhiraparatvāt 'sa hi tasya' ityekavacanena sahitābhidhaya- paratvāyogena sa gārhapatyaḥ tāhavanīyasya yonirityeva tadarthakatayā ṛtvijāmapi tayorlokaṃta eva praklaptiḥ |
idamamānanti 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta, grīṣme rājyanyaḥ, śaradi vaiśyaḥ' iti |
tatra saṃdihyate kiṃ brāhma- ṇādiśravaṇaṃ nimittārthe, brāhmaṇadasyaiva ādhānāḥ, vasantādiṣvādhīrninti, uta brāhmaṇādīnāmādhānaṃ vidhīyate iti |
pūrvādhikaraṇe prāsaṅgikamavedheḥ prayogamedaṃ nirūpya idānīṃ prastuta eva guṇanivandhanaḥ karmabhedaḥ prati- pādyate |
sarvopapada- śravaṇe sati upapadārthasaṃkrānto vidhiḥ dhātvarthānuvāda- pekṣate iti siddham |
tadapi 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnāda- dhīta' iti vasantādyupapadārthasambandhitvāt ādhānānu- vādamapekṣate |
tathāhi, āhavanīyasādhyāḥ khalu agnihotrādayaḥ 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti śruteḥ; 'āhitāgnirāhavanīyaḥ' ityevadavaśāt āhavanīyaśca ādhānasādhyaḥ ityākṣepāt asyeva ādhānaprāptiḥ |
athavā 'ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte' ityetasādeva ana- nyākṣitaśakteḥ vidhāyakāt ādhānasya prāptatvāt tadanu- vādena vasantādikālavidhānāya nimittārthe brāhmaṇadi- śravaṇamiti |
'ya evaṃ sapanaṃ bhrātṛvyamavati sahate, ya evaṃ vidvānagnimā- dhatte' ityevadasaṃnbandhāt vidhivisiddheḥ |
nanvādhānaviśiṣṭe brāhmaṇe brāhmaṇa- viśiṣṭaṃ vā ādhānamaṃ nimittaṃ ? ubhayathā'pi ca viśi- ṣṭānuvāde vākyabhedaḥ |
tatrāpi viśeṣaṇaparyāta, kārakasya ca kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt, brāhmaṇasyaiva nimitta- tvācca vākyabhedaḥ |
na ca nimittakālyorhorapi udedaya- tvena kathamasmin vākye samāveśaḥ |
kālasya kriyā'nvayitvāt nimittasya ca kartavyatvāt vaila- kṣaṇyena samāveśopapatteḥ |
tena yathā'yupapatravyatirekeṇa ādhānasambandhena brāhmaṇādyanuvādādarthavādatvāt brāhmaṇādi- nimittake ādhāne vasantakalāvidhānamiti |
bhavedevaṃ, yadi yathāśrutasyādhānasya ākṣe- pata: prāptirbhavet |
atra hi 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta' ityātmanepadāt kartṛgāmiphalamādhānaṃ pratīyate |
tena anuvādapakṣe evāyaṃ vākyārthaḥ, 'kartṛgātāhavanīyaphalabhājanaṃ brāhmaṇena vasante kartavyam' |
na ca agnihotrādibhiritebhireva ākṣepā- devaṃvidhamādhānaṃ labhyate, yadapyeta |
āhavanīyo hi tairākṣipyate, na tu ādhānānuprabandham |
na ca anuvāda- gataviśeṣadarśanāt tathābhūtasyaivākṣepa iti vācyam |
yathā 'airaṃ kṛtvādeyam' ityatra irāpadasya kasmin sthāne niveśaḥ iti saṃdehe 'na girā girā' iti niṣedhānuvādadarśa- nāt irāpadasya girāpadasthānaniveśo nirṇītaḥ |
iha tu 'āhavanīye juhoti' iti viniyogabalāt āhava- nīyamantareṇa ṛtuvidhyasaṃbhavāt bhavatu āhavanīyopādānā- kṣepaḥ |
sa ca svataḥ prāpyabhāvāt vasantādiviśiṣṭādhāna- meva |
'ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte' iti pratyakṣameva vacanena vidhāyaka- masti āgneyapadayuktam |
tatra kartṛgāmiphalasyaivādhā- nasya prāptatvāt tadanuvādena vasantādivākyeṣu brāhmaṇādinimittaṃ vasantādiphalamātraṃ vidhāsyate |
maivam, syādevaṃ yadi 'ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte' iti vidharbhavet |
evaṃ hi śrūyate 'sa evaṃ sapanaṃ bhrātṛvyamavati
ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte apa upasṛjati' iti |
kiṃca ādhatīti asaṃdigdhaḥ pratyakṣo'tra vidhiḥ śrūyate |
tathā sati agnihotrādiśruteḥ ākṣepaḥ, vartamānapadeśasya vidhitvakalpanāṃ vā na saṃbhavati |
(vā. pṛ. 589) ataḥ sarvathā prāpyabhāvāt vasantādivākyeṣu brāhmaṇādīnāṃ nimittārthe śravaṇaṃ, kiṃtu kartṛkālanekuṇasaṃśraddhāni bhinnānyeva ādhānāni vidhīyante |
nanu apaśudhā dhikaraṇe eva ādhānakṣepo 'ya evaṃ vidvānagnimādhatte' iti vidhiṃ varṇayiṣyate |
tatra hi pradhānabhūtakarmaṇi kamiśruteḥ varṇa- catuṣṭayasādhāraṇatvāt |
tadvalena śudrādhikāre sati tadu- papatyarthe kamiśrutimeva varṇacatuṣṭayasambandhenaiva ādhānasyā- kṣepo bhaviṣyati |

'agnimādhatte' ityasya varṇacatuṣṭayasādhā- raṇānādhānavācakatvaṃ vasantādivākyasyaiva kāla- viśeṣavidhānāt śudrādhikṛtakālīnamevādhānamiti śudra- syāpi āhitāgneradhikārapūrvapakṣe, siddhāntitaṃ kamiśrute- varṇaparatve'pi avirodhāt na etadadhikaraṇasiddhavasantā- divākyānāṃ viśiṣṭādhānakṣepeṇa śudrādhikāraḥ saṃbhavati |
tena kamiśruteḥ varṇacatuṣṭayādhikāratvena samadhikaśudrā- dhikārasaṃsiddherā nirāsārthaṃ tadadhikaraṇam |
tasiddhaṃ caitada- dhikaraṇasiddhameva sarvaṃ sāritamityapi punaruktam |
prayo- janam - pūrvapakṣe āhitasyāpi agre krayaṇādilakṣaṇasya karmāṅgatvam |
sūtraṃ tu - ādhāne'pi pūrvavadeva pāvanavacanāni na nimi- tārthāni ādhānasya asarvaśeṣatvāt āhavanīyavat karma- śeṣatvābhāvena ākṣepābhāvādityarthaḥ |
'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta' 'grīṣme rājanyaḥ' 'śaradi vaiśyaḥ' iti śrutiḥ : ādhāne brāhmaṇādīnāṃ nimittatvamāha, na tu ādhānaprāptikā śrutiriyaṃ iti usūtre pūrvapakṣe siddhāntamāha |
ādhāne viṣaye vasantādi- vākyaṃ brāhmaṇadivasantādiviśiṣṭādhānaprāpakaṃ, na tu prāptā- dhāne nimittasaṃyogena kālaviśeṣadyotakam |
ādhānasya asarvaśeṣa-vān sarvakarmaśeṣatvābhāvāt sarvakarmaṇvatayā ādhānavidheḥ aśravaṇāt |
tasmāt brāhmaṇādīnāṃ ādhānasya prāpakāṇi śrutyādīni iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhavadevaṃ tu sarva- asarva ityanyathā vyākhyātam |
tatra sarvaśeṣatvāt sarva- saṃbhāraśeṣatvāt iti varṇakāntareṇa vyākhyātam |
ādhānaṃ sāṅgenaiva pradhānasya yājurvedikātvāt upāṃ- śutvena bhavitavyam |
vā. 3|3|15 pṛ. 890. ādhānaṃ sāmavedoktaṃ vāravantīyaṃ sāma uccai- svrena prāptaṃ, yajurvedavihitatvena upāṃśutvaprāptyā bādhyate |
vāla, pṛ. 140. ādhānakālaḥ sadyaḥsomacikī- rṣoyāṃ ṛtvanakṣatrādīnāmevena bādhyate |
vi. 5|4|15. ādhānanyāyena ( 3|6|11-13 ) vacnāma prayājādi prakṛteraṅgaṃ bhavati, tadatidiśyate |
na tu pana- māneyasyaḥ karmāṅgaṃ iti sādhitam |
vā. 3|6|16|17. ādhānapavamāneṣṭiyāṃ ( samuccitābhyāṃ ) āhavanīyasiddhī paścāt tasmin agnihotrahomaḥ |
vṛ. 5|2|19-25. ādhānapaurṇamāsyormadhye yajña- mānasya kadā cit maraṇe pātrābhāve dāhāvamaprasaṅgāt ādhānamārabhyaiva yajñapātrāṇi dhāryāṇi |
ādhānavratāni āhitāgni- vratāni ādhānottaramevārabhyante, na tu pavamāneṣṭyanu- ṣṭhānapekṣā, tathā agnicchidratayānyapi cayanānantarameva kartavyānīti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
vṛ. 5|3|10-28. ādhānasamanantaraṃ somamenāyajñamānaḥ : 'purā saṃvasa- rāt havīṃṣi nirvapet' |
bhā. 5|4|13|18. ādhāna- sāmānyavihitakādidikṣāyāḥ bādhaḥ : punarādhānapra- raṇaśratadikṣāyā |
10|3|15-33. ādhāna- sāmnāṃ kacit sāmavedaśāstrāyāṃ vidhiḥ : kalpanīyaḥ iti keṣāṃ cinmatam |
su. pṛ. 1184. ādhāna- sāmotpattervaistuto yājurveditve'pi sāmavedakatvaṃ kṛtvā- cintayā |
soma. 5|1|9 ādhānā- ṅgatvena apūrva evāyaṃ (tūṣṇī) homaḥ vidhīyate |

bhā. 10|8|15. ādhānādivākyanyāyena 'ādhānādivākyānāṃ ṛtvaṅgabhūtāgnisaṃskārapratipādanadvāreṇa puruṣārthatvaṃ' ityevaṃ- rūpeṇa upanidāmapi dūrasthena kratuphalena nairākāṅkṣyaṃ ṛtvarthakartṛpratipādanādareṇa |
pratyakṣavacane sati anyathā''nupapattiḥ sati arthāpatti- labhyaśrayaparigrahaḥ |
'ya evaṃ vidvān' ityapi vartamānapadadeśaḥ pratyakṣāyāṃ liḍi brāhmaṇādivākye- ṣūpalabhyamānavidhiśakti labhate |
asita naitadupanmasya pratyakṣavidhiyuktokopasarjanadi saṃbhāravidhānārthatvaṃ iti aprāptameva brāhmaṇādiviśiṣṭamādhānaṃ vidhīyate iti |
'brāhmaṇādīnāṃ vasantādividhibhiḥ samuccāraṇaṃ' iti , padapadasambandhacāritāyāṃ vidhiśaktau nimittaphalatvāt |
itarastu prāptatvena vidheyatvaṃ nivartayati 'na tu amīṣāṃ ādhāna- sambandho na viditaḥ' iti 'kena prāpto vidita iti' prāpakākṣepaḥ |
itarastu nirākaraṇamapyanyat balīyāsaṃ ca pratyakṣavidhiṃ, kimartha prathamameva upanyasāmi iti matvā 'kāmaśrutiḥ' ityāha |

'kāḥ kāmaśrutyaḥ' iti sakrodhaṃ prāpaṇaśaktau ākṣiptāyāṃ svarūpameva eṣa na jānāti iti manyamāno darśayati 'agnihotrādiphalavidhayaḥ' iti (ārthikaṃ bhāṣyaṃ) kathaṃ anyaparāmiḥ satībhiḥ tat prāptaṃ ityāśaṅkya arthāpatti darśayati |
tena 'karmaje karma yūpavat' (7|3|9|28) iti āhavanīyādi- grāhibhiḥ karmabhiḥ anyopāyatvāt gṛhītamādhāna- miti |
sarvaprakārāsaṃbhave ca viśiṣṭavidhirabhavati iti saṃbhrāpekṣayā vākyabhedamāha |
yadi hi sarvakarmāṇi śeṣabhūtāmādhānaṃ bhavet, tataḥ taiḥ ākṣipyeta vā na vā |
teṣāṃ tu 'rūpaṃ vā''śeṣabhūtatvāt' (7|3|9|129) ityanenaiva nyāyena āhavanīyādigrahaṇamapyavasānāt na kaścidapi ādhānāṅgatvapratipādane heturasti |
tat 'sarvāthe vā' (3|6|1|156) iti vakṣyati, tat sarvakarmā- rthānyatvāt iti vyākhyāsyate |
'kimato yathevaṃ' iti, aṅgāṅgamapi anyathā''nupapattyā śakyamākṣepaṃ iti manyate |
siddhāntavādī tu anyathā''nupapattimānatvāt amayaḥ kāmaśrutibhiḥ prāpyavanti, nādhānamityāha 'nanu ādhānamamīnāmapyupāyaḥ' iti |
tatra nāma rūpamātraṃ gṛhyate, yat laukikopāyasārthaṃ bhavati vakṣyatatvādi |
tasmāt avaśyameṣāṃ vedenaiva upāyo''pi ākṣebhyaḥ, sa tu nādhānavyatirikta''sti iti tadapi āśritamiti |
sarvaiśca taiḥ āhava- nīyādimātrāprāptibhyaḥ kāmaśrutyo nirākāṅkṣāḥ kriyante |
tassātraikāntena ādhānaṃ prāptaṃ iyasti niyama- vicchedakaḥ |
' yathaiva hi vrīhyādīnāṃ na tāvat kṛṣimantareṇotpattiḥ, atha ca na sarvapuruṣaiḥ tathaivopyante, krayādibhirapi labhya- mānatvāt |
evaṃ tāvat prakṛte eṣā ādhanenāgnyādipyanti, apare tu tasmāt upāyāntareṇa prāpyanti |
jyotiṣṭome 'muṣṭī karoti, vācaṃ yacchati, dīkṣita- māvedayati' iti, 'hastāvananenike, ulaparāji stṛṇāti' iti na śrūyate |
tatra ānantaryeṇa pāṭhāt muṣṭīkaraṇaṃ vācyamaśca dīkṣitāvedanaṃ, tathā hastāvananenaṃ ulaparājistaraṇañca iti utsṛṣṭaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
muṣṭīkaraṇa- vācyamayoḥ sarvakarmārthatvaṃ, hastāvananenasya ca ādhyarthya- sakalapadārthādhyālaṃ iti utsṛṣṭa eva siddhāntaḥ |
tathā ca uktamāna- ntarye codanā, na codanā, na pramāṇam |
pravalena liṅgena prakaraṇena ca bādhat iti |
'muṣṭī karoti, vācaṃ yacchati, dīkṣitāvedayati, hastāvananenike, ulaparāji stṛṇāti' iti jyotiṣṭome paṭhitānāṃ vākyānāṃ svena svena padasamūhena sārthakena samāptatvāt |
tasmāt muṣṭīkaraṇavācyamayoḥ sarvakarmā- rthatvaṃ, na dīkṣitāvedanamātrātmakatvam |
tathā hastāvananenasya ādhyarthyasakalapadārthādhyālaṃ, na tu ulaparājistaraṇamātrā- ṅgatvam |
ke. ānantaryamacodanā iti nyāyena prakaraṇasya prābalyam |
kau. 1|4|12 pṛ. 166. ānantarya- macodanā ityanena nyāyena ānantaryasya akāraṇatayā buddhirnivṛtteḥ saṃnidhiena anuṣṭhādhikaraṇe abhihita- tvāt |
su. pṛ. 1112. ānantarye satyāpi yadi dvitīyanyāyaḥ 'ānantaryamacodanā' iti nyāyena (3|1|14|24) tṛtīyanyāyo durāpetaḥ |

soma. 2|1|16. sākāṅkṣapradhānasthale sānāyya- saṃnidhipaṭhitapātrāśudhanamatre sākāṅkṣabuddhipivṛtti- rūpādhikārasya āgneyādisādhāraṇatvāt tasya ca āna- ntaryamacodanā iti nyāyena prajājātāvicca avyavahita- saṃnidhipekṣayā prābalyat na kevalasāṃnāyyāṅgatvam |
bhā. 3|1|14|24 ānantaryarūpakramasya āna- ntyādhikaraṇena (3|1|14|24 aviniyojaka- muktam |
su. pṛ. 1072, ānantaryalakṣaṇasya kramasya viniyojakatvaṃ siddhānte nābhyupagamyate |
pṛ. 1193, ānantaryalakṣaṇasya kramasya viniyojakatvaṃ saṃbha- vati saṃnidhiviśeṣamānānarthakyāya prakaraṇālikalpasya ānantarye'pi tulyatvāt |
pṛ. 1067, ānantaryalakṣaṇa- sya kramasya viniyojakatve tasya pūrvottarayoḥ padā- rthayoḥ tulyatvāt pūrvasyaiva uttaratvaṃ nottarasya pūrvāṅgatvatā iti niyamayogaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ - jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'muṣṭī karoti, vācaṃ yacchati, dīkṣitāvedayati' iti |
tatra sandeha kiṃ muṣṭīkaraṇaṃ vāgmaśca āvedanārthe, uta kṛtsnaprakaraṇe niveśaḥ |
tathā hastāvananenaṃ kiṃ ulaparāji stārituṃ, uta prakaraṇe sarvapadārthān kartu iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? hastāvananenaṃ hastasaṃskārārthaṃ, vāgmaḥ puruṣasaṃskārārthaḥ |
tena kegākeṣāṃ padārthānāṃ imau saṃskārī, ityākāṅkṣā asti |
tasmāt ānantaryāt āvedanārtho vāgmaḥ muṣṭīkaraṇaṃ ca |
nahi 'dīkṣitaṃ āvedayet' ityasmin arthe 'āvedayati' iti (bhavati), na ca 'starituṃ' itya- smin arthe 'stṛṇāti' iti |
na ca eṣāṃ parasparaṃ kaścit saṃbandho'sti |
padārthākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ ānantaryaṃ ekavākyatayāyāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavati |
muṣṭyoḥ karaṇaṃ, vāgmaśca yājamānaṃ, āvedanamābhyaryanaṃ, tatra kathamāṅgāśritaṃ āvāhyate |
athavā yat tatra dīkṣitasya āvedyamānaṃ, tasyāṅgatvena itarī saṃdihyate |
kasmāt punastulye āna- ntarye pūrvasvaivāṅgatvamucyate, na parasya ? ke vidāhaḥ,- aniyamapradarśanārthameva prāgyathāt pūrvopādānam |
sarvāpekṣāṇe ca purastāccaritasya aṅgānuguṇāt pūrva- mālocanaṃ bhavati, tena 'muṣṭikaraṇavāgmabhyāṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ' ityapekṣate 'dīkṣitamāvedayati' ityupatiṣṭhate |
śakyate ca tasyāpi parataḥ prayojanavattvaṃ kalpayituṃ, atastadarthatva- meva yuktam |
ūrdhvastṛṇe dadhi vedimadye staraṇaṃ ulaparājistaraṇaṃ prāyetavyam |
(sudhā - utpūrvasya lunāteḥ kapadanpratyaya dhāvantopagamāntayoḥ lopanipāta- nāt kakāranakārayothya itsaṃjñatvena lopāt ulapaśabdasya ūrdhvalavanāhisugandhyādikadinanuvācitā ūrdhvaśabde- noktā |
tṛtīyāyā ulapaiḥ kṛtā rājiḥ ityarthe tṛtīyā- samāso darśitaḥ |
pṛ. 1067. kut- hale tu ulapāḥ udīritunāni śuṣkatṛṇāni vā |
yājñikāstu ekaṃ darbhamuṣṭi- meva pṛthak gṛhṇanti |
sarvatra ca yogyatvaṃ, avāntara- prakaraṇaṃ, ekavākyatvaṃ ca mahāprakaraṇān balīyāṃsi vini- yojakāni |
' nahi dvayorākhyātyoḥ kena cidupapancena vinā ekavākyatvaṃ saṃbhavati, yatra prakaraṇaṃ bādheta |
yogyatā punaḥ anantarārthatve ca samā, yadā sarvārthatve yuktaratā |
bahuṣu hi padārtheṣu avadhānaṃ upayujyatetarāṃ, evastu yathākathaṃcidapi kriyete |
yadi tāvat pūrvasya kathaṃbhāvaḥ, tata uttaramevāṅgāṃ prāpnoti |
na caivaṃ bhavitumarhati, sādhyāśasya aparipūrṇa- tvāt |
na ca uttareṇa asau (kathaṃbhāvaḥ) avaklapta- prayojanāvasthena śakyaḥ pūrayitum |
yathevaṃ tato yo'ntarāle guṇa- kāmaḥ (godonādiḥ) tena saha sarvamādhastyaṃ (adha- stana ityarthaḥ) aṅge saṃdhatte, naiva pradhānaṃ yāvat prāpnu- yāt, avāntarakathaṃbhāvasya niṣpannatvāditi |
[ pradhānāt prāk paścācca ] anyasaṃbandhamāmuktvā yāvadantaṃ gacchati ityanupaṅgādhikaraṇe (2|1|16) vyākhyātam |
nanu evaṃ sati sarvāntaraprakaraṇoccheda eva prāpnoti |
] sarveṣāṃ hi prajājādīnāmaṅgaṃ kiṃ ciduktvā punaḥ parāmarśo'sti, iti tatparyantāvāntaraprakaraṇakalpanā bhavati |
anyathā hi avyavasthaiva syāt, sarvaśeṣāṇāṃ parasparaśeṣavatprasaṅgāt |
yatra punaḥ saṃkīrtanaṃ nāsti, tatra sarvaṃ pradhānārthameva adhyavasātavyam |
tasya tu kiṃ kevalasya, atha sāṅgasya ityatra vivekaṃ 'prakaraṇa- viśeṣātsaṃyuktaṃ pradhānasya' (3|1|19) ityārabhya vakṣyati |
tadiha yogyatā muṣṭikaraṇadīnāṃ sāṅgapradhānā- rthatvaṃ niścitam |
yadi tu āvedayituṃ starituṃ iti ca śrūyate, tataḥ 'tumanmukhulau kriyārthāyām' (pā0 3|3|10) ityekavākyatayā viniyogo bhavet, na tu evamasti |
ataḥ saṃyogato'viśeṣakaraṇāviśeṣapācca kṛtsne prakaraṇe niveśaḥ iti |
yata ekavākyatā- lakṣaṇameṣu pratyekaṃ dṛśyate, na sarveṣu |
śā - ānantyāt ekavākyatāt avāntaraprakaraṇādvā tanmātrāṅgatve prāpte abhīdhīyate 'liṅgaprakaraṇābhyāṃ hi sarvārthatvaṃ pratīyate |
soma - pūrvatra kramāt ājyabhāgādyatve mantrāṇāmami- hite iha kramaḥ apoyete iti (apavāda-) saṃgatiḥ |

prayojanaṃ svakāle daivāt hastāvanijanādi akṛtvā katipayapadārthānuṣṭhānanantaraṃ tatsmaraṇe yatra smṛtaṃ, taduttara- padārthānāmaveguṇyāya tatra kartavyaṃ siddhānte, pūrvapakṣe tu anantarapadārthasya anuṣṭha
asati sāmānyādhikaraṇye anyathā saṃbhave vā lakṣaṇā'bhāvāt |
asatyakṣe punaḥ na kiṃcit lakṣaṇā- vṛttaṃ, ṣaṣṭhyāḥ saṃbandhamātratvitvena anaṅge'pi upakāraka- mātrāpekṣayā upapannatvāt |
nahi asau aṅgāṅgi- saṃbandhameva eka bravīti |
anaṅgamapi sa yūpaḥ tadaṅga- parārthatvāt upakārako vājapeyasya |
yattu ānarthakyena ṣaṣṭhīśrutiḥ viniyojiketi, tat yūpaśabdenāpi saha avi- śiṣṭam |
ataśca saptadaśāratnidhipate anuṣṭhānatvāt yādṛśaṃ vayaṃ vājapeyasya yūpaṃ paśyāmaḥ, tādṛśasya grahaṇaṃ, iti paśupāśaprayatnam |
asti tu eṣā'pi jijñāsā, yadi vājapeyasya sākṣāt yūpaḥ syāditi |
yadā tu na nopalabhyaḥ, tadā pakṣāntaramavalambitam |
' (yethā iti vyācaṣṭe -) sākṣāt tāvat na saptadaśāratnitvaṃ yujyate ityuktam |
saṃbandhamātramapi anirdiṣṭaṃ vāja- peyasya ityetānmātreṇa na jñāyate |
tasmāt yathoktamevāsya (pāraṃ- paryaṇa) viśeṣaṇatvaṃ adhikāraparaṃparāṃ anuvadati |
vakṣyati hi etat 'ārādapīti cet, tadākye hi tadarthatvāt' (3|1|13-4) ityatra 'yathā prakaraṇa- vaśena tadupakāramātre dharmā vidhīyante, na sākṣāt aṅge- ṣbeva kevaleṣu iti |
' tasmāt na kena cin pramāṇena virodhaḥ iti |
sūtrārthastu - saptadaśāratnitvādi kaṃ pradhāne vājapeye ānarthakyenā- yogyatvāt tadaṅgeṣu niveśate iti |
saumikatvād vājapeye yūpo nāsti paśu vinā |
' ityatra abhyahitatvāt pradhānatvāt prakaraṇagrahācca saptadaśāra- tnitvaṃ vājapeyeodeśena ṣaṣṭhīśrutyā vidhīyate na yūpodeśena, atiprasaṅgāpatteḥ, vājapeyena viśeṣaṇe viśiṣṭadeśācca |
ataḥ saptadaśāratnitvaṃ vājapeyeodeśena vidhīyamānaṃ tadīyo- dharmapātrādreṇa niveśate, yūpapadaṃ sādhyatvāddrauṇam |
iti prāpte, yūpapadasya gauṇatve pramāṇābhāvāt yūpapadena svakāryaṃ lakṣyitvā tadudeśena saptadaśāratnividhīyate |

yadyapi ca dravyaṃ araniparimāṇaṃ cātideśataḥ saṃbhavaprāptikaṃ, tathāpi tadanuvādena saṃkhyāvidhāne ekaprasaratābhaṅgāpatteḥ tataḥ pūrva- pravṛttagṛhīkāreṇa viśiṣṭadravyameva saṃkhyāvidhilakaṃ 'lohitoṣṇīṣāḥ' ityādicat vidhīyate |
yūpakāryasvarūpe ānarthakyāt prakaraṇāt vājapeyāpūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇayā vājapeyāpūrvasaṃbandhiyūpalābhāt 'vājapeyasya' ityanuvādaḥ |
paṣṭhī ca paraṃparāsaṃbandhe'pi padyupapannā nasāri devadattasyāya- mitivat |
(ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyasya svarūpam ) sākṣā- saṃbandhena anvayāsaṃbhave paraṃparāsaṃbandhena anvayo bhavati, vigherānarthakyaprasaṅge iti |
ke. ānarthakyāt tada- ṅgeṣu ityadhikaraṇe saptadaśāratnitvasya vājapeyā- ṅgatvabhūtaguṇāvagārā anvayaḥ ' iti
ku. 2|1|2|27. ' padārthe anarthakasya sataḥ tadaṅge niveśaḥ ' iti ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyasūtrārthaḥ, etadeva ca nyāyasya svarūpam |

( ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyasambhasya kāraṇam ) bhāvanādvārā'pi pravartamānasya vidheḥ aprāptaprāpaṇa- svabhāvatvena anyataḥ prāptāyāṃ tātparyayogāt ānarthakya- tadaṅganyāyena guṇe tātparyavatāro yuktaḥ |
revatīvāravantīyasatra-ghopajīvanāṃśakeḥ : guṇatvena ca ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyaviṣayatvāt aṅgeṣu tatsaṃbandhaṃ nikṣeptu- mārabhamāṇaḥ ... |
pṛ. 861. ( ayaṃ nyāyo yatra yathā na pravartate ) ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyaḥ anyā āna- rthakyaparihāropapattau na pravartate |
ata eva ' na saumye- 'dhvare ' iti saptamīsthale ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyo nāvata- rati iti daśame vakṣyate ( vārtike 10|8|2|5 ) |
soma. 3|7|4. ānarthakyatadaṅgeṣu iti na pradhānadavatārya tadaṅgāśrayate |
yo hi pradhānopakāritvena śrūyate, sa tadaṅge'pi sthitaḥ upakaroti ityevaṃ kalpyate |

3|1|2|22 pṛ. 136. na ca pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyena ( 3|1|2|13-4 ) yajurvedavihitāne'pi jñāyamānamupā- śulatvaṃ tatrāsaṃbhavāt ānarthakya0 nyāyena tadaṅgamatrepu niveśamānaṃ vāravantīyamapi āskandatīti vācyam |
ku. 3|1|28 pṛ. 313. na ca paṣṭhīpratipādyāt saṃbandhadvinā āna- rthakyatadaṅganyāyo'sti ityuktam |
3|6|125. na pratyakṣaṃ na codakena jyotiṣṭome upavītam |
pradhāne hi asaṃbhavana aṅgeṣu arthāt kriyate |
dupu. 10|4|1|1 pṛ. 1906. nāyaṃ ānarthakya- tadaṅganyāyasya viṣayaḥ |
sarvatra hi śrutaśabdanyaśabdanoghe yogyatājñānābhe'pi ayogyatājñānābhāveṇa śābda- bodhasya ānubhavikatvāt ayogyatānirṇayaḥ : pratibandhaka- mātram |
yatra tu kalpitaśabdena śābdabodhaḥ tatra śabdakalpa- nāyāṃ yogyatājñānasyaiva kāraṇatvaṃ, ayogyatānirṇayābhāva- sattve'pi yogyatājñānābhāve śabdakalpanā'nudayaḥ ānu- bhavikāt |
ataśca yāgatagatayogyatājñānābhāvena tadgatā- śrutabodhakaśabdasyaiva prakaraṇe akalpanāt kutastadasaṃbhave aṅgeṣvāvatāraḥ ? |
sarvatra svodeśyasya apūrvavyabhicāre apūrvasādhanatvalakṣa- ṇāthai prakaraṇānupraveśaḥ; yathā 'vrīhīnavahanti' ityādī |
prakṛte tu ( pavamānahaviṣāṃ anyatvajñānalavicārasthale vāraṇī yajñāvacaraḥ ityatra ) yajñapadenaiva avyabhicaritā- pūrvasādhanatvopasthitau ka tadaṅgāvatāraḥ ? iti vārtikakāraḥ |
( asyāpavādaḥ ) abhikramaṇopasaṃsthānayoḥ ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena kartavyanayasiddhisupajīvya tadviśeṣe vicārite saṃprati ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyāpavādaḥ kriyate ( guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt 0 iti ) |
( asyo'jīvanam ) anuvākyānāṃ pradhānānvaye ānarthakyapatteḥ tadaṅgatvabhayoḥ : kramānusāreṇa atratāroktyā vāraṇādhikaraṇa ( 3|1|12 ) poditānarthakya- tadaṅgāvatārījīvene kṛte |
sa ca varṇakramaḥ na vākya- prathamākṣareṣu, kiṃtu sthalākṣareṣu draṣṭavyaḥ :) |
adhigṛ- praiṣe ' na pitā vardhate, na mātā ' ityatra arthe pṛṣṭhādi- buddheḥ pratyakṣatvāt pratiṣedhāsaṃbhavāt ānarthakyatada- ṅganyāyena śabde vijñāyate |

1|2|144. vāja- peyātvenāvagatasya saptadaśāratnitvasya tatrāsaṃbhavāt tadaṅgā- vatāre'pi abhihite tenaiva nayena abhikramaṇopa- vyānayoḥ : karmāṅgabhūtakartavyatāre siddhe kimabhikramaṇasya kṛtsnadarśapūrṇamāsātvāt tadaṅgeṣu sarvaliṅgu avatāraḥ :, prayājahomādauvā tadaṅgatvaṃ adhvaryumātre ( iti vicā- rāta ) upavītasya ca kiṃ sāmidhenyucanamātrānnājñāt tadaṅgatve hetumātre avatāraḥ :, kṛtsnadarśapūrṇamāsātvādvā |
tadaṅgabhūteṣu sarvaliṅgeṣu iti vicārāt paryavasitaḥ āna- rthakyatadaṅganyāyaḥ |
su. pṛ. 109. na ca pradhānabhūtayāgāsya āśrayavāsaṃbhave ānarthakyatadaṅga- nyāyena eva avatāraḥ, āśrayatvasya ānarthakyatadaṅga- nyāyāviṣayatvena revatyādhikaraṇe sthāpayiṣyāmāṇatvāt |
kau. 1|2|22 pṛ. 45, 'iṣe tvā' iti mantraḥ samāmnāyayā puroḍāśāṅgatvena prasaktaḥ 'iṣe tveti śālāṃ chinatti' iti itikaraṇākhyagauṇaśrutyā śālā- chedanāṅgatvena viniyujyate |

na cātra adhikārākhyaprakaraṇe sākṣāt yāgāṅgatvāvagateḥ ayaṃ śrutikamavirodhaḥ, yāgasya spaṣṭaliṅkamantrāntarāvaruddhatvena asya sākṣāt tatrānanvaye ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena aṅgeṣu prasaktau samākhyāyā'nu- rodhena puroḍāśāṅgatvopapatteḥ |
3|1|7|14 pṛ. 356. uccaistvādeḥ śabdadharmasya kriyāyāṃ saṃniveśasaṃbhavāt ānarthakya0 nyāyena tadaṅgatvena niveśaḥ |
kau. 1|3| 11. pare tu avivakṣitakārakaṃ guṇamātraṃ prakaraṇayukte prayogavacanena anugṛhītaṃ ānarthakyatadaṅgageṣu ityevaṃ dravyeṣu avatīrṇaṃ sarvārthaṃ manyante |
tattu prakaraṇe aniti- kartavyatā''sakaguṇagrahaṇābhāvāt ānarthakyatadaṅga- nyāyasya ca kriyāṅgatvāvagamī upapannatvena pūrvapakṣa- mūlyābhāvasattvāt upekṣaṇīyam |
vā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 691. svanirviṣayatvānyāyā''nupapattyā kathaṃcit ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena ( audgātrasamākhyāyāḥ : ) aṅgamātraviṣayatvakalpane'pi |
bhāṭṭa. 3|7|24. 'kartari śap' ( pā0 3|1|68 ) atra kartarīti parasaptamī |
na ca śabdasaṃniveśe kartā paratrāvasthitaḥ saṃbhavati, ataḥ 'ānarthakyāt0' iti śabde kārye vijñāyate |
vā. 3|4|143 pṛ. 922. kartṛśabdasya ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena kartṛvāciśabda- vācitvaṃ aṅgīkṛtya sārvadhātukarūpasāmanādhikaraṇyena vyākhyānāt |
( kartṛ kṛt, sārvadhātuke yu ) su. pṛ. 1417. chativanavanītamājyam |

vā. 3|8|2|38. nanvaḥ nipātatvena kriyā'nvayanaiyyābhāvāt kriyā''nyāya''ṅgīkāre ca pradhāna- bhūtāyāḥ tasyā evānyāthātvāpatteḥ, ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena kriyāviśeṣaṇeṣu anvayāvagamāt bhakṣaṇābhāvasaṃkalpasya vidhānaṃ 'na kalaśaṃ bhakṣayet' ityatra iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

bhāṭṭa. 6|15. 'āghāne'pi tatheti cet' ( 3|8| 20|38 ) iti aniṣṭāpādanena siddhāntakṣepārthe sūtraṃ pavamāneṣṭīnāmanñatvena ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyāviṣayatvād- yugmamāsaka upakāramātreṇa'pi yūpe aratnisādhatadaśyāvatārā- myupagamāt upakāramātrasya tannyāyaviṣayatvātsamā- yāgameṣvante na somayāgam |
na ca anapekṣitāḥ prakara- ṇena grahītuṃ śakyante |
na ca ṣaṣṭhīpratipādyāt saṃbandhatvāt vinā ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyaḥ astītyuktam |
vā. 3|6|125, jyotiṣṭomasya somadravyatvāt na paśudharmaḥ : kiṃcit prayojanaṃ iti ānarthakyatadaṅgayeṣu ityevamaṅgeṣveva avata- rantaḥ aṅgatvāviśeṣāt triṣvapi avataranti |
tasmāt trayāṇāṃ samānaṃ vidhānaṃ iti prāpte abhidhīyate |
3|6|7 18 pṛ. 1043. paśudharmāṇāṃ agniṣomīyāṅgatvāva- gamāt pūrvaṃ aupavasathye ahani'nuṣṭhānaṃ, ityatra na pramāṇa- masti |
satyāpi tatra pāṭhe prakaraṇena ānarthakyatadaṅganyāya- sahakṛtatvena paśudhravye'pi aṅgatvavagamāt teṣāṃ kālabhedena tatratatra anuṣṭhānapratīteḥ |

( iti pūrvapakṣe ) kau. 3|3| 5|12 pṛ 336. paśudharmāṇāṃ mahāprakaraṇatvāt jyotiṣṭomatvadāt paśudharmatvena sākṣātsaṃbaṃdhāyogāt ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena paśuyāgādarā janakatvāttaḥ, teṣāṃ ca madhye kasya cit viśiṣṭa prakaraṇabādhakatva- vakṣyamāṇābhāvena aviśeṣāt sarvārthatvaṃ iti ādyaḥ pūrva- pakṣaḥ |

bhāṭṭa. 3|6|17. yadi ( pātrāṇi pavamāneṣṭeḥ :) aṅgaṃ, tato yajñasaṃyogāt sākṣāt āghāne ( pradhāne ) asaṃbhavanyapi pātrāṇi ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena pava- māneṣṭisu ( āghānāṅgabhūtāsu ) bhavanti ( pūrvapakṣe ) |
śā. 3|1|12. vāraṇavaikakṛtāni ahomā- rthāni ca pātrāṇi yajñagāmittvena viditāni ādhāna-
prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā katamasya yajñasya bhavantu iti 'ānarthakyāt0' iti pavamānahaviḥṣu vijñāyate iti pūrva pakṣaḥ |
vā. 3|1|212 pṛ. 736. pāśamantrasya bahutvavacanāntasya vikṛtau utkarṣaḥ |
na ca sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakapramāṇābhāvaḥ jyotiṣṭoma- mahāprakaraṇasyaiva ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyasahakṛtasya ṛtupaśuṣu sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakatvasya sattvāt |
bhāṭṭa. 9|3|15. paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāśabdayoḥ pradhānamātravacanatvāt 'ānarthakyāt0' ityevaṃ avataratoḥ pradhānahaviḥṣveva kevaleṣu pravṛttiḥ |
vā. 3|7|48, anupayuktaśrauta- vyāpāravattva eva pratyayaḥ : āna0 ityanena nyāyena bhāvanāto''tṛtīye tatsaṃbandhi kāraṇaṃ upasarpati |
2|2|3|6 pṛ. 486. prākāśaśabdavācyayoḥ pradīpayoḥ dānasaṃbandhasya pradhānatvāt ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena viśeṣaṇe avatarāt viśeṣaṇabhūtatvāttvaḥ pradīpasaṃbandhavidhiḥ |

vidheyatvasaṃbandhena adhvaryoreva prādhānyavivakṣāyāṃ dāna- viśiṣṭamadhyeṣu anyasya tasya pradīpasaṃbandhavidhiḥ; dadātya- vivakṣayā vā śuddhādhvaryvanuvādena pradīpasaṃbandhavidhiḥ; iti vacanavyaktīnāṃ madhye kāvyārthe anyasaṃbandhavidhiḥ itya- śakyaṃ vivektum |
su. pṛ. 869. ānarthakyatadaṅganyā- yena dharmayoreva praiṣatvānupapannatvayoḥ itaretarayogapratīteḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 3|7|22. ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena prokṣaṇasya ulūkhalamusalayo- ravatare'pi vākyāt avaghātodeśenaiva vidhānam |
9|1|2. viśeṣyabhūtāyāḥ bhāvanāyāḥ vidravākyā- deva prāptatvāt vihitaitārthaviṣayatvayogyāt āna- rthakyatadaṅganyāyena viśeṣaṇe eva avatarāt |
tatra yāstāvat prātipadikārthe viśeṣaṇaṃ gāvaḥ; tāsāṃ tadataḥ puruṣadatyantabhedāt bhāvapratyayenāgrahaṇam |
na ca puruṣa eva 'tathya bhāvaḥ' ityevaṃ vakṣyadebhedaṃ labhate |
vā. 3|6|122 pṛ. 670. maṇḍūkasūktasya ( ṛsaṃ. 7|103|1-10 ) prakaraṇāt jyotiṣṭomasaṃbandhye ava- gate ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena tadaṅgabhūte cayane niveśaḥ |
kau. 2|1|6|23, iṣyate ca paśvavayavavādānasaṃba- ndhino manotāmantrasya mahāprakaraṇatvāt jyotiṣṭome prāptau ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena tadaṅgabhūte svarūpe asaṃhite'pi savanīye prāptiḥ |
3|1|2|22 pṛ. 206, pradhāna- saṃbandhānupapattau ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena svataḥ asaṃhite- nāpi aṅgena pradhānopasthāpitena dharmasaṃbhrava iṣṭa eva |

3|1|2|22 pṛ. 209. yadā tu āgneyaḥ savanīyaḥ paśuḥ jyotiṣṭome'sti, tadā manotāmantrasya mahāprakaraṇatvāt jyotiṣṭomasaṃbandhve avagate avadīyamānahṛdayādisādhanatvāvagamācca tatrānartha- kyaprasaktau ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyasahakṛtaprakaraṇena savanīya sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakapramāṇena tatraiva niveśaḥ |

bhāṭṭa. 10| 4|22. astu vā ( agniṣṭut- ) yāgasya agniṣṭomastotra- janyatvāt paraṃparāsaṃbandhena janyatvāparaparyāyāśrayatvā- yoge'pi ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena agniṣṭomastotre avatāraḥ ( pūrvapakṣe sthityā ityuktam ) |
kau. 2|2|126 pṛ. 282. rarthaṃtarasāmnaḥ sākṣāt somayāga- saṃbandhabhāvāt ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena 'rarthaṃtarasāmā' iti nirdeśaḥ pṛṣṭhastotradvārā paraṃparāsaṃbandhe eva yogyatvāt paryavasyati |
soma. 2|3|1. 'vājapeyasya' ityādau yatraiva śrutaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, tatraiva ānarthakyatadaṅga- nyāyaḥ |

yadi tu tasyāpi paśoḥ ( savanīyasya ) viśiṣya pramāṇāntaraṃ apūrvasādhanatvopasthāpakaṃ na syāt, tato mahāprakaraṇaparigṛhītānāmeṣāṃ parimāṇādīnāṃ āna- rthakyatadaṅganyāyena bhavet sarvapaśvarthatvam |

bhāṭṭa. 3|6|17. yadyapi pavamāneṣṭināṃ pradeśāntarapaṭhitatvāt na viśiṣṭa adhi- kāro'sti upasthāpakaḥ, tathāpi pradhānādhikāreṇa pradhā- nāṃśe bādhitena tatsaṃbandhapavamāneṣṭyupasthāpanāt āna- rthakyatadaṅganyāyena vāraṇādeḥ tadarthatā'virodhaḥ |
kau. 3|1|2|22 pṛ. 206. yajñasādhanatvena śrutānāṃ vāraṇādīnāṃ sākṣāt ayajñapātrāne niveśasaṃbhavāt ānarthakyatadanyāyena pavamāneṣṭirūpe yajñe eva

niveśa: iti prāpte, bhāṣyakārasiddhāntaḥ ādhāna- prakaraṇe paṭhitena 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti vākyena pavamānahaviṣāṃ agnyāṅgatvāvagateḥ ādhānāṅga- tvābhāvena ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyasaṃbhavāt vāruṇādīnāṃ sarvayajñāṅgatvaṃ iti |
bhāṭṭa. 3|1|12. ānarthakya- tadaṅganyāyena adhiṣṭhomastotrānāṃ vāravantīyasya yukta evāvacāraḥ |

kau. 2|1|2|26 pṛ. 283. guṇa- phalānvayavidhāyino vākyasya āśrayalābhārthaṃ prakaraṇā- pekṣatvena tadādhakatvāt prakaraṇena aṅgatvāne sati ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyaviṣayatvasaṃbhavāt yogyatvāt stotraṃ avatarato vāravantīyasya ... |
ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena kratvaṅgabhūtastotranirvṛttidvārā vāravantīyasāmno yāgāṅgatvasaṃbhavaḥ iti na ca vācyaṃ, vaiṣamyāt |
samadaśāratnaṃ hi vājapeye sākṣātsaṃba- vāt tadaṅgapañcapañcapadadvārā vājapeyāṅgatvamaśnute |
vāra- ntīyaṃ sāma tu aṅgabhūtastotradvārā kathaṃ yāgākārakatā- maśnuvīta ? kriyākārakabhāvasya sākṣātsaṃbandharūpatvāt |
ku. 2|1|2|27. ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena kratusaṃba- ndhidhvena śrutasya vairūpyādeḥ stotrasaṃbandhaḥ |
na ca āna- rthakyatadaṅganyāyena avatīrṇasya sarvavidhatvaṃ, tathātve yājyādāvapi cātuḥsvaryeṇa vairūpyāpatteḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 10|6|6. ānarthakyatadreṣu (3|1|1|8) ityatra nyāyo'na (na to padyau karoti, na some) nāsti, some yena pratiṣedhaḥ syāt |
saṃbandhamātraṃ na aṅgāṅgibhāve astītyeti yūpe niveśaḥ |
iha tu ādhāratvena somaḥ śrūyate, na saṃbandha- mātrayā |
vā. 10|8|2|5. vājapeye satadaśāra- litā ṣoḍaśipātre niveśite yūpe iti cintāyāṃ ānarthakyatadreṣu ityanena yūpe niveśaḥ abhihitaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1072. ānarthakyatadreṣu ityanena nyāyena kratu- saṃbandhena śrutaṃ sāma stotravattvarati |
vā. 2|1|1 pṛ. 572. ānarthakyatadreṣu ityanena nyāyena sāmi- dhenīnāṃ pradhānena anyarahitatve'pi savanīyapaśurūpa- somāṅgatvopapattiḥ |

aindrāsā. 5|1|12. 'spyeno- dghanti' ityatra tṛtīyāyā viniyuktasya sphyādeḥ udghana- nādirūpe ānarthakyatāt udghanatvasamānādhikaraṇa- prakṛtāpūrvasādhanībhūtadravyasākāṅkṣakriyātvameva lakṣyate, na tu udghananādimātrajanyavyāpārasādhanatāśrayatvaṃ, yajñā- yudhavākyena yajñāsādhanatayā syādādi viniyuktānena utpattiśiṣṭapuroḍāśādyavacchedāt sākṣāt pradhānāṅgatvena- viniyogāt, ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena prakṛtāpūrvasādhanī- bhūtadravyasākāṅkṣakriyāmātre viniyojakatvena tātparyagraha- ṇāt |
kau. 3|1|1|11 pṛ. 153, na caivaṃ taduttara- bhāvipradhānāṅgattvābhāvena kathaṃ pradhānaprakaraṇeṇa aṅga- mātrārthatvaṃ iti vācyam |
3|1|1|24 pṛ. 216. aṅgāṅgibhāve ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyā- vatārasaṃbhavāt saumyarathasyāpi dīkṣādināntarīya puruṣa- śeṣatayā vidhiḥ saṃbhavati |
ayameva āna- rthakyapratihatānāṃ viparītaṃ valāvalaṃ iti nyāyaḥ |
liṅgasya niravakāśatvāt ānarthakyapratighāta- nyāyena tasya prāvalyam |
) soma. 2|1|13. na kevalaṃ tātīyapramāṇameva ānarthakyapratihatāne bādhyate, kiṃtu dvaitīyakamapi |
yathā abhyuditeṣṭau guṇena karmabhedasya prasaktasya 'saha śrapayati' iti vidhānārthakyāt bādhaḥ |

sāṃgrahaṇamīti śrūyate 'āmanamasyāmanasya devā iti tisra āhutīrjuhoti' iti |
tatra āmanahomaḥ anuyājānāṃ nivṛttiḥ iti pūrvapakṣe utsūtre prāpte siddhāntamāha |
āmane asi āmanasya iti mantre padacchedaḥ |
samuccayo'dhikaṃ 'adhikaṃ' iti padaṃ tṛtīyādhyāye sūtrāt anuvartate |
āmane āmanahomeṣu utkeṣu anuyājaiḥ samu- ccayaḥ syāt |
liṅgadarśanāt 'bahirātamā vai prayājayājāḥ; ātmā devatā, yat prayājayājānāṃ purastādā upari- ṣṭhād juhuyāt, ātmānaṃ sajātānāmādadhīta |
atha yanmadhyato juhoti, madhyata eva sajātānāmātmānaṃ dhatte' iti anuyājānāmanirvṛtti darśayati liṅgam |
etasmāt liṅgadarśanāt āmanahomānāṃ anuyājaiḥ samuccayaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. 'āmanamasyāmanasya devā iti tisra āhutī- rjuhoti' iti vivakṣitāpekṣayā ādhikyāmupagame ānanyakaṃ ityudāharaṇam |
atra hi 'sāṃgrahaṇya grāma- kāmo yajeta' iti pradhānavākyagatagrāmakāmapadamupapreṇa vivakṣitāpekṣayā āmanahomavidheḥ ādhikyāmupagame grāmakāmapadānubandhanārthakyam |
vāla. pṛ. 3. 'āma- nasamyanasya devā iti tila āhutīrjuhoti' ityatra saṃtvāmannvanti yāgāntaraṇi vidhīyante |
bhā. 10|4|4| 7, āmanahomāḥ sāṃgrahaṇya aṅgaṃ, na tayā sampradhā- natā |
āmanahomāḥ sāṃgrahaṇyamiṣṭau prakara- ṇeṇa gṛhyante iti tantrasāre (4|4|7 sūtre) uktam |
balābalādhikaraṇe tu bhaṭṭasomeśvaraḥ kramādeva āmana- homānāmnatāmāha, tadabhyupetavādamātram |
yadapi miśraiḥ śāstradīpikāyāṃ (4|4|7) saṃnidhigrāhatvamuktaṃ, tadapi abhyupetavādamātram |
vāla. pṛ. 11. āmanahomāḥ sāṃgrahaṇyapṛktā eva, na tu phalārthāḥ |
ataḥ sarvadaiva prayājānuyājamadhye kartavyāḥ, na tu grāmakāmanyāyeva |
bhā. 4|4|4. āmanahomaiḥ pratyakṣaśruteḥ ānu- mānikā anuyājāḥ na nivartyeran iti samuccayaḥ |
bhā. 10|4|4|7. āmanahomeṣu 'tisra āhutīrjuhoti' iti saṃkhyā karmabhedaḥ |
tatra āmanahomāḥ śrūyante, 'āmanamasyā- manasya devā iti tisra āhutīrjuhoti' iti |
atra sandehaḥ kiṃ sampradhānabhūtā āmanahomāḥ ? sāṃgrahaṇyeṣṭāḥ, utāṅgaṃ tasyā iti |
'ugro'- syugrastvaṃ deveṣvyugro'haṃ sajāteṣu bhūyāsaṃ priyaḥ sajātā-
etānukūpya, 'āmanamahāmanasya devā iti tisra āhutīrjuhoti' ityāmananti |
ṭup— vikṛtihiṃ (sāṃgrahaṇī) upakārākāṅkṣiṇī 'kṛtopakārān (prākṛtān) padārthān upamitalakṣita- prāpaṇe [anumitalakṣita iti pāṭhaḥ bhāṣyoktānusāreṇa, upamita iti tu khamatena] gṛhṇāti |
tasmāt nirākāṅkṣī- bhūtā, satyapi svasaṃvidhāne, nāklṛptopakārān āmana- homān gṛhṇāti |
'kiṃ sampradhānabhūtā āmanahomāḥ' iti kiṃ phalavantaḥ ityarthaḥ |
yathā āgneyādīnāṃ ekaprayoga- vacanagrahaṇāt sampradhānatā, naivameṣām |
) 'tulyaṃ hi yajimattvaṃ' (iti bhāṣyasyāyamarthaḥ) yadi saṃskārakarma syāt, tataḥ phalaṃ na kalpyetāpi, yāgāstvete, tasmā- detebhyaḥ phalaṃ kalpyate |
prākṛtairdhaiḥ yatpūrva (aṅgaṃ) tadapūrvamapi saṃbadhyate eva ākāṅkṣāyā- manyāvṛttyā asaṃbaddhaiḥ padairvyavahitamapi |

āmana- homānāṃ ca vidyate prākṛtairaṅgaiḥ saṃbandhaḥ 'yat prayājānāṃ purastāt juhuyāt, bahirātmānaṃ sajātānāṃ dadhyāt, yadanuyājānāmuparihāt, svarge lokamapakāmet' (yanamce juhoti, madhyata eva sajātānāmātman (iti yanmce parāmṛśyamānāḥ (āmanahomāḥ) asaṃbandhipadadvayavāyena (saṃbandhipada iti pāṭhaḥ) gṛhyante (tasmādāmana- homāḥ kṛtaprayuktā iti siddham |
soma-- yathā saumyasya caroḥ phalārthatvāt upa- sadanatvaṃ evamihāpi iti pratyakṣatvāt dṛṣṭānta- saṃgatiḥ |
prakṛtau paridherapradhānārthatve'pi darvihomā- nāmapūrvatvena paridhyanuvādena mantramātravidhānānupapatteḥ |

viśiṣṭavidhau gauravācca, paridhimantrāṇāmapi sāṃgrahaṇya- thaitve sati 'sajāteṣu bhūyāsamiti paridhīn paridadhāti' iti taittirīyaśākhāyāṃ paridhimantrāvācakeḥ asaṃbandhi- padaiḥ, śāntare paridhimantrairvā vyavadhānāt 'vyavadhāyā- chānuṣajyate' iti nyāyena tadasaṃbhavaḥ |
na ca cānuṣaṅgā- saṃbhave'pi āryādikāphalavattvena prādhānyaṃ yuktam |
sūtrā- rthestu- phalavatsāṃgrahaṇyādikaṃ itarasya aphalasya āmana- homādeḥ pradhānaṃ syāt |
kutasteṣāmaphalatvaṃ ? 'vyavadhāyā- chānuṣajyate' ityanuṣaṅgābhāvasya uktahetutvāt anuṣaṅgā- saṃbhavena phalavattvāsaṃbhavāt iti |
' bhāṭṭa-- 'vaiśvadevī sāṃgrahaṇīṃ nirvaped grāmakāmaḥ' iti prakṛtya 'āmanamahāmanasya devā iti tisra āhutīrjuhoti' iti śrutam |
tatra āmanahomānāṃ sāṃgrahaṇītvadhravat, tasyāḥ vikṛtitvena prakaraṇābhāve'pi saṃvidhānādeva tadaṅgatvopapatteḥ |

'yatprayājānāṃ purastā- jjuhuyād bahirātmānaṃ sajātānāṃ dadhyāt, yadanuyājānā- suparihājjuhuyāt svarge lokamapakāmet, madhye juhoti' iti prākṛtāṅgamadhyavṛttitvaśravaṇena prakaraṇādvā tadupa- patteśca |
evaṃ prayojanatvopapattau ca na grāmakāmapadānuṣaṅgeṇa svatantraphalārthatvakalpanā pramāṇā- bhāvāt, iṣṭadhraparidhiparidhānāṅgabhūtatvenābhyupagamyanaiva- yāca |
ataḥ sāṃgrahaṇīyuktā evete, na tu saumya- vat phalārthāḥ |
āmanaṇavibhaktyā vidhiśaktipratibandhaḥ 'ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya' ityādī |
) iti nyāyena amītra ( - amīn vihara ) iti āmantraṇasāmarthye praiṣasāmarthye ca liṅgasattvārthena vyākhyāsyam |
yacchabdā'mantraṇottampuruṣāyupahatavidhi- śaktayo mantrāḥ dharmasādhanatvenocyamānāḥ 'devāśca yābhi- ryaṃjate dadāti ca' ityevamādibhirātyapadaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ śruterapi na karmāntaraṃ kalpayanti |
āmahīyavaṃ nāma sāma jyotiṣṭome mādhyaṃdina- pavamāne 'uccā te jātamanasaḥ' iti gāyatre tṛce gīyate |
āmiā eva sā bhavati, yatra tate payasi dadhi ānīyate |
āmiā tate payasi dadhyānayanasya prayo- jikā, na vājinam ||
bhāṣya-- cāturmāsyeṣu vaiśvadeve śrūyate, 'tate payasi dadhyānayati, sā vaiśvadeviāmā, vājibhyo vājinam' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ : kiṃ tate payasi dadhyānayanaṃ āmiā prayojayati na vājinaṃ, utaubhayamiti |
kutaḥ ? yasmin kṛte yanniṣpadyate prayojana- vat, tat tasya prayojakamiti gamyate |
tatra anyatarāyai kriyeta, yadi vinigamanāyāṃ heturbhavet |

ṭup-- (sūtragataḥ ) sarvaśabdo vakṣyamāṇapūrvapakṣā- locanayā draṣṭavyaḥ (sarvameva āmiāvājinakrayapāṃsādi- saṃyavananinayanaparyantaṃ ekarūpāyāḥ niṣpadyate aneneti niṣpatteḥ dadhyānayanekāhyanayanayādeḥ praṇītā'rpaṇītāyāḥ prayojakatvena samaṃ syāt iti vakṣyamāṇasarvapūrvapakṣaṇā tantreṇa idaṃ sūtraṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ |
kutaḥ ? nāya yat dadhipayobhyāṃ nirvartyate, tat haviḥ |
yadi tat haviḥ syāt, ubhayaṃ tābhyāmeva niṣpadyate, iti na gamyeta viśeṣaḥ |
kuta etat ? 'sā vaiśvadeviā' ityu- cyate, na tato yat niṣpadyate iti |
nanu cchīliṅganirdeśā- t āmiā haviḥ; sā ca tato niṣpadyate |
vājinaṃ ca haviḥ; tadapi niṣpadyate iti |
tadeva hi payastataṃ dadhisaṃsṛṣṭaṃ āmiā bhavati |
āha, yadi payo dadhisaṃsṛṣṭaṃ haviḥ; kiṃ tarhi ucyate āmiā prayojiketi |
tatra hi dadhipayasoḥ saṃsṛṣṭayoḥ rasa upalabhyate |
tapte payasi dadhani ānīyamāne ubhayaṃ bhavati |
dadhnaḥ ca payaḥ saṃsṛjyate, vājinācca vivi- cyate |
śabdaḥ saṃsargo dadhnā, aśabdo vāji- nena vivekaḥ payasaḥ iti |
sarasanāma ca pūrvoktena śabdena ekākyatāṃ yāti |
itarasmin pakṣe payasi dadhyānayanaṃ vājinavivekalakṣaṇā'rthe syāt |
āmiāeva sā bhavati, yatra tate payasi dadhi ānīyate |
ṭup-- yat (sā iti ) sarvanāmnā pratinirdiśyate, tat devatātvena (naiśvadeviā iti vacanāt ) tena ca (sarvanāmnā ) anantaranirdiṣṭaṃ pradhānabhūtaṃ prati- nirdiśyate |
(trayaṃ pūrvavākye nirdiṣṭaṃ tat payo, dadhi, ānīyataśca |
tatra ) ānayatiḥ saṃskārakatvāt anyatra ( dadhina payasi vā ) śeṣabhūtatvāt anantara'pi na pratinirdiśyate |

syuktaṃ tatrāha-- ) ubhau strī vājine na sta |

) nirvatyate, tadaviḥ ' iti bhāṣyaṃ arthadvāreṇa paṭhitam ) |

( ' āha, tate payasi ' ityādi- prati nīyate ! tataśca ( dvitīyānirdiṣṭena karmaṇā ) coyabhāṣyasya uttarabhāṣyaṃ ' śabdaḥ saṃsargaḥ ' iti |

tasmāt anena dvāreṇa yena vyāpyamānatvāt pradhānabhūtā ( pradhānabhūtā karma- ( saṃskārasiddhayarthatayā ) saṃskārādhikyīpaṃtaḥ ilyataḥ bhūtaḥ iti pāṭhadravyam ) tatra ( ānayatinā dvikarma- ( abhiprāyat bhāṣyakāraḥ ) āha ' śābdaḥ saṃsargaḥ ' keṇa ) dvitīyasya apekṣitatvāt yo vyāpyamāno- iti |

' mantraḥ ' ' juṣantāṃ yujyaṃ payaḥ ' vājinasya śeṣabhūtaṃ kriyate |
tasmāt paya evāmikṣā vaiśvadevagahaviḥ iti lakṣaṇā |
( yadyapi na kasya cit padasya śrutārtha hitvā |
soma-- pūrvasroktasahitārthavicāraṇāt ( ekaviṣa- aśrutavājinaśeṣatve taddvāreṇa śabdasyāpi aśrute tātparya- yatvaṃ-- ) saṃgatiḥ |
śrutaparityāgena nāśrutatātparyaṃ yuktaṃ 'pi hematvavat, ghaṭādermṛdvikāratve'pi mṛttvavat payo- iti bhāṣyātparyam ) |
vikāratve satyeva āmikṣāyāḥ payastvaṃ, na tu āmikṣā- mukhyaśabdābhisaṃstavācca |
vājinayāgāt pūrvaṃ vāji- bhāṣyaṃ-- na cobhayaṃ prayojakaṃ nyāyyam |
nātra vacana- nāpacāre punardadhyānayanena vājinaṃ na saṃpādanīyaṃ iti masti idaṃ prayojakamiti neti |
tatra punaḥ ' dravyaprayuktatvāt vāji- rthakaṃ bhavatīti prayojakaṃ kalpyate |
tatra ekasmin nyāyāt lopaḥ ' iti nyāyaḥ |
' yasya sarvāṇi ' prayojake siddhe arthavyupadeśo, nātyadāpi prayojakaṃ bhavi- iti vacanāt snigdhakṛt ājyena tadanuṣṭhānamiti |
kathaṃ gamyate ? thestu-- ekassāt dadhyānayanāt ubhayorniṣpatteḥ sarve mukhyaśabdābhisaṃstavāt |
mukhyaśabdaḥ saṃstauti nyāyya āmikṣā vājinaṃ ca dadhyānayanaprayuktau samaṃ syāt iti |
tasmin sati prayojake parihṛtatvādānarthakyasya, na dvitī- na ca siddhānte vājinasyānuniṣpāditvāt yugapanniści- yamapi prayojakam |
prathamā ca āmikṣā, dvitīyā vāji- rsiddhā |
apica mukhyaśabdena pariniṣpatyarthatvenaiva svārthatvena vinā niṣpadyamānatvam |
ca āmikṣā stūyate ' mithunaṃ vai dadhi ca ghṛtaṃ ca |
atha tacca yugapanniścitāvāpi saṃbhavati iti yugapanniściteḥ yatsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ maṇḍamiva mastiva paridṛśyate, garma eva saḥ |
mithunasya ca garbhaiḥ : prayo- vi-- ' āmikṣā vājinaṃ ca syādityaneti : prayo- jakaḥ, na garbhedakam |
yayubhayaṃ prayojakaṃ, āmikṣā paya evātra tacchabdānmantrato rasāt |
prayo- vājine nahe punastate payasi dadhi ānetavyam |
dup-- tāpaviśiṣṭe dadhyānayanaṃ prayojakena yāvacca bhāṭṭa-- cāturmāsyeṣu prathame parvaṇi ' tate payasi saṃgrathyate, tāvat sākāṅkṣamanarthakam |
tasmāt ānarthakya- dadhyānayati sā vaiśvadeyāmikṣā, vājimyo vājinam ' parihārārthamāmikṣā prayojakī |
tatra dadhyānayanasya āmikṣā vājinaṃ cetyu- rthaikye parihṛte, nāsti vājinena saṃbandhaḥ |
bhayaṃ prayojakaṃ, uta āmikṣā eva iti cintāyāṃ, dadhyā- śā-- ' madhurāntarasā''mikṣā ghanarūpā ca, nayanavākye tāvat tatpayo'dhikaraṇaka dadhyānayanamātraṃ śrutaṃ, tena sā |
' na tu payaso dadhno vā prādhānyaṃ, saptamyā prādhānyā- ata ubhayaprayuktamānayanamiti |
na cānayaterdvikarmakatvāt payaso vyāpyamāna- ( tacchabdena ) parāmṛṣṭaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ vidhīyate |
payastvaṃ na sthale adhikaraṇatvādhikāratvāttarāviśayā saṃbandhamātra- dravāpekṣaṃ rasamātranimittakam |
paya eva ghanībhūta- vivakṣāyāṃ ca saṃbandhamātramye paṣṭhīprāptau ' akathitaṃ ca '
iti karmasaṃśakkaraṇāt dvitīyāvidhānāvatavi prādhānye pramāṇābhāvāt, prakṛte saptamīśravaṇe adhikaraṇatvavivakṣā- 'vagaterdvitīyakarmaprasaktatvācca |
nahi āmikṣā nāma dadhipayolā, rasaghanībhāvādisaṃbhadena arthāntaratvāt |
'tasyai dṛtaṃ, tasyai dadhi, tasyā āmikṣā, tasyai vāji- nam' iti medena vyapadeśācca |
'juṣantāṃ juṣyaṃ yat' : iti tu dhānyaśabdavat vikāraparam |
ataśca dadhyānayasya svākye uddeśyā- bhāvāt sāmarthyena dadhisaṃsṛṣṭapayojyāmikṣā'rthatvāṅgīkāre ca janyatvāviśeṣeṇa vājināthaitvasyāpyavagateḥ ubhayo prayojana- jakam |
iti prāpte 'sā vaiśvadevī' iti sarvanāmapraḥ prakṛta- parāmarśitvāt pūrvavākye yat prādhānyena nirdiṣṭaṃ, tadāmi- kṣetyavadhāryate, na tvarthāntaram |
rasaśca madhurāmlarūpaḥ tayore- vāvadhāryate, iti na tato'rthāntaram |
ghanībhāvastu pīyū- ṣādivat abhede'pi upapanna eva |
tasmādāmikṣā arthā- ntaraṃ, api tu dadhi payo vā, tatrāpi viśeṣastu aṣṭame (2|4) atideśaviśeṣasiddhayarthe nirūpayiṣyate |
tat siddhaṃ svavākye eva āmikṣārūpoddeśyatvānvitāvagaterdhyāna- yanaṃ tavyuktameva, na tu vājinaprayuktaṃ, tasya tacchabdāva- bhāvena arthāntaratvapratīteḥ |
ataśca tasya anuṣaṅgavatvāt tadāgasya siddha- tvādādivat anuṣaṅgaprasattitvāvagateḥ tadabhāve'pi ca parayuktadadhyāyanayopajīvitvāvagatainaṃ tadyojakatvaṃ vājinasya kalpanīyaṃ gauravaprasaṅgāt |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe vājinasyāsya arthakarmatvena sama- prādhānyāpatteḥ āmikṣāyāgavikāre anatideśaḥ |
siddhānte tu anuṣaṅgaprasattitvena āmikṣāyāgajña- tvāt tadadhikāre'tideśaḥ |
someśvarastu siddhānte'pi vājināye arthakarmatvaṃ vadataḥ āmikṣāyāgajñatvātpatteḥ tadadhikāre'tideśo na sidhyet |

yattu bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ pūrvapakṣe vājinanāśe āmikṣānāśe iva punardadhyānayanena vājinotpattiḥ, siddhānte tu ājyena samāpanamiti prayojanamuktaṃ, tat paṣṭhe (4|6) havirnāśādinimitte ājyena samāpanasya vidhivalena vakṣyamāṇatvena pūrvapakṣe'pi tulyatvādupekṣitam |
'12. āmikṣā dadhipayomyāṃ nārthāntaraṃ, apitu dadhi payo vā |
tatrāpi viśeṣastu (paya eveti) aṣṭame (8|2|4) atideśaviśeṣasiddhayarthe nirūpayiṣyate |
yanniścuttviyāntā nirūpitodeyatāśāli yat, tat tasya prayojakam |
4|1|12. āmikṣā paya eva amlasaṃyo- gena ghanībhūtam |
dadhi ca tatra payo ghanībhāvituṃ upādīyate |
dadhyabhāve anya- nāpi amlena kāñjikādinā kriyate |

11|2|16|163, āmikṣā maitrāvaruṇī 26--27. āmikṣā 'maitrāvaruṇīmāmikṣāṃ vaśā dakṣiṇā' iyaṃ rājasūye caturthī aveṣṭiḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 11| 4|3. āmikṣā vājinotpatteḥ prayojikā notpatti- pālanayoḥ |

5|1|8|129. āmikṣā sutase payasi dadhani nikṣipte alpena kālena dredhā tadbhavati |

hi dravyamātrasya taddhitadaivatocyate asyaśabdābhidheyasya vigrahavākyasya aseyitatvena saṃnihitasya dravya- viśeṣasyaiva devatāsaṃbandhaḥ taddhitena kriyate, na caitāvatā padāntarānarthakyaṃ 'āmikṣāṃ' ityanenaiva nyāyena saṃni- hitaviśeṣaṇāpekṣitaviśeṣyasamarpaṇārthatvāt padāntarasya |
tatte payasi daghani prakṣipte payo ghanībhavati yogyena kālena |
dadhnaḥ anyenāpi ca aglena dravyeṇa ātañcane datte payo ghanībhavati |
tasmāt dadhnau ghanībhāvatvāt payaḥ pradhānatvācca āmikāyāḥ payaḥ eva prakṛtiḥ, na dadhi nobhayam |
āmikāyāḥ payovikāratve svīkṛte tu dadhnau bahakālatva sadyaskālatvānugraho na syāt |
tathā coktaṃ 'aṅgadvāra: pradhāneṣu siddhārthānugama: ka cit |
pradhānadvārakājñeṣu ka citsthita , khata: ka cit |
tathāpi sarvaśabdānāṃ kāryonvitābhidhānasāmarthya hitvā ākāṅkṣitayogyatāsaṃsihitānvitābhidhānasāmarthyanaiva sāmānyavyutpattī liṅgādiyuktavākyeṣu kāryasyaiva tathā bhūtatvāt |

tadanvitāvagataṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ viśeṣaśakti- kalpanā, nyutpattikālāvagatamātreṇa viśeṣaśakti- kalpane śābdasaṃnihitenaiva vyutpattau anvayadarśanāt 'dvāraṃ dvāraṃ' ityādi aśrutārthyāhāraśabdakalpanā- prasaṅga: |
tena yathā holākā'dhikaraṇe sāmānyaśāstra- kalpanenaiva viśeṣācāropapattau na viśeṣaśāstrakalpanā, evamihāpi ākāṅkṣā''didanmātraśaktikalpaneveti |
svasaṃtāne ca kāryasyaiva anekaviśeṣaṇaviśi- ṣṭasya pravṛttihetutvamavagatam vyavahāravākye'pi tadarthava- nirṇaya: |
na ca svasaṃtāne ākāṅkṣā''didanmātre śabda- saṃnihite vā vyutpatti: |
holākā'dhikaraṇe tu vyabhi- cāreṇa tattadeśādiviśeṣapratipādakopapattat śābdakalpanā- pramāṇābhāvāt bhavatu sāmānyaśāstrakalpanā |
nahi tatra anuṣṭhātrumātrāt anuṣṭhātṛtvāt na kiṃcit vyavasthā- kāraṇamasti |
tathā vārttikakāra- pādairapyuktaṃ 'na tvatropapadaṃ kiṃcit yathācārānusāri yat |
atho- cyeta -- yathā 'gāmānaya' ityādiṣu kāryārthānvayo'va- gata:, tathā 'gaurgacchati' ityādiṣu siddhārthānvayo'pi avagata eva |
tenobhayāpi prayogadarśanāt ubhayānugatā- kāṅkṣā''didanmātre eva śaktiravardhāyate, na kāryamātre |
yathā devadattasya putra iti napatte ca sākṣātsaṃbandhe para- parāsaṃbandhe'pi ca prayogadarśanāt ṣaṣṭhīvibhakte: ubha- yānugatasākṣātparaṃparaudāsīnasaṃbaṃdhamātre śakti: |
yathā ca tathaiva dvitīyāvibhakte: īpsite'nīpsite ca prayoga- darśanāt ubhayānugatakriyājanyaphalabhāgitvamātre eva śakti:, na tu bhaṭṭasyaiva īpsitamātre iti |

svavyutpatyanusāreṇa tāvat, sarvaśabdānāṃ kāryānvayaparatva- meva avagataṃ, paścāt siddhārthaparatvamavagamyamānaṃ, na vyutpattikālāvagataṃ ananyathāsiddhaṃ kāryānvayaparatvaṃ bādhitu- mutsahate, siddhāntāvagamasya lakṣyārthevopapatte: |
nanu vyutpattikālāvagatamapi kriyākāryatvāccitaṃ yathā paścā- drāvasitāyākāryāvagamane bādhyate eva, tathā atrāpi bhavi- ṣyatīti |
paścādrāvino'pi sthāyikāryāvagamasya ananyathāsiddhatvāt, pūrvāvagatārtha hi lakṣaṇā''dikaṃ bhavati |
tena ananyathā- siddhena paścādavagatena apūrva asiddhasya pūrvāvagatasyāpi bādhitatvāccitrā kriyākāryasya lakṣaṇikāt, apūrvakārya- syaiva mukhyatvam |
nahi tatra niyamena prathamaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā: sākṣātsaṃbandhaṃ paraṃparāvasaṃbandhaṃ vā, dvitīyāyā īpsitamanīpsitatvaṃ vā kaścidavagacchati, yena mukhyatvārthameva bhavet |
aniyamena tu pratītī sādhāraṇārthatva- meva yuktam |
bhedenedaṃ vyutpattau sarvaśabdānāṃ kāryānvayaparatvameva adhigataṃ bhavet |

yathā hi 'gāmānaya' iti śabdaśravaṇānantaraṃ viśiṣṭārtha- viṣayavyavahāradarśanāt śabdajanitaviśiṣṭaviṣayakāryāva- gamānamānaṃ, tathā putrajanmapratipādakavākyaśravaṇānantaraṃ pitṛgatamupasādāromarṣaṇādidarśanaṃ pramāṇāntarāvagatatapu- mapatyajanmano vyutpattamānasya śabdajanitaharṣahetusiddharūpa- putrajanmavagamānamānamapi saṃbhavatīti kāryanvaya: ? evaṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ vyutpattiriti |
kiṃ sarvathā śabdavyavahārānyupapannasya iyaṃ siddhārthavyutpatti: , arthavyutpannasya vā ? tatra atyutpannasya harṣahetumānānmantyā viśeṣānavagateriva |
yathā hi tatra harṣahetutayā putrajanma samācitaṃ, tathā subhagāgarbhavimoka-
sukhaprasavasubhalajanmādīnāṃ anekeṣāṃ upaplavān śabdasya putrajanmapratipādanāvadhāraṇe pramāṇamasti |
nāpi artha- vyutpannasya, pūrvasiddhavyutpatyanusāreṇa anyutpannaśabdasyāpi kāryaparatvasyaivāvagamāt |
tena vyutpatyanusāreṇa sarvaśabdānāmeva siddhe kāryānvayaparatve, arthavādānāpi kāryākāṅkṣāyāṃ svatantrakāryābhāvāt samabhivyāhāravidhyu- ddeśaikavākyatayā kāryaparatvaṃ vācyam |
tena prathamapāda- siddhamapi codanāyā: prāmāṇyaṃ arthavādaikavākyatāvaśena apratipādakatayā punarādhipya samādhīyate iti bhavati saṃgatiriti |
na ceha nityanirdoṣavākye tathā saṃbha- vati |
ato yena prakāreṇa asya kāryaparatā saṃbhavati, tadanusartavyam |
tasya ca yadyapi karaṇetikartavyatāvidha- niyojyasyarthapratipādanenānyau'sti, tathāpi prāśastya- pratipādanena bhaviṣyati |
nanu ekakartṛ- kānekapadārthānuṣṭhānasya kramaviśeṣamantareṇa asaṃbhavat, kramasya prayogopalakṣaṇatvena anvayasya ākāṅkṣitatvāt yuktastathā anvaya: |
prāśastyaṃ tu phalasādhanatā''dirūpaṃ vidhita eva siddhaṃ, na kramavadākāṅkṣitamiti kathaṃ tadanvaya: ? maivam |
na ca vācyaṃ raktasya anvaya: ; prāśastyasya tu vidhivodhyatvena anadhikatvāt nākāṅkṣeti |
yato nādhikāryatve'pi 'ekaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhoja- yet' ityādiṣu brāhmaṇapadasyadvitīyāvibhaktibhyaika- svābhidhāyināmapi ekādipadānāṃ anuvādarūpeṇāpi eka- vākyatābalena anvayopalabdhi: |
tena etadadhikaraṇanyāya- metadeva yat svarasato vidhyanākāṅkṣite'pi sarbathā pravṛttyupayogini anyalambhe'pi ekavākyatābalena ākāṅkṣosthāpanenāpi śabdasyānyayabodhanatātparye iti |
tacca prāśastyaṃ lakṣaṇārthaṃ arthavādapadāni pratyekaṃ vā lakṣayanti |
sarvaśabdānāṃ kāryānvitasvārthābhidhāyakatve teṣāṃ svato'na- midhāyakatayā nyāyasaṃpādanāya ca prathamamavagataprāśastya- lakṣaṇārthaṃbhavaditi |
tena sārthavādakasyaiva vidhyuddeśasya kāryaparatayā siddhaṃ prāmāṇyamiti |
tathāhi kāryaparatvameva sarvaśabdānāmiti yadupavarṇitaṃ, tattāvada- saṃbaddham |
yato, yathā svasaṃtāne srānapānādau viśiṣṭa- kāryavagamasya pravṛttihetutvamavagataṃ, tathā siddhanvarūpa- syāpi jananīgātrasaṃparkāderheturhetutvaṃ avagatameva |

tena yathā 'gāmānaya' ityādiśabdaśravaṇānantaraṃ prayoyyavṛddhasya viśiṣṭa- vyavahāradarśanena viśiṣṭakāryāvagamaṃ ujjīya viśiṣṭakāryā- vagamaparatvaṃ vidhiśabdasamabhivyāhāratadarthāvagamāt adhyavasīyate, tathā atidūrasthaputragamane sati 'ayaṃ te putra: samāyātaḥ' iti śabdaśravaṇānantaraṃ mukhaprasādādidarśanena pitṛgataṃ siddhaṃ harṣahetuṃ ujjīya siddhārthānvayavagamaparatvamapi evaṃvidha- śabdānāṃ tadbhāvabhāvitayā pratīyate eva |
atha 'mālave te rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati' iti jyotirvidārākhyāte bhaviṣya- drāvagamamasāpi harṣahetudarśanārthaṃ siddhārthānvayavagamasya sarvena harṣahetutvam |

evaṃ tarhi bhavatā'pi evaṃvidhavākya- śravaṇānantaraṃ mālavādigamanapravṛttisaṃdarśanena vyabhi- cārāt, kathaṃ sarvatra kāryānvayaparatvam ? athāsya kāryā- nmidhāyakatve'pi kāryapadādhyāhāreṇa vā, svabuddhiprabha- kāryāvasāyena vā pravartanaṃ, evamatrāpi svagatamālava- rājyayogyatāpratipādakaśabdādhyāhāreṇa vā, svabuddhi- prabhavarājyayogyatā''dyavasāyena vā siddhānvāyavagamasyaiva harṣahetutvopapatti: |
tena harṣahetūnāṃ ānantye'pi siddhārtha- nyāyavagamatāntra vyabhicarati |
viśeṣāvadhāraṇamapi yathā tvatpakṣe viśiṣṭārthaviṣayaśabdadarśanāt saṃpadyate, tathā mamāpi viśiṣṭabhūtānvayadarśanānantaraṃ śabdaprayogāt setsyati |

atha pratītau harṣahetubhūtaṃ putragamanaṃ putra- gataharṣahetubhūtautsukyādyabhidhānaśabdaścā tadvākyānna niś- yate, tadā tatrāpi 'gāmānaya' ityādau godarśanānantaraṃ gogataguṇotkarṣādikāryapratipādanasaṃbhāvanayā ānuṣaṅgikaṃ
tvanmate'pi etadeva sādhu, na punaḥ sarvaśabdānāṃ kāryā- |
apūrvasādhanājñānapi, na ca dṛṣṭopanipātīti na tatra |
kiṃca yadi ayaṃ kratau niyamaḥ, tadā adhyayanamātra- |
na ca arthavādānāṃ kenāpi prakāreṇa kāryānvayayogyatā |
atha 'anadhīyānā hi trātyā bhavanti' iti vacanāt |
paścāt ākṣepo'yaṃ mandākanyavahāriṇa eva śobhate iti |
ca sati traivarṇikasya upāyāntaraniṣṭatveḥ arthāttatra ayamartha- |
jñāne niyamaḥ, na tu tanniyamārtho'yaṃ vidhiriti |
vyāpāro'sti, na vā ? yadyasti, tadā dṛṣṭe vidhivaipha- |
tacca tadaiva saṃbhavati yadi kṛtsna eva vedo dharme pramāṇa- |
etadeva ca asyādhikaraṇasya pāramārthikaṃ pūrvapakṣa- dṛṣṭāsaṃbhave ca adṛṣṭakalpanā'vasarāta, 'yacchakyate' rahasyam |

tasmāt āmnāyasya vedasya vidheyatvarūpakriyā'rtha- ityupabandhāt, lokāvagataśaktyanusāreṇa adhyayanasya akṣara- tvāt pṛthagvasthitanāmārthavādānāṃ ānarthakyaṃ vidheyakriyā- grahaṇakrameṇa puruṣāmilaṣitārthajñānahetutvāt tadeva 'rthatvam |
evaṃ bhāvyatayā anumanyate, na tu svargādikamadṛṣṭam |

na ca prāpte abhidhīyate— dṛṣṭe vidhyanarthakyāt nārthajñānaṃ vidhyavaruddhabhāvanābhāvyaṃ, vidhinā tvekavākyatvāt stutyarthena vidhīnāṃ vedasya adhyayanavidhivinantareṇa arthatātparyāvadhāraṇasaṃ- syuḥ |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ-- bhavedetadevaṃ, yadi stutidvāreṇa uccāraṇasya arthaparatve śabdanāmārthaparatvaṃ saṃbhavati, na vidheyakriyā'rthatvaṃ arthavādānāṃ na syāt |
sā ca arthabhāvanaiva sādhyasādhanetikarta- tsargikaṃ arthaparatvaṃ ca citta puruṣadoṣapādopyate |
tatra puruṣapravṛttirūpaṃ bhāvyaṃ, saṃbandha- apoṣayepe doṣābhāvāt utsargasiddhaṃ anapodhitamasyeva, bodhaṃ ca karaṇāmādāya itikartavyatā sāṅkhyāyāṃ lokā- kiṃ vidhinā ? maivam |
dvividho hi śabdānāṃmarthaḥ kevalo nusāreṇa pravṛttyutsāhajanakaṃ viṣayaprāśastyajñānameva svī- viśiṣṭaśca |
dṛṣṭaṃ ca loke krayavikrayādivyavahāre pravṛttyutsāha- paratvaṃ viśiṣṭārthapratyayasamuddeśataḥ samuccāraṇāt niyata- janakaṃ viṣayaprāśastyajñānameva |
yathā 'iyaṃ gauḥ kreyā samabhivyāhārakalpanāt nānyataḥ sidhyati |

tathāhi, anaprajā bahukṣīrā rūpyapatyā' yathā vā 'ayaṃ ketavyaḥ 'gauraśvaḥ puruṣo hastī' iti parasparasaṃbaddhādyeṣpi puruṣo na puruṣamātraṃ, kintu ayaṃ matto hastī' yathā vā padārtheṣu yadā viśiṣṭārthapratītitātparyakamuccāryate, pratigrahādimatruccau 'nāyaṃ brāhmaṇamātraṃ, kiṃtu vasiṣṭho' vā tadā jaghanyadyutyarthāpayeṇāpi 'ayaṃ gauḥ vegavān' ityādiṣu |
tathayā loke sadasadardhapratipādakasya padanica- 'puruṣo'pyanyaceṣṭaiḥ hastī mahābalaḥ' iti viśiṣṭārtha- yasya lakṣaṇayā'pi vṛttyā prāśastyapratipādane vidheyaka- bodho bhavati |

tathā anekārtheṣu akṣādiśabdeṣu vākyatvaṃ, tathā atrāpi arthavādānāṃ prāśastyalakṣaṇayā arthaviśeṣāvadhāraṇaṃ na śabdasvabhāvakṛtaṃ, aneka rūpavākyā- śabdabhāvanaitikartavyatā''śapuraṇe vidheyadeśavākyatvena rthāvagamaprasaṅgāt, kintu uccāraṇatātparyakṛtameva |

na ca arthabhāvanā rūpakriyāyāṃ 'gaurityamāha' ityucarite na gośabdena arthapratyayaḥ, sādhyasādhanetikartavyatāmeva paramananvayaḥ, anenaṃbhūtasya kintu uccāraṇasya śabdaparatvāt śabdapratyayaḥ eva paraṃ vidheḥ ananyaprasaṅgāt |
tena viśiṣṭārthajñānaṃ na śabdasvabhāvakṛtaṃ, nāpi yāt praveśādeva prāśastyānanvayaḥ, na tu svātantryeṇeti uccāraṇasvabhāvakṛtaṃ, kintu viśiṣṭārthapratyayatātparyāt nānupapannam |
tacca uccāraṇatātparyaṃ yato loke puruṣā- anyathā'pi śabdasya lakṣaṇayā anyaparatvam |
apo- miprāyavaśāduccīyate, tathā vede viśiṣṭārthajñānārthoccāraṇa- rūpaye tu vede kathamarthavādaśabdasya lakṣaṇayā'pi prāśastya- vidhiśvādeva paraṃ pratīyate iti dṛṣṭārthatve'pi bhavati paratvam |
sa hi 'svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' : avagate dṛṣṭatvād adhyayanavidheḥ arthaparatvaṃ, adhyayana- iti śrūyamāṇaḥ adhyayanabhāvanābhyāmmākāṅkṣamāṇaḥ vidhau ca arthapare uccāraṇārthatvagatiḥ |
lokāvagataśaktyanusāreṇa hi dṛṣṭārthatvamaṅgī- bhūtaṃ bhāṣyāśe nirasya karaṇāṃśe niveśayati |
lokadṛṣṭyā ca uccāraṇasya akṣarādigrahaṇa- adhyayanena puruṣaḥ samīhitaṃ bhāvayediti sthite, krameṇa samabhivyāhṛtapadārthajñānamupacyate eva, kintu
ādhānasaṃskṛtasya tu agneḥ tātparyāvadhāraṇe sati vyatiṣajyate |
tena amato lokā- 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti vidhyantarasya viniyoja- nusāreṇa tattvavadhāraṇamātraṃ, adhyayanavidhisiddhatātparyā- kasya vidyamānatvāt ayaṃ doṣaḥ |
vṛtte adhyayane mīmāṃsādiparicayottarakālamarthajñānaṃ bhavati, evaṃ tāvat sarvaśabdanāmuccāraṇasya viśiṣṭārtha- nādhyayananantaram |
ataḥ kathaṃ dṛṣṭārthajñānārthatvaṃ- bodhanatātparyamantareṇa na viśiṣṭārthajñānavyavasthetyuktam |

adhyayanavidheriti ? yataḥ akṣarādigrahaṇakrameṇa hi adhya- vede tu adhyayanavidhiṃ vinā uccāraṇaniyamābhāvāt yanasya arthajñānārthatvaṃ, tena ca krameṇottarakālamapi smṛti- uccāraṇaviplave sati phalaśabdasya aṅgasaṃbandhi- samārūḍhasyaiva svādhyāyasya arthāvabodhahetutvamaviruddham |
nahi loke'pi śabdaśravaṇānantarameva viśiṣṭārthānvodhaḥ, evaṃ pāṭhakrameṇāpi anuṣṭhānakramaḥ |
prayājādīnāṃ na kintu smṛtilekhya padeṣu nyāyasaṃbhāvanāsaṃbhāvitānvayeṣu |
tathā ekasmin vākye 'yo hotā so'dhvaryuḥ' : tathaivāpīti nātūpapannam |
nanu dvitīyāvibhakteḥ (tāṃ. brā. 25.4.4.) ityādi vyatikrameṇāpi kṛtyācca svādhyāyasya adhyayanasādhyatvamavagamyate |
tat yo'dhvaryuḥ sa hotetyuccāraṇasaṃbhavāt prathamāgatatvena kathamarthajñānasyāpi sādhyatvam |
nahi ekasmin vākye hotṛpadārthasyaivakārasya adhyupadeśasya kāryalakṣaṇaparatvam |
bhavedetad, yadi vidhimeyaṃ ubhayasādhyatvaṃ muṣṭīrnirvapati' (āpa. śrau. 1|8|2.) ityatra bhavet |
atra ca evamarthāvabodhasyaiva sādhyatvaṃ dṛṣṭatvāt, prathamāgatasaṃskṛtasyaivā''dau turyeṇa mudhivādho na bhavet |

nityoccāraṇavidhe tu samuccāraṇavidheḥ prāganavadhāritārthatātparyasya kāryantare ca arthapare sati naimāluccāraṇaviplavakṛtaḥ anyāyā'rthāva- śrutādibhiḥ aviniyuktasya niṣprayojanatayā sādhyatvā- bhānadoṣaḥ |
tathā sati yathocāritatvena arthapareṣu yathā- yogāt |
vidhiśca avadhṛte adhyayanasyārthaparatve samabhivyāhṛtatvena nyāyasaṃpādanavaśāt ākāṅkṣā''dyupa- svādhyāyasya arthaparatve siddhe ta
adhyayanavidhinā kṛtsnasyaiva vedasya samīhitārthatvabodha- paratve susthite, arthavādānāṃ ca mukhyārthatve tadasaṃbhavāt lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇīyam |
nanu akṣarādyahakrameṇa apekṣita- iṣṭopayogamanusaṃdhāya adhyayanaviṣaye apekṣitārthatva- bodhārthatvam |
vidhyuddeśa- syaiva arthavādabhāgasyāpi lokānusāreṇa agrata eva vidheya- prādāstyalakṣaṇā''śrayaṇāt apekṣitārthatvabodhanaparatvasya nyāyasaṃpādanādupasthitatvāt |
ataḥ siddhaṃ prāśastyaprati- pādanadvāreṇa vidhyuddeśaikavākyatayā prāmāṇyamarthavādānā- miti |
tacca prāśastyaṃ lakṣyāmāṇaṃ na pratyekaṃ padalryate |
kiṃ tarhi ? vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā ' iti samastasya chipapraladātvalakṣaṇaprāśastyasya gatiḥ |
prayojanaṃ, yathārthavādānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ, tadā 'aktāḥ śarkarāḥ ' ityatra viśeṣopanāyakapramāṇatvābhāvāt yatkiñci- dañjanasādhanadravyopādānam |
arthavādaprāmāṇye tu 'tejo vai ghṛtaṃ ' ityarthavāde ghṛtastutirdhṛtārthāt ghṛtopādānameva |
sūtraṃ tu vidhinā vidhyuddeśena ekavākyatvāt stutyarthena arthavādāḥ pramāṇaṃ sphuriti |
arthavādapurāṇāṃ āmnāyavacanānāṃ aprāmāṇyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣapratipādanārthe sūtram |

āmnāyasya vedasya kriyā'rthatvāt iṣṭāniṣṭasādhanaviṣayapravṛttijanyatā- rūpakriyāpratipādanārthatvāt atadarthānāṃ tādṛśakriyāprati- pādanaśūnyānāṃ āmnāyavacanānāṃ anarthakyaṃ arthaśūnyatvaṃ arthapramitijanakatvābhāvaḥ aprāmāṇyaṃ iti yāvat |
tasmāt keṣāṃ cidāmnāyavacanānāṃ aprāmāṇyaṃ sarva- pāmeva vacanānāṃ anarthaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ aprāmāṇyamityarthaḥ; ucyate kaiścit 'vidhivacanāni na pramāṇaṃ, yadiktvāta arthavādavat ' iti |
śāstraṃ ca dṛṣṭaṃ ca śāstradṛṣṭe, śāstreṇa dṛṣṭaṃ śāstradṛ
'stenaṃ manaḥ' 'anṛtavādinī vāk' ityatra dṛṣṭavirodhaḥ pūrvapakṣiṇā dvitīyasūtre uktaḥ, tannirāsārthaṃ siddhānta- sūtram |
'hiraṇyaṃ haste bhavati, atha (aṃśagrahaṃ) gṛhṇāti' ityasya vidheḥ śeṣo'yam |
yathā stenāḥ pracchannarūpāḥ evaṃ manaḥ iti rūpāt guṇavādaḥ |
anṛta- vādinī vāk iti prāyāt guṇavādaḥ |
vāk hi prāyaḥ anṛtaṃ vadati iti anṛtavādinī iyuktam |
manasā saṃkalpya vācā mantramuccārya karma kriyate |
te ca vākmanase doṣayukte, hiraṇyaṃ tu nirdoṣaṃ, tasmāt aṃśagrahagrahaṇakāle haste hiraṇyaṃ dhāryam |
stenaṃ anṛtavādinī iti ca guṇavādaḥ gauṇaḥ śabdaḥ ityaparo'rthaḥ |
'tasmād dhūma evāgnerdivā dadṛśe nārcciḥ' iti 'sūryo jyotirjyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāhā' ityagnihotramantrasya prātastanasya vidheḥ stāvako'yamarthavādaḥ |
agniḥ prāta- rādityaṃ gacchati iti sūryamantraḥ eva vaktavyaḥ iti stutiḥ |
dūratvāt agreḥ divā adṛśyatvaṃ iti gauṇaḥ prayogaḥ |
evaṃ 'agnirjyotirjyotirmiḥ svāhā' iti mantrasya sāyaṃkālikasya vidheḥ stutyarthaṃ 'tasmādagnireva naktaṃ dadṛśe na dhūmaḥ' iti vākyam |
rātrau ādityaḥ agnimamupanidhāti iti tejaso bhūyastvāt rātrau agni- rdṛśyate na dhūmaḥ iti gauṇatā prayogāsya |
dūraṃ ca bhūyaśca dūrabhūyasī tayorbhāvo dūrabhūya- stvam |
dṛṣṭānte śrūyamāṇasya bhāvapratyayasya pratyekaṃmanva- yāt dūratvāt bhūyastvāt iti pṛthak hetutvasiddhiḥ |
"na caitad vidamo vayaṃ brāhmaṇā anāhāvā vā iti 'devāḥ pitaraḥ pitaro devā yo'hamasmi sa san yaje, yasyāssi, na tamanataremi' iti pravare prīyamāṇe japati" ityatra śrūyate |
kṛtaḥ ? rūparādhāt striyāḥ mātuḥ aparādhāt mātṛ- vyabhicārasaṃbhavāt |
tat kṣetriṇāmādāya sarvasyāpi suvijñānaṃ iti cet, tatra kartuśca putradarśanāt iti |
'utpāda- yituḥ putra iti brāhmaṇaṃ' ityupakramya 'retodhāḥ putraṃ nayati' ityādinā bījāvāpasya kartuḥ putraḥ, na tu kṣetriṇaḥ ityarthasya āpastambādibhirnirdhāraṇāt |
tadevaṃvidhamapi brāhmaṇaṃ 'devāḥ pitaraḥ' ityādimantrajapena anāhāṇasyāpi saṃpadhate iti stutirupāpadyate |
'śāstradṛṣṭavirodhacca' iti dvitīyasūtre śāstradṛṣṭena virodhaḥ iti yaḥ ante doṣa uktaḥ, tannirāsārthaṃ sūtram |
ākāle āvṛte kāle īṣkāle vā bhavaṃ, athavā samāna- kāle bhavaṃ ākālikaṃ kṣaṇamabhaṅguraṃ aihikaṃ sulabhamityarthaḥ |
tasya īpsā icchā 'ko hi tadeda' ityādinā arthavādena pradarśitā iti na śāstradṛṣṭena svargasukhena virodhaḥ |
ayamarthaḥ :- jyotiṣṭome prācīnavaṃśaśāstrālayāḥ atī- kāśāḥ (liḍakī, jharokhā iti bhāṣā) kartavyā iti 'dikṣu atīkāśān karoti' iti vihitam |
gavākṣa- karaṇe hi dhūmakleśanirākaraṇaṃ tāvat ākālikaṃ tālkā- likaṃ phalaṃ labhyate |
kiṃca jyotiṣṭomena kadā cit svarga- sukhālābhame'pi anatyasya aiśvaryasya gavākṣadvārā darśanenaiva sulabhalābhaḥ syāt |
atīkāśābhāve tu so''pi na syāt tasmāt atīkāśāḥ kartavyāḥ iti atīkāśastulyathai 'ko hi tadeda' ityādi śāstram |
evaṃ ca atī- kāśavidhisutyarthavādatvāt na śāstradṛṣṭavirodhaḥ |
atra ākālikepā, akālikepsā iti dvedhā pāṭho bhaṭṭapāde- ruktaḥ |
tatra ākālikaśabdasya 'ākālikadācata- vacane' (pā0 5|1|114) iti sūtreṇa siddhiḥ |

ādirjanma anto nāśaḥ, tayoḥ samānakāle prati- pādane gamyamāne samānakālaśabdasya sthāne ākāla ityādeśe parastāt iyapratyaye ca nipātite ākālika- śabdasya siddhiḥ iti sūtrakāramahābhāṣyakārayorabhiprāyaḥ |
dācatavacane' iti sūtraracanāmabhipretya āhutakālārtha- kāt īṣkālārthakādā ākālaśabdādeva adhikārike prāgveṭhaji kṛte rūpasiddhiḥ svīkṛtā |

akāliketi pāṭhe tu 'kāla iti loke viprakarṣaḥ (bhūyān kālaḥ) ucyate, tatra bhavaṃ 'kālāt ṭhañ' (pā0 4|3|11) iti ṭhañi kālikaṃ, na kālikaṃ akālikaṃ (alpakālaṃ vinaśvaraṃ) ' iti bhaṭṭapādairaiva vyutpattiḥ pradarśitā |
'tathā phalābhāvāt' iti sūtreṇa upanyastāyāḥ pūrva- pakṣaśaṅkāyāḥ nirāsārthaṃ siddhāntasūtram |
yā'sau garga- trirātravedānumantraṇavidyā mutraśobhāvājimatvahetutvena uktā, sā gargatrirātravedānumantraṇayoḥ praśaṃsā iti sudhā |
atra vidyāpraśaṃsāśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanāt dve pṛthak pade iti niśrīyate |
