evaṃ saiva teṣāṃ prasaṅgāt kārye sādhyayiṣyatīti |
anyathā kṛtvā doṣa ukta:, anyathā parihāra: |
dārśapūrṇamāsiko yāva- jīvakāla: iti kṛtvā doṣa ukta:, naimittika: iti parihāra: |
sā hi kāmena nimittena vā codyate |
soma-- pūrvavat ihāpi prasaṅga: ityusthita: saṃgati: |
sūtrārthastu- ārambhaṇīyā vikṛtau na syāt prakṛteryāvajjīva prayogatayā vikṛtīnāṃ tatkālamadhyapātena prakṛtyarthe kṛtāyā eva tasyā: vikṛtiṣu prasaṅgasambhavāt iti |
vi-- 'ārambhaṇīyā sauryādau nota syā, tra prayogavat |
, katyarthā na prayogārthā ārambhame tato bhavet |
' bhāṭṭa-- nāvamikādhikaraṇoktarītyā ārambhaṇī- yāyā: darśapūrṇamāsārambhajñatvāt vikṛtāvapi ati- deśena tadārambhajñatvopapatte: kartavyaiva ārambhaṇīyā |

na ca tasyā: sakṛt kṛtāyā eva prakṛtau sarvaprayogopakāra- katvāt anyadarśapūrṇamāsaprayogaṃ yāvat etajjanyopakārā- vasthānapratīte: tanmadhyakriyamāṇavikṛtiṣu upakārakatvo- papatte: prasaṅgasiddhiśaṅkā, asyā: darśapūrṇamāsārambha- bhūtāyā: dvitīyādiprayogānajñatvāt |
vistareṇa cāya- martho navame eva nirūpita: |
sarvayogājñatvaṃ vadatāṃ tantra- ratnakārādīnāṃ ca mataṃ nirākṛtam |
ata: anvārambha- ṇīyājanyasya upakārasya uktavicārambhe kṛte eva nāśāt anyadarśapūrṇamāsaprayoge yāvat avasthāne prayojanābhāvāt
tantraratnakārādīnāṃ tu tasyā: sakṛt kṛtāyā eva sarvaprayogārthatvaṃ icchatāṃ vikṛtau prasaṅgapatti: anivāryaiva |
bhāṣya-- asti rājasūya: 'rājasūyena svārājya- kāmo yajeta' iti |
aiṣṭikeṣu anumatyādiṣu saṃśaya: kiṃ ārambhaṇīyā kartavyā, neti |
kuta: ? sarvairambha- yaina tatra jyotiṣṭoma: samāmnāyate 'agniṣṭomaṃ prathama- māharati' iti |
sa prakṛtānāṃ pradhānānāṃ ekaikasya tantreṇa samāmnāto bhavitumarhati |
ekaikasya hi atra pradhānasya tantreṇa sādhāraṇaṃ prakaraṇam |
tena anu- matyādīnāṃ ārambhārthe siddhe, na ārambhaṇīyā bhavitu- marhati |
dup-- 'sarvairambhayaina tatra jyotiṣṭoma: samāmnā- yate' ityuktaṃ ( bhāṣye ) |
nanu ṛtvigvaraṇaṃ sarvapradhānārthaṃ, tatra pradhānādīdīnāṃ ārambhaṇīyā bhaviṣyati |
soma-- bhāṣyakāreṇa rājasūyaprakaraṇe 'agni- ṣṭomamagre āharati' ityārambhaṇīyākāryaṃ agniṣṭomavidhā- nāt pratyāmnānāt vā: iti siddhāntitam |
tasmāt dvāralopādeva bādha iti vārttikakāreṇa siddhāntitaṃ, tadeva granthakāreṇāpi ( śā. ) uktamiti dhyeyam |
sūtrārthantu - saumikasaṃyuktatā aiṣṭikāt pradhānā- dapi ārambhaṇīyā nivarteta sarvārambhārthatayā agniṣṭomasya vidhānena ārambhaṇīyāyā anaṅgatvāt iti bhāṣyakārapakṣe |
vārttikakārapakṣe tu sarvaiṣāmārambhasya sādhāraṇyena aiṣṭikāsādhāraṇatvābhāvāt iti |
vi-- sā kimasyanumatyādau na vā, 'ṅgiṣyasyupa- kramāt |

bhāṭṭa-- yatra rājasūyādau iṣṭipusarūpāṇi pradhānānveya anyapradhānasaṃyuktāni, tatra satyapi teṣāṃ prādhānye 'tatta- diṣṭyā yakṣye' ityādisaṃkalpasya 'tattadiṣṭimai jāyatāṃ' ityākārakatvenāntareṇāpi 'rājasūye me jāyatāṃ' ityā- kārakarājasūyatvaprakārakecchājanyatve'pi utpattisaṃbha- vena tattadiṣṭivyāvacchedyoddeśyatākapravṛttiviṣayatvābhāvāt na tata: pūrvaṃ tāvadārambhaṇīyā |
na vā 'rājasūyena yakṣye' iti mahāsaṃkalpatvāt pūrvaṃ, tasyāpi rājasūyatvāva- cchinnoddeśyatākapravṛttiviṣayatvena tattadiṣṭivyāvacchedyo- ddeśyatākapravṛttiviṣayatvābhāvāt |
nahi rājasūyatvaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsaniṣṭhāprakṛtitārūpitavikṛtitvā''vacchedakaṃ, tasya somayāge'pi sattvena atiprasaktvāt |
ata eva yatra cāturmāsyādau āgrayaṇādau vā nātiprasaktaṃ cāturmāsya- tvādi, tatra pratiyāgaṃ bhinnātideśakalpane satyapi, tasya uddeśyatā''vacchedakatve na kā cit kṣati: |
vastutastu prakṛtāvapi darśapūrṇamāsatvaṃ noddeśyatā''vacchedaka api tu āgneyādimeva, kālekyācca tantreṇa karaṇam |
tataśca vikṛtāvapi cāturmāsyādau tattadyāga- tvameva uddeśyatā''vacchedakaṃ, kālekyācca tantreṇa karaṇam |
'cāturmāsyairyakṣye' ityasya ca 'tattadyāgairyakṣye' itye- vārtha: iti na kaścit virodha: |
prakṛte tu satyapi tatta- diṣṭyāde: uddeśyatā''vacchedakatve tattatsomayāderapi uddeśyatā''vacchedakatvāt nānvārambhaṇīyā |

'darśapūrṇamāsāvārambhyamāṇaḥ' ityanena darśapūrṇamāsā- syoḥ viśeṣaṇavidherjñāt apūrvasādhanalakṣaṇavelāyāṃ prakṛtāpūrvaniṣṭhakāryatānirūpitakāraṇatā'vacchedakatvavicchinne sati nirūpitakāraṇatā'navacchedakatvavicchinnaṃ uddeśyatā- viśeṣaṇaṃ vivakṣaṇīyaṃ, ataśca rājasūye tādṛśohyeta- tā'bhāvāt nānvārambhaṇīyā|
ata eva prakṛtau 'agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau ca me jāyantām' ityākārakecchā'pi nodeyatāghaṭikā|
anyathā agnihotrīyaprathamaprayogī- yādyapadārthesthāpi tādṛśohyetatā'prabhṛtiviṣayatvāt tatrāpi anvārambhaṇīyā''patteḥ|
ataḥ tādṛśohyottaraṃ 'darśa- pūrṇamāsau jāyetāṃ' ityākārakecchā jāyate, saiva uddeśyatāghaṭikā iti dhyeyam|
'āgnāvaiṣṇava- mekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped darśapūrṇamāsāvārambhyamāṇaḥ, sarasvatyai caruṃ, sarasvate dvādaśakapālaṃ, agnaye bhagine- 'ṣṭākapālaṃ, yaḥ kāmayeta bhagi annādaḥ syāmiti|
tatra eṣo- 'rthaḥ: sāṃsyikaḥ kiṃ ārambhaṇīyāyāṃ ārambhaṇīyā kartavyā, uta neti|
kiṃ prāptaṃ? tatra syāt, prayāja- vat|
āha, nanu tasyā api arthe anyā ārambhaṇīyā, tasyā
api arthe anyā ārambhaṇīyā, tasyā api arthe anyā ityevaṃ ārambhaṇīyā na vyavatiṣṭheta|
sarvāstveva ana- yasthāsu sāmarthyena vyavasthā bhaviṣyati|
tena tasminnahani yāvatkṛtvaḥ prayoktuṃ śakyate, tāvatkṛtyo- 'mpyasyate, iti nāvyavyavasthā iti)|
bhāṣyaṃ-- na vā iti pakṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate|
ataḥ prakṛtitva ārambhaṇīyā''pi ārambha- ṇīyāpravṛttena kartavye|
akṛtvā''pi anyāṃ ārambhaṇīyāṃ, ārambhaṇīyāṃ kurvan ārambhaṇīyāpravṛttaḥ eva karotīti gamyate|
tasmāt na ārambhaṇīyāyāṃ āra- mbhaṇīyā syāt|
api ca jalabudbudavat avyavasthā ārambhaṇīyāyāṃ vākyena gamyamānā sāmarthyena bādhyate|
ṭup-- asaṃbhūtā hi sā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ, asaṃbhūtasya ca pradhānatvenaiva siddhiḥ (iti bhāṣyam)|
kasmāt? darśa- pūrṇamāsaprayogāt vahiḥ ārambhaṇīyā kriyate, na tu tathā dīkṣaṇīyādi|
aṅgaṃ ceyaṃ kathaṃbhāva- paripūrṇā ārambhaṇīyā vidhīyate|
tau ca prāk vidhānāt ārambhaṇīyā- śūnyau|
kutaḥ? 1 ekaṃ hīdaṃ vākyaṃ yadā ārambhaṇīyāṃ vidadhāti, tadā nāsau darśapūrṇamāsayorvihitā|
soma-- iha svārthatayā pṛthagārambhasaṃbhavāt kartṛtvā ityuthiteḥ|
sūtrārthastu tasyāmārambhaṇīyāyāṃ sā syāt prayājādivat iti|
vi-- tasyāṃ sā'sti na vā, ''save- 'pyasyāḥ pṛthagupakramāt|
bhāṭṭa-- anvārambhaṇīyāyāṃ satyapi darśapūrṇamāsa- prayogavahirbhāve naiva anyā anvārambhaṇīyā kāryā|
'anvārambhaṇīyeṣṭyā yakṣye' iti saṃkalpasya sāṅgo darśapūrṇamāsau me jāyetām' ityākārakecchājanyapravṛttyā- ''pi utpattisaṃbhavena anvārambhaṇīyātvā''vacchinneoddeśya- tākapravṛttiviṣayatvābhāvāt|
ata eva vaimṛdhe cātu- rmāsyādyaṅgabhūtavaiśvānarapārjanyādhikārapadau pavāmāneṣṭa- ṣpi ca nānvārambhaṇīyā|
darśapūrṇamāsā- vṛttāvapi ārambhaṇīyāyāḥ ādau sakṛdevā'nuṣṭhānaṃ, na tu pratyāvṛttiḥ|
bhāṣyaṃ-- sto darśapūrṇamāsau 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti|
sāmānātā 'āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped, sarasvatyai caruṃ, sarasvate dvādaśakapālaṃ, agnaye bhagine'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet: kāmayetānnādaḥ syāmiti, nityavadeke bhaginamāmanti' (iti)|
āvṛttiśca darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'yāva- jjīvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' iti|
tatra iṣṭyāvṛttau saṃdehaḥ: kiṃ ārambhaṇīyā''pi āvartete, neti|
yathā aṅgabhūtāḥ prayājā āvartyante evaṃ aṅgabhūtā ārambhaṇīyā''pi āvarteta|
ṭup-- 'api vā''pyekadeśe syāt' (6|1| 12) iti (sarvaiṣvadhikaraṇe) yāvajjīvike- 'pi prayoge itikartavyatā bhavatītyuktam|
tatra prathama- padārthadvāreṇa śrūyamāṇā (darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ) ahaṃ āra- mbhaṇīyā (ityasaṃdigdham|
sā-) kiṃ pratiprayogaṃ kartavyā, uta sarvaprayogāṇāṃ sakṛt (iti cintyate)|
kathaṃ? agniādhāya sarvaiḥ saṃkalpayati, parvaṇi- parvaṇi mayā darśapūrṇamāsau kartavyau iti|
evaṃ nādhya- vasāya darśapūrṇamāsau kartavyau iti ārambhaṇīyā kriyate|
tacca sādhā- raṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ prayogāṇāṃ yāvajjīvaprayogāt|
athāpi prathamaṃ pravartanaṃ ārambhaḥ, tathāpi prathamapravṛttena sarve prayogāḥ kṛtā bhavanti|
kutaḥ? 1 ādhānaṃ kṛtvā sarvaiḥ saṃkalpayati 'mayā yāvajjīvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsau kartavyau āāgate''gate kāle' (iti) sa ca (saṃkalpaḥ) sarveṣāṃ prayogāṇāṃ aṅgasamānaviśeṣatvāt sādhāraṇaḥ|
saṃkalpaśca pūrvau (audāsīnyarūpaṃ) avasthāṃ vādhamānaḥ adhyavasānaṃ ('idaṃ kuruṃ' iti evaṃvidhaṃ) bhavati|
pakṣāntaraṃ nigadavyākhyātena bhāṣyeṇa darśayati- ) atra ( bhāṣya- ) granthaḥ ' athāpi prathamaṃ pravartanaṃ ( agnyā- nvādhānaṃ ) ārambhaḥ, tathāpi prathamapravṛttena ( iti bhāṣyamūle pāṭhaḥ |
ārambhaṇīyāpravṛttena iti ṭup-ratnayoḥ bhāṣyapāṭhaḥ ) sarve prayogāḥ kṛtā bhavanti iti |
tamaparitoṣaṃ darśayan vārttikakāraḥ pūrvavyākhyānaṃ dūṣayati- ) naitadyuktam |
kālo nāma nimittaṃ ( karmaṇaḥ , tena ) sa karma prayojayati |
prāk paurṇamāsīkālāt karma na prayujyate , nimittābhāvāt |
tat ( ca nimittaṃ ) ekaṃ ( eva ) prayogaṃ prayojayati ( na prayogāntaram |
) puruṣa pūrvavāsyāṃ ( audāsīnyaṃ ) utsiktvā tat eva ( nimittāt ) saṃkalpamadhyavasānaṃ vā karoti |
tacca ( adhyavasānādi ) ekasya ( eva prayogasya ) na dvitīyādeḥ ( nimittābhāt |
) api ca itikarta- vyatā prayogeṇa prayujyate , na karmaṇā ( karmasvarūpeṇa |
) yadi ca karmaṇā prayujyate , tathā sati prajājānāmapi karmaikatvāt sakṛdeva prayogaḥ syāt |
yaduktaṃ ādhānaṃ kṛtvā sarvaiḥ saṃkalpyate , parvaṇiparvaṇi mayā darśapūrṇamāsau kartavyau ( iti |
) sa ca ( saṃkalpaḥ ) sarvaprayogā- magṛdyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt iti |
sarvaprayo- gāṇāṃ saṃkalpa eva na prāpnoti , nimittābhāvādityuktam |
( nanu āghānānantaraṃ sarvasādhāraṇaḥ saṃkalpo bhavann nāpa- hotuṃ śakyate , ata āha- ) vidvāṃśca adhikriyate |
sa ca jānāti ' nityāni mayā kartavyāni , kāmyāni ca phalārthinā ( yadi phalārthī bhaviṣyāmi ' iti jñāna- mātraṃ tadā bhavati , na tu tadaivaṃ saṃkalpayati |
) yo'sau asya puruṣasya āghānāduttarakālaṃ saṃkalpaḥ ( iti tvayo- cyate ) sa saṃkalpa iva , na ( paramārthataḥ ) prayogadvayam |
) ataḥ ( bhāṣya- kāreṇa vyākhyānaṃ ) anyat kriyate |
( evaṃ vṛttikāratena adhikaraṇaṃ vyākhyāya tatrāpari- toṣāt vyākhyā'ntaraṃ kriyate |

yastu prathamaḥ padārtha ārambha iti , tatraiṣa saṃgrahaḥ kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsauyoḥ ārambhamayāyoḥ ārambha- ṇīyā prathamaṃ padārthe samyak karoti , uta puruṣasya ārambha- māṇasya prathamaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ pravartamānasya ārambhaṇīyā kartāraṃ ārambhaṇayogaṃ karoti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prakaraṇāt tayoḥ ārambhame syāt |
evaṃ cet ārambha- bhedāt iṣṭāpattau pratyārambhaṃ syāt |

ṭup- ' darśapūrṇamāsāvārabhyamāṇaḥ ' iti śānac kartāramabhidhatte , tatra saṃśayaḥ : kimārambhaśabdaḥ darśapūrṇa- māsādyarthe ( agnyādhānādyarthaṃ ) abhidhatte , uta ( darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ) apravṛttasya ( puruṣasya ) pravartanaṃ ( ārambhaśabdo'bhidhatte iti |
) tatra ) pūrvapakṣavādī manyate , yadyapi ayaṃ ( śānac ) kartāramabhidhyāta , tathāpi phalakalpanāmāya ārambhaṇīyā na puruṣārthā , kiṃtu kratvarthā |
( puruṣārthatve hi phalaṃ kalpayitavyaṃ syāt ) kartvarthā cet pratiprayogamāvartata ( iti |
kutaḥ ? nirvapet iti śrutyā kartṛsambandhaḥ kriyate |
itarathā padārthamātre vidhisiddhe kartuḥ prayatnavacanaṃ aviṣa- kṣitaṃ syāt |
yat kartṛ- sambandhe phalaṃ kalpayitavyaṃ , tacca kalpayiṣyate |
evaṃ cet eka- sminnārambhe kṛtārambhaṇīyāke puruṣe tantraprayogāt yāvajjīvaṃ prayoge kṛtārambhaṇīyākaḥ puruṣo bhavati |
dvitīyādiṣvapi prayogeṣu darśapūrṇamāsau ārabhya- māṇaḥ : kṛtārambhaṇīyāko jāta iti yogya eva bhaviṣyati |
na ca dvitīyādiṣu prayogeṣu samāne'hani kṛtā- rambhaṇīyākaḥ asau iti |
dvitīyādi- ṣvapi prayogeṣu samāne evāhani darśapūrṇamāsau ārabhya- māṇaḥ asau kṛtārambhaṇīyāko jātaḥ : iti yogya eva bhaviṣyati ( tasmāt sakṛdeva ārambhaṇīyā |
) ṭup- - siddhāntastu- darśapūrṇamāsārambhayogyaṃ puruṣaṃ kurvantī ( ārambhaṇīyā ) ṛtunā gṛhyate |
api ca yaḥ ( ārambhamāṇaḥ iti ) śānacā puruṣaḥ upāttaḥ , tasya viparivartamānasya ( nirvapena ) iyanena ārambhaṇīyā śrutyā ( śānacā ) pratipādyate |
itarathā ( yadi kevalaṃkārya ārambhaṇīyā ) śānac anarthakaḥ syāt |
( kathaṃ ? ) nirvapet iti uccārite'pi ārambhaṇīyā kṛtyarthā bhavatyeva |
( kathamiha- ) mahāprayogavacane ( darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta ityatra ) yo bhāvavacanaḥ , tena vidhānaṃ ( grahaṇaṃ ) bhavi- ṣyati ( prakaraṇāt |
prakṛte kimāyātaṃ tadāha- ) sā ca bahiḥ ( prayogāt ) kriyamāṇā puruṣamārambhayogaṃ karoti |
tacca ( ārambhasya ) ekatvāt na śayate asyāyaṃ ( puruṣaḥ ) prayogasya yogyaḥ , asya neti agraha- māṇaviśeṣatvāt sarvaprayogāṇām |
yadi ca ( darśapūrṇa- māsa- ) tantramaye kriyeta , tathā sati yasya ( prayo- gasya ) tantraṃ , tathaiva yogyaṃ karoti , nānyasya iti ( gamyeta viśeṣaḥ , na caivamasti |
agrahyamāṇaviśeṣatvāttu sakṛt kṛtaiva sarveṣāmupakaroti iti nāvartanīyā |
) nanu luṭaḥ samāne'hani utpannamānatvāt yasyaiva ( prayo- gasya ) samāne'hani ārambhaṇīyā kriyeta , tasyaiva puruṣaṃ yogyaṃ karoti iti gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ |
tatra bhāṣyakārastāvat idaṃ codyaṃ ' dvitīyādiṣvapi prayogeṣu samāne evāhani darśapūrṇamāsāvārabhyamāṇa'sau kṛtā- rambhaṇīyāko jātaḥ , iti yogya eva bhaviṣyati ' itya- nena granthena nirākaroti |
nanu luṭ ana- yatanabhaviṣyatkālatvena arthaṃ bādhyate |
yadi tu luṭ anayatane vidhīyamānaḥ luṭ avyavamānaḥ ādhānaṃ na labheta , tato bādhetāpi |
ayamatrādhānamāno'pi labhate eva ( ātmānam ) tasmānna bādhate |
tasmāt luṭ anadya- tane adyatane ca , luṭpratyayastu anayatane eva |

( yadi ca adyatane eva luṭ syāt , tataḥ bhaviṣyacchando'pi luṭantatvāt adyatane eva prayujyate , tatra ' bhaviṣyati anayatane ' iti sāmānyādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt ) na ca ( somena yakṣyamāṇo'mīnādadhīta ' ityanena etat tulyaṃ , tatra ādhānaṃ kṛtvā somena anyaśca ( kratubhiḥ
ādyā pravṛtteraiva, bahvyo nai kasya karmaṇaḥ |
‘darśapūrṇamāsāvārabhye, tābhyāṃ yājavīṃ yakṣye’ iti yājñikataḥ saṃkalpo na nyāyamūlakaḥ |
tatra na tāvadiyaṃ prakaraṇāt prayājādivat sākṣāt kratvarthā, ‘darśapūrṇamāsāvārabhyamāṇaḥ’ iti padadvayavedhārthāpteḥ |
nāpi vakṣyamāṇe ārambhe nimitta medanahomādivat naimi- ttikī, kriyā'ryāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ upapade vihitena luṭ- pratyayena asyā ārambhabhyatvīteḥ |
pratiprayogaṃ āvṛttyanāghnī tu sūtrakārāṇuke api phalaṃ, iti na iha adhikaraṇaśarīraṃ, ekā- daśopayuktatvena uhānupayuktatvāt |
tatra anvādhānā- dirūpe prathamapadārthe yājñikānāṃ darśapūrṇamāsārambhaprasiddheḥ agnyādhānameva tattvena ārambhapadārthaḥ |
tadarthā ca anārambhaṇīyā tatkāryaprayuktā, na tu prathamapadārthatvena rūpeṇa prathamapadārthaṃ, yena pūrvavat agnyādhāna- rahitāyāṃ vikṛtau ārambhajñatayā uhyeta |
na ca anvā- dhānasyāpi apravṛttapravartanaviṣayatvenaiva ārambhadavācyatā, na anvādhānatvena, iti kathaṃ na pūrvādhikaraṇaviṣayatvaṃ iti vācyam |

tathāhi, darśapūrṇamāsa- viṣayakapravṛttisāmānyābhāvataḥ puruṣasya vā darśapūrṇa- māsaviṣayiṇī pravṛttiḥ, tadviṣayatvaṃ tat, na tu nirukta- puruṣasya yatkiṃcidviṣayapravartanaviṣayatvaṃ, tasya ādhāna- bhojanādāvapi sattvena atiprasaktvāt |
ataśca nikṣiptapunaścitadarśapūrṇamāsavākyakativiṣayatvaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsayoreva nānvādhāne, aṅgapradhānabhedena tattviṣayaka- kṛtyorbhedāt |
na tu atra darśapūrṇamāsakā bhāvanā śrutā ‘tā upāṃśu kartavyāḥ’ itivat dvitīyānirdeśena darśapūrṇamāsakarmakatvena ārambhapadārthaghaṭakatvasya tvayā vācyatvāt |
ataḥ anvādhāne tasya bādhāt yājñika- prasiddhā rudreva tat ārambhapadasa |
dvitīyā ca ṣaṣṭhyarthā, sa tu anuvādaḥ |
tataśca tadarthā ca ārambhaṇīyā na tadahitāyāṃ vikṛtī uhitavyā |
iti prāpte, vṛttikāreṇa tāvat evaṃ siddhāntitaṃ, na anvādhānaṃ ārambhapadārthaḥ, tadabhāve'pi ‘devatāścaiva yajñamārabhyate’ iti jyotiṣṭome'pi ārambhaśabdaprayogāt |
kiṃtu ‘idaṃ mayā kartavyaṃ’ iti saṃkalpaparaparyāyaḥ adhyavasāyaviśeṣaḥ |
tadarthā anarambhaṇīyā anvādhānarahitāyāmapi vikṛtau sattvāt kartavyaiva |
prakṛtau ca ādhānottaraṃ sarvayājajīvika- prayogāṇāṃ sakṛdeva saṃkalpakaraṇāt sakṛdeva ārambhaṇīyā iti |
tatra yathaiva ekasmin putre jāte vaiśvānarī nisṛpya putrāntarajanmani punarnirvape nādhyavasāyakaṃ, tadvat ihāpi adhyavasāyabhedāt sakṛtkaraṇānapattiḥ |
sā'pi na sākṣāt, apitu śānacā kartṛtvāt jajñyamānavat kartāraṃ ārambhayorthaṃ karoti iti tad-dvārā ārambhārthā |

yadyapi ca darśapūrṇamāsau iti dvitīyāyāḥ viṣayatvāt, darśapūrṇamāsābhiviṣaya- kāpravṛttapravartanaviṣayatvaṃ ca darśapūrṇamāsābhyatvenaiva saṃbhavāt, tat : pūrva prayogamadhye eva anvārambhaṇīyā anuṣṭheyā ityarthaḥ : ‘darśapūrṇamāsāvārabhyamāṇaḥ’ ityasya prāpnoti |
tathāpi uktārthasya pāṭhādeva prāpteḥ padadvayavaiyarthyapraśnena dvitīyā uddeśyatvaparā |
tena aṅga viṣayapravṛtterapi pradhānoddeśyakatvāt darśapūrṇamāso- ddeśyakāpravṛttapravartanaviṣayatvaṃ tatprathamaprayogāyādartha eva iti tadaṅgaṃ ārambhaṇīyā |
ataśca darśapūrṇamāsapade apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇāyāṃ tatpadārtharahitāyāṃ tādṛśaprathamaprayogādyapadārthāntaratvāt vikṛtau uhita- vyaiva ārambhaṇīyā |

atra hi darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ na tattadvyaktitvena pravṛtti prati uddeśyatā, yena tad-vyaktitvavacchinnoddeśyaka- pravṛttidharmāsamānakālīnataduddeśyakapravṛttiviṣayatvāt dvitīyaprayogīyādyapadārthatvenāpi sā syāt |
darśapūrṇa- māsau iti śravaṇāttu darśapūrṇamāsameva uddeśyatā'vacche- dakam |

āvaśyakaṃ ca ubhayatrāpi pravṛttipratiuddeśya- tā'vacchedakavibhaktyā, itarathā sāmānyato ‘vihitakriyā ge jāyatāṃ’ ityākārakauddeśyatayāḥ : gaṅgāsnānapravṛttāvapi darśapūrṇamāsoddeśyakapravṛttitvāt tatrāpi ārambhaṇīyā- ''patteḥ |
atra sāmānyākārakecchāyāṃ gaṅgāsnānānuṣṭhānottaraṃ ādyadarśapūrṇamāsaprayoge'pi anvā- rambhaṇīyā na syāt, ataḥ : prathamāvacchedakavivakṣā |

vastutastu ‘darśapūrṇa- māsau me jāyetāṃ’ ityākārakecchayā gaṅgāsnānakaraṇe'pi tadāpattivāraṇārthaṃ yasmin padārthe saṃkalpatvādirūpe kṛte darśapūrṇamāsau ārabdhau iti vyavahāraḥ : tatpadārthapravṛttereva uddeśyatā'vacchedakatve praveśa āvaśyakatve, tat eva uktakhaṇḍe'pi vāraṇasiddheḥ, tattadvyaktitvādeḥ uddeśyatā- 'vacchedakatvāraṇārthameva avacchedakavivakṣā |
ata eva tadāpadyaiva uktalakṣaṇeva ārambhatvāt na dvitīyādi- prayoge anvārambhaṇīyā |
nanu evaṃ ‘sāṅgena jyotiṣṭomena yakṣye’ ityevaṃvidha- saṃkalpaviṣayapravṛtteḥ : dīkṣaṇīyātvāvacchinnoddeśyakapravṛtte tataḥ pūrve anvārambhaṇīyā''pattiḥ |

yadi tu uddeśyatāyāḥ tatra ‘sāṅgo jyotiṣṭomo jāyatāṃ’ ityevaṃ- mākārakecchāviṣayaviśiṣṭatvena viśiṣṭadharmāvacchinna- tvāt noktapravṛttitvaṃ ityāśaṅkyeta, tataḥ : ‘dīkṣaṇīyā yakṣye’ ityevaṃvidhāvāntarasaṃkalpatvāt pūrve anvārambhaṇīyā- karaṇapattiḥ, tasya nirūpravṛttiviṣayatvāt, avāntara- saṃkalpaviṣayapravṛtteḥ : ‘dīkṣaṇīyā me jāyatāṃ’ ityevamākā- rakecchājanyatvena dīkṣaṇīyātvāvacchinnoddeśyakatvāt |

‘dīkṣaṇīyā jāyatāṃ’ ityākārakecchā'nu- pattāvapi ‘sāṅgo jyotiṣṭomo jāyatāṃ’ ityākāraka- sāṅkavajasravaprakārakatvena eva ‘dīkṣaṇīyā yakṣye’ ityevaṃvidhasaṃkalpaviṣayapravṛtteḥ saṃbhavata tādṛśasaṃkalpa- rūpādhyavasāyasya dīkṣaṇīyātvāvacchinnoddeśyatākapravṛtti- viṣayatvābhāvena dvāralopādeva dīkṣaṇīyā''sī da rājasūya- gateṣṭipaśubandhādau ca anvārambhaṇīyā''bhāvasya daśame (10|1|2|4) vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
evaṃ ‘somo me jāyatāṃ’ ityākārakecchaiva ca somādyarthameva vaiśvā- nareṣṭyādau pravṛttisaṃbhavāt ‘vaiśvānareṣṭyā yakṣye’ iti saṃkalpasyāpi vaiśvānareṣṭyātvāvacchinnoddeśyatākapravṛttipa-
tvābhavena dvāralopādeva na tatrāpi anvārambhaṇīyā iti draṣṭavyam |
darśapūrṇamāsatvaṃ tu 'sāṅgo darśapūrṇamāsau jāyetāṃ' ityākārakacchāyāt prakāratvāt bhavati uddeśya- tā'vacchedakakoṭipatvaṃ iti viśeṣa: |
ata: siddhaṃ anvārambhaṇīyāyā: uktavidhārambhātvāt vikṛtau ūha: |
yattu mūle prathamaprayogārambhe kriyamāṇāma anvārambha- ṇīyā sarvaprayogāṇāmupakaroti |
na ca ārabhyamāṇa: iti adyatanakālatvāt dvitīyādiprayogatā pradhānadinakartavyatā- vagate: kathaṃ sarvaprayogopakārakatvaṃ iti vācyam |
atha- tanānayanasādhāraṇabhaviṣyatkālamātratvāt: adyatana- mātrakālatvāttvāt, itarā 'bhaviṣyati adyatane luṭ' ityatra 'bhāvaṣyati' iti luṭpratyayaprayogānupapatte: |

yadyapi prathamaṃ liṅadayo na vyatirekaṃ niyogaṃ pratipādayitumīśate, avahantyādiṣviva śabdakathamānādhikāraniyogādanuvādakatvāt, tathāpi adhikāraniyogaṃ prati eṣāṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgīnāṃ avāntarapūrvāṇāṃ ajanayatāṃ ajñatā upapadyate iti paścādadhikārāvapūrvābhāvenopādeya āśravaṇī- yāvāntarapūrvāṇi liṅā'bhidheyānupeyate |
nanveva- māśritya avāntarapūrvābhyupagamo yathā, tathā tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ |
yāni ca tāni avāntarapūrvāṇi śabde- nā'bhūtāni, (tāni) adhikārarūpaiḥ prati upanīyante |
nanu evaṃ tarhi dīkṣaṇīyā''diṣu vāḍniyamasya avā- ntarapūrvaprayuktatā na syāt, kiṃtu prokṣitābhyāmanavahantīti tadapūrvaprayuktatvevāpadyeta |

yadyapi avāntarapūrvāṇāṃ parabhāvā''śrayatvābhāḥ, (tā- 'bhāvaḥ) tathāpi svarūpaniṣcayartha eva vāḍniyamādiko dharmaḥ, ‘na dīkṣaṇīyāyāmanbrūyāt’ iti dīkṣaṇīyā- saṃvadavāntarapūrvasvarūpasaṃvandhāvagamāt |
na ca teṣāṃ svarūpaparityāgena ajñā''vibhāvalakṣaṇa yuktā |
avaghātādīnāṃ tu pramāṇā- ntarātsevasiddhināṃ vinā'pi prokṣaṇaṃ kharūpasiddheḥ; svarūpa- pārthatve ayuktaṃ niyamaniyogasyānuṣṭhānam |
tadevaṃ svaya- mallatvāt laghvanuṣṭhāneṣu prayājādiṣu nādhikārakalpanā'- vakāśaḥ |
tenaiva prakāreṇa pradhānaviṣayeṣu utpattiniyogeṣu karaṇavāntarābhāvo veditavyaḥ |
yo hi tamavāntaravyāpāraṃ nābhyupagacchati, tasya kāraṇabhedo na syāt darśapūrṇamāsā- diṣu |
tathā āmeyādidharmā upaśupājādiṣu bhaveyuḥ, paramāpūrvaprayuktatvāt tatpratiṣṭhānabhāvāviśeṣāt |
avā- ntaravyāpāramede tu yuktā vyavasthā, anyathā āmeyasya karaṇatā, anyathā upaśupājādīnāmapi |
nahi yathā āmeyasya apūrvasādhanatā, tathā sauryasyeti prakṛtadvārābhāvena pārṣaṇahomayo-
ye ca santyavāntarapūrvāṇi, na sādhanarūpāṇi (iti) ācakṣate, na teṣāmavāntaravyāpāreti prācīnasakaladoṣaprasaṅgaḥ |
kāryotpattinimittābhāvena hi avāntaravyāpāratā, anyathā āśramāderapi kṛṣisamu- tyāyitve'nyavat navamasyābhime avāntaravyāpāratā''- patteḥ |
nanvevamadhikāraśūnyatve dīkṣaṇīyā''diṣu ati- deśo na syāt |
nāvāntarapraka- raṇaṃ nāma pramāṇamasti, prameyabhāve pramāṇa- tvānupapatteḥ |
yāvadeva tānyavāntarapūrvāṇi nāva- gamyante, tāvadeva sarvasya ārādupakārakaṃ padārthe- jātasyāviśeṣeṇa pradhānavidhiragṛhītatvāt |
yāni tu vākyā- dimisteṣu avāntarapūrvāṇi niveśitāni, tatra prati- ṣṭhitāni na paramāpūrve saṃkramaṇamanti |
yadi niradhi- kārāṇāmapi sādhikārāṇāmiva svārasikā''kāṅkṣā bhavet, bhavedevam |
kathaṃ punarakāryatā anuṣṭheyatā ca ? nūnaṃ bhavān aśrutapūrvaḥ |
yadeva hi puruṣeṇa mamedaṃ kāryamiti nirapekṣamevāvagamyate, tadanuṣṭheyam |
yattu tasiddhayarthe prāgasiddhaṃ sat vini- yujyate, tat kāryam |
yadeva cānuṣṭheyaṃ tatraiva kathamidhyākāṅkṣā, na kāryamātre |
avahīnastarhi prayājādīnāmeva dīkṣaṇīyā''- diṣu ākāṅkṣā''patvena atideśaḥ |
yathā paṭo bhavatīti nirā- kāṅkṣāpi padadvayasya rakapaṭeccāraṇāt rakaṃ prati ākāṅkṣā, anyathā rakaṃḥ paṭo bhavatītyanyaprasaṅgaḥ |
evaṃ prayājādiṣu na kiṃcidākāṅkṣāsthāpane kāraṇāntara- mastīti na saumikadharmātideśaḥ |
ye tu adhikṛtādhikārāsyupa- gamena sādhikārātāṃ aṅganiyogānāmāhuḥ; teṣāṃ prayājādiṣu rātrisatranyāyenārthavādikaphalakāmaḥ evādhikārī prāpnoti iti nādhikṛtādhikārasaṃbhavaḥ |
syānamataṃ, ititarkyatathā''- kāṅkṣā pradhānavidhenaṃ paripūryate iti |
mā paripūri, prayojanaṃ tu paripūrṇaṃ, na pramāṇam |
arthavādapadāni pramāṇāṃśopanipātīni, teṣāṃ parokṣā vṛtirmā bhūditi tanpratipādakaphalakāmaḥ evādhikārī yuktaḥ |
sādhikāra- vidhisaṃnidhimātreṇa tu niradhikārāṇāṃ pratīyateḥ tādarthya adhikārākāṅkṣā nāstītyarthavādapadāni arthavādamātraparva- sāyīnyeva |

tathā payovrataṃ brāhmaṇasyetyādiṣu bhojanāya pravṛttasya dravyārjananiyamāvat svavākye evādhikāriṇo labdhatvācca pradhānapravṛttasya adhikārakalpanā śakyate kalpayituṃ, atha svātantryaṃ payovratādīnāmāpadyate |
tathā nā'nyataṃ vadediti prakaraṇadhīte'pi niṣidhyamānakriyākartṛ- radhikārāvagamānna prakaraṇāṇupraveśasaṃbhavaḥ |
tathā bhinnaṃ juhotīti nimittasyādhikāraviśeṣatvāt vinā nimitta- kalpanāt adhikāraviśeṣaṇatvāt na homasya darśapūrṇa- māsāṅgatvalāmaḥ |
na vā idamapi sādhanaṃ bhinnaśabdasya yaugi- katvāt prakṛtigāmitve sati nimittato'pyadhikāre''dhi- kṛtasyādhikāraḥ |

api vā adhikārākā- ṅkṣāyāṃ adhikāre kalpayitumupakānte kimiti arthena saṃnidhānena adhikāraḥ kalpyate, varaṃ bhavatvanuṣaṅgaḥ sākṣā- cchrutasya adhikārapadasya, pradhānavākye tu śrute adhikārapade pradhānane saha saṃnve sati saṃnihitānāṃ aśutādhikārāṇāṃ sādhikārapadamadhyena anvitānāṃ adhikārākāṅkṣaiva nāstīti anuṣaṅganirākaraṇe mulyuktiḥ |
api- ca pratyekaṃ ‘samidho yajati’ ityādiṣu pradhānādhikṛtasya adhikārāvagamāt pratyekameva samidādīnāṃ pradhānopāya- bhāvāt pratyekamimitikartavyatābhāvaḥ syāt |
avāntara- vidyo hi tadā savidhayaṇāṃ upāyabhūtaṃ prakalpayanti |
kara- ṇāvaruddhe paramāpūrve karaṇatāsaṃbhavāt karaṇopārajanakatayaiva upāyabhāvakalpanām |
tatśrānapekṣyopāyabhāvamāśritya ekasyaiva karaṇopakārasaṃpādakatvāt vikalpaḥ : samidādīnāṃ syāt |
adhikāravidhinā tu tāvat tādarthyamātragrahaṇe tasya tadanvitasya anyathā'
paścāttu tasya vākyena punardvirātasaṃbandhaḥ iti nānupraveśaṃ kiṃ cin |
tadevaṃ ārā- dupakārakeṣu prathamaṃ tādarthyena adhikāraniyogaṃ prati anvi- teṣu nādhikāraniyoga vidhinā anuṣṭheyabhūtena karaṇopakāre klṛpte, taṃ prāṃta nādhikāraniyogena janakatvakalpanām |
na ca kṣaṇikabhāve teṣāṃ parasparaṃ svarūpeṇa asaṃbhavatāṃ saṃbhūyopakārajanakatāmāpadyate iti aśāntarapūrvāṇi svīkriyante |
evamāśrayiṣu vinā'pi apūrveṇa dravyadevatā- saṃskāramukhena karaṇopakārajanakasiddhiriti nāpūrvasyāśravaṇe kiṃ cana pramāṇam |
tatryai na sākṣāt dravyadevatopakāro yāgaḥ, kiṃtu svāṅgabhūta mantratantrāṃśamukhena |
na ca yāge'dhikārā- nanupraviṣṭe tayostatra viniyogopapattiḥ |
na cāpūrvamanta- reṇa yāgasya adhikārānupraveśaḥ, iti avadyaśrāvaṇīyama- vāntāpūrvādyam |
tatrāpi dravya- devanāsaṃskārādaurevamapattireva prayojikā, yāge dravyasya sākṣādvāgārāditi mantavyam |
na ka cit dravyasya dvāraṃ śrutiḥ samarthayati |
na tu aprākaraṇiko'pi dravyasya viniyogaḥ, sākṣāt karaṇopakārajanakatvābhāvāt |
tasya liṅgena samā- khyayā sthānena bhāvārtha eva janakatayā saṃbandhaḥ |
guṇa- devatayośca vākyena viniyogaḥ, nānābhyāpatvāt kāraṇānām |
aṅgasādhanatadupapādane tadavacchedakatayā astyeva tayorupayoga iti na kārakatvā viniyogo virū- dhyate |
yā tu saṃkhyā uttamakramasamavāyāthā ekādaśa prayājān yajatīti (sā) utsannānāṃ karmaṇāṃ vidhānā- saṃbhavāt kāmāśritā vidhīyate |
yadyapi ca uddeśyagataṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vākyabhedabhayena vivakṣāṃ nārhatīti prayājādīnāṃ sāhityaṃ na vivakṣitaṃ, tathāpi tasya pṛthaktvaniveśitvāt na pratyekaṃmisaṃcaḥ, kiṃtu samudāyasyaiva |
na cābhyāsaṃ vinā tasya pratipattiḥ ityarthāt abhyāsādhyayaṇam |
sa hi vidhīyamānāni karmāṇi avacchinatti, na ca tathā vidhe- yatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
bahuṣu vihiteṣu sa prayogeṇa parilabhyate eveti na pṛthaggriheyatvamavalambate |
avidheyabhūtāpi tau bhāvāvarthā abhinadan na viśro upakarotīti sa nāmnyau |
yastu bhinnaprātipadikāmidheyaḥ, so'ruṇimādivanna na karmaṇi kāraṇatayā vidhīyate |

yaḥ punarayaṃ vibhaktya- midheyaḥ, tasya yadyapi śaktyā prātipadikārthasaṃbandhaḥ, tathāpi tasya tanmātrasaṃbandhatve prakaraṇasāmānyādito graha- saṃbandho nopapadyate, iti grāhakīyāvasthāsaṃbandhataiva aupā- dānīkī iti nirṇīyete |

viniyuktasya paścādekapradānaṃ anavacchinnasya na saṃbhavatītyasti tadavacchedakabhūtasaṃkhyā- 'pekṣā, saṃkhyāyāśca pratītagrāhakānvayanirāhāya āśrayā- pekṣeta tadavasthāsaṃnidhinā vidhiḥ; kalpayati |
upādāna- lakṣaṇo vidhibhāvāpatteḥ ākṣepāparaparyāyo mīmāṃsakaḥ: pratipannaḥ |
'saurye caruṃ nirvapet' ityādi sādhikāro vidhiḥ prasaṅgataḥ upapatti vinā anupapadyamānaḥ |
nahi kṣaṇikaṃ yāgamātraṃ utpattiviniyogānapekṣaṃ adhikāra- siddhisamarthamiti bahuṣoktam |
viśvajidādiṣu adhikāra- mantareṇa anuṣṭhānāsaṃbhavāt kāryarūpasya vidheḥ agratasya anupapattiḥ adhikārakalpanābījam |
saṃkhyā'nvitaśca vidhayarthaḥ pratīta: tadanvayopapattaye grāhakīyadaśāṃśandhitā- māpādayati nimitte evaiti yo'dhikāre sādhyabhūto vidhiḥ |
kāmādhikāre tu kāmasiddheḥ tadāyattatvāt mānasī pravṛttiḥ prāgeva anuṣṭhānapravṛttāvapi apratihatā nimittatā astīti vidhiraprayojakaḥ |
yadeva hi yasya kāryaṃ, tadeva tasya prayojakam |
yacca vidhinā svasiddhayartha- mākṣipyate, tadvidheyamiti tattvajñāḥ |
nanvevaṃ viśvaji- dādau adhikāro'pi ākṣipyatavā vidheyaḥ : evā syāt |
nādhikārasya niyogasiddhau vyāpāraḥ, kiṃtu kartṛtvasya tatpratipatyarthaśca adhikārākṣepaḥ iti |
evaṃ ca vidhinā svasiddhayarthe anākṣipyamāṇatvāt na kramo vidheya
kramasya pāñcamikasya na kiṃci- dabhidhānamasti, na ca anamihitasya tasya vaiyogikaṃ aupādānikaṃ vā śeṣatvaṃ ghaṭate |
na vā śeṣabhūtasya vidhi- rākṣepāya prabhavati |
yastu 'vaṣaṭkartuḥ prathamabhakṣaḥ' iti prathamaśabdāmidheyaḥ kramaḥ, sa hi viniyogo vidheyatveti nibandhanāntaraḥ |
tataḥ pañcame hi yattāvat śrautakramaḥ 'adhvaryugṛhapati dīkṣa- yitvā' ityādī, na tasya kiṃcidabhidhānamasti |
kvāpyanyayo'pi hi samānakartṛke'rthe vartamānatvāttaḥ vidhīyamāno'pi ya eva prathamaṃ prayujyate, tata eva vidhīyate, tatra kvāpyanyayapratyayaśravāt |
yathāprayogatrāci- tvādvāgataḥ yathāvati cānuṣṭhānaṃ iti kramo'pi tathā- vidha evāvagamyate |
anamidhīyamānasyāpi avagatyupāyabhāvastatra tatra pramāṇe cintita eva |
yadi vidhayarthe prati śeṣatvaṃ kramasya nāsti, kathaṃ tarhi codanālakṣaṇatvam |
na vidheyatā codanālakṣaṇatve hetuḥ adhikārasya tadbhāva- pramajñāt |
avidheyarthaḥ tadanvitaḥ pratipādyeta iti codanā lakṣaṇaṃ, tarhi kramānvito'pi prayogavidhiḥ : avasīyate, iti tasyāpi codanālakṣaṇatvamavicchidyam |
api tu yathāviniyoga- madhikāraḥ, sāmānyato'pi adhikārārāśrayaṇena viniyoga- siddheḥ, yasyāpi pratiprakaraṇaṃ vyavasthāliddhaye grāhakapūrvako viniyogaḥ |

yadyapi ca sādhikārasya grāhakatvaṃ, tathāpi sāmānyataḥ svargakāmādau adhikāriṇi labdhe, sādhikā- ratve saṃpanne grāhakagrahaṇe nivṛtte, niyukteṣu aṅgeṣu tada- vacchinne vidhayarthe kāryārthini tadanuṣṭhānasamarthasya svarga- kāmino'dhikāraḥ; iti paścādadhikāraviśeṣaniyamaḥ |
ata eva anvadhirapyaṅgādīnāṃ avekṣaṇaśravaṇātikramaṇādyaṅga- vati, pañcādyepāṇāmādheyatrayavalakṣaṇāṅgabhāji, ādhva- nīyādiyogini ca anāhitāgnīnāmadhikāraḥ |
yeṣāṃ ca na svābhā- vikī śaktirapetā, teṣāmadhikāro bhavetyeva, adṛṣṭavāṇāṃ asāmadheyatvādidhiviśeṣaparayorindriyāṇāṃ ca |
na nanu teṣā- madhikāro na nirvahatyeva apūrvasiddhinibandhanātvātsya, tasyāḥ sakalāṅgāmāyattvāt |
satyaṃ kāmādhikāro na bhavetyeva, tasya setikartavyatāphalabhāvanāviṣaya- tvāt |
phalakāmasya hi phalabhāvanāṃ prati ekakaraṇabhūte- 'dhikāro nāvakalpate |
sarve ca karaṇaṃ setikartavyatāṃ karaṇatāmanubhavatīti saṃmatam |
vyāghātāttu viṣayābhāvāt viṣaye'pi anupapatteḥ adhikāravilaya eva kāminām |

) nyāyāttāt (anvādeḥ : ājyāvekṣaṇādau) vyāghātāttu ) viṣayābhāvāt (vyāghātāttu hetoḥ ājyāvekṣaṇābhāvena viṣayasya darśa- pūrṇamāsakarmaṇaḥ abhāvāt ) viṣayiṇo'pi (daśādhikāra- 'nasvaraphalasyāpi ) anupapatteḥ adhikāravilaya eva (svargakāmasya hi adhikāraḥ; viśiṣṭasvargaphalasaṃbhave ca adhikārasya vilaya eva prātaḥ |
atra vidvānḥ pramāṇam ] nimi- ttaśca kevalabhāvārthaviṣaya evādhikāra ityajñānupasaṃhāre- 'pi viṣayamoṣāttu nādhikārarāgam |
ane- naivādhikāreṇa nimittādhikāre gauṇe mukhyasya śāstrārtha i
kāryanibandhanaṃ ke cidanye mīmāṃ- yogyatā ca tāvadavivādā |
saṃnidhānaṃ tu buddhena prākṛ- sakā manyante |
liṅgaviśeṣeṇa prākṛtamapūrve buddhau saṃnidhī- sthita eva, apūrvagrahaṇapūrvakatvāt viniyogasya |
yadi hi yate, tacca svopakāraṃ saṃnidhāyate |
ata evopakāra- ‘darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta’ ityanena sādhikāraṃ saṃbandhaḥ aupadeśika iti tattvavidaḥ |

yo hi granthena yāgamuddiśya samidho yajeti samidādividhiḥ syāt, vidhayaiva upasthāpitaḥ tasmin anyameti, sa aupade- tadānīṃ evamuddiṣṭa vidhānāt yāvadyāgameva sami- śikaḥ prakṛtau ivopākāraḥ, yathā viśvajidādau adhi- dādividhiriti yajilu sarvāpyeṣu samidādividhināt kārī |
tadevamupakārasaṃbandhamupetaḥ kena padārthena janyate upadeśo na vyavasthitaḥ |
nahi tadā svargakāmapadaṃ darśa- iti paścāt

śarāvaḥ; sa ca ubhayasya haviṣaḥ' iti|
viśeṣaṇaṃ na mṛṣyate, haviṣā'pi te viśeṣaṇaṃ |
tatra gavākṛtvā dravyaṃ lakṣayitvā tasya ānayanamucyate|
tatrāpi cet enamabhaviṣyat, naiva enāṃ śuklaśabdo |
ārti ācchet' ityaviśeṣe yatkiñcit iti gamyate|
tatra sarvasyaiva kiñcit ārti ṛcchati, antataḥ caritaṃ |
ākhyātāye saṃhalaya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, parārthe punaḥ : viyujya |
( vidhīyate ), tataḥ ( haviḥśabdasya vidhipratyayasya ca ādhutteḥ ) vākyabhedaḥ ( syāt ) prahaikalpanyāyena ( 3|1|13 ) |
' āha , yadi viśeṣaṇaṃ na mucyate ' ( haviṣā viśeṣaṇaṃ mā bhūt ) iti ( bhāṣyaṃ haviṣo viśeṣa- ṇatvaṃ nirākaroti |
tathādyuktaṃ , nahi siddhāntī havipo viśeṣaṇatāmicchati , ārtisaṃbandhaṃ dravyaṃ upapātābhidheyaṃ pañcāśavasya kāraṇaṃ , ityupakrame ārtiviśiṣṭasya havipo nimittatvābhidhānāt |
ata āha- ) ' yadi ubhaya- śabdasya ārtinā saṃbandho neṣyate havipo'pi mā bhūt saṃbandhaḥ iti , viśeṣaṇaśabdena saṃbandhamabhidhatte ' |
( ayamavataraṇasya granthaḥ likhite mudrite ca dṛṣṭīkā- granthe upalabhyate |
tatra tu atra sthāne iṣṭaṃ paṅktiḥ- ' yadi ubhayaśabdasya svarūpeṇa havirviśeṣaṇaśabdena saṃbandhamabhidhatte , tena ārtimātrameva haviḥsaṃbandhānapekṣaṃ nimittaṃ prāpnoti ityabhiprāyaḥ |
nanu na tanmātrasya nimittatā ghaṭate , nityatvāt |
ataḥ kathamidaṃ codyaṃ , ata āha- ' iti ) |
kriyāpadagaṇo nimittatvaṃ pratipadyate iti vivekagṛhītvā codyate |

( nimittaviśeṣaṇe vākyabhedābhidhānāt ārtihavipo- ranyatarena anyatarasya viśeṣaṇe vākyabhedāt ubhayapadasya nimittāntarbhāvaḥ , itarayoścāntarbhāvaḥ iti viveka- magṛhītvā coditavāniti ) ' mṛgāmahe haviṣā viśeṣaṇaṃ ' iti ( siddhāntabhāṣyam |
paramatathā ( api viśeṣaṇatve viśeṣaṇatve ca ) nirākriyate iti ( matvā anadarāt ) havirviśeṣaṇaṃ bravīti ( sarvathā kevalayoḥ nimittatva- nirākaraṇasiddheḥ ) |

śaknoti hi śrutyā tatsaṃbandhaṃ vaktuṃ , havi- rupasaṃbandhaṃ tu vākyena brūyāt ( asya bhāṣyasyābhi- prāyamāha- ) kartavyatvāt ( vidhipratyayaḥ ) yassāt paraḥ śrūyate tasyaiva ( paramārthataḥ śrutyā ) kartavyatāmāha |
sa ca ( yāgaḥ ) kārakairvinā nāmānaṃ prati labhate
phalanimitte ( api ) kriyā ( naimittikā ) ākāṅkṣate , iti te prati kriyāṃ vidadhāti ( tena kārakaphalanimittānāṃ vidhinaiva apekṣitatvāt vivakṣā ) |
yat ( tu ) havipo viśeṣaṇaṃ ( ubhayatvaṃ ) , tat nāsau ( kriyā ) na tatsādhanaṃ iti ( vidhi-pratyayena na parāmṛśyate |
( nanu ubhayaviśiṣṭaṃ haviḥ nimittaṃ bhavatu , na tu ārtiviśiṣṭam |
ata āha- ) evaṃ cet ārtiviśiṣṭena haviṣā nimittapratyayaḥ upajāyate |
naimittikaprayogavacanena ( nirvapet ityanena ) tātramā- śravasya apekṣitatvāt |
yadanyat ( ubhayamiti nimittā- saṃnipāti ) padāntaramudīkṣyate , tat vilambitatvāt ( paryavasthite vidhau paścādāgacchat ) vākyaṃ ( bhavati ) |
( bhāṣyavyākhyānāntaramāha- ) athavā ācchet iti ( nimittābhidhāyī liṅgaśabdaḥ ) yassāt paraḥ śrutaḥ , tasya ( eva ārtyarthasya śrutyā ) nimittabhāvamāha |

tatra kevalaśrutiparigrahe ( sati ārtimātrasya nityatvena ) nimittabhāvābhāvāt : iti ārtinā haviṣi viśeṣa- māṇe ( api ) śrutirna ( atīva ) hīyate , yathā dhānyaṃ anyatra vidhīyamāne ( brīhīn prokṣati ityatra nānyataḥ śrutihāniḥ ) |
havirbhavasaṃbandhe tu na dhātvartho vidhīyate ( nimittatayā nābhiyate ) , na so'nyatra ( nāmyaviśeṣaṇatayā'pi nimittaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ ) |
tassāt ( nimittakartavyatāvācanena ( ācchet ityanena ) nāpekṣitaṃ , na ( api ) naimittike ( nirvapet ityanena ) , ataḥ avivakṣitam |

' atha kassāt na padadvayaviśiṣṭā ārtiḥ nimittaṃ pratīyate iti ' ( ityādi ' tat ubhaya- viśiṣṭā ārtinimittaṃ iti gamyate ' ityantaṃ codya- bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe- ) yathā haviḥśabdānāt ( ārti- havipoḥ ) viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ paramārthaśrutyāgame ( aṅgīkriyate ) , evaṃ ubhayapadājñānāt yādṛśī śrutiḥ ( tadabhāvena saṃbhavati ) tādṛśaiva grāhyā |
tassāt ārtyā ( na kevalaṃ havirviśeṣyaṃ kiṃtu ) dve api ( haviṣ- bhavatve ) itaretarayukte viśeṣyate |
( tadeva ' ubhayaviśiṣṭā ārtiḥ ' iti bhāṣyaṃ saṃbandhaparaṃ viśiṣṭapadaṃ , ārtiviśiṣṭe-

yathā- śrutameva vā nyāyyemityāha- ) athavā ārtiviśe- ṣaṇaṃ ityevaṃ vivekaṃ ( pūrvapakṣī ) agrahītavān , kiyattu gṛhītaṃ ( pūrvapakṣiṇā ) ' ārtinivṛttirapi tatra gamyate ' iti pūrvassāt ( siddhāntabhāṣyāt ) ārtiḥ viśiṣṭā nimittaṃ iti |

evaṃ cet ( ārtinivṛttireva nimittaṃ cet , tataḥ ) yathaiva ekena ( haviḥpadena ) viśeṣya- māṇā ārtirnivṛttiḥ ( śrutyamihitā ) asti ( na tu apagatā ) evaṃ dvitīyenāpi ( ubhayapadena viśeṣya- māṇā ) ārtinivṛttirasya ( iti ) na śrutirhāsyete |
idaṃ tāvat devatānāṃ priyaḥ praṣṭavyaḥ ' ityādinā ( ' tatra śakyaṃ viśeṣavacanena pratiṣedhavāca- kena nivartayituṃ ' ityantena bhāṣyeṇa ) antarṇītābhiprāyaḥ idānīṃ pratipādayati ( bhāṣyakāraḥ ) |
karma ( phalaṃ , saṃskāryaṃ vā ) nimittaṃ codiya dhātvarthasya vidhīyate |
( tayoḥ ) yat viśeṣaṇaṃ , na tat kriyāṅgaṃ , ityataḥ tasya avivakṣā ( pūrve ) uktā |

( nanu ubhayapadaṃ nimitta- saṃnipātyeva na tu nimittaviśeṣaṇaṃ , ataḥ kathaṃ tasya avivakṣā ? ata āha- ) iha ( ca ) ārtiviśiṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ nimittaṃ , tad ( dravyaṃ ) vyastamapi havirākṛtitaḥ , samastamapi |
tassāt yadyat havirākṛtitaṃ ( dravyaṃ ) tasya- tasya nimittatā śabdena pratipādyate |
yathā ' gauḥ na padā svalpaḥ ' iti yoyo gauḥ , sasa padā na spṛśyate evamihāpi |

' apica ubhayaśabde haviṣā saṃbandhamāne'pi naiva ubhayaviśiṣṭā ārtiḥ pratīyate ' ( ityādi ' tassātto- bhavaviśiṣṭā ārtirnimittaṃ ' ityantaṃ bhāṣyamākṣipati- ) nanu ubhayaśabdo havirviśeṣyati ityanena ( pūrvaṇaiva ) gatārthasya kimarthaṃ punarupanyāsaḥ ? ( ucyate |
( tatra hi ) ārtyā saṃbandhamāno havirviśeṣyati ityuktaṃ ( codya- vādinā ) yathā ' śuklo gaurānīyatāṃ ' iti ( atra ) gāṃ ( ānayatinā ) saṃbandhamānāṃ śuklaḥ |
arthāt ( eka- kammāt ) viśeṣaṇam kṛṣṇatvādinā karoti |
evaṃ dṛṣṭāntadāntikayoḥ ( upādeyoddeśyaviśeṣaṇayoḥ ) tulyatve codite itaraḥ vivekaṃ kathayati ( ' viṣama upanyāsaḥ '
tadarthe saṃkṣiptaṃ darśayati- ) kriyāprādhānye tasyāḥ ( kriyāyāḥ ) vidhīyamānatvāt viśeṣaṇa vibha- kṣitam |
guṇabhūtāyāṃ tu ( kriyāyāṃ ) yat pradhānasya viśeṣaṇaṃ , tat avivakṣitam |
iha tu ( apicetyādinā ) haviṣā pūrve ( eva ) saṃbandhamurarīkṛtya nirākaroti , ( nirā- karaṇamāha- ) ārtinā haviḥ parāmṛśyate , na ( tu ) ubhayaśabdo vidyamāno'pi |
( evaṃ idharmātisaṃbandhatvāt ārtisaṃbandhame nirākṛte sati- ) ' atha ārtyāśrayavibhakti- yogāt ' iti |
( ityādi ' aśvasya śraityaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati ' ityantaṃ bhāṣyaṃ samāhṛtya vyācaṣṭe- ) anena ( bhāṣyeṇa ) ekavibhaktimāntvaṃ ekavākyatvaṃ ca ( ubhayaśabdasya ārtisaṃbandhve pramāṇaṃ- ) upanyasyate |
( ekavibhakti vibhṛṇoti- ) ātaḥ : havirāśrayaḥ , tatra ( itivi ) yā vibhaktiḥ , sā itaratrāpi ( ubhayapade dṛśyate ) |
tassāt yayā vibhaktyā haviścārthegāṃ ( ārtyā ) saṃbadhyate , tathaiva ubhayamapi saṃbadhyate |
( ānantarye vibhṛṇoti- ) yathā ca manasi viparivartamānayā ārtyā haviḥ saṃbadhyate , evamubhayamapi , viparivṛtte- stulyatvāt |
( ekavākyatvaṃ vibhṛṇoti- ) ekavākyagate come api ( ārtyubhayale ) , ānarthakyāt ubhaya- śabdasya ( nahi saṃbhavati ārtisaṃbandhena arthavatve yuktamanarthakyam ) |
yadyevaṃ manyase iti ( pūrvapakṣa- vādyabhiprāyaṃ ) upanyasya pariharati |
( ( tatra prathamacodyaparihārabhāṣyamabhiprāyamāha- ) ekavibhakti- yogāt haviṣā ( eva vākyalakṣaṇaḥ ) saṃbandhaḥ syāt , nātyā |
( ānantarye pariharati , ' bhāryā rājñaḥ puruṣo devadattasya ' ityatra- ) yathā bhāryā saṃbadhyamāno rājā ānantarye'pi na puruṣeṇa saṃbadhyate , nirākāṅkṣatvāt , eva- mubhayapadam |

( ekavākyatāṃ pariharati- ) ' aśvena gacchati śvetena patenāyutaḥ ' ityatra- ) yathā śraityaṃ paṭena saṃbadhyamānaṃ ekavākyatve'pi nāśvaviśeṣaṇaṃ , tena anapekṣitatvāt , evaṃ haviṣaḥ ātmā saṃbandhatvāt ubhaya- padasya na ārtinā saṃbandhaḥ iti |
anena vākyena ( 'yasyobhayaṃ havirātirmācchet' i- tyanena pūrvameva ārti-) saṃbandhivena avadhṛtatvāt |
apīca ubhayaśabdo'pi haviṣā saṃbadhyate, na haviḥ- svarūpeṇa (ārnathyaprasaṅgāt ), kiṃtu yena (rūpeṇa ) ārtiāśrayo haviḥ, (tena rūpeṇa saṃbadhyate ) |
yathā brīhiṣu prokṣaṇaṃ apūrvīyāśena ( saṃbadhyate, na brīhirūpeṇa |
ākṣepepusaṃharati-) evaṃ cet ubhayaviśiṣṭā ārtiḥ iti yuktam |
tatra (prokṣaṇe) prakaraṇāt apūrvīyāśatā śakyā lakṣayituṃ brīhirūpe ārtivat |
iha tu prakaraṇānīyasya (pramāṇāntarasya) abhāvāt aśakyā lakṣaṇā |
pūrvaṃ ārtinā (haviḥ ) saṃbandhaḥ; tataḥ tadanuraktasya (ārtyanuraktasya ) ubhayeneti, evaṃ ca lakṣaṇā bhavet |
evaṃ ca (sati) havipo dvirucāra- ṇāt vākyabhedaḥ |

tataḥ tadanuraktasya ubhaya- saṃbandhāya punaruccāraṇaṃ 'yat ārte haviḥ, tacedubhayaṃ', iti ! mādhyaṃ vyācaṣṭe-) evaṃ (pūrvoktanayena ubhaya- śabdasya) ārtyanurāge nirākṛte 'athocyeta ārti- viśiṣṭena haviṣā ubhayasya saṃbandhaḥ' ityanena (bhāṣya-) granthena (ārtyā-) anuraktena haviṣā saṃbandhaḥ kasmānna bhavatīti |
(ucyate) evaṃ ca (sati) pūrvadoṣadvayaṃ parihṛtaṃ bhavati, (doṣadvayamāha-) na ārtinā (ubhayasya) saṃbandhaḥ, (kiṃtu) śuddhena haviṣā iti |
itaraḥ (tu siddhāntīvādī) āha, 'na ācchet (ityayaṃ śabdaḥ) havirviśeṣaṇatayā upādīyate' iti |
viparīte viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve avaśyaṃ- bhāvitvāt ārternityatvaprasaṅgāt nimittakatvāghātaḥ |
nāyaṃ (ārteḥ) havirviśeṣaṇatvanirākaraṇa- paraḥ (granthaḥ), kiṃ tarhi paramatābhiprāyeṇa |
(tadeva vivṛṇoti-) kathaṃ nu (nāma) ubhayapadena haviḥ saṃbadhyeta ityanena aṃśena viśeṣayati |

( 'āha yathaiva ākhyātātpradhānānye' ityādi- 'ubhayahaviḥśabdau ārtiviśeṣaṇārthamuccāryetāṃ' itya- nasya bhāṣyasyābhiprāyamāha-) tatra (vakṣyamāṇaḥ) vacanavyaktīḥ upanyasan ākhyātāsya guṇapradhānaviveka- māha |
pradhānabhūte (vidheye) ākhyāte viśeṣaṇaṃ vibhaktiṃ, guṇabhūte (vidheye) avivakṣitam |

tenāyaṃ (bhāṣyasya-) arthaḥ, yatra ākhyātātthaḥ svavidhānārthamuccāryate tatra vivakṣitaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ, yatra (tu) paravidhānārthamuccāryate yathā 'dadhnā juhoti' iti dadhi- saṃbandhavidhānārthaṃ homa ucyyate, tatra dvitīyapadasaṃbandho nāsti, vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
evaṃ viveke kathite vacana- vyaktyaḥ upanyasyante |
( 'atha punaruccāraṇaṃ na kriyate' ityādinā bhāṣyeṇa) prathamaṃ haviḥśabdaḥ tantryate (tatra- śabdāt sādhāraṇaparyāyāt 'takaroti tadānadhe' iti ṇini karmaṇi lakāraḥ |
haviḥśabdasya ārtyanubhaya- śabdābhyāṃ tantreṇa saṃbandhaḥ pradarśayate ityarthaḥ :) 'eva- mubhayaśabdo yadi ārtinā saṃbadhyeta na havirviśiṣṭaṃ syāt' ityanena (bhāṣyeṇa) ārtipadaṃ tantryate |
'atha haviḥśabdena saṃbadhyeta' iti (ityādibhāṣyeṇa) ubhaya- miti adhyāhṛtya ubhayaśabdaḥ tantryate |
(sarvatra dūṣaṇa- māha-) ato doṣo vājapeyādhikāraṇoktaḥ (āvṛtti- lakṣaṇaḥ |
śā- ubhayātau pañcaśarāvaḥ iti prāpte, ucyate 'yacchachropakaṃ yāvannimittaṃ paryavasyati |
' ...yathaiva haviḥśabdaḥ ācchet ityanena ākhyātena saṃbadhyate, tathā ubhayapadāmi asamatatvāt tenaiva saṃbadhyate, na haviṣā, nāmapadānāṃ parasparasaṃbandhānāṃ ākhyātena saṃbandhāt |
ubhayapadaṃ tu evaṃ yojyaṃ, na sāyaṃdohātireva nimittaṃ, na prātardohātireva, kiṃtu ubhayamapi parasparanapekṣaṃ nimitta- miti |
soma- ārtipakṣasya puroḍāśadāhakātsyasya nimitta- śarīrāntargatatve, śrutatvāt ubhayatvasya (nimittatvaṃ) kiṃ vaktavyaṃ iti praśnavantatā saṃgatiḥ |
nanu 'yasyobhayaṃ' iti vākyaṃ 'yasya sāyaṃ dugdhaṃ itirātirmācchet' iti prakṛtya āmnāyate |
tatra ca 'yasyobhayaṃ' ityetānmātrameva vivakṣitaṃ, 'havirāti- mācchet' iti prakaraṇaprāmānātvādaḥ |
evaṃ ca prakaraṇa- lamdhye'pi śabdavyāpārābhāvāt vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt ubhaya- havirātiveva pañcaśarāvayāgaḥ |
tena siddhāntā- bhāvāt ayaṃ vicāro'nupapannaḥ (iti cet, satyaṃ) nedaṃ 'yasya sāyaṃ dugdhaṃ' ityannāmnāyate, kiṃtu darśapūrṇa- māsaprakaraṇe sāyaṃprātardauhī āmnāyate idamāmnāyate iti kṛtvā cintyate |
tatra ca havirātirmācchet ityasyāprakṛta- tvāt prakaraṇāt tallābhāsaṃbhavāt noktadoṣaḥ iti |
nanu prahādhikaraṇena (3|1|7) idaṃ punaruktaṃ uddeśya- viśeṣaṇavivakṣāyāstantrokteḥ |

ubhayasya viśeṣaṇatvamaṅgīkṛtya tadvivakṣitamavivakṣitaṃ veti nātra vicāryate, kiṃtu ubhayatvaṃ nimittāntargataṃ na veti ! nimittāntargatatve nimittasvarūpasya vivakṣitatvāt tadanta- rgataṃ ubhayatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ, na ceneti |
nanu- 'helārājīye (vākyapadīyaṭīkāyā 3|1|92) 'ekatvaṃ vā bahutvaṃ vā keṣāṃ cidvivakṣitam |
' iti harigranthavyākhyānāvasare 'tathā sati 'yasyobhayaṃ' itya- trāpi dvitvasya vivakṣāyāṃ anyatarāti naimittikābhāva- prasaṅgaḥ |
ityāśaṅkya tatra dvitvamātraṃ na śrutaṃ, kiṃtu dvaya- yatraḥ samudāyaḥ, 'saṃkhyāyā avayave tvavat' iti saṃkhyā- viśeṣaṇavākyavaghaṭitasamudāyatayapapratyayādeśājanata- tvāt ubhayaśabdasya |

tataścātra ubhayaśabdārthasya ava- yavadvārāyatsamudāyasya ekāyavanāśe'pi nāśāt anyataranāśe'pi naimittikānujñanupapadyate" ityuktātvāt (nedamupalabhyate tatra śloke) ubhayatvavivakṣāyāmapi eka- nāśe'pi pañcaśarāvaḥ syāt |
samudāyābhidhāne'pi haviḥpadāsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vastuto haviḥprādhānyāttu havirdvayanāśe eva prāyaścittaṃ naikāṃśe iti |
tatra ca nārtimātrasya nimittatā sarvadaiva kasya cit ārtisattvena nityatayā nimittalānu- papatteḥ |
ataśca tadeva ubhayatvamapi ubhayapadavaiyārthyāpatteḥ lakṣaṇayā nimittakoṭi- praviśati ubhayahavirātireva nimittam |

iti prāpte, grahaikādhikaraṇanyāyena īpsitoddeśyaviśeṣasya nimitta- rūpoddeśaviśeṣaṇatvāpi vivakṣā''to viśiṣṭalakṣaṇavāśca ekavacanānurodhena ubhayapadānurodhena havirādipadeṣu karaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt ubhayapadasya ca ubhayamapi ityevaṃ tathā'pi upapatteḥ ubhayatvasya nimittakoṭipraviṣṭatvā- bhāvāt ekaikahavirnāśe'pi prāyaścittam |
vastutastu pakṣadvaye'pi na havirādipade lakṣaṇā, sarveṣāṃ padārthānāṃ ākhyātānvayottaraṃ paścāt parasparānvayopapatteḥ |
evaṃ ca viśiṣṭasya nimittatvānadaro nimittatā'vacchedakagauravamiyā anyataravivakṣayā'pi |
nimittaśrutyupapatteranyatarapadasya va ādhānavākyagata- puṃstvasya anuvādatvenāpi upapatteśceti draṣṭavyaḥ |
' ārtivākye ( yasyobhayaṃ havirśātimācait ) tātparyagrāhakasya amāvāt vākyabhedaparijihīrṣayā karmā- ntaravidhiraiva nyāyyaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 114-115. ārthīkaraṇe ( ārtinyāye ) ubhayapadasya avivakṣā |
vākyārtha. pṛ. 20. yatsaṃbaṃdhāt prāk nimittameva nopajāyate, bhavati tat nimittasyāpi viśeṣaṇam |
yathā ārtyadhikaraṇe vakṣyate 'mṛdhāmadhe haviṣā viśeṣaṇaṃ', iti |
' iti uttarottarotkṛṣṭaśālīnagṛhasthacatuṣṭayānu- krameṇa adhyayanajīvaninaḥ caturthaślokoktyā ārtijyādyā- panakarmadvayajīvaninaḥ apakṛlapsūcanena ārtijanyanindā kṛtā |
vi. 12|4|15. ārthivyaṃ yaja- mānāḥ eva syuḥ satre, nānye |
anyatarakoṭivyavasthā koṭya- ntarasya ārthikī vyavasthā bhavati |

tatrādyā yathā 'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇo devatā, sa saumeyeṇa amīṣomīyo bhavati' iti amīṣomīyapuroḍāśe kṛtalomayāgapuṃviṣayatvena vyavasthāpite, arthāt tadabhāvaḥ akūtalomayāgapuṃviṣaya- tvena vyavasthito bhavati |
'pūrvamepuramāvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti' ityamāvāsyāyāṃ pūrvaidhavedikaraṇe vyavasthāpite, arthāt havirabhivāsanottaraṃ vedikaraṇaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vyavasthitaṃ bhavati |
tadidamudāharaṇadvayaṃ pañcame siddhaṃ 'tathā'pūrve' ( 5|1|16|29 ) ityatra pūrvai, 'utkarṣārda brāhmaṇasya' ( 5|1|4|17-14 ) ityatro- ttaram |
bāla. pṛ. 19-20. ārthī parisaṃkhyā dvividhā, prāptaparisaṃkhyā aprāptaparisaṃkhyā ceti |
tatra prāptaparisaṃkhyā tridoṣā aprāptaparisaṃkhyā ca taddhīnā |
sā ca phalataḥ pari- saṃkhyaiti gīyate |
bhāṣyakārāntarmate tu siddhānte'pi ka viddhī- kṛtā, yathā daśame ( 10|5|13|13-14 ) agni- rasāṃ dvirātre śrutaṃ 'vaikhānasaṃ pūrvai'han sāma bhavati ṣoḍa- śyuttare' iti |

tatra dvirātrottamānāṃ atirātrasaṃstha- tvāt prakṛtyatirātraḥ ṣoḍaśavikalpe prāpte, 'uttare- 'han dvirātrasya gṛhyate' iti vākyāntareṇa anāranyā- dhītena niyataḥ ṣoḍaśī iti 'uttare' ityanena agni- rasāṃ dvirātre eva parisaṃkhyāyate |
yadyapi 'na vā parisaṃkhyānāt' ( 3|7|6|33 ) iti sūtrakṛtā tatra parisaṃkhyātyevoktaṃ, bhāṣyakṛtā ca tathaiva vyākhyātaṃ, tathāpi vārtikakṛtā adhikaraṇānte saptadaśa- śruteḥ upasaṃhārārthatvaivoktā |
tasmāt prāptaparisaṃkhyāudāharaṇaṃ smārtameva 'pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ' iti |
nanu keyaṃ ārthī bhāvanā ? kartavyavyāpāra iti cenna, yāgāderapi tadvyāpāratvena bhāvanātvāpatteḥ |
satyaṃ na yāgo bhāvanā, kiṃtu svargaicchājanito yāgaviṣayo yaḥ prayatnaḥ, sa bhāvanā |

yaśca prayatnapūrvakaṃ gamanādi karoti, tasmin 'devadatto gamanaṃ karoti' iti karotiprayogadarśanāt, vātādinā spanda- māne tu 'nāyaṃ karoti, kiṃtu vātādinā asya spando jāyate' iti prayogāt karotyarthastāvat prayatnaḥ |
karoti- sāmānyādhikaraṇyaṃ ca ākhyāte dṛśyate 'yajeta- yāgena kuryāt' 'pacati- pākaṃ karoti' 'gacchati- gamanaṃ karoti' iti |
na ca 'ratho gacchati' iti prayogānupapattiḥ, rathe yatnābhāvāditi vācyam |
yanmate- 'pi anyopādānānukūlaṃ vyāpārasāmānyaṃ bhāvanā, tanmate- 'pi gamanātiriktavyāpārānāpatteḥ 'ratho gacchati' iti prayogasya aupacārikatvameveti |
yathā āhuḥ 'prayatnavyatiriktā''rthī bhāvanā tu na śakyate |
( miśramatamāha— ) anye tadāhuḥ : 'bhaviturbhvanā- nukūle bhāvakavyāpārastat bhāvanā |
yasmin vyāpāre kṛte karaṇaṃ phalotpādanāya samarthe bhavati, tādṛśo vyāpāra iti yāvat |
'kuṭhāreṇa chinatti' ityākhyātāśravaṇe hi bhavatyetādṛśī matiḥ : 'kuṭhāreṇa tathā vyāpyate, yasmin vyāpāre kṛte kuṭhārāt chedanaṃ bhavati' iti |
evaṃ 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' ityasyāyamarthaḥ : 'yāgena tathā vyāpyeta, yasmin vyāpāre kṛte yāgāt svargo bhavati' iti |
sa ca vyāpāraḥ kaḥ kuta udyamana- nipātanādiḥ, ka vicca agnyanvādhānādiḥ |
brāhmaṇatarpa- ṇāntaḥ kāryabhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa paścādavagamyate, anyopādānānukūlatvena sāmānyatastvākhyātadeva |
'ratho grāmaṃ gacchati' ityatrākhyātena grāmaprāptyanukūle vyāpāra eva pratīyate, 'rathasthā gamanena vyāpyate, yasmin vyāpāre kṛte gamanāt grāmaprāptirbhavati' iti pratīteḥ |
na tvatra gamanamātramākhyātārthaḥ, tasya dhātunā uktatvāt |

tatra 'ko'sau vyāpāraḥ ?' ityapekṣāyāṃ pūrvo- sarāvāntaradeśavibhajanasaṃyojanarūpaḥ iti paścādavagamyate, 'pūrveṇa pradeśena vibhajya, uttareṇa saṃyujya ratho grāmaṃ gacchati' iti prayogāt, 'ubhayatha nipāta kuṭhāreṇa chinatti' iti |

( cetanakartṛkakriyāvāciṣapi yatte ityādiṣu paramatye eva lakṣaṇaprasaktiḥ, nāsannamate ityāha-) evaṃ 'devadattaḥ prayatnate' ityatrāpi 'devadattastathā vyāpriyate, yathā prayatnau bhavati' iti prayatnānukūle vyāpāra evākhyātāyārthaḥ, na tu prayatnaḥ, tasya dhātunā uktatvāt |
vyāpāraviśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ ca icchā''diḥ paścāda- vagamyate ubhayamananipātanatvāt |
tathā ca sarvatra anugata- tvāt anyopādānānukūlavyāpārasāmānyameva ākhyātārthaḥ, na tu prayatnamātraṃ, 'ratho gacchati' 'devadattaḥ prayatnate' ityādiṣu tadabhāvāt |
( upāditā hi avayavabhedena prayojyaprayojaka- bheda maṅgīkṛtya bhāvanāpratītiḥ : vārtikakṛdbhiḥ bhāvārthā- dhikaraṇe |
vastutastu yathaiva 'bhavati' ityatra bhāvanāpratītyupapādanaṃ vārtikakāraiḥ atiśayārthaṃ, tathaiva ihāpi 'ratho gacchati' ityādiṣu tadupapādanamatiśayārtha- meva |
nahi 'ratho gamanaṃ karoti' 'puruṣo yatnaṃ karoti' 'ghaṭo bhavanaṃ karoti' iti kasyāpi anu- bhavo'sti |
ataḥ : anyopādānānukūlajñānādareṇa vyāpārasāmānyameva sarvatra ākhyātārthaḥ ityetha granthatātparyam |
indodāharaṇeṣu yathāsthito gamanavyāpāraḥ, puruṣāśrito yatnavyāpāraḥ, ghaṭāśrito bhavanavyāpāraḥ, iti vinaiva lakṣaṇaṃ bodhopapattiḥ |
) na cātra aupacārikatvaṃ vaktuṃ yuktaṃ, mukhye saṃbhavati tasyānyāyatatvāt |
karotyartho'pi anyopādānānukūle vyāpāra eva, na prayatnamātram |
( vyāpāratvaṃ śakyatā'va- cchedakaṃ, na yatnatvaṃ ityetāvati tātparyam |
anyo- pādānānukūlatvasya tu śakyatā'vacchedakatvaṃ tatra pratītiḥ, ākṣepādā ityanyadetat ) karotiśca cetanācetanakartṛkā- khyātāmānādhikaraṇyāditi |
tattu siddhaṃ anyopādānā- nukūle vyāpāra arthī bhāvanā iti |
saiva ca yajeta ityatra ākhyātāṃśenocyate 'bhāvayet' iti |
tasyāśca bhāvyā- kāṅkṣāyāṃ svargādiḥ bhāvyatvena saṃbadhyate |
ārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte gāyatre tuce evāgantūnāṃ sāmnāmāvāpaḥ |
ārṣeyapavamāne jyotiṣṭomagate kāvākhyaṃ sāma balyā- mupamanm |
soma. 10|1|15. ārṣeyapavamāna- mādhyandinapavamānayoriva vidvāvidṣṭomakkapyupa gāyatrīvṛhatyanuṣṭup sāmnāmāvāpo'pā |
svādiṣṭhyā' ityekaṃ sūktaṃ, tasmin gāyatryaḥ tisra ṛcaḥ |
tāsu gāyatrī saṃhitaṃ ceti dve sāmanī |
'puro- jitī vo andhasaḥ' iti sūktāntaraṃ, tatra ekā anuṣṭup uttare dve gāyatryau |
tāsu śyāvāśvaṃ ānvīghavaṃ neti dve sāmanī |
'indramaccha sutā ime' ityaparaṃ sūktaṃ, tasmin uṣṇihastilaḥ |
syādasti, syānnāsti, syādasti ca nāsti ca, syādavaktavyaḥ, syādasti cāvaktavyaḥ, syānnāsti cāvaktavyaḥ, iti saptabhaṅgīnayādī ārhata: syādvādī |
svacchandasya ākhyātapratirūpakāvyasya kathaṃcicchabdārthavācitvābhyupagamāt anekāntavādī vadvānāṃ saṃsāriṇāmātmanāṃ śarīrādatyantavyatirekābhāvena tanmiśratvāt mūrtatvaṃ vadati |
su. pṛ. 616. ārhatapakṣeṇa śarīraparimita ātmā abhyupagamyate |
vā. 2|1|2|15 pṛ. 402. ālabhati: asyāmi: prāṇiṃsaṃyukte yajimadamidhāno dṛṣṭa: |
dravyadevatāsaṃbandhānyathā'nupapattyā pūrvamassāmi: yaji: kalpita: (ālabhate: yāgārthatvaṃ svīkṛtam) nāhaṣṭapūrvaśaktyā ālabhyamidhānena yabhicāryanumānābhāsena vā |
vā. 2|3|16|16. 'ālabhati: yatra prāṇiṃsaṃyukta: tatra yāgānumānam' iti vyāpti: |
su. pṛ. 123, ālabhate: sparśavācino'pi prāṇiṃsaṃyuktasya yāgavācitvakalpanā na viruddhā |
pṛ. 123. ālabhaticodanā apūrvakarmaṇo vidhāyikā, na tu avyaticoditānāṃ karmaṇāṃ samudāyasyānuvāda: |
agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta ' hṛdayasyāgre'vadyati atha jihvāyā atha vakṣasa: ' |
agnihotre doṣādhikāre 'vatsamālabheta' sparśamātravidhirayaṃ, na yāga- vidhi: |
2|3|15. ālabhambhasya-paśvālambhasya śaklasaṃpmedho lohitanirasanaṃ ca na prayojakaṃ, kiṃtu pratipatti: |
yāgavyastauryorvākye yāgavidhi:, na tu guṇavidhi: dravyadevatāsaṃyogāt |
tatrāyamartha: saṃśayika: kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsike ālabhame ālabhame guṇavidhi:, darśapūrṇamāsike ca nirvāpe nirvāpo guṇavidhi:, uta na prakṛtimepyate yāvadukte, uta yajimatī ete karmaṇī iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? prākṛtayo: ālabhanirvāpayo: guṇavidhī iti |
nanu ālabheta, nirvapet iti ca, naitau vidhātārau |
na caitayoridito'rthau, ālabhame: kartavya:; nirvāpa: kartavya: |
kimarthamanuvādatau ? ālabhame śvetaṃ vidhātuṃ, nirvāpe ca carum |
vā- na kasya cidapi karmaṇa: prakaraṇe śrūyate 'śvetamālameta' 'caruṃ nirvapet' iti |
tatra saṃdeha: kiṃ anāramyādhīnāṃ prakṛtyarthatvāt prākṛtayoreva ālabha-nirvāpayo: śvetacaru guṇau vidhīyete, kivā karmāntare yāvacchrute, uta yajimatī iti |
kathaṃ ? yadi tāvat ālabhanirvāpau prakṛtya śrūyetātāṃ, tata: prakṛtapratyayānuvṛttireva prasajyeta iti karmāntarāśaṅkā na syāt |
anāramyavāde tu sati, śvetādiguṇasya upādeyatvāt kadā cit durasthānuvādena guṇo vidhīyate, kadā cidvā viparītyabhavāt karmāntaraṃ iti jāyate saṃdeha: |
tathā 'dravyasaṃyogāccodanā paśutono: ' ( 2|3|16|17 ) ityanena gataprāyamiva atra yajimatkarmavidhānaṃ lakṣyate |
tat prakṛtayāgābhāvāt anuvādādaśyāmāsayāṃ śvetādeśa guṇasya autpattika-dravyasaṃyukte'pi karmaṇi vidhānopapatte: kathaṃ syāt iti punarapyanyate |
pūrvapakṣaśca anyorālabhanirvāpayo: aprakaraṇāt avayava prākṛtaeva grahītavyo ityevaṃ pravartate |
tannirākaraṇamapi ca prakaraṇābhāvāt asādhāraṇalakṣaṇatvābhāvācca na prākṛtayo: laukikavyāvṛttarūpayo: pratītirasti ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? yathaiva ayaneṣu guṇasaṃbandhapare vākye karmavidhiśabdābhāvāt akarmāntaratvaṃ, tathā ihāpi bhaviṣyati iti ca-śabdena annādiśyate |
na cāsau guṇavidhi: iti viṣayāvacāraṇārthye prakaraṇagrahaṇam |
athavā yadyapi etāvatā pūrvapakṣalakṣaṇe prakaraṇe śrūyate, tathāpi karmaṇi vidhiṣabdānavarodhāt guṇārthaiva puna:śrutiriti |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: (yā) śakteṣā, sā śvetaukṛtya ālabhadhyā ( sraṣṭavyā ) |
nirvāpaśrca caru kartavya:; caruparimito ( odanasthālīparimito ) vā |
tathā vāyavyaṃ iti sarvavanaspatau vāyavyatā (ka) tvāt kathaṃcit īṣāyā evāgvāda: |
kiṃ tarhi ? ālabhamāntaraṃ vidhīyate iti, nirvāpāntaraṃ na |
yadi ālabhanirvāpau vidhīyete, tato na prākṛtau tau vihitau |
yadi na vidhīyete, tata: prākṛtau lakṣyete 'yo ālabhanirvāpau kartavyau' iti |
tatastau lakṣayitvā śvetau vidhātavyau bhavata: caruśca |
tau ca bhūtikāmāsya brahmavarcasakāmasya ca iti dvāvapi arthau vidheyau syātāṃ, tatra vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
athavā yo'sau vidhāyaka: śabda: sa lakṣayitavyopayukta:; iti vidhāyābhāvāt eko'pyanyau na śakyate vidhātum |
atha sa eva labdhavyati, tenaiva ca vidhāpyate guṇa: iti, na mitho vidhānalakṣaṇa-saṃvanavo'kalpate |
atha dhātvartho'nuvāda:; pratyayo vidhātumiṣyate ityucyate 'ya ālabhambha: sa etadguṇa: kartavya: ' iti, tathāpi na prākṛtau lakṣyeta |
pratyayārthe anyamāne prākṛto'nūdyate iti, sa hi kartavyo niniṣṭho na laukika: |
ato na prākṛtānuvādo ghaṭate, iti yāvaduktaṃ ālabhambhamātraṃ nirvāpamātraṃ ca apūrva kartavyam |
' śrutirmūlaṃ hi karma ityuktaṃ 'codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharma: ' iti ( 1|1|2 ) |
vā-- ' yadi ālabhanirvāpau vidheyatvaṃ na mṛṣyata: |
tato guṇavidhiśca syāt vidheyau tvatra tau matau |
' vāyavyapadaṃ pūrvadeva upekṣya phalapadaparigraheṇa tāvat pratyayaśrūyate |
yadi hi ālabhanirvāpau anya śvetatvaṃ vidhīyete, tata: phalapadaṃ anarthakameva syāt |
atha guṇaphalasaṃbandho vidhīyate, tathāpi ālabhyāde: prakṛtasya ādhyasyāmātvāt vākyenaiva tatsaṃbandhakaraṇe vākyaṃ midhyeta |
na ca tena vinā iha kiṃcit na sidhyati |
nahi yadekatra guṇabhūtaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, tena anyatra prādhānyaṃ vācanikamapi na pratipattavyaṃ iti kiṃcit pramāṇam |
vāyavyādiśabdaścātra sarvatra dravyāṇāṃ yathā- kathaṃcit devatāsaṃnnidhopapatteḥ anuvādaḥ |
athavā yat kena cit vāyavyaiḥ saṃkalpitaṃ, tat ālambhadibhi- ryojyamānaṃ abhyudayakāri bhavati |
athavā vāyusyācaiva uddiśya spaṣṭaṃ nisaṃ vā ityetātvātirmeci- vyati |
na cāvaśyaṃ yāge eva devatā uddeśyā |
yatrayatra hi cocyate, tatratatra uddiśyamānā na virudhyate |
tasmāt yatkiṃcit śvetaṃ vāyavyeṇa spaṣṭamyaṃ iti yāvadukta- codanā'nusārāt (avasīyate) |
guṇavipakṣe phalapada- saṃbandhe vākyabhedamidhāya idānīṃ tatparityāgaṃ abhyu- petyāpi bravīti (bhāṣyakāraḥ) |
tasyābhiprāyaḥ, yadidaṃ anāramyavādānāṃ prakṛtyarthatvamabhidhatte (3|6|1|1-8) naitat vācanikam |
gavāmayane pratimāsaṃ catvāro'gniplvāḥ ṣaḍahāḥ, ekaśca pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ ityanuṣṭhānam |
'saṃsthite pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe madhyamāsye dhṛtaṃ vā' ityanena ca ṣaḍahānte madhya- śānamukttam |
prathamamāse pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍehe anuṣṭhite dvitīya- māsasyādau abhilavāścatvāro'nuṣṭhīyante |
tathā ca pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍahānāṃ abhilavaiḥ vyavāye vyavadhāne sati kālasya bhedaḥ spaṣṭaḥ |
evaṃ vyavāye sati kālabhedāt pratipṛṣṭhyaṣaḍahānte madhya- śanasyāpi āvṛttiḥ syāt, na tu sarvaṣaḍahānte sakṛdeva |
āśālaste'yaṃ yajamānaḥ iti nityaṃ nirdeśaḥ, yajña nirdiṣṭe iti nityānuvādaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsādiṣu karaṇatvābhāve'pi teṣāmāśrayatvamupa- padyate iti dhyeyam |
bhā. 3|6|16|41-47, āśraye ca pravartamāne tadāśritamapi pravartate yathā paṭe ākṛṣyamāṇe tadāśritaṃ citramapyākṛṣyate |
āśrayasya daurbalye āśritaṃ durbalatarameva bhavati iti nyāyārtha: |
‘pītvadhikaraṇa- ( vā. 1|3|4|9 pṛ. 218,19 ) ṇyutvādidambhecchaprasiddhitamaccharūpadādaurbalyanyāya: śiṣṭākopādhikaraṇa- ( 1|3|13|5-7 ) parāhata'pi punarajjīvito bhavati |
ḍupū- ( ekadeśena anyadīyaṃ dravyaṃ devatāṃ ubhayaṃ vā āśrayanti saṃskurvanti ye padārthāḥ, te āśrayaṇaḥ |
tatra udāharaṇakṣepādyajena pūrvapakṣamāha- ) anudāharaṇaṃ sviṣkṛt ( kevaladṛṣṭārthatvena adṛṣṭārthatvāyogāt |
tadāha- ) mantraḥ tāvat ( ayāḻabhiḥ ityādiḥ ) iṣṭa- devatāṃkīrtanāt dṛṣṭārthaḥ |
( yāgo'pi dṛṣṭārtha eve- tyāha- ) ākīrṇakarasya dravyasya ( iṣṭaśiṣṭasya puroḍā- śādeḥ ) aniyamena pratipādane prāpte yāgena prati- pādyate |
( tena ) yo'sau ( āhavanīye dravya- ) prakṣepaḥ, so'pi dṛṣṭārthaḥ eva |
ato yāgena dravyasya saṃskriyamāṇatvāt na itareḥ ( samidādibhiḥ ) tulyatā |
samidādyo'pi nodāharaṇaṃ, teṣu dravyadevatāsa guṇabhūtatvāt kriyaiva pradhānabhūtā ( iyudāharaṇam |
( paśu- yāga eva hi vapāyā hṛdayādibhiśca vitataḥ, sa ca nāśrayī |
samāpyate- ) yatra akṛtāthai dravyaṃ, devatā tu iṣṭā yakṣyamāṇā vā kīrtyate yāgāntaraṃ ca, tadudāharaṇam |
paśupuroḍāśasya devatoddeśena yaḥ prakṣepaḥ, tasya adṛṣṭādṛṣṭe nānyat prayojanamasti |
ata āha ( sūtrakāraḥ ) āśrayiṣvaviśeṣeṇa bhāvo'rthaḥ pratīyate |
‘ bhūtaṃ bhavyāyopadiśyate ’ iti ( bhāṣyaṃ ) bhūtaṃ dravyaṃ bhavyāṃ kriyāṃ nirvartayati iti kriyātaḥ adṛṣṭam |
athavā yadyapi yāgo devatāṃ saṃskurvan upakaroti, tathāpi sādhanatāṃ pratipadyamānaḥ āśrayo bhavati, nānyathā |
bhāṣya- asyāṃ tu codanāyāṃ anārambhaḥ apūrvasya |
asmin hi yāge kriyamāṇe devatā smaryate, sviṣkṛtyapi dravyaṃ pratipādyate |
ḍupū- yatra dravyadevate guṇabhūte āśrayātasya ( yathā samidādiṣu ), tatrāpūrvam |
yatra punadravyaṃ devatā vā pradhānaṃ ( sviṣkṛtpaśupuroḍāśādiṣu ), tatra tadarthatvāt āśrayātāthaisya nāpūrvam |
syādvā dravyacikīrṣāyāṃ bhāvo'rthe ca guṇabhūtatā- ''śrayāddhi guṇībhāvaḥ |
satyāmapi devatā- cikīrṣāyāṃ, tasmin devatāsaṃskārārthe guṇabhūtatā, yāgasya dravyapratipādanena ca |
tasmin mantreṇa hyadṛṣṭe kriyamāṇe tyāgaḥ aparaḥ adṛṣṭārthaḥ śrūyate |
tasya na kiṃcit dṛṣṭamasti devatā- ''śrayāttu devatāgataṃ tata apūrve iti gamyate |
ḍupū- ( svitkṛtvā iti siddhāntasūtrasyābhiprāyamāha- ) yadevatāsaṃkīrtanaṃ mantreṇa, tatra dṛṣṭārthāya, smaraṇasyāpekṣita- tvāt |
śā- uttamaḥ prayājaḥ paśupuroḍāśaḥ sviṣkṛt ityādayaḥ anyona parakīya dravyadevataṃ saṃskurvantaḥ kiṃ tadarthā eva, utāpūrvāthā apīti cintyate |
dṛṣṭe ca sati nādṛṣṭaṃ kalpyaṃ, nāpūrvamastyataḥ |
tyāgāṃśasya tu nādṛṣṭādṛṣṭe kiṃ cit prayojanam |
soma- yathā dravyapariccheda rūpadṛṣṭadvārā liṅga- saṃkhyayoḥ sādhanatvaṃ, evaṃ uttamaprayājādīnāmapi iti pratyakṣatvāt dṛṣṭāntasaṃgatiḥ |

yadyapi prakṣepo devato- ddeśavat yāgaśabdārthāntargatatvābhāvāt na yāgāṃśaḥ, tathāpi prakṣeptasya devatoddeśena tyajyamānānāṃ kartavyatvāt so'pi yāgāṃśa iva pratīyate ityetāvatā prakṣepāt dravyasaṃskṛtiḥ |
nanu svāhākārasya kevaladṛṣṭā- rthatve avāntarapūrvābhāvena aṅgapūrvaprayuktākramamātra- siddheḥ tatpūrvasyadravyotpādanasya abhikramaṇādilakṣaṇaṃ prayojanam |

dārśapūrṇamāsikadharmātideśābhāvāt tadatideśalakṣaṇaṃ ca prayojanaṃ saṃbhavati, sviṣkṛti tadupapādanasya tu na kiṃ cit prayojanaṃ, yathā pūrvapakṣe pratipattisvāt tadarthāvadānanāśe lopaḥ, tathā siddhānte'pi ekadeśadravyatvena dravyaprayojaka- tvābhāvāt lopāviśeṣaḥ |

uttarā- rdhādidravyayojanakatvābhāve'pi adṛṣṭārthatve sati adṛṣṭasya saṃpādanārthe ‘ yasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi naśyeyurdubhayepuraharervā ājyena tā devatāḥ pratisaṃkhyāya yajeta ’ iti havirnāśe vihitenājyena sviṣkṛt kartavyaḥ ityasti prayojanam |
sūtrārthastu- ye aṃśena pratīyamānaṃ dravyadevataṃ saṃskārakatvena āśrayante te āśrayaṇaḥ; teṣu bhāvyante iti bhāvaḥ arthaḥ |
apūrve pratīyate, anyairyajatijuhotītyādibhiḥ : apūrvārtheḥ aviśeṣeṇa iti |
bhaṭṭa- yajati juhotīti yā yatra śrutaṃ, tatra yaje- stāvat devatoddeśaviśiṣṭadravyayāgātvāt tyāgāṃśasya adṛṣṭavidhayā ārādupakārakatvaṃ, uddeśāṃśasya tu dṛṣṭavidhayā tadupakārakatvameva |
juhotisve tu tadaṅgameva adṛṣṭa- vidhayā itarau, samapradhānāva vā prakṣepeṇa saha |
ata evo- bhayatra mantraḥ tadaṅgabhūtadevatāprakāśanāthai eveti sthitiḥ |

yatra tu svāhākārasviṣkṛtsvavākyapaśupuroḍāśādi- homavājinejyādī pratyakīṃ dravyaṃ devatā vā prakṣepān- śenoddeśena mantreṇa vā saṃkriyate, yathā svāhākāra- sviṣkṛtpaśupuroḍāśādī āgneyādidevatāḥ mantradevato- ddeśābhyāṃ, sviṣkṛti prakṣepona tadīyaṃ dravyaṃ, piṣṭa- lepahomādau prakṣepeṇa tadīyaṃ dravyameva |
sarvatra pramāṇaṃ tatra- tatroktaṃ, vakṣyate ca |
yastu tatra tyāgāṃśaḥ, saḥ adṛṣṭārtha eva |
na ca tasya padārthaikadeśatvāt niṣprayojanatve'pi na kṣatiḥ, vihitapadārthatvānnā''nupapattyā tadavayavānāṃmapi arthādihitatvena prayojanākāṅkṣopapatteḥ |
ataḥ so'pya- dṛṣṭārtha eva san phalavat prakṣepādyaṅgaṃ tatsaṃskāradravyakrameṇa veti tatsaṃskāradravyadevatādāveva prokṣaṇādivadadṛṣṭaṃ janaya- tīti saṃlipatyopakārakaḥ tattvayuktaśca |
iti prāpte, viśeṣa- tayā pratīyatasya tyāgāṃśasya prakṣepādyaṅgatve pramāṇābhāvāt devatādeśa dṛṣṭamātrāpekṣatvena adṛṣṭopakārānapekṣatvāt praka- raṇāt tyāgāṃśasya ārādupakārakatvameva prayājādivat |
tatra tu etāvān viśeṣaḥ, yat paraprayuktadravyadevatopajīvitvena na paraprayuktabhāve svātantryeṇa tattvadravyadevatā''kṣepa- kathyam |
ata eva ekakapālasya sarvahome sviṣkṛdyāgasya lopa eva, stopakāradravyasya nāśāditi nimittābhāvena ājyenāpi samāpanāyogāt |
cayanādau ayāge vācanika- prayājādiviniyoge'pi ca na svāhākārayāgaḥ |
prakṛtau tu dravyanāśe ‘ yasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi naśyeyurdubhayepuraharervā ājyenaitā devatāḥ parisaṃkhyāya yajeta ’ iti vacanāt ājyena samāpanam |
saṃlipatyopakārakatve tu saṃskāryā- bhāvāt iḍāvat lopa eveti viśeṣaḥ |
10. ‘ āśrāvaya, astu śrauṣaṭ, yaja, ye yajāmahe, vauṣaṭ ’ iti saptadaśākṣaraḥ prajāpatiḥ : yāgīyapadārthasmaraṇa- rūpadṛṣṭārtha eva |
atra ‘ brahmavaivāsyācamava- rundhe ’ iti phalaśrutirvādāḥ, na phalavidhāyikā |
dīrghalakṣaṇa- patrāṇāṃ kāśānāṃ aśvakeśaiḥ sādṛśyāt āśvavālaśabdasya kāśeṣu gauṇatvam |
soma. 13|5 pṛ. 36. āśvavālaśabdaḥ: aśvapucchakeśasadṛśatvāte avayava- vyutpattyā loke prayujyate |
( ātithyeṣau ) ityadhikṛtya ' yaṣo vai devebhyo'tho bhūtvā'pākrāmat, so'paḥ prāviśat, sa vāladhau gṛhīta:, sa vālān muktvā viveśa, te vālāḥ kāśā abhavan' iti vākyaśeṣaśravaṇāt kāśaparatā pratīyate |
somanāthayāṃ tu ' yaṣo vai devebhyo 0 viveśa ha te vālāḥ keśatāṃ prāptāḥ kāryotaḥ prastarastu taiḥ ' iti vākyaśeṣaḥ paṭhitaḥ |
paraṃtu mudrakaiḥ ' kāryotaḥ prastarastu taiḥ ' iti vākyaṃ laghubhirakṣarairmudritaṃ, pūrve tu sarvaṃ sthūle- rakṣaraiḥ ' iti viśeṣaḥ |
kaustubhe tu 1|3|4|9 pṛ. 72 ityatra ' yaṣo ha vai devebhyo 0 viveśa, te vālāḥ kāśatāṃ prāptāḥ ' iti iyan īdṛśaḥ vākyaśeṣaḥ paṭhitaḥ |
vā. 1|3|4|9 pṛ. 229-224. āśvalādhikaraṇanyāyena ( vā. 1|3|4|9 pṛ. 229-224 ) satyāmipi katipayanāṃ asaṃkhyatānāṃ asaṃskṛtajātiviśeṣamātraviṣayatvasiddhiḥ |

atra lokataḥ : ' āśvalāḥ prastaraḥ ' ityatra aśvasya ye vālāḥ dīrghakeśāḥ tanmayaḥ prastaraḥ iti jñāte'pi śāstrataḥ āśvalāḥ nāma kāśatvadabhoṃḥ tanmayaḥ prastaraḥ kartavyaḥ iti sidhyati ityadhikaraṇārthaḥ |
āśvinaḥ grahaḥ : jyotiṣṭome aindravāyavādi- graheṣu tṛtīyasthāne paṭhitaḥ |
tasya ca daśamasthānatvaṃ vākyenaiva śabdenāmyate ' āśvino daśamo gṛhyate ' iti |
vi. 5|4|1, āśvinaḥ grahaḥ jyotiṣṭome prātaḥ savane gṛhyate |
' āśvino daśamo gṛhyate, taṃ tṛtīyaṃ juhoti ' |
śā. 2|16, yadyapi āśvinaḥ pañcamo hūyate tathāpi upāṃśu-antaryāmayoḥ avaṣaṭkārahomatvāt vaṣaṭkārahomeṣu āśvinahomasya tṛtīyatvaṃ bodhyam |
āśvino dhūḥ : ( dhūmravarṇaḥ ajaḥ paśuḥ ) sautrāmaṇyāṃ prathamaḥ |
bhā. 3|5|1|14. ' āśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ ' iti āśvinaḥ puroḍāśaḥ dvikapāla uktaḥ |
bhā. 5|1|2|1. āśvinasya somagrahasya ' sarvataḥ parihāramāśvinaṃ bhakṣayati ' iti viśeṣa uktaḥ |
svamastakasya paritaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ grāmayitvā bhakṣaṇīyaḥ iti |
bhā. 3|5|6|20. āśvine dvikapāle haviṣkṛtaṃ savanīyaparvatayā prasaṅgasiddhā bhedena nāhātavyā |
śā. 1|2|4. āśvine śakhe atirātre śasyamāne sūrye anudyati sarve mantrāḥ śaṃsanīyavenopadiṣṭāḥ |
āśvinagrahādūrdhvaṃ savanīyaḥ paśurālabhyate jyoti- ṣṭome suryādite prātaḥ savane |
vi. 5|1|6, āśvina- grahādūrdhvaṃ savanīyapaśusthāne sādyaske yāge sāhityen paśu- trayālabham : kartavyaḥ |
tatrādau snānakrameṇa savanīyaḥ; tataḥ prakṛtiṣaṭparvāparyāta āmīpomīyasya anuvandhyaśceti |
āśvinagrahasya kāmasaṃyoge jyotiṣṭome āditaḥ pratikarṣaḥ syāt |
sa ca pratikarṣaḥ antaryāmādūrdhvaṃ aindravāyavāt prāk |

bhā. 10|5|19-22| 67-73. āśvinagrahagrahagottaraṃ codakaprāptaṃ yūpapari- vyāṇaṃ kṛtvā punarvihitaṃ raśanāntareṇa parivyāṇāntaraṃ kṛtvā āgneyaḥ savanīyaḥ paśupākartavyaḥ, iti ' āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśupākaroti ' iti vacanenoktam |
vi. 4|6|9. āśvinadvikapālasya dvidaivatvāt sati vyakṣarataditatvatvāt aindrāmavikṛtitvam |
bāla. pṛ. 120. āśvinapātre dhānā nidadhāti jyotiṣṭome |
savanīyapuroḍāśeṣu vidyamānānāṃ eva ayaṃ ekadeśasaṃyogaḥ, na tu anyataḥ |
3|5|1|14. ' āśvināgrān gṛhṇīyādāmāyinaḥ, śukrāgrān gṛhṇīyādabhivacarataḥ, mandyagrān gṛhṇīyādabhivacaramāṇasya '
iti vacanāt āśvinādīnāṃ sarvāditaḥ ( aindravāyavāt prāk ) pratikarṣaḥ kartavyaḥ |

nyāyāmṛtadvaitasiddhi bhūmikā. pṛ. 3. āsattistu avyavadhānena anvayapratiyogyupa- sthitiḥ |

atītakartṛkaprācīnagranthaviva- raṇapare granthe 'iti manasi nidhāya' - 'ityabhi- pretyāha' - 'ityādyuktvā'ha' ityādī kannāpratyayopapattiḥ |
tatra hi 'āha' ityavyayaṃ uvāca ityarthe vimaktiprati- rūpakaṃ iti vaiyākaraṇasamayaḥ |
parivāsanaṃ samūlamāha- raṇaṃ chedanaṃ ca sarvaṃ aṅgāyārthaṃ, na mūlārtham |

bhā. 2|6|828-29. āhavanīyaḥ anārabhyavādena sarvahomāryaḥ iti taddhitakarmāntabhāvāt āhitāgneḥ adhikāraḥ |
vā. 3|2|16|139. āhavanīyaḥ gārhapatyadeva ādheyaḥ, na tu laukikāt |

vi. 3|8|14. āhavanīyasya ādhānapavamāneṣṭibhyāṃ siddhau paścāt tasmin agnihotrahomaḥ |
vi. 5|3|12|1. āhavanīyasya (somakrayaṇyāḥ saptamapadapātasthale 'pade juhoti' iti vihitena) padena vācaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 132. āhavanīyasya sāmānyena vihitasya jyotiṣṭome viśeṣa- vihitena vartmanā, rājasūye viśeṣavihitena vatmīkavapayā ca vācaḥ |
bhā. 10|8|8|16. āhavanīye gataśrībhirdhārye udyate sati jyotiṣṭome prāyaścittaṃ, kintu manasvīhomāyeva |

saṃkarṣa. 3|2|8. 'āhavanīye juhoti' ityādivākyena aiṣṭika- pāśuka-saumika-darśeṣvemeṣu āhavanīyasya upayogaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ pratipādyate |

vā. 3|4|14|37. āhavanīye vapāyāḥ śrapaṇaṃ vihitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, yo'yaṃ māṃsapākapratiṣedho vaidike |
bhā. 12|2|16. āhavanīyagārhapatyau ubhāvamī yadā naṣṭau bhavataḥ, tadā sūryasya astamayaḥ udayo vā yadi bhaveta, tadā punarādheyaṃ kartavyam |
tasmāt astamayakāle udayakāle vā vahnidvayanāśaḥ punarādheyahetuḥ |

iti prāpte, sakṛdā- hitasya gārhapatyasya jāgaraṇāmaraṇīyāṃ yathā dhāryopāyaḥ, tathā ajasrapakṣe āhavanīyasyāpi |

iti prāpte, kāṣṭhasya abhyupādāna- svāyogena tatra gaṇāsaṃbhavāt śāstraikasamadhigamye tu gamane 'gārhapatyāt āhavanīyaṃ jvalantamuddharati' iti agnihotra- prakaraṇasyavacanena gārhapatya eva itarāmilayavacanāt tata eva pratikarmoddharaṇam |
