vi. 7|3|12, āhavanīyādiśabdānāṃ tadarthānāṃ ca alaukikatve'pi prasiddhapadasamabhivyāhā- rāt vyutpattiḥ saṃbhavati |
1|3|10 varṇakaṃ 1, āhavanīyādyamayaḥ ādhāne pavamāneṣṭibhiśca saṃskṛtāḥ uttarakratuṣu upayujyante |
3|6|4, āhava- nīyādyamayaḥ 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta' ityādidhā- nāt manuṣyāṇāmeva saṃbhavanti, nānyeṣāṃ gandharvādīnām |
sa ca ka cit prakṛtāveva vihitaḥ san vikṛtāveti- diśyate |
'pade juhoti', 'vartmani juhoti' 'vatmīkavapāyāṃ juhoti' ityādiṣvapi pūrvayena deśamātravidhānāt tatrāhavanīyaṃ upanidhāyaiva hotavyam |
iti prāpte, 'uttarādhe'me juhoti, dakṣiṇārthe somāya' ityādiṣviva juhotisayogena homādhikaraṇatveva vidhānāt āhava- nīyanivṛttiḥ |
ata eva 'catuṣpathe juhoti' iti vidhāya 'eva vā amīnāṃ padavīśo nāma, agnitveva juhoti' ityanena catuṣpathasya prakārāntareṇa agnitvopādānaṃ saṃgacchate |
bhā. 4|1|21 varṇakaṃ 2. āhicchatramathurāvāsibrāhmaṇānāṃ acatve'pi surāpānaṃ anācāraḥ |
vā. 11|3|17 pṛ. 204. 'āhitāgnimabhirdahanti yajñapātraiśca' ityā- dhānakartṛsaṃskāraḥ taccharīrapratipattirūpo vihitaḥ |
'svecchayā maraṇaṃ viprāt' ityādinā āgnyādyādīnuktvā 'na teṣāṃ snānasaṃskārau' iti saṃskāraśabdena niṣiddhaḥ |
āhitāgnipratatāni ‘na chinnaṃ dāru abhyā- dadhyāt’ ityevamādīni āhitāgnirevāgniṣu bhavanti, na tatra pavamāneṣṭayaḥ pratīkṣitavyāḥ |
āghāne nimitte puruṣārthatayā yathā vratāni vihitāni, tathā agnicchidratāni |
‘āhitāgniṃ chinnaṃ dāru abhyādadhyāt’ (amyādadhīta iti vārtike) ityādyāhitāgnibhrata āghānāttarameva |
nava prayājāḥ, navānuyājāḥ, drāvyāyabhāgau, aṣṭau havīṣi, agnaye samavadyati, vājino yajati iti |
bhā. 12|1| 1|4, caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāṃ āhutayo hūyante, trayodaśa amāvāsyāyām |
(pañca prayājāḥ, drāvyāyabhāgau āgneyāgrīṣomīyau dvau, upāṃśuyājaḥ ekaḥ, sviṣṭakṛt, trayo'nuyājāḥ iti caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāmāhutayaḥ |
yatra bahavo darvihomāḥ krameṇa kriyante, tatrāpi gaṇā- rambhe sakṛdgṛhītasya sarvadaivatyatayā pañcatrayapūrvaviniyoga- yupasyeva tantratā |
iti prāpte, prathamahomāvya- hitapūrvakāle gṛhītasya gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt tadarthaiva |
āpyāyanaṃ tu na vacanamantarā upapadyate iti pratyāhuti sakṛd grahaṇam |
āhīnaivukādayaḥ ācārāḥ na dākṣiṇātyaireva kartavyāḥ, kintu kartṛdeśanirapekṣeṇa, sarvadharmaste |
dakṣiṇa- deśāgnihotraḥ prāṅ vā udaṅ vā avasthitaḥ āhīnaivukā- dīn karotyeva |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ havi- ṣpūmantrasya mukhye'rthe āhnāne viniyogaḥ, na tu avaghāte |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ eṣa mantraḥ hanti prati upadiśyate, uta hantiḥ asya kālaṃ lakṣayati iti |
kathaṃ hanti prati upadiśyate, kathaṃ vā kālaṃ lakṣayet ? yadi evaṃ saṃbandhaḥ kriyeta ‘haviṣkṛdehi ityavaghnan’ iti, tato hanti prati upa- diśyate |
atha ‘avaghnan āhayati’ iti, tataḥ asya kālaṃ lakṣayati |
yathā aindrī gāyatryādi prati upadiśyate, evameva mantro hanti prati upadiśyate |
evaṃ śrutiḥ anugṛhītā bhavati, itarathā lakṣaṇā syāt |
hantikālasya mantrasya ca saṃbandho bhavet, na hanteḥ mantrasya |
evaṃ ca sati āhayati ityayaṃ anuvādaḥ |
yo hi ‘ehi’ iti brūte, sa āhayati |
tatra kena cit guṇena mantro hanti pratyāyayiṣyati |
vā-- evaṃ tavāt mukhyaṃ kāryaṃ mantrāṇāṃ iti sāpavādamavasthitam |
ataḥ paraṃ etat vicāryate ka utsargasya viṣayaḥ, kaḥ apavādasyeti |
tatra ‘haviṣkṛdehi’ iti vā haviḥ karoti yajamānasya patnī, tadāhnānaprakāśanāsamartho mantraḥ |
sa kiṃ tatraiva viniyujyeta avaghnansaṃyogasya kālatvena avirodhāt, athavā vacanāt anyathā'thai pūrvatarapratītāvāhnānameveti |
yadi ‘haviṣkṛdehi’ ityanena ‘avaghnan āhayati’ iti vidhīyate, tataḥ avaghātājñjayam |

atha ‘avaghnan’ ityetana ‘āhayati’ ityevaṃ saṃbadhya rūpadeva prāptaṃ āhnānakāle mantraṃ anūdya ‘triḥ’ iti vidhīyate, tataḥ ‘avaghnan’ ityasya svakālalakṣaṇā'rthatvāt na ayathā- 'rthe vacanaṃ iti yathā'thaiḥ eva mantraḥ |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? avaghnanśrutyanugrahāt āhayatetha mantrarūpādeva prāpta- tvāt avaghnanteva haviṣkaraṇe kartṛtvaṃ kathaṃcit asti. ityayathā'rthatvam |
bhāṣyaṃ- naitadasti hanti prati upadiśyate iti |
yadi asminneva vākye mantro vidhīyeta, anekaguṇavidhānāt vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
nanu asmin pakṣe mantro vidhīyate kālaḥ, tatra sa eva doṣo bhavet |
avaghnankāle eva arthena haviṣkṛt āhnāyatyā, tatra ayameva saṃbandhaḥ anūyate |
yattu kālalakṣaṇā'rthaḥ śabdaḥ iti, naiṣa doṣaḥ |
mantro'pi ca rūpādeva āhnāne prāptaḥ, so'pi anūyate eva |
coditaśca vākyāntareṇa avaghātaḥ śakoti kālaṃ lakṣayitum |
lakṣaṇe ca śaturvṛttiḥ prāptaṃ cānyadanu- dyate |
’ ‘avaghnan’ ityatra hi dhātvarthopasarjanaḥ kartā lakṣaṇāyuktaḥ pratīyate |
tasmāt sarvametet anūdya ‘triḥ’ iti vidhīyate nānyat, vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
’ ( tribhyāse vihite jāyate, saḥ asmin vākye arthāpattipramāṇe vidhīyate ityarthaḥ |
) tathā ca ‘yāvajjīviko'bhyāsaḥ’ ( 2|4| 11 ) ityatra kālābhyāyoḥ anyonyavidhehetutvaṃ vyākhyātam |
( śaṅkāpādāni āha- ) atha kasmāt na guṇāt avaghnanti brūte ? haviḥ karoti hi avaghnantiḥ, tasmāt haviṣkṛt |
kimivaṃ bhaviṣyati ? rūpādeva avahanto mantre prāpte kevalaṃ trirāvṛttimeva vakṣyati |
guṇābhāvāt gauṇaṃ abhi- dhānaṃ avahanto na saṃbhavatīti |
nahi alo ‘āhūtaḥ asmi’ ityavagacchati, tatra ahayye āhnānaṃ syāt |
vā-- atha yaduktaṃ hantireva haviṣkṛt bhaviṣyati iti, tatrocyate ‘guṇābhāvāddhaviṣkṛttvamantrābhāvā yadocyate |
’ ( acetane avaghāte āhnānādiviṣayatva- lakṣaṇaguṇābhāvāt haviṣkṛtprakāśakatvamantrābhāvaḥ : ) ‘āmantraṇādisāmarthyaṃ liṅgamāśritya tadvā |
bhāṣyaṃ- liṅgaṃ ca bhavati ‘vāg vai haviṣkṛd vācamevaitāhayati’ iti |
sā hi strī, vāk iti hi strīliṅgaḥ |
avaghnantistu na strī, pumān, na napuṃsakamiti |
na niyogataḥ ava- hanteḥ strīliṅgaḥ śabdaḥ, pulliṅgo'pi tasyāsti ava- ghātaḥ iti, napuṃsakalaṅgo'pi karmeti |
api ca patnyāḥ svarūpe sāhaśyaṃ, avahanteḥ parūpeṇa śabdena |
tasmāt patnyā haviṣkṛt liṅgaṃ anurūpataraṃ bhavati |
vā-- evaṃ ca ‘vāk’ ityarthasyaikāntikeneva strītvena saṃstato bhaviṣyati |
anyathā anupāttastrīliṅga- kriyā''dipadena anekāntyavalliṅgena śabdadharmatayā kathaṃcit kalpyaḥ syāt |
bhāṣya-- avahanti mantre sati, asmin mantre vidhyantarakopaḥ syāt 'apahataṃ rakṣa ityavahanti' 'apa- hatā yātudhānāḥ ityavahanti' iti |
śā-- pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyād vidhau yuktā na lakṣaṇā |
iti prāpte, abhi- dhīyate, 'tribhyāso na pāṭhena nityaprāpto yataḥ ka cit |
āhvāne tu mantrasya yogo hantestu lakṣaṇā |
tasmāt trirā- vṛttimādhividhānāt āhnānāṅgaṃ mantraḥ, nāyathā'rtho- 'vaghāte |
soma-- nanu āhnānasyāpi vidheyatvāvadhāvena viśiṣṭavidhitvāt kathaṃ vākyabhedaḥ |
na ca 'patyehavi- ṣkṛt upatiṣṭhati, sā abhidadhyāvahanti ' iti ava- ghātasya patnīkartṛkatvāvagatyā avaghātāthai tadāhnānasya arthaprāptatvāt na vidheyatvamiti vācyam |
anāhatāyāḥ svayamāgatāyā api avahantṛtvasaṃbhavena āhnānasya nityaprāptyabhāvena vidhisaṃbhavāt |
yattuktaṃ nyāyasudhāyāṃ mantravarṇataḥ prāptyabhyupagame āhnānaprāptau tatra mantraviniyogaḥ, mantravarṇācca āhnāna- prāptiḥ ityanyonyāśrayaḥ syāt |

kiṃca nityaprāptasyāpi āhnānasya 'uru prathasveti puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti puroḍāśāntyānyā'nupapattyā prāptasyāpi prathanasa ādhva- ryavasamākhyābalena adhvaryukartṛkatvasiddhaye 'yajamānameva tat prathayati' ityarthavādopapattaye ca vidheyatvam ihāpi adhvaryukartṛkatvāprāptyai 'vācameva tadāhayati ' ityarthavādopapattaye ca vidheyatvamāvaśyakam |
( na kāla- vidhiḥ 0 6 iti sūtranayasudhāyāḥ arthato'nuvādādyam ) tatra |

'ehi' itipadayuktasya mantrasya nityadā- mnātasya nityaṃ ṛtūpakārakatvasya vaktavyatayā tasya ca mantrasya dṛṣṭārthatvābhāya mantrasāmarthyaparyālocanalabhyā- hānatvaiva dvāratvaucityena ca dṛṣṭadvārā kṛtau mantravini- yogabaladeva dvārabhūtasyāhnānasya tatra mantrānvayasya ca siddhayā anyonyāśrayānavakāśaḥ, mantrasya adhvaryakāṇḍe samāmnānabalādeva āhnānasya adhvaryukartṛkatvasiddhau tadarthe āhnānavidhivaiyarthyācca |
'uru prathasva ' iti mantrasya tu ādhvaryakāṇḍe samāmnānamānāt prathanasya nādhvaryukartṛka- tvasiddhiḥ |
adhvaryvacāritamantreṇa anyasyāpi tadarthasmṛtau satyāṃ anyenāpi prathanānuṣṭhānasaṃbhavāt |
prakṛte ca 'ehi' iti śabdaprayogatveva āhnātṛtayā ehītipadayuktamantrasya ādhvaryabale āhnānasyāpi ādhvaryatvamavarjanīyaṃ iti vaiṣamyam |
arthavādaśca tribhyāsamātrāvidhāvapi kathaṃcidu- papādayituṃ śakyate iti tadarthamapi viśiṣṭavidhirauva- dṛṣṭasya āhnānavidhānasya anaṅgīkāryatvāt iti (pṛ. 213) |
na ca mukhye avaghnan iti pade siddhāntino lakṣaṇā, pūrvapakṣiśastvantya jaghanye āhyatipade iti vaiṣamyaṃ śakyam |

avaghātasya 'lakṣaṇaheloḥ kriyāyāḥ' iti kriyāntaralakṣakakriyākartṛvihitaśatrupratyayena kriyā'ntara- lakṣaṇā'rthatvāvagamena anyopasarjanatayā svārthasamarpake avaghnan iti pade eva prathamaśrute'pi lakṣaṇāyā nyāyya- tvāt |
sūtrārthastu- āhnānaṃ āhnānamantro'pi, tathā aindrīvat ayathārthaḥ syāt iti |
bhāṭṭa-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ' haviṣkṛdehīti trirava- ghnāhyati' iti śrutam |
tatra nāyaṃ mantraḥ āhnā- nāṅgaṃ, tasya ' patyeva haviṣkṛdupatiṣṭhati, sā devānami- dutyāvahanti ' iti vacanānusāreṇa abhāvapratīteḥ |
tayoścāvaghātayoḥ ' vrīhīnava- hanti ' ityanena saṃskāryasaṃśraye'pi dṛṣṭārthatvāt vikalpaḥ |
patnīkartṛkatvāvaghāte ca ' avarakṣo divaḥ ' iti mantraḥ |
ataśca anena vākyena avaghāte gauṇe evāyaṃ mantro viniyujyate |

( ' gauṇīvṛttiprakāraḥ śravaghāte'pi kathaṃcit ' sthālī pacati ' itivat kartṛtvamupacarya acetane'pi cetanatva- māropya ' he avaghāta ! tvamehi, saṃpadya bhava ' ityarthā- jhīkāreṇa draṣṭavyaḥ ' iti kaustubhe pūrvapakṣānte uktam |
iti prāpte, mukhye evāhvāne vini- yogasaṃbhave mantrasya āhyatipadasya ca gauṇatvakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt |
mantravarṇikaviniyogāvidhikalpatayā ' sadhyāsam ' ityādinā grahaṇadeva āhnānasyāpi niyamena prāptatvāt |
' patyeva ' ityasya tu nāyamarthaḥ yat svayamevottiṣṭhati, na tu āhyatīti, api tu patyeva nānyeti |
ataśca āhāne mantrasya liṅgādeva prāptatvāt āhnānasya ca sahāyyātvena avaghātakāle eva prāpte : ' avaghnan ' ityasyāpi anuvādāt kevalaṃ tribhyāsamātraṃ vidhīyate iti na gauṇe avaghāte viniyogaḥ |
i ikārastu ( iñ pratyayastu ) yathaivāpatye siddhaḥ tathā kriyāyāmapi kartari |
ikṣitabantaḥ dhātuṃ arthe'pi kva cit prayujyate yajiḥ yajatiḥ iti ca, tat śabde''mihite lakṣaṇayā arthapratītiḥ : ityavagantavyam |
yathā ikṣvāt parvaṇaparvaṇi rasotkarṣastathā sannabhainapi kramaśaḥ utkarṣatāṃ prāpnotīti |
ukte ca ' ikṣotrāt kramaśaḥ : parvaṇaparvaṇi yathā rasa- viśeṣaḥ |
yathaikṣuraso bahurato'pi barhimalio dṛśyate, tathā māyā antarbahurūpā''pi bahi- statsvarūpā dṛśyate, tasyāśca yadvimalatamaṃ rūpaṃ tadevakṣu- rasasyeva sitā |
yathā cekṣumādhuryaṃ sitāyāṃ kurunamabhi- vyajyate anyatra malasaṃparkādapataraṃ ca, evaṃ paraiśvarye sattve śuddhe sarvamabhivyajyate |
yathaikṣuvikāreṣvapi rasa- guḍaśarkarāditāsu mālinyāpagamatāratamyādeva vibhinna- rūpatvaṃ dṛśyate tathā sattvādiṣvapi bodhyamiti |
icchā svarasataḥ puruṣārthe eva svargaputrapaśvādādau bhavati |
yathā meṣamuttareṇa yāni asmādītiyairanupalabdhapūrvāṇi svādūni vṛkṣaphalāni, na tāni prati asakṛt icchā bhavati |
no khalu anyapuruṣeṇa upalabdhe'pi viṣaye anyasya upalabdhuricchā bhavati |
' icchāyāḥ iṣyamāṇena sākaṃ jñānadārakaḥ saṃbandho nātiriktaḥ ' iti so'yaṃ icchā- nyāyaḥ |
na ca putrādiprīyansukhādeḥ putrādiviṣayatvā- pattiḥ icchānyāyāt iti vācyam |
advaita. pṛ 466. vaidikalādinā'dhyāpasya icchā rūpatve na kā cit kṣatiḥ |
rahasya pṛ. 15. iccheṣyamāṇasamabhivyāhāre iṣyamāṇasya prādhānyaṃ iti nyāyaḥ yajeta svargakāmaḥ ityādi klaptaḥ |
parimala. 1111 pṛ. 47 vas. iccheṣyamāṇa- samabhivyāhāre iṣyamāṇasyaiva bhāvyatā iti nyāyaḥ prakṛte vividiṣāyāṃ karmaviniyogaṃ na pratibhannāti |

ābharaṇa. 314|125 vas., iccheṣyamāṇa- samabhivyāhāre vidheyabhāvanāyā bādhanāpekṣāyāṃ iṣyamāṇameva bhāvyatvena anveti ' iti ' svargakāmo yajeta ' ityādivākyeṣu klaptena viśeṣanyāyena pramalena ' pradhānārthasya arthāntareṇa anvayaḥ ' ityasya sāmānya- nyāyasya bādhitatayā vedane eva karmaṇāṃ viniyogaḥ ( iti śaṅkā ) |
tathā āghārau ājyabhāgau, prayājānuyājāḥ, patnīsaṃyājāḥ, samiṣṭayajuḥ, sviṣṭakṛditi |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ sarve yāgāḥ pradhānabhūtāḥ, uta ke cit guṇabhūtā iti |
' yajeta svargakāmaḥ ' ityaviśeṣeṇa yāgebhyaḥ phalaṃ śrūyate |
apitvā'ṅgāni kāni cid, yeṣvaṅgatvena saṃstutiḥ, sāmānyato hyabhisaṃstavaḥ |
yathā, ' amīṣū vā etau yajñasya yadādhārau ' ' cakṣuṣī vā etau yajñasya yadājyabhāgau ' , ' yatrayājānuyājāścajyante varma vā eta- dyajñasya kriyate, varma vā yajamānasya bhrātṛvyābhirudhye ' iti |
abhīṣū rathasyāṅgaṃ, cakṣuṣī cakṣuṣmataḥ; varma varma- vataḥ |
yadi ca aṅgāni tāni saṃstutāni, tataḥ saṃstvo'rthavān bhavati |
' na ca prayājān yajati ' ' na cānuyājān yajati ' iti ca |
aviśiṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ, pradhāneṣu guṇasya vidyamāna- tvāt |
' śiro vā eta- dyajñasya yadāgneyo, hṛdayamupāṃśuyājaḥ, pādāvagnīṣomīyaḥ ' iti |
śiraḥ śirastato'ṅgaṃ, hṛdayaṃ hṛdayavataḥ, pādau pādavata iti sarvasyaiva aṅgatvena saṃstviriti sarvamevāṅgaṃ prāpnoti |
asati pradhāne kasya aṅgam ? tasmāt naitat aṅgamiti |
bhāṣyaṃ --atha yaduktaṃ anyārthadarśanaṃ, parārthatvāt na tat sādhakaṃ bhavati |
parārthe hi tat vākyaṃ, na iṣya- māṇasya prayājādeḥ prāpaṇārtham |
tasmāt anyadasya pramāṇamanveṣyaṃ śrūyantare nyāyo vā |
pṛthaktvatve tvabhidhānayorniveśaḥ śrutito vyapa- deśācca, tat punarmukhyalakṣaṇaṃ yat phalavattvaṃ, tatsaṃ- nidhāvasaṃyukte tadaṅgaṃ syāt, bhāgitvāt kāraṇasyā- śrutaanvayasaṃbandhaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsaśabdakebhyaḥ phalaṃ śrūyate ' darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta ' iti |
kāni punaḥ darśapūrṇa- māsaśabdakāni ? yeṣāṃ vacane paurṇamāsīśabdaḥ amā- vāsyāśabdo vā |
nanu amāvāsyā- śabdakānāṃ naiva phalaṃ śrūyate |
pṛthaktve samu- dāyayorniveśaḥ : etorabhidhānayoḥ : ' paurṇamāsī ' iti ca ' amāvāsyā ' iti ca |
triṣu āgneyādiṣu yaḥ samu- dāyaḥ, tatra paurṇamāsīśabdaḥ; itareṣu amāvāsyāśabdaḥ |
kathaṃ ? paurṇamāsī amāvāsyā iti ca diśabdaḥ śrūyate, hyarthavat vyapadeśācca |
kathaṃ tadvyapadeśaḥ ? dvivacana- nirdeśāt ' darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ ' iti |
kathaṃ ? ' darśau vā etayoḥ pūrvaḥ, paurṇamāsa uttarastayoḥ |
aya yat paurṇamāsaṃ pūrvamārabhate, tadyathāpūrva prakriyate |
paurṇamāsamārabhamāṇaḥ sarakhatyai caruṃ nirvapeta, sarakhate dvādaśakapālam |
ubhāvetau yathāpūrva kalpayitvā ārabhate ṛddhayai, ṛdhnotyeva, atho mithuna- tvāya ' iti |
tatra darśaśabdena prakṛtya amāvāsyāśabdena śruvan ekārthatāṃ darśayati |
śakyate ca candrasya darśanaṃ amāvāsyā ' darśaḥ ' iti lakṣayituṃ yathā cakṣuporabhāve sati cakṣuṣmān iti vaktuṃ lakṣyate |
etasmāt vyapadeśācca śrutiśca loke śravaṇāt ekāryatāmeva adhyavasyāmaḥ |
yat anyat tatsa~nidhau śrūyate ( aphalaṃ ), tat tadaṅgam |
kathaṃ ? itakartavyatā''kāṅkṣasya saṃnidhau śrūyamāṇaṃ itakartavyatāviśeṣatvena paripūraṇasamarthe, tadaṅgaṃ bhavitumarhati |
śakyamanuṣaktuṃ, kiṃtu darśapūrṇamāsavākyaṃ sākāṅkṣameva syāt, anyā asya itikartavyatā śrutā kalpyeta |
etāmapi prayājādīnāṃ anyā kalpyeta, etaditikartavyatā avagamyamānā utsṛjyeta |
tena aṅgañca kāraṇabhāgā iti eṣāmanyena phalena saṃbandhaḥ abhutaḥ |
tasmāt na sarvāṇi samapradhānāni, āghārādīni guṇakarmāṇīti |
yathā ' caturhotrā paurṇamāsībhirabhiṣṭute, pañcahotrā amāvāsyām ' iti, sarveṣu pradhānaṣu asmin samudāye caturhotrā, asmin pañcahotrā iti |
vibhāgāvijñānācca idaṃ nopapadyeta, bhavati ca evaṃlakṣaṇakaṃ guṇavidhānam |
api ca aṅgatvena āghārādīnāṃ saṃstutirupāpannā bhaviṣyati |
bhāṣyaṃ --atha yaduktaṃ āgneyādīnāmapi aṅgatvena saṃstutiḥ aṅgatvaṃ khyāpayediti, tannarahitavyam |
pradhānānāmapi eṣāṃ satāṃ utpatyapekṣayā śiraādiśrutiḥ bhaviṣyati |
yathā jāya- mānasya hi puruṣasya agre śiro jāyate madhye madhyaṃ paścāt pādau, evaṃ āgneyaḥ agrataḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ --' caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāmāhutayo hūyante, trayodaśāmāvāsyāyāṃ ' iti |
itarathā na caturdaśa paurṇa- māsyāṃ āhutayo bhaveyuḥ, na vā amāvāsyāyāṃ trayodaśa iti |
tasmāt āgneyādīni pradhānāni, āghārādīni aṅgāni iti siddham |
idaṃ punaḥ ( darśapūrṇamāsau iti ) prasiddhārtha- mākhyātasya viśeṣaṇam |
' tasmāt ṣaṇṇāmeva prādhānyaṃ itareṣāṃ tu prakaraṇāt tadaṅgatvam |
soma--pādādau rājasūyavākye yo'yaṃ samapradhānā- jñāṅgatvavicāraḥ, tatprasaktavicārāntarāṇi parisamāpya idānīṃ sa eva vicāraḥ kriyate iti saṃgatiḥ |
’, baṇmukhyā nāmataḥ siddhāḥ śeṣā anye'- ṅgasaṃstuteḥ ||
bhāṭṭa—prayājādisādhāraṇyena ‘darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta’ ityanena rājasūyavat yajinā na phala- saṃndhaḥ |
kiṃtu āgneyādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmeva, darśapūrṇamāsanāmrā āgneyādiṣvayāgeṣva prasiddhārthakena yajeracchedāt |
yathā ca darśapūrṇamāsanāmaḥ prasiddhādyakatvaṃ tathopādirta paurṇamāsādhikaraṇe (2|2|3) |
tadadhikaraṇaprayojana- kathanāye tamidamadhikaraṇaṃ prayuktisiddhayarthaṃ na virupyate |
rājasūyanāmaśca yathā prakṛtasarvayāgaparatvaṃ, tathā tadadhi- karaṇe spaṣṭameva |
tanyāyasvarupaṃ tu ‘tad-dvitvānusāriṇo hi darśapūrṇamāsaddha tadviṣayau bhavataḥ’ iti vārtike uktam |
atra sudhā ‘paurṇamāsa- māvāsyāśabdoktasamudāyadvitvānusāritvāt darśapūrṇamāsa- śabdayoḥ samudāyaviṣayatvam’ iti |
su. pṛ. 732, paurṇamāsādhikaraṇaṃ vinā (2|2|13-8) iḍā''- dhikaraṇapūrvakapa eva syāt iti iḍā''dhikaraṇasya paurṇamāsādhikaraṇādhīnatvāt paurṇamāsādhikaraṇayojanatvena ārambhaḥ |
pṛ. 732, yaccānyat svargādi sādhyaṃ kalpyeta, tasya iḍā''dhikaraṇanyāyāt darśapūrṇamāsa- nāmaviśepitasyuktena āgneyādiṣṭakena saha saṃbandha- nirākāṅkṣībhūtasya na prayājādau saṃbandhākāṅkṣā asti |
agnīṣomīye paśau sviṣṭakṛt iḍā''śeṣāt yāgaṃ kṛtvā avaśiṣṭāt aṅgatrayasamudāyāt ijyeta |
prakṛtitvat prakṛtau yathā darśādiyāgaviśiṣṭāt puroḍāśāt sviṣṭakṛdyajyate tadvat |
anijyārtheḥ doḥ- pūrvārtha, gudamartha, śroṇijaghanāthai iti vyaṅgaiḥ tribhiraṅgaiḥ prākṛtenyāśeṣasya vikāraḥ bādhaḥ syāt |
śaravat yathā śyenādau śaraiḥ prākṛtāḥ kuśā bādhyante tadvat |
iḍā parācī ‘yaḍiopahūtā iti tat parācī, yat upahūteḍā iti tat pratīcī’ |
(yadā iḍopāvhāna- nigade iḍāśabdaḥ ādau uccāryate, tadā sā parācī nāma |
yadā tu iḍāśabdaḥ upahūtaśabdāt paścāducāryate, tadā sā pratīcī nāma ityarthaḥḥ) |
vi. 10|7|12. iḍāṃ śeṣādiḍāmavadyati’ (agnī hutāt haviṣaḥ śeṣāt iḍāyā avadānaṃ kriyate) |
mā. 4|14|4|14. iḍāṃ yajamānapañcamā ṛtvijaḥ bhakṣayanti darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
iḍāmeva prakṛtya ‘yaṃ kāmayetāpaśuḥ syāditi parācīṃ tasyeḍāmupahayate’ (yaṃ kāmayeta paśumān syāditi pratīcīṃ tasyeḍāmupahayate) iti śrutau pratyakṣaśabdena pratyakṣamuktā kartṛrucyate |
evaṃ parākaśabdo'pi ‘yat prakṛta upahayate’ iti vacanāntarāt |
ityādinā aneka- vidho yaḥ pratīyate tasyārthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
iḍānāṃ tu mukhā- saṃbhavāt aśvadatvāt kartumurvāt evāśritaḥ |
iḍā''dibhakṣaḥ brahmādibhireva kartavyaḥ, na tu taiḥ svagṛhe nayanaṃ ityuktaṃ ‘bhakṣāyo vā dravye samatvāt’ (3|4|17|50) iti sūtre bhāṣyavārtikayoḥ |
bhāṣya-- santi śeṣabhakṣāḥ jyotiṣṭome, darśapūrṇa- māsayośca |
teṣu saṃśayaḥ kiṃ te parikrayārthāḥ, uta neti |
kiṃ prāptam ? śeṣabhakṣāśca tadvat bhavitumarhanti, yadvat dakṣiṇādānam |
prītiṃ hi karoti bhakṣaṇaṃ, prītyā ca ānamanti |
kutaḥ ? yajñārthena hi dravya- mukhyatvaṃ prayojanavat |
‘dakṣiṇādhāt madhyācca avadyati’ ityevādi ekadeśavacanaṃ prakṛtaśeṣāpekṣaṃ bhavati, na dravyasya utpādakam |
tasmāt dravyasya bhakṣaṇamucyate, na bhakṣaṇārthe dravyamupādīyate |
bhāṣya-- api ca yaccheṣaṃ dravyaṃ, tat devatāyai saṃklṛptaṃ, yajamānena na svayaṃ upayoktavyamiti |
tasmāt na upayuktaṃ ṛtvijaḥ īśate, no khalvapi yajamānaḥ |
tatra asya devatārthaḥ saṃkalpa eva nāvakalpate |
bhāṣya-- svāmini ca bhakṣaṇaṃ dṛśyate ‘yajamāna- pañcamāḥ samupahṛtā iḍāṃ bhakṣayanti’ iti |
katham ? evaṃ sati naiva vijñāyate, iḍābhakṣaṇena yajamānapañcamāḥ parikrīyante iti |
kuṇḍapāyināmayane, ‘atasakaiścamasaiḥ somān bhakṣayanti’ iti prāpte bhakṣe viśeṣaḥ śrūyate ‘atasakaiḥ’ |
soma-- yadi ānarthakyaṃ dakṣiṇādānasya satre bādhaḥ, tarhi tadeva śeṣabhakṣaṇāmapi bādhaḥ |
sūtrātthestu --tadat dakṣiṇā- dānavat śeṣabhakṣā anyārthāḥ iti |
pratipattiḥ saṃskṛti- tvāt satreṣu na nivartate ||

bhāṭṭa-- śeṣabhakṣāstatra dvitīyāsayogāt haviḥ- pratipatyarthāḥḥ prayājaśeṣanyāyena kartuḥ kariṣyamāṇakarmaṇi baladhānādyarthāśca na tu ānarthakyauḥ, tasyāḥ prakṛtī ānu- ṣaṅgikatve'pi pra prayojakatvāt |
astu vā iṣṭaprayojana- tvādiṣepāt trayāṇāmapi prayojakatvaṃ, na tu ānati- mātrasya |
ataḥ satre tadabhāve'pi pratipatyārthe kartavyaṃ eva |
’ (bhakṣaḥ parikrayo na syāt iti yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ) |
iḍānigadaḥ sarvo'pi na caturvāramāva- tanīyaḥ 'caturupahayate' ityuktā āvṛttistu 'iḍā upahṛtā' itipadaviṣayiṇī |

evamahaṃ vicārya adhunā ādyapūrvapakṣavādī punastaṃ dūṣayati |
nahi ūhaḥ karmaṇa ekatvāt, abhyāsānāmapi phalacamasatvat asamānavidhānatve pramāṇabhāvāt |
abhidhividho'stu svasvavidhiyuktatvena kratuvidhiprayuktatvā- bhāvāt yuktaḥ paraprayuktāmidhiviyojīvakatayā kyavikāra- saṃkocaḥ |
ato mānagrahaṇamatrāveva kāmamaindramātrapradāna- viṣayau bhavetāṃ, na tu mānāpyapi |
vastutastu--'vasumate' ityanena devatā'ntarasyāpi abhidhānāt tayorapi sarvārtha- tvameva |
( itaḥ paraṃ 20 adhikaraṇasyaḥ ekādaśādhikaraṇa- siddhāntapratipādako granthoṃ niveśyate |
na indrīyātpade tatpuruṣaḥ, api tu bahuvrīhivire |
tatpuruṣe'pi pūrvapade saṃbandhalakṣaṇā, pīta- pade ca svīkṛtavācyatvalakṣaṇā |
yadyapi ceyaṃ siddhāntano'pi tulyā, tathāpi avayavasvīkārasya avayavasvīkārasāpekṣa- tvena vilambopasthitikatvāt tulyatvam |

atra pītapade arthāśrayatvaparyantaṃ matvarthīyaṃ kṛtvā pādhātunā ca avayava- gatameva tatsaṃbandhasvīkāraṃ lakṣayitvā indraḥ pītaḥ svīkārakartā ( pānakartā ) yasmin savane iti vyutpattyā samānādhikaraṇabahuvrīhiriṣyate |
ataḥ sarvasyaiva somasya uktavidhaprāptaḥsravanādi- saṃbandhatvāt anaindrāṇāmapi samantrakameva avikāreṇa bhakṣaṇam |
yadi tu pītapadasya pūrvanipātāpattimāśa- ṅketa, tadā astu indre pītaṃ pānamasminniti saptamī- bahuvrīhiḥ |

yadi tu niṣṭhā'ntatvena pūrvanipātātpattivi- śiṣyeti vibhajyate, tadā pītapadasya ākṛtigaṇatvena āhitāgnyādigaṇāntaḥpātamanaṅgīkṛtya ' vā''hitāgnyā- diṣu ' ( pā0 2|1|37 ) iti sūtreṇendraśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ |
astu ayaṃ tatpuruṣa eva, tadā'pi tu lakṣaṇyā somasaṃbandhisavanaparatvam |
na ca tasyāṃ pramāṇābhāvaḥ, taittirīyaśākhāyāṃ prātaḥsravanādibhedena indrītapānasyaitatapītapṛpadānāṃ trivāraṃ pāṭhasyaiva pramāṇatvāt |
indrīyādipadānāṃ sakṛtpaṭhitānāmeva pāṭhopapattau tatra yogyatvaiva prātaḥsravanādidānāṃ vibhāgena viśeṣaṇatvo- papattiḥ |
atasteṣāṃ prātaḥsravanādibhedena trivāraṃ pāṭha eva vaiyarthyabhiyā savanaparatvalakṣaṇatātparyagrāhakaḥ |
ataśca indrītādiviśeṣaṇatrayayuktasya tatsattvasya saṃbandhinaṃ somamanyadevatamapi bhakṣayāmīti mantrārthāvagateḥ sarvatraika- mantryam |
' indrītasyopahato bhakṣayāmi ' ityādau svareṇaiva bahuvrīhinirṇaye indrīyādhikaraṇa avaiyākaraṇān prati sārthakam |
tatpuruṣe pūrvapadasya lakṣaṇā bahuvrīhau tu śakitve iti |
pare tu indrītapade tatpuruṣe'pi pūrvapadalakṣaṇayā, pītapade hutā- hutaśeṣalakṣaṇayā ceti lakṣaṇādvayāpattyā lakṣaṇābahuvrīha- pekṣayā tatpuruṣasya durvalatvāt siddhāntasiddhiḥ |
indrīyādhikaraṇe nirākāṅkṣasya vidheḥ mantraliṅgatusāreṇa saṃkocaḥ nirākṛtaḥ |
ke. indrīyādhikaraṇe bahuvrīheḥ anyapadārthaśakteḥ vyavasthāpa- yiṣyamāṇatvāt |
indrī- pītādhikaraṇe siddhāntasūtre ( 3|2|17|41 ) indra- pītasamāsasthena indraśabdena sāpekṣendradevatvasya aindrādau somasya grahaṇaṃ vakṣyati |
indrī- pītādhikaraṇasiddhānte ' gāyatracchandasaḥ ' ityādiḥ savanaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ sthitam |
kau. 312|142 pṛ. 303, indrīyādhikaraṇasiddhāntagau tadviniyogastu ( bhakṣa- mantraviniyogaḥ ) naivāniṣṭaḥ |
ata eva indrītādhi- karaṇaprayojanasya anupadatkārāyāgo'pi viṣayaḥ |
na ca vājiṃśabdasya viśvadevaparatve- 'pi na viśvadevatvena teṣāṃ devatārthaṃ kiṃtu vājitvena |
tataśca sutaśatvādhikaraṇagata-indramahendranyāyena devatā- bhedāt nāsti pūrvakarmasaṃbandhaḥ iti vācyam |
vede samidādipadānāṃ agni- pāṭhasāmānādhikaraṇye satyapi indramahendranyāyena samidādi- padaiḥ tattadyakāśānānupapattiḥ, śabdasya devatātvena tadbheda padāntaraprayogānupapatteḥ |
vāji- śabdo'pi viśvadevadevatāmukhena vājinadravyaṃ vihitaṃ bhavati |
indraśabdaḥ yajñasādhanatvarūpāt sādṛśyāt aiśvaryādvā gārhapatye gauṇaḥ |
indrāyudhamiva dhātutrayānuktaṃ ekaṃ karma ( yajati, dadāti, juhoti |
indrāyudhaṃ yathā lohitaśuklakṛṣṇastribhi- rdhātubhiḥ saṃhatyānujyate tadvat |
indriyaṃ gamakaṃ, yat sattāmātreṇa svasaṃnikṛṣṭamarthaṃ gamayati |
indriyaṃ saṃnihite eva viṣaye jñānaṃ janayati |
yathā- anādyavidyayā viṣayabhogalāmattha- mevānugamitamidaṃ jagat jaḍampraṇājāta sarve ceti bhāvaḥ|
maṇi. pṛ. 19. indriyakāmasya agnihotraṃ dadhnā juhuyāt, ... ya indriyakāmaḥ syāt, sa dadhnā homaṃ kuryāt... indriya- kāmasya homasaṃbaddhaṃ prayatnaṃ dadhisaṃbaddhaṃ kuryāt|
26. indriyakāmavākye anyata eva dadhno homānyatvābhāt na karmāntaratā|

su. pṛ. 855, indriyakāmahomaḥ āśrayatvamantareṇa guṇasya phalasādhanatvāt‌yogyāt vidhimantareṇa ca prakaraṇāvagatasyāpi homasya āśrayatve pramāṇābhāvāt prakaraṇāvagataṃ svarūpamanya guṇaphalasaṃbandhavidhivyanayā'- nupapattiprasṛtena vidhinā āśrayetvena
āpatitaṃ bhavati 'dadhnā juhoti' ityetadeva vākyaṃ kevalaṃ gṛhyate iti|
api ca 'dadhyatra daśame pakṣe taddomasya viśeṣaṇam|
' (daśa dravyāṇi tu sudhāyyāṃ- 'payo dadhi yatrāgreva sarpiretadanujñalā|
somo māṃsaṃ tathā tailamāpastāni daśaiva tu ||
' iti) yadyapi tāvat dadhyādīni nityaṃ home samuccīyaren, tathā sati vicitra- mapi karma ekadeśagrahaṇena coditaṃ iti kathaṃ cit kalpyeta|
dadhyādīnāṃ tu vaikalpikatvāt ekaikasyaiva daśame pakṣe homājñatvam|
ataśca dadhivākye'pi ālocya- māne pākṣikaṃ dadhi dṛśyate |
na ca yadā dadhnā juhuyāt ityevaṃ anuvadituṃ śakyate, phalasyā- vidheyatvāt |
eṣā hi atra vacanavyaktiḥ, 'yadi indriyakāmaḥ, tadā nityaṃ kevaladadhiviśiṣṭaṃ homaṃ kuryāt |
na cāsau tādṛk anyataḥ prāptaḥ iti midyate |
nanu homapramāṇaṃ tāvat pratijñātaṃ tavyabhimānācca amedasiddhiḥ |
yat dravyaṃ na pratyabhijñāyate, na tat karma- bhedakāraṇam |
tasmāt tadeva karma guṇamātrābhyadhikaṃ phale vidhīyate |

yathaiva cārthāt aniyatānekadravyakatve prāpte kevaladadhiniyamāt vaika- lpikadravyakatve kalpite, taṇḍulādividhivyāpteḥ vaika- lpikadravyakatve kalpite, taṇḍulādividhivyāpteḥ kevala- dadhiniyamakaraṇāt |
nahi asau etasmāt vākyātte kathaṃ cidapi prāptaḥ |
tena homāt phale bhavati karmāntara- tvam |
tatra hi etadavasthita, ākhyātācchabdāḥ phalapadena saṃbadhyante, na dravyaguṇaśabdāḥ iti |
satyāṃ karma vidhīyate, na karmaṇi guṇaḥ |
' tatra nāma aguṇe karmaśabde sati guṇe vidhīyate, yatra sa guṇe na bhavati, tacca arthāntaraṃ na śrūyate |
na ceha dravyamapi tadasti, dadhno vākyāntareṇaiva prāptatvāt, phalasya ca abhyadhikasya upādānāt |
ata āha phalamiha śrūyate, tacca karmaṇe nyāyyaṃ iti |
tatra kiṃ dṛṣṭaṃ hi karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ iti - praśnasya dvidhā pratibhāsaḥ ( vākyabhedena, ekavākyatayā ceti |

tatra vākyabheda- pakṣamanupaśyati -) ekastāvat neti brūmaḥ, nahi etat dṛṣṭenānena sidhyati ityādiḥ, nirākaraṇaparatvena siddhāntacchāyā'nusārāt 'kiṃ' ityetāvāneva praśnaḥ, 'kiṃ' iti etat nyāyyaṃ ? ityarthaḥ |
itara āha dṛṣṭaṃ hi karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ ( kṛṣvāditeo brīhyādi ) iti |
'yadi' ityādi tāvat svayameva āśaṅkaya nirākaroti yāvat tasmāt naivaṃ- jātīyakeṣu etat bhavati iti ( ityantaṃ bhāṣyam |
imaṃ vākyabhedapakṣaṃ dūṣayitvā ekavākyatāpakṣaṃ upanya- syati -) tatra tu ( uttaratra ) kathaṃ tarhi homāt nyāyyaṃ phalaṃ ityevaṃ ekāntikaḥ siddhāntavādinaḥ praśnaḥ |
sa ca ātmīyavacanopasaṃhārādanantaraṃ duḥśliṣṭaḥ pratibhāti ityevaṃ anyayojanā yuktā |

( atra pakṣe bhāṣyaṃ yojayati - ) tacca karmaṇo nyāyyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣavādinā abhihite siddhāntavādī dadhipadānarthakyabhayena bhāvāthī- dhikaraṇanyāyāsaṃbhavāt śabdasya asāmarthyaṃ manyamānaḥ pṛcchati kiṃ dṛṣṭaṃ hi karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ kṛṣvāditeḥ iti, anena nyāyena sāmānyatodṛṣṭena homāt phalaṃ manyase iti |
yadyapi ca codanālakṣaṇadharmābhyupagamāt anumānādīnāṃ īdṛśebhyaśca asāmarthyaṃ sthāpitaṃ, tathāpi vedārthanirṇaye teṣāṃ kāraṇatvāniṣedhāt tadarthanirṇayārthaṃ anumānopanyāsaḥ |
paraḥ punaḥ bhāvāthīdhikaraṇavāsitāntaḥ- karaṇaḥ ākṣipannāha, mā me adhyāropamevaṃ dāḥ, śabde sati na hi anumānaṃ bravīmi |
na ca etena sāmānyato- dṛṣṭena asadamimataṃ sidhyati, asiddha-anaikāntika-
kathaṃ ? yadi tāvat 'homaḥ phalavān phalavattvā dṛśyamānatvāt' ityucyate tataḥ pratijñātāyarthadeśatvāt asiddhatvam |
atha 'kṛṣvā- dīnāṃ phalavattvā dṛśyamānatvāt' iti, tato'pi apakṣadharma- tvam |
atha vinaiva pakṣadharmatvāt yatcchāyāmātreṇa kalpyeta, tacca dravyeṣu aviśiṣṭam |
atha sādṛśyadvāreṇa upamayā kalpyeta tacca sādṛśyaṃ phalavṛddhiḥ kṛṣvādibhiḥ saha homasya kriyātmanā vidyate, na dravyasya akriyātmakatvāt |

iti tatra dravyasyāpi asyeva kiṃcit sādṛśyaṃ iti manasi kṛtvā yadi pratyāsannāvāntara- sādṛśyapekṣayā tannirākriyate, tataḥ śakyaṃ pratyāsannatarā- pekṣayā homasyāpi nirākartuṃ iti manyamāna āha homo'pi asadṛśaḥ, sādhanasvarūpaphalabhedāt kṛpe |
atha kiṃcit sādṛśyaṃ gṛhyate, tat dravyasyāpi sat anityaṃ dravyatvat kārye ityādidharmabhedāt asi iti pūrvapribhāyavivaraṇam |
atha dravyādanyat sadṛśataramasti iti āpekṣikatvāt sādṛśyasya susaharo apekṣite viprakṛṣṭaṃ viśadameva bhavati |
tena kriyātve kṛṣihomavartini apekṣite viprakṛṣṭatvāt sadanityādiyuktaṃ dravyaṃ asadṛśameva ityucyate |
tathā sati kriyātve'pi dadhyārthabhojanagamanayāvāntara- sādṛśyapekṣā kṛṣohomayoḥ |
' na caitat siddhaṃ iti upamānena sādharmyamātramānena vā sarvadharmaprāptiḥ anumānoktanyāyya- vyāpakanirapekṣā apyuktā, sarvapadārthanāmatvaprasaṅgāt |
tathā coktaṃ ( 11|2|12 pṛ. 17 bhā. ) 'na hi devadattasya śyāmatve yajñadattasya śyāmatvaṃ bhavitumarhati' ( iti ) tathāhi 'na sāsnādimattvaṃ dṛṣṭvā gavaye sadṛśe gavā |
prakṛteṣu phalādīni na yānti vikṛtiṃ ca cit ||
' yadi yacca kāraṇabhūtaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ siddhe dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇi taccetat sādhye'pi pakṣe, kāraṇabhūtameti avagatameva bhavati tat tasya sādhakaṃ iti |
ato vacanāt kāryakāraṇayoreva gamyagamyakabhāvo bhāṣyakārābhipretaḥ iti cinmayante |
kāryakāraṇayorapi ca na tathā kāraṇaṃ gamakaṃ vyabhicāravadavasthatvāt, yathā kāryam |
tasmāt liṅgameva vyāpyatvena dṛṣṭaṃ sapakṣe vyāpakasya anyatra sādhyabhūtasya gamakatvasaṃbhāvanāya gṛhyamāṇaṃ kāraṇamityuktaṃ iti draṣṭavyam |
tathā ca viṣṇoti tasmāt sadṛśamapi sādhakamasādhakaṃ veti parīkṣyatvaṃ iti |
yadi tarhi parīkṣitena ca kāraṇenāmihitena kāryamidamabhidhīyate |

'dathendriyakāmasya' ityatra vākye 'yat karma tat phalavat, karmatvāt, kṛṣvādivat' 'karmasādhyaṃ vā idaṃ phalaṃ, phalatvāt, vrīhyādivat' ityetadanumāya atha karma tat phalavat iti pratisādhanābhidhānena anaikāntikīkaroti |
uparate karmaṇi dravyāṇāṃ tantvādinā tatsaṃyogādīnāṃ ca dravyāntaraṃ paṭādi phalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ iti |
evaṃ hi śaṅkyate, kadā cidi- hāpi karmanimittameva phalaṃ vadet |
tena bravīti indriya- kāmavākye 'dadhi phalavat dravyatvāt tantuvat, indriyaṃ vā dravyajanyaṃ phalāt paṭādivat |
' api ca kṛṣernāṣṭaṃ iti hetoḥ viruddhatvaṃ vadati |
tathaiva hi ayaṃ hetuḥ karmaṇaḥ phalavattvaṃ, phalasya vā karmajanyatvaṃ sādhayati, evaṃ dṛṣṭārthaphalatvaṃ asadṛśagamakaphalatvaṃ vā sādha- yati |
tasmāt naivajātīyake kāryakāraṇabhāve samasta- hetudoṣaprasaṅgāta etadbhavati ka cit dṛṣṭadhanya aṣṭa- kathaṃ tarhi homāt nyāyyaṃ phalamiti ucyate |
'ucyate' śabdenāgamyate tat phalaṃ iti bhāvāthīdhikaraṇopanyāsena uttaram |
dadhnaḥ phala- miti cānyāyaṃ ityarthasiddhaṃ sat yaducyate, tat tulyabalavattvanirākaraṇārtham |
api ca dadhi ubhayamasamarthaṃ kartuṃ iti |
na tāvat karmānapekṣya dadhnaḥ kāraṇatvamasti, yena kevalaṃ phalasaṃbandhaiva syāt |
ata ubhayatra vidhitavyaṃ, na ca tat śakyamiti |
vā, tathāhi dadhi ubhayasamartha iti yathāśrutagṛhītena paravacanena vastusāmarthyamevoktamiti dṛśyate |
na brūma ekasyobhayaṃ prayojanaṃ na yukta- miti |
na vayaṃ vastusāmarthyaṃ apahṛtumahame, kiṃ tarhi samarthe'pi vastuni avihitatadanuṣṭhānāt avaśyaṃ dadhi ubhayārthatvena vidhātavyam |
tadiha dadhihomasaṃbhave saṃnikṛṣṭe dadhiphala- saṃbandhe ca viprakṛṣṭe yugapat vidhīyamāne yugapadeva saṃbhavā- saṃbhavau abhyupetavyau syātām |
tasāādanyataraparityāge sati tyaktasiddhisaṃbhave sati saṃnikṛṣṭatvena dadhyapi homena saṃbadhyate, so'pi phalena iti karmayukte sati phale, siddhaṃ karmāntaratvaṃ iti |
na karmā- ntaraṃ, kiṃtu guṇāt phalamiti |
'agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ' ityatra karma- samabhivyāhṛtaṃ phalaṃ svargakāmo homena kuryāditi |
nahi atra homaḥ indriyāya kartavyaḥ iti pratīyate |
homasya dadhi- saṃbandha indriyāya, na homasyotpattiḥ |
ya indriyakāmaḥ syāt, sa dadhnā homaṃ kuryāt iti |
katamo'tra śabdaḥ puruṣaprayatnasya vakteti ? 'juhuyāt' iti brūmaḥ |
nanu śrutyā homasaṃbandhaṃ eva puruṣaprayatnaṃ vadati, vākyena dadhi- saṃbandham |
na ca yugapadubhayasaṃbandho na virudhyate vākyaṃ hi tathā bhidhe- teti |
ye bhavatīdaṃ pakṣamāśrayeran, te śrutiṃ apabādherantarām |
asmadīye tu punaḥ pakṣe juhuyāt iti dhātvarthaḥ kevalaḥ apabādhito bhavati |
yuṣmadīye tu krūsena eva dadhnā śabdaḥ |
taṃ ca apramāṇyataḥ samā- mananti iti gamyate |
na caitat pramañcatītyuktaṃ 'tulyaṃ hi sāṃpradāyikaṃ' ( 1|2|18 tulyaṃ ca iti tatra pāṭhaḥ ) tasmānna karmasamabhivyāhṛtaṃ phalam |
guṇa- samabhivyāhṛte tu na kaścit pramādapātaḥ |
avaśyaṃ hi juhuyāditi dadhīndriyakāmayoḥ saṃbandhavidhānārthe vaktavyaṃ bhavati |
nanu ucyamāne'pi na kevalaḥ karotyartho'va- gamyate kevale na vacaḥprayojanam |
homasaṃbaddho'pyasau karotyartha eva, kevalaṃ tu asya homasaṃbandhe viśeṣaḥ, na tu karotyarthāṃ bādhate, indriyakāmasya homasaṃbandhaṃ prayatnaṃ dadhisaṃbandhaṃ kuryāditi |
nanu evaṃ sati eṣa doṣaḥ: homasaṃbandhimāhṛtaṃ phalamiti |
juhuyāt iti śabdasya etat sāmarthyaṃ, yat homaviśiṣṭaṃ prayatnamāha |
na tu atra homaḥ sādhanatvena vidhīyate |
ata eva ca vṛttikāreṇoktaṃ 'homāśrito guṇaḥ phalaṃ sādhayiṣyati, yathā rājapuruṣo rājānamāśrito rājakarma karoti' iti |
tasmāt dadhnaḥ phalaṃ, ya indriyakāmaḥ, sa dadhnā kuryāt indriyam iti |
asyāśca itikartavyatāyāḥ saṃnidhānāt, codanāliṅgasya ca juhotyarthasya darśanāt |
athavā dadhiśabdasya vivakṣitārthatvāt dadhihomasaṃbandho'yaṃ vākyena vidhīyate |
tena dadhno homena saṃbadhyamānāt phalaṃ bhaviṣyati iti |
vā-- yāhyeṣu vākyeṣu dhātvarthāt phalaṃ iti bhāṣyārthādhikaraṇe sādhitaṃ, taiḥ anugamyate |
tadyathā dhātvarthasaṃkrāntasya phalavatī bhāvanā āsā- dayati, tadā dhātvarthameva karaṇīkaroti, anyacca tadarthe bhavati |
tacca 'agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ' ityādiṣu nāmno vidhivyapahārasamarthatvāt avihitam |
iha tu dadhipadaṃ aśepanāmetyalakṣaṇasaṃsparśāt avaśyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ khalu uttarayati |
ataśca ākāṅkṣitadhātvarthānuvādāyāṃ dadhnurakāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ phalamupalabhyamānaṃ dadhisādhanakameva avadhāryate, na homasādhanakam |
na ca vidheyantarāpādāne sati atikrāntārtha- vidhānamavakalpate ityuktam ( 2|1|16 ) |
yathā ca dadhnā vidhyākṣepāt na homavidhānaṃ, tathā phalapadapratyavekṣa- ṇāt na home dadhividhānaṃ, kiṃ tarhi ? phalabhāvanāyām |

katamo'tra śabdaḥ puruṣapraya- tnasya vaktā iti dadhiphalapadayoḥ bhāvanā''tmakatvena sākṣāt vidhiviṣayatvānupapatteḥ ākhyātapratyapekṣaṇe ca āśritatvāt prayogasya ( 2|1|14 ) ityevaṃ dhātvartha- tyāgaśakteḥ tata eva phalena bhavitavyaṃ iti manyamānasya praśnaḥ |
siddhāntavādī tu pratyayārthavidhitvaṃ ( vidhīyatā ) dhātvarthānuvādatvaṃ ca vibhaktaṃ padayannāha juhuyāt iti |
nanu śrutyā homasaṃbandha eṣaḥ iti parasya svāmiprāya- vivaraṇam |
iha ca ye bhavatīdaṃ pakṣaṃ āśrayeran te śrutiṃ apabādherantarām |

homasya ca phala- bhāvanākaraṇatvāt 'bhāvayedindriyaṃ homena' ityevamava- sthitasya karaṇabhūtenaiva dadhnā samatvāt saṃbandhe anu- papadyamāne avaśyaṃ mattvarthalakṣaṇā parigṛhyate 'dadhimatā homena' iti |
na ca tasyāṃ kiṃ cit pramāṇamasti |
na ca dadhiśabdasya asati pravṛttinimitte karma- nāmadheyatvaṃ ghaṭate |
so'yaṃ ubhayasāt bhraṣṭo dadhi- śabdaḥ anarthakaṃ eva prāpnoti |
tataśca śabda- dharmasainikaprigraheṇa dharmyaṃ śabdaḥ parityāgāt bādhitaḥ: iti dhātvarthatā śrutiḥ |
na cāsyoccāraṇaṃ śakyaṃ kena ciddhātunā vinā |
' pratyayatvāt avaśyameva dadhī- ndriyaviśiṣṭaṃ bhāvanāṃ vidhātumuccāritavyaḥ |
sa ca kevala- prayogāsaṃbhavāt dhātuvyatiriktaprakalpyanupapatteḥ yataḥ:kṛta- ścit dhātoḥ para uccārayitavyaḥ |
tataśca yatracana dhātau upādātavye prāpte prakaraṇaprāptahomopādānaṃ aṅgīkṛtam |
dadhisaṃbandho'pi cāsya prakaraṇadeva āśrayāśrayirūpaḥ prāptaḥ anudiśyate |

yathā ca na vibhaktervacanameva ekaṃ prayojanaṃ, iti mahādiṣu kārakamātrapratipatyarthe uccāryamāṇa- nāntarīyakatvāt avivakṣitatāmapi saṃkhyāṃ prāyayati iti vakṣyate ( 1|1|14 ) , tathā atra pratyayānu- grahārthamapi dhātuuccāryamāṇaḥ saṃdhravyatvāt avivakṣita- mapi svārthaṃ pratyāyayati |
nahi tasya arthapratyāyanamātrameva ekaṃ prayojanaṃ iti vaktavyam |
nanu ucyamāne'pi iti, pratyayānugrahārthe dhātuuccāryamāṇaḥ: svārthe pratyaya- yati iti |
na cāsya advaitatvaṃ avivakṣākāraṇaṃ kiṃ cidasti |
vastu homasaṃbandho viśeṣaḥ, nāsī kiṃcit virupaddhi, prakārāntareṇa vā bhāvanāṃ viśeṣayati |
nanu evaṃ sati sa eva doṣaḥ iti, aparitajyamāno'pi homo balāt karaṇībhavati iti manyate |
siddhāntavādī tvāha-vākyā- ntarāstasya juhuyāditi śabdasya etat sāmarthyaṃ yena taveyaṃ bhrāṃtirbhavati homa eva karamiti |
nipuṇastva padayāta yathaiva pratyāsatteḥ sādhyāṃśamupādhāya ayogyatā pracyāvyate, tathā atra dadhipadānurodhena sādhanāt |
yathā ca tatra pratīyamānaṃ bhāvanāviśeṣaṇaṃ aṃśāntare avasthitaṃ, evamihāpi guṇāśrayatvena avasthāyate |
yathoktaṃ vṛttikāreṇa ( upavarṇeṇa ) homāśrito guṇaḥ phalaṃ sādhayiṣyati iti |
kaḥ punaḥ āśrayāśrayisaṃbandho nāma, kiṃ-kena-kathaṃ-bhāvyatiriktaḥ, uta atyatirikta iti |

kāraṇībhūtaguṇasattvena vacanaṃ vinā'pi phalapaṭhisaṃbhavatvāt vacanavaiyarthyaprasaṅgena svakṛtisādhyā- ghāryatvasya dṛṣṭavidhayā guṇasaṃbandhenaḥ āśravya apekṣāyāṃ, prakaraṇāt homasya āśrayatvalābhāt juhotiḥ sādhutvārtha- manuvādaḥ |
ke cittu karaṇatvaviśiṣṭaṃ dadhi, dadhikaraṇatvaṃ vā tṛtī- yāpāṃtaṃ phalakaraṇatvena vidhīyate |
prayojanaṃ daṇḍo na pratinidhiḥ ullekhaviśeṣo vā iti siddhānte draṣṭavyam |
bāla. pṛ. 117-119. indriyakāmādhikaraṇe guṇā- dapi phalaṃ sādhitam |

vā. 3|6|143 pṛ. 1069. indriyakāmādhikaraṇasiddhasyaiva guṇaphalasaṃbandhasya ākṣepasamādhānaṃ dākṣāyaṇayajñādhikaraṇe ( 2|3|14-15 ) |
