bhāṭṭa. 10|5|18. na ca revatyadhikaraṇa- ( 2|1|2|28-29 ) nyāyāpekṣayā laghubhūtendriyakāmā- dhikaraṇanyāyena guṇaphalasaṃbandhavidhirupapadyate |

kau. 2|1|3| 27 pṛ. 295, saṃkramaṇacena yajetānnādyakāmaḥ' atra dvayoḥ ( kriyā-phalayoḥ ) svarūpeṇa prāsibat atrāphale'pi kriyāyāḥ sārvakāmyavākyena prāptatvāt aprāptaguṇavini- yoge eva vidhisaṃkramaṇāt yuktaḥ indriyakāmādhikaraṇa- nyāyena guṇaphalasaṃbandhaḥ |
2|3|1|10 pṛ. 44, 'hīp iti vṛṣṭikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt' dadhyādivat guṇasaṃkrānta- śaktinā vidhinā indriyakāmādhikaraṇanyāyena hīpādika- meva tatphaladeśena vidhīyate ( pūrvapakṣe ) |

2|3|1| 27 pṛ. 295. utpattivākyena sarvāṇi prākaraṇika- kāni guṇaphalanimittavākyāni saṃbadhyante, na paraspareṇa ' iti indriyakāmādhikaraṇavyavamāpanānyena prayoga- vākye bhāvanotpatyābhāvāt nānyeṣāṃ taccheṣatvaṃ saṃbhavati ityāśaṅkya |
indriyatvaṃ saṃvaddhārthaviśadāvabhāsakatvaṃ, aparokṣa- jñānajanakadravyaṃ vā, jñānānāśrayatve sati jñānakāraṇa- manaḥsaṃyogāśrayatvaṃ vā |
tatra ādyāni catvāri gandha- rasasparśaprāmātrābhivyañjakatvā gandhādimattvānumānena pṛthivyaptejovāyuprakṛtīni |
'guṇādīnāṃ tvaṃsaṃbandhāt ' iti vārttikanyāyena indriyavākyasya dadhihomānyakāri- vākyevākyatvābhāvāt na indriyavākye takārahomānvaya- grahaṇam |
( 'guṇādīnāṃ tvaṃsaṃbandhāt vyavidhiḥ syāt parasparam' vā. 2|1|2|25 pṛ. 541 |
bāla. pṛ. 25. 'imāmagṛbhṇan- raśanāmṛtasyetyasyābhidhānīmādatte' iti pratyakṣavacane abhidhānidhānāne mantrasya viniyoge sati na liṅgāt gardabharaśanā''dāne viniyogaḥ |
evaṃ ca liṅgāt anya- vastvayā viniyogasya prathamaprasakteḥ na vyavasthā'rthe vacanapravṛttiḥ; kiṃtu jhaṭiti vacane pravṛtte sati arthādeva vyavasthāsiddhiḥ |
'iṣuṃ viṣṭṛti karoti' iṣuṃ yāge viṣṭṛtī kuśānidhānaṃ iṣvākāraṃ kuryāt ( iṣuṃ vāṇam ) |
yathā dhanuṣaḥ sakāśāt muktasya iṣoḥ bāṇasya karmaṇaḥ prārabdhavegākṣayādeva kṣayaḥ iti prasiddhaṃ, tathā prakṛte'pi |
'iṣe tvā' ityanena eko'rthaḥ kriyate, 'ūrje tvā' ityanenāparaḥ |
bhā. 2|1|15|43. 'iṣe tveti śākhāṃ chinatti' iyaṃ itikaraṇarūpā viniyogentrī śrutiḥ someśraratena |
irāpadaṃ girāpadasthāne gātavyaṃ jyotiṣṭome yajñajñayīye sāmni |
na irāpadasyapadeśe kiṃ cit kāraṇaṃ gṛhyate |
tasmāt tasyopadeśaḥ ( airaṃ kṛtvādeyaṃ iti ), sa karmakāle vidhānāt samāmnāye prāptaṃ girāpadaṃ bādhate |
ṭup. 9|1|18|55. irāpade girāpadadharmā bhaveyuḥ jyotiṣṭome yajñajñayīye |
iṣuḥ nāma ekāḥ, aparaḥ śyenaḥ, tau dvāvapi ābhicārikau |
'iṣuṃ viṣṭṛti karoti' iṣuṃ yāge viṣṭṛtī kuśānidhānaṃ iṣvākāraṃ kuryāt ( iṣuṃ vāṇam ) |
yathā dhanuṣaḥ sakāśāt muktasya iṣoḥ bāṇasya karmaṇaḥ prārabdhavegākṣayādeva kṣayaḥ iti prasiddhaṃ, tathā prakṛte'pi |
'iṣe tvā' ityanena eko'rthaḥ kriyate, 'ūrje tvā' ityanenāparaḥ |
bhā. 2|1|15|43. 'iṣe tveti śākhāṃ chinatti' iyaṃ itikaraṇarūpā viniyogentrī śrutiḥ someśraratena |
iṣṭa - ( yaj ) śiṣyasya hi pratipattirūpaḥ saṃskāraḥ |
yadi vā upavāpamatvena tuṣāṇāmanvaye tādṛśaniyamasya vyabhicāraḥ iti vibhāvyate, tadā ākīrṇakarapratipatti karmatvātirikta karmatvānvaye niyamaḥ |
agnicayane mumyatha eva, na tu dhātu- mayyaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|2, tāśca sāstrikāḥ kāryāḥ na tu aniyatasaṃsthānāḥ |
2|1|2, tāśca sarvā abhripakā eva, nairṛtyastu tupapakkāḥ |
iti prāpte, 'tadvā- nāsāmupadhāno mantraḥ' iti smṛtyā ( pā0 4|1|125 )
prāṇabhṛtpadaghaṭitamantrakaraṇatvenopapattau na prāṇihiṃsā niṣedha- saṃkoco yukta iti|
saṃkarṣa. 1|1|23. iṣṭakā: citriṇya: vajñiṇya: bhūteṣṭakā:; etā madhyamāyā~ citau lokaṃpnāta: pūrvamupadheyā agniyane|
vi. 5|13-8. iṣṭakā: na paśuśīrṣādisthale niveśyā: antarālapūraṇārtham |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|4. iṣṭakāyā: svayamātṛṇṇayā upadhāne upadhānakartre varadānaṃ adhvaryu- kartṛkaṃ, vacanabalāt |
vi. 3|8|2. iṣṭakānāṃ agni- cayanasādhanabhūtānāṃ alpaṇḍatvādayo dharmā:, na tu prathama- citidharmā: |
tasmāt citriṇyādiṣvapi te santi agnya- pūrvasaṃvanivaidhaiva tāsāmapi vākyena viniyuktvāt |
3|6|12. iṣṭakānāṃ anāramyadhītānāṃ aśeṣatā, na tu citiśeṣatā |
tena tā: sakṛdupadhātavyā:, na tu prati- citi |
mā. 5|13|15-16. iṣṭakānāṃ nirmāṇaṃ na yāthākāmyena kiṃtu dīkṣottarakālameva |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|28, dīkṣāta: pūrvamapi prājāpatyapaśo: parata: iṣṭakākaraṇakāla: |
vi. 5|13|0. iṣṭakāsu ukhyabhasma spṛṣṭe tena sarvā agnayo bhavanti |
vi. 9|1|8. iṣṭakādharmā: ke cit ammannīya durvādiṣu api bhavanti cayane |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|8. iṣṭakāpākārthe agnicayane yo nimentyo'gni:, sa manthanasādhyo laukika: śāstrīyasaṃskārarahita: |
vi. 7|3|7, iṣṭakāpākārthe nirmantyāgnī agnīmīpayyagatanirmantyāgnidharmāṇāṃ nāti- deśa: |
iṣṭakāpāda: nāma saṃkarṣakāṇḍe tṛtīyādhyāyasya dvitīya: pāda: |
ke. iṣṭakāśabdastha mūle (bhāṣye) jātivacanatvaṃ nirākṛtya ākṛtivacanatvaṃ arthasaṃśayānantaraṃ sādhitaṃ, tatrātītopapattaṃ ayuktaṃ caityupakṣiptam |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|1. iṣṭakopadhānaṃ ' brahmasṛjvata, bhūtātmasṛjyanta ' ityādīn sṛjavādyudghaṭitān mantrān ' sṛṣṭīrupadadhāti ' ityanena vidhīyate |
vi. 3|4|17, iṣṭakopadhānavidhi: ' artha purobhuvastasya prāṇo bhautrāyana: ' ityādiprakaraṇaprāptamantrādane ' prāṇa- bhṛta upadadhāti ' iti |
iṣṭi: ārambhaṇīyā somasya aṅgabhūtāt dīkṣaṇīyā- dikāt nivartate|
' darśapūrṇamāsāvārambhamāṇa: ' iti ārambhadvārā darśapūrṇamāsāṅgaṃ iṣṭiravagatā: na ca somaprayoga- madhyavartināṃ dīkṣaṇīyādīnāṃ ārambho'sti |
sājātyaṃ ca sākṣāt paraṃparayā vā tadyathā nodeyyakatvena |
tasyā jyotiṣṭomā- jñatvāt yata: iṣṭi: ārambhānaṃ, sa cārambha: pradhānena saṃyukta: ārambhasya pradhānasaṃyogāt |
tādṛśārambhasya aṅgabhūtadīkṣaṇīyāyāmabhāvāt dvāralopena aṅgabhūtadīkṣaṇī- yāyā: ārambhaṇīyā nivartate |
tasmāt dīkṣaṇīyā''diṣu ārambhaṇīyāyā bāgha iti siddhānta: |
bhā. 6|8|17, iṣṭya: adhvarakalpā, sarvapṛṣṭhā, mṛgārā, sumanā: ityādaya: |
tatra darśapaurṇamāsika eva vidhyante, na saumika:, na vā vikalpa: ubhayo: |
vi. 1|2|13. iṣṭya: paśava: somā: kāmyā: na pāṭhakrameṇa kartavyā:, yathākāmaṃ te kartavyā: |
bhā. 5|3|1|22-36. iṣṭya: paśavaśca agni- ṣṭomānuṣṭhānāt prāgapyanuṣṭhātuṃ śakyante |
vi. 5|3|14. iṣṭya: vaikṛtya: darśapaurṇamāsābhyāṃ tulyakālā api satya: na darśapaurṇamāsikaṃ tantramupajīvanti |
na ca tulya- kālatve prasaṅgo bhavati |
1|0|12|14|9. iṣṭināṃ kāmyānāṃ nityānāṃ vā prakṛtivikṛtibhūtānāṃ parvapyevānuṣṭhānam |
' ya iṣṭyā paśunā somena vā yajate so'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā ' ityuktvāt |
vi. 1|2|12, iṣṭināṃ kāmyānāṃ naimittikānāṃ ca anuṣṭhāne pāṭhakramo na niyāmaka: |
kiṃtu kāmo vā nimittaṃ vā niyāmakam |

5|3|12. iṣṭṭiṣu atideśakāni prakṛtiliṅgāni 1 taddhitena devatānirdeśa:, 2 ekadevatvaṃ, 3 dvidevatvaṃ, 4 auṣadha- dravyakatvaṃ, 5 ājyadravyakatvaṃ, 6 payodravyakatvaṃ, 7 dadhi- dravyakatvaṃ, 8 ummvalaviśadadravyakatvaṃ, 9 pañcaprabhavagatamida- dravyakatvaṃ, 10 nirvapatimantra iti aṣṭādhyāye uktāni |
vāla pu. 119. iṣṭṭiṣu aliṅgāsvapi (darśapūrṇamāsa- liṅgasvapi) sthālīpulākavat darśapūrṇamāsavidha- ntasya siddhi: |
' vidhito'pi nyāyapūrva:, sa ca nyāya- stulya: sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ vaikṛtānāṃ liṅgavatāmaliṅgavatāṃ ca |
' bhā. 7|1|4|12, iṣṭṭiṣu aindrāgnādiṣu darśapūrṇamāsa- rūpaprakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogo bhavati |
kiṃ punastat prakṛtiliṅgaṃ ? taddhitena devatopadeśa:, kapālavattā, nirvapatiśabdaśca |
' aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet ' iti ' aindrāgmo dvādaśakapāla: ' iti |
iṣṭṭiṣu darśapūrṇamāsayo: pravṛtti: ' (8|1|4| 11) ityanena nyāyena dārśapaurṇamāsikānāṃ phala- niyama-kartṛ-samudāyānāṃ sauryādiṣu pravṛttiriti pūrva: pakṣa: |
' aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet prajākāma: ' ityeva- mādyāsu iṣṭṭiṣu darśapūrṇamāsayo: pravṛtti: syāt |
codanāyāṃ prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogastu taddhitena devatopadeśa:, kapālavattā, nirvapatiśabdaśca |
' āgneyo'ṣṭākapāla: ' ' agnihotra- havaṇyā havīṃṣi nirvapati ' iti prakṛtau |
' aindrāgme- kādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet ' iti tu atra |
saurye tu ' sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet ' iti ' prāyeṇaprayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti ' iti ca liṅgam |
8|1|5|18, iṣṭṭiṣu somāṅgabhūtāsu śeṣabhakṣāṇāṃ somāṅgadakṣiṇayā prasaṅgasiddhi- rnāsti |
12|1|18|8-9. iṣṭṭicāturmāsyeṣu kārtikāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ kāści- diṣṭṭayo vihitā: |
tāstu vakṣyamāṇena nyāyena ' ya iṣṭyā ' iti vākyavaśena anyeṣṭivat sasyakālā eveti avivādam |
' prajākāmaṃ caturhotrā yājayet, caturgrahītamājyaṃ gṛhītvā caturhotāraṃ vyācakṣīta |
pūrveṇa arheṇārthe juhuyāt, tadu- ttareṇārthe ' iti |
yadyapi artha homa: akṛtaśeṣa: kṛtaśeṣo na bhavati ata eva apūrvo'pi, tathāpi sarvahomānāṃ iṣṭṭipūrvatvāt iṣṭṭipūrvatvāt pavamāneṣṭibhi: saṃskṛteṣveva agniṣu syāt |
ādhānasya sarvaśeṣatvāt sarvavaidika- karmaśeṣatvāt pavamāneṣṭīnāṃ ca ādhānāttvāt |
tasmāt ādhānena iṣṭṭibhiśca saṃskṛteṣu agniṣu caturhotrahoma: iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ tuśabdena nirasyan siddhāntayati |
na caturhotrahoma: saṃskṛteṣvagniṣu bhavati, yata: ' eṣā vā anāhitāgnereṣṭi: yaccaturhotāra: ' iti caturhotraṃ mantrān, caturhotreṣukramakaraṇakahomān asaṃskṛteṣu agniṣu
nanu tarhi 'eṣā vā iṣṭiḥ' iti iṣṭitvamuktaṃ kathaṃ saṃgacchate tatrāha- iṣṭitvena tu saṃstvaḥ asya homasya stutimātram |
siddhānte liṅgamidamuktaṃ, prātirvaktavyā iti cet tatrāha |
sa vidhiḥ sarveṣāṃ akṛtaśeṣoṣāṃ kratuśeṣāṇāṃ ca caturhotṛhomānāṃ syāt |
aviśeṣāt, caturhotaṇāmayaṃ dharmaḥ, nātra akṛtaśeṣāṇāmeveti viśeṣa uktaḥ |
tasmāt iṣṭirājasūyācāturmāsyeṣu prayogānurodhena ajñānā- māvṛttiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ|
bhāṣyam-- darśapūrṇamāsebhyāṃ dvau samudāyā darśa- pūrṇamāsaśca |
tathā rājasūye anumatyādaya iṣṭayaḥ pavitrādayaḥ somāḥ |
tatra vicāryate kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsasya ca tantreṇa ajñānāṃ prayogaḥ, tathā rājasūye iṣṭīnāṃ somānāṃ ca cāturmāsyeṣu ca parvāṇāṃ, uta medaneti |
oṃ iṣṭyante (dīkṣaṇīyā'nte) eva dīkṣitatvaṃ, tasya ca abhivyañjanamātrārthaṃ daṇḍādayaḥ iti iṣṭyante eva dīkṣitadharmāḥ pravartan |
' alokikatvena 'etāvaddi- raṅgaiḥ saṃpūrṇa upakāraḥ ' iti niśretumaśakyatvāt iṣṭyādau nāsti mūlaprakṛtitvam |
yathā laukikabuddhikriyāyāṃ odanaḥ karaṇaṃ, tasyāḥ saṃnipatyopakāriṇaḥ śāstropapādayāḥ, ārādupakāriṇaḥ pīṭhadīpādayaḥ |
tathā bhāvanāyāṃ yāgaḥ karaṇaṃ, avaghātā- dayaḥ saṃnipātinaḥ, prayājādaya ārādupakāriṇaḥ |
iptā tu laukike yathā pratyakṣaṃ niśrīyate, tathā śraute śrutyā niśrīyatām |
agnyādheyaṃ pavamāneṣṭyathaṃ vā na veti vicāre pūrva- pakṣamāha |
yat yasya prakaraṇe paṭhyate tattadartha bhavati |
pavamāneṣṭyo nādhānānāṃ iti siddhānte helantaraparaṃ sūtram |
' jīryati ha vai eṣa āhitaḥ paśuḥ |
tenaitaṃ punarnavaṃ karoti ' iti liṅgaṃ pavamāneṣṭau agnyārthatve liṅgam |
etābhiriṣṭibhirhi agniḥ punaḥ navo bhavati ityuktamatra |
darśapūrṇamāsārambhe ārambhaṇīyā iṣṭiḥ samāmnātā ' āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśapālaṃ nirvapeta, sarasvatyai caruṃ, sarasvate dvādaśapālaṃ, agneye magniṣṭomāt nirvapeta yaḥ kāmayetānnādaḥ syāmiti |
darśapūrṇamāsayośca ' yāvajjīvaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ yajeta' iti āvṛttiḥ śrutā |
tayorāvṛttyoḥ kiṃ ārambhaṇīyā'pi āvarteta, uta neti vicāre pūrvapakṣa- māha |
iṣṭyāvṛttau darśapūrṇamāseṣṭyoḥ āvṛttau satyāṃ ārambhaṇīyā āvarteta |
ārambhaḥ punaḥ ārambhastu yāvajjīvaprayogāt yāvajjīvaprayogamudiśya eka eva |
su. pṛ. 890. oṃ īpsitaṃ karma caturvidham |
oṃ īpsitatamaṃ hi yat sādhanaṃ, tat dvitīyā'ntenocyate |
bhāṣṭa. 6|4|6. oṃ īrṣyā hi vivekaparipanyanīti nyāyaḥ |
sā vivekasya ' idaṃ heyamidamupādeyaṃ iti ' vivecanāyāḥ paripanthī śatrurūpetyarthaḥ |
sāhasī. 944. oṃ ' īśānāya paśyata ālabhate, tān paryabhikṛtā- nusṛjati ' iti īśānāye gṛdhramedhīyājabhāganyāyena (10|3|9|24) codakaparilopāt ārthikaḥ aṅgā- ntarapratiṣedhaḥ |
upaniṣadādiprāmāṇagamyamīśvaramaṅgīkṛtya tadicchaiva tattadākārikā vede liṅgayarthaḥ tātparyarūpā ca |

rahasya. pṛ. 15. oṃ ' īśvaro vā eṣa diśo'numaditoḥ yadidaśo'nu vyavasthāpayanti diśāmave- dhyo bhavanti dikṣveva pratiṣṭhitanumādāya ' iti digvyavasthāpananimittamodaparivārāhatayā śrūyamāṇā rājasūyāntargatā aveṣṭiḥ iti |
na ca tasya kaścit sraṣṭā ' iti bindau dravyaḥ : ślokavārtikasya |

( ṛju - (pṛ. 141) atra ke cit arthavādagatasṛṣṭipalayaśrutyupanipātamātropa- jātaśraddhātiśayavipralambhabuddhayaḥ kaṇabhakṣākṣacaraṇamatapravaṇa- cetasaḥ sarvasya tanubhuvanādeḥ īśvaraṃ kāraṇaṃ ācakṣāṇāḥ pracakṣate |
karma ca adṛṣṭadāmasaṃyogādeva paramāṇuṣu prati- jñāyate |
tadukte ' anumānasodhācca karmaitadahakāritāni ' ( vai. sū. 5|1|23 ) iti |
na nācetanaṃ cetananadhiṣṭhitaṃ ka cidapi kārye paryoproti vāsyādikamiva |
na cetamucitaṃ ya eva te kṣetrajñāḥ, ta eva tepāmadṛṣṭānāmadhaṣṭhātāro bhaveyuriti |
jñātā hi padārthasya padārthasāmarthyasya ca adhiṣṭhātā upalabhyate, yathā takṣā vāsyāḥ |
na ca kṣetrajñāḥ svasamavāyinī api dharmādharmalakṣaṇe adṛṣṭe svarūpataḥ śaktito vā veditumalaṃ iti tadatirekī cetanaḥ kalpyate |
tena cetanātiśayā- dviṣṭhitādṛṣṭavaśeṣajātakaminimittayogasvaparamāṇvārabdha- ṇukādikāryaparaṃparāsaṃbhūtaṃ tanubhuvanādikaṃ ādimat avagamyate |
tathā upacittam sakalaṃ vināśyayogi iti sādhitam |
tadidaṃ pratipakṣapakṣakāmapi naroddhaṃ kramate ityupekṣitaṃ bhagavatā bhāṣyanibandhadhanakāreṇa |
yadyapi sidhyedayaṃ manorathaḥ, tathāpi kathamekadaiva sarve avayavino vilīyante iti samadhigamanīyam |
adhuneva kimiti kasya cidudayaḥ kasya cidvilaya iti nāṅgīkriyate dṛṣṭānumāt iti manyāmaha |
api ca yadi kṣetrajñāḥ : nādhiṣṭhātāraḥ : jñānābhāvāt anyastarhi kathamadhiṣṭhātā, tasyāpi jñānā- nutpatteḥ |
sāmā- nyottheṣamapi na dṛṣṭopamardena ka dṛṣṭopamardena ka cittaṃ vartate |
nanu etadapi dṛṣṭaṃ ' cetanānadhiṣṭhitaṃ acetanaṃ na pravartate ' iti |
satyaṃ ubhayatra parihāṇe kiṃ parihīyatāmiti, tatra viśeṣaviṣayatvāt asmadīyameva jñānodayakāraṇāntarānumānaṃ ādaraṇīyam, na punaḥ īśvaravādināṃ atyantasāmānyaviṣayaṃ acetanaṃ cetanādhiṣṭhitaṃ iti |
taduktaṃ bhagavatā vārtikakāreṇa - ' prasiddhāvayavaṃ yasmādaviśeṣe pratiṣṭhitam |
etena idamapi parākṛtaṃ bhavati ' nityaiva īśvarasya buddhiḥ ' iti |
yato yāvā buddhiḥ sāsā utpattimī vināśinau ca |
yādṛśaṃ hi vāsyādiṣu karasaṃyogādikaṃ adhiṣṭhānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, tādṛśameva adṛṣṭe'pi anumātavyam |
yathā vāsyā kriyākāṣṭhādisaṃyogasya, ātma- lābhaśca adṛṣṭasya yāgādyanuṣṭhānasiddha eva |
maṇi. pṛ. 170. īśvaranirāsaḥ kṛtaḥ ( vārtikakāraiḥ : ślokavārtike. saṃjñatvākṣeparihāraparicchede ) padapadārthasaṃbandhasya īśvara- kṛtasaṃketātmakatve vedāprāmāṇyāpatteḥ |
tatra hi khalu jagati bhāvā bhavanti |
te ca vivādādhyāsitā upalabdhimatkartṛkāḥ kāryatvāccetano- pādānatvādā, yatkāryamacetanopādānaṃ vā tatsarvamupalabh- makartṛkaṃ yathā prāsādādi, tathā ca tantubhuvanādayaḥ |
na ca pṛthivyādīnāṃ kāryatvamasiddhe, mahattve sati kriyāvattvena vā sāvayavatvena vā vastrādivat tasiddheḥ |
abhimataṃ hi pareṣāāmapi karmajatvāt kāryajātasya krameṇaśretanahetu- tvāt kāraṇavarṇaṃ jagataḥ |
sarvajñapūrvakatve tu na tena hetoḥ vyāptirduṣṭacarī |
viruddhatā ca hetoḥ asarvajñapūrvakatve- naiva kummādī upattimattvasya vā cetanopādānatvasya vā vyāpterupalambheḥ |
na ca upalabdhimatpūrvatvamātraṃ sādhana- viṣayaḥ, tadviśeṣasya tu sarvajñapūrvakatvāt tadviṣayasyāpi tataḥ siddhiriti sāmpratam |
tathāhi, yadyasau viśeṣo na sādhanavyāptaḥ kathamattatsiddhiḥ, siddhatvāt kathaṃmaviṣayaḥ, viṣayaśca kathaṃ na svāśrayāt tadupagati spṛśet ?
sāmānyamātravyāptau api antarbhā- vitaviśeṣasya sāmānyasya pakṣadharmatāvaśena sādhyadharmiṇyanu- mānāt |
tathāhi, vahyanumānamapi na vahnisāmānyamātraviṣayaṃ, tasya prāgeva siddhatvāt |
nāpi tadviśiṣṭagirigocaraṃ, vahnivasāmā- nyasya tatsaṃbandhābhāvena tadviśeṣaṇatvā''nupapatteḥ |
itarathā golasasamavāyādiva gāvaḥ : śāmbetyādayaḥ parvate'pi vahvilasamavāyāt vahniḥ prasajyate |
asti ca vahnitvena gireḥ saṃyuktasamavāyaḥ saṃbandha iti, tarhi nā''prati- padya parvatasaṃyukta vahniviśeṣaṃ asau śakyapratipattiriti vahniviśeṣasyāpi anumānam |
tatrāpi nendriyakaraṇikā kā cit kriyā upalavdhā |
na khalu chidādyaḥ : kriyāḥ indriyasādhanāḥ, traśanādīnāmani- ndriyatvāt |
na ca traśanādisādhanāḥ saṃbhavanti rūpādipari- cchidalakṣaṇāḥ : kriyāḥ |

tasmāccaiva kriyāsāmānyāsya satyapi karaṇāmādhīnatvamavyāptatve pakṣadharmatāvaśāda indriya- lakṣaṇakaṇaviśeṣasiddhiḥ, tayehāpi satyapi utpattimatastasya acetanopādānatvasya ca upādānopakaraṇasaṃ pradānaprayo- janajakartṛmātramānatve vivādādhyāsiteṣu pakṣadharmatāvalād viśiṣṭasya tasya siddhiḥ |
anyathā sāmānyasyāpi nyāya- kāmitasya asiddhiḥ syāt, nirviśeṣasya asaṃbhavāt, viśeṣasya cānyasya anupapatteḥ |

asarvajñasya ca adṛṣṭā- dimedavijñānarahitasya adhiṣṭhātṛbhāvā'saṃbhavāt tena yadyapi upalabdhimatkartṛkatvaṃ nyāyaviṣayaḥ, tathāpi tadvi- śeṣasya pakṣadharmatātvāt pratilabham : iti viśeṣaviṣayamanu- mānam |
tasya sādhyadṛṣṭāntayordharma- vikalātva utkarṣapakarṣārṇayogasya sarvānumānasādhāraṇyena anumānamātrāprāmāṇyapratikṣepahetutvāt |

atra īpsitaprasiddhāyattasādhanaṃ śabdoktaṃ, tadāyatto- pādānādiviṣayatvāt, yasya yadāyattamupādānādiviṣayatvaṃ tat tatsiddhāyattasādhanaṃ, yathā dhūmo vahnayādeśa- viśeṣasiddhayadhīnopādānādiviṣayatvaḥ tadadhīnasiddhiriti |
īśvaraprerito gacchet svargaṃ vā śvabhrameva vā |
asti hi śrutiḥ ' apāṇipādo javano grahītā paśyatyacakṣuḥ sa śṛṇotyakarṇaḥ |
sa vetti viśvaṃ nahi tasyāsti vettā tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam |
asaṃkhyeyasthāvarādilakṣaṇakāryadarśanāt akhilaviṣayanityavijñānamātraśālī ṣaḍguṇa īśvaraḥ seddhu- marhati |
kumbhamacikīrṣuḥ cikī- rṣurvā tadupādānādiṣu alasatayā aprayatamānaḥ kumbhāra- mbhāya kalpate |
tasmāt jñānacikīrṣāprayatnasamudāyena janmā- kāryatvādi na jñānamātraṃ bhavitumarhati |
pṛthagjana- jñānavilakṣaṇamīśvarajñānaṃ asahāyameva viśvasmin kāryaṃ paryāptamiti cet ? hanta bhoḥ kimasya jñānenāpi svarūpā- tiśayaḥ evāsyāḥ sahāyaḥ tatratatra kāryaṃ vatsyatīti |
nanu tasyaiva sta eva kṣetrajñagatau dharmādharmau, santi ca paramāṇavaḥ sahāyāḥ |
avijñātāste na pravartante iti jñānamepitāvyamiti cet |
atha avijñātāste kasmānna pravartante ? tathā anupalabbhāt kumbhāyupāyeyiṣyati cet |
sa ca prayatnabhede iti prayatnahetubheda eva sākṣātkārodaye heturiti kathaṃ tama- ntareṇa tatsaṃbhavaḥ ? nahi vahnimantareṇa tṛṣakṣepaṇaphūtkāra- mātrādeva odanaṃ sidhyati |

yadi manyate svataḥ eva cikīrṣāprayatnau api bhagavatīśvare iti ? atha kimetau nityau anityau vā ? nityau cet kṛtamīśvarasya jñānena cikīrṣāprayatnotpādā'nupayogā, tayornityatayā svopādo- payogānapekṣatvāt |
na ca prayatnavat jñānamapi sākṣāt kāryopādānāṅgam |

prayatnabhedena khalu ayamadhiṣṭhityu- pādānādi, na tu samaye jñānasya kaścidupayogaścikīrṣāyā vā, niṣpāditakriye karmaṇi aviśeṣādhādyinaḥ sādhanasya sādhanavyātipātāt iti dattajalāñjalīśvarasya sarva- jñatā |
tataḥ kimapareṇa kāraṇena ? aho bata pramādo yadayaṃ ' ātmanaḥ saṃyoga- viśeṣapasamavāyikāraṇau icchāprayatnī tamanatareṇa jñāna- mātrādeva bhavataḥ ' ityapi vaktumavasitaḥ |

tena tashāyaḥ tatra cikīrṣā- prayatnadvayaṃ yugapat prasṛte tathākāryojananāya ' iti cet ? nanu manāṃsi tasaṃyogāśca kimanviṣṭhitāni cikīrṣāprayatnau pradhuvate adhiṣṭhitāni vā ? yadyanadhiṣṭhitāni, tatastatraiva vyabhicāraḥ |

'prayatnāntareṇa cikīrṣā'ntarajanmā tadadhiṣṭhānaṃ, na cānava- sthānaṃ, anāditvāt cikīrṣāprayatnapravāhasya ' iti cet ? yathā amyutannarsaṃjñīhepaḥ īśvaraḥ kṣetrajñeṣu pratibandhacchate dharmādharmanicayeṣu jagati ca paramāṇavvyāmāpāce nirdhyāpāraḥ |

kiyantamapi kālaṃ sthitvā cikīrṣati prayatate vā, tadā tasya cikīrṣāprayatnaurjanitayonai sthitaṃ cikīrṣā'ntaraṃ vā prayatna'ntaraṃ vā samasthitau kuto manasāṃ tasaṃyogānāṃ vā adhiṣṭhānaṃ ? ityanadhiṣṭhityo manasta- saṃyogebhyo na prayatnacikīrṣe upadheyatām |
upadyamāne vā kathaṃ kāryatvaṃ acetanopādānatvaṃ vā na hetuṃ vyabhicārataḥ |
na ca savitṛprakāśavadīśvarasya jñāna- mātreṇānnātra prayatnamātraṃ tattaccāvamedopadhānāt tadiyaṃ bhavatīti sāṃpratam |
upadyīmānā- dhiṣṭhāne tadupadhānasya kāryasya anupādāt, tasya ca adhi- ṣṭhānādupayeteriti |
so'yamīdṛśo viśeṣo vicārasahaḥ kathaṃ pakṣadharmatāvalapi sādhyadharmiṇi upasaṃhiyate ? nahi svayamapyupadyamānaṃ anyasyopapādanāyālama |
kā tarhi sāmānyasya ānumānikasya asati viśeṣe gatiḥ ? kimavaśyamavitavyamasya gatyā ? nanu pramāṇasiddhamupāda- nīyaṃ, yasya anumā upapadyate |
tasya nāma vādinaḥ yaḥ sahasahāyaniḥsahāyanimittatvādi viśeṣaparihārāya gaganakusumāyamāne kṣityādivartini buddhimatpūrvakatvasāmānya- sāmānyaṃ sādhanārhaṃ sādhanaṃ prayojayati |
na ca saṃbhavati tādṛśo viśeṣo, yamādhāya kṣityādau buddhimatpūrvakatvasāmānyaṃ vyatiṣṭheta |
nahi na saṃbhavati parvatatanmavatrtiviśiṣṭaviśeṣaḥ : anubhūtasvarūpasya vā taijasaścaruravayavo rūpopalambhasādhanam |

tasmāt yathā kaściccitrāstacchi acchedyamākāśaṃ prati vyāpārayan puruṣo nigṛhyate, na punarasirākācaṃ vā, tadvat kāryatvama- cetanopādānatvaṃ vā tarkasahāyaṃ labdhaparipākādṛṣṭavat- kṣetrajñaparamāṇvādi saṃyogakāraṇāmātravibhyamīśvare sarve iti |
' sarvajñatāvādāryaḥ ' iti vindau vidhivivekagranthe 22 kārikāyāṃ draṣṭavyaḥ |
tatra naiyā- yikābhimateśvarasya nirāsaḥ sarvajñatānirāsadvārā sādhitaḥ |
veda eveśvarasiddhau pramāṇaṃ nānyat iti maṇiḥ |
ke cidevamanumānaṃ vadanti, vivādādhyāsitaṃ sakartṛkaṃ kāryatvāt, yatkāryaṃ tat sakartṛkaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ, tathedamaṃ tasmāt |
atra saṃdigdha- kartṛkaṃ bhūrāhākurādikaṃ pakṣaḥ, prasiddhakartṛko ghaṭādiḥ sapakṣaḥ, asiddhakartṛkamākāśādi vipakṣaḥ |
na ca kāryatva- masiddhamiti vācyaṃ, sāvayavatvena kāryatvasya siddhatvāt |
nanu viruddho hetuḥ, yatkāryaṃ taccharīrakartṛkaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, yathā ghaṭādikaṃ vigrahavatkulālādikartṛkaṃ, evaṃ ca kāryatvaṃ śarīri- kartṛkatvameva sādhayati, bhavatāṃ cāśarīrakartṛkaṃ sipā- dhayiṣitam |
aśarīrakartṛkatvaviparītaṃ śarīrikartṛkaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ vipakṣaḥ, tatra kāryatvasya pakṣavipakṣayoreva varta- mānatvāt viruddhatvam |
naivaṃ, yadi aśarīrakartṛkatvameva sādhyaṃ, tadā viruddhatvam |

asmākaṃ tu saśarīrakartṛkatvā- śarīrakartṛkatvaviśeṣaṃ parityajya sakartṛkatvamātrameva sādhyaṃ, itarathā agrimatve sādhye kiṃ pratyakṣamimattvaṃ, uta apratya- kṣāgrimatvamiti vikalpe, pratyakṣamimatve sādhyavikalpa- taiveti sakalamānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ |
ataḥ pratyakṣapratyakṣa- viśeṣaparihāreṇa amisattāmātrameva sādhyamiti vaktavyaṃ, tathā'pi |
athāsākamapi dharmādharmadvāreṇa kṣetrajña- syaiva kartṛtvāt sakartṛkatvamastyeveti siddhasādhanā |

naivaṃ, kṣetrajñasya dharmādharmādhiṣṭheyajñānasaṃbhavāt kartṛtvameva na saṃbhavatīti tallakṣaṇo dharmādisākṣātkaraṇanipuṇaḥ ( kartā adhikaraṇasiddhāntanyāyāparaparyāyatayā ) pakṣadharmatayā vicitrajagannirmāṇacaturaḥ kartā siddho bhavati |
nanu vilakṣaṇasyāpi kartṛtvaṃ nopapadyate, tasyāpi dharmādharma- sākṣātkāraśakteḥ |
na ca tasya pratyakṣasya dharmādharmaviṣayatvaṃ, pratyakṣatvāt saṃpratipannapratyakṣavat |
na ca tasya bāhyendriyāṇi dharmādharma- gocarāṇi indriyatvāt, asmadādīndriyavat |
āntaramapi manaḥ karaṇaṃ bahiraiva svatantraṃ na bhavati antaḥkaraṇatvāt, asmadādyantaḥkaraṇavat |
na ca tasyecchājñānayorapi nityatvaṃ icchājñānatvāt asmadādīcchājñānavat |
na ca tasya vigrahasyāpi nityatvaṃ bhautikatvāt, asmadādi- vigrahavat |
na tasya abhautiko divyo vigrahaḥ saṃbhavati vigrahatvāt, asmadādigrahavat |
jagatsyutpādakamimaṃ na tasya saṃbhavati cetanatvāt, kṣetrajñavat |
tathāhi, tadetat sarvaṃ anumānajātaṃ vilakṣaṇameva paramaṅgīkṛtya ucyate, anaṅgīkṛtya vā ? aṅgīkṛtya cet dharma- grāhakapramāṇavirodhaḥ sarveṣām |
naivaṃ, prasaṅgāpādanamapi anumānameva, kiṃtu anumānasyaiva uktiprakārabhedamātram |
atastadaṅgīkāre tadgrāhaka- pramāṇavirodhaḥ, anaṅgīkāre cāśrayāsiddhiriti tadavastha- meva pūrvoktaṃ dūṣaṇam |
kiṃca anvayādyaviprabhṛti ādyaguṇakaṃ acetanaṃ kāryaṃ cetanādhiṣṭhitamevetyucyate iti nirvi- vādam |
sā ca adṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogāt bhavati, adṛṣṭaṃ ca cetanādhiṣṭhita- meva sat kāryakaram |
tathāhi, vimatipatitamevaṃ cetanādhi- ṣṭhitaṃ kāryakaraṃ acetanatvāt, yadyadacetanaṃ tattat cetanādhiṣṭhitaṃ kāryakaraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā vāsyādi, tathā cedaṃ tasmāttathā |
adhiṣṭheyasvarūpaśaktikāryavān adhiṣṭhātā bhavatīti kṣetrajñadavyo nityecchājñānādimān adhiṣṭhātā pakṣadharmatāvalat siddho bhavati, parvatagatājñātāmiviśeṣa- vat |
na ca jñānasya kṣetrajñajñānavat anilatvaprasaṅgaḥ, pārthivāṇu- rūpādikamanityaṃ dyamititi ā paramāṇuṣu na rūpādyanityatva- prasaṅgaḥ |
evaṃ vā anumānaṃ, vivā- dādhyāsitaṃ upādānopakaraṇasaṃpadānaprayojanābhijñabuddhima- kartṛkaṃ, kāryatvāt ghaṭādivaditi |
ataḥ siddhaḥ anumāne- naiva kṣetrajñavilakṣaṇo bhagavānīśvaraḥ iti cet |
yaduktaṃ kṣityā- dikaṃ sakartṛkaṃ, kāryatvāt ghaṭādivaditi, tat siddhasādhanaṃ kṣetrajñasyāpi dharmādharmādareṇa kartṛtvavyāpyadharmāt |
taduktaṃ ' karmabhiḥ sarvasiddhānāṃ tasiddheḥ siddhasādhanam ' iti |
atha buddhimatkartṛmātraṃ sādhyamiti cet, buddhimattva- mapi kṣetrajñasya vidyate iti punarpi siddhasādhanameva |
atha na buddhimatkartṛkatāmātraṃ sādhyaṃ, kiṃtu upādānopakaraṇādi- svarūpaśaktikāryabuddhimattṛ, tarhi sādhyavikalatvaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
na ca kulālasya tadviṣayaṃ jñānamastīti sādhyavikalatvameva |
kiṃca kimatra sādhyatvenaiveṣṭitaṃ kiṃ asadādikartṛkatvaṃ, uta vilakṣaṇa- kartṛkatvaṃ ? yadi asadādikartṛkatvaṃ, tarhi siddhasādhanamapa- siddhāntaśca |
atha kartṛtvasāmānye'pi pakṣadharmatayā vilakṣaṇasiddhiḥ; naivaṃ, itaretarāśrayaprasaṅgāt, ubhayānugata- sāmānyavat asiddhiriti |
tathāhi kādācikaṃ kāryamiti karma- sādhane dravyaguṇādityatiriktameva karma siṣādhayiṣitam |
tatrāpi kiṃ dravyādi kāryaṃ vilakṣaṇaṃ vā iti vikalpe, dravyādau siddhasādhanaṃ, vilakṣaṇe sādhyavikalatā, ubhayānu- gatakāraṇamātre sādhye anyonyāśrayatvamiti samānatvāt |
naivaṃ, tatra vilakṣaṇadharmākṣepaḥ pakṣadharmatayā yuktaḥ, kāraṇa- jātīyasvabhāvānatikrameṇa vilakṣaṇadharmābhāvāt |
tathāhi, saṃpratipannaḥ kartā kulāladiḥ saśarīraḥ : puṇya- pāpādhīnaḥ anityecchājñānādiḥ |
na vilakṣaṇasya kriyāśaktyādisādhyaṃ pakṣadharmatayā sarva- jñatvasarvaśaktimattveśvaravādikartṛjātīyavilakṣaṇaguṇāmā- kṣepa iti ghaṭate |
atha sāvayavatvāt kāryatvaṃ sādhyate iti, tatra, nahi sāvayavatvaṃ prayojakaṃ kāryatvasya |
atha tadeva heturbhavatu, tarhi asiddho hetuḥ, kṣityādīnāṃ prāgabhāva- vattvāsiddheḥ |
nanu sāvayavatvaṃ prāgabhāvavattvaṃ ca ubhayaṃ prayojakaṃ bhavatu, ataḥ sāvayavatvena kāryatvaṃ prasādhyate, sadhaikedeśadhṛtepi sādhakatvābhyupagamāt |

naivaṃ, śakya- kriye hi sāvayavatvena kāryatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ghaṭādau, aśakya- kriye hi sāvayavatvena viśeṣahetunā kāryatve pratipiṇḍe sāvayavatvasāmānyāddhetunā kāryatvaṃ na śakyate sādhayituṃ, bādhitaviṣayatvāt |
yathā mūrtatvaṃ anityatvena ghaṭādau vyāptamapi aśakyanāśeṣu paramāṇuṣvanityatvaṃ na sādhayituṃ

tathāhi, yatra kāryatvaṃ sakartṛkatvena viśeṣahetunā vyāptaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ghaṭādau, tatra sarvatra vigrahavatkartṛkatvena vyāptaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kulāladau, ataḥ sakartṛkatvaṃ sādhayat kāryatvaṃ, vigrahavattvaviśiṣṭameva sādhayati |
naivaṃ, tathāpi śarīrasthasyaiva preraṇāyāṃ kartṛtvaṃ, prameyapi svaśarīrameva |
prayatnanimittaṃ hi preraṇaṃ, tacca aśarīriṇo na saṃbhavati, muktānyātmani asaṃbhavāt |
atha pūrva- śarīraparibhogenaiva śarīrāntaragrahāt aśarīrasya śarīra- parigrahe kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, nahi yugapaccharīradvayaparigrahaḥ saṃbhavati |
naivaṃ, tatrāpi sūkṣmaśarīrasya saṃbhavāt, pūrvaśarīraparityāge sarvatra śarīriṇaḥ eva kartṛtvam |
na ca etāvatā sakalānumānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ, sapakṣadṛṣṭasya avyabhicāritva eva dharmasya parigrahāt, yathā dhūmasyā- gni vyāptau |
aparvatatvamapi vyāptamiti cenna parvate'pi ca cittu pratyakṣadarśanāt |
anumitisiddhadeśyatiriktedeśatvamapi avyabhicārāt upādhiriti cet, vyāptigrahaṇadaśāyāṃ akasmādeva ananumitisiddhadeśya saraṇābhāvāt |
ataḥ sakartṛkatvaṃ sādhyamānaṃ śarīrakartṛkatvameva, śarīrakartṛkatve sarve vipakṣaḥ, ataḥ pakṣavipakṣayoreva kāryatvasya hetorvartamānatvāt viruddhārthasādhakatvādvā viruddho hetuḥ |
aśarīra- kartṛkatvaṃ sādhyamarhalena īpsitaṃ, tatra kāryatvaṃ saśarīrakartṛkatvavyāptamiti tadeva sādhyamiva dharmaviśeṣaviparītasādhano hetuḥ, tathā dharmaviśeṣa- viparītasādhanaśca |
aśakyakriyasya hi bhūbhūdharāderdharmibhaṃ, kāryatvaṃ ca śakyakriyatvena ghaṭādinā vyāptimite tadapi sādhayati |
tathā kāryatvaṃ kṣetrajñakartṛkatvena vyāptamiti tadapi sādhayati |
tathā kāryatvaṃ adṛṣṭavatkartṛkatvena vyāptamiti tadapi sādhayati |
atha aśeṣaviśeṣaparihāreṇa sakartṛkatvasāmānyāt sādhyaṃ, tarhi sāmānyamātrakartṛkatvābhāvāt sādhyavikalataiva |

pakṣadharmatayā viśeṣākṣepo kartṛjātīya- svabhāvānuguṇameva kṣetrajñādi viśeṣameva ākṣipatī, na viparītasvabhāvaṃ, yathā abhimattve sādhye pakṣadharmatayā uṣtvādāhakatvādidharmayuktasya abhimaviśeṣasya ākṣepaḥ, na viparītasya aṇutvādādiyuktasya |

cetanakartṛkatve hi sādhyatvenābhimataṃ, tatra bhūbhūrādikaṃ pakṣaḥ, cetanakartṛkatvaṃ ghaṭādiḥ sapakṣaḥ, cetana- kartṛkavyatiriktaḥ sarvo vipakṣaḥ, tatra kāryatvaṃ pakṣatraye'pi vartate, bhūbhūrādau sālābhāñchadau ca, ataḥ anaikānti- katvamaparihāryam |
tathāhi, kimidaṃ kāryatvamabhipretaṃ bhūbhūrādeḥ, kiṃ bhūbhūrādyavayavina eva abhūbhāvamavalakṣaṇakāryatvaṃ, āhosvit avinā- śinyeva avayavini krameṇa katipayavayavotpattilakṣaṇam |

krameṇa katipayavayavotpattilakṣaṇe kāryatve anvayavyatirekatvaṃ, evaṃvidhasya kāryatvasya bhūbhū- rādiṣu asaṃbhavāt anyābhāvācca, pakṣe eva varta- mānatvāt, sapakṣasadbhāvena kevalavyatirekatvābhāvācca |
tathāhi, anupalabdhyā tāvat kṣityādīnāṃ akartṛkatvameva niścīyate, ataḥ anu- palabdhibādhitaṃ idamanumānam |
yathā śaśamastakaṃ viṣāṇa- vat catuṣpāmastaktvāt, gomastakavat ityanumānamanupa- labhyā bādhyate |
atha jagatkartṛranumānasiddhatvāt aśarīratvācca asadādyupalabhyayogyatā nāstīti yogyā- nupalabbhāvāccānumānabādhaḥ |
evaṃ tarhi śaśaviṣāṇa- syāpi anumānasiddhatvāt paramāṇuvat ayogyānupalabhyaḥ iti na tatrāpi anumānabādhaḥ |
yadi viṣaṇajātīyasya rūpavattvamahattvādidarśanāt tatra pratyakṣayogyatā, atrāpi tarhi kartṛjātīyasya vigrahavattvena pratyakṣayogyatā asa- dādyupalabhyayogyatāt upalabhyeta, na copalabhyate |
akartṛlaprayukteyaṃ vyāpti- riti cet, ubhayopi prayojakatve virodhābhāvāt |
tathā vivādādhyāsitaṃ kṣetrajñakartṛkaṃ, cetanakartṛkatvāt ghaṭādi- vat |
tathā kṣityādikaṃ nityaprayatnecchā- īhārthaḥ: kāmā na kartavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
na caite jñānavatkartṛkaṃ na bhavati, kāryatvāt ghaṭādivat |
evaṃ īhārthyā arthavādāḥ: kiṃtu vidhaya eva |
sadbhāva- kṛtyācintā uktena anena nyāyena sarvaiśvare'pi vāraṇe śarkaṃ ko nu taṃ kalpayiṣyati ||
’ iti sarveṣāmeva sūktavākoktaphalānāṃ akriyamyānatvena avacane eteṣāmanumānānāṃ dṛṣṭalakṣaṇatvāt, adṛṣṭalakṣaṇatvāt prāpte ‘jīvatyavacanamāyurāśiṣastadarthatvāt’ (10|2|
agnihotraśabdaḥ dharmapradeśaḥ nityāmihotrācca dharmātideśaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
yathā ṣaḍahāt pṛṣṭhānāmatideśaḥ evaṃ saumikādavabhṛthāt iha (vāruṇaprāghāsike'vabhṛthe ) dharmātideśaḥ |

athāpi vyavahāranityatāyānena pauruṣeyakaraṇaparaṃparā anādiḥ kalpyeta, tathāpi 'uktaṃ tu śabdapūrvatvaṃ' ityasya nyāyasya sthitatvāt anekapuruṣakṛtamapi sat vyākaraṇaṃ vedālambhanatvaṃ na pratipadyate ( pūrvapakṣe idam ) |
na tu vedavākyeṣu abhiprāyantare pramādo vā kasya cidasti |
na ca vaktā, yo'nyathāt kathayet sarvapuruṣāṇām |
1|1|13 pṛ. 699. uktaṃ samāmnāyaidamarthya tasmāt sarvaṃ tadarthaṃ syāt |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ udbhidādyo guṇavidhayaḥ āhosvit karmanāmadheyāni iti |
'udbhidā yajeta' ityādiṣu na tāvat matvarthalakṣaṇāyā viśiṣṭavidhānaṃ vidhivagauravaprasaṅgāt, lakṣaṇādoṣācca |
tatra anyataravidhāne yadi yāgo vidhīyate tadā upapadavaiyarthyam |
nāpi anyatra vihitaṃ yāgamanūdya vede guṇavidhiḥ saṃbhavati, sarvatraiva upapadaśravaṇeṇa karmavidhānā- sambhavāt ( karmavidhisaṃbhavāt ) |
tena akāmenāpi laukike eva mātṛyāge ( gaṇayāge iti bahirlikhitam ) guṇavidhiḥ iti vaktavyam |
tathā ca sati pramāṇāntarasāpekṣa- tvena vedasyāpi aprāmāṇyaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
siddhā- ntastu sāmānyādhikaraṇyatvāt yathābhāṣyaṃ nāmadheyatvameva iti |
evaṃ mukhyārthameva lakṣaṇakatvaṃ, na tu aprāmāṇyamapekṣya |
tadetat vidhigaurava - matvarthalakṣaṇābhiyā vedāprāmāṇyaśrayaṇe bhojanāyāsabhayena maraṇapakṣaśrayaṇamiva bhāti |
na ca laukikagaṇayāgāśrayaṇe lakṣaṇato vimokeḥ, vedavihita- devatāyāḥ alambhena gaṇayāgasya mukhyayāgatva- bhāvāt |
bhavatu vā yathākathaṃcit laukikakarmāśrayo guṇavidhiḥ, tathāpi nāprāmāṇyam |
'āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho muñjīte' itivat laukikakarmāśraye'pi prāmāṇyopapatteḥ iti yatkiṃcidetat |
prathamapāde hi samastasyaiva vedasya sakaletaraśaṅkā- nirāsena dharme prati codanātvena prāmāṇyaṃ vyutpāditam |
tasya arthavādantrātmakasya codanāntargatatvena dharme prati upayogabhāvāt aprāmāṇyamāśaṅkya dvitīyapāde codanā'ntargatapradarśanena pratyekaṃ upayogapratipādanāt prāmāṇyaṃ vyavasthāpitam |
tṛtīyapāde tu smṛtyācāra- mūlabhūtaḥ tathābhūta eva vādo'sti iti nirūpitam |
idānīṃ vidhyuddeśagatatvena nāmadheyānāṃ sāmānyena nirūpito'pi dharme prati upayogaviśeṣaḥ pūrvaṃ na prati- pāditaḥ iti tadyaḥ punaḥ prastāvanā |

atra yadyapi bhāṣye pūrvottarasūtrābhyāṃ ekamevedamadhikaraṇaṃ pratibhāti, tathāpi pūrvasūtrasya pūrvapakṣamimatāyāpratibhānāt vicāradvayogācca vārtikakārapādaiḥ anumita- pūrvapakṣaṃ vicāradvayameva edācaritam |
ataḥ tridhivedatvameva vidhyuddeśena akriyā'rthatvāt ānarthakyameva udbhidādipādānāṃ iti |
vi. sāhasrī. 483. na caivaṃ ' vikalpatti pacati ' iti prayogāpattiḥ, tasyā dhātunevoktatayā ukthārthanāmaprayogāt |
rahasya. pṛ. 88. ' ukthaśā yaja somasya ' iti mantraḥ yatra kevalagrahakaraṇahomastatra |
saṃkarṣa. 2|3|12. ukthyaḥ ( somayāgaviśeṣaḥ ) kāmyaḥ abhi- ṣṭomasya saṃsthāviśeṣaḥ |
ayaṃ agniṣṭomāt prāk nānu- ṣṭhātuṃ śakyate |
tatra agniṣṭomastotrottaraṃ trīṇi ukthya- stotrāṇi adhikāni |
bhāṭṭa. 3|6|16. ' ukthyo vairūpasāmā ' iti ukthye vairūpya sāmnaḥ pṛṣṭhastotre niveśaḥ |
vi. 10|6|16. ' ukthyāni aindrāgnāni ' ( ukthyayāgaḥ devatayā aindrāgnaḥ ) |
tatra hīgū ūrdhva ū iti nidhanānāṃ vṛddhi-annāya-svargaphalārtha krameṇa vyavasthā, na tu saubharāt nidhanānāṃ pṛthak phalam |
vi. 9|1|8. ukthye yaḥ atigrāhyaniṣedhaḥ sa vikṛtyukathye eva, na tu prakṛtyukthye |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|3. ukthye rājanyasya stutaśastrasahitaḥ ṣoḍaśī uktaḥ ' apyukthye ' iti |
bhāṭṭa. 10|1|12. ukthye savanīyapaśudvayasya agniṣṭupe ' prāssā agni bharata ' ityatra asmai iti padasya sthāne ābhyāṃ iti nāsti ūhaḥ |
ukthyagrahāḥ trayaḥ jyotiṣṭome sūryāstāt prāgeva gṛhyante |
yadi daivāt ukthyagrahā astamayādūrdhvamukthye. ran, tadā taduttarabhāvī ṣoḍaśigraho'pi utkṛṣyaḥ |

ukthyaparabhāvasya ( ṣoḍaśigrahasya ) kevala- grahaṇāṅgatve'pi grahaṇasya saṃnipātitvena ārādupakāra- stotrāśrayatvā antaraṅgatvāt antaraṅgadharmatvena kramasya bahiraṅgastotrāpekṣayā prabalatvāt tadanugrahāya ṣoḍaśyutkarṣa āvaśyakaḥ. jyotiṣṭome |
( ṣoḍaśigābhyāsakālena aṅgasya stotrasya kāle bādhyate, ata utkṛṣyaḥ ṣoḍaśī ) |
ukthyarūpo guṇo nityāgniṣṭomasya saṃsthā vikṛtya saṃsthā'ntaraṃ gamayati |
vi. 3|6|16. ukthyastotreṇa pratyahaṃ samāpyamānaḥ dvādaśāhīya- daśarātraḥ daśakṛtvo'bhyasyamānaḥ śatakṛtvatāmāpadyate |
bhāṣyam - jyotiṣṭome śrūyate ṣoḍaśinaṃ prakṛtya ' taṃ parāñmukhatvebhyo gṛhṇāti ' iti |
yadā daivāt mānuṣādvā pratibandhāt ukthyāni utkṛṣyante, kiṃ tadā ṣoḍaśī utkṛṣyo, neti bhavati saṃśayaḥ |
kutaḥ ? evaṃ stotraṃ smin kāle ṣoḍaśinaḥ kutaḥ bhaviṣyati ' samayā- dhyuṣite sūrye ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotramupākaroti ' iti |
ukthyasaṃyogo hi ṣoḍaśino bhavati ' taṃ parāñmukhatvebhyo gṛhṇāti ' iti |
yaduktaṃ ṣoḍaśinaḥ svakāle na avajarnaṃ bhaviṣyati, ucyate |

ṭup - ( adhikaraṇārambhabhāṣpite - ) nanu ' samayā- dhyuṣite stotraṃ ' ityanena viśeṣavacanena ṣoḍaśino yaḥ ukthyaparabhāvaḥ ( 'grahaṃ vā gṛhṇītvā camasaṃ votrīya stotramupākaroti ' iti sāmānyavacanena prāta:) sa bādhyate |
ukthyaparabhāvaśca samayādhyuṣitatvaṃ ca ubhayamapi anugrahītuṃ śakyate tasmāt ( avirodhāt ) sāmānyaviśeṣayorvā nāsti |
na ca ' daivānmānuṣādā pratibalāt ' ismina ( pakṣe-pakṣā- śravaṇe ) sāmānyaviśeṣaṇo'sti |

( katham ?) śāstraṃ hi daivaṃ mānuṣaṃ vā pratibalamapekṣya sāmānya- viśeṣaṇārthaṃ naiva karoti ( tataśca stotrāṅgasya samayā- dhyuṣitatvasya grahaṇasya ca ukthyaparabhāvasya saṃpāda- yitumaśakyatvāt avyavadhāveva anyatarasmin, kasya bādhanaṃ yuktaṃ iti yukko vicāraḥ ) |
stotraṃ punaḥ yāgasya na sākṣādupakaroti ( ārā- dupakāritvāt ) |
ataḥ anayoḥ ( kālayoḥ ) anta- raṅgasya kālaḥ anugrāhyaḥ ( krama eva kālaśabdokteḥ ) |
tasmādāha ( bhāṣyakāraḥ - ) ' stotrakramamanusṛtyamānasya pradhānakramo virudhyate ' iti |
athavā ukthyairutkṛṣyamāṇaiḥ ( ṣoḍaśi - ) yāgaḥ eva anena prakāreṇa utkṛṣyate, ṣoḍaśigāsyāpi ukthyaparatvāt |
graheṇa ( ca ) gṛhya- māṇena yāgaḥ prānto bhavati yathā avadānena |
ataḥ tatkālena ( grahayāgābhyāsakālena ) aṅkakālaḥ ( stotrasya kālaḥ ) bādhyate |
śā-- ( ukthyagrahāṇāmutkarṣe ṣoḍaśī utkṛṣyate, na veti saṃśaye ) ' tatra notkarṣarṇa yuktaṃ stotra- kālopasaṃgrahāt |
utkarṣapakṣe hīyeta svakālāt stotramasya hi ' ' krama'pi tu pradhānaṅgabhūta- tvāt balavānasau |
soma-- kālataḥ padārthagrāhe kramabādhaḥ kaimutyāt siddhaḥ iti pratyavakṣānāt saṃgatiḥ |

ukthyaparabhāvasya kevalagrahaṇāṅgatve'pi grahaṇasya saṃnipātitvena ārādupa- kārakastotrāpekṣayā antaraṅgatvāt antaraṅgadharmatvena kramasya bahiraṅgastotrāpekṣayā prabalatvāt tadanugrahāya āvaśyakaḥ |
soma. 5|1|18. vi - ' ukthyotkarṣe ṣoḍaśī notkarṣetyutkarṣe'- thavā |

' bhāṭṭa-- daivānmānuṣādā'parādhādeva ukthyetkṛṣyeṣu ṣoḍaśitotramutkṛṣyate, na veti cintāyāṃ, ' samayā- dhyuṣite sūrye ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotramupākaroti ' iti vacana- vihitasamayādhyuṣitakāle'prāmāṇyātvādutkarṣaḥ |

na ca ' taṃ parāṅmukhatvebhyo gṛhṇāti ṣoḍaśinam ' iti vacanena ukthyaparabhāvasya vihitatvāt stotrasya ca ' grahaṃ vā gṛhītvā ' iti vacanena grahaṇottarakālatvāt tadanurodhena samayādhyuṣitakālaḥ, ' taṃ parāñcaṃ ' ityanena ṣoḍaśi- yāgābhyāsasyaiva ukthyaparabhāvavidhānena grahaṇasya stotra- pūrvakālatve'pi bādhakābhāvāt |
ata eva tatra gṛhṇāti- nirdhapatitatvāt yajamāna eva |
astu vā grahaṇaparaḥ; tathāpi taittarīyaśākhāyāṃ ṣoḍaśinaḥ savanatraye'pi āgnānāt savanantaraviyaṃ ' taṃ parāñcaṃ ' iti vākyam |
astu vā etadapi sarvaviṣayaṃ, tathāpi ' grahaṃ vā ' ityasya sāmānyaviṣayatvāt ukthyottaragrahaṇe'pi samayādhyuṣite stotrakaraṇe na kaścidvirodhaḥ |

yadi tu sāmānyaviśeṣarūpatvāt yathā'vasthitaśāstraviṣayatvena daivāparādhe apravṛtteḥ sarvārthānāṃ tulyabalatvamucyeta, tathāpi ukthyaparabhāvasya kramatvena upādeyatvāt pūrvādhi- karaṇanyāyena bādhopapatteḥ samayādhyuṣitakālānugrahe nyāya eva |
na ca kālasya aṅgāṅgatvena pradhānakramamapekṣyā daurbalyaṃ, ubhayorapi aṅgāṅgatvāt |
na ca grahaṇasya ava- dānavat pradānopakramatvāt, tadiha ekapadārthatvāt |
iti prāpte, grahaṇasya ṣoḍaśigābhyāsakalpakatvena anta- raṅgatvāt tatkramasya prābalyam |

na ca grahaṇasya uttarakālaṃ karaṇe'pi stotrasya kālānu- grahaḥ śakyaḥ, tathātve stotre grahaṇottarakālatvasya pradhāna- pratyāsatteśca bādhaprasaṅgena ekasyaivāsya samayādyuṣitakāla- vādhasya nyāyyatvāt |
oṃ ukthyāmiṣṭomasaṃyogādastaśastraḥ syāt, sati hi saṃkhyānatvam |
ṣoḍaśī grahaḥ prakṛtau gṛhyamāṇaḥ astutaśastraḥ syāt stotraśastrarahitaḥ |
ukthyāmiṣṭomasaṃyogāt 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyāt apyukthye grāhyaḥ' iti agniṣṭoma-saṃsthasya ca kratau ṣoḍaśī grahītavya ityucyate |
sati hi stutaśastre ṣoḍaśinā śakheṇa ṛtuḥ saṃtiṣṭheta, tathā ca saṃkhyā'nyatvaṃ syā

iti prāpte, 'kaustaṃ bhavati' ityādi- vat 'vairūpaṃ bhavati' 'ukthyo vairūpavān' ityevaṃ- vighnanirdeśamaṅkatvā bahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ svaiyarthyaparihārārthaṃ vairūpāderbahuvrīhipadenirdiṣṭasyadvayarthatvaṃ gamayati |
śakyate cā''pi kautsādinyāyenaiva (10|4|9) samasaṃkhyavādaprāktasāmabhāvātkathaṃ yasminstve tanniveśa- prasaktau sādṛśyaviśeṣeṇa tanniyamaḥ |
nahi atra prāktastottrānuvādena vairūpādividhānaṃ, yena 'āgneyā grahāḥ' itivat sarvastotreṣu niveśaḥ syāt |
na ca ānarthakyatadañjyāyena avatīrṇasya sarvaviṣayatvaṃ, tathāpye yājyādavapi cātuḥ- svaryyādhena vairū(pyā)patteḥ |
astu vā trivṛdādistomavat tatrāpi sarvavidhayatvaṃ, tathāpi brūhītinirdeśavaiyarthyapari- hārārthameva māhendrastotraviṣayatvopapattiḥ |
ata eva prakṛtau 'pṛṣṭheḥ stuvate' iti vākyena pṛṣṭhagrahavidhivi- pakṣe'pi kaṇvarathaṃtarasya na sarvapṛṣṭheṣu niveśaḥ |

kiṃtu 'bṛhatpṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' iti vākya- dvaye dvayoreva sāmnoḥ, pṛṣṭhapaṭhasāmānādhikaraṇyasya anyathā- vaiyarthyapatteḥ tatparihārārthaṃ pṛṣṭhapadasāmānādhikaraṇya- nirdiṣṭānāṃ kaṇvarathaṃtarādīnāmapi tatkāryārthapravattīte- māhendrastotre eva niveśaḥ |
nahi 'bṛhatpṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityādau stotrānuvādena sāmavidhiḥ sāmaviśiṣṭastotra- vidhirvā saṃbhavati, vāmadevyādisāmābhirvā bṛhadrathaṃtarayorapi pāṭhādeva prāpteḥ |
ato'sya vaiyarthyaparihārārthaṃ kaṇvarathaṃ- tarādīnāṃ svakāryakāritvamityuktaṃ citrā'dhikaraṇakaustume |
yatra ca ukthyādiviśeṣacodanā tatraiva kevalaṃ tadarmaprāptiḥ |
vā. 3|1|16|47, ukthyādisaṃsthānimittaṃ ukthyagrahastotrāskhādi aprākṛtaṃ, tatra yat itaragrahastotra- śastradharmātideśaṃ kiṃ cit guṇakāmagataṃ prāpnoti, tanna bhavati |
ukthavākye karmaśeṣapratiṣedhavidhānena pratisaṃvatsaraṃ bhinnanāmamevokṣaṇaṃ ānayanaṃ ahīne pañcaśāradīye |

' ityādipāṭhakāmmātairmantraiḥ saṃpāya tasyāmagniṃ nidhāya ṣaḍayāme dvādaśayāme vā śikye tāmukhāmāsthāpya tacchiṣyaṃ (suvarṇarukmāntarite ) svakaṇṭhe baddhvā tamukhyamagniṃ saṃvatsaraṃ bhṛtvā paśvādiṣṭakābhiramiśratavyaḥ |
(agnihotra- payaḥ śrapaṇārthaṃ ca sābhinitye kratau ca ukthyāgnidhāraṇārthaṃ ukhā bhavati ) |
ukhāyāṃ munmayāṃ caturasrāyāṃ mahatyāṃ aṅgāradhānikāyāṃ bhavaḥ agniḥ ulkhaḥ |
tayoḥ kāmyanityayoḥ agmyoḥ samuccayaḥ ukhāyāṃ syāt |
niyoge niyojane avadhāne ayaṃ kāmaḥ śrūyate 'āhṛtya anadadhyāt brahmavarcasakāmasya' iti |
tathā ca avadhāna- mātreṇa kāmasiddhiḥ, na tu homane |
yadi ca kāmyena nityasyāmervādhaḥ syāt, kāmye avasthāpite nityo naiva syāt |
asati ca nitye asaṃskṛteṣu āghānādisaṃskārahetubhira āghādi- ṣveva karma homaḥ syāt |
tasya buddhirnihitasya agnyādhānāsya devatā'rtha- tvāt devatāparigrahārthatvāt nityābhāve devatāparigraho na syāt |
tasmāt kāmyanityayoḥ samuccayaḥ, na kāmyena nityasya bādhaḥ |
vikāro bādhaḥ syāt kāmyena āghādinā nityasyāmeḥ |
ukto heturyasya tat uktahetu 'naimittikaṃ tu prakṛtau tadvikāraḥ' ( 3|6|13|10 ) iti heturuktaḥ |
tasmāt āghādinā kāmya nityasya ukthyasya bādhaḥ, na samuccayaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā 'asati cāsaṃskṛteṣu karma syāt' (sū. 18) iti tatrāha |
vacanāt vacanabalāt asaṃskṛteṣvapi saṃskārarahiteṣvapi āghādiṣu agniṣu karma homaḥ syāt |
vṛkṣāgrājjvālataḥ āhutena kāmyanāmnā samuccaye sati prādādyena agninā vaihārikasya agneḥ saṃsargaḥ syāt |
tatra ca agnaye śunaye aṣṭakapālaḥ kartavyaḥ syāt |
tasmāt kāmyena nityasyāmeḥ na samuccayaḥ kiṃtu bādhaḥ |
ekasmāmeva ukhāyāṃ nityakāmyayordhāraṇavidhāyakāt vacanāt agnisaṃsargo na doṣāya iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
vacanabalāt agnisaṃsargo na doṣāya, tathā vacanabalādeva itarasminnapi pakṣe asaṃ- skṛteṣu āghādiṣṭeṣviṣu homo'pi syāt |
tasmāt kāmye- nāmnā nityasya ukthyasya bādha eva, na samuccayaḥ |
tatrocyate kāmyena bādhāya nityasyāmeḥ utsargo'pi abhi- grahaṇarūpasya karmaṇaḥ kṛtatvāt tata eva devatāparigrahaḥ siddho bhavati |
vacanācca agmyantare yajate iti na doṣaḥ |
bhā. 12|4|10|30-31, ukthyasyāmeḥ nityasya cayane kāmyena āghādyagninā bādhaḥ |
ukthyasyāmeḥ pratyakṣameva nayanāt na samā- ropaḥ |

agreḥ pratyakṣanayasya samāropavidhineva parisaṃkhyāta- tvāt ukthyasyāpi samārope prāpte, ukhāsaṃyogasyaiva ukthyapadapravṛttinimittatvena samākhyāvirodhāt śakaṭe pātra- sthāpanādividhānācca na tatsamāropaḥ |
ukthyasyāmeḥ saṃvatsaraṃ bharaṇābhāve vaiśvānaregnirmi- ttikī, na nityā |
ukthyāgni- bhasmanaḥ mṛdaśca saṃsargeṇa cayanekānāṃ nirmāṇaṃ dīkṣosara- kālameva, na yāthākāmyena dīkṣāntaḥ pūrvaṃ prājāpatyapaśoḥ parato'pi nirmāṇakālaḥ |
uccaritaśabdasya padicyorgami samānārthatvena jñānārthatvāt ucchabdasya cotkarṣārthatvena niścaya rūpajñāno- tkarṣavācitvāt uttaroccaritaśabdayoḥ avadhāritārthatvā- viśeṣaḥ |
bhā. 10|4|12|23-24. uccāvacadhvani: dīkṣaṇīyādau avāntarapūrva- prayukta:, na paramāpūrvaprayukta: |
yat ṛgvedasāmavedābhyāṃ kiṃ cit kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ vā cocyate, tat sarvamuccai: kartavyam |
tathā 'taṃ ( pravargyādyaṃ mahāvīraṃ ) bhinnamamimuro yatte didamidhri: ' ityādi |
vā. 3|3|12 pṛ. 813. 'uccairṛcā ' ityādyupasaṃhāramagrādipadaṃ vedoṣa- krameṇa bādhyate |
bāla. pṛ. 140, 'uccairṛcā kriyate ' ityatra vākyapādākhye vedokramādhikaraṇe ( 3|3|1 ) nyavadhāraṇakalpanā uktā |
saṃkarṣa. 4|1|2. uccaitvaṃ upāṃśutvena bādhyate apāne sāmnām |
bāla. pṛ. 140, uccaitvena upāṃśutvaṃ bādhyate nigadeṣu |
'uccairṛcā kriyate, upāṃśu yajuṣā, uccai: sāmnā ' iti |
( tatraśca ) uccaistvena guṇena tānyeva yajūṃṣi vyapadiśyante nigadā iti ( parasaṃbodhanārthatvāt ) |
bhā. 2|1|342-43. uccaistvasya upāṃśutvāt balīyastvaṃ parasaṃbodhanārthatvāt nigadasya ' guṇe svarūpato dharma: pradhānadārato'para: |
yatra syāt, tatra vijñeyaṃ guṇadharmasya sādhanam |
su.pṛ. 679-80. ' ucchiṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayet ' ayaṃ dravyatiṣedha: puruṣa- pārtha: |
bāla. pṛ. 11. ucchiṣṭasya mitrasañjānāṃ bhojanaṃ anācāra: udīcyānāṃ dākṣiṇātyānāṃ ca |
vā. 1|3|17 pṛ. 204. ucchiṣṭapatrāvalyādikaṃ kartṛ tyajate, tacca na puna: kvāpyupayujyate |
vi. 5|3|13. uccaiyaṇaṃ ityādaya: yūpasya ( audumbaryāśca ) saṃskārā: |
bhā. 11|3|14. ujjitimantrāvāhanaṃ vājapeye śasya evaṃ yajamānasya, na anyasya |
bāla. pṛ. 119. utkaraṇe prākṛtavājināsādananānuvādena vihitena prākṛtavedairdhā: saumikacāturmāsyeṣu |
bhā. 10|2|118- 22, utkare vājināsādanaṃ guṇavidhi: na karmāntaram |
( utkarṣa: nāma yat yatra deśe kāle vā paṭhitaṃ, tasya tato'nyatra nayanam |
ke. ) bhā. 6|9|128-39. agnīṣomīyasya puroḍāśasya tadvikārāṇāṃ ca somottaram |
vi. 5|4|4. utkarṣa: anuyajānāṃ sarvasomānāṃ upariṣṭhāt vājapeye |
bhā. 11|3|148 ( 50 ), utkarṣa: anuyājakāṇḍasya āgni- mārutādūrdhvaṃ jyotiṣṭome |
3|1|12. utkarṣa: upādipadānāṃ ( darśapūrṇa- māsaprakaraṇapaṭhitānāṃ pūṣānumantrādīnāṃ ) guṇatvābhāvāt, tadvyātirekeṇa itarapadānāṃ prakṛtopayogyarthapratipādakatvā- bhāvācca |
bhāṭa. 9|31, utkarṣa: pūṣānumantraṇamantrāṇāṃ darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇāt tattadevatāke karmaṇi |
3|2|1. utkarṣa: paurṇameyaṇasya darśapūrṇamāsayo: śrutasya paurṇa- vikṛtau |
vi. 3|1|18. utkarṣa: pravaraṇīhomādīnāṃ saumikānāṃ prātaranuvākāle pauroḍāśikebhya: parastāt |
bhā. 5|1|125-26, utkarṣa: pratipado: ' yuvaṃ hi stha: ' ' ete asrapra ' ityanayo: dvivahu- yajamānakayo: jyotiṣṭomāt kulāyayāgādau |
5|1|28|130, utkarṣa: saṃtardanasya agniṣṭome śrutasya ukthyādau dīrghasome |
3|1| 1124-39, utkarṣa: savanīyapuroḍāśadevatānāṃ api āgnimārutādūrdhvaṃ anuyājotkarṣaṃ ukthyapramāṇe sūktavāke |
vi. 3|4|5. utkarṣa: na upāṃśuyājasya, agnīṣomīyasya na kārya: |
prājāpatyo vā vaiṣṇavo vā tu kārya eva |
bhā. 5|4|6119-21, utkarṣa: na patnīsaṃyājīya- jāghanyā: darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇāt |
3|1|20-23, utkarṣa: na piṣṭalepaphalakaraṇahomayo: jyotiṣṭome āgni- mārutādūrdhvamanuyājotkarṣe'pi |
ādhānasya iṣṭiparvatvaṃ somapūrvatvaṃ vā iti pūrvā- dhikaraṇavagatam |

utkarṣāt ' āgneyo vai brāhmaṇo devatā, sa someneṣṭvā agnī- pomīyo bhavati, yadevāda: paurṇamāsaṃ havi:, tat tarhi anunirvapet, tarhi ubhayadevatya bhavati ' iti vākyena brāhmaṇasya somānuṣṭhānottaraṃ darśapūrṇamāsayo: utkarṣa: ukta: |
tasmāt brāhmaṇasya iṣṭiparvatvaṃ nāstya, kiṃtu somapūrvatva- meva ādhānasya iti prathama: pūrvapakṣa: |
darśapūrṇamāsayorhomayotkarṣa ukto vacanena, kiṃtu śrutisaṃyogāt ' yadevāda: paurṇa- māsaṃ havi: ' iti paurṇamāsaśabdena saṃyogāt paurṇamāsī iṣṭiraiva ekā utkṛṣyate |
tasmāt brāhmaṇena paurṇamāseṣṭi- reva somāt prāk na kartavyā |
tasāt somapūrvatvamiva iṣṭiparvatva- mapi brāhmaṇasya saṃbhavati iti |
na kevalaṃ ekasyā: paurṇa- māseṣṭereva utkarṣa: saṃbhavati, kiṃtu sarvasya darśapūrṇamāsā- tmakasya karmaṇa eva utkarṣa: |
amāvāsyāpaurṇamāsīrūpa- kālabhedena iṣṭiporanuṣṭhānabhede'pi ' darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargaṃ- kāmo yajeta ' iti śrutyā ekaphalakatvena karmaikyasya spaṣṭatvāt |
tataśca paurṇamāsīrūpe ekadeśe somādūrdhvaṃ utkṛṣṭe ubhayātmakaṃ sarvameva karma utkṛṣṭaṃ bhavati |
tasmāt brāhmaṇasya somapūrvatvameva, neṣṭiparvatvaṃ iti puna: prathama: pūrvapakṣa: prāto bhavati |
kutūhale tu kriyate iti karma phalaṃ, aikamyatvāt ekaphalakatvāt iti vyākhyātam |
brāhmaṇasya ādhānaṃ iṣṭiparvapi syāt na somapūrva- meveti niyama: |
' yadevāda: paurṇamāsaṃ havi: tat tarhi anunirvapet ' iti vidhistu tadaiva prasiddhadarśapūrṇamāsa- samudāyārthena prasiddhapaurṇamāsasyaiva syāt |
darśapūrṇamāsa- samudāyāsthāne prasiddhapaurṇamāseṣṭyāsthāne vā paurṇamāsasaṃjñakaṃ karmāntaramevedaṃ somādūrdhvaṃ vidhīyate |
prasiddho darśapūrṇa- māsau, tadekadeśabhūtā paurṇamāsī vā somādūrdhvaṃ naivotkṛ- ṣyate |
tada- rthena brāhmaṇena brāhmaṇoddeśena iti kutūhalam |

' yadevāda: paurṇamāsaṃ havi:, tat tarhi anunirvapet ' iti vākyena apūrvameva paurṇamāsanāma kaṃ karmāntaraṃ brāhmaṇasya somottaraṃ vidhīyate ādhānaṃ tu iṣṭiparvameva brāhmaṇasya iti tata: tṛtīye pūrvapakṣe uktaṃ tacca |
kintu prakaraṇāt paurṇamāsaśabdena ekadeśavācakena kṛtsnasya darśapūrṇamāsasamudāyasya tena vākyena somottaratvaṃ nāma kālo vihitaḥ syāt |
brāhmaṇakṛtasya somapūrvameva darśapūrṇamāsasamu- dāyastu somādūrdhvaṃ vacanena ekadeśotkarṣadvārā utkṛṣyate iti yaduktaṃ tannirāsacce somapūrvatvamātrādī |
brāhmaṇasya somādūrdhvaṃ paurṇamāsī eva kevalaṃ syāt ‘yadevādaḥ paurṇamāsaṃ haviḥ, tat tarhi anunirvapet’ iti vacanāt |
ekaṃ vā śabdasāmarthyāt, prāk kṛtsnavidhā- nāt ||

‘yadevādaḥ paurṇamāsaṃ haviḥ, tat tarhi anunirvapet’ iti vacanena darśapūrṇamāsasamudāyasya somādūrdhvaṃ notkarṣaḥ, nāpi paurṇamāsasaṃjñakakarmāntaravidhiḥ, nāpi sarvasyāḥ paurṇamāsyā utkarṣaḥ iti vākyārthaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi tena vākyena kriyate ? tadāha |

śabdasāmarthyāt ‘āgneyo vai brāhmaṇo devatayā, sa someneṣṭvā abhīpomīyo bhavati, yadevādaḥ paurṇamāsaṃ haviḥ, tat tarhi anunirvapet, tarhi ubhayadevatyo bhavati’ iti adaḥśabdasamānādhi- karaṇapaurṇamāsaśabdasya ekamātrahaviṣkartva sāmarthyāt |
tasmānādhikaraṇaśca paurṇamāsaśabdaḥ tadevānuvadati, na sarvo paurṇamāsīṃ, nāpi darśapūrṇamāsasamudāyam |
abhī- pomīyapuroḍāśāt itarasya kṛtsnasya haviṣaḥ somāt prāk vidhānāt ca ekameva haviṣkṛṣyate |
tato yat vacanena utkṛṣyate tadūrdhvaṃ somāt, yatnotkṛṣyate tadvābha- vitumarhati |
brāhmaṇasya iṣṭipūrvatvaṃ somapūrvatvaṃ vetyubhau eti siddhāntaḥ |
6|1|12|23-24, utkarṣe sūktavākyasya na savanīyadevatānā- mutkarṣaḥ pañcanakṣatratvāt, yathā niṣkarṣe''nanvayaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome āgnimārutādūrdhvaṃ anuyājotkarṣeṇa sūkta- vākyasya utkarṣe sati somadevatānāṃ savanīyapuroḍāśa- devatānāṃ notkarṣaḥ |
pañcanakṣatratvāt pañca pañcatvaṃ, na pañcatvaṃ pañcanakṣatraṃ, somadevatānāṃ pañcanakṣatratvāt anu- yājādyutkarṣe'pi notkarṣaḥ |
yathā paurṇamāsyāṃ sūkta- vākyasya prayoge darśadevatānāṃ niṣkarṣe nivṛttau ananvayaḥ na anvayo bhavati paurṇamāsīsūktavāke, tadvat |
saumikadevatāsaṃkīrtanānāṃ sūktavāka- vākyena saṃśogāt sūktavākyasya ekadeśatvāt |
‘bhṛjjacintrā, harivante dhānāḥ, pūṣaṇavate karambhaṃ, sarasvatīvate parivārpa, ayaṃ yajamānaḥ 0’ iti |
yat ‘yathā niṣkarṣe ananvayaḥ’ ityuktaṃ tatra samānatantratvāt darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ, paurṇamāsyāṃ ca arthalopāt darśadevatānāṃ lopāt paurṇamāsīsūktavāke ananvayaḥ nānyaḥ |
tasmāt āgnimārutā- dūrdhvaṃ anuyājotkarṣeṇa utkṛṣyamāṇe sūktavāke savanīya- puroḍāśadevatānāmapi utkarṣaḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 15,21, utkarṣavidhiḥ kriyā-guṇa-jāti- dravyaviṣayakatvena caturvidhaḥ |
vidheyāṃśe uddeśyaviśeṣaṇabhāvāṃśe veti trividhaḥ iti saṃhatya dvādaśavidhaḥ |
āghāne iṣṭipūrvatvaṃ soma- pūrvatvaṃ vetyubhau pakṣau brāhmaṇasyāpi |

idānīṃ saṃdehaḥ kiṃ trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ iṣṭipūrvatvaṃ somapūrvatvaṃ vā, uta brāhmaṇasya somapūrvatvameva, uta paurṇamāsī utkṛṣyate, brāhmaṇasya ubhau kalpau iti, athavā karmāntaramidaṃ yadūrdhvaṃ somāt, athavā ekaṃ haviṣkṛṣyate brāhmaṇasya ubhau kalpau iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ iṣṭipūrvatvaṃ soma- pūrvatvaṃ vā |
utkarṣo hi śrūyate ‘āgneyo vai brāhmaṇo devatayā, sa someneṣṭvā agnī- pomīyo bhavati |
yadevādaḥ paurṇamāsaṃ haviḥ, tat tarhi anunirvapet, tarhi ubhayadevato bhavati’ iti |
kimiva hi vacanaṃ na kuryāt ? tasmāt brāhmaṇasya somapūrvatvameveti |
nahi kalpayoḥ brāhmaṇasya kaścit viśeṣa āmnāyate |
śrutisaṃyogaḥ : paurṇamāsyā- statra ‘yadevādaḥ paurṇamāsaṃ haviḥ’ iti |
yāvadvacanaṃ vācanikaṃ, tatra na nyāyaḥ kramate ‘tulyayoḥ ekadeśo utkṛṣye nūnaṃ aparo'pi, ekadeśaḥ utkṛṣyate’ iti |
bhāṣyam-- yaducyate kevalā paurṇamāsī utkṛṣyate iti, tatra |
itarathā na syāt phalaṃ, eka- deśatvāt paurṇamāsyāḥ |
kevalāyāmutkṛṣyamāṇāyāṃ ava- śiṣṭasya pūrvatra kriyamāṇasya na phalaṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- naitadasti kṛtsnotkarṣa iti yadevaṃ samu- dāyasya asati vacane utkarṣaḥ parikalpyeta |
tasmādanya- deva evaṃnāmarkaṃ karma ūrdhvaṃ somāt syāt |
evaṃ eka- deśasya aśrutaṃ phalaṃ na kalpayitavyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
nāma- dheyaṃ tu dvayoḥ karmaṇorekaṃ, akṣaḥ pādāḥ pādāḥ iti yathā |
karma- vidhānaṃ śruteḥ etat bhavati, tat vākyasya bādhakam |
dup-- yadi kevalā paurṇamāsī utkṛṣyeta phalaṃ na syāt |
dharmagrahaṇe lakṣaṇā- śabdaḥ śrutisaṃbhave kalpyaḥ syāt |
tasmāt prasiddhena nāmnā prakṛtasya karmaṇo grahaṇaṃ kālavidhānārthaṃ syāt |
yatra phalaṃ na śrūyate, vākyādau'pi tāvattatra yadyate |
kalpyaṃ phalaṃ iti yaducyate, na tat phalaṃ vacanamantareṇa, tatra phalavacanaḥ śabdaḥ kalpyeta, tena ca sahaikavākyatā |
kālavacanena tu saha pratyakṣaṃ ekavākya- teti |
ḍup- paurṇamāsaprakaraṇe śrutaṃ nālaṃ karmāntaraṃ kalpa- yitum|
ato niśatyasya yāgasya kālamupadiṣṭasya kṛtārthe vākyaṃ aśaktaṃ karmāttaravidhau|
ataḥ tatsaṃbandhena phalasya coditatvāt darśo'pi utkṛṣyateti|
vacanamidaṃ 'yadevādiḥ paurṇamāsaṃ haviḥ; tat tathaiva anunirvapet' iti|
yat phalaṃ nāstīti, samudāyādeva phalaṃ bhaviṣyatīti, vacanāt evaṃvijñānāt|
ekaṃ vā śabdasāmarthyāt, prāk kṛtsnavidhā- nāt|
bhāṣyam-- ekaṃ vā haviḥ utkṛṣyate, na kṛtsnā paurṇamāsī|
yāvadvacanaṃ vācanikaṃ, tat vacanena utkṛṣṭhaṃ śakyate, nānyadapi|
prāk somāt kṛtsnaṃ vidhīyate, tato yat vacanena utkṛṣyate, tat ūrdhvaṃ somāt, yanno- tkṛṣyate, tat prāk bhavitumarhati|
uddeśyatā'vacchedakamapi ca nāgnīṣomadevatāka- havirvat, tathāpi yāge uttarakālatayā abhaktā'nāpatteḥ|
nāpi tadevatākāgalaṃ tadevatākaprakṛtayāgalaṃ vā, tadevatā- katvasya viśeṣaṇatve taddhikṛtau devatātantryakāyāṃ somo- ttaratvasya atideśānāpatteḥ|
upalakṣaṇatve ca viṣṇupajā- patidevatvasyāpi upāṃśuyājasya somottaratvāpatteḥ|
kiṃtu agnīṣomadevatānirākaraṇatārūpitakāryatāvacchedakī- bhūto yaḥ tadapūrvasādhanatā'vacchedakadhyāpyo dharmaḥ; tada- stvam|
asti hi brīhyādidaivikalpikasādhanasthale dhyabhicāraparihārāya āgneyopayogādyājyādevyādyo dharmaḥ ityuktaṃ teṣāmadhikaraṇe (3|1|17-18) kaustubhe|
tasya yadyapi nānyatra avaghātādisaṃskāravidhau uddeśyatā'- vacchedakakoṭipaviṣṭaṃ gauravāt, tathāpi atra artha- yādavaśāt tasya uddeśyatāvighātaḥ|
ataśca viṣṇupajā- patijanyatāvacchedakavyāpyadharmayoḥ vyāpakadharmopāṃśuyāja- tvasya ca svavyāpyapi agnīṣomajanyatāvacchedakatvā- bhāvāt noddeśyatā'vacchedakatvam|
agnīṣomīyapuroḍāśe tu apūrvasādhanatā'vacchedakībhūtasya agnīṣomīyayāgava- syaiva agnīṣomajanyatāvacchedakatvāt svavyāpyatvācca noddeśyatā'vacchedakatvavyāghātaḥ|

tattaddhikṛtau devatātantra- yuktāyāṃ tu tattaddhikṛtitvasya tattadevatājanyatāvaccheda- kasya tattaddhyāpyadharmatvāpanatayā uktavidhavyāpyatva- sattvāt noddeśyatā'vacchedakatvavyāghātaḥ iti dhyeyam|
atra ca anupādeyaguṇayoge'pi na karmāttaratvāśaṅkā, darśapūrṇa- māsaprakaraṇapaṭhitatvāt|
tathā ca laukiko nyāyo''nugato bhavati utkṛṣṭaḥ|
iti laukiko nyāyaḥ yathā rājadṛṣṭiḥ kṣattarī|
(evaṃ nikṛṣṭe ādityādau utkṛṣṭasya grahaṇaḥ dṛṣṭiḥ kartavyā ayamādityo brahma iti, na vaiparītyam|
nyāyani. 1|3|12|13 vas., 'utkṛṣṭaṣṭyā nikṛṣṭa- mupāsyam' iti nyāyānugṛhītavākyā dvitīyā-itiśabda- śrutibhyāṃ utkṛṣṭaniṣṭayotkṛṣṭamevopāsyaṃ phalaviśeṣapara- tvāt rājādivat ityanumānabhañjāt|
4|1|4|1 vas. brahmaṇaḥ pradhānatve'pradhānatve vā brahaiva phalavada iti śruterupapattau satyāṃ nikṛṣṭe utkṛṣṭadṛṣṭiḥ kartavyā iti laukikanyāyo na bādhanīyaḥ|
uragasya viṣadaṃṣṭrāḥ utkhātāścet sa urago yathā kamapi na bādhate, tathā mūlavināśāduttaraṃ jīvanmuktasya dṛśyamāno'pi saṃsāro na bādhitumalaṃ ityarthaḥ|
uttamapuruṣeṇa vidhiśaktipratikramaḥ 'barhirdeva- sadanaṃ dāmi ' 'śukaṃ tvā śukyā... yajñape gṛhṇāmi ' ityādau|
vā. 2|1|6|13, uttamapuruṣa-yacchabda-āma- ntraṇādyupetavidhiśaktyo mantrāḥ na karmāttaraṃ kalpayanti|
'uttarā dohayati' itya sarvāsāṃ gavāṃ dohanaṃ vidhīyate|
vi. 11|1|9. uttarāyāśca yoneśca tvāmiddhi0 sa tvaṃ naścitra0 ityanayoḥ prathamayena saṃpādita- kakubhoreva bṛhadrathaṃtarayogaṃ jyotiṣṭome|
25-28, uttarayorapi svayontyattaroreva kaṇvaratha- tasya vaidyastome pṛṣṭhastotrasādhanatayā vihitasya gānaṃ, na rathaṃtarāyuttarayoḥ |
oṃ 'uttarayogyāyati' ityuttarāśabdena uttarā- granthasyoḥ yoneruttarayoḥ dvayorṛcorgrahaṇam ||
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome samāmananti 'rathaṃtaramuttara- yogyāyati', 'bṛhaduttarayogyāyati', 'kavacīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati', 'yadyonyāṃ gāyati, taduttarayogyāyati' iti |
athedānīmidaṃ saṃdihyate kiṃ yonyuttarayorvā, uttarāgranthasamītāyorvā, utottarāgranthasamīte eva upādātavye iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? niyamakāriṇaḥ śāstrasya abhāvādaniyamaḥ iti |
āha, dravyāmapi samākhyāpraka- raṇābhyāṃ vākyaṃ balīyaḥ |
sarve hi saṃnnidhiśabdāḥ padāntaranapekṣa- māṇā na kaṃ cidapi arthamāhuḥ |
tasmādapekṣitaṃ padā- ntaraṃ, tat prakṛtaṃ saṃnihitaṃ vā |
itasthā aparipūrṇārthe vākyaṃ anabhidhāyakameva kasya cidarthasya syāt |
nahi saṃjñāsu gṛhyamāṇasu padāntarānantarya- mapekṣitavyaṃ bhavati |
dup-- 'rathaṃtaramuttarayogyāyati' ityatra pūrvapakṣa- vādī uttarāśabdaṃ saṃkhyāśabdaṃ manyate, (tena) 'yad yonyāṃ taduttarayogyāyati' iti vākyāt yonyuttare (yoniśca uttarā ca te dve iti jñeyam |
paramārthamāha-- ) athavā 'yad yonyāṃ taduttarayoḥ' iti yonyuttare vākyāt, uttarāgranthagate iti vākyādeva |
siddhāntastu uttarāśabdo rūḍhyā granthe prasiddhaḥ, 'uttarā- vartante, uttarā adhyāpyāmaḥ' iti (prayogāt) |
(nanu saṃkhyāyāmapi rūḍha eva, tatra ko viśeṣaḥ ? tamāha-) asmin (uttarāgranthasye) gṛhyamāṇe (tu) gṛhyamāṇeṣu (saṃnnidhiśabdatvāt ) prakṛtamapekṣitavyam |
tatra vila- mbivaḥ pratyayaḥ, itaratra tu avilambitaḥ |
ekaṃ kaṃ cit sāmānyaviśeṣamāśritya tṛcaśabdamupa- caranti |
etadevamukte yadiśeṣe kaścit saṃkhyā bhavati, itarathā hi sarvatra sarvasaṃkhyā bhaveyuḥ; tathāhi saṃvyavahārābhāvaḥ syāt |
tasmāt samānacchandakāsu samānadevatākāsu ca tṛcaśabdocārāt uttarāgrantha- samītā eva mahītavyāḥ iti |
soma-- astu pūrvatra saṃśaraviśeṣopaprasallakṣaṇa- viśeṣaniyāmakasadbhāvāt samāstveva (samānacchandakā- sveva sāmagānaṃ) iti niyamaḥ |
iha tu viśeṣaniyāmakā- bhāvāt aniyamaḥ ityucyateḥ |

nanu rūḍhatve uttarāgranthe yatrakāpi paṭhitorapi ṛcorgrahaṇaṃ syāt, tattadyonyuttarayoreva grahaṇaṃ ityatra niyamakā- bhāvāt iti cet maivaṃ, uttarāgranthe yonipāṭho na yoni- svarūpārthaḥ; chandonāmakamayaḥ yathātādeva tatsvarūpāya- gateḥ |
kiṃtu yonyuttarayoḥ uttarāgranthapaṭhitayoreva yathā syāt ityevamarthameva ṛgantarasaṃvalitatayā yonipāṭhaḥ, iti tathaiva niyāmakatvāt |
śrutyarthastu-- naimittikaṃ saṃjñānimittameva uttarātvaṃ ānantaryāt pratisaṃbandha- pekṣākṛtamyavadhānābhāvāt pratīyate iti |
(chandoya-tathayoḥ : uttarānāmakamayathayorvā ṛcoḥ gīteḥ sāmagānasya ūhanaṃ iti saṃśayaḥ |
) bhāṭṭa-- 'yonyāṃ gāyati taduttarayoḥ' ityatra uttarāśabdena yonyuttarayostattarāgranthapaṭhitayośca uttarayo- rgrahaṇaṃ, uta uttarāgranthapaṭhitayoreveti saṃdehaḥ |
uttarā- śabdasya 'prastaramuttaraṃ barhiṣaḥ sādayati, tūṣṇīmuttarā dohayati' ityādau saṃnnidhiśabdatvadarśanāt, vaiva yoneḥ parataḥ paṭhitā, saivottarā |
tataśca yonigranthe rathaṃtarāyoneḥ parato bṛhadyoneḥ pāṭhāt tasyāṃ rathaṃtarasya gānam |
uttarā- granthe ca rathaṃtarāyoneḥ parato 'na tvāvā~ anyo divyo na pārthivaḥ' ityasyāḥ pāṭhāt tasyāmapi vikalpena |
citrāyāge 'sāra- svatī bhavataḥ' ityatra yājyānuvākyā''dirūpottara- padārthapravṛttyā ādau sarasvatī tataḥ sarasvatī iti tannirvāpakramopapattiḥ |
saṃkrame. 2|1|26, uttaravediḥ sādhyeṣu śāstrīyasaṃskāranirapekṣaiva gṛhyate urvarā bhūmiḥ |
uttarārdhadhikaraṇanyāyena (1|1|9|47-53) yāvat prathamā'ntaṃ (āyuryajñena kalpatāṃ ityādi) kalpitabhedaḥ iti na kapiñjalādhikaraṇanyāyena trivamātra- paryavasānā'śaṅkā |
kau. 2|1|6|48 pṛ. 128. iṣyate ca uttaranyāyena pramāṇāntarasattve anya- trāpi kapiñjalādhikaraṇanyāyāt |
yathā 'āgneyaḥ sūphariṣṭakā upadadhāti' ityatra yāvadidaṃ āgneyasṛ- grahaṇaṃ, na tu tatra kapiñjalādhikaraṇanyāyapravṛttiḥ |
10|3|4. uttarārdha (puroḍāśasya) tyāgaṃ prati guṇaḥ, prakṣepāṃ prati pradhānam |
bhā. 3|5|4|17. uttarārdhasya avayavino vā havipaḥ sviṣṭakṛtakṣepaḥ na prayojakaḥ, ājyaprakṣepasya tu prayojakaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'uttarādhārta sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ puroḍāśasya āgneyāyaḥ prayojakaḥ sviṣṭakṛta aprayojakaḥ, uta ubhayamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? 'ekanibhakteḥ sarve samaṃ syāt' iti |
vidya- mānasya avayavinaḥ ekadeśa upādātavyaḥ iti tatrādhau bhavati, na avayavinamupādātya iti |
yathā 'ikṣukhaṇḍa- maso prayaccha', 'modakaśakalamasmai prayaccha' iti na ikṣumupādādīta iti gamyate |
sata: ikṣoḥ laṇḍamupādādīta, sato modakāt śakalamupādādīta iti (tu gamyate) |
aprayojakaḥ puroḍā- śasya sviṣṭakṛt iti, naitadevam |
sviṣṭakṛtye anyaḥ puroḍāśa utpāda- yitavyaḥ, yasyottarādhārta sviṣṭakṛdiṣyate |

tasya agnaye saṃkalpitasya neṣṭe yajamānaḥ, kathamasau tat anyasmai devatāyai dadyāt ? kathaṃ agniṃ prati nirdeśa iti ? idaṃ śrūyate 'aggiraso vā ita uttamāḥ suvarga lokamāyan, te yaśasā'bhyayan, te puroḍāśaṃ priyasva, bṛhaspatiṃ priyasva, ādityāya priyasva, sa nāpriyata |
ṭup-- agnaye sakalasya nirdeśāt tasyottarādhaḥ kathamanvena yujyate |
yasmin anupādyamāne artho na sidhyati, saḥ arthād- tyāpyate |
saṃnihite ca śeṣe sati sidhyati uttarādhārta grahaṇam |
yadeva anyārthe dravyaṃ saṃnihitaṃ, tasyaiva uttarādhārta grahītavyam |
uttarādhārta hi sviṣṭakṛte śrūyate, na amuṣya dravyasyeti, na caitāvatā vyavahāro bhavati |
sa eṣa saṃnihitamepekṣate, saṃnihitaṃ ca parārtham |
ataśca aprayojiketi ; yaduktaṃ anīśānena na śakyaṃ dātumiti, vaducyate |
ṭup-- uttarādhārta iti śeṣaśrutyanyā'nupapattyā śeṣiṇaṃ prayuṅkte |
na ca evaṃ śrūyate puroḍāśasya uttarādhārta iti |
bhāṣyam-- karmanimittaśca sviṣṭakṛto bhāga iti śrūyate |
katham ? 'devā vai sviṣṭakṛtamabruvan, havyaṃ no vaheti |
so'bravīt uttarādhaiva mahyaṃ sakasa- kṛta avadyāt' iti |
karma kurvato bhāgo'yaṃta uttarā- dhārta iti stutirbhavati |
yadi āgneyasya uttarādhārta ityucyate, tato'sti karmārthena bhāgena sādṛśyamidaṃ, tat āgneyaṃ havyaṃ, yat kila vahasīti |
prayojakatve ca asati sādṛśye stuti- sāmañjasyaṃ na syāt |
bhāṣyam-- liṅgamati bhavati 'tad yat sarvebhyo havibhyaḥ samavadyati, tasāt idamudare viśvarūpamatraṃ samavadhīyate' iti |
yadi parārthāt dravyāt saṃnihitā- diyate, tadā tatsaṃnidhānādviśeṣāt sarvebhyo'vadīyate ityupapadyate |
tathā idamaparaṃ liṅgaṃ 'śepā- diḍāmavadyati' 'śepāt sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati' iti |
soma-- pūrvatra hṛdayādyarthasya paśoḥ śaklulohita- grahaṇasaṃbhavāt tasyāprayojakatve'pi iha prakṛtapuroḍāśo- ttarādhagrahaṇasaṃbhavāt sviṣṭakṛtaḥ prayojakatvaṃ iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |

sarvapradānādhikaraṇokta- rītyā (3|4|14) kṛtsnasya puroḍāśasya āgneyatā- karaṇāt yajamānasya tatra svāmitvabhāvena tasya devatā'- ntaroddeśena tyāgāyogyāt tadyadai (sviṣṭakṛtyai) puroḍā- śāntaraṃ saṃpādya tasyottarādhārta sviṣṭakṛta yakṣyavyaḥ |
ihā''dau tu devantā'ntarasaṃgatyabhāvāt prakṛtagrahaṇaṃ na duṣyati |
na ca puroḍāśāntaramaṇe 'śepāt sviṣṭakṛto'- vadyati' iti śeṣaśca sviṣṭakṛto'virodhaḥ |
(iti vācyam) 'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsāpayati' ityatra karmāntare śeṣa śabdasya puroḍāśāntare'pi upapatteḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yadi prakṛtasambandhamanapekṣya 'uttarādhārta' iti vākyaṃ svārtha- bodhakaṃ syāt, tadā dravyāntaraprayojakaṃ syāt |
uttarārdhaśabdasya sāpekṣatayā asyottarādhārta iti saṃśraya jñāne vākyārthopavasānāt |
evaṃ ca 'kasya' ityapekṣāyāṃ saṃnihitāgneyasya ityeva uttarādhārta prakṛta- sambandhyuttarādhameva avalambate iti na puroḍāśāntarayukteḥ avakāśaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- ekadeśadravyaṃ sviṣṭakṛdādi karma aprayojakaṃ karmopadiṣṭatvāyāmeva vidha- mānena āgneyādipuroḍāśādinā saṃbandhāt iti |
yadvā prakṛtopajīvīṃ syā, dvāt svasya siddhaye |

bhāṭṭa-- yatra 'uttarādhārta sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati' ityādau na dvitīyānirdeśaḥ tatra pratipattive pramāṇābhāvāda- pādānatvena śrutasyottarādhasya yāgaṃ prati guṇatvāduttarādhasya tāvadyāgaḥ prayojako bhavatyeva |
na ca prakṛtapuroḍāśasya avayavitve na svatantrāpekṣatvaṃ, prakṛtasya
patañjalayuktyāniyamamevareva pramāṇatvamāgamāt vāgyogavit na ca tasya pratipattisāpekṣatvāt prakṣepaśenāsya ityādīnāmeva apasmṛtitvāpattiḥ (iti kecitpakṣe doṣaḥ)|
prakṣepasyāpi āgneyādi- kau. 3|1|8|27 pṛ. 131. prakṣepatvaṃ svāgācchatvenaiva prayojanāpekṣatvāt, uttarārdhasya aṃśabhedenāpi guṇatvapradhānatvayorsvīkāre vairūpyaprasaṅgācca |
uttiṣṭhan iti mantre kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ, na tu utthāne ataḥ siddhaṃ sviṣṭakṛdyāgaḥ arthakameva prajāvādivat mantravidhiḥ |
bhā. 3|1|4|10 uttiṣṭhannavāha amīda- yadyapi tāvadarthakameva syāt, tathāpi sasaṃbandhitvāt gnīn vihara vrataṃ kuruteti vācaṃ visṛjate iti ca |
pratisaṃbandhyapekṣāyāṃ, yāvanmantrapratisaṃbandhitvātḥ tāvannā- tatra jyotiṣṭome abhiviharaṇapreṣe amīdagnīn vihara nyākṣepatvaṃ, gauravāt |
asti ca prakṛte pratipatteḥ iti mantro'nvitaḥ |
ata eva śeṣāsviṣṭa- kuruta iti mantro'nvitaḥ |
na tu utthāne vāgvimoge kṛte ityapi liṅgamupapadyate |
ataḥ asamarthayorviniyogāsaṃbhavāt agalyā lakṣaṇā- prati guṇatvena viniyuktasyāpi pradhānagatapratipatsā- mapi aṅgīkṛtya kālo vidhīyate |
'nurodhena vākyāntarakalpanāyā prakṣepaśaṃ prati prādhānye'pi na kṣatiḥ |
utthānavāgvisargayoḥ pattereva dhāraṇaprayojakatvakalpanādayoge nānumite hyasau kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
sarvāṇi havīṃṣi samavadyati iti liṅgamapi prādhānyā- dupapannam |
eva san sviṣṭakṛtprakṣepasya tadapyaktaḥ, bhāṣyam - jyotiṣṭome śrūyate uttiṣṭhannavāha amī- pratipādyatvāviśeṣāt |
ataḥ sa nāvayavino nottarārdhasya dagnīn vihara iti |
ājyaprakṣepasya tu prayojako bhavyatveti visṛjati iti |
va prati mantro'rūpadeśaḥ, uta kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
yatra pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ, śaṃkara - āgneyādeḥ sviṣṭakṛcca |
uttarārdhavarṇaśena rathaṃtaraṃ gātavyaṃ, na yonirvarṇa- amīdagnīn ityevaṃ uttiṣṭhan anvāha iti, vrataṃ kuruta śena |
bhā. 9|1|132-133 uttaraśabdo rūḍhyā ityevaṃ vācaṃ visṛjati iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
lakṣaṇābhāvāt granthe prasiddhaḥ, uttarā vartate, uttarāḥ adhyāyāpāmaḥ iti |
ityamyāne vācaṃ visṛjati iti vākyena pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
uttarottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ iti nyāyena liṅgena siddhāntaḥ |
yadyapi ca śakyate utthānakriyā vāgyogavit ityādīnāṃ puruṣārthaparatve'pi kātyāyanoktatvena amīdagnīn vihara iti vaktum |
tathāpi adṛṣṭārthaṃ vacanaṃ bhavati, iti na mantrayoḥ utthānavisarjanārthatā kalpyamānāyāṃ ca mantrā- ntara vihitaṃ bādhyeta yāḥ paśūnāmṛṣabho vācaḥ iti |
vidhiṣo'pyatra vāgvisarjane yāḥ paśūnāmṛṣabho vātra nyāyyā |
vā-- atideśasūtrātvāt sarvaṃ pūrvasvārthā yoja- soma--kimanayormantrayoḥ gauṇe utthāne vāgvisarjane yitavyāḥ |
idānīṃ ca viniyogaḥ, kivā mukhye abhiviharaṇavratapreṣaiḥ taraṇa- vidhānāve'pi iti viśeṣaḥ |
viramyāsparatvācca tatra puroḍāśābhighāraṇapreṣaṇe vratakaraṇapreṣaṇe ca viniyogaḥ, mantropadeśo na jñātaḥ, na tviha tathā pūrvapakṣe bījam |
utthānavāgvisargābhyāṃ tu mantrayoḥ kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ iti |
utthānenāgnirīdhyate ityanena ( bhāṣyeṇa ) utthānaṃ tatrotthāne vāgvisarjane ca mantrayorvacanaina viniyogāt prakāśayate iti pratipādyate |
yadā ayaṃ ( mantraḥ ) vacanāt tvayyārthe ( 3|1|12 ) iti pūrvatatrādhi- utthānāṅgaṃ bhavati, tadā praiṣābhāvāt praiṣādhikāro nāsti karaṇanyāyena gauṇeṣveva viniyogaḥ |

evaṃ ca vahniṣva- ( praiṣādhikaraṇe 3|1|11 ) iti prāptakālātāyāṃ mānadeśagatenādhvaryuṇā utthānaṃ vinā amīdagnīn adhi- loṭaṃ kalpayitvā adhvaryurtṛkāṇyeva abhiviharaṇādīni viharaṇadeśca kartumaśakyatayā amīdagnādisādhanatvena bhaveyuḥ |
ataśca tadīyamubhayaṃ teṣāṃ kartṛtvena vivakṣya- gauṇyā utthānā anadhīyate |
tathā kṛvi hiṃsāyām iti māṇaṃ amīt ityādibhiḥ śakyaṃ prakāśayitum |

dhātoḥ kuṇutaśabdaṃ niṣpādya bhakṣaṇasyāpi hiṃsā rūpatvā- evaṃ vrataṃ kuruta iti vāgabhidhānaṃ vāk tṛpyatu śrayaṇena vrataṃ payoyavādidaṃ kuruta bhakṣayata ititattva āśrayādvāco yat āsyasya vratakaraṇe ityevaṃ visarjanagarbhabhūtavāgeva anena mantreṇa kartṛlopacārā- kartṛtvaṃ tat śakyaṃ vācyaṃ upacarituṃ, tatra vrataṃ kuruta prātaḥ |
aindrīvat iha gauṇeṣveva mantraviniyojaka- guṇābhāvāt ( 3|1|13 ) mantraguṇābhāvāt itye- śrutyābhāvāt samabhivyāhārāvagatasaṃbandhasya kālārthasaṃyoga- tadeva adṛṣṭārthatvaprasaṅgenocyate |
tvenāpyupapatteḥ, liṅgena mukhya eva viniyogaḥ ; iti parapreṣaṇamantareṇopapadyate iti vakṣyāmaḥ |
sūtrārthastu--utthānavisarjane api āhvāna- yugapadvikṣituṃ śakyate padārthasya prātaḥ kālaḥ tava ca vat na mantraprāptaye iti |
iti, midyeta hi tathā vākyaṃ iti praiṣādhikaraṇabhāṣye [ 3|1|10|11 pṛ. 1126 ] liṅgamapi kiñcidvedyam ( su- vi-- uttiṣṭhan pranademīdagnīndidaṃ tathā |
pṛ. 1098 ) liṅgamapi kiñcidvedyam ( su- kuruta vratamityevaṃ paṭhan vācaṃ visṛjati |
mantrau liṅgāntarābhāve'pi guṇābhāvasūtraṃ amīdagnamantrayoḥ vidheyau kālau vā, mantrotthānamayokoḥ |
viniyojyau na mukhyavṛttyā utthānavāgvisargaprakāśanāsāmarthya'pi gauṇa- kālasya lakṣaṇā yujyate vidhau |
, mantrārthānanyāt tatra sāmarthyasatvāt śrautaviniyogopapatyā śaṅkānirāsārtha- tadvidhinaiva śakyate |
agalyā lakṣaṇā tena kāle tvena loṭ vyatiriktasya mantrabhāgasya sāmarthya- vidhīyate |

' saṃbhave'pi loṭasya praipaviṣayalakṣaṇasya guṇasya utthānavāgvisargagauravāttvāt ityevaṃ vyākhyāya bhaṭṭa--some uttiṣṭhan anvāha amīdagnīn vihara āmantraṇādisādhamyai liṅgamāśrīyate tadā ityanena tathā vrataṃ kuruta iti vācaṃ visṛjati |
darśapūrṇa- nyāyena [ vā. 3|1|16 pṛ. 757 ] amīt ityā- māsayoḥ : praṇītāḥ preṣyan vācaṃ yacchati, tāṃ mantraṇamādhyaṃ ca liṅgasūtrārthatvena vyākhyāyaṃ ityāśayaḥ |
tatrāpi pūrvavadeva mantrāṇāṃ mukhye'pi viniyogaḥ; na tu gauṇayoḥ : utthāna- vāgvisargayoḥ |
pralakṣāpi brāhmaṇavākyasya kālavidhā- yitvenāpi upapattau gauṇatātparyagrāhakatvābhāvāt |
lakṣaṇa, śatapratyayasya kālikasaṃbandhena upalakṣaṇārtha- tvamaṅgīkṛtya śrutyaiva anyonyapatteḥ |
vrataṃ kṛṇuta ityatra itikaraṇasyāpi mantrasvarūpamātraparatvāt kālikasaṃbandhasyaiva saṃsargavidhayā bhānopapatteḥ na lakṣaṇā |
haviṣpradākye tṛtīyāyāstu vāgyamāpekṣitāvadhisamarpakatvena tadekavākyatāpattau vākyabhede pramāṇābhāvāt itthaṃbhūta- lakṣaṇārthatāmaṅgīkṛtya kālavidhiraparavam |
ataśca tadvā- kyoḥ pāṭhakramāvagatatantramantrapāṭhakāle vāgavisargaḥ kartavyaḥ iti so'pi tatra kālavidhirave |
5. 🜸 utpattidopi hi caṇakaḥ śakaḥ kiṃ āṣṭakaṃ bhaṅktumiti nyāyaḥ |
asyārthaḥ, upatito'pi bharjana- samaye bhṛṣṭaḥ santutito'pītyarthaḥ |
āṣṭakaṃ bharjana- kāriṇaṃ bhaṅktuṃ nāśayituṃ śakaḥ samarthaḥ kiṃ ? api tu netyarthaḥ |
yo hi jano'pakartumasamarthaḥ san kupyati, sa nilajja evetyarthavidyakāyāmayaṃ pracarati |
sāhasī.796. utpattiḥ anyatra, viniyogo'nyatra, evaṃ sati kataravedasaṃyogo bhavatu iti cintā |
utpattisaṃyoge vikalpe vā prāpte, viniyogavedasaṃyogaḥ prādhānyāt ityuttaram |
vā. 3|2|9 pṛ. 814, utpattiḥ karmaṇaḥ sarvatra upadeśena gamyate, nātideśena |
nahi anutpanne karmaṇi kathaṃbhāvo bhavati, na ca tasmin- sati atideśaḥ pravartate |
2|1|721 pṛ. 525. utpattiṃ vidhiviparivṛttireva pratipadyati, na svarūpa- viparivṛttiḥ |
camasādhvaryūṇāṃ saṃkhyā kiṃ aniyamena kā cit grāhyā, niyatā vā kā cit iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
tuśabdena caśabdādīnīyena camasā- dhvaryavaḥ iti padaṃ pūrvasūtrādanukṛṣyate |
bahupadaṃ ca buddhyā pṛthak kṛtvā āvaśyaṃ prathamādyavacanāntane vipari- ṇamayya yojanīyam |
tathā ca camasādhvaryavaḥ bahavaḥ eva syuḥ; na tu aniyamaḥ |
kutaḥ ? utpattau 'camasādhvaryū gṛṇīte' iti utpattividhau bahuśruteḥ bahulaśruteḥ |
yadyapi uddeśyagataṃ bahutvamavivakṣitaṃ bhavati, tathāpi ṛtvija- tathāpyetat vivakṣitameva bahutvam |
tathāca camasādhvaryavo bahavaḥ syuḥ ! ke. 🜹 utpattau nityasaṃyogāt |
yasya aṅgavaikalyaṃ pratisamādhātuṃ naiva śakyaṃ, tasya apratisamādheyāṅgavaikalyasya puruṣasya ādhānādikarmādhi- kāro nāstyeva iti siddhāntamāha |
utpattitvelāyā- meva yo'nvādhāḥ tasya ananvādeḥ nityasaṃyogāt apari- hāryatvāt nāstyadhikāraḥ |
yattāvadutpattau eva aṅgavikalaḥ jātya- nvādiḥ sa nādhikriyate, nityasaṃyogāt ājyāvekṣaṇādi- bhiraṅgaiḥ kratoḥ nityasaṃbandhāvagamāt |
andhastu ājyā- vekṣaṇaṃ, paśuḥ viṣṇukraman, vadhiraḥ praiṣādiśravaṇaṃ, kartuṃ naiva śaknuyāt |
tasmāt apratisamādheyāṅgavaikalyasya nādhikāraḥ karmasu iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. 🜺 utpattau yena saṃyuktaṃ tadarthaṃ tacchrutihetu- tvāt, tasyārthāntaragamane śeṣatvāt pratipattiḥ syāt |
atra pratipatikarmaṇo lakṣaṇamucyate, tena ca kṛṣṇa- viṣāṇāyāḥ cāntāle prāsanasya pratipattirucyate |
utpattau utpattividhau 'kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāyā kaṇḍūyati' ityādi yat kṛṣṇaviṣāṇādidravyaṃ yena kaṇḍūyanādinā saṃyuktaṃ, tat viṣāṇādi tadarthe taccheṣabhūtaṃ kaṇḍūyanaśeṣabhūtameva jñeyam |
śrutihetutvāt śeṣaśeṣibhāvasya śrutihetutvāt viṣāṇāyā iti tṛtīyāśrutyā śeṣatvaṃ bodhitatvāt |

atha tasya viṣāṇādidravyasya arthāntaragamane anya- nārthena dakṣiṇādānottaraṃ cātvāle prāsanarūpā kriyā gamane saṃgrathe vihite sati śeṣatvāt viṣāṇāyāḥ prāsanarūpe kriyā'ntare guṇabhūtatvāt pratipattiḥ syāt viṣāṇāprāsane pratipattiḥ syāt |
adhikārārthastu kaṇḍūyanaṃ prāsanaṃ ceti ubhayaṃ vipāṇāyāḥ prayojakaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
kaṇḍūyanaṃ prayojakaṃ, prāsanaṃ tu pratipattiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
'kṛṣṇa- viṣāṇāyā kaṇḍūyati' iti kaṇḍūyane tṛtīyānirdeśāt viṣāṇāyāḥ guṇabhāvaḥ |
'nītāstu dakṣiṇāsu cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ prāsyati' iti prāsane dvitīyānirdeśāt anyatra kṛtārthatvāt prādhānyamiti |
ke. utpattau yena saṃyuktaṃ iti caturthe vakṣyamāṇasya pratipatikarmatvakāraṇasya kṛtakāryatvasya sarveṣvapi haviḥśeṣeṣu aviśeṣāt |
ku. 3|4|19|150. utpattau yena saṃyuktaṃ ityadhikaraṇe sviṣṭakṛdā- dīnāṃ pratipattirūpasaṃskārakarmatvaṃ vyavasthāpyate |
3|4|19|188. (utpattau yena saṃyuktaṃ tatra tadarthaṃ tacchrutihetutvāt tasyārthāntaragamane śeṣatvāt pratipattiḥ syāt ' iti pāṭho'tra ) 'śrute cārthaṃ' 'dadha- śraṃ' ityatrāpi pratipattiḥ syāt |
anyapūrvakaṃ śrutaṃ dadhi ca indrāyopanaṃ, tasyārthāntaragamanaṃ viṣṇuṃ śidhiviṣṭaṃ prati |
tasmāt tasyāpi 'utpattau yena' ityanena nyāyena pratipattiḥ prāpnoti |
padārthamūlatayā vākyārthaprāmāṇyaṃ iti pratipādanārthe asmin vākyādhikaraṇe tadbhūtādhikaraṇaparaparyāye pūrva- pakṣasūtramidam |
ke. ( sūtrākṣarārthārthe tu aneke granthā eva saṃkṣepataḥ udāhriyante ) |
padapadārthasaṃbandhasya utpattau vā autpatti- kace'pi codanā : avacanāḥ apramāṇabhūtāḥ syuḥ |
arthasya vākyārthajñānasya atannimittatvāt tādṛśasaṃbandhasya śaktirūpatve tātparyalūpatve vā puruṣasaṃndhāpekṣāyāḥ durnirvāratvāt |
avacanāḥ ityasya sthāne racanāḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |
utpattau padārthajñānotpattau satyāṃ vākyavākyārthayoḥ saṃbandhāḥ racanāḥ puruṣakalpitāḥ syuḥ |
arthasya vākyārthajñānasya atat padārthajñānabhinnaṃ nimittaṃ kāraṇaṃ yasya tattvāt |
utpattau avagamyate iti utpattiḥ vākyārtho dharmaḥ alaukikaśreyaḥsādhanatāyāgādibhāvanā- ''tmakaḥ |
śabdārthasaṃbandhānāṃ utpattau autpattikatve api na codanāyāḥ prāmāṇyam |
te hi sāmānya- mabhidadhati, vākyārthaśca viśeṣarūpaḥ |
nanu padā- mihitāḥ padārthā eva vākyārthe bodhayantu, tatrāha |
athavā śabdārthasaṃbandhānāṃ autpattikatve'pi vedavākyārthasya dharmasya avacanāḥ : apratipādakāḥ syuḥ |
na ca padārthānāṃ tannimittabhāvaḥ asaṃndhanatvāt iti sūtrārthaḥ |
prakṛtānāṃ śabdārthasaṃbandhānāṃ autpatti- katve'pi vedavākyārthasya dharmasya avacanāḥ : apratipādakāḥ apramāṇamiti yāvat |
varṇapadādīnāṃ pratyekasamudāya- vikalpitānāṃ vākyārthapratyayaṃ prati hetubhāvanupapatteḥ |
tannena cedaṃ artha- padaṃ vākyārthapadārthayoḥ : pūrvārdhābhyāṃ saṃbandhaṃ vyākhyāyem |
iti nyāya ratnākaraḥ pṛ. 846-847. autpattika iti utpattidavivaraṇam |
avacanāḥ ityasya vivaraṇaṃ 'na codanā - lakṣaṇaḥ' iti |
vākyasya vākyārthe saṃgatigrahaṇārthe lokāpekṣatvāt vedo dharme na pramāṇaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe sūtreṇa prāpte siddhāntamāha |
tadbhūtānāṃ teṣveva padārtheṣu bhūtānāṃ vartamānānāṃ padānāṃ kriyā'rthena samāmnāyaḥ sambhāvanaṃ kāryam |
nāna- pekṣya padārthān pārthakyena vākyaṃ arthāntaraprasiddham |
bhavedapyapattiḥ yadi asatyā- mapi śaktau nānyannimittamavakalpeta |
padāni hi svaṃsvaṃ padārtha- mabhidhāya nivṛttavyāpārāṇi |
athedānīṃ padārthāḥ avagatāḥ santo vākyārthe gamayanti |
tadbhūtānāṃ teṣveva padārtheṣu bhūtānāṃ vartamānānāṃ padānāṃ kriyārthena kriyāvacanena padena saha samāmnāyaḥ samyak parasparānvitasvārthabodhakatvena uccāraṇaṃ bhavati |
' antarvedi praṇītā ninayanti ' iti ca praṇītānāmapi |
kiṃ praṇītānāṃ saṃvayanaṃ prayojakaṃ ninayanaṃ ceti, uta |
saṃvayanaṃ prayojakaṃ, ninayanaṃ pratipattiḥ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣe |
praṇayati ' iti upanyāsā utpattividhinā saṃvayanena ninaya- |
nena vā kenāpi saṃyogo nāsti, tasmāt tāsāṃ vibhāgaḥ |
syāt artha saṃvayanārthe artha ca ninayanārthe iti |
loke māghyadine satre dakṣiṇā nīyante ' iti |
' agastyā hi tenaivotyattiḥ tenaiva ca viniyogaḥ |
tasmāt yaśopavītasyānuvāda eva na vidhiḥ iti |
pṛ. 171. ⚹ utsargaṃ yaḥ karoti tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati |
tatra 'ye puroḍāśo evaṃ 'sato vā liṅgadarśanaṃ' iti sūtraṃ dehā |
bhā. 3|7|8|19, utsargaṃ tu svayaṃ kurvatā sarva |
darbhoṃ : ' iti vākyāṃśo hi vidhirayaṃ anuvāde veti jñeyam |
na ca vayaṃ jhayena, virodhe vikalpena grāhyaḥ ityevaṃ suhṛd bhūtvā sūtra- devādīnāṃ rūpaṃ viccaḥ |
atha tu eṣa kāleṣu devāni kāraḥ śiṣyebhya upadiṣṭavān |
anyārthe ca vākyametaddarśayati 'pūrvāhṇo vai devānāṃ, maṇḍana-- 'pūrvāhṇau devakāryāṇi kuryāt |
' 6. aye gamane ṭup-- 'ya iṣyā paśūnā vā' iti paurṇamāsyāma- ayane |
māvāsyāyāṃ vā niyataṃ grahaṇaṃ, agnihotrādeḥ pakṣe'niṣṭa- tvāt ( nahi śuklapakṣe puṇyāhādau cāgnihotrānuṣṭhānamiha # udayanīyaṃ dvādaśāhasya uttamamahaḥ |
aharaharanuṣṭhānatavyatvāt- atò bhāṣye-- ) upa- 5|4. udayanīye atirātre prāyaṇīye ca ekādaśinānāṃ nayanacūḍākaraṇādīni tu udāharaṇaṃ ( uktam ) |
