bhā. 10|6|4|6-12. udayanīye aprayāje ( samuccite asamuccite vā kāle ) |
api sviṣṭakṛnnigade ayāḍadevānāmājyapānāṃ ityasya na lopaḥ |
ahanyeva śakyate kartumiti, na rātrī kariṣyate |
ṭup-- uttarasūtradvayaṃ na nyāyyat, niṣprayojana- jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'prāyaṇīyasya niṣkāse udayanīya- tvāt |
jyotiṣṭome prāyaṇīye'diti- soma-- brahmavaryaprabhṛtyupanayanādikālanirūpaṇaṃ devatākaścāgnibharvati, antimāyāmudayanīyasyāpi sa iti saṃgatiḥ |
te yadi niṣkāsena saṃskriyante, niṣkāso'pi prayojanavān bhavati |
atha tu niṣkāsaḥ saṃskriyate, na ca tena kaścidarthaḥ |
nanu tenāpi prāyaṇīyo nirvartitaḥ, tadarthasyāpi saṃskāraḥ |
apica niṣkāsasaṃskāro'yaṃ bhavan prāyaṇīyasya aṅgaṃ bhavet |
tasmādudayanīyaviṣayāṇāmayaṃ niṣkāsasaṃsargeṇa adṛṣṭaḥ upakāraḥ kriyate śrayaṇāvat |
tadyathā, 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti, dānābhirihāryojanaṃ' iti śrayaṇeḥ somasya |
soma- abhyadhayat niṣkāse nirvāpo'pi karmā- ntaraṃ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- avaśyameva iha udayanīye'pi niṣkāso guṇabhūtaḥ iti |
bhāṭṭa- jyotiṣṭome prāyaṇīye'tithyeṣṭiśca darśa- pūrṇamāsavikārau dvitīyānyadinayoḥ āmnātau |
tatodaya- nīyakaraṇe 'prāyaṇīyasya niṣkāse udayanīyamunir- pati' iti śrutam |
tatra pūrvavedeva udayanīyadharmakaṃ karmā- ntarameva prāyaṇīyaniṣkāsadravyakaṃ tatsaṃskāratayā āśrayi- karma vidhīyate, saptamī ca dvitīyārthe |
tataścodanīya- dharmāṇāṃ dvāramātratvamiti saṃgatilebhenā'śakya nirā- kriyate |
ataḥ prāyaṇīyaniṣkāsasya kṛtārthasya iyamī- padeśikī pratipattiḥ udayanīyanīvaḥ |
iti prāpte, nirvā- pasyāpi prakṛtau nirupyamāṇadravyasaṃskārārthatvena avagatasya niṣkāsārthatve aprākṛtakāryakāritā''caḥ |
nirvāpeṇa niṣkāsasya dṛṣṭapratipattirūpasaṃskārajanane ca prācīna- prayājanīyatvābhāvāt ubhayathā'pi adṛṣṭārthatvāvaśyakatve
niṣādasthapatyadhikaraṇanyāyena saptamīśrutyā prakaraṇācca tadīya- nirvāpātutrādena puroḍāśapākavat prāyaṇīyaniṣkāso vidhīyate |
udavasanīyaṃ karmaṃ 'satrādudavasāya pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena jyotiṣṭomena sahasradakṣiṇena yajeta' iti |
bhā. 10|2|12|39-40. oṃ udavasanīyaḥ satradharmā syāt tadaṅgatvān tatra dānaṃ dharmamātraṃ syāt |
'satrādudavasāya pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena jyotiṣṭomena sahasra- dakṣiṇena yajeta' iti udavasanīyaḥ soma uktaḥ |
sa satradharmā satrasya dharma eva dharmā yathāsau satradharmā syāt tadaṅgatvān satrāṅgatvān |
tasmāt tatra udavasanīya satrāṅge yat dānaṃ sahasradakṣiṇāyāḥ, tat dharmamātraṃ syāt na parikriyārtham |
tasmāt udavasanīyaḥ satradharmā tatra dānaṃ dharmamātraṃ aṣṭārthe iti pūrvaiḥ pakṣaḥ |
udavasanīyo jyoti- ṣṭomo na satradharmā, na ca tatra dānaṃ dharmamātram |
utpūrvasya avapūrvarasya prahāṇaṃ ityarthaḥ tat kṛtvā |
tasmāt vibhaktacoditatvāt udavasanīyo na satrāṅgaṃ, na ca tat tatprakṛtitaṃ tasmāda dānaṃ parikriyārtham |
udavasanīyaḥ satradharmā syāt tadaṅgatvān, tatra dānaṃ dharmamātraṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- asti udavasanīyaḥ 'satrādudavasāya pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena jyotiṣṭomena sahasradakṣiṇena yajeta' iti |
tatra eṣo'rthaḥ saṃśāyakaḥ : dakṣiṇādānaṃ dharmamātraṃ, uta parikriyārthamiti |
tathā idamaparaṃ dvaitaṃ kiṃ satrāṅgamūdava- sanīyaḥ, neti |
atha na satrāṅgaṃ, parikriyārthamiti ; kiṃ prāptam ? satrāṅgamiti |
yathā 'abhi citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta' 'vājapeyeneṣṭvā bṛhaspatisavena yajeta' iti |
evaṃ cet sāṅgasya satrasya svaṃ kartṛkatvāt dharmamātraṃ tatra dānam |
dup-- 'na ca satrodavasānakāle udavasanīyaḥ, lakṣaṇā hi tathā syāt' iti ( bhāṣyasya ) ko''bhi- prāyaḥ |
uttaraṃ-- na ( tāvat ) satraṃ asmin vākye vidhīyate ( vihitatvāt ) |
na satraṃ ka cit ( anyatra aṅgatvena vidhīyate ), na satre ( api ) kiṃcit ( vidhīyate ) iti satraṃ ( pariśeṣāt ) parārthe ( uda- vasanīyakālasrdha ) ucyeta ( siddhānte ) |
( tathāca lakṣaṇā- parihārāya satrāṅgatvena udavasanīyo vidhīyate ) |
'vājapeyeneṣṭvā' ( iti ) 'satrādudavasāya' ( iti ca ) tulyaṃ matvā pūrvapakṣaṃ karoti |
uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ : ( abhi- dhīyate ) naitayostulyatā kriyayoḥ : ( vājapeyasatrakriyayoḥ |
) vājapeyeneṣṭvā iti nirvanaṃ ( anuṣṭhāya ) pūrvakriyā anyat kriyā'ntaram vidhīyate tadaṅgatayā |
lakṣaṇayā tu tyāgo gamyate, na tu śa-śabdena |
kriyāviśeṣā hi ( kriyāyāḥ avasthā- viśeṣāḥ ) : ārambhānuṣṭhānaparisamāptayaḥ : ( na tu tathā tyāgaḥ ) |
( iha tu ) utpūrvaḥ avasthatiḥ śrutyaiva tyāgaṃ bravīti ( satra- ) karmaṇaḥ |
yadanyat vidhīyate ( pṛṣṭhaśamanīyaṃ ), tasyā- jñatā nāsti, pūrvaṃ karmaṇaḥ parisamāptatvāt |
yadi udava- sāyaśabdaḥ anugrahat ( tat ) kathamaṅgaṃ ( syāt ) |
naimittiko'yaṃ svatantraḥ iti cintāyāṃ, satrāṇāṃ phalavattvāt aphale'yaṃ bṛhaspatisavananyāyena ( 4|3|12|8 ) satrā- ṅgam|
yadyapi vā sanodavasānaṃ nimittaṃ, tathāpi aśvaprati- graheṭinyāyena ( 3|4|11 ) satrāṅgam|
na ca utpūrvekasya asyateḥ tadviṣayakavyāpāropāramatvāccitvāt, aṅgatve ca asyāpi tadviṣayakavyāpāratvātsarvebhāvāt udavasānottaratvā- nurodhena svatantraphalakatvanyāyapi na doṣaḥ iti vācyam|
ekasatrottaramapi satrāntarasya tasyaiva vā kāmanāvataḥ karaṇa- saṃbhavena satratvāvacchinnaviṣayakavyāpārasāmānyoparamasya kadā 'pi niśrutemaśakyatvāt|
atastasyā''pi tadyaktiprayogopa- ramaḥ eva udavasānapadārtho vācyaḥ|
sa ca mamāpi saṃbhava- tīti yuktamaṅgalaṃ bṛhaspatisavādivat|
na ca evamaṅgapradhā- nayorekakartṛtvāt yajamānasyaiva karaṇātpaṭho dakṣiṇā'''jñānā- nutpattiḥ, tasyāḥ adṛṣṭārthatvāṅgīkāreṇa akarmakarebhyo'pi brāhmaṇebhyo dānopapatteḥ|
vastutastu aṅgatve'pi prayoga- vahibhūtatvena pṛṣṭhaśamanīyesya ṛtvikkartṛkatvopapatteḥ bṛha- spatisave iva dakṣiṇā'''jñānāṃ na virudhyate|

'ye yaja- mānāste ṛtvijaḥ' ityanena hi satraprayogamadhyavarti- jyortiśena vājapeyaprayogamadhyavartipṛṣṭhopasadodeśena sata- daśaratnatvādi vidhivat yajamānavidhānāt bṛhaspati- savyapādo ātideśikadharmaprāptitat, ihāpi ṛtviganatara- syaiva prāpyupapattiḥ|
iti prāpte, 'satrādu- davasāya' ityatra utpūrvekasya avasthateḥ ( bo anta- karmaṇi |

so syati ) satratvāvacchinnopadheyaphalakatva- dveṣyakavyāpārasāmānyoparamatvāccitvāt, satyapi satrānta- rasya agre kartavyatve etatsatropadheyaphalakatveḥ vyāpāra- ntarābhāvena udavasānopapatteḥ, aṅgatve ca tadasaṃbandhādanaṅga- tvam|
ataḥ satrodavasāne nimitte naimittiko'yaṃ puruṣārthatayā vidhīyate|
ataśca tadakaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ karaṇācca pāpa- dhvaṃsaḥ|
prayojanaṃ, aṅgatve satrādhikāribhiḥ saṃhatya ṛtvigantarasaṃpapādanena karaṇaṃ, anaṅgatve tu vakṣyate|
ata eva ātideśikasya katraikatvasya sāsadadyadinā bādha- kalpakatvāt adhyāyasaṃgatiḥ|
' 'yāvat'srān' ityanena hi viśeṣyatvenopalakṣaṇī- bhūtanimittatvapratipādakena asaṃkhyāvacchinnaṃ naimi- ttikaṃ iti udavasānīyanyāyena śrūyamāṇamapi vāruṇa- bahuvamavivakṣitam|
'satrādudava- sāya pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena yajeran' ityatra kvāprāptyavatvādeva udavasānasamānakartṛkatvalatvāt kriyāviśeṣaṇamātravidhā- tini ātyante kartṛgatatva-sāhilyāvaviśadaśame vakṣyate|
su. pṛ. 1639. udavasānīyayā savanavibhāgamatulyaṃ sāṅgaṃ prayogaṃ tredhā vibhajya mandramadhyamottamoccāraṇaṃ saṃpādanīyam|

ūrdhvamavabhṛyāt, ā udavasānīyāyāḥ iṣṭeḥ, atipannānāṃ na pratihomaḥ syāt|
pratiṣedho hi bhavati, 'etayā punarādheyasaṃmitayevāgnihotraṃ hotavyaṃ' iti
te na kṛtā iti na syāt pratihoma iti|
sūtrārthastu-atra- myādutkarṣe iṣṭeḥ prāk na homaḥ iṣṭyanantaraṃ adhikāraprati- pādanavacanena arthāt pūrva pratiṣedhāt iti|
12. bhāṭṭa-- kṛte'''bhaye yadi udavasānīyotkarṣe daivā- dinā bhavet, tadā kāle prāpte agnihotrahomaḥ eva kartavyaḥ, tadakaraṇe vā pratihomaḥ kāryaḥ; dīkṣāyāḥ avabhṛyena unmocitatvāt|
yattu 'etayā punarādheyasaṃmi- tayā ijyā iṣṭyāmihotraṃ juhoti' iti vacanaṃ, tat prakaraṇāntaranyāyāt somāṅgatayā udavasānīyasyaiva vā karmāntaravidhāyakam|

iti prāpte, niṣedhapratiyogitvena agnihotrādeśapakṣitatvāt tadapekṣitāvadhisamarpakatvenāpi upapattau yāgāntaravidhāyakatvānupapatteḥ dīkṣonmoke'pi udavasānīyayeṣṭīyatā āvaśyakatvāt pūrvavadeva ana- dhikārāt na pratihomādikaraṇam|

yadā tu dīkṣā saṃjātā yasya iti dīkṣita iti vyutpatyā vṛttadīkṣotpatti- katvena niṣedhaprayojakaṃ rūpamāśrīyate, tadā dīkṣā'- bhāve'pi sarvadā niṣedhaprasaktau udavasānīyāyāḥ ava- dhitvamayāmetameveti na tadutkarṣe pratihomādi|
tatra daivāt udavasānīyotkarṣe homo vā pratihomo vā na kāryaḥ|
vi. 11|16. udāsīne anīpsitaṃ karma yathā 'tṛṇaṃ spṛśati'|
maṇi. pṛ. 130. udāharaṇaṃ sādharmyodāharaṇaṃ vaidharmyodāharaṇaṃ ceti dvividham|
hetumuddeśena sādhyamupapādānaṃ ādyaṃ yathā 'yo dhūmavān sa vahimān yathā mahānasaḥ' iti|
sādhyābhāvamuddeśena hetubhāvāvamupapādānaṃ dvitīyaṃ, yathā 'yo na vahimān na sa dhūmavān yathā hṛdaḥ' iti|
tatra ekenaiva gatārthatvāt na dvayorāvaśyakatā iti|
maṇi. pṛ. 40. sadyantattvātipratipādakavākyatvaṃ udāharaṇatvaṃ, yathā, 'yo dhūmavān so'gnimān yathā mahānasaḥ' iti|
pṛ. 39. uditaṃ anuditaṃ ucyamāne pravṛttiviśeṣakriyā nāsti|

bāla. pṛ. 91. udīcyāśca deśāntare (gatāḥ api) udavapabha- yajñādīn (kurvantyeva tathāpi na asau deśadharmaḥ; kiṃtu sarvadharmaḥḥ) |
tatra prathamo dakṣiṇāṃ saṃpūrṇāṃ ( 12 gāḥ ) prāpnoti, dvitīyasārdhaṃ ( 6 gāḥ ), tṛtīyaḥ tṛtīyāṃśaṃ ( 4 gāḥ ), caturthyardhamardhamaṃ ( 3 gāḥ ) |
vi. 3|7|17. audgātrasya kartā adhyetā vā udgātā ityucyate |
evaṃ vyaktaṃ audgātrasya kartā udgāteti gamyate |
bhā. 3|5|8|26. udgātāḥ varaṇanimittā udgānanimittā vā bahavo na saṃbhavanti iti vedasaṃyoganimittāḥ kalpyante |
bhā. 3|7| 19|40. udgātre sāmabhibhuktaṃ rathaṃ dadāti vāja- peye |
tatrāsti 'praitu hotṛcamasaḥ, pra brahmaṇaḥ, prodgātṛṇām' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimatra evaṃ camasaṃ udgātā bhakṣayet, uta sarvai bhakṣayeyuḥ, athavā saha subrahmaṇyeti |
kiṃ chandogāḥ bhakṣayeyuḥ, athavā saha subrahmaṇyeti |
udgātā ekaḥ śrutyā saṃyojyate camasena 'prodgātṛṇām' iti |
nanu bahutvaṃ śrūyate, tena bahavo bhakṣayeyuḥ, ucyate |
śrūyate bahutvavacanaṃ, tat udgātṛprātipadikagataṃ, tat vivakṣitaṃ sat udgātṛgṛhatvaṃ brūyāt |
tatra bahutvaṃ śrūyamāṇamapi na śakyatvāt udgātumevaṃ kartum |
anumānaṃ hi etat bahūnāṃ camasa iti |
katham ? 'yat bahuṣu prātipadikaṃ vartate, tato bahu- vacanaṃ bhavati, bahutvavacanaṃ tu tato dṛṣṭeya prodgātrāṇāṃ iti, tasmāt nūnaṃ bahūnāṃ camasaḥ' ityanumānam |
pratyakṣaṃ tu eka udgātā, na dvitīyo na tṛtīyaḥ |
tasmāt ekasya camasaḥ, sa ca udgāturiti |
vā-- idānīṃ vaṣaṭkāromāmiṣavabhakṣān anu- karvaiva prakhyāt samākhyāmaviśeṣaṇasmaraṇameva tāvat karoti |
tasminneva praiṣe ( 'praitu hotṛḥ' ityādī pūrvādhikaraṇokte ) 'prodgātṛṇāṃ' iti śrūyate |
tatra caturthā saṃdehaḥ kimatra evodgātā bhakṣayet, uta sarva- svijaḥ, uta stotrakāriṇaḥ, āhosvit catvāro'pi chandogā iti |
ke citu dvitīyatṛtīyayoḥ pakṣayoḥ ekatvamicchanti, sūtradvaye'pi sarvaśabdaprayogān, lakṣaṇā- yāśca pratyāsatteḥ kevalacchandogaviṣayatvāt |
kutaḥ saṃdehaḥ ? 'visaṃvādaḥ sphuto hyatra prakṛtipratyayā- rthayoḥ |
' tatra pāśādhikaraṇanyāyena 'guṇe tvanyāyyakalpanādeśa- tvāt' ( 9|3|15|16 ) iti prātipadikārthaprādhā- nyāt |
'udgātāraṃ vṛṇīte' iti ca utpattau ekatvāt ekasmai eva udgātre camaso dātavyaḥ |
ekasmin udgātāre bhakṣayati bahutvavacanaṃ pramādādadhītaṃ iti gamyate, na hi tadanūdyate, na vidhīyate iti |
nanu sarveṣvapi bhakṣayetsu udgātṛśabdaḥ pramādo gamyate |
pāśamantrasya prakaraṇe bahutvaṃ na kathaṃ cit prakāreṇāntarita ityavivakṣā yuktā |
atra punaḥ lakṣaṇāyāṃ upapadyamānāyāṃ nāvivakṣā upapadyate |
anyena ṛtvijā tu bahutvavacanasya naiva kaścidasti saṃśravaḥ |
ke te ? prastotā udgātā pratihartā iti |
tat etena bahutvavacananirdeśena ānumā- nikakriyāyoganimittaḥ udgātṛśabdo vivakṣita iti ava- gamiṣyāmaḥ |

vā-- yasmāt bahutvavacanasya udgātṛvyatiriktaḥ saha prātipadikena anupāttatvāt saṃśravau nāvakalpate, na ca nirmimittā lakṣaṇā avakalpate, na ca lakṣaṇā vinā ānarthakyaṃ, avayavaprasiddhyā stotrakāriṣu upapadyamāna- tvāt |
bhāṣyam-- sarve chandogāḥ sahasrabrahmaṇāḥ bhakṣa- yeyuḥ |
kimiti ? gānasaṃyogāditi nāyaṃ pakṣa upa- padyate |
katham ? ekasmin udgānena saṃśravaḥ, itaro gānena |
gīti- mātraṃ gānaṃ laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ ca |
dvitīyaṃ sāmnaḥ parva ūpūrveva gīyateḥ abhidheyaṃ prasiddham |
tatra eka eva udgīthaṃ karoti iti eka evodgātā, na bahavaḥ |
tasmāt gānasaṃyogāt bahavo bhaviṣyanti iti etadapi nopapadyate |
audgātraṃ nāma pravacanaṃ, tathā audgātrāṇi karmāṇi |
audgātrasya kartā, adhyetā vā 'udgātā' iti ucyate |
evaṃ vyaktaṃ audgātrasya kartā udgātā iti gamyate |
yasya udgātā prasiddhaḥ, taddiṣṭe karma anākhyātamapi audgātramiti vadati |
śabdaśca yasya audgātraṃ prasiddhaṃ, sa tasya kartāraṃ udgāteti vadati anā- khyātamapi |
yathā yasya udamedhaḥ prasiddhaḥ, sa tasya anā- khyātamapi apayaṃ audmedhiḥ iti brūte |
yasya auda- medhiḥ ( prasiddhaḥ ), sa tasya pitaraṃ anākhyātamapi udamedhaṃ pratipadyate |
evaṃ audgātrasaṃśravāt upapadyate udgātṛśabdaḥ : prastotā'pi, udgātā'pi, pratihartā'pi, subrahmaṇyo'pi |
evaṃ bahutvavacanaṃ udgātṛśabdaśca ubhayamapi upapannaṃ bhaviṣyati |
yathā udgātṛ- śabdaḥ : 'vinigamya udgātāraḥ sāmnā stuvate' iti stotrakāriṣu |
yathā idamapi vacanaṃ 'udgātāro nāpavyā- hareyuḥ, uttamāmepottamā ( iti brūyuḥ )' iti apa- subrahmaṇānāmeva |
vā-- na tāvat samudāyaprasiddhī saṃbhavantyā avayava- prasiddhiḥ prātipadikasya yuktā |
na ca avayavaprasiddhi- rapi atra stotrakāriṣu vidyate |
iti ( bhārthaṃ ) bhaktiḥ iti vakṣyame pramādāt parvaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ |
( nārthaṃ bhāṣyakārasya pramādaḥ, pañcānāṃ sasānāṃ vā bhaktīnāmeva parvaśabdabodhapyatvasaṃbhavāt |
' iti śloke vārtikakāreṇa sarvemeva parvaśabdaḥ bhaktiparyāya eva prayuktaḥ |
tasmāt varaṇanimittāḥ udgānanimittā vā bahava udgātāraḥ saṃbhavanti iti vedasaṃyoganimittāḥ kalpyante |
chandogapravacanaṃ hi audgātraśabdenābhidhīyate tattvacanasthaṃ karma, tattvavanācca puruṣāḥ pravṛttatvena anudgātṛtvena ca audmedhinyāyena ( bhāṣyoktena ) udgātāraḥ ; ityanumātuṃ śakyate |
na ca eṣa nyāyaḥ : avayavadhikaraṇe ( 2|3|2 ) nirākṛtaḥ |
' saranti hi udgātṛdaṃ iti aṇa pratyayaṃ, na tu tasya kartā iti pratyayalopam |
tasmāt na audgātraśabdāt eṣaḥ ( udgātṛ- śabdaḥ rājyaśabdāt rājaśabda iva ) āgantavyaḥ |

yathaiva tatra (aveṣṭyadhi- karaṇe) 'yogāt lokaḥ prayukte' ityāramya evaṃ vyākhyāta, 'prathamaṃ jātinimitto rājā, tataḥ tatsaṃyogāt pālanaṃ rājyaṃ, tatsaṃbandhādi brāhmaṇādiṣu sthānāpatyā vā anumānena vā rājaśabdaḥ' (atra 'yogāt lokaḥ prayukte' iti śabdo'nuvādaḥ, uttaraśca tātparyataḥ bhāṣyānuvādaḥ) tathaiva atrāpi varṇāt eva evodgātā, tataḥ tatsaṃyogāt karmapracavanayoḥ audgātraśabdaḥ, tayogādapi stotra- kāriṣu udgātraśabdaḥ |
tasmāt avirodhāt sarvacchandogānāṃ ayaṃ bhakṣa iti |
atha svamatena asubrahmaṇyānāṃ chandogānāṃ bhakṣa: ityāha-) na tu etat yuktam |
bhakṣaṇavelāyāṃ hi ye vyāpyante tatsaṃnihitāśca preṣakāle, te bhakṣaṇe saṃbadhyante |
na ca subrahmaṇyā yasmin kāle kaścit vyāpāraḥ ato nāsya sadasi antarbhavati vā saṃnidhāna- masti, yena bhakṣe adhikṛtaḥ syāt |
tatra yathaiva pravacana- saṃyoge satyapi anyeṣāṃ akarmasaṃyuktānāṃ chandogānāṃ bhakṣo na bhavati, evaṃ subrahmaṇyasyāpi iti manyāmahe |
na ca bhakṣaḥ kartṛsaṃskāraḥ, yena yad‌yajñabhayāt sarvatravācyate |
tasmāt upa- pattyantaraṃ tuśabdena vyāvartya stotrakāriparigrahaḥ evārtha iti samarthanīyam |

etaduktaṃ bhavati, sarve tu anena śabdena abhīyante, na stotrakāriṇa eva kevalāḥ, tathāpi tu yathoktāt kāraṇāt ekadeśe subrahmaṇyavarja pravartate yathā 'viniyavadha udgātāraḥ sāmnā stuvanti' ityatra |
athavā 'sarve tu' iti atrāttara- pūrvapakṣa parigraha 'kāraṇāda‌deśe syāt' iti sūtrāntaraṃ stotrakāripakṣe niyoktavyam |
soma- samākhyānāt iti sūtreṇa (3|5|22) samākhyānimittakamete kathyate tatsaṃbaddhānantarā cintā |
sūtrārthastu- ekasyodgātuḥ udgātraśrutvā camasaṃyogā- vagamāt sa ekaḥ evodgātracamasaṃ bhakṣayet iti |
bahutvān bahutvavacanāt akhilāḥ sarve ṛtvijaḥ iti dvitīyaḥ |
yoge rūḍhibādhite sati samākhyāyā anyaḥ caturthaḥ |
bhāṭṭa- tatraiva 'pretu hotṛḥ' ityādimantre 'prodgā- tṛṇāṃ' iti śrutam |
tena kiṃ udgātra eva taccamasa- bhakṣaṇe viniyujyate, uta udgātratprabhṛtītaraḥ trayaḥ iti cintāyāṃ, prātipadikaśrutyā udgātraiva |
na ca bahu- vacanānurodhena asya sarvatomukhādau utkarṣaḥ, prātipadi- kasya vā liṅgasamavāyena tritayaparatvaṃ, yogena vā utkṛṣ- gaṇakāritvena tattritayaparatvaṃ kalpyatāṃ iti vācyam |
udgātraśabdasya pracuraprayogeṇa udgātrāparyāyasāmatṛtīya- bhāgurūpodgānakartṛra rūḍhatvāt guṇabhūtabahutvānurodhena karaṇanyāyena anupapatteḥ |
nahi utkarṣāyogaḥ eva tada- dhikaraṇaviṣayaḥ prakaraṇaprādhādakatvāt utkarṣayoge śruti- bādhakatvāt lakṣaṇayāogasya sūtrāt tadadhikaraṇaviṣayatvāt |
ato bahutvavacanameva vyatyānuśāsanādirītyā ekāva- lakṣaṇayā vyākhyeyam |
na ca ekatvalakṣaṇāyāṃ jaha- svārthatā''patteḥ prātipadike eva ajahatsvārthatā yuktā iti keṣāṃ vidukkaṃ yuktam |
mukhyatvaprādhānyābhyāṃ prātipadike jaghanyavṛttyaṅgīkāre niraste jahatsvārthatāyāḥ phalamukhatvena adoṣatvāt |
na ca pratihartṛdikarmaṇyapi tatpratipādakavākyeṣu ca audgātraṃ karma, audgātraṃ kāṇḍaṃ vā, iti samākhyānāt tatkartṛyapi pratihartṛādī udgātra-

śabdasya śakyaiva prayogopapatteḥ anekārthakasya udgātraśabdasya bahutvānurodhena 'niṣadha udgātāraḥ stuvate' ityādidavat tritayaparatvaṃ, aviśeṣādvā subrahmaṇyacatuṣṭayaparatvaṃ kiṃ na syāt iti vācyam |
anekaśaktikalpanāmiyā udgāna- kartṛvācakatvasya udgātrapadasya lakṣaṇādinā'pi kācika- sarvaviṣayaprayogopapatteḥ |
tadedasaṃyogācca anyatrāpi audgātraśabdaḥ udgātraśabda gauṇaḥ, iti draṣṭavyam |
ataḥ pāśādhi- karaṇanyāyena udgātraiva ekaḥ piveta |
iti prāpte, na udgātraśabdasya ṛtvigviśeṣe śaktiḥ |
klṛptavākyayoge naiva utkṛṣṭhānakartṛmātravācitena upapattau atirikta- śaktikalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt |
pranuprayogasya āhva- nīye agripadavat niruḍhalakṣaṇayā''pi upapatteḥ |
na ca atra rathakārādiśabdavat avayavārthe vihāya ṛtvigviśeṣe prayogaḥ, yena atiriktā''pi śaktiḥ kalpyeta |
na ca udgātratipi udgātrayavācī eva iti niyamaḥ |
ata eva pañcajādiśabdasya maṇḍkādau prayogābhāvena yogarūḍhakalpanāyāmi prakṛte na tatkalpanā, api tu agniśabdavat niruḍhalakṣaṇaiva |

ataśca tātparyagrāhakastatra lākṣaṇikārthagrahaṇe'pi prakṛte 'agnimupanidhāya stuvīta' itivat mukhyārthasaṃbhave lākṣaṇikārthagrahaṇādyogāt bahutva- nānurodhāt 'niṣadha udgātāraḥ' itivat prakṛtānupūrvaya- gānakartṛṇāṃ trayāṇāmeva grahaṇam |
mūlagranthāthakāraṃ tu yuktyurovena na doṣaḥ, siddhānte anyātvābhāvāt iti dhyeyam |
somaṣamakṣaḥ camasināṃ vidhyate iti pūrvādhikaraṇe sādhitam |
udgātṛcamasaśca ekaḥ udgātā eva ṛtvik bhakṣayet, nānye'pi |
saṃyogāt udgātracamasaḥ iti śrutvā udgātṛsaṃbandhena camasasya vācakatvena padena, udgātraiva kevalasya saṃyogāt saṃyogasya bodhanāt |
anyenāpi bhakṣaṇe tu udgātracamasa iti śrutirnopapadyeta |
tasmāt udgātracamasaṃ udgātā eka eva bhakṣayet iti prathamaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
sarve eva daśa ekādaśa vā camasinaḥ anye'pi vā sarve avaśiṣṭā ṛtvijaḥ udgātṛcamasaṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ |
nanu tathā sati udgātra- camasa iti śrutirbādhitā syāt |

'prodgā- tṛṇāṃ' (udgātṛṇāṃ camasaḥ pra etu gacchantu) iti udgātra- camasapare vacane udgātrāṃ iti bahutvavacanena udgātṛbhinnā- nāmapi arthāt sarveṣāmeva camasena saha saṃyogasya saṃgrahaṇasya uktatvāt |
tasmāt sarveḥ udgātṛcamaso bhakṣaṇīyaḥ iti dvitīyaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
na sarve udgātṛcamasaṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ, kiṃtu stotrakāriṇaḥ, stotraṃ ye kurvanti gāyanti te, udgātā ca prastotā ca pratihartā ceti traya eva bhakṣayeyuḥ |
itareṣāṃ tu ṛtvijāṃ sutarāṃ nāsti gānasaṃyogaḥ |
udgātā ca udgīthabhakteḥ gāyakaḥ, sa ca eka eva iti cet, satyam |
tathāpi udgātrāṃ iti bahutvaśruteḥ bahutvavacanaśruteḥ lakṣaṇayā trayo gānakartāro gṛhyante |
asmin sūtre yadyapi stotrakāriṇāṃ iti pāṭhaḥ anekeṣu ādarśapustakeṣu dṛśyate |

'tasmāt stotra- kāriṇāṃ camasa iti' iti bhāṣyācca tathaiva pāṭhaḥ sidhyati, tathāpi adhikaraṇasya prathamasūtre 'ekaḥ' iti, dvitīye caturthe ca sūtre 'sarve' iti prathamāntā- nāmeva padānāṃ darśanāt prakṛtasūtre'pi stotrakāriṇaḥ
vṛttau kutūhale ca prathamāntaḥ eva pāṭhaḥ spaṣṭaḥ |
na traya eva stotrakāriṇaḥ bhakṣayeyuḥ kiṃtu udgātṛgaṇasahitāḥ sarve catvāro'pi udgātṛcamasaṃ bhakṣa- yeyuḥ |

kāraṇā- dekadeśe syāt, yatra tu 'viniścaya udgātāraḥ sāmā stuvate' iti vacane audumbarīkhāsamīpe, bahiṣpava- māne ca sadaso bahirapi viniścaya upaviśya sāmā stuvate ityatra gānarūpakāraṇāt udgātrādin subrahmaṇyo grahītuṃ na śakyate, tatra udgātṛcamaḥ ekadeśe catuṣṭayai- kadeśe tritaye syāt |
tathā kāraṇābhāve tu subrahmaṇyasahitā eva grāhyāḥ |
tasmāt samudrahmaṇyasahitāstatra udgātṛ- gaṇīyā ṭhadgātṛcamasaṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ |

tanmate itthaṃ sūtrārthaḥ - vedasaṃyogāt sāma- vedasaṃyogāt yadyapi 'protgātṛṇāṃ' iti udgātṛśabdena sarve catvāro'pi abhīyante, tathāpi kāraṇāttu bhakṣaṇakāle sadasi antarvedyāṃ vā subrahmaṇyasya vyāpārābhāve anupa- sthitirūpatvāt, ekadeśe catuṣṭayaikadeśe udgātṛtritaye eva udgātṛśabdaḥ syāt |
kiṃca vārtikakāraiḥ - 'athavā sarve tu vedasaṃyogāt iti pṛthak sūtram |
tasya pakṣasya nirākaraṇaṃ 'kāraṇādekadeśe syāt' iti pṛthak kṛtena sūtreṇa kṛtam' ityuktam |
kutūhale tu vārtikakārapakṣaṃ nirākṛtya punaḥ bhāṣya- kārapakṣa eva sādhitaḥ |
tatra ekasya subrahmaṇyasya deśaḥ atisarjanaṃ tyāgaḥ syāt iti vyākhyātam |
udgātṛpratihartroḥ jyotiṣṭome bahiṣpavamāne yuga- padapaccheda'pi asti prāyaścittam |
paraṃtu viruddhatvena ekatra ubhayānujñānāsaṃbhavāt vikalpena ekaṃ kiṃcidanuṣṭheyam |
yaddvātrā jaghanyaḥ syāt, punaryathe sarvasvaṃ dadyāt, yathetarasmin |
bhāṣyam-- yadā pratihartuḥ pūrvamapacchedaḥ tata udgātṛḥ, tatra adākṣiṇyeṣa iṣṭvā punaryajñavyam |
tatra saṃdehaḥ punaryāge kiṃ dvādaśaśataṃ dātavyaṃ, uta sarvasvamiti |
kutaḥ ? evaṃ hi āmnāyate 'tatra tadadyāt yat pūrvasmin dāsya syāt' iti |
tatra punaryajñe sarvasvaṃ dadyāt yathetarasmin pūrvasminbhave sarvasvam |
pratihartṛra apacchinne dvādaśaśataṃ bādhitvā sarvasvaṃ dāsyaṃ bhavati |
nanu pūrvasminnahani dvādaśaśatamāpi aso dāsyan āsīt |
satyaṃ, sarvasvadānena tu ubhayaṃ pradattaṃ bhavati, tasmāt tat deyam |
apica pūrvasminnahani naiva dvādaśaśataṃ dāsyaṃ bhavati |
etāvaddhi dāsyaṃ ityucyate, yasya uttara- kāle tāvat dāsyaṃ bhavati |
na ca pūrvasminnahani dvādaśa- śataṃ dīyate |
nanu ca sarvasvamapi pratiṣṭhitaṃ bhavati tadapyasau na dāsyan iti sā'pi asya mithyābuddhiḥ |
pratihartā ca tasminnapacchinnaḥ iti dvādaśaśataṃ bādhitvā sarvasvameva dāsyaṃ bhavati |
dup-- dvādaśaśataṃ sarvasvadena bādhitaṃ na tat dāsyan bhavati |
sarvasvadamapi adākṣiṇyena (pāścātyena) pratiṣiddhaṃ, tadapi na dāsyan bhavati |
bādho hi parimāṇāntaropadeśena vā pratiṣedhena vā saṃbhavati |
adakṣiṇasya saṃsthāpanaṃ nivṛttiḥ kathamānā anyathā na saṃbhavati iti dakṣiṇānivṛttiḥ kalpyate, na śabdāt |
anivṛttau tu pratihartṛ- pacchedaḥ sarvasvadasaṃ dāsyan bhavati |
soma-- paranimittaprāyaścittasya kartavyatvaṃ vina etadvicārāsaṃbhavena pūrvapakṣatvāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- yadyudgātā paścādapacchiḥ, tadā punaḥprayoge sarvasvadasaṃ dadyāt yathetarasmin pratihartṛpacchedavati prayoge iti |

bhāṭṭa-- krame'pi yadi udgātrapacchedo jaghanyaḥ, tadā tannimittapunaḥprayoge sarvasvameva deyaṃ, na tu dvādaśaśataṃ paranimittapātāt, pūrvaṃ tasyaiva pūrvaprayoge deyatvena prasaktatvāt, 'tatra tadadyāt' ityanena yat pūrvaprayoge paranimittapātāt pūrvaṃ deyatvena prasaktaṃ tasyaiva dakṣiṇā- tvena vidhānāt, dvādaśaśatasya pūrvanimittatvena bādhitatvena deyatvā aprasakteḥ |
ataśca yadyapi sarvasvamapi adākṣiṇyena dakṣiṇatvena vā pūrvaprayoge vastuto bādhitameva, tathāpi paranimittapātāt pūrvaṃ bādhanābhāvāt deyatvena prasaktau na kā cit kṣatiḥ |
yadā tu pratihartṛpacchedo jaghanyaḥ, tadā tasminneva prayoge sarvasvaṃ deyaṃ, na tu pūrvāpacchedanimittakaḥ punaḥ- prayogaḥ kāryaḥ |
na ca sarvasvadāne adākṣiṇyatvena virodhāt tadāpaccheda'pi punaḥprayogavādhe pramāṇābhāvaḥ, adākṣiṇyapunaḥprayogayoḥ samuccitayoreva naimittika- tvena ekābhāve itarasyānupapatteḥ |
ataśca yathā patnyāḥ imaśrunāmabhāvāt keśanāmapi na vapanaṃ, sāhi- tasya vivakṣitatvāt, tathaiva adākṣiṇyasyābhāve punaḥ- prayogasyāpyabhāvaḥ |

yadyapi ca dakṣiṇatvasya punaḥ- prayogakṛtatvā vidhānasya āvaśyakatvādeva pūrvaprayoge adākṣiṇyasya arthaprāptatvāt 'adakṣiṇaṃ taṃ' ityasya anuvādatvamucyate, tathāpi pākṣikānuvādabhidheya adākṣiṇyalope punaḥprayogalopaḥ iti draṣṭavyam |
vastutastu 'somamapabhajya' itivat pākṣikānuvādatve'pi punaḥ- prayogalope pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
na ca tasya saṃśṛdravyamātro- palakṣaṇatvāt na pākṣikānuvādatvamiti vācyam |

vastutastu nāyamaṇuvādaḥ, 'tatra tadadyāt' ityanena pūrvaprayoge dātavyadakṣiṇāyāḥ punaḥprayogaṅgatva vidhāne'pi pūrva- prayogaṅgatvabhūtakartṛtvārthe tasminnapi tasyā āvaśyakatvena adākṣiṇyaprāpyabhāvāt |
na ca evaṃ punaḥprayogasya jyotiṣṭomatvādeva dvādaśaśatādirūpadakṣiṇāprāpyupapatteḥ 'tatra tadadyāt' ityasya vaiyarthyamiti vācyam |
tasya pūrvaprayoge ekaviṃśatyādipakṣakaraṇena punaḥprayoge dvādaśa- śatāderapi prāpyatvāt tannivṛtyarthatvena sārthakyāt, udgātrajaghanyatve sarvasvadasāprāpyatvācca |
na caivaṃ keśaśmaśruvapanasya punaḥprayogabādhaḥ, tatra dvaṃdvena sāhi- tyasya upādeyakeśaśmaśrutvata uktatvāt sāhityāva- cchinnasya kriyāṅgatvena pratyekaṃ tadaṅgatvābhāvāt |
prakṛte tu aruṇaikahāyanītyau pratyekameva kriyā'nyathā ekavākyo- pādānādinā paścāt sāhityāvagame'pi naiklope
nahi āruṇyāsaṃbhave ekahāyanīlopaḥ; upāṃśuyāje devatā'ntarasaṃyogābhāve vā apanayalopaḥ iṣṭaḥ |
ataḥ pratihartuḥ paratve pūrvaprayoge sarvasvaṃ dattvā punaḥprayoge'pi tadyaṃ iti siddham |
yadā tu āprayoge udgātrāmāprāpacchedaḥ; tannimittakadvitīyaprayoge ca pratihartṛpacchedaḥ, tadā tatraiva sarvasvameva deyaṃ, naimittikatvena nityadakṣiṇābādhakatvāt |

na ca punaḥprayogasya prāyaścittatayā pūrvaprayogānnāt 'tatra dadyāt' ityanena ca pūrvaprayogāṅgabhūtadakṣiṇā eva uttaraprayogacchittamātravidhānāt aṅgaguṇavirodhanyāyena (12|2|9) aṅgabhūtapunaḥprayogāṅgasarvasvadakṣiṇābhāvena pradhānabhūtapūrvaprayogāṅgadakṣiṇāyāḥ eva devatvamucitaṃ iti vācyam |
ataḥ tasyāpi punaḥprayogāttvāt pareṇa naimittikena pūrvasya bādhāt sarvasvameva deyam |
22. udgātrapacchede uttarakālīne'pi punaḥprayoge pūrva- kālīnapratihartṛpacchedayuktaṃ sarvasvameva dātavyam |
vi. 6|5|2, udgātrapacchede jyotiṣṭome bahiṣpavamāne 'adakṣiṇe yajñaḥ saṃkhāpyaḥ; athānya āhvayaḥ; tatra tat dadyāt yat pūrvasmin dākanū syāt' ityuktam |
udgātrapacchedeviśiṣṭasyaiva ahaḥ ahargaṇe āvṛttiḥ na tu sarvasya ahargaṇasya ||
bhāṣyam— ahargaṇe yadā bhavati kasmiścidhani udgātrupacchedaḥ tadā saṃdehaḥ kiṃ kṛtsnaḥ ahargaṇaḥ āvartate, uta tadeva ahaḥ iti |
'iṣṭvā' iti ca yāgaṃ parisamāpya iti gamyate, na sāṅkamite |
yāni aharnantarāṇi sāhāyyena upakariṣyanti, vidyante eva tāni |
śā— 'aśabdatvāt samūhasya na phalaṃ prati codanā |
yāgasya codanā tatra yāgāḥ pratyeka- meva te ||
soma— pūrvasmin prayogābhidhāne'pi iha prayogā- vṛttiḥ syāt ataḥ prayogābhidhānamanupapannaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe paryavasānāt saṃgatiḥ |
atra pūrvaprayoge dakṣiṇādānā- bhāvāt dvitīyaprayoge'pi na kiṃcideyaṃ iti ke cit |
dvādaśāhe dīyamānāyā dakṣiṇāyāḥ sarvahaḥsādhāraṇyāt ekasyāpyahaḥ kṛtsnā dvādaśāhadakṣiṇā deyā ityanye |
bhaṭṭa— dvādaśāhyargaṇe yadi ekasmin kasmina- ścidahani udgātrupacchede bhavati, tadā kṛtsnasya aha- rgaṇasya āvṛttiḥ |
astu vā utpattyākye pratyekaṃ kāraṇatvābhāvāt dvādaśāha- padenāpi ca samudāyānāmeva pratyekameva phalaṃ prati karaṇatvaṃ, ekapadopādānācca karaṇānāṃ samuccayaḥ |
tathāpi yattutasaṃbandhadhudgātā apacchinnāt tena ṛtunā yajeta ityarthavaṃgamāt udgātāṛṣa ekasyaiva sarvasādhāraṇatvena sarvāvṛttiḥ |
vā. 2|1|21|22 pṛ. 737. uddharaṇaṃ (agre :) yadā darśapūrṇamāsābhyena kriyate tathaiva ca agnihotraṃ pravartate, tadā agnihotradravyamantraḥ na kartavyaḥ |
mā. 9|4|8|39, uddharaṇasya (ullekha- nasya ) kṛtastasya prakāśakatvaṃ agnigṛhapragatasyenaśalā- kasyapakatvekṣaṇaṇādinām |
saṃkarṣe. 3|2|5. udbhit-- 'athaiṣa udbhit saptadaśo bhavati bṛha- ssāmā nidhenabrahmasāmā ' iti talavakārīyatāṇḍake vākyam |
niṣedhanāmarka mādhyaṃdine savane brāhmaṇacchaṃsi- śastrārtha sāma yasmin sa tādṛśaḥ |
ku. 1|4|6|17. udbhit-- ucchandasya ūrdhvame videha vidāraṇe lokavyākaraṇayoḥ prasiddhatvāt udbhicchabdasya khanine avayavaprasiddhilauke |
su. pṛ. 398. udbhit- ucchandasāmarthyāt micchabdasāmarthyāt udbhicchabdaḥ kriyāvacanaḥ |
udbhedanaṃ prakāśane paśūnāmena kriyate iti udbhit yāgaḥ |
bhā. 1|4|12 pṛ. 325. udbhicci- trādiṣabdānāṃ phalapadānvayanirāsena yajanyanvayaḥ abhihito bhāvārthādhikaraṇe ( 2|1|12 ) |
su. pṛ. 392. udbhittyādīnāṃ kāmpānāṃ anuṣṭhāne pāṭhakramo na niyāmakaḥ |
tatra udbhidānāmadheyaṃ dharme pramāṇaṃ iti śīrṣakam |
uktaṃ samāmnāyaidamatyaṃ, tasmāt sarvaṃ tadartha syāt |
bhāṣyam - 'udbhidā yajeta' 'balabhidā yajeta' 'abhijitā yajeta' 'viśvajitā yajeta' iti samā- mananti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimudbhidādayo guṇavidhaya āho- svit karmanāmadheyānīti |
sa kiṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyena saṃbadhyate, udbhidā dravyeṇa yāgamabhinivartayediti, uta sāmānādhikaraṇyena udbhidā yāgena yajeteti |
dvedhā'pi etasmin pratibhāti vākye, saṃbhavati saṃśayaḥ |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? uttamassāmiḥ samāmnāyasya aidamatyam |
kaścidasya bhāgo vidhiḥ, yaḥ aviditamarthaṃ vedayati yathā 'yomena yajeta' iti |
kaścidayaṃvādaḥ, yaḥ prayojanaṃ vidhiṃ stauti yathā 'vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā ' iti |
kaścinmantro yo vihita- marthaṃ prayogakāle prakāśayati yathā 'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' ityevamādiḥ |
tasmādudbhidādayaḥ amīṣāṃ prayojanā- manyatamāya prayojanāya bhaveyuḥ |
tatra tāvat arthavādaḥ, vākyaśeṣo hi sa bhavati vidhātavyasya |
yadi guṇa- vidhiḥ, na tarhi karma vidhīyate |
yadi nāmadheyaṃ syāt, yāvadeva yajeteti, tāvadeva udbhidā yajeteti, na praṣṭuṃ kaścit guṇaviśeṣaḥ syāt |
guṇavidhī ca guṇa- saṃyogāt abhyadhikamarthaṃ vidadhataḥ |

vā-- evaṃ smṛtisahitasya vedasya prāmāṇye siddhe adhunā vākyārthavyākhyānāvasare sati aparisamāpyaiva pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ, kena saṃbandhena nāmadheyacintāyāḥ prastāvaḥ kriyate ? ke cit tāvadāhuḥ, kimudbhidādayo guṇasya pramāṇaṃ, uta kriyānāmadheyatvena iti |
evaṃ sati hi samastameva śāstraṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇadamidhaṃ
sarvatra hi etat vicāryate kimidaṃ vākyaṃ asyārthasya pramāṇaṃ, utānyasyeti |

ye'pi (vicārakāḥ) ca ete dve api sūtre pūrvottarapakṣau parikalpya ekādhi- karaṇatvena vyācakṣate, tairapi 'uktaṃ samāmnāyaidamatyaṃ' ityanena sūtreṇa kaḥ siddhāntamabhipretaḥ pūrvapakṣānuguṇo'rtho vidhīyate, iti vaktavyam |
tasmāt dvayorapi adhi- karaṇayoḥ anumitapūrvapakṣayoḥ uttarapakṣasūtradvayametat iti vyākhyeyam |
tatra prathamaṃ tāvat udbhidādīn udāhṛtya saṃdehaḥ kriyate kimete kiṃ dharme iti upayogaṃ gacchanti, uta neti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptaṃ ? 'āmnāyasya kriyā'rthe- tvāt ' ityanarthakyam |
'dharmāṃnupayuktaṃ sat' iti pāṭhe nāmadheyatvena yaṃśāt vedāt adhikaṃ sat anarthakyaṃ prapadyate ityarthaḥ |

) nahi ete vidhyādiṣu antarbhavanti, sādhyasādhanetikartavyatā''nami- pāyitvāt tāvat codanāvācyaṃ, śrutibuddhayabhāvāt artha- vādātirekaḥ, karmāśrabhūtaivaṃjñapakatvāt yathārthatābhāvāt mantrakāryaniṣṭhātiḥ, na cānyat vedaprayojanamasti, ityapramāṇaṃ evaṃjātīyakāḥ |
siddhatvādeva ca viśeṣasya na nāmadheyaṃ vidhāyiṣyate iti naśyati |
yadā ca kenāpi prakāreṇa udbhidādīnāṃ viśeṣa- vacanatvaṃ, tadā tadanyatvāvinābhūtasāmānyavacanatvena yaje- ranarthakatvam |
lāghavaṃ ca vidhirguṇavidhī bhaviṣyati, yāgānu- vādāt |
yadi evaṃ guṇādhisattvāt vidhiśakteḥ, na tarhi karma vidhīyate, tathā ca avihite karmaṇi kasya guṇo vidhīyate ? ityanarthakyaṃ, ataḥ āha- ( bhāṣyaṃ ) ' prakṛtau jyotiṣṭome ' iti |
nanu guṇavidhikṣe ' jyotiṣṭomena ' ityasyāpi tatparatvāt avihitameva karma |
tadvyāvṛtte ca vidhāyakaṃ ca guṇasya vidhātumaśakyatvāt jyotiṣṭomapadamevaikaṃ nāmadheyam |
athavā tadekaṃ guṇa- viśiṣṭaṃ karmavidhānaṃ, itarāṇi karmānuvādena guṇavidhā- nāni |
nanu evaṃ sati sarvāḥ ekāhāhīna satracodanāḥ jyotiṣṭomasyaiva guṇaviddhiāreṇa prakaraṇāt anatiriktāḥ |
iti karmāṃtarābhāvāt na jyotiṣṭomaḥ kathaṃ cit prakṛtiḥ |
athavā prakriyate iti prakṛtiḥ; prakṛtajyoti- ṣṭomaḥ ityarthaḥ |
athavā 'athaiṣa jyotiḥ ' ityevamādīnāṃ karaṇavibhaktyākhyātsaṃsparśabhāvāt guṇavidhitvānupapatteḥ ekāntena bhedakatayā karmanāmatvaṃ, tadapekṣayā ca jyotiṣṭomaḥ prakṛtiḥ |
nanu utpattivākyaśeṣeṇa somena, jyoti- ṣṭomena vā avarodhāt jyotiṣṭome guṇāntaravidhānamayuktam |
athavā viśiṣṭavihitamapi karma svarūpamātraṃ niṣkṛṣya guṇāntare vihitaṃ na autpatti- kāt viśiṣyate, anyathā gatyasaṃbhavāt vikalpaḥ iti manyate |
vakṣyantī udbhidādimato lakṣyet udbhidatā yāgena kurdhā- diti |
karaṇaṃ hi yāgaḥ, udbhidādyapi tṛtīyānirdeśāt karaṇaṃ, tatra udbhid- yāgena iti karmanāmadheyatvena sāmānādhikaraṇyasāmañja- syam |
nanu prasiddhaṃ dravyavacanatvaṃ apahanmayeta, aprasiddhaṃ karmavacanatvaṃ pratijñāyeta |
kutaḥ ? karaṇavācino hi prātipadikāt tṛtīyā bhavati, kathaṃ na yāgaḥ |
yadi tṛtīyānirdeśe sati udbhidādimyaḥ śabdebhyo yāge buddhirupayeta, syādeta- devam |
tṛtīyā- vacanamanyathā nopapadyate iti cet, kāmaṃ mopapādi |
apica yadi nāmadheyaṃ vidhī- yete na yāgaḥ |
atha yāgo na nāmadheyaṃ, ubhayavidhāne vākyabhedaḥ iti |
udbhedanaṃ prakāśanaṃ paśnātama- nena kriyate ityudbhid yāgaḥ |
evamābhisukhye na jayāt abhijita, viśvajayāt viśvajita |
vattu apravṛttiviśeṣakaraḥ anarthaka iti, nāmadheyamapi guṇalopapanvena arthavat |
vā --- yat utpattī prathamaśane arthāntarapūrvaktvena ekāntato na prasiddhamudbhidādi, tat vaidikavyavahāre prathamapanipātāt sāmānādhikaraṇyena nāmadheyaṃ syāt |
athavā evamapūrve karma vidadhat arthavat bhaviṣyati |
'guṇo vidhīyamāno hi phale karmaṇi vā bhavet |
viśiṣṭavidhibuddhavā vā, sarvathā ca na yujyate |
' phalaṃ prati tāvat vidhīyamāne parapadasaṃbandhavidhānaṃ, vyava- hitakalpanā, dhātoḥ pārārthyaṃ, autpattikobhayābhaḥ, ana- danīyatvaṃ ca lanniādinā atyantāprasiddhena yāgaḥ iti doṣāḥ |
sārva- kāmyaprāptajyotiṣṭomaviśeṣaṇatve vākyabhedaḥ, pratyayavyāpāra- viprakṛṣṭatā, dhātupāyārthānandanīyayāgasomavācavikalpaśca atyantāyuktāḥ |
tathā viśiṣṭavidhī sarvapārārthya, aneka- vidhiśaktikalpanā, mattvarthalakṣaṇa, gamyamānasāmānyādhi- karaṇyāgaḥ, anadanīyayāgaśca iti doṣāḥ |
tat darśayati ( bhāṣyaṃ- ) itarathā śrutiḥ udbhidādīn ( khaniādīn ) vakṣyati ( iti bhāṣye pāṭhaḥ |
( śastraṃ pāṭhāntaraṃ darśayati- ) vakṣyantī lakṣyet iti vā ( bhāṣya- ) granthaḥ |
prātipadikasāmarthya- muktvā vibhaktisaṃbandhadipi etadeva avagamyate iti darśayati- 'yāgena kuryāt' ityādinā |
' yat karaṇā- bhidhāyinyā tṛtīyāyā ' ( mā. 3|1|6|2 pṛ. 679 ) ityevamādiṣu kārakāṇāṃ vibhaktyarthatvābhyupagamāt kathaṃ 'karaṇavācino hi prātipadikāt' ityucyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ |
athavā karaṇaśabdo yādṛśamarthaṃ bravīti, tādṛśasya prātipadikaṃ vācakameva |
kṛdantena hi kārakaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamevocyate, na vibhaktitvat niṣkṛṣṭā śaktiḥ |
tathā ca 'karaṇaṃ karaṇena karaṇāya' iti ca kārakāntarayogo dṛśyate |
anyathā hi vibhaktyabhihitaiveka ekena kārakena vaśī- kārāt na dravyaṃ kārakāntarayogaṃ pratipadyeta |
tasmāt śaktyupasarjanadravyavacanatvāt kṛdantānāṃ upapannaṃ karaṇaśabdāthācin prātipadikam |
tena etaduktaṃ bhavati, yat asmin vākye karaṇaṃ, tadvā- cinaḥ prātipadikāt tṛtīyā utpattavyam |
yāgaścātra phalabhāvanāyāḥ karaṇaṃ, na dravyaṃ iti vakṣyati (2|1|12|
tataśca yat udbhidapadaṃ yāgavacanaṃ, evaṃ tṛtīyā'ntaṃ sat ekavākyatāṃ yāsyati, arthāntaravacanatve tu asaṃbaddhaṃ syāt |
' yathaiva 'vrīhibhiryajeta', 'somena yajeta' ityādīnāṃ karaṇabhūtayāgavākyatve sati tṛtīyā'ntatvaṃ vaiyadhi- karaṇye'pi aviruddhaṃ, evamihāpīti |
yathā tat utsāryamāṇamapi svacchandataḥ punaḥpunardakaṃ chādayati |
evaṃ yo'nyo'pi svacchandavyavahāraḥ, sa haṭha iti prasiddhaḥ |
' vrīhyādayo hi atyantarūḍhāḥ, te svārthamaparityajataḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamapratipadyamānāḥ gatyantarābhāvāt guṇa- vidhayo vijñāyante |

ye punaḥ : udbhidādayo yaugikāḥ, teṣāṃ yenaiva prakāreṇa yatnena dravyavacanatvaṃ, tenaiva karmavacanatvamapi upapadyate, iti pratyakṣasiddhau udāsīnāyāṃ, anumānenāpi ajñānasaṃśayamudāsakaraṃ na duṣyati |
sarvaśabdārthadhāraṇe hi ayamabhyupāyaḥ, yat prasiddhasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nāma |
pradhānaṃ ca karaṇaṃ yāge labdhātmakaṃ śaknoti prātipadikaṃ ātmaviṣayamāpā- yitum |
' tvapakṣe hi avaśyaṃ kā cit vibha- ktyarthe'pi pratyayasya vidhiśaktiḥ kalpyā syāt |
jyotiṣṭomāde- rapi svaphalodbhedanakāritvāt etannāmaprasaṅga iti cet |
athavā arthāpattivaśena etadviśeṣaviṣaya- meva udbhedanaṃ nimittaṃ, na cānyat tadastīti vyavasthā yathā sāmānādagragamanaviśeṣanimittatvaṃ gośabdasya |
atra vidheyatāyā dhātvarthavṛttitvā- bhāvāt padārthāntarabhūtatvāt tato'pi daurbalyam |
dhātoḥ sādhutvārthakamaṅgīkṛtya anyoddeśena anyakaraṇakabhāvanā- vidhiḥ caturthaḥ |
tadevamudbhidguṇaviśi- ṣṭasya yāgasya phaloddeśena vidhāne ṣaḍvidhaprakārāśraya- ṇāt atigauravam |
guṇasya yāge ananvāyāt mattvartha- lakṣaṇā ca |
nahi bhāvanāyāṃ samānapadopāttattvārtha- karaṇatvāvaruddhāyāṃ guṇasya karaṇatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
atastasya yāgānvāyatvakalpane yāgasya kārakāt, kārakāṇāṃ ca parasparasaṃbandhānupapatteḥ : 'somena yajeta' ityatra udbhi- datā yāgeneti mattvarthalakṣaṇā āvarayakīti prāpnaḥ |
vastutastu dṛṣṭānte'pi somasya karaṇatvena bhāvanā- manvayaḥ tatastatra vakṣyate, yuktaśca |
ekakaraṇatvāvaruddhe'pi karaṇatvāntarasya bhinnarūpitasya prakāratayā bhāvanā'- nyopapatteḥ |
nahi yāgakaraṇatvaṃ bhāvanānirūpitaṃ, api tu svargenarūpitam |
ataśca yathaiva anyanirūpitamapi tatka- raṇatvaṃ prakāratayā bhāvanāyāmanveti, tathaiva somakaraṇatva- mapi yāganirūpitam |
ubhayatra tattvanirūpakasya pākṣika- bodhagamyatvāt na ko'pi virodha iti |
nāsmin pakṣe yadyapi mattvarthalakṣaṇā, tathāpi viśeṣaṇavidhikalpanā''di- kṛtaṃ guṇayāgobhayaviśiṣṭabhāvanāvidheḥ gauravamāpādyamānaṃ nāpahotuṃ śakyam |
yathā ca prātikabhāvanāsaṃbandhārthā- kāre'pi dvitīyobhayetayā mattvarthalakṣaṇā tathoktaṃ kaustubhe |
teṣāṃ tatra arthāntare rūḍhatvena nāmatvā- saṃbhavāt |
prakṛte tu yathaiva yogena khanine pravṛttiḥ, tenaiva yogena udbhidyate utpādyate phalamiti vyutpattyā karmaṇya- pīti nāmalasaṃbandhena dvitīyavidhividhāpakaraṇatvāt lāgha- vam |
na ca bhido vidāraṇe eva smṛteḥ śaktiḥ, 'bhidir' ityeva dhātupāṭhāt |
ato vidāraṇe ityopādāne'pi prayogāt tulyavadvṛtti- katā |
na ca nāmadheyārthakaṃ saṃkalpadā saurtha- katvāt |
ka ca ciphlopancaśca yathā 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ 'saṃsthāpya paurṇamāsīṃ vaigumyantu nirvapati' iti |

itarā hi prakṛte eva karmaṇi guṇaphalopancatvāpattene karmāntaratvaṃ, na ca yogasya phalodbhedanakāritvasya atiprasaktatvāt apūrve karmaṇi rūḍhikalpane somādipadānāpi tadāpattiḥ, sarvatra yogarūḍhitve prācīnaprayogasyaiva kāraṇatāyāḥ klṛptatvena prakṛte tadakalpanāt |

11416 pṛ. 70. udbhida- dhikaraṇe guṇe karmaṇi ca avayavayogenaiva saṃbhava- davṛttattvaḥ, atha ca tatratyaśāstrāntarahitā udbhidādayaḥ śabdāḥ, tātadāhya guṇavidhayaḥ karmanāmadheyaṃ (vā) iti vicāraḥ |

tasmāt satyāpi aṅgaguṇavirodha- nyāyasya upakramanyāyāpavādatve prādhānyāpannenaiva prakṛta- siddhāntopapādanaṃ draṣṭavyam |

upakramaprābalyanyāyamevamāhuḥ- 'sarvasyāpi śabdasya svārthalaṅghane virodhaḥ kāraṇaṃ, sa ca pratiyogini dṛśyate, na copakramadaśāyāṃ upasaṃhāro virodhī jñāyate, iti upakramo mukhyavṛttireva yuktaḥ' iti |

51. syādayaṃ upakramaprābalyadindhyāyaḥ, yadi utpattiviniyogātkalayoḥ kharāpekṣā bhavet (uccaiḥ- ṛcā kriyate) tasya tu kālāditvat prayogavidhiviśeṣaṇa- tvena apekṣitatvāt tannibandhanasyaiva svarasya prābalyam |
upakramabalena upasaṃhāraśabdārthakalpanāyāṃ lakṣaṇā- parigraheṇa śabdārthavijñānasya dharmasya (śrutyarthatvasya) bādhaḥ |
bhāṣyam--jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'uccairṛcā kriyate uccaiḥ sāmnā, upāṃśu yajuṣā' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimugādi- jātiṃ adhikṛtyate śabdāḥ pravṛttāḥ, uta vedanadhikṛtyate |
tenopāṃśutvaṃ jātyā adhikṛtayā saṃbadhyate, vedānāmidhi- kārakaḥ śabdo nāstīti |
apica, ṛgvedavyatikrāntānā- mṛcāṃ yajurvedai ucaiḥ prayogo bhaviṣyati |
itarathā tasyā eva ṛcaḥ ubhau dharmau vaikalpikau syātāṃ, tatra pakṣe bādhaḥ syāt |
itarathā veda- saṃyoge sarvasminnapi kratau upāṃśutvaṃ syāt |
vā — evaṃ liṅgaviniyogaṃ upavarṇya saṃprati vākya- viniyogaḥ prastūyate |
'tadyadi ṛktvaṃ uttvaṃ kriyate gāī- patyaṃ paretya bhūḥ svāheti juhuyāt |
tatra kiṃ ṛgyajuḥsāmaśabdairuccai- stvopāṃśutvadharmavidhau mahābhāgyātmiyasaṃjñahomavidhau ca pūrvottarapadasaṃbandhanirapekṣāmidhānaśrutireva |
teṣāmṛ- yatrārthavaśena pādavyavasthā' ( 2|1|9|135 ) ityevaṃla- kṣaṇāṃ ṛgādijātānāṃ grahaṇaṃ, uta samastamantrājñānāma- kānāṃ vedānāmiti |
tatra yadi vā upakramasthaveda- padaṃ avayavabhūtajātalakṣaṇāthaṃ, athavā upasaṃhārasthaṛgādi- jātaṃ sabrāhmaṇasamudāyalakṣaṇārthamiti sambhavātsambhavayoḥ saṃdehaḥ |
sa ca 'aktāḥ śarkarāḥ' itīvat ākṣepa- parihārābhyāṃ samarthanīyaḥ |
evaṃ tarhi tenaiva (aktā- dhikaraṇenaiva 1|4|13 ) gatatvāt naitadārabdhavyam |
saṃdigdhe hi vākyaśeṣasya tatra prāmāṇya- muktam |
iha punaḥ viśuddheśrvatirnāmagādidhādīnāṃ niḥsaṃdigdhamantrabhedajātavacanatvāt asaṃdigdhaḥ eva viśu- deśaḥ |
'yathā ca dravyasāmānyaṃ kriyā cā na virudhyate |
' na kathaṃcit ṛgādidavena brāhmaṇaṃ vaktuṃ śakyam |
śaknoti tu vedaśabdaḥ ekadeśo'pi vartituṃ, samudāyaśabdānāṃ eka- deśeṣvapi upalabdheḥ, yathā 'grāma āyātaḥ' iti |
tathā cāpyetārastatraiva sutarāṃ prayujyate 'vedamadhīmahe, vedo vartate' iti |
' ṛco hi tā eva kāścit triṣvapi vedeṣu paṭhyante, tathā yajuṣi |
tatra yadi vedatvaṃ dharmasaṃbandha- hetutaḥ, tādṛśeṣu na jñāyate ko dharmaḥ kriyātāmiti anyāyyo vā vikalpa āśrīyate, vedāntaravyapadeśāśca tulyatvatvāt |
anyathā vedasya samastadvipaśakāhādisatra- viṣayatvāt yāvadvedānusāri dharmaḥ prakaraṇamucchrya sārvatrikaḥ syāt |
nanu jātādhikāre'pi vedavat jātasya prakaraṇā- ntareṣvapi bhāvāttulyametat |
atha prakṛtajātātikramakāraṇā- bhāvādiha vyavasthā, sā vedapakṣe'pi aviśeṣā |
( pādabaddhā ṛcaḥ, padasaṃghā yajūṃṣi, parvabrahmāni sāmāni |
atredaṃ vaktavyaṃ - 'sāmnaḥ parva' iti bhakti- padārthe parvaśabdaṃ prayuñjāno bhāṣyakāro vārtikakārairūpitaḥ 'pramādapātaḥ' iti vadadbhiḥ |
atra tu svayameva bhakti- śabdārthe parvaśabdaḥ prayujyate vārtikakāracaraṇaiḥ; iti |
dvivarṇaṃ ca pade jātigośabdatvaṃ na kalpitam |

yathaiva hi vākyatvaṃ nāma jātiḥ bhinnasthānakaraṇaprayatnāni vyañjakakramavarṇārthātmakapadasamūhe anvayavarṇaṃ vā vilakṣaṇā- vayavapadārthasaṃbandhapratyayākāṅkṣāvayavadhanāt bhramaṇatvādi- nyāyena kalpayituṃ tadbhūtādhikaraṇe nādhyavasitam, tathaiva ṛktvayajustvasāmatvāni kramavarṇasvaraśravaṇāṇi na śakyāni kalpayitum |

( su-mitraiḥ kaṇṭhādamiḥ sthānaiḥ, uccāraṇa- prakārākhyaiśca karaṇaiḥ ; tadetadubhaiśca prayatnaḥ vyañjakatvena kramavattvāt ayugapadbhāvināṃ varṇānāṃ varṇasamudāyātmakānāṃ vā akṣarāṇāṃ akṣarasamudāyātmakānāṃ vā padānāṃ samūhe, vākyāntye vā varṇai jātirūpaṃ vākyatvaṃ bhramaṇādivāt kalpayituṃ bhramaṇādyabhāvāt nānyavarṇairvā tebhyālocanasaṃbhavaḥ, padatadrākyasaṃjñadvayavidhavādhanāt iti tadbhūtādhikaraṇoktāt tallakṣaṇānaṃ padarūpāṇāṃ vākyāvayavānāṃ grahaṇarūpaiḥ padārthānāṃ padapadārthasaṃbandhānāṃ ca smaraṇarūpaiḥ pratyayaiḥ padārthānāṃ cānyonyākāṅkṣābhiḥ vyavadhānāt jātyāśrayānanusaṃdhānena jātigrahaṇādyogāt yathā nādhyavasitaṃ, tathā ṛgādīni jātirūpāṇi kalpayituṃ na śakyāni ityarthaḥ |
jātaṃ samūhasāmānyaṃ na jātirnāma kā cana ||
' loke'pi caiva jātijātaśabdārtha- prasiddhiḥ iti evameva vyākhyāyeyam |
vedaprāye vākye vedapakrame nigamyamānā ime śabdāḥ śrūyante 'prajāpatirvā idameka āsīt |
agne- rṛgvedo vāyoryajurvedaṃ ādityāt sāmavedaḥ' ityevamupa- kramya nigamane idaṃ śrūyate 'uccairṛcā kriyate, uccaiḥ sāmnā, upāṃśu yajuṣā' iti |
etatsyāt kāraṇāt ebhiḥ prakṛtaiḥ upāṃśādi kartavyaṃ, na jātā ṛgādibhirityu- cyate |
yassāditaḥ ete vedā jātāḥ, tasmādetaiḥ upāṃśādi kartavyamiti |
vā -- 'kimidaṃ prāyadarśanāditi' ( bhāṣyam ) nedamanvaiḥ prāyadarśanaistulyaṃ iti paśyan pṛcchati |
( atulyatvameva pradarśayati -- ) 'prāyavacanācca' ityatra hi pradhānaprāye yatra anyāni pradhānāni, tatra vacanāt ityuktam |
tathā 'viśaye prāyadarśanāt' iti saṃskāra- prāye yatra anye saṃskārā godohanādayaḥ, tatra asya darśanamiti |
na tu iha yatra anye vedāḥ, tatra eṣāṃ ṛgādīnāṃ darśanaṃ ityapi vaktuṃ śakyam |
nahi etadavyati- riktā vedāḥ santi, yeṣāṃ mayapāte saṃkīryeran |
tatrottaramāha ( bhāṣyaṃ - ) vedaprāye vedaprakrame vedabuddhijanitasaṃskārāvate manasi 'ime śabdāḥ śrūyante' |
yattu viśuddheśrvalī- yastvāt arthavādapadyo vedaśabdaḥ avayavaviṣayo bhaviṣyatīti, tatra brūmaḥ |
' ye hi viśuddheśrat parastāt arthavādāḥ śrūyante, teṣāmasti daurbalyam |
ye purastāt śrūyante, te mukhyatvāt balīyāṃso bhavanti |
sarvasyaiva hi śabdasya svārthālaṅghane virodhaḥ kāraṇam |
sa ca pratiyogini haṣṭe virodho vijñāyate |
tadiha yadā 'trayo vedā ajāyanta, agnirṛgvedaḥ' ityādi śrūyate, na tadā jātavacanānāṃ ṛgādīnāṃ uccāraṇamasti |
ataḥ tena tāvat śruticaivena vyāptā buddhiḥ |

athedānīṃ ṛgādiśabdāḥ svārthaparāḥ santaḥ na saṃtradhyante, iti balāt lakṣaṇāṃ pratipadyante iti, tata eva svārthe viśuddheśrvatatve daurbalyaṃ, 'mukhyaṃ vā pūrvacodanālakṣaṇetyeva' ityeva ityevamityetat upapa- mapi arthavādāt mukhyavedajñānaṃ bādhitā viśuddheśrajñāna-

’ ye hi bhinnavākyagatāḥ parasparanirapekṣāḥ virodhino'rthāḥ śrūyante, teṣāṃ pūrvasya uttarānupramadenaiva labdhātmakatvāt uttarasya pūrvopamadena vinā āmalābhā- papatteḥ paurvāparyabalīyastvaṃ jāyate |
yatra tu ekavākya- tayā parasparapekṣāṇāṃ śravaṇaṃ, na tatra etat bhavati |
pūrvapratīte ca uttaraṃ ātmānuguṇamadhika vā ākāṅkṣati |
ataśca yat anadhikamanuguṇaṃ vā, tat anapekṣitatvāt naiva tasmin vākye'sti |
na ca avidyamānena pūrvapakṣaḥ śakyate iti pūrvabalīyastvaṃ bhavati |
tadiha vidhyarthavādayoḥ samānaviṣayatvāt yāvadeva arthavāde vedāḥ saṃkīrtitāḥ, tāvadeva kimapi vidheyaṃ etadityetat avyavat |
tataśca kimeśāṃ vidheyaṃ ityetannāmrā apekṣate, na tu kasya kiṃ
anantarā tu śrutimātrakapramāṇagamya- viniyoge vicārite adhunā ubhayakalyakapramāṇagamyavini- yogavicārāvasaro'ta spaṣṭā |
tadiha upakramopasaṃhāraika- vākyatayā vedadharmatvamavadhāritaṃ iti vākyaviniyogaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- evaṃ liṅgaviniyoge nirūpite iha vākyādiviniyogo nirūpyate |

tadiha jyotiṣṭome śrutena 'uccairṛcā kriyate' ityādinā vākyena vidhīya- mānasya uccaistvādeḥ uddeśyasamarthakena ṛgādipadena kiṃ ṛgādīnāṃ mantrāṇāmeva uddeśyatvaṃ pratipādyate, uta 'trayo vedā ajāyanta' ityādyupakramārthavādavedhana lakṣaṇāyā ṛgvedādivihitakarmāṅgībhūta mantramātrasya cintāṃyāṃ, upakramasthāpi vedapadma guṇabhūtānparādhavādavedhana pradhānabhūtavidhyuddeśastathādipe niḥsaṃdeha aṅguṇa- virodhanyāyena lakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakatvāt vedapade eva tadeka- deśaṛgādilakṣaṇā |
vastutastu vedaśabdasya avayavade'pi na lakṣaṇā, vedatvasya pratyekavṛttitvāt |
iti prāpte, upakrame vedapada- śravaṇena etāvadavagamyate, nūnamatra vedasya, stūyamānatvā- duddeśyatvaṃ vidheyatvaṃ vā tasyāvaśyaṃ vākye vivakṣitamiti |
tatra ca vidheyasya uccaistvāderlābhān pariśeṣādeva tasyo- ddeśyatvāvagateḥ |
ataśca asaṃjātavirodhinaḥ upakramasthasya vedapadasya tātparyagrāhakasya sattvāt ṛgādipade tanman- tvena ṛgvedādivihitakarmāṅgībhūta mantralakṣaṇā |
na copa- kramāvagatasyāpacchedakavicāraṇayena pareṇa bādhaḥ, tasya hi vidheyastutisāpekṣatvena arthatadaikvākyatayā āvaśyakatvāt pūrvaviroghe parasyānutpannatvādeva abhyupagaccheḥ |
na ca vedatvasya ṛgādiṣu paryāptatvāt upakramā- virodhaḥ, vedatvasya mantrāṅgāṇasamudāyātmake anyaviśeṣe eva paryāptatvena avayavaparyāptatvābhāvāt |
yathā ca etādṛśaviṣaye niṣedhasya vidheyasya vailakṣaṇyaṃ,

evaṃ ca vedatvasya prakaraṇavākyavākyamātreṣu aparyāptatvāt prakaraṇena vākyasya viṣaye upasaṃhārādupapatteḥ vedatvāvacchinna- vihitakarmāgrodhena vākyena svaravidhānāvagateḥ prakaraṇa- bādhe'pi na kṣatiḥ |
upakramādhikaraṇe upakramamātrasyamanapekṣya nyāyā- ntareṇa svarāṇāṃ vedadharmatvanirṇayaḥ ityuktam |
asaṃjātavirodhitvena upakramagatārthavādasya yathāśrutatathaiva vyākhyātatvāt aṅguṇavirodhanyāyasya vidhyuddeśatadākyaśeṣānyaviṣayatāyā upakramādhikaraṇe vyavasthāpitatvāt |

upagānaṃ ṛtvija eva ke cit kurvanti |

gānaṃ prāptameva prākṛtaṃ, upacayaḥ upasargārtho vidhīyate |
yadā etayoranyatarat, tadā ṛtvikāryaṃ panyo vartante |

bhāṭṭa-- gavāmayanagataṃte mahāvrate 'dikṣu dundubhayo nadanti' iti prakṛtya 'patnaya upagāyanti' iti śrutam |

tadiha kiṃ patnayaḥ prākṛtopagānānuvādena vidhīyamānā ṛtvijāṃ nivartikā uta aprākṛtopagānasaṃnnidhatvāt anivartikā iti cintāyāṃ, prakṛtau upagānasya vihitatvāt ihāti- deśena prāpte tadanuvādena vidhīyamānāḥ patnayo ṛtvijāṃ nivartikāḥ |
na ca gānasyodeśyatve taddeśe'nyasya upa- cayasya avivakṣāśaṅkā, upasargāṇāṃ parasparānvayavyutpatyā viśiṣṭoddeśopapatteḥ |
na ca tathāpi 'dikṣu dundubhayo nadanti' iti pratyakṣopadeśādarthāntaraparivarta- mānasya patnīkartṛkopacayasyopapatteḥ |

prātagānānuvādena upasargārthasyopa- cayasya patnīnāṃ ca parasparaviśyāsaṃbhavena anekavidhāne vākyabhedācca |
ataśca prākṛtopagānakriyāyāṃ kartṛtvena vidhīyamānāḥ patnayo ṛtvijāṃ nivartikāḥ |
śārīragītyātmaka evaiti kathaṃ tatra kāṇḍavīṇādividhānamiti vācyam |
śārīra- gīteḥ śārīre evopacayaḥ ityatra pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva prakṛtau sādhanatvavidhānābhāvāt upacayasya śārīra- tve'pi iha kāṇḍavīṇādividhānāt aśārīratve'pi na kṣatiḥ |
astu vā ihāpi tasya śārīratvaṃ, kāṇḍavīṇā-
tacca yogyatā- balena vādanadvaite kāṇḍavīṇāvādanaṃ kurvatībhirmukhena prākṛtamupagānaṃ kāryam |

taireva sati, asya na kiṃ cidirostyeti |
sarvārthā hi sā na kevalaṃ apatyārthatāmeṣyati |
api ca evaṃ sarvate, ‘ dharme cārthe ca kāme ca nāti- rittanyā ’ iti |
