ādhānasya bhāryāsaṃyogottarakālatvāt upanayanahomaḥ laukike'gnau iti siddhānta uktaḥ|
tatreyamāśaṅkā-- ādhānāt pūrvaṃ ekā dārakriyā, sā karmārthā bhaviṣyati, adhānottarakālaṃ ca dvitīyā dārakriyā, sā cāpatyārthā|
evaṃ sati prathamaṃ bhāryāsaṃyogaḥ, tata ādhānaṃ, tena saṃskṛte- 'gnau upanayanahomaḥ; tato vedādhyayanamityādi iti|
hi yasmāt karmabhiḥ agnihotrādikarmabhiḥ saha tatsamavāyaḥ; ādhānasaṃbandhaḥ ādhānasādhyāgnīnāṃ saṃbandho bhavati|
tathā ca bhāryāsaṃyogottaraṃ ādhane sati karmādhikārān upanayanakāle ca tasya sarvasyāsaṃbhavāt upanayanahomo laukike'gnau eva|
asmin sūtre yā pūrvapakṣaḥ śaṅkā uktā, tadarthatvena idaṃ sūtraṃ sutrodhinīvṛttau vyākhyātam|
tadyathā-- 'upanayanāt prāk ādhānārthamekā bhāryā astu, ādhānottaraṃ dārasaṃgrahaḥ prajāyartho'stvityāha-- akarmeti|
tasmin upanayanakāle samavāyaḥ bhāryāsaṃbandhaḥ karmabhiḥ saṃbaddha iti śeṣaḥ' iti|
tataḥ paraṃ 'akarma ca dārakriyā''dhānottarakāle' iti siddhānta- sūtram|
etadvitīyasūtrarūpā paṅktirapyabhāṣye'pi dṛśyate tathā sā pūrvasūtra- vyākhyānamatthe patitā satī vyākhyānarūpaiva na svatantra- sūtrātmikā iti spaṣṭam|
na cedaṃ sūtraṃ anyatra kāpi dṛśyate|
śrāddhaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ yathā āhitāgneḥ anāhitāgneśca bhavati tadvat dārasaṃgrahaḥ āhitāgneḥ anāhitāgneśca, arthāt ādhānottaraṃ ādhānāt prāk ca syāt iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt|
anāhitāgnerapi dārakarma iti pūrvapakṣoktaṃ niṣedhati siddhāntī|
na anāhitāgneḥ dārakarma saṃbhavati 'adhītya snāyāt' 'snātvā udvahet' 'jātaputraḥ ādadhīta' iti śrutibhiḥ vipratiṣedhāt|
tasmāt ādhānāt prāk dārakarma naiva saṃbhavati|
ādhānāt prāk dārasaṃgrahaḥ karmārthaḥ; ādhānottaraṃ ca putrārtha iti pūrvapakṣiṇā yaduktaṃ tatra|
tasmāt ekaiva bhāryā karmārthā apatyārthā ca|
yadyapi vastutaḥ ekaiva patnī karmārthā apatyārthā ca, tathāpi 'anyatarāpāye anyāṃ kurvīta' iti smaryate|
tasmādyasya na dharmasaṃpannā, na prajāsaṃpannā vā patnī so'nyāṃ kurvīta iti smaryate|
somapānāt iti śabdaḥ 'somapo na dvitīyāṃ jāyāṃmabhyupayata' ityatrārthavādaṃ vyapadiśati|
'somapāne na dvitīyāṃ jāyāṃ abhyanujñāyate' iti ca|
asmāt somapānāt somapāna- viṣayakāryatvāt dvitīyasya dāraparigrahasya prāpaṇaṃ prāptiḥ bhavati|
tasmāt dharmaprajā'nyatarāpāye kāraṇe sati upanayaccheta dvitīyaṃ dārasaṃgrahaṃ kurvīta|
evaṃ yadyapi bhāryādvayaṃ sidhyati, tathāpi na upanayanahomāt prāk bhāryāsaṃgrahaḥ sidhyati, na cādhānam|
tasmāt upanayana- homaḥ laukike'gnau eva, na saṃskṛte'gnau iti niśrīyete|
kiṃ caturgṛhītaṃ bhavati samānayane ? neti brūmaḥ |
ādhāre'pi ādhāre, yadavaśiṣṭaṃ catuḥsaṃkhyameva tasya grahaṇamāsīt |
alpaṃ hi caturgṛhītaṃ homāpāyāntaṃ, tadarthāṃta kathaṃ syāditi |
alpatvaṃ ca bahutvaṃ kasya cidapekṣya bhavati |
yadi hi aupabhṛtamaṣṭasaṃkhyaṃ, evaṃ caturgṛhītamalpaṃ bhavati |
dup— na tāvat samānayane caturgṛhītaṃ bhavati pūrvameva (samānayanāt) tasya (jauhavasya) catuḥsaṃkhyā- paricchinnatvāt |
itarasya ca (aupabhṛtasya) catuḥsaṃkhyatve (sati) kīdṛśo alpatvamavacche ? yadi tu a
' (sadṛśasya gavayasya darśanāt asannikṛṣṭe gavi sādṛśyasya jñānaṃ yattadupamānam |
na cādṛṣṭapūrvasya adṛṣṭasahasya ca upamānaviṣaya- tvam |
2|1|2|5 pṛ. 390. upamānaṃ pūrvadṛṣṭe arthe smaryamāṇe dṛśyamānārthasādṛśyajñānam |
evaṃ ca āraṇyakavākyārthajñānavataḥ araṇye gavayadarśane tatkaraṇaṃ, tatsādṛśyaviśiṣṭo goḥ iti jñānaṃ pramā, vākyārthasmaraṇaṃ avāntaravyāpāraḥ |
arthā- ntarasya tādṛśayogarūpasādṛśyasya nyāyasyavṛttitā yāvadā- śrayapratyakṣabhāvena tadyogatāt |
evaṃ ca pratyakṣavarthavidhisāhacaryasya āgneyavidhi upamityā upasthitamevavidhiṣividhitvetikartavyatā apekṣitāyāḥ sauryādiṣvanyatraḥ phalaṃ iti jīrṇāḥ |
ato gosādṛśyaviśiṣṭapiṇḍadarśanaṃ karaṇaṃ, atideśavākyārtha- smaraṇaṃ avāntaravyāpāraḥ ; 'ayaṃ gavayapadavācyaḥ' 'gavayo gavayapadavācyaḥ' iti vā saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhana pramā ityāhuḥ |
pṛ. 13. upamānaṃ--'sādṛśyād dṛśyamānād yat pratiyogini jāyate |
tatsadrūpamātre smaraṇaṃ, tayopamānatvameva na prasaktaṃ, pramāṇalakṣaṇādhikārāt |
etenaiva asadṛśāt yat sadrūpajñānaṃ tadviṣayāt tattadviṣayajñānaṃ, tadupyanumānaṃ nādyannīyameva pramāṇatvādityuktam |
yattu prasiddhārthasya sādhamyāt aprasiddhārthasādhamyamupamānamityuktaṃ, tada- yuktam |
tathāhi, ‘yādṛśo gaustādṛśo gavayaḥ’ iti śrutātideśavākyasya vane gavayamupalabhamānasya ayaṃ gavayaḥ iti pratītirūpamānaphalamucyate |
tatra tāvad ‘gohasadṛśo gavayaḥ’ iti prathamā''dyatiḥ puruṣavākyamātraprabhavā nopa- mānaṃ bhavati |
yadapi vanagatasya gavaye tadatte ca gosādṛśye jñānaṃ, tadapi pratyabhijñāpratyakṣam |
yā tvetsya gavaya- śabdavācyatā'vagatiḥ, sā'pi gavayaśabdaprayogādā
'tatrau saha' ityapyuccuḥ pratyāha iti vyapadeśo bhavati adhvaryoryajamānasya ca |
taddhi kleśena kalpyamānaṃ kadā cidubhayorna śakyate kalpayituṃ ityā- śaṅkā syāt |
kalpanāhetustu yugapatpravṛtteraviśiṣṭaḥ iti na kiṃ citrauravam |
atha kasmāt nobhāveva prayujyatā ? yadā ekenāpi prayujyamānaḥ śakkotyeva ubhayagāmi phalaṃ prakāśayituṃ, tadā siddhe'yaṃ na kiṃ cidubhayakartṛkatvena prayojanamasti ityadhyurniyamaḥ |
( vastutastu 'tatrau saha' iti mantraṃ adhvaryuryajamānau dvāvapi prayuñjāte iti yājñikācāraḥ |
) śā-- yatra vyapadeśo bhavati 'tatrau saha' iti tatrāpi dvivacanasyātyantānupapatteḥ ṛtvigbhyāmimaṃ (api) |
vi-- 'bhadraṃ tatrau sahetyetat kasmin ?, svāmini yujyate |
) bhaṭṭa-- evaṃ yatrāpi 'tatrau saha' ityādī dvivacanā- yanupapattiḥ tatrāpi ṛtvigbhyāmimam (api) |
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome uparvamantraḥ, 'rakṣohaṇo valaghano vaiṣṇavān khanāmi' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ sarvaparveṣu sakṛdeva mantraḥ prayoktavyaḥ, uta pratyuparvamiti |
yadi pratyuparvaṃ prayujyeta, ekasmin bahuvacanāntāmidhānaṃ na sādhayet |
yathā loke ekasminnarthe bahuvacanaṃ na prayujyate |
api ca sakṛdeva eva śaknoti sarvoparvānabhidhātum |
saṃnipāti hyetanmantraṃ, yenoparvatantraṃ saṃnipātitaṃ tadarthameva vijñāyate |
ato yasyoparvasya arthaṃ mantraḥ saṃnipātiḥ, tasyaiva mantrakāritaḥ saṃskāro na sarveṣām |
ye tu asaṃnipātikarmāṇāṃ mantrāḥ, yathā subrahmaṇyā''hvāne 'devā brahmaṇaḥ' ityaupavasathye'hani, teṣāmekakālatvāt ayuddhā- mānaviśeṣāṇāṃ sakṛdvacanaṃ syāt |
yattu na bahuvacanānta ekṣyābhidhāyakaḥ iti, prātipadikārtho'bhihitaḥ, vibhaktyarthaśca karmatvam |
soma-- idaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavat tantratā ityukteḥ (dṛṣṭānta-- saṃgatiḥ |
loke yathā ekasmin bahu- vacanasamarthe tadapihyapi iti |

ataśca pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttyā yathaiva mantrāvṛttiḥpātra- prokṣaṇāvṛttau prāptāyāṃ 'śṛṇvadhvam' iti bahuvacanānu- rodhāt prokṣaṇatantrāpādānena mantratantraṃ, tathaihāpi satyapi karaṇamantratve bahuvacananurodhāt mantratantramavam |
etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ; yadatra sāmarthyāt pratyuparvaṃ khanana- syāvṛttiḥ; na caitāvatā mantrāvṛttiḥ, sakṛtpaṭhitamantra- janyasmṛtyaiva sarvoparvakhananaprakāśanopapatteḥ |
nahi atra pratyuparvaṃ khanane vaijātyaṃ, yena 'mantrānte karmādiḥ saṃnipātaḥ' itivacanavihitamantrāntakālabhedenāpi kathaṃ- cidbhedo bhavet |
'uparvān khanati' iti vidhinā ekajātīyasyaiva khananasya pratyuparvamarthādicintonnatvāt |

iti prāpte, vidheyatā'vacchedakabhūtavijātīyakhananatvasya atraikatve'pi ekoparvakhanane tasya pratyekavṛttitvaṃ, saṃskāryabhedyamedāt pratigrahaṃ saṃmārgavat pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kriya- māṇajyotiṣṭomādivacca |
ataśca vidheyatā'vacchedakī- bhūtavijātīyakhananatvaparyāptyadhikaraṇasya karmapadārthatvāt tasya ca mantrāntakālakatvavidhānāt mantrāvṛtterāvaśyaka- tvam |
vediprokṣaṇe tu naikākāvat vijātīyaprokṣaṇasvarūpa- vidheyatā'vacchedakaṃ pratyekavṛttī |
api tu virājātiviśiṣṭa- prokṣaṇavidhānāt sarvābhyāsye jyotiṣṭomavat nyāyasya- vṛttayeva |

ataśca tatra vidheyatā'vacchedakamarthasyāpyadhi- pāśādhikaraṇanyāyena bahuvacanātiriktasakalamantrasya pratya- kāvṛttipratīteḥ, bahuvacanasyāpi tadanurodhenāvṛttisvīkṛtya pūjādyarthatvena vyākhyānaṃ draṣṭavyam |
jyotiṣṭome 'rakṣohaṇo valaghano vaiṣṇavān khanāmi' iti uparvavāṇāṃ khanane mantraḥ |
sa kiṃ sarvaparveṣu sakṛt ādau prayoktavyaḥ pratyuparvaṃ veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha ? uparvamantraḥ tantraṃ syāt |
lokavat, yathā loke bahuvacanaṃ ekasminnarthe asamarthe evamatrāpi |
na saṃnipātitvādasaṃnipātikarmaṇāṃ viśeṣā- grahaṇe kālaikatvāt sakṛdvacanam |
na uparvamantrasya tantratā, kiṃtu pratyuparvaṃ mantrāvṛttiḥ kartavyā, saṃnipātitvāt khanana- karmaṇaḥ |
mantrasya ca saṃnipatyopakārakatvāt anuṣṭheyārtha- smaraṇadvārā adṛṣṭajanakatvāt |

ye tu asaṃnipātināṃ saṃni- pātibhinnānāṃ saṃnipatyopakāribhinnānāṃ ārādupakārakāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣādadṛṣṭajananakānāṃ mantrāḥ, yathā subrahmaṇyāhvāne 'devā brahmaṇaḥ' iti aupavasathye'hani, teṣāṃ ekakāla- tvāt 'asya mantrasya anenaiva karmaṇā saṃbandhaḥ' iti viśeṣāgrahaṇe viśeṣajñānābhāve sakṛt vacanaṃ syāt |
prakṛte tu uparvakhananakarmaṇā bhinnakālatvāt viśeṣasaṃbandho gṛhyate |
bhā. 11|4|15|56-56. uparidhāraṇaṃ sugaṇḍopari samiddhāraṇaṃ apūrvatvā- dvīdhīyate |
pretāmihotre śrutyasya upari- samiddhāraṇasya daive karmaṇi vidhiḥ, na tu adhastā- tsamiddhāraṇaśeṣārthavādatvam ||
vā-- idānīṃ evaṃvidha- (yat-hi-ityādi-) śabdābhāve anuvādavyavasthāprasaktasyāpavāda ārabhyate |
tatraiva diṣṭāmihotre mahāpitṛyajñe vā śrūyate 'adha- stāt samidhaṃ dhārayannudayet upari hi devebhyo dhāra- yati' iti |
tatra 'upari hi devebhyaḥ' ityatra pūrva- vadeva vidhyanuvādasaṃdehe hiśabdayogāt, vartamānāpa- deśāt, vidhyantareṇa caikavākyatvāt, ācārataḥ prāpteḥ, anuvādaḥ iti prāpnoti |
yatra ka ca prāpte samid tantra niyamyate ||
devāryasya suci prakṣitasya havipa: āhavanīyadeśaṃ nīya- mānasya avaśyameva hasto vā ambaddhā kiṃ cit dravyaṃ ācārādupardi dātavyam |
tatra pratyāsatte: samidhamyate ‘sugdaṇḍe samidhamupagṛhya anudravati’ iti cāsyāpi vidhe: ācārāpekṣitārthavidhānāt etadeva phalaṃ vijñāyate |
tasmāt ‘upari dhārayati’ iti prāptasya upavītāderivā- nuvāda: ‘sato vā liṅgadarśanaṃ’ ( iti pūrvanyāyāt ) |
’ satyaṃ ācārāt pracchādanaṃ kartavyaṃ, na tu tatra samid paḍe'pi prāpnoti, yā saṃnidherniyamyeta |
hastā- ceva hi tatra yogyatvāt prāpnuyāt na samid |
nanu ca somacamasādīnāṃ vacanasāmarthyāt yā kā cit ānarthakyā bhavati, evamatrāpi yā kā cit pracchiṃsamirviṣyatīti |
oṃ upalakṣaṇāyāye'pi upalakṣaṇāyaḥ iti nyāyaḥ pratidinaṃ śaklavelāyāmāgantavyaṃ ityādi prasiddhaḥ |
nahi kālaviśeṣopalakṣaṇatayā upātte śaklavacanau ka- cit divase devādyakṛte sati tadupalakṣitaḥ kālo nāstīti avagamyate |
'upāṃśuyājaḥ ekapuroḍāśāyāmapi paurṇamāsyām' iti cindau asyādhi- karaṇam |
'vastutaḥ utthānantarasya paścāt saṃpattāvapi pūrvamapi upalakṣaṇīyānapāyanyena saṃbhavamātreṇa pūrvapakṣaprapañcyupapatteḥ |
yadi ca vastutaḥ kālavidheḥ upalakṣaṇapāyanyāyena anukartavyaliyamamaya- viśeṣe eva tātparyaṃ uktaṃ kālabādhastadā nāyaṃ kāla- vidhiḥ |
oṃ upalakṣaṇopanyāse viśeṣaṇasya dṛṣṭāntatā na yuktā iti yat, tat upalakṣaṇasyāpi viśeṣakatvāt caudyam |
yadvā kena cit sāmānyena dṛṣṭāntatā bhaviṣyati anabhidheyatvena viśeṣakatvena veladugdham |
oṃ upalakṣaṇaṃ hi anupalamyamānaṃ nāstītyasya jñānasya gocaratāmāpadyate |
oṃ upavatyaprabhavatyonaimittikoḥ prākṛtayoḥ pṛṣṭha- pratipadoḥ saṃsavādivikṛtau nānuṣṭhānam ||
tatrāsti rathaṃtaranimittakaṃ bṛhanni- mittakaṃ ca, 'upavartī rathaṃtarapṛṣṭhasya pratipadaṃ kuryādiya- vartī vṛhatpṛṣṭhasya' iti |
tatropadetaḥ saṃśāyikaḥ kiṃ rathaṃ- taranimittakaṃ bṛhannimittakaṃ vā kārye, vikalpaḥ, athavā rathaṃtaranimittakaṃ kartavyaṃ, athavā anyanimittakameva kartavyam |
kiṃ prāptam ? anyataranimittakaṃ kartavyaṃ, vikalpaḥ iti |
nahi vinigamanāyāṃ hetursti, evaṃnimittakaṃ kartavyaṃ, naivaṃnimittakamiti |
na ca he pratipado śakyate kartum |
bhāṣyam-- yaduktaṃ, samā prāptiḥ, nāsti vinigama- nāyāṃ heturiti |
soma-- kāvasya (nāma sāmanaḥ) pṛṣṭhavaṃcanvā- bhāvāt apratānamittatvātbhave'pi saṃsavāditagatayoḥ bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ pṛṣṭhasaṃbandhāt pratipannimittatvasaṃbhavaḥ ityucitaiḥḥ pratyudāharaṇasaṃgatiḥ |
vi-- 'upavatyaprabhavatyo sto gosave yadi vā nahi |
, ekaikasya nimittaṃ prakṛtā- vatra tu dvaye |
( 'upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ' iti upavatī ṛk, 'prayujo vāco agniyaḥ' iti agniyavatī ṛk |
bhāṭṭa-- saṃsavādivaikṛtau prakṛtiprāptayorvṛhadrathaṃtara- sāmnoḥ samuccayaḥ śrūyate 'saṃsava ume bṛhadrathaṃtare kuryāt' |

tatra yanmate tāvu dvayorvikalpena eka- pṛṣṭhastotrasādhanatvaṃ, tanmate dvayorasminneva stotre samuccayāt, satradaśastome ekasminneva stotre vibhāgena sāmnostadāśrayatvaiśca pāṭhaḥ abhyāsenetyavivādameva |
sa ca vibhāgaḥ keṣu citpayeṣu rathaṃtaraṃ, keṣu cit bṛhaditi kalpasūtrakāravacanādavagamyatavya |
yanmate tu sāmadvayāsādhya- pṛṣṭhastotrabhedaḥ, tanmate'pi na stotrayoḥ samuccayaḥ, yena satasadaśāstomakastotradvayānuṣṭhānaṃ śaṅkyeta |
api tu vikalpena prāptoreva stotrayorekasmin kasmiścit stotre sāmadvayasya tadāśrayatvaiśca samuccayaviśeṣādyorvidhiḥ |
ata eva ye sāmadharmāḥ saṃmīlanādayaste tatkāle kāryā iti teṣā- mapi samuccayaḥ eva |

ye tu bṛhatsāmakatve rathaṃtarasāma- katve vā nimitte anyājñatvena vihitāḥ, yathā aindra- vāyavāgratvañcāgrāgatvadayaḥ, yathā vā 'agravatī bṛhatpṛṣṭhasya pratipadaṃ kuryāt, upavatī rathaṃtarapṛṣṭhasya' iti |
atra hi bṛhatsāmyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhiṇā jyotiṣṭoma- gatavṛhatpṛṣṭhatve nimitte vahiṣpavamānāntaraprakaraṇāt tadratapratipadudeśenāgravatī vidhīyate |
te iha saṃsavādau kāryā na veti sandehe nimittadvayasyatvāt naimittikadvayasyapi prāptam |

iti prāpte, yadi- śabdādyupāttasya nimittatvasya kādācitkatvāt kādācitkatvasya ca bṛhadrathaṃtarayoranyonyavirodhaprayuktatvāt bṛhadrodhinī rathaṃtarasya rathaṃtaravirodhinī vā bṛhato nimittatā prakṛtau avagamyate |
ata eva anyonyavirodhasya nimittatvābalavattvāt na tadvighātātko'pyamedo- 'pi |
ata eva ubhayatra nimittatā yathā prakṛtau, vaikadikatvāt vikutāvapi |
yatra tu dvividhavirodhatā'bhāvaḥ, tatra satyapi rathaṃtarādau na tasya nimittatā |
ata eva viśvajidādau 'pacamāne rathaṃtaraṃ, ābheve bṛhat' ityādinā stotrāntare tatsatve'pi naindravāyavāgrādi- niyamaḥ |
ataśca tadeva saṃsavādau virodhābhāvena nimi- tābhāvācca naimittikā dharmāḥ |
ataśca tatrāniyatā grahamātā, aniyatā ca yā kā citpadite dravyam |
oṃ upavarṣeṇa devatoddeśa-dravyayāgaprakṣepapādyathārtha- trayasamudāyarūpaṃ juhotyarthe prati devatāyā dravyasya vā karmatyāgogāt juhotiyoge karmaṇi dvitīyā'nupapatteḥ tṛtīyā'rthavācitā uktā |
su. pṛ. 632, oṃ upavarṣeṇa dhātvarthānapekṣasya guṇasya bhāvanā'vacchedakatvāt homadvārā phalasādhanatā uktā |
ādhāne vāravantīyayajñāyajñīyavāmadevyāni sāmāni vidhāya 'upavītā vā etasyāgrayo bhavanti yasyāgnyādheye brahma sāmāni gāyati' iti sāmagānasya upavādaḥ nindā kṛtā |
ayamupavādaḥ tadvat 'śiṣṭvā tu pratiṣedhaḥ syāt' (10|8|13|6) ityadhikaraṇokta- ṣoḍaśigrahaṇaniṣedhavata vikalpāyaiḥ syāt |
ādhāne sāmnāṃ gānasya na vikalpaḥ, kiṃtu akarma akaraṇameva |
'upavītā vā etasyāgrayo bhavanti yasyāgnyādheye brahma sāmāni gāyati' iti sāmagānasya pratiṣedhāt |
tathā ca vidhānāt pratiṣedhācca vikalpa eva |
tannedamāmananti ' ya evaṃ vidvān vāravantīyaṃ gāyati ' ' ya evaṃ vidvān yajña- yajñīyaṃ gāyati ' ' ya evaṃ vidvān vāmadevyaṃ gāyati ' iti |
vā etasāmayo bhavanti yasyāgnyādheye brahmā sāmāni gāyati' iti |
tatrāyamartha: saṃśāyikaḥ, ki ayamupavāda: pratiṣedhārthaḥ, uta paryudāsārthaḥ, uta arthavādārthaḥ iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? na paryudāsaḥ, brahmaṇaḥ aprāptatvāt |
yathā ' prajāpatirvā eka āsīt, sa ātmano vapāmaduḥkhadat ' iti |
na brahmaṇaḥ upapādaḥ kasya cidarthādaḥ saṃbhavati |
na ca vākyāntarasthenārthavādena kiṃ cidapi prayojanamasti |
kiṃvat ? yathā ' atirātre gṛhṇāti ṣoḍaśinaṃ ' iti vidhāya pratiṣedhārthe syāt |
kathaṃ ? brahmaṇo gānaṃ naiva prāptaṃ iti brahmajñānapratiṣedhārthe vacanaṃ nāva- kalpate |
bhāṣyam -- iti cet dṛśyate sāmagānasyaiva nindeti |
yathaiva hi nindayā na kartavya- miti gamyate, evaṃ upadeśāt kartavyaṃ iti gamyate |
na ca anyat kartavyaṃ iti kaścit vidhiḥ prakalpate, yasya praśaṃsārthe nindeta |
yadyapi ' upavītā vā etasāmayo bhavanti yasyāgnyā- dheye brahmā sāmāni gāyati ' iti bhāṣyādāhṛte vākye
tathā ca tatra nindaiva śrūyate, na pratiṣedhaḥ |
ata eva sūtre'pi nindāārthakaḥ upavādaśabda eva prayuktaḥ, tathāpi nindayā pratiṣedho gamyate ityā- śayenodāhartumiti dhyeyam |
' na brahmā sāmāni ' iti brahmaśabdaḥ brāhmaṇaparaḥ san udgātaranuvādakaḥ |
tathā ca ' na gāyet ' iti svarūpeṇa gānameva niṣidhyate |
pratiṣedhasya ca gānasya vastuto brāhmaṇa udgātā iti brahmaśabdo'nuvādaḥ |
vikalpito vā, sūtyo'pi vapotsedhe iva sūtiḥ |
bhāṭṭa -- ādhāne ' vāravantīyaṃ gāyati ' ' vāmadevyaṃ gāyati ' ' yajñīyaṃ gāyati ' iti sāmāni vihi- tāni |
tato ' na brahmā sāmāni gāyati ' iti śrutam |
tatrāyaṃ na tāvat brahmakartṛkatvapratiṣedhaḥ paryudāso vā, brahmaṇo vidhyābhāvena prāptyabhāvāt tadabhyupapatteḥ |
ādhānasāmasu hi yajurvedavihitatvāt viniyoga- vidhivedinibandhaḥ : adhvaryudeva kartā nyāyena svaravat prāpnoti, tathāpi vācanikodgātṛkartṛkatvaṃ brahmakartṛka- svam |
ato'yaṃ brahmā brāhmaṇaḥ iti vyutpattyā udgātāra- meva brahmaśabdena anūya gānaniṣedhaḥ eva iti gānasyaiva vikalpaḥ |
yada'pi kalpasūtrānusārāta brahmā'pi udgātrā saha vaikalpiko vihitaḥ, tadā'pi tenaiva brahmaṇo vikalpasiddheḥ nānena brahmaṇo niṣedhaḥ, vaiyarthyāt |
ataḥ tadā'pi ayaṃ gānaniṣedha eva tadvikalpasiddhayarthaḥ iti dhyeyam |
upavāsasya tupavāsasya puroḍāśakapalāprayo- jakatvaṃ nāsti darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
jyotiṣṭome ' sarvarlija upavasanti ' iti ṛtvijāmupavāso vidhīyate |

yathopavāsādicchā śreṣṭhā'sti mikṣāyāḥ : kleśajanakatve'pi hi upavāsasya adhikaduḥkha- pradasyāpekṣāyā iṣṭatvena yathā varatvaṃ, tathā kleśa- dāyakatāratamyena bahuduḥkhadāyakā'pekṣayā svalpaduḥkha- dāyakasya varatvaṃ yatropadiśyate tatrāyaṃ pravartate |

tathā ca yeṣāṃ pāmarāṇāṃ tattvamasyādimahāvākyajanyamedhajñānaṃ kutaścitpratibandhavaśāt bhūyobhūyaḥ śrūyamāṇamapi na buddhi- mārohati, taiḥ prakṛtanyāyena paramavyavahṛtadevaṃ karmānu- ṣṭhānaṃ, tato'pi saguṇopāsanaṃ kāryameva |
tataḥ śuddhāntaḥ- karaṇe jāte bhavatyeva jñānamityāyuktaṃ pañcadaśīgranthe ' upa- vāsādyathā bhikṣā varaṃ dhyānaṃ tathā'nyataḥ ' ityādi |
kartuśca vāsovinyāsamātraṃ guṇo bhavati upavītaṃ nāma |
3|1|1|121, upavītaṃ kṛtsne darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe nividyate, na sāmidhenīṣveva |
3|4|1, upavītaṃ ' nyogikī nityayajñopavītī ' iti smṛtivihitaṃ puruṣā- rtham |
upavītaṃ hi kartuvāso- vinyāsaḥ, yajñopavītaṃ tu sūtrasya vinyāsaviśeṣaḥ |
tat samācārataḥ sarvakarmārthe prāptaṃ, upavītaṃ tu prakaraṇāt darśa- pūrṇamāsayoreva, yajñopavītena cāsvāvirodhāt samuccayaḥ |
iti dupaṭīkāyāṃ vārtikakṛtoktatvāt, ' saṃdigdhe vyāvādākyabhedaḥ syāt ' ityatra ca (3|1|1|121) ' kartuśca vāsovinyāsamātraṃ guṇo bhavati upavītaṃ nāma ' (pṛ. 733 |
) iti bhāṣyakṛtoktatvāt nānena (upa- dhyayate ityanena ) brahmasūtraṃ vidhīyate |
payeyeta yājayedā ' ityanenaiva ca brahmasūtrasya śrautatva- siddhiḥ |
' yajñopavītī hi devebhyo dohayati ' iti śrutireṣā ' prācīnāvītī dohayet ' ityasya pretāmihotratavidheḥ |
kutaḥ ? liṅgadarśanāt, pretāmihotraprakaraṇe ' yajñopavītī hi devebhyo dohayati ' iti prācīnāvītatvasyatā upa- vītānuvādasya liṅgasya darśanāt |
upavītasya darśapūrṇa- māsārthatve tu nāyamanuvādaḥ ; saṃgaccheta, jīvadagnihotra- dohaviṣayatvāttasya |
upavītaṃ sarvakarmārtha iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena vyāvartayati |
upavītaṃ na sarvadharmaḥ, na sarva- karmāgnimiti vidhīyate |
yattu mṛtāmihotre ' yajñopavītī hi devebhyo dohayati ' iti liṅgamuktaṃ, tacca tasya darśapūrṇamāsagatasya dohasaṃnidheḥ upavītasyānuvādāt darśanam |
kutūhale tu aprakaraṇāt ityapi padacchedaḥ svīkṛtaḥ |
tasmāt upavītaṃ darśapūrṇamāsāṅgameva na sarvadharma iti siddhāntaḥ |
upavītasya atidiṣṭasya upavītena nivītena samuccayaḥ : ityane |
bhā. 10|4|1|1-2 varṇakaṃ 1 upa- vītasya kaṇṭhavandhaḥ prāyeṇāprāpta eva, ityasti niyamavidhe- ravakāśaḥ |
upavītasya kāmyāmidhenī- saṃnidhinā kāmyāmidhenyataḥ : prakaraṇāvagatena darśa-
su. pṛ. 1059. upavītasya ( tadākyasya ) na sāmidhenībhiḥ ( tadākyena ) eka- vākyatā |
bhā. 3|1|12|22 pṛ. 735. upa- vītasya puruṣārthasya smṛtyā prāptāvapi kṛtyasya prāpya- bhāvāt ' upapadyate ' iti pañcamalakāreṇa vidhiḥ |
na ca nivītayopavītayorvirodhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ; vāsobhyāṃ tadubhayo- papatteḥ |
vā— ataḥ paraṃ paṭ sūtrāṇi bhāṣyakāreṇa na likhitāni |
tathā ca ' digbhāgaśca tadat ' iti nivītādhikaraṇatādeśaḥ tadānantaryādupapadyate iti |
santi ca jaimineḥ evaṃ prakārāṇyapi anatyantāsa- bhūtāni sūtrāṇi |
tatra kaiścit śrīṇyadhikaraṇāni kalpitāni , apare- ścatvāri |
yadetat pūrvādhikaraṇe darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ vidhīyamānatvena upavītamudāhṛtaṃ , tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ tat darśapūrṇamāsayoreva avatiṣṭhate , athavā sarvakarmārthamiti |
ye tu adhikaraṇatrayaṃ samarthayante , teṣāmevaṃ saṃdehaḥ kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoreva vidhiḥ , atha sarvakarmārthatvaṃ anuvādāśrutiḥ |
' mṛtāmihotre hi pitṛdevatye śrūyate ' prācīnāvītī dohayet |
tadyadi sarvārthamupavītaṃ , tato'yaṃ pindhye agnihotrasatraṃ nityayajñopavītānuvādo'vakalpate |
na cāyaṃ darśapūrṇamāsasyaivānuvādaḥ; viprakṛṣṭatvāt hetuvanni- gadārthavādānarthakyācca |
yadi hi tasminneva karmaṇi anyāvasthāyaṃ dharmo bhavati , tataśca tadavasthaparijihīrṣayā hetuvannigado'vakalpate |
na tu ṛtvantarasya parihartavyaṃ atyantaviprakarṣeṇaiva aprasaktatvāt |
na ca devebhya iti bahuvacanaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoravakalpate , vaikalpikendramahendretyeka- devatyatvāt sānāyyasya |
agnihotre tu sāyaṃprātardevatā- locanena upapannaṃ bahuvacanam |
tataścāyamartho bhavati , yasmāt devayukta- karmāttaramartho'yaṃ , ataḥ pindhye'gnihotre na kartavya iti |
soma— prakaraṇādupasthānanivītasya itya- yukte , upabhyānasyaiva prakaraṇe niveśābhāvāt iti pratyava- sthānāt ākṣepasaṃgatiḥ |
' yajñopavītī hi devebhyo dohayati ' ityatrāpi yajñopavītaśabdena vāsovinyāsa- viśeṣa evābhidhīyate , ityatrāyaṃ vicāraḥ pravartitaḥ |

bhāṭṭa— tadidamupavītaṃ sarvakarmārthaṃ , mṛtāmihotre ' prācīnāvītī dohayet , yajñopavītī hi devebhyo doha- yati ' iti jīvadevatāyāṃ yajñopavītānuvādaliṅgasya prāpyabhāvena sarvārthatāgamakamatvāt , viprakṛṣṭatvena darśapūrṇa- māsasyānuvādānupapatteśca , vaikalpikendramahendradevatya- dārśikadohane devatāhṛtvābhāvena tadanudānupapatteśca |
sarvārthatve tu kartṛsaṃskārasyopavītasya bahudevatyāgnihotra- prayogāṅgatvena tadohane'pi prāptaḥ : anuvādopapattiḥ |
iti prāpte , saṃnikṛṣṭasaṃbhave viprakṛṣṭānuvādasyāpi nyāyya- tvāt prakṛtivikalpaprabhrāyeṇa ca sānāyye'pi devatā- bahutvasattvāt anuvādopapatteḥ prakaraṇāt darśapūrṇamāsāṅ- mevopavītam |
vastutastu , vakṣyamāṇavacanānusāratu agni- hotre'pi yajñopavītasattvena tatratyasyaivārthamamuvādaḥ |
bhāṣyam— ( taittirīyake 2|5 ) darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ saptamāṣṭamotrāṃnuvākayoḥ sāmidhenyaḥ uktāḥ |
daśame kāmyāḥ sāmidhenīkalpā idamakāmasya etāvatīranubrūyāt idaṃkāmasya etāvatīḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ sāmidhenīreva anubrūyāt : upapadyate , uta prakaraṇe savaneva padārthān anutiṣṭhatā upapadyata iti |
kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? upavītaṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ prakaraṇe samāmnātaṃ , atha nivṛtte vā tāsāṃ prakaraṇe iti na jñāyate |
bhavati hi ' sāmi- dhenīranubrūyāt ' iti viśeṣākāṅkṣa vacanam |
parastāt nividāṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ eva kāmyā vidhīyamānāḥ śrūyante , yadanmanantaraṃ yajñopavītamāmnātaṃ , tena aniṣṭacataṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ prakaraṇamiti bhavati matiḥ |
ataḥ prakaraṇe nividaḥ samupanapitā na vyavadadhati , yathā dvādyopasattvā ahīnadharmau jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe iti |
asmin saṃdehe kiṃ tāvatprāptam ? sāmidhenīprakaraṇamaniṣṭaṃ , tatropavītaṃ samāmnāta miti |
kiṃ kurvatā tat kartavyamiti bhavati tatra padārthī- kāṅkṣā |
tatra buddhau saṃnihitena aviprakṛṣṭena , sāmidhenī- vākyena ekavākyatāmupagamya sāmidhenīṣu upavītaṃ upapadyate ityeṣa śabdo vidadhātīti gamyate |
asmin saṃdehe vākyabhedaḥ iti nirṇaya iti |
iha samāmnāya sānubandhasya sāmidhenīvākyasya , asya ca ' upapadyate ' iti vacanasya nividāṃ vidhāya- kena sāmidhenībhiḥ asaṃbandhena granthena vyavadhānaṃ bhavati |
yasya ca paryavasite'pi vacane tatsaṃbandhameva arthāntaraṃ prakramante , na tatrānanuvṛttaṃ prakaraṇam |
yatra tu paryavasite vacane tadasaṃbaṃdhameva arthāntaraṃ prakramante , na tatra buddhau pūrvaḥ padārthaḥ saṃnidhīyate |
na ca buddhau asannihitena eka- vākyatā bhavati |
saṃnidhau samāmnāyasya etadeva prayojanaṃ kathamubhābhyāṃ padārthābhyāṃ viśiṣṭāṃ buddhimupādāye- yuriti |

athānyena prakāreṇa dhyānādinā pūrvapadārthamavagamya vākyārtha saṃjanayet , avaidikaḥ sa puruṣabuddhipūrvako vākyārtho bhavet— yathā anyasyānuvādāt ākhyātapadaṃ gṛhītvā , anyasmācca nāmapadaṃ yo vākyārthaḥ saṃjanyate |
tat bhavet, yatrānyena dhānādinā pūrvapadārthamavagamya vākyārthe saṃjanayet |
nanu sāmidhenīkalpāṃ anantarayuktānāṃ saṃnidhau upavītāmnāyate, tena sāmidhenībhiḥ saṃbhanyate iti |
ativṛttameva hi sāmidhenīnāṃ praka- raṇaṃ, niviṣṭyadairdhadhanānāt |
vākyena hi sāmidhenīkalpāḥ kāmyāḥ saṃbandhamupagacchanti, na prakaraṇamanuvartate |
na ca punaḥ kalpavacanena sāmidhenyaḥ prakṛtā bhavanti |
nahi tatra tāsāṃ vacanaṃ kartavyaṃ iti |
tatra aprakṛtāsāmidhenīṣu yasyaikavākyatā guṇasya sāmidhenīrnāsti, na tasya tābhiḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
tasmāt kṛtsne prakaraṇe yadanujñeyaṃ, tat yaṣopavīteneti siddham |
vā — siddhe karmaṇāṃ karmasamavāye adhunā avāntara- prakaraṇamahāprakaraṇayoḥ katarat viniyojakaṃ iti upavīta- mudāhṛtam |
'nanu darśapūrṇamāsayo- reva prakaraṇaṃ' iti (bhāṣyaṃ) mahāprakaraṇayattvāt naiva avāntaraprakaraṇāni āvibhavanti |
athavā abhismindhanaprakāśanadvāreṇa dṛṣṭasaṃskārārthatvāt na tāsāṃ prakaraṇamiti manyate |

' yathaiva aṅgavākyāni paripūrṇa- svārthāḥ santi darśapūrṇamāsavākyena ekavākyatāṃ yānti, na ca ātmatvaṃ jahati, evaṃ aṅgabhāvanāḥ svāṅgaparipūrṇaḥ paramabhāvanāyāṃ saṃbadhyante, na taddīnatvena tāsāṃ svadharma- nivṛttiḥ |
saṃskāro'pi ca apūrvārthatvāt tassiddhyupāyaṃ apekṣamāṇaḥ prakaraṇamibhavati |
'dṛṣṭe'pi ca phale naiva sā'pekṣā na pravartate |
ataśca yadyapi dṛṣṭārthā ākāṅkṣā dṛṣṭenaiva pūryate, 'abhismindhana-

prakāśanaṃ bhāvayet' kena ? sāmidhenyanuvacanena, katham ? vivakṣāprathanābhighātādikamopajanitavarṇagrahaṇasamarthakaraṇa- śrotrasaṃskārānugṛhītena iti, (vivakṣāpradanādikrameṇa upajanito yo varṇagrahaṇasamarthakaraṇarūpaḥ śrotrasaṃskāraḥ, tadanugṛhītenetyarthaḥ) |
tathāpi 'niyamādṛṣṭaṃ kathaṃ setsyati' iti anuvartate ekākāṅkṣā |
sā ca śāstra- coditena adṛṣṭenaiva upāyena pūryate |
tasmāt asti sāmidhenyanuvacanasya upavītādigrahaṇasamarthaṃ avāntara- prakaraṇam |
evaṃ tarhi tasya saṃnikarṣeṇa baliyastvāt tadaṅgatvenaiva bhavitavyaṃ, iti kuto mahāprakaraṇavini- yogaśaṅkā ? ucyate |
satyaṃ etadevaṃ syāt, yadi tasya niviṣṭyadavadhānena prakaraṇavicchedāśaṅkā na syāt |
evaṃ tarhi vicchinne tasmin jitaṃ mahāprakaraṇa- neti |
kutaḥ ? kāmyasāmidhenīkalpasyakīrta- nena avicchedasaṃdehāt avispaṣṭaṃ mahāprakaraṇam |
atha 'kiṃ tāvadyānta ityādibhāṣyaṃ' vyācaṣṭe-) kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? 'abhitaḥ sāmidhenīnāṃ kīrtanāt prakriyā sthitā |
' yathā darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe pūyādyanumantrāṇi asaṃbaddhā- nyapi na purastāt prakaraṇaṃ vicchindanti, tathā nividā- nyapi na vicchindantiḥ prakaraṇam |
athavā avāntaraprakaraṇena nividāṃapi sāmidhenyanuvacanāṅgatvān naiva asaṃbaddhapada- vyavāyaḥ ityupapannaṃ upavītamapi tadaṅgemeva iti |
nahi kāryataḥ punaḥ kalpaiḥ saṃdhātuṃ sā hi śakyate |
' tāvat hi prakaraṇamanuvartate, yāvat viniyogāhaṃ paśyati |
tadiha nividādinā tatra liṅgena sāmidhenībhirityutthāni abhismindhane viniyujyante 'deveddo mantridaḥ' iti |
tatra yadi agniḥ sāmidhenyaṃ bhavet, tataḥ taddvāreṇa tānyapi aṅgāni bhaveyuḥ |
atha anagnau satyapi aṅgatā kalpyate, tataḥ sāmidhenīnāmapi nividā- ṅgatvaṃ kalpayet |

yadi punaḥ nividaḥ aṅgaṃ bhaveyuḥ, tataḥ godohananyāyena āśrayagrahaṇādāpi tāvat kāmyeṣu prakaraṇānuvṛttiḥ syāt, athāpi kāmyānāmaṅgaṃ bhavet, tathāpi pūyādyanumantravat prakaraṇābādhaṃ nividāṃ kathaṃcit anusaṃdhānena adhyavasyema, na tu anyataradasti iti asati avāntaraprakaraṇe mahā- prakaraṇena sarvārthatā |
nanu yadi vicchinne prakaraṇe kāmyāḥ kalpāḥ śrūyante, tataḥ ekaviṃśatyā pratiṣṭhāṃ bhāvayet, kimāśritayā ? iti prakaraṇena āśraye anu- nīyamāne sākāṅkṣatvāt aparipūrṇatā prāpnoti |
atha vākyena āśrayaṃ upanīyate, tataḥ prāpte karmaṇi saṃbandha- dvayakaraṇāt vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
tatra yadi vākyabhedo'bhyupa- gamyeta, kathaṃcit vā parihiyeta, tato revatīvāravantīya- saubharādiṣvapi evameva vākyena prakṛtāśrayadānāt siddhāntahāniḥ |
aya āśrayalābhāt kathaṃcit anuvartate prakaraṇaṃ, tataḥ upavītamapi tathaiva prāpnoti iti sarvathā saṃkaṭametat |
kiṃ tarhi ? revatīvāravantīyavākyavadeva anenāpi viśiṣṭaṃ karma vidhīyate |
kathamiti ? anubrūyāt iti śabdasāmānyāt, saṃkhyāprayāsatveca 'sāmidhenyanuvacanavat' iti gamyate |
tataśca saṃkhyye- yānāṃ ṛcāṃ anyeṣāṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ prāptiḥ |
yadyapi cātra karmāntaratvāmantaratvayoḥ phalaṃ nāsti, tathāpi vākyaṃ evamavakalpate iti itthaṃ varṇitam |
na tu evaṃ sati etānyanuvacanāni darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmugṛhīta- tvāt pṛthageva prayoktavyāni |
na tāvat etena asatpakṣo nivartyate, sarvathā upavītasya sarvārthatvasiddheḥ |
na tasyānyaprayukta- tvāt svātantrye sati labhyate |
' yo hi nigadaḥ prāk sāmidhenībhyaḥ prayujyate, sa nivittvadeva na sāmi- dhenyam |
tadanantaratvena ca udyamānāsu anubrūyāt iti vidhiḥ, na svatantrāṇām |
tat yadi pṛthak prayogaḥ syāt, tataḥ sāmidhenyaṅgamātratvāt itareṇa nigadena vinā anuvacanavat vihanyeta |
na cāprayoga- madhyasthaḥ śakyo vahniḥ : samindhitum |
tena 'arthā- bhidhānakarma ca' ityasya prakṛtidanupraveśāt prākṛtasya sāmidhenīkāryasya agrisamindhanaprakāśanasya etenaiva prasaṅgataḥ prāptaḥ arthāta prayogamadhyapatitasāmidhenādhīnatvam |
nanu evamapi eṣāmeva kāmyānāṃ kalpānāṃ sarveṣāṃ anyasya vā upavītamaṅgaṃ syāt |
paścāt saṃnidhinā- 'ṅgaṃ syāt sa ca prakaraṇāvaraḥ |
' sarvāstveva vikṛtiṣu yat prākṛtāṅgamadhye na paṭhitaṃ, tat aklaptopakāratvāt prākṛtairanāṅkṣīkṛte prakaraṇe paścādāgacchat saṃnidhi- viṣayo bhavati |
sa ca avirodhe viniyujyate, virodhe tu videnādivat prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate |
tasmāt kṛtsnadarśa- pūrṇamāsārthaṃ upavītaṃ iti siddham |
na cādvaityava- dhīyante pradhānāni kathaṃ cana |
(prābhākaroktamanūdya nirasyati —) ekadeśināṃ tu avāntaraprakaraṇābhāvāt, saṃnidheśca prakaraṇāt durbalatvāt asatyapi vicchede sāmidhenīnāṃ, darśapūrṇamāsāṅgamavupa-
anyathā smṛtimulabhūtaśruter- vijñātavedatvāt 'yadyavijñāte bhūmīvaḥsuvarilāhavanīye juhuyāt' ityetat prāpyeta |
iti prāpte, yacchabdaśrava- ṇāt pratyakṣavidhyābhāvāt vidhyantaraikavākyatvācca nāyaṃ vidhiḥ; api tu prāptātvāt tacchabdopakṣitoddeśyaviśeṣa- samarpakaḥ evetyanuvādaḥ |
' 6. upaveśaḥ darśādau palāśaśākhāyāḥ prādeśaparimitaṃ mūlabhāgaṃ chittvā kartavyaḥ |
vi. 4|2|3, upa- veṣaḥ na śālācchedaprayojakaḥ, kintu anuniṣpādī |
ataḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ upaveṣārthaṃ śākhācchedo na kāryaḥ |
paurṇamāsyāṃ vinā'pi śākhāparivāsanena yadeva aṅgārā- pohanākṣamaṃ dravyaṃ, sa eva upaveśaḥ |

'mūlataḥ śākhāṃ pari- vāsyopaveṣaṃ karoti' iti vākyāt śākhācchedanakāryatve- nāpi avagatasya upaveṣasya paurṇamāsyāṃ amāvāsyāyāmapi vā sānāyyarahitāyāṃ śālācchedanabhāve'pi siddhiḥ caturthe ( 4|2|18-9 ) sādhyiṣyate |
saṃkarṣa. 3|2|36. 'upaveṣeṇa kapālānyu- paddhāti' ityasya saṃnayadviṣayatayā saṃkocaḥ |
upaveṣaṇāmakena kāṣṭhaviśeṣeṇa prathamaṃ aṅgāraviśeṣaṃ samyagavasthāpya 'dhruvamasi' iti mantreṇa tasminddhāre puroḍāśapālamupaddhāti |
yathā- 'upaveṣeṇa kapālānyupaddhāti' iti yadā upaveṣastadā teneti gamyate, yadā upaveṣo nāsti tadā'pi upadhānamastyeveti |
evaṃ yadā dvipuroḍāśayāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ antarālaṃ, tadā upāṃśuyāja- 'ntarāle syāt, yadā ekapuroḍāśāyāṃ nāntarālaṃ, tadā'pi upāṃśuyājaḥ syādeveti |
śākhāyāṃ tatpradhānatvādupaveṣeṇa vibhāgaḥ syād vaiṣamyaṃ tat |
bhāṣyam - darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ samāmnāyate, 'mūlataḥ śākhāṃ parivāsyopaveṣaṃ karoti' iti |
tatrāyamarthaḥ sāṃśayikaḥ kiṃ śālācchedanasya ubhayaṃ prayojakaṃ śākhā upaveṣaśca, uta śākhā prayojikā, upaveṣo'nuniṣpā- dīti |
kiṃ prāptam ? ubhayaṃ chedanānniṣpanne śākhā śākhāmūlaṃ ca, ubhayaṃ ca prayojanavat |
agreṇa vatsāpā- karaṇādi kariṣyate, mūlataḥ upaveṣaḥ |
kasādevamabhisaṃbandho na bhavati, śālāṃ parivāsya mūlata upaveṣaṃ karotīti |
atha saṃnihitena saṃbadhyate, tathāpi śākhā- prayuktyena ityapyatati |
kathaṃ, 'mūlataḥ śākhāṃ parivāsyopaveṣaṃ karoti' iti parivāsyateḥ pradhānabhūtā śākhā, dvitīyāsaṃyogāt |
upaveṣamiti yā dvitīyā, sā karoteḥ, na parivāsyateḥ |
upaveṣe karoteḥ karmatayā pratīyamāne, itarat ( mūlaṃ ) upaveṣaṃ nirvartayati |
yathā 'svaraṃ karoti' iti pūrvapakṣe joṣaṇādīnāṃ prakṛtānāṃ grahaṇamuktam |
tatra kāraṇāntareṇa ( yūpaśabdasya lakṣaṇaprasaṅgena ) kharorbhāvānāṃ nidhiyopādānāyaiḥ karotirityuktam |
svākyoccāritena yūpaśabdena yā itikartavyatā lakṣyate, sā vākyenaiva svarūpasambandhinītyevaṃ pūrvapakṣastatra ( śaṅkitaḥ ) |
iha svākyocce nāsti yūpa- sthānīyaṃ padaṃ, yat itikartavyatāṃ lakṣayet |
( katham ? ) mulādhikaraṇena chedanena śākhāṃ niṣpādya anyadapi ( kriyā'ntaraṃ ) karotītye- tadadramyate |
upaveṣasya svākyocce chenādikāyā itikartavyatāyā aśravaṇāt prakṛtā syāt |
athānyena prayuktaṃ mūlaṃ gṛhyate, tathā sati parakīyatvādaprayojakam |
bhāṣyam - 'śākhyā vatsānapākaroti', 'śākhyā gāḥ prāpayati', 'śākhyā dohayati' ityemādiṣu śākhāgraheṣu nopaveṣasya vyāpāraḥ, tataḥ śākhāśabdo- 'paiti |
kimato yathaivaṃ ? yatra śākhāśabdaḥ tadarthaṃ chedanaṃ, dvitīyānirdiśyate |
athāpi mūle śākhāśabdo bhavet, evamapi śākhāśabdo- padiṣṭeṣu na mūlaṃ, amūlaparivāsitatvāt |
yaccaivaṃ saṃskṛtayā śākhyā kriyate, tadarthaṃ chedanam |
kiṃ bhavati prayojanam ? paurṇamāsyāmapi śākhā utādyā, yathā pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
ṭup - yadyapi mūlaṃ śākhāśabdenocyate, tathāpi mūlaparivāsanena saṃskṛtā śākhā kāryayogyā |
chedanādi ca śākhā'thaiṃ dvayaṃ tasmāt prayojakam |
soma - - prācyā diśaḥ kevalaśākhāprayojyatve'pi chenādanāṃ na kevalayojyatvaṃ, kintu mūlamagramapyathaiṃ iti pratyavasthānāt prayudāharaṇasaṃgatiḥ |
yadyapi mūlāgocaro vicāraḥ pravartanīyaḥ, tathāpi mūlāprayukteḥ tarkakalpanāpāleāpanādiprayuktiparyavasānāt tadgocara eva sa pravartitaḥ |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe upaveṣanāśe punaḥ śākhā āhartavyā, paurṇamāsyāmapi ca śākhā āhartavyā |
siddhānte tu ubhayatrāpi na śākhā āhartavyā |
tataśca tatropaveṣā- bhāvāt yenakenacit kāṣṭhena kapālopadhānam |
sūtrārthastu- śākhāyāṃ śākhāpradhāne 'mūlataḥ śākhā parivāsya' iti vākye upaveṣeṇa parivāsanasya vibhāgaḥ asaṃbandhaḥ syāt |
dvitīyāyā śākhāyāḥ karotikriyā'pekṣatvena śākhā'thaibhyā- dupaveṣasya iti |
vi - - 'śākhāṃ chittvopaveṣaṃ ca mūle kurvanti śākhayā |
dvayaṃ prayo- jakaṃ chittvaivāpākṛtyaiva vā, āyo'mūlāgrotra vibhajya viniyogataḥ |
prāyaścittasiddhayarthaṃ idamapi darśapūrṇamāsāṅgatvena ‘upabhya- yate’ ityanena vidhīyate’ ityapi ke cit (śāstra- dīpikāprakāśakāradayaḥ) |
nīvītādisamabhivyāhārasya ubhayatra pratyabhijñāpakasya tulyatvāt vāsovinyāsaḥ evātra niyamyate iti yuktamupapadyatām |
sarvathā ‘upapadyate’ iti vidhiḥ darśapūrṇamāsavidhivahitatvāt tattāvaka- svānupapatteḥ iti siddham |
) yāvajjīva- vākyena agnihotre jīvanasya nimittatvāvagama'pi vacane- naiva dāhāvadhi sāyaṃ prātaḥkāle maraṇottaraṃ nityatvena vihitāgnihotraprayogo mṛtāgnihotram |
(sāyaṃhomottaraṃ yajamānamaraṇe śarīradāhāt prāk tadīyaḥ prātarhomaḥ adhvaryuṇā kartavyo bhavati |
tadidaṃ mṛtāgnihotraṃ nāma iti tu kevalaḥ |
tasmin mṛtāgnihotre ‘prācīnāvītī dohayet yajñopavītī hi devebhyo dohayati’ ityanena śrutena daivāgnihotre hi yajñopavītasya vidhiranuvādo vā iti cintā- yām |
svarūpeṇa prāptasyāpi brahmasūtrasya śrautaprāyaścitta- prāptiphalakatvā vidhiḥ; vāsovinyāsaparūpaśca vā niyamyārthe vidhiḥ |

iti prāpte, sthitaṃ tāvadaparyavasitaṃ, madhye cintā'ntarārambhaḥ- sthitatvāduttaram = (‘sato vā liṅgadarśanam’ ?) hiṃsradoṣapañcaka vidhivattatraikavākyatvācca ayampi nīvītādivat prācīnāvītastutyarthaḥ |
ata eva ‘upapadyate’ itivat ānarthakyābhāvādapi vidhikalpanaṃ nirastam |
yajñopavītapadavācyabrahmasūtrasya ca smṛtyaiva jīva- dagnihotre prāptatvāt aucityādinā stutyupapattiḥ |
vāso- vinyāsasyarūpasyāpi vā aniyamena uktavidhayā jīvadagnihotre prāptatvāt stutyupapattiḥ |
yadi tu niyamena tatprāptiḥ stutau āvaśyakyapekṣyeta, tataḥ sannikṛṣṭāsaṃbhavāt viprakṛṣṭadarśapūrṇamāsādisthasyaiva ayamanuvādaḥ stutyarthe nānupapannaḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 159. upa-śabdasya ‘upadhike ca’ iti cakāreṇa lakṣaṇasyāsyāpi karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvyākhyānam |
upaśayaḥ: nāma yūpaviśeṣaḥ: yūpaikādaśinyāṃ ekā- daśaḥ |
tatra parivyāṇādisaṃskārābhāve'pi amantrakāḥ chedanādayaḥ: ke chidrarmāḥ vācannikā vicinte |
rahasya. pṛ. 152. upaśleṣalakṣaṇa suvantatiṅantādyekapadasvarūpā vini- yoktrī śrutiḥ |
tatra suvantām ekaikapadarūpā ekapratyayarūpā va viniyoktrī krameṇa bādhyavādhakābhāve ukte yathā ‘ tathā yasyaikamekaṃ padaśrutyā pratīyate |
( vā. 3|3| 7|4 pṛ. 840 ) bāla. pṛ. 41, 42. upasaṃjñeyanimittamapi utsargaṃ bādhate |
pṛ. 249, pari. 65. ‘prakalpya cāpavādaviṣayaṃ tata utsargo'bhini- viśate’ ityetanmūlamidaṃ navīnāḥ paṭhanti |
anena nyāyena ‘ato'm’ ityasya viṣaye luk: apravṛttiḥ |
bhūtiḥ pṛ. 201. upasaṃhāraḥ asaṃjātavirodhitvena prabalaprakramamanu- sṛtya netavyaḥ |
upasaṃhāraḥ upakramānu- rodhena balāt lakṣaṇā''dikaṃ pratipadyate |
tantrama viśeṣavacanena upasaṃhriyate, yat ṛtusaṃyogā- yāsāmarthye kathaṃcit parokṣaśrutyā saṃjujyate yathā sāt-
su. pṛ. 8. upasaṃhāraḥ na ka cit darvihome ‘pṛthivyai svāhā’ ityādī svāhākārapunaḥśrava- ṇasya ‘vaṣaṭkāreṇa svāhākāreṇa vā devebhyo''jñāyaṃ pradīyate’ ityanārabhyādhītasvāhākāreṇa |
‘sasadṛśa sāmi- dhenīranubrūyāt’ iti anārabhyavidheḥ vaiguṇyādiṣu sāmi- dhenīvidhinā upasaṃhāraḥ ‘yat sāmadaśaṃ tat vaiguṇyādiṣu’ iti |
’ ( vā. pṛ. 977. ) anārabhya- vidhiḥ : sāmānyavidhiḥ, mitravindā''diprakaraṇastha viśeṣavidhiḥ |
parākramaḥ: 81. upa- saṃhāre hi sāmānye prāptaśca viśeṣe saṃkoco bhavati |

yathā ‘puroḍāśaṃ caturdhā karoti’ iti puroḍāśasāmānye prāptaṃ caturdhākaraṇaṃ ‘āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti’ ityāgneye saṃkocyate iti cet ( nyāyasudhākāroktaṃ parihāramāha- ) tanmātrasaṃkocārthatvāt upasaṃhārasya |
( taddūṣaṇāya saṃpradāyamatamāha- ) anye tu upasaṃhāro nāma sāmānyataḥ prāptasya viśeṣe saṃkocanarūpo -nyāyārūpo vidheḥ |
tanmātrasaṃkocaḥ iti ko'rthaḥ ? 1 āgneyāne saṃkoco vā, sāmānyāprāptasya viśeṣamāne saṃkoco vā ? |
ādye anā- rabhyādhītatadadasya mitravindā''diprakaraṇasthena vākyena upasaṃhāro na syāt, āgneye saṃkocābhāvāt |
dvitīye caturdhākaraṇaṃ puroḍāśamāne prāptasya āgneye saṃkocatvat anuyājānuyājāsādhāraṇyena prāptasya anuyājeṣu saṃkocāt upasaṃhāraḥ syādeva ( tasmānna tat ) |
mīmāṃsā. pṛ. 456-57. upasaṃhāraprābalyena dahrakādyo brahma iti na nirṇayaḥ, kiṃtu bahunugrahanyāyena |
parākramaḥ: 571, upasaṃhāraprābalyena nirākāṅkṣasya vidheḥ saṃyogo na yuktaḥ |
idaṃ sarvaṃ sodāharaṇaṃ ‘vidhirdvividhaḥ?’ iti mahati praṣṭavye bāla-granthe draṣṭavyam |
upasaṃhārasthaṃ upakramasthena bādhyate yathā ‘uccai- rṛcā’ iti ṛgādipadaṃ vedopakramena |
āgneyasyaiva puroḍāśasya caturthākaraṇaṃ, nāgnīpomīyādeḥ !! śeṣastu guṇasaṃyuktaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ pratīyeta, mitha- stepāmsaṃbandhāt |
bhāṣyam- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sāmānyate ‘āgneyaṃ caturthā karoti’ iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ āgneye agnīpomīye ca aindre ca ( iti ) sarvatra caturthākaraṇaṃ, kiṃvā āgneye eveti |
kiṃ prāptam ? caturthākaraṇaṃ, āgneyamiti devatāguṇasaṃyuktaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ pratīyate |
yasya agnirdevatā anyacca bhavati, asau āgneyaḥ |
tathayā-vā ḍitthasya ḍitthasya ca mātā, sā ḍitthasya bhavati, evamihāpi |
yadi āgneyasya agnīpomīyasya ca puroḍāśasya mithaḥ saṃbandho na bhavet, tataḥ āgneye eva caturthākaraṇaṃ vyavatiṣṭheta |
yathā ‘āgneyasya mastakaṃ vibhajya prāptimava- dyati’ iti sarvebhyaḥ prāśitāvādanaṃ, evaṃ caturthākaraṇamapi |
sa tu saṃyogaḥ kiṃ ekedeśenāpi bhavati, uta samastaineva iti vicāraḥ |
kiṃ caturthākaraṇavidhī āgneyaśabdena dvidevatyo gṛhyate, na veti |
’ yadyapi agniḥ adevatā, na tu asamavetaḥ |
na ca upa- lakṣaṇāni yathāśrutāneva upāṃśuyājāntarālakālalakṣaṇārtha- puroḍāśadvayavat kāryeṣu āśrīyante |
' (pālnīyataśabdeṣu paśya- lakṣaṇārthatvāt tenaiva upalabdhatvena hetunā tadhuratadāraḥ) |
bhāṣyakāreṇa tu etadeva ( ānantaryamacodanā 3|1|24 iti sūtrasthaṃ acodanāpadam ) anuṣajyokam ' miyaste- pāmasaṃbandhāccodanā syāt ' iti |
bhavati ca evaṃvidhānāṃ sādhāraṇatvaṃ tathā ca prāśitre hṛdyate iti (prāśitrāva- dānarūpaḥ śeṣaḥ agniguṇasaṃyukto'pi sādhāraṇaḥ ) |
vyavasthita vā caturthakaraṇamāgneya eva, na sādhāraṇaṃ bhavitumarhati |
agninā devatayā arthena e- devatyasya saṃyogaḥ, na dvidevatyasya agnīṣomīyasya aindrā- sya ceti |
kutaḥ ? yasya hi agnīṣomau devatā, ubhaya- viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ saṃkalpaḥ kriyate |
tasya agniḥ soma- mapekṣamāṇo devatā, na nirapekṣaḥ |
yasya cāgniḥ soma- mapekṣamāṇo devatā, na tasmāt taddhita utpadyate |
devatāliṅgasya hi sāmarthyena saṃyogo bhavati taddhitārthasya, nāsati sāmarthye |
atha yadyuktaṃ yathā prāśitrāvadānaṃ sarvairbhāḥ kriyate evaṃ caturthakaraṇamapīti |
na tatraivaṃ saṃbandhaḥ kriyate, āgneyasya prāśitra- mavadīyata |
ekaṃ chetadākhyaṃ ' prāśitramavadyati ' iti dvitīyaṃ ' āgneyasya mastakaṃ vibhajya ' iti |
yadi tu tatra kevalāgnirdevatyo nāmaviṣyat , tadā ānarthakyaparihārāya dvidevatyo'pyagrahīṣyata |
tato jāto ditsyaḥ, etāvatā saṃbandhena mātetyucyate |
sa ca tāvāṃstatra saṃbandho'stīti ditsyasya māteti yuktaṃ vacanam |
vā - ' yathaiva hi prahatvena camasā nopa- lakṣitāḥ |
āgneyatvaṃ tathā na syād dvidevatyopa- lakṣaṇam ||
yāṃ codiya dravyaṃ tyajyate sā devatā |
nāmnīṣomīya āgneya aindrāgno vā tadu- cyate ||
taddhitādyo'tra liṅgaṃ hi samarthānāṃ ca taddhitaḥ |
tenāyaṃ taddhitaḥ nāmnīṣomīyāditānniṣṭhāt ucyate iti na tadarthasya devatvamāha |
yatra tu asau nirapekṣo devatā, sa śakya āgneya iti vaktum |
sāmānyavākyena sarvatra prāśitrāvadāne prāpte mastakaviroga- viśeṣavidhānārthe etadacchanaṃ iti vaiṣamyam |
' ' taṃ caturdhā kṛtvā puroḍāśaṃ barhiṣadaṃ karoti ' iti |
viśeṣe sthāpyate sā tu nityaṃ śāstrāntarīyayā ||
' mastakaṃ vibhajya ' iti guṇaparatvāt aśakyaḥ sāmānyavidhirupa- saṃhartum |
idaṃ tu nirguṇaṃ punarvanaṃ śaknoti sāmānyaṃ svaviṣaye sthāpayitum |
dūrasthatvāt aśakyaḥ asyopasaṃhāra iti cenna, ' yasya yenārthasaṃbandhaḥ - ' ( dūrasthenāpi tasya saḥ |
tena ' avaśyameva sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaṃ prati gacchati |
gatamātraṃ ca tat tena viśeṣe sthāpyate dhruvam ||
ayamapi prāptaṃ, tataḥ kramādyai śravaṇamiti vaktavyam |
' yadi tu tatra kevalāgnirdevatyo nābhaviṣyat ' iti (bhāṣyaṃ) ' lakṣaṇārthā guṇaśrutiḥ ' ityetasyaiva (sūtrāvayavasya 3|1|25) vyākhyā |
kevaladevatābhāve hi manotāyāmivā agni- śabdaḥ ubhau lakṣyet |
asti tu ekadevatyaḥ, tasmāt tasyaiva caturthakaraṇam |
yadyapi ca upalakṣaṇaṃ kāryayogi na bhavati, tathāpi tenānupalakṣitaṃ na śakyaṃ grahītuṃ iti ekadevatyasyaiva grahaṇaṃ iti siddham |
śā - ' agniḥ saṃbandhamātreṇa bhaved dravyopa- lakṣaṇam ||
' iti prāpte, brūmaḥ ' kevalāhetavāvācī taddhito'sme : samuccayan |
' soma-- vyavasthāsaṃyogaṃ vyavasthāprasaṅgagataṃ samāpya idānīṃ saṃyoga eva kimekadeśena, uta samastana iti vicāryate iti saṃgatiḥ |
yadyapi viśeṣavacanamātreṇa na sāmānyavacanapātopasaṃhāraphalaṃ, tathātve ' na brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt ' iti sāmānyavacanasyānyā ' nātreyaṃ hanyāt ' itiviśeṣavacanena upasaṃhāraprasaṅgāt |
kiṃtu yatra sāmānya- vacanānujñāyā viśeṣapekṣā, tatra viśeṣe upasaṃhāraḥ |

prakṛte ca caturthakaraṇasya pratipattirūpatayā sarvapikṣitatvena sāmānyavacanasya puroḍāśamātre caturthakaraṇānuṣṭhāpakatvopa- pattyā anuṣṭhānāya viśeṣapekṣāvirāhat nopasaṃhārakalpaṃ viśeṣavacanasya saṃbhavati, tathāpīha sāmānyavacanaṃ na caturthakaraṇavidhāyakaṃ, kiṃtu lāghavāt barhiṣadatvamātrasya kramasya vā vidhāyakam |
tataḥ caturthakaraṇārthe anuvādā- katvāt tasya prāptāgneyavacanānusāreṇa viśeṣaviṣayatvaṃ paryavasyati |
sūtrārthastu - anyopalakṣakatā guṇabhūtāyi- saṃyuktaḥ śeṣaḥ agnīṣomīyādisādhāraṇaḥ pratīyate, upa- lakṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ ca parasparamasaṃbhavāditi |
vi-- ' caturthaṃ kāryaṃ āgneyaḥ puroḍāśa itīritam |
' bhāṭṭa - darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ' āgneyaṃ caturthaṃ karoti ' ityatra nāgnidevatākatvahaviṣyaṃ uddeśyatāvacchedakaṃ, viśiṣṭo- deśye vākyamedāpatteḥ |
athavā ' puroḍāśaṃ caturthaṃ karoti ' ityanena upasaṃhārāt agnirsaṃbandhapruroḍāśasyaiva tat, na tu ājyasyeti |
astu vā etadvyavasthāpi kathaṃ- cidvikṣā, tathāpi dvidevatye'pi agneḥ asyaiva devatā- tvam |
iti prāpte, prajurūpayogāt taddhitasya devatātve eva śaktasya saṃbandhamātralakṣatvā- nupapatteḥ |
na ca devatātvaṃ dvidevatye pratyekaṃmṛti, itaretarayogarūpacārtha- vihitadvaṃdvena sāhityasya vivakṣitatvāt sahitayoreva vyāsajyavṛttatvopādhirūpadevatātvāṅgīkārāt |
ata eva dvaṃdvānte ityādipravādāt yatra uddeśyatvena sāhityavivakṣā, tatra iti dhyeyam |
ataḥ kevalāgnipadāt utpannastaddhitaḥ : nāmyāsāpekṣya devatātvaṃ abhipretārthaṃ kṣamaḥ |
tathatve na tāvat prakṛtadravyamātraṃ apūrvasādhanalakṣakaṃ, tasya devatātvaditvena anukteḥ |
nāpi haviṣyaṃ, taparatvasya devatātvātpratīti vinā anupapatteḥ |
nahi ' haviṣye vācye devatātvaṃ eva ' iti smṛtyā niyamyate, tadācitte'pi saṃbandhasāmānye taddhitasya sattvāt |
tasya tu anuyogipratiyogiāpekṣatvāt havirārtinyāyena ' ardhamantarvedi ' itivat agnirdevatākatveṣṭasyaiva lakṣaṇayā
tena ca 'puroḍāśaṃ caturthī karoti' iti sāmānyavacanasya upasaṃhāraḥ |
sāmānyavidheḥ viśeṣaparkīrtane sati sātadaśyavat tadupasaṃhāro nyāyyaḥ |
anaārambhā- dhītasya sātadaśyasya viśeṣopasaṃhāraḥ na viśeṣasaṃkīrtana- mātrāt, kiṃtu aspaṣṭatvāt |

tathāvat sāmidhenīdvārā sarvavikṛtyarthatvaṃ kalpayitumupakramapyate, tāvadeva mitra- vindā''diṣu prākaraṇikena vākyena ṛtuviśeṣasaṃyakte kṣīṇā arthāpattiḥ na ṛtvantarasaṃbandhaṃ kalpayati, iti aspaṣṭakṛtasaṃbandhatvāt sātadaśyopasaṃhāraḥ |
(anena granthena 'sāmānyavidhiraspaṣṭaḥ saṃhiyeta viśeṣataḥ' iti upasaṃhāranyāyasvarūpaṃ vivṛtam) ; parākramaḥ. 371-2. upasaṃhāranyāyasya svarūpaṃ 'sāmānyavidhiraspaṣṭaḥ saṃhiyeta viśeṣataḥ' iti |
asyāpavādastu, 'spaṣṭasya tu vidhernānyai- rupasaṃhārakalpanā' iti (uttarārddhakaḥ) nyāyaḥ |
su. pṛ. 787. upasat pūrvāparāhābhyoḥ abhyasyamānaṃ āgneyasaumyavaiṣṇavayāgatrayamekā upasat |
tathāvidhānaṃ tisraṇāṃ upasadāṃ jyotiṣṭome vihitānāṃ avayavabhūtā pratyekaṃ ādau āgneyī upasat 'abhimanikaṃ' iti vākyena vihitā |
ke. upasat : dvādaśa ahīne dvādaśāhe ca, tisro jyotiṣṭomādau ekāhe, ṣaṭ agnicayane |
ke. upasat : 'dvābhyāṃ lomā- vadyati' ityāramya dvādaśopasattvaṃ dvādaśāhikaṃ dharmaṃ gavāmayane darśayati |
bhā. 8|1|17-19. upasat : vi. 4|2|13, upasadaḥ nāma jyotiṣṭomādī dīkṣā- divasadvaye somabhivadisatpūrva kartavyamā homāḥ |
tatra codakaprāptānāṃ tisṛṇāmupasadāṃ svasthānaviddhatvā ṣaṭtvaṃ saṃpādanīyam |
tathā ca prathamā + prathamā, dvitīyā + dvitīyā, tṛtīyā + tṛtīyā iti ṣaṭtvam |
na tu prathamā + dvitīyā + tṛtīyā, punaḥ prathamā + dvitīyā + tṛtīyā, iti ṣaṭtvam |
su. pṛ. 690. upasadāṃ dīkṣāṇāṃ ca svasthānaviddhyā prayogo dvādaśāhe |
ṭupū. 1|14| 5|18. upasadāṃ dvādaśāhe tantreṇānuṣṭhāne dvādaśanā- mahā sahaprayogavidhānāt |
vi. 9|1|9. upasadāṃ purastāt saumyaḥ, antarā khāṭḥ, upariṣṭādaiṣaḥ paśuḥ kartavyaḥ |
bhā. 4|4|15-6, upasadāṃ ṣaṭsaṃkhyā sarvasaṃpradā na tu pratyekaṃ, cayane |
5|3|11-2. upasatsu abhīṣṭomīye paśau ātithyāyāṃ ca ekameva barhiḥ |
tenaiva saṃskāreṇa upasatsu abhīṣṭomīye ca prasaṅgasiddhiḥ |
vi. 1|2|1|9. upasatsu ātithyāyāṃ abhīṣṭomīye ca barhiḥ : saramantraḥ abhyāvarttate deśapṛthaktatvāt |
bhā. 1|2|1|20|44. upasatsu ātithyā'nte ca (pañca- daśarātre) yā subrahmaṇyā kriyate, tasyāṃ yathādevatemeva tantrabhedaḥ, nāsti tantrocāraṇam |
bhā. 9|1|12-3 varṇakaṃ 2, upasatsu gṛhamedhīye ca vaidikī evetikartavyatā |
tāsu upasatsu upasatkaraṇe yāvat uktaṃ tāvadeva kartavyam |
asau hi prākṛta eva apūrvaguṇaśūnyaḥ śrutaḥ |
tathā ca suveṇa kartavyasyādhārasya aguṇatvāt prākṛtasyaiva śrutatvāt tena sauveṇa ādhāreṇa prākṛtasya śeṣasya prathamādhāra- bhinnasya sarvasyājñātasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt |
tasmāt prathamādhārabhinnaṃ kiṃ cihna kartavyaṃ iti pakṣāntaram |
'nānyamāhutiṃ juhuyāt' iti upasatpradhāna- homāt prāk homasāmānyaṃ pratiṣidhya 'suveṇāghārayati' iti sauvasyādhārasya pratiprasavāt |
tataśca apratiṣiddhaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ prayājādi varjayitvā anyat sarvaṃ prākṛtaṃ kartavyam |
'nānya- māhutiṃ juhuyāt, suveṇāghārayati' iti nāyaṃ prati- ṣidhya pratiprasavaḥ |
mukhyāyā eva somasya viśeṣa devatāyāḥ agneḥ prāk abhījyatvābhāve hi anenoktaḥ |
'nānyamāhutiṃ purastāt' āgneyyā āhuteḥ prāk 'juhuyāt agniṃ' ityevamabhidhānāt |
tasmāt śeṣasya sautrādhārabhinnasya prākṛtasya anijyā na ijyā yāgatvābhāvaḥ |
tasmāt upasadaḥ apūrve karma, yāvaduktaṃ kartavyaṃ ityeva siddhāntaḥ |

ke. upasatsu homamantrāḥ 'yā te agne'yāśayā tanurvarṣiṣṭhā gahareṣṭhā ugraṃ vanno apāvadhīt (dhīṃ) tveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhīt (dhīṃ) svāhā' 'yā te agne rajā- śayā (tanu0) ' 'yā te agne harāśayā (tanu0)' ityāmnātāḥ |
tatra prathamamantraḥ 'tanurvarṣiṣṭhāḥ' ityādiḥ antimo bhāgaḥ dvitīye tṛtīye cāpi mantre anuṣajanīyaḥ |
bhā. 1|1|3|123, upasatkālīnaṃ subrahmaṇyā''hvānaṃ hrāne 'caturahe sutyāmāgaccha' ityatra caturdaśāhe āgaccha, trayodaśāhe āgaccha, ityādirūpeṇa sutyāhāni nopalakṣayitavyāni, avikāreṇa prayogaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|26, upasaddineṣveva agnihotrasya, na tu pūrvam |
vi. 9|1|2 varṇakaṃ 2. upasadviddhau svasthānaviddhyā adhikasaṃkhyā- pūraṇam |
bhā. 5|3|13. upasatsthānaviddhyāyena (5|3|13) prayājānāmekādaśasiddhaye svasthānaviddhau uttamaḥ prayājakhibhyasanīyaḥ |
tatra saṃśayaḥ : kiṃ yāvat pratiṣiddhaṃ tāvat kartavyaṃ anyat sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ, atha kiṃ yāvaduktapidaṃ tāvat kartavyaṃ anyat sarvaṃ na kartavyaṃ, athavā apūrvā upasad : iti |
'aprayājāstā anunayājāḥ' iti prayājanuyājānāṃ pratiṣedhaṃ kṛtvā kṛtārthaḥ śabdaḥ avaśiṣṭān codakaprāptāna na vārayati |
bhāṣyam - na caitadasti, pratiṣiddhaṃ varjayitvā sarvaṃ kartavyamiti |
aviśiṣṭo hi asau sauva ādhāraḥ punarākhyāyate |
na tatra kaścid guṇo viśiṣṭaḥ śrūyate |
bhāṣyam - na caitadasti yāvaduktaṃ kartavyaṃ avaśiṣṭaṃ neti |
kiṃ tarhi ? sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ varjayitveti |
evaṃ pratiṣedhaṃ kṛtvā kṛtārthaḥ śabdo nānyasya bādhako bhavitumarhati |
na ca ghaṭapadasya ghaṭabhinne lakṣaṇayā bhūtalena anvayo'stu iti vācyam |
anye tu dhātau śaktilakṣaṇayoḥ upasarga-samabhivyāhāratadbhāvahetukatvavat, upasargāṇāṃ dyotakatva-śakteśca kalpanāyāṃ gauravāt vācakatvaiva yuktā |
evaṃ ca evakārādau anyayogavyavacchedayogavyavacchedayoḥ, iva-kārādau sādṛśyadīnāṃ ca śaktipradarśanamupapannam |
ata eva 'atra hyevāvapanti, ata evodvapanti' iti vaidika-prayogasya 'tatraivāyāti' 'ita evābhivartate' iti laukikaprayogasya copapattiḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 169-160. ✱ upasargārthasattā dhātvarthasattāyāḥ pratyayārthena arthaviprakarṣāt durbalā |
kadā cit niśrāte puruṣe daṇḍaguṇavidhānārthamucyate 'daṇḍī premānvāha' iti |
evamihāpi (aruṇayā ityatra) yadi upasarjanabhūtaḥ aruṇo guṇaḥ, pradhānabhūtaṃ kārakaṃ, tathā anudite kāraṇe aruṇaguṇavidhānārthe vacanaṃ yujyate |
'prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanaṃ' iti yeyaṃ ekadeśasya upasarjanasaṃjñā, sā pūrvanipātamātra-siddhayarthā 'upasarjanaṃ pūrve' iti, na punaḥ upasarjana-tvena padāntarāsaṃjñārthā |
ṛ.pṛ. 71. ✱ upa-sarjanaṃ yadyapi karmādyaiḥ, tathāpi viśeṣaṇena saṃbadhyate |
vākyasthaṃ tu 'ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' itivat saṃbadhyamānaṃ dṛṣṭam |
vā. 3|4|14|3 pṛ. 938. ✱ upasarjanaṃ vṛttisthaṃ na padāntareṇa saṃbadhyate |
ratnākara. pṛ. 346. ✱ na upa-sarjanena abhibhūtasyārthavṛtti viśeṣaṇāntareḥ saṃyujyate |
‘ taddhitārthe ca vṛttasya (indraśabdasya) vṛddhiḥ syādu-ttare pade (mahendrapade) |
’ mahendra iti syāt, na cendraviśeṣaṇaṃ mahattvaṃ (syāt) |
vā. 2|1|1|16 pṛ. 419. ✱ nahi upasarjanaṃ pada padāntareṇa saṃbadhyate rājapuruṣavat |
su. pṛ. 1378. ✱ upa-sarjanatvaṃ artho'pi prathamāvagatamantrārūḍho netaraṃ gṛhṇāti svaprādhānye ca saṃbhavati na paropasarjanatvaṃ pratipadyate |
su. pṛ. 1422, ✱ upasarjanatvasya saṃbandhaṃ vinā asiddhiḥ |
pṛ. 828. ✱ upasādanaṃ vedastaraprayogasya barhiṣaḥ lavane prayojanam |
mā. 1|1|4|147. ✱ upastaraṇaṃ abhighāraṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇaleṣu na kartavyam |
mā. 10|2|13-12. ✱ upastaraṇaṃ iḍāpātre kriyamāṇaṃ iḍāyāḥ saṃskāraḥ eva |

taddiṣṭahomadhividhiḥ dvaidhaṃvidhaḥ ityatra saṃkhyāmātravidhiḥ iti pakṣe ca lāghavagauravakṛtaviśeṣābhāvāt dvaidhaṃvidhaḥ ityasya saṃkhyāviśiṣṭāvadānavidhāyakatve'pi svātantryeṇa avadānavidhau adṛṣṭārthatvāpatyā dṛṣṭārthatayā pradānopakrama- tathaiva avadānasya vidheyatayā pañcamoktapradānāntānu- samayasya upapannatvāt; caturavattavākyasya avattaviśiṣṭa- homavidhāyakatve catuḥsaṃkhyāyāḥ vidhnasvīkāreṇa haviṣo caturavadānāprasaktatayā etadvikaraṇapratipādyasya haviṣo nityaṃ dviravadānasya siddheśca pakṣadvayamapi vārtikakārasya saṃmatam|
sūtrārthastu- puroḍāśotpatterhomārthatvāt pradhānasya puroḍāśasya caturavadānaṃ, homasaṃyogena hotavyasya caturava- dānapratīteḥ|
ājyaṃ tu puroḍāśena atulyatvādhikaṃ iti nopastaraṇābhighāraṇābhyāṃ saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ, taducyateḥ saṃskārārtha- tayā guṇabhūtatvāt|
na caivaṃ saṃkhyādhikyaṃ loke pṛthagbhūta devadatta ityadau guṇena supādinā ādhikyadarśanā
śatakṛṣṇalacarau ājyena upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe na kartavye iti siddhānte ‘catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati catura- vatsyāpya’ ityātivacanaṃ sādhakatayā upanyastam |
caturavat caturbhiḥ kṛṣṇalaiḥ sidhyati iti tadarthaḥ |
punaśca upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe kartavye iti pūrvapakṣamupanyasya ātivacanasya gatimāha pūrvapakṣī |
ātivacanaṃ saṃkhyāsamānatvāt saṃkhyayā samāna- tvāt tulyatvāt upapadyate |
avadāne catuḥsaṃkhyā kṛṣṇale- ṣvapi catuḥsaṃkhyā iti ubhayatra saṃkhyayā samānatvam |
tuśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣiṇā ātivacanasya catuḥsaṃkhyāstuti- paratvaṃ yaduktaṃ tat vyāvarttayati siddhāntī |
satoḥ vidya- mānayoḥ upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayoḥ stutyarthamātivacanaṃ vyarthe syāt |
yadi avidyamānamāpadyati iti ātiḥ ityucyate tato guṇa- vān iti stutirbhavet |
tasmāt satoḥ upastaraṇāmidhāra- ṇayoḥ āsivacanaṃ vyartham |

śatakṛṣṇale carau ‘catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati catura- vatsyāpya’ iti ātivacanāt liṅgāt upastaraṇā- midhāraṇayornivṛttiḥ yathā gamyate, tathā ekāvadānatvāt ‘catvāri kṛṣṇalāni ekamavadānaṃ’ iti ekāvadānavacanāt liṅgāt upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayoḥ anivṛttirgamyate |
caturbhiḥ kṛṣṇalaiḥ ekaṃ mukhyamavadānaṃ caturavatsyāpya tu upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayoḥ kartavyatā iti |
evaṃ ca sati liṅgadvayavirodhaḥ prātaḥ, tasmāt upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayoḥ vikalpaḥ syāt na tu ekānte nivṛttiḥ |
tuśabdaḥ vailakṣaṇyarthaḥ vikalpastu kadā cit syāt iti |
pūrvasūtre vikalpaṃ doṣamabhidhāya punaḥ pūrvapakṣī svapakṣaṃ sādhayati |

‘catvāri kṛṣṇalānyekamavadānaṃ’ ityukte sakṛdevāvadāne sarvavikāre sarvasya caturavattasya vikāre sati, caturavatta sthāne caturbhiḥ kṛṣṇalaiḥ sakṛdevāvadāne sati, hi yasmāt ita- rasya haviṣaḥ punaśrutibhiḥ kṛṣṇalaiḥ dvitīyāvadānasya yo'- bhyāsaḥ : ‘catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati samṛddhayai’ iti, tathyānarthakyaṃ syāt |
evaṃ ca abhyāsāt caturbhiśścaturbhiḥ kṛṣṇalaiḥ dviravadānaṃ upastaraṇaṃ vāmidhāraṇaṃ ceti caturavattasiddhiḥ |
śatakṛṣṇalacarau upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe kartavye na vā iti vicāre pravartamāne ‘catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati’ iti abhyāsaḥ dvitīyamavadānamapekṣya bhaviṣyati iti ukta- matanirāsārthaḥ |
abhyāsaṃ vinā'pi avadānadharmeṇa dvitīyāvadāna- syāpi siddhatvāt |
tasmāt upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe kartavye iti pūrvapakṣa eva |
tatra cāyamarthaḥ - tuśabdena vikalpaṃ nirasya pūrvapakṣī svapakṣaṃ sādhayati |
sarvavikāre sarvasya prākṛtasya dviravadānasya śatakṛṣṇalecaturāvadāne vikāre sati ‘catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇalānvyacati’ iti abhyāsasya ānarthakyaṃ syāt sarvavikārapakṣe dvitīyāvadānābhāvāt |
ānarthakyameva sādhayati, hi yasmāt sarvavikārapakṣe abhyāsaḥ itarasya dvitīyāvadānarūpasya haviṣaḥ kṛte syāt, apivā kiṃvā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ kṛte syāt |
kṛṣṇalādyekena avadānadvayaṃ upastaraṇāmidhāraṇārthaṃ ca dvayaṃ iti catura- vattasaṃpattiḥ |
akarma vā saṃsagārthe nivṛttatvāt tasmādāti- samarthatvam |
śatakṛṣṇale carau pracaraṇa- kāle upastaraṇāmidhāraṇayoḥ akarma na karma |
suvi puroḍāśādyava- yavānāṃ saṃsargaḥ śliṣṭatā mā bhūt iti upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe kriyate |
kṛṣṇalānāṃ tu tādṛśaḥ saṃsarga eva na saṃbhavati |
iti saṃsargasya arthasya nivṛttatvāt abhāvāt upastara- ṇādi na kartavyam |
evaṃ ca ‘catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇala- nyavacati caturavattasyāpya’ iti ātiḥ - ātivacanasya samarthatvaṃ samyagarthatvaṃ sidhyati |
kṛṣṇalacatuṣṭayasya dviravadānatvane tanmātreṇaiva upastaraṇā- midhāraṇe vinaiva caturavattasya siddhirbhavati iti |
tasmāt śatakṛṣṇale carau upastaraṇāmidhāraṇe na kartavye iti siddhāntaḥ |
upasthānaṃ āhavanīyasya gārhapatyāduddhṛtya svāya- tane sthāpayatyeva, na tu gārhapatyātsyaiva sata: |
saṃkarṣa. 3|2|8. upasthānaṃ āhavanīyasya vikṛtiviśeṣe (dvādaśāhe daśame'hani mānasatotrāt prāk ) praṇīta- yaiva ṛcā ‘ayaṃ sahasramānavaḥ’ ityanayā |
bhā. 9|2| 8|29-30 varṇakaṃ 2. upasthānaṃ nityaṃ upasthāpākapa- kṣama |
su. pṛ. 1202. upasthānaṃ yasya kriyate, tasya samīpe eva sthitvā tat kriyate nānyathā |
ṭupū. 7|2| 14|36. upasthānaṃ sadyovirdhānamaṇḍapayoḥ prakṛtyā aindyā vaiṣṇavyā ca krameṇa kartavyam |
vi. 3|18. upasthāne āgnīdhrasya prākṛtamantraviniyogaḥ jyoti- ṣṭome |
vi. 3|18. upasthāne gārhapatyasya kadācaneti mantraḥ śrutiprābalyatvāt |
iti prāpte, āhavanīyasyādiśabdānāṃ tattadāyatanasthitasakṛtāmivāci- tvena home iva taditarakāryeṣyapi tāṭasthyeva āvaśya- katvāt tat uddhṛtyaivopasthānam |
saṃkarṣa. 3|2|8. upasthānādyādhikāraḥ puṃsaḥ eva, na striyāḥ |
su. pṛ. 1202. upasthitaparityāge mānābhāvena savanīyasya prāthamyaṃ sādhyate āśvinagrahottaraṃ paśutrayasya sahopalambhe |
ke. 5|1|6|13. upahavye kratau aupadeśikāśvadakṣiṇā prākṛta- kṛṣṇalaṛtudakṣiṇāyāḥ bādhaḥ |
bhā. 10|3|18|65-67, upahavye nāma ekāhe aśva eva dakṣiṇā |
sā ca brahmaṇe eva deyā itareṣāmānātistu laukikena dānena kartavyā |
10|3|18|65-67. ‘upahūtaḥ upahavyaḥ’ iti mantrasya liṅgena vibhajya viniyogaḥ kartavyaḥ |
tatra somabhakṣe praśne ‘upahavya’ iti, uttare ca ‘upahūtaḥ’ iti |
upahomāḥ nakṣatreṣyādau ‘agnaye svāhā kṛtti- kābhyaḥ svāhā’ ityādayaḥ |
vi. 5|2|9, upahomāḥ paścāt, nāriṣṭhahomāḥ prāk ityevaṃ krameṇa nakṣatreṣyādau pradhānottaramanuṣṭhānaṃ kartavyam |
( yājñikāstu nāriṣṭha- homān kṛtvā upahomān kurvanti |
tatsaṃbadapada- vyākhye'pi kathaṃbhāvāniyantritā eva gṛhyante iti varṇayanti |
ṭupū. 8|1|31. upahomaḥ upadiṣṭaḥ ādiśikṣānaṃ nāriṣṭhahomānāṃ samuccayaḥ |
nakṣatreṣyādau nāriṣṭhahomāḥ pūrvaṃ, upahomāḥ paścāt kāryāḥ |
pṛ. 140. upāṃśutvāt uccaistvaṃ brūyāt : 'guṇa svarūpato dharmaḥ pradhānadvāro'paraḥ |
yatra syāt tatra vijñeyaṃ guṇadharmasya bādhanam |
su. 3|1|14|42, upāṃśutvarūpo dharmaḥ pradhānadveṇa aṅgāni prāpnuvan adharmaḥ ityevaṃ kathyate, na tu aṅgasya svarūpeṇa upāṃśutvāpādikā yajurvedai sākṣāt codanā asti |
pṛ. 1177. upāṃśutvanyāyaḥ dvividhaḥ; 3|8|19|36- 36 ekaḥ; 9|1|12-3 varṇakaṃ 2 iti cāparaḥ |
prathamaviṣaye tu idamucyate 'tasmāt yatkiñcit prācitamamīmāṃsīyāt tenopāṃśu caranti' iti vākyavihitasya upāṃśukhasya 'yāvatyā vācā kāmayīta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāyāmanubrūyāt' iti dīkṣaṇīyāmātra
utpattestu niveśaḥ syād, guṇasyānuparodhenārthasya vidyamānatvād, vidhānāntarā'dhesya naimittika- tvāt, tadabhāve'śrutau syāt |
antarālasya guṇaḥ utpattivākyena śrūyate, 'upāṃśuyājamanantarā yajati' iti |
tasmādasya guṇasyānuparodhena guṇau niveśeta, naikapuro- ḍāśāyāṃ syāt |
tada- bhāve antarālasyābhāve, aśrutau yadi dvipuroḍāśo na śrūyate, tataḥ syaikapuroḍāśāyāmupāṃśuyājaḥ |
'āgneyasyaiva no upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti paurṇamāsīdhaḥ ekapuroḍāśaṃ varjayan upahyate |
bhāṣyam —guṇaśca antarālaṃ pradhānārthaṃ śrūyate upāṃśu- yājārthena, antarālenopāṃśuyājyopakartavyamiti |
paurṇamāsyāṃ śrayamāṇa upāṃśuyājaḥ ekapuroḍāśāyā api paurṇamāsītvāt prāpnoti |
tasmādantarālasya guṇasya śākhaṃ yadā paurṇamāsī tadeti syāt |
yathā 'upaveṣaṇa kapālānyupadadhāti' iti yadupaveṣaḥ, tadā teneti gamyate |
evamihāpi yadā antarāla, tadā antarāle bhaviṣyati |
nanu antarālamupāṃśu- yājaḥ śrūyamāṇaḥ antarālābhāvādyujyamāno'pi, paurṇa- māsyāmekapuroḍāśāyāṃ vaiguṇyāt phalasya asādhakaḥ |
phalavatī hi sā bhaviṣyati, yadā dvipuroḍāśā saṃbhaviṣya- tīti |
yadi ekapuroḍāśāyāṃ vaiguṇyamupāṃśu- yāja syāt, tato na kriyate, na tu vaiguṇyamasti |
ki tarhi ? kālaṃ lakṣa- yituṃ, yau puroḍāśau tayormadhye, iti |
katham ? anyathāhi tau puroḍāśau etadvidhīyate, 'jāmi vā etadyajñasya kriyate, yadanyaśrau puroḍāśau, upāṃśuyājamanantarā yajati' iti |
yau tāvanuditau yathā vyavahitau bhavataḥ, tatho- pāṃśuyājaḥ kartavyaḥ |
katham ? yo hi dvayoḥ puroḍāśayormadhyeḥ iti kālo'vagamyate, sa eva pūrvasmāduttara iti |
evaṃ cet, yadyapi ekapuroḍāśāyāṃ dvau puroḍāśau na staḥ, tathāpi sa pūrvaṃ āgneyo'sti |
yasmin āme na nāgāḥ, na śaṅkhāḥ, na paṭahaḥ |
praśaṃsāpā upāṃśu- yājasya vaicitryeṇa, na tu etadevātra vidhīyate, yada- jāmitvamiti |
kutaḥ ? vihitasya hi prayojanaṃ vicī- yate |
na caivaṃ sati upāṃśuyājo vihitaḥ syāt |
na ca ajāmikaraṇaṃ nāma kiṃcididaṃ phalam |
'amṛtaṃ vā ājyaṃ martyaṃ havi- ryadupastṛṇāti abhighārayati amṛtāhutimevaināṃ karoti ' iti |
' karmāṅgabhūtasya kālasya ekapuro- ḍāśāyāmapi labhāt tatrāpi upāṃśuyājo na bādhi- tavyaḥ |
syādvā, nāstyanta- (nāsti, anta - ) reyukalpaye kāle'sti śaṅkhavat |

bhāṭṭa —paurṇamāsyāmāgneyayoḥ kriyamāṇaḥ upāṃśuyājaḥ kiṃ dvipuroḍāśāyāmeve syāt, uta somayāgāt pūrvamamī- pomīyādvādyarthaṃ caindrāgnābhāvādāgneyamātratve naikapuro- ḍāśāyāmapi syāditi cintāyāṃ, antarālakālasya pūrvottarabhāvipuroḍāśadvayanirūpakatvāt nirūpakaviśiṣṭasyaiva aṅgatvena tadabhāve tasyāllābhāvāt antarālasya ca satyapi paurṇamāsyādikāle 'amāvāsyāyāmaparāhṇe' itivat tasyāhyattā itarasyānaṅgatvān dvipuroḍāśāyāmeva upāṃśu- yājakaraṇam |

iti prāpte, puroḍāśadvayasya kalpaprayojanatvena svataḥ upāṃśuyājajñānatvāt kālaviśeṣaṇatve ca viśiṣṭa- vidhigauravāpatteḥ : kālopalakṣaṇamātratayā pratīteḥ, kālasya ca 'śaṅkhavelāyāmāgantavyam' ityādau loke śrutopalakṣaṇā- bhāve'pi upalakṣaṇāntaratasya āgamanadikkriyā- 'nyadarśanai sutarāmāyupuroḍāśopalakṣaṇenaiva anyapuroḍāśa- rūpopalakṣaṇābhāve'pi kriyopalakṣaṇopapatteḥ |
ataśca nātra paurṇamāsyādikālsya antarālakālena saṃkocātsya bādhaḥ |
yadā tu antarālapadena āgneyottararūpaḥ kramaḥ eva vidhīyate, mantrapāṭhakamaprāptatvāt anyute veti vibhāvyate, tadā uttarapadārthalope pūrvapadārthalopaḥ |
tatra ca prajāpatiḥ viṣṇuḥ amīpomau ca vikalpena devatā |
bhā. 10|8| 17|59-61. • upāṃśuyājaḥ paurṇamāsyāmeva, nāmā- vāsyāyāmiti vyavasthāsti |
yukto vā bahuvacanabrāhmaṇe (kauṣītake) spaṣṭena vākyena (atha yat saṃyavasāyāntyasya antareṇopāṃśuyajña yajati, tayorbrahmaṇaṃ ityanena |
(tātravṛtāmamīpomau ājyasyaiva nau upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan ityevavādāt ) vi. 5|1|8, 10|8|16. • upāṃśuyājasya utpattivākye devatā'-bhāvāt adhyaktā (iti cet ), ucyate |
• upāṃśu-yājasya 'davinnarayadyo bhūṣāmamaṃ dameyaṃ' iti mantraḥ yathāsaṃkhyakramāt sidhyati |
kiṃ prāptam ? yadat dravyaṃ prati aniyamaḥ : pūrvādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣe, tadvat devatāyāṃ aniyamaḥ |
tasmāt prakṛtānāṃ tantramabhānāṃ anya- tamayā devatayā prakṛtatvādekavākyatāṃ kṛtvā devatāṃ avagamiṣyāma: |
soma— pūrvavadiha niyamakāmābhāvāt arthaprātadevatā'- ntaresya na bādha: ityucyate : saṃgati: |
sūtrārthastu— pūrvādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣe dravye yathā aniyama: , tadvat devatāyā api aniyama: syāditi |
vi— ' tatra ya: ko'pi deva: syāt tāntriko vā , 'grimo bhavet |

upastaraṇābhighāraṇāśrayatvāt ' iti, nopastaraṇābhighāraṇa- vacanaṃ caturavattasya vākyaśeṣabhūtaṃ, yathā ' satadaśa sāmidhenīranubrūyāt ' iti mitravindā''diṣu satadaśa anubrūyāt iti, naivamiha caturavadyet |
kathaṃ tarhi ? caturavadānasaṃyuktaṃ dravyaṃ juhuyāt haviṣya upastṛṇīyāt, abhighārayecceti |
yatra havidhi upastaryamāṇe abhighāryamāṇe ca caturavatta- yuktaṃ pradānaṃ bhavati, tatra na pradhānadravyāt caturavadāta- vyam |
yatra punaḥ pradhānadravyāt caturavaṇḍamantareṇa na caturavattaṃ bhavati, tatra pradhānadravyāt caturavadātavyam |
caturavattabhūtamiha hotavyaṃ vivakṣyate netastato vā caturava- dātavyamiti |
' ' caturavattaṃ juhoti ' iti vākyāt asyupāṃśuyāje caturavattam |
bhāṭṭa-- yadā catuḥsaṃkhyāyā api uddeśyatā'vacche- dakoṭipraviṣṭatvena catuḥsaṃkhyākāvadānavidhikalpanā, tadā kimupāṃśuyāje caturavattaṃ bhavati na iti kṛtvācintayā cintyate |
idaṃ ca upāṃśuyāje caturgṛhītavidhānastīti kṛtvācintā'ntaraṃ bodhyam |

tatrāvadānāṅgatvacatuḥ- saṃkhyāyāḥ aupadhasānāṃyavyoḥ paśavadupastaraṇābhighāraṇābhyāṃ saṃpāditatvāt upastaraṇābhighāraṇayośca suci asaṃsargārtha- tathā upāṃśuyāje arthalopātpranivṛtteḥ caturavattasyāpi lopaḥ |

iti prāpte, vihitacatuḥsaṃkhyāyāḥ ' dvirhaviṣyo- 'vadyati ' ityanena haviṣyo dviradāne vihite auṣadha- sāṃnāyyasthale upastaraṇābhighāraṇābhyāṃ paśuvat saṃpādane'pi saṃkoce pramāṇabhāvena upāṃśuyāje'pi pravṛttāyāstathā havi- paiva saṃpādanāpatterlope pramāṇābhāvāt kartavyameva catura- vattam |

vastutastu pūrvoktavidhayā avacchedodeśenaiva prakṣepa- vidhānāt catuḥsaṃkhyāyā uddeśyatā'vacchedakoṭipraveśā- bhāvena avidheyatvādupāṃśuyāje upastaraṇābhighāraṇayoḥ prayo- janābhāvena lope'pi ' dvirhaviṣyo'vadyati ' ityanena hi avadānasyaiva prāptau ' catura ājyasya gṛhṇāti ' ityupāṃśu- yājāvāntaraprakaraṇatvāt vākyena upāṃśuyājoddeśena śrovā- pādānakacaturgṛhītavidhānāt tenaivopānśuyājaḥ, tasyaiva ca prakṣepaḥ pratipattiḥ |

yattvanārabhyādhītaṃ ' caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti ' iti vacanaṃ, tena amihitadravyakabhedanahomāyanu- vādena caturgṛhītavidhānaṃ, na tūpāṃśuyāje, juhotinā yāgalakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt, prākaraṇikatrauyavidhinā tasyaiva hyavadānaprasaktau anārabhyādhītacaturgṛhīta- vāghaprasaṅgācca |
ataḥ ' ājyācca sarvasaṃyogāt ' itya- dhikaraṇabhāṣyalikhitopāṃśuyājaprakaraṇapaṭhitavākyādeva tatra caturgṛhītavidhiḥ |
' ( upāṃśuyāje tu tadvet iti pāṭha āvaśyakaḥ |
